title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

About the team
Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical experience
- Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.)
- Associate or higher education in related field
- Experience with reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

title: Senior Program Manager, Corporate Accounting Enterprise Program Office (CAEPO)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Program Manager to join the Corporate Accounting Enterprise Program Office (CAEPO) responsible for contributing to the launch of automation initiatives across the Accounting organization. With the rapid growth of the company, it is essential to make continued investments in process improvement, automation, and technology. This role is based in the US but will have a globally impacting scope and will partner with the world-wide Accounting teams. A successful candidate in this position will have experience in accounting automation, aptitude for project management, technology, internal controls and process design.

This position supports and can directly influence the implementation of accounting technology automation solutions to drive process improvement, reduce manual effort, and improve financial controllership for account reconciliations and the overall month-end close cycle. It requires the ability to interpret accounting requirements and transform those to a technical solution with the support of technical partners. The Senior Program Manager will collaborate with a broad group of stakeholders from local and global accounting, business, finance and technical teams to deliver scalable solutions to complex problems.

The candidate will benefit from having operated successfully in a fast-paced global organization. Strong prioritization and communication skills are required in representing the accounting organization’s responsibility of financial controllership to internal stakeholders from non-financial disciplines. Practical project management experience is required, along with demonstrable exposure to leading and delivering on technical projects.

The role offers the opportunity to participate in influencing innovative business and accounting opportunities and to work closely with experienced cross-functional partners. As a member of the team, this individual will also have access to internal training and coaching opportunities to further develop the skills required to excel as a Senior Program Manager in the organization.

Key Job Responsibilities
- Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders to influence automation design and implementation with financial best practices
- Gather and document detailed functional accounting requirements and drive the prioritization and execution of technical deliverables
- Define a project plan and think critically to identify, evaluate and communicate on potential risks and obstacles early in the project lifecycle
- Define and execute on the pre-launch user acceptance testing and lead the automation launch readiness assessment
- Prioritize effectively to manage a diverse portfolio of projects, supporting manual effort reduction, account reconciliation automation, and process efficiency while maintaining financial control
- Streamline program delivery across the accounting organization by standardizing project communications, execution and documentation, ensuring consistent, scalable global processes
Role can be based out of Seattle, Arlington, Los Angeles, Boston, Austin, Nashville, Portland.

Key job responsibilities
- Proven technical and functional expertise related to Blackline financial close automation solutions or similar ERP’s.
- Partner with key counterparts across geographies to launch business and/or technical initiatives in a scalable and cost effective manner
- End-to-end project management across a suite of launches within a program
- Develop a solid understanding of Amazon’s Finance - systems and processes
- Translate complex business requirements into functional designs
- Oversee comprehensive testing of systems changes and development of standard operating procedures, process documentation and performance metrics
- Manage process transitions/implementations across multiple functions and geographies
- Motivate and influence business, operational and technical teams to ensure that best practices are followed and implemented
- Identify, assess, track and mitigate risks at multiple levels
- Proactively monitor program performance to identify, address and prevent potential issues
- Address barriers through problem solving, communication and active coordination with stakeholders
- Drive effective teamwork, communication collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field

title: Sr. Innovation and Design Eng, Worldwide Design and Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you an innovative leader that wants to architect the next generation of automated fulfillment solutions before they become reality? Do you want high-level ownership in solving complex, ambiguous problems at the earliest stages of concept development? Does the challenge of designing advanced system integrations that leverage breakthrough technologies, robotics, and material handling equipment appeal to you? If so, we have the job for you!

We're looking to add a high-impact Innovation & Design Engineer to our Advanced Concept Team. In this role, you will drive early-stage concept design and system modeling for next-generation fulfillment architectures. You will own advanced concept projects from initial modeling through design approval, creating the blueprints that guide future network implementation. You will develop functional requirements and collaborate with product development teams, ensuring automation technologies meet holistic fulfillment needs.
Your projects will focus on advanced concept integration across multiple automation technologies, creating solutions that span hardware, software, and operational requirements. You will work on concepts that may become templates for new construction or retrofit strategies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.

You will collaborate with a team of highly skilled engineers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where business problems are often undefined. Our team operates horizontally across WWDE's business verticals, with regular senior leadership engagement. You will be challenged to think strategically; you will learn cutting-edge automation technologies; you will work on high-impact, high-visibility concepts that shape Amazon's fulfillment strategy; you will grow as a technical leader through mentoring and cross-functional collaboration.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end concept design including physical layout, system modeling, and ergonomic assessment for next-generation automated fulfillment solutions
• Design advanced concept integration for ASRS, robotics, and material handling equipment in early-stage development phases
• Create visual prototypes and design artifacts that communicate complex automation concepts to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership
• Develop cost-effective solutions leveraging automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and robotics for future network implementation
• Create technical documentation including functional requirements which guide product development for downstream implementation teams
• Author technical white papers that convey highly complex designs and trade-offs to senior leadership audiences
• Iterate on early-stage concept designs through simulation and modeling to optimize space utilization, throughput, and operational efficiency

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing CAD layouts for a next-generation ASRS concept, refining integration points based on simulation results. Mid-morning, you present visual prototypes of your robotic cell design to the product team, translating complex automation concepts into clear functional requirements. After lunch, you mentor an junior engineer on their first advanced concept design, helping them think through system-level trade-offs and ergonomic considerations. You close the day iterating on layout optimizations for your second active project, a regional distribution center retrofit concept, preparing technical documentation that will guide the implementation team's development phase.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our
customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is looking for an energetic, detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team in the Greater Milan Area. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers.

Also expected from the CE is the ability to manage large scale impacting projects and new region support from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, procurement, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The CE directs, trains and supports EOTs in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems.

The role will be based in the Greater Milan area, however flexibility is required to travel to other locations within the EMEA region if required.


Key job responsibilities
- Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in data centers
- Assist in the design and build out of new facilities
- Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center region and work OT hours as needed to support site stability
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
- Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
- Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and assisting in recruiting efforts for the same
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
- Utilize internal Change Management Systems to manage building workflows
- MV/LV Isolation to facilitate MV maintenance
- Provide metric availability reporting on a weekly basis

The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate the following competencies and behaviors:
- Ability to solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context.
- Aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving.
- Ability to maintain SLAs through the implementation of proactive issue detection and immediate response.
- Proven experience of reading SLDs and control schematics.
- Ability to follow support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries into a trouble ticket system.
- Shows good judgment and instincts in decision making.
- Ability to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment.
- Ability to demonstrate their ability to take ownership of technical issues brought to them by their customer base

Physical Requirements:
· Work at heights and from ladders.
· Perform physical tasks
· Work in a noisy environment with ear protection

**To apply, please submit a detailed copy of your CV in English**

Working location:
Our data centers are located in remote areas outside Milan, where access via public transport may be limited. Therefore, a valid driving license is required for this role.

Work Schedule:
This is a 100% in-person onsite position due to the hands-on nature of managing mission-critical infrastructure. The role follows standard working hours (8 AM – 5 PM Milan time from Mo - Fri) with no shift work.

Working language:
Please be advised that the interview process at AWS will be conducted in English, as we are an international team based in the Greater Milan area.

designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between data
centers and customers.

Network Development Engineers perform high quality network and/or systems operations, deployments, scaling, technology refresh, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.

Engineers in the Internet Edge organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we evolve routing policy, implement traffic engineering solutions, grow our peering footprint, secure the “front door” from bad actors on the Internet, and architect the hardware platforms and network design to support any Amazon product that needs to reach end-users worldwide. Our infrastructure moves terabits of traffic to and from the Internet at any given moment, and represents one of the largest edge surface areas in the world, requiring complex solutions to ensure that capacity always stays ahead of demand. To accomplish that, our engineers develop automation, write software, and work with a wide range of partner teams to continually improve and automate our Internet connectivity in areas such as capacity delivery, configuration deployment, impairment detection, and traffic optimization. Internet Edge engineers make decisions on both a day-to-day and long-term strategic basis, which carry a large amount of responsibility and impact across all of Amazon’s products.

descriptionHtml:

Key job responsibilities

- Drive a culture of proactive risk identification and mitigation by establishing early warning systems, leveraging data insights, and building strong partnerships across functions. Guide your team in developing sound judgment to spot emerging people-related risks before they impact the business.

And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

- Excited about a mix of office and field work.

You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. title: Principal, Senior Principal and Distinguished Engineer, AWS Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Agentic AI drives innovation at the forefront of artificial intelligence, enabling customers to transform their businesses through cutting-edge AI solutions. We build and deliver the foundational AI services that power the future of cloud computing, helping organizations harness the potential of AI to solve their most complex challenges. Join our dynamic team of AI/ML practitioners, applied scientists, software engineers, and solution architects who work backwards from customer needs to create groundbreaking technologies.

Role Overview

We are seeking exceptional Principal Engineers to join the Agentic AI organization at AWS. This requisition represents multiple opportunities across various teams building the next generation of AI agent platforms, services, and tools. As AI agents proliferate across the industry, AWS is at the forefront of this transformation, building the technical foundation that will make sophisticated multi-agent workflows accessible to developers worldwide. In these roles, you'll design, build, and scale systems that genuinely move the needle for customers — leveraging the latest AI-powered development tools to work faster, think bigger, and ship better. We're looking for Principal Engineers who bring rare technical knowledge, a builder's instinct, and the kind of curiosity that doesn't stop at "good enough."

What You'll Do

As a Principal Engineer in Agentic AI, you will be a hands-on technical leader tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems in the rapidly evolving Generative AI space. You will:


• Deliver high-impact technical projects and architect software systems built to scale — leveraging cutting-edge AI-powered development tools to push the boundaries of what's possible.
• Build trend-setting AWS services in the Gen AI field, solving the hardest engineering challenges to enable machine learning powered solutions for customers
• Deliver strategic technical projects that have significant bottom-line impact on our business and competitive position
• Design and architect large-scale systems that are scalable, efficient, and fault tolerant as tier zero Amazon services
• Provide technical leadership by mentoring engineers and drawing from deep technical expertise to guide complex technical decisions
• Shape technology, product, and business in a fast-moving, startup environment within a large company
• Work across domains including compute, databases, networking, identity, and ML science teams

Depending on your background and interests, you may work on:

• AgentCore Platform: Building comprehensive, modular infrastructure for deploying and operating autonomous AI agents securely and at scale, including serverless runtime, memory, identity, gateway, and observability components
• Agent Orchestration: Developing sophisticated multi-agent coordination and workflow orchestration patterns, solving intrinsically hard problems in context management, state coordination, and autonomous system control
• Knowledge & Evaluation: Creating robust evaluation frameworks, knowledge retrieval systems, and augmentation services that power AI-driven solutions with accurate, context-aware information
• Security & DevOps: Implementing Shift Left Security by building intelligent security agents that perform application security engineering and penetration testing functions, preventing insecure code from reaching production
• Migration & Modernization: Accelerating enterprise modernization through agentic AI services that transform .NET, mainframe, and VMware workloads


Key job responsibilities
Deliver some of our most strategic technical projects and design new software systems at scale

Lead architecture and engineering strategy for critical AI agent platforms and services

Mentor engineers and provide leadership on complex technical issues

Work closely with product, engineering, and science leaders to drive innovation

title: Gestionnaire, Opérations de centres de données/ Data Center Manager , YUL Datacenter Operations
descriptionHtml:
Gestionnaire, Opérations de centres de données


Amazon Web Services (AWS) est en forte croissance et est à la recherche d’un gestionnaire de centre de données pour rejoindre son équipe d’exploitation des infrastructures en pleine expansion.

AWS est une entreprise de technologie très dynamique et leader mondial dans le domaine des centres de données. Le poste permettra d’assurer la disponibilité et la fiabilité globales pour atteindre ou surpasser les niveaux de service définis pour les opérations du centre de données. Notre équipe de gestion des infrastructures est actuellement à la recherche de gestionnaires de la technologie ayant de l’expérience en gestion du personnel, une solide connaissance technique, et le dynamisme et la vision nécessaires pour mener l’exploitation des centres de données d’AWS au prochain niveau. Le candidat retenu aura de l’expérience dans la création et l’élaboration de stratégies, le mentorat de personnes à tous les niveaux, le parrainage de projets et la proposition de solutions techniques. Ce poste consiste à diriger des équipes de diagnostic de matériel et de réseaux, et de réparation. Ce poste inclut la participation à une rotation de garde. Tous les candidats doivent être prêts à travailler de manière indépendante et à gérer efficacement leurs équipes. L’établissement des priorités de travail, les compétences organisationnelles, la communication efficace et la capacité de réagir rapidement sont essentiels à la réussite. En plus de posséder une solide connaissance des opérations d’un centre de données et de la réparation de matériel informatique et des réseaux, le candidat devra produire des documents, apporter des solutions novatrices, participer à des projets qui s’étendent sur tout le site, et résoudre des problèmes complexes à l’intérieur du centre de données. Cette équipe travaille dans un environnement qui fonctionne 24 h/24 et 7 j/7.

Ce poste exige que le candidat sélectionné obtienne et conserve une cote de sécurité active du statut de fiabilité auprès du gouvernement du Canada.
Puisque ce rôle nécessite que l’employé interagisse avec d’autres entités d’Amazon à l’échelle mondiale ainsi qu’avec des employés et d’autres intervenants dans d’autres provinces canadiennes la connaissance du français et de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste.


Data Center Manager

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a Data Center Manager to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team

AWS is a fast paced technology company and a leader in the world of data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. We are currently expanding our infrastructure management team and are looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people in all levels, sponsoring projects and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation. All candidates should be willing to work both independently and managing their teams effectively. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. In addition to strong knowledge in Data Centers, hardware and network repair, candidates will create documentation, innovate solutions, participate in site-level project work, and fix complex problems within the Data Center Space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7.

This position requires that the candidate selected obtain and maintain an active Reliability Status security clearance with the Government of Canada.
Due to the nature of the role that requires interaction with other Amazon entities globally and with Amazon employees and stakeholders in other provinces in Canada, bilingualism French and English is required for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités

Le candidat retenu sera responsable des opérations d'un centre de données. Parmi les responsabilités principales, on retrouve :

• Prioriser et attribuer les billets de support aux techniciens et opérateurs du centre de données
• Gérer la performance d'une équipe diversifiée de professionnels en opérations de centres de données, avec des compétences variées sur plusieurs sites
• Développer et maintenir des parcours de carrière pour les employés et effectuer les mises à jour dans nos outils internes
• Recruter et former des techniciens en centres de données afin d'assurer des niveaux d'effectifs adéquats en tout temps
• Assurer une gestion efficace et efficiente des opérations quotidiennes du centre de données, incluant la gestion des files d'attente, la planification des quarts de travail 24h/24 et 7j/7, ainsi que la logistique du matériel informatique
• Développer ou appliquer une expertise approfondie dans tous les aspects des opérations de centres de données
• S'assurer que tous les indicateurs de performance opérationnels sont mesurés, suivis et atteints de manière constante
• Inspirer et guider l'amélioration continue des processus d'équipe, de l'innovation technologique et de l'automatisation
• Gérer les événements à grande échelle, notamment les pannes, et agir en tant que responsable principal lors des escalades
• Gérer et améliorer les flux de travail et le débit des opérations des centres de données
• Recommander, documenter et superviser les politiques et procédures conformes aux meilleures pratiques de l'industrie et aux SLA requis
• Maintenir le calendrier de garde en coordonnant les absences et les congés de l'équipe
• Collaborer avec les partenaires interfonctionnels, notamment les équipes d'ingénierie, de planification de capacité et des installations, afin de soutenir les objectifs opérationnels
• Être passionné par la qualité et la constance des services offerts et s'efforcer continuellement d'améliorer l'expérience client

--------------------------------------

Key Job Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:
• Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
• Manage the performance of a diverse team of data center operations professionals with varying skills across multiple locations
• Develop and maintain career paths for employees and update records in our internal tools
• Recruit and train data center technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels at all times
• Ensure effective and efficient management of day to day data center operations including queue management, 24/7 shift scheduling, and hardware logistics
• Develop or apply subject matter expertise across all aspects of data center operations
• Ensure all operational KPIs and metrics are being measured, tracked, and consistently met
• Inspire and guide continuous improvement in team processes, technology innovation, and automation
• Manage large scale events including outages and serve as the primary call leader during escalations
• Manage and improve workflows and throughput across data center operations
• Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures aligned with industry best practices and required SLAs
• Maintain the on-call schedule while coordinating team absences and vacation coverage
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including engineering, capacity planning, and facilities teams to support operational goals
• Be passionate about the quality and consistency of services delivered and continuously strive to improve the customer experience



A day in the life
À propos de notre équipe

Nous sommes l'équipe qui assure le bon fonctionnement de l'infrastructure. Jour après jour, nos professionnels en opérations de centres de données se présentent avec un sens des responsabilités qui va bien au-delà de la file de billets. Nous résolvons des problèmes, nous bâtissons, nous améliorons et nous prenons soin les uns des autres. C'est la culture que nous avons construite, et c'est une culture que nous protégeons.

Notre mission est claire : offrir des opérations de centres de données fiables et de haute qualité sur lesquelles nos clients et partenaires peuvent compter. Nous nous mesurons à cette norme chaque jour, à travers nos indicateurs de performance, nos temps de réponse et les retours que nous recevons des équipes que nous soutenons. Mais les chiffres ne racontent qu'une partie de l'histoire. L'autre partie, c'est la façon dont nous nous traitons mutuellement et dont nous grandissons ensemble.

C'est une équipe qui valorise l'apprentissage. Nous investissons dans le développement de carrière parce que nous croyons que les meilleures opérations viennent de personnes qui se sentent soutenues et stimulées à parts égales. Nous recrutons pour le potentiel, nous formons pour l'excellence et nous créons un espace où chaque membre de l'équipe peut tracer son propre chemin.

Nous opérons sur plusieurs sites, ce qui signifie que nous avons appris à bien communiquer, à coordonner nos efforts à travers les fuseaux horaires et à faire confiance les uns aux autres pour maintenir les standards, même lorsque personne ne regarde. Ce type de confiance ne se construit pas par hasard. Il se forge à travers la constance, la transparence et un engagement commun à bien faire le travail.

Le candidat idéal apporte bien plus qu'une expertise technique. Vous dirigez avec empathie et vous vous tenez responsable de la croissance de votre équipe avec la même rigueur que vous appliquez à la performance de vos systèmes. Vous créez un environnement où les gens se sentent en sécurité pour soulever des problèmes, poser des questions et apprendre de leurs erreurs. Vous êtes à l'aise lorsque le plan n'est pas encore écrit. L'ambiguïté ne vous freine pas. Elle vous motive à construire une structure, à mobiliser les gens autour de vous et à améliorer la façon dont les choses fonctionnent.

Si vous êtes quelqu'un qui tire fierté de l'excellence opérationnelle, qui aime résoudre des problèmes complexes et qui souhaite diriger une équipe qui se soucie vraiment de ce qu'elle bâtit, vous vous sentirez chez vous ici.
---------------------------
About Our Team

We are the team that keeps the infrastructure running. Day in and day out, our data center operations professionals show up with a sense of ownership that goes beyond the ticket queue. We troubleshoot, we build, we improve, and we look out for each other. That is the culture we have built, and it is one we protect.

Our mission is straightforward: deliver reliable, high-quality data center operations that our customers and partners can count on. We measure ourselves against that standard every day, through our KPIs, our response times, and the feedback we receive from the teams we support. But the numbers only tell part of the story. The other part is how we treat each other and how we grow together.

This is a team that values learning. We invest in career development because we believe the best operations come from people who feel supported and challenged in equal measure. We recruit for potential, train for excellence, and create space for every team member to find their path forward.
We operate across multiple sites, which means we have learned to communicate well, coordinate across time zones, and trust each other to hold the standard even when no one is watching. That kind of trust does not happen by accident. It is built through consistency, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing the work right.

The ideal candidate brings more than technical depth. You lead with empathy and hold yourself accountable for the growth of your team with the same rigor you apply to the performance of your systems. You create an environment where people feel safe to raise issues, ask questions, and learn from mistakes. You are comfortable when the playbook is still being written. Ambiguity does not slow you down. It motivates you to build structure, bring people along, and improve the way things work.

If you are someone who takes pride in operational excellence, enjoys solving complex problems, and wants to lead a team that genuinely cares about what it builds, you will feel at home here.

title: Sr. Power Generation Engineer - Availability, Global Energy
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about large power infrastructure systems? Do you love to innovate, discover, and apply your knowledge to advance world-class systems? Do you get excited about the idea of pushing the boundaries of power system availability? We are seeking an experienced electrical engineer with extensive experience in power infrastructure design, including power generation, and reliability and availability modeling to support our growing requirements for novel solutions to delivering power to AWS data centers. We are looking for candidates with proven ability to influence technical teams, a track record of delivering complex power systems from design and specification through deployment, and a deep understanding of availability modeling.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), our data centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of data center critical infrastructure design, space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market, reliability, and lowest total cost of ownership. Our Engineers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is continually improving the world of cloud computing. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our mission, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. AWS’s work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. If you are a creative, smart, and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems, we want YOU!

As a Senior Power Generation Availability Engineer, you will serve as the Subject Matter Expert and technical leader within the Power Generation Solutions team for power system availability modeling. You will own complex and ambiguous problems that span multiple teams and drive technical decisions that impact AWS’ global infrastructure strategy. You will lead availability modeling of different power and energy configurations, including new strategies and technologies to ensure that we can exceed our customers expectations for delivering power to our data centers.

Additionally, you will have a role in defining power generation designs and evaluating designs against AWS’ strict requirements for safety, availability, cost, and sustainability impacts. This may include equipment selection and sizing, conceptual design development, creating single line diagrams, specifications, and participate in project development. Your technical expertise on system availability will guide cross-functional teams in making critical design decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and managing technical risks across complex power systems.

Amazon has a global presence, therefore, domestic and international travel may be necessary. Teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and collaborate with others to accomplish the required tasks. This includes working with internal groups as well as external suppliers and consultants, including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.


Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Power Generation Availability Engineer on the Power Generation Solutions team, you will be responsible for the following:
- Developing availability models and analysis of different power generation sources (including, but not limited to; utility sources, diesel generators, reciprocating engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, battery energy storage systems, and renewable energy) to serve data center loads in grid connected or grid independent configurations
- Support the development of power generation configurations for different applications, including primary, temporary, or backup power
- Understanding the design and functionality of the global data center fleet, including existing, upcoming, and unique site designs
- Interpreting, evaluating, and developing Single Line Drawings (SLD), engineering drawings, equipment submittals, equipment specifications documentation, and performance data to advance concepts and solutions
- Providing feedback to the Design Engineering teams for design revisions for new data centers as well as to Field Engineering for operational data center upgrades
- Understanding grid interconnection standards and requirements, including working on microgrid design and controls, and distributed energy resources
- Working on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions
- Being a leader within the group as well as within other teams
- Being positive and offer creative, out of the box solutions
- Having fun and working hard!

About the team
The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filtering, battery monitoring systems, branch circuit monitoring systems or SCADA systems
- Experience constructing electrical engineering systems including large scale power distribution/generation gear and mechanical engineering systems including cooling systems
- Experience with availability modeling software (ReliaSoft or similar software), familiarity with Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), outage data, and maintenance data of key high voltage, medium voltage, and low voltage electrical distribution equipment, energy storage equipment, and power generation equipment
- Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, single and three-line diagrams, P&ID drawings, submittals, sequence of operations, and mechanical and electrical drawing packages.
- Ability to analyze data and provide quantitative answers for outage rates, probability of outages, mean-time-between-failures (MTBF), mean-time-to-repair (MTTR), and additional metrics to evaluate power availability.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering
- Professional Engineer License
- 10+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
- Familiarity with power flow studies, substation design, protection coordination, and utility interconnection requirements, emerging power generation and energy storage technologies, and power distribution for large scale mission critical facilities.
- System Matter Expert level of understanding of both electrical equipment and designs related to data centers and power generation equipment
- Experience with gathering, compiling, and analyzing data to identify availability and/or performance risks within the design and operations of critical power infrastructure, including an understanding of data analysis methodologies and statistical techniques.
- Ability to produce analyses that ensure data centers satisfy defined design requirements, including availability goals, power quality specifications, and predicted performance targets.
- Experience with developing solutions and executing plans on fast-track design/build projects and/or multiple significant upgrade projects
- Experience with commissioning and/or performance testing of critical infrastructure and the associated controls systems for mission critical environments
- Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, R), or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, etc.)
- Possess excellent attention to detail and communication skills in order to maintain high quality standards for being organized, setting priorities, meeting deadlines, and staying within budgets
- Possess leadership and problem-solving skills

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About You:
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

About The Role:
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):

- Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
- Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
- Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
- Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
- Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
- Liaising with internal teams & management groups
- Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
- Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
- Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.

People Management.
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.

Incident Management.
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.

Vendor Management.
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.

Process Improvement.
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. Health & Safety.
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.

title: Graduate Logistik Manager - Bad Hersfeld, Hessen
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
• Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
• Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
• Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
• Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
• Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
• Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort


A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium vor dem Starttermin oder Abschluss innerhalb der letzten 24 Monate
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space.

AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

This role may require up to 40% travel to support site operations and project needs.

Key job responsibilities
As a Data Center Controls Engineer you will:

• Troubleshoot and perform Root Cause Analysis or Corrective Action for BMS and EPMS related issues in AWS data centers.
• Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.
• Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
• Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
• Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
• Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.
• Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management.
• Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
• Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
• Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
• Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
• Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
• Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

#DCCD_AMER

Basic qualifications

- Experience with power management and power monitoring systems
- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent, or 5+ years of industrial controls and automation experience
- 2. Experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).
- 3. A minimum of two (2) years in Controls or Electrical construction project coordination with multiple teams or vendors to meet project requirements.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains
- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent, or 6+ years of industrial controls and automation experience
- 2. Experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).

title: Program Manager Ⅲ , Production Planning Team
descriptionHtml:
Production Planning Team (PPT) within Amazon Japan Operations is seeking a Program Manager to lead strategic production planning initiatives across our nationwide network.

Amazon’s mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company and to offer the Earth’s widest selection. We continuously enhance the customer experience through selection, price, and convenience, powered by data-driven decision-making and operational innovation.

Established in 2023, PPT is a strategic organization responsible for advancing production planning capabilities and network optimization across more than 100 Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and External Fulfillment (EF) sites in Japan.

As a Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end strategy and execution of production planning across the FC/EF network. This role goes beyond short-term labor and capacity alignment; you will design scalable, long-term mechanisms that optimize accuracy, productivity, and cost efficiency at network scale.

You will be expected to challenge existing processes constructively, operate effectively in ambiguous environments, and make data-driven decisions with high judgment. Success in this role requires strong analytical capability, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders to drive large-scale operational transformation.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

アマゾンジャパンオペレーションのプロダクションプランニングチーム（PPT）では、プログラムマネージャーを募集しています。

Amazonは「地球上で最も豊富な品揃え」と「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業」をミッションに掲げ、Selection・Price・Convenienceを中核とした顧客体験の向上を追求し続けています。その実現のため、データドリブンな意思決定と継続的なイノベーションを通じて、オペレーションネットワークを進化させてきました。

PPTは2023年に設立された戦略組織であり、日本全国100以上のフルフィルメントセンター（FC）および外部フルフィルメント（EF）拠点を対象に、生産計画の高度化とネットワーク最適化を推進しています。

本ポジションでは、日本全国のFC/EFネットワーク全体を対象とした戦略的生産計画の策定・実行に対してオーナーシップを持っていただきます。短期的な需給調整に留まらず、中長期視点でスケーラブルな仕組みを設計し、精度・生産性・コスト効率の最適化を実現することが求められます。

既存プロセスを建設的に見直し、曖昧さの高い環境下においてもデータと論理に基づいた意思決定を行い、社内外のシニアステークホルダーを巻き込みながら変革を推進できるリーダーを求めています。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
[Important responsibilities of the program manager]
Own the strategy and execution of labor optimization across the JP FC/EF network, ensuring the right balance between cost efficiency and customer experience (CX), while driving sustainable improvements across short-term (3 months), mid-term (6 months), and long-term (1–3 years) horizons.

Design, implement, and continuously improve scalable labor cost management mechanisms that enable both operational network expansion and structural cost efficiency.

Lead the alignment of labor cost management practices with global standards while ensuring effective localization to meet the specific needs of Japan operations.

Identify, evaluate, and adapt global best practices to improve productivity, planning accuracy, and operational efficiency across the Japan FC/EF network.

Drive cross-regional collaboration to scale successful practices developed in Japan to other regions and contribute to the evolution of global planning standards.

Influence senior stakeholders across operations, finance, and global teams through data-driven insights, enabling aligned decision-making and effective execution of strategic initiatives.

[プログラムマネージャーの責任]
JP FC/EFネットワーク全体におけるLabor最適化の戦略策定および実行をリードし、コスト効率とCustomer Experience（CX）の両立を図りながら、短期（3ヶ月）、中期（6ヶ月）、長期（1～3年）の各時間軸で持続的な改善を推進する。

・ネットワークの拡大とコスト効率の両立を可能にする、スケーラブルなLabor Cost Managementの仕組みを設計・構築し、継続的な改善を行う。

・Labor Cost Managementにおけるグローバルスタンダードとの整合をリードするとともに、日本のオペレーション環境に適した形でのローカライズを推進する。

・海外のベストプラクティスを特定・評価し、日本のFC/EFネットワークに適用することで、生産性、計画精度、およびオペレーション効率の向上を推進する。

・日本で生まれた成功事例や新しいプランニングの仕組みをグローバルに展開し、グローバルな計画標準の発展に貢献する。

・データに基づく分析とインサイトを通じて、オペレーション、ファイナンス、およびグローバルチームのシニアステークホルダーに影響力を発揮し、戦略的な意思決定と施策の実行を推進する。

A day in the life
[Working style] ・Flextime ※ Standard working hours 8 hours/day and business hours is 9-18 (also consider personal circumstances). All business days are spent in the designated office or other company location.

[勤務形態] ・フレックスタイム制 ※標準労働時間帯は1日8時間、営業時間は9:00～18:00（個人の事情も考慮）。 原則すべての営業日で所定の拠点に出社。

About the team
This position works as a member of the PPT(Production Planning Team) within Amazon Japan's FNP team. Our team is in charge of a wide range of tasks, from short to long-term ranges, so that we can operate our ever-expanding Operation Network more efficiently, and we are making improvements day by day so that we can deliver products with a rich selection of products, sufficient inventory volume, and quick delivery speed to our customers. Amazon aims to create a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon complies with the Equal Employment Opportunity Act. We provide equal recruitment and selection opportunities without discrimination based on race, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other attributes.

title: SDE II - Backend, Cross Border Shopping Experience
descriptionHtml:
Stay local, shop global! Amazon Cross Border Shopping experiences allow customers to easily discover a wide selection of international products available from Amazon’s websites around the world, offering simplified customs, faster delivery, local language and payment support, and a world-class customer service. Global Store and Customer Exports have presence in multiple countries and is at the forefront of Amazon’s global expansion strategy. We have maintained a startup culture and are looking for a Software Development Engineer I with an entrepreneurial mindset and tech prowess to solve the next level of challenges in international shopping for worldwide customers.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer (SDE) to join the Cross Border Customer Experience team. In this role, the SDE will design, write, and maintain user experience software for Amazon shopping pages used by millions of customers around the world. The engineer will collaborate with world-class product managers to define the future direction of customer experience throughout the entire shopping journey (Search, Detail Page, All Offers Display, Cart, Checkout, Order Details Page) and will apply the best engineering practices to deliver working solutions for international Amazon customers. The SDE will work on customer’s international shopping journey including personalized recommendations and displaying relevant cross-border shopping information (pricing, delivery, legal) in order to enable customers to shop efficiently and with confidence while delivering on business goals. The SDE will adhere to best practices of software development in large-scale distributed systems while innovating and experimenting in an agile fashion. You will participate in the entire software lifecycle from concept, design, development, through testing, release, and maintenance. You will be mentored by tenured Amazon engineers and you will be expected to coach and mentor others around you.

Key job responsibilities
- Gather and analyze business and functional requirements, and translate business requirements into technical design specifications.
- Write high-quality, efficient, testable code and recommend improvements in development, maintenance, and system standards, and contribute to software documentation.
- Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions
- Maintain and support our software in production including urgent support for customer-facing systems
- Be responsible for technical problem solving, meeting product objectives, and developing best practices
- Serve as an essential technical resource in the full development cycle.
- Mentor junior team members technically
- Contribute to multi-year product and technical roadmaps

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Brand Specialist - UAE National, AVS (Amazon Vendor Services)
descriptionHtml:
Are you a self-starter with a passion for e-commerce, looking to expand your retail skillset and shaping the way the biggest brands work with Amazon?
Sounds great. What will I be working on?
As Brand Specialist, you will be part of the Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) team, which provides a suite of services designed to help Amazon's most strategic brands working across all key areas of retail business. You will work with vendors supplying the top brands on Amazon, acting as the main point of contact for them. Your priority will be to work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow your brands and improve their performance. You will do this while facilitating great business relationships and ensuring vendors' satisfaction with the service.

Key responsibilities as a Brand Specialist are:
• Own the relationship end-to-end with top brands
• Partner internally with key retail functions to contribute to the definition of priorities and operational goals according to the brands' needs
• Partner with our Media Team to ensure best-in-class event execution
• Define joint business plans and assist in delivering impact for the brands you support directly
• Regularly audit metrics to continually drive quality of the AVS experience and deliver targets
• Contribute to continuous enhancement and innovation within the AVS across MENA
Brand Specialists work on a variety of tasks for the brands they support, typically falling within the five focus areas. These include but are not limited to:
• Business Advice: Providing business advice based on deep financial analysis and reporting, to identify areas of opportunities
• Selection: Helping grow the selection of products by managing the launch of new products and improving product discoverability
• Availability: Support driving process improvement and operational excellence within our vendor community by reducing costs, defects, and lead times, while increasing innovation
• Traffic: Analyzing traffic channels and working on initiatives to generate traffic by supporting the development and execution of marketing and merchandising campaigns
• Conversion: Planning and executing promotional activities and improving customer journey on Amazon
Alongside this, you will contribute to improving the efficiency of the service itself. We are constantly working to build scale for this service through the right set of tools and cross-functional collaboration including but not limited to Tech teams.
This role is available in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
This role offers 360° exposure to different areas of the industry e-commerce, opening a multitude of career paths.




Key job responsibilities
• Be the point of brand and category expertise for Amazon Tier 1 Vendors - serving as a trusted business advisor
• Help by innovating new solutions to complex business challenges
• Own and manage significant pool of Tier 1 Vendors
• Developing, selling, implementing, and evaluating business plans to deliver or exceed on the vendor improvement plans
• Collaborating with multi-functional teams (Marketing, Finance, Supply, Operations, among others)
• Managing and improving pricing, visibility, and availability for your brands
• Translate Category Business Plans into tangible action plans
• Develop productive working relationships with the vendors and create the mutually beneficial value
• Turn raw data and insights into actionable conclusions
• Use analytical tools and integrate various data systems to develop new insights
• Identify opportunities to improve our products, services, processes, systems, and tools
• Work with different parts of the Amazon business to implement improvement projects, including working with category teams, product teams, and technical support team

- In final year of study for Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or graduated in the last 24 months with a degree in Business, Science, Engineering fields or Supply Chain
- Experience in key accounts management, projects management, customer facing roles or commercial roles
- Excellent analytical, problem solving and negotiating skills
- Advanced MS Office Skills (Excel proficiency is a must)
- English proficiency: Arabic speaking is an advantage
- UAE National with family book

Preferred qualifications

- Brand management of portfolio/regional roles
- Previous Key Account Management experience is an advantage
