title: Customer Solutions Manager, AWSI Automotive & Manufacturing, AWS
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join our global Automotive & Manufacturing Industries team. In this highly visible role, you will be responsible for helping guide AWS customers along their multi-year journey to the cloud, ensuring that all AWS teams are working together effectively and efficiently to deliver outcomes for the customer.

Our team is committed to helping industry enterprise customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.

You will be a critical partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with large scale cloud transformations and helping shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.

You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. You will manage cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live events and transitions are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.

You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. Your enterprise cloud experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.

Key job responsibilities
You will establish a deep understanding of your customer’s business vision, culture and processes, and evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt the right solution at the right time. Customer Solution Managers (CSM) are responsible for four focus areas:

Accelerating AWS Adoption through delivery and execution of customer cloud initiatives

Customer Enablement, you will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams

Implement governance structures to effectively govern both our partnership with the customer, and the customer’s adoption of AWS

CSMs are able to effectively coordinate cross-functional resources, drive disciplined project delivery, and quantify the tangible business benefits that customers realize through their cloud transformation initiatives. This holistic approach to customer engagement, coupled with the CSM's deep understanding of the Automotive & Manufacturing Industry and AWS capabilities; positions CSMs as trusted advisors who can guide customers through every stage of their cloud journey - from initial strategy and planning to migration, modernization, and ongoing optimization.

This position requires up to 25% travel.

About the team
The AWS Industries (AWSI) team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
- 5+ years of work in enterprise IT, either as a vendor, consultant or have prior experience working with or managing technical programs experience
- Experience in customer-facing roles
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written

Preferred qualifications

- AWS or other cloud certification
- Knowledge of the software development/engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery or IT lifecycle
- PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification

title: Power Generation Engineer, AWS Global Energy
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about large power infrastructure systems? Do you love to innovate, discover, and apply your knowledge to advance world-class systems? Do you get excited about the idea of pushing the boundaries of power system availability? We are seeking an experienced electrical engineer with a background in power infrastructure design, including power generation to support our growing requirements for novel solutions to delivering power to AWS data centers. We are looking for candidates with proven ability to influence technical teams, a track record of delivering power systems from design and specification through deployment, and a deep understanding of power generation designs.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), our data centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of data center critical infrastructure design, space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market, reliability, and lowest total cost of ownership. Our Engineers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is continually improving the world of compute. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our mission, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. AWS’s work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. If you are a creative, smart, and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems, we want YOU!

As a Power Generation Engineer, you will serve as a technical lead within the Power Generation Solutions team for the evaluation and development of primary, temporary, and backup power designs. You will own challenging and ambiguous problems that span multiple teams and drive technical decisions that impact AWS’ global infrastructure strategy. You will lead developing different power and energy configurations, including new strategies and technologies to ensure that we can exceed our customers expectations for delivering power to our data centers.

Additionally, you will have a role in defining power generation designs and evaluating designs against AWS’ strict requirements for safety, availability, cost, and sustainability impacts. This may include equipment selection and sizing, conceptual design development, creating single line diagrams, specifications, and participate in project development. Your technical expertise on will guide cross-functional teams in making critical design decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and managing technical risks across complex power systems.

Amazon has a global presence, therefore, domestic and international travel may be necessary. Teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and collaborate with others to accomplish the required tasks. This includes working with internal groups as well as external suppliers and consultants, including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

Key job responsibilities
As a Power Generation Engineer on the Power Generation Solutions team, you will be responsible for the following:
• Developing designs and analysis of different power generation sources (including, but not limited to; utility sources, diesel generators, reciprocating engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, battery energy storage systems, microgrids, distributed energy resources, and renewable energy) to serve data center loads in grid connected or grid independent configurations
• Support the development of power generation configurations for different applications, including primary, temporary, or backup power
• Understanding the design and functionality of the global data center fleet, including existing, upcoming, and unique site designs
• Interpreting, evaluating, and developing Single Line Drawings (SLD), engineering drawings, equipment submittals, equipment specifications documentation, and performance data to advance concepts and solutions
• Providing feedback to the Design Engineering teams for design revisions for new data centers as well as to Field Engineering for operational data center upgrades
• Understanding grid interconnection standards and requirements, including working on microgrid design and controls, and distributed energy resources
• Working on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions
• Being a leader within the group as well as within other teams
• Being positive and offer creative, out of the box solutions
• Having fun and working hard!


About the team
The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 3+ years of experience with leading power infrastructure designs in complex mission critical facilities combined with 3+ years of design or operational support for power generation infrastructure systems
- In-depth knowledge of continuous operating redundant electrical systems and power infrastructure. This includes but is not limited to; uninterruptible power sources, medium and low voltage electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches.
- Experience and knowledge of power generations equipment, systems, controls, including, but not limited to; diesel generators, distributed energy resources, gas turbines, battery energy storage systems.
- Experience and knowledge of medium-voltage and high-voltage equipment, including substation configurations, protection requirements, and integration of on-site power.
- Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, single and three-line diagrams, P&ID drawings, submittals, sequence of operations, and mechanical and electrical drawing packages.

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- 6+ years of direct experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical data centers or power infrastructure
- Familiarity with power flow studies, substation design, protection coordination, and utility interconnection requirements, emerging power generation and energy storage technologies, and power distribution for large scale mission critical facilities.
- System Matter Expert level of understanding of both electrical equipment and designs related to data centers and power generation equipment
- Experience with gathering, compiling, and analyzing data to identify availability and/or performance risks within the design and operations of critical power infrastructure, including an understanding of data analysis methodologies and statistical techniques.

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Databases, RDS Platform
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) powers millions of databases for customers ranging from startups building their first application to the world's largest enterprises running mission-critical workloads. RDS and Aurora together form the most widely used managed database portfolio in the cloud, and the AWS Console is how most of these customers interact with the service every day.

The RDS Console team builds the experience customers depend on to provision, configure, monitor, and operate their databases. We support every RDS engine and Aurora variant across all AWS regions, partnering with service teams to translate complex database capabilities into intuitive workflows. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead this team and define the next generation of the Console experience, making it simpler for new builders to get started, and giving experienced operators the control they need to manage fleets at scale.

Who would succeed in this role:
- A deeply technical leader who stays close to the customer as well as the software and architecture that power the customer experience. You are energized by building systems that are both technically sophisticated and deeply impactful to the business.

- A leader who coaches their team on building systems at scale with the right customer experience, and who reaches out across the company to enlist input from key engineers, product managers, and UX designers to bring the thinking into your team's decisions. You build alignment across organizational boundaries and turn diverse perspectives into a shared technical direction.

- A leader who dives deep into a problem to understand how things work, when to make a subtle change, and when to disrupt the status quo to achieve the right results. You are comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: one moment you are whiteboarding how to simplify a complex database workflow with your senior engineers, the next you are coaching a newer engineer through their first operational event.

- A leader who cares about their people as much as the customers. You create clarity for your team in ambiguous situations. You set a high bar but invest in helping everyone reach it. You default to trust and ownership, giving engineers the autonomy to make decisions while ensuring the right guardrails are in place.

Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.


Key job responsibilities
- Leading a team of software development engineers building customer-facing Console experiences across all RDS and Aurora engines and all AWS regions.
- Partnering with product, UX, and cross-functional teams to translate customer needs into compelling, intuitive interfaces.
- Driving operational excellence and ensuring high availability of Console services at scale.
- Hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering talent while raising the bar on technical quality.
- Collaborating across organizational boundaries with engine teams, control plane teams, and AWS Console platform teams to deliver integrated experiences.

About the team
The RDS Console team is part of the RDS Platform organization within Amazon RDS. We build the AWS Console experience that customers use every day to manage their databases across all RDS and Aurora engines.

We are a collaborative team that values ownership, customer obsession, and technical excellence. We partner broadly across RDS and take pride in making complex things simple. We believe in giving engineers real autonomy, investing in their growth, and building software we are proud to put in front of customers.

iverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Realtime Analyst, NCC, Network Control Center
descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業を目指し、カスタマーエクスペリエンスをすべての活動の中心に据えています。Amazon カスタマーサービス（CS）は、カスタマーエクスペリエンスの最前線に立ち、すべてのCSチャネルにおいて、あらゆるやり取りの中で、お客様に便利で高品質かつ喜ばれる体験を提供するために、たゆまぬ努力を続けています。

CS内のNetwork Solutionsは、世界最大のカスタマーサービスネットワークの設計、計画、運用を担当しています。需要を予測し、お客様を最適な体験にマッチングさせ、サービス品質を継続的に改善する、インテリジェントで適応性のあるシステムを構築しています。私たちは、CSを手動で運用されるリアクティブなモデルから、CSをAmazonの成長ドライバーおよび競争優位性とするAIネイティブなエコシステムへと変革しています。

カスタマーサービスのネットワークコントロールセンター（NCC）に参画いただくリアルタイムアナリストを募集しています。NCCは、Amazonカスタマーサービスの集中型インシデント管理機能です。お客様、アソシエイト、ドライバー、ブランドに影響を与える重大インシデントをリアルタイムで検知、管理、解決し、数十のクロスファンクショナルチームと連携して、お客様への影響を最小限に抑え、サービスを復旧させます。システムが大規模に障害を起こした時、コンタクト量が予測を超えて急増した時、またはサービス障害が数百万のお客様とのやり取りを脅かす時、NCCが指揮を執ります。

title: Software Development Engineer - Silicon Development Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
We're seeking a Software Development Engineer to help architect, build, and operate the
infrastructure that accelerates silicon development at Annapurna Labs. In this role, you'll
contribute to the platforms, tooling, and automation that enable our chip design teams to iterate
faster, validate more thoroughly, and bring transformative silicon to market. You'll work at the
intersection of cloud infrastructure, high-performance computing, and electronic design
automation—building systems that directly impact AWS's ability to innovate in custom silicon.
This is a unique opportunity to grow your skills in infrastructure that supports chip development
while working with world-class engineers across hardware, software, and operations disciplines.

Key job responsibilities
Customer-Focused Infrastructure Development
• Partner with silicon design, verification, emulation, and software teams to understand
their development workflows, pain points, and iteration cycles.
• Build tooling and automation that eliminates manual toil and reduces time-to-results.
• Gather continuous feedback from internal customers and rapidly iterate on solutions.
Benchmark infrastructure based on silicon development workflows to provide internal
customers with the optimal resources for silicon development.
Own Platform Delivery and Operations
• Design, implement, and operate cloud infrastructure and high-performance computing
clusters using schedulers like Slurm.
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure-as-code and service deployments
with comprehensive testing and safe rollback mechanisms.
• Take ownership of platform reliability, performance, and cost efficiency from initial design
through production operation.
Drive Results Through Automation and Observability
• Develop monitoring, diagnostics, and alerting systems that surface actionable insights on
efficiency, utilization, reliability, and cost trends.
• Establish incident response processes, runbooks, and documentation that enable
operational excellence.
• Proactively anticipate system failures and implement preventive measures, reducing
operational toil and improving system resilience.

A day in the life
Each day you will work with some of the best engineers in the industry to develop Machine
Learning Accelerators. On-site in Austin, Texas, you will be part of the team that develops
custom silicon and contribute to the infrastructure that enables this innovation.
You might start your day investigating anomalies in job completion rates or resource utilization
patterns. You could spend your morning collaborating with a design verification team to optimize
their regression workflows, identifying bottlenecks and proposing improvements. In the
afternoon, you might be building new tooling that simplifies infrastructure access for emulation
teams, or contributing to monitoring dashboards that give teams real-time visibility into their
development velocity.
You'll participate in design reviews, contribute to postmortems when incidents occur, and
continuously refine the systems that accelerate the path from RTL to silicon. Throughout the
day, you'll balance immediate customer needs—unblocking a team waiting for compute capacity
—with longer-term platform investments. You'll write code, review infrastructure-as-code
changes, and collaborate across teams who depend on the systems you build.
Take a look inside our labs to see what you will learn at Annapurna Labs:
• https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/aws/take-a-look-inside-the-lab-where-aws-makes-
custom-chips
• https://youtu.be/rViVFrQg4Hk

About the team
At Annapurna Labs, your infrastructure work directly enables breakthrough innovations in
custom silicon that power AWS and transform industries. You'll collaborate with world-class chip
designers, verification engineers, and software developers who are pushing the boundaries of
what's possible. We offer the resources and scale of AWS with the innovation culture and
technical depth of a focused silicon team.
If you're passionate about building infrastructure that accelerates innovation, thrive on customer
obsession and ownership, and want to see your work enable the next generation of AWS silicon
—we want to hear from you

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of administrative experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering experience
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java,
- Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience building services using AWS products
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

descriptionHtml:

title: Real Estate Manager, Real Estate
descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

Amazon is currently looking to hire an experienced Manager - Real Estate to join the team and play a critical role in supporting all property acquisition activity across East India. Regular travel will be require and this role reports to the Regional Manager – Real Estate North.

In this role, you will support the India team to ensure the timely completion of new lease transactions including renewals, expansions, terminations, and reconfiguration of existing warehouse space. This encompasses the entire process from working with the local management team in defining the requirements, lease negotiations (business and legal terms), on-site surveys, comparative financial analysis of lease transaction, and project management to affect the end result. Your primary objective in this role is to provide adequate, cost effective storage/operation space for Amazon on the continent given the market conditions working to challenging deadlines and budgetary requirements.





Key job responsibilities
Key Tasks/Responsibilities:

Deliver the Real Estate requirements of the assigned region in keeping with the overall strategy for maintaining and developing space requirements of Amazon India Warehouse/storage strategy
Ability to monitor and manage large construction projects
Develop a strong team of capable of working on and delivering various Real Estate requirements of Amazon
Develop strong relationships with developers, property consultants, and key govt. functionaries in the assigned geography
Strong understanding of the Zoning rules, Development planning byelaws, Master planning and Land title due diligence.
Discuss with local stakeholders and governmental bodies to ensure support for FC (Fulfillment Center) expansions
Innovate and structure complex real estate transactions
Landlord relations, negotiation and contractor management, including escalation of any issues beyond regular daily activity
Stakeholder management across different levels, both internal and external

Basic qualifications – BE (civil)/ B. Arch. / LLB with PG in management / PMP / MBA with BE

Experience/Skills required:

1. Significant exposure to Industrial, Commercial and Retail real estate asset class
2. Significant transaction management experience with ability to close agreements, due diligences and commercial terms in line with corporate policies.
3. Industry expert with strong network of key players in the market
4. Strong knowledge of construction, budgeting, valuation and scheduling of large construction projects
5. Asset Management skills (property and buildings), including the acquisition and disposition of assets and lease administration
6. Experience of team building and team management
7. Ability to proactively monitor and control various vendor relationships and external resources (including contract negotiation and vendor management skills)
8. Knowledge of financial analysis techniques including discounted cash flow and capital budgeting
9. Understanding of real estate trends, best practices and the vendor marketplace
Basic qualifications

5+ years of Reliability Program Manager or equivalent experience
Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon experience
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Experience with computers, including MS Excel, Word and Office



Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience
- Experience with computers, including MS Excel, Word and Office

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of team management, budget responsibilities, supplier management, problem solving, and client/ customer relations experience
- Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
- Experience with preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls, and industrial electronics & robotics
- Experience working with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) integrators
- Experience maintaining material handling equipment and integrated systems
- Experience in project management
- Experience with statistical analysis

title: Operations & Logistics Internship Friuli Venezia Giulia- Talent Pool
descriptionHtml:
You are applying to our Talent Pool for Operations Internships starting from January 2027 onwards. By applying early, you benefit from:

- Early consideration for available positions
- Priority access to preferred locations and start dates
- Greater scheduling flexibility during the interview process
- Advance placement ahead of peak hiring season
Our preliminary timeline: interviews start taking place in September, with role matching beginning around October. This timeline is subject to change depending on business needs.

****This position could be based in any Amazon Operations centre across Friuli Venezia Giulia, depending on availability and business needs. Please note that this role requires on-site presence. Relocation support will be provided. Applying to the talent pool is non-binding and does not guarantee a specific start date or offer.****

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.


A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.


About the team
Intern Community:
• As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
Support:
• The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
Learning Sessions:
• Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
Opportunities:
• Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.
Internship Start Dates across the year:
• We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through July 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

Basic qualifications

- Currently in your penultimate (graduating in 2028) or last year, and working towards a university degree in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.
- Eligible to complete a full-time internship (40hours/week) of 3-6 months with a start date between January and July 2027.
- Highly proficient in both spoken and written English and the local language of the country you are applying for (Common European Framework of Reference C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

title: Regional Procurement Manager, UKI OPEX Procurement
descriptionHtml:
The Regional Procurement Manager (RPM) leads Amazon's OPEX Procurement at a regional level ensuring the continuous supply of essential non-inventory materials and services across the network. This role manages a geographically dispersed team serving approx 16 sites within East Midlands & South of UK, as per alignment of the new global model organisation. Team structure includes 4 Procurement Managers, who handle local procurement operations, and 5 Store Coordinators (SC), who manage on-site consumables for Operations. They support all end-to-end procurement operations for a diverse logistic network.

Home site location subject to discussion, but to be based within East Midlands & South of UK.



Key job responsibilities
Core responsibilities require expertise and responsibilities in 6 areas:

- Strategic operations management: The RPM develops and executes regional procurement strategies to drive network growth and operational excellence. This includes managing complex supply chain needs through supplier performance frameworks and demand planning coordination across facilities. This role requires a deep understanding of operational requirements that drive measurable business impact, while supporting SME coordination and enabling SPMs achieve stablished KPIs.

- People leadership: Leading a multi-site procurement team demands strong people management capabilities. The RPM builds and develops talent across geographically dispersed locations, ensuring team members have the tools and support needed to serve their respective sites effectively. This includes coaching SPMs and SC to maintain high performance standards and deliver consistent results across the network, while excelling in connection results.

- Stakeholder management: Success in this role depends on strong partnerships with senior site leadership and regional support functions. The RPM collaborates with key operational stakeholders through quarterly one-on-one meetings and maintains open communication channels throughout the year. They drive efficiency improvements and align procurement strategies with site objectives, deeply understanding operations processes and brilliant basics. Additional responsibilities include representing SPO in regional leadership forums and GPO workstreams, supporting SPMs in achieving site QBR targets, and managing strategic relationships with internal partners and external suppliers. The RPM also oversees high-complexity service disruptions, high-risk contracts, and senior stakeholder expectations.

- Cost optimization: The RPM develops direct reports capabilities to identify and capture sustainable savings aligned with company policies and reporting standards. RPMs ensure SPMs achieve regional targets through strategic procurement leadership, utilizing expertise in procurement strategy and category knowledge, while deploying company savings methodologies and value creation frameworks.

- Network optimization: RPMs standardize procurement processes and FC service activities while managing supply chain initiatives. They apply analytical tools for supply base optimization, supplier segmentation, and lead cross-functional cost projects. RPMs align global category strategies with local execution and contribute to SPO Global Initiatives through standardized practices across the FC network.

- Compliance and risk management: RPMs drive compliance and risk mitigation strategies. They ensure SPMs implement supplier governance frameworks, maintain procurement policy adherence, and manage supply chain risks. This includes oversight of due diligence processes (onboarding through Supplier Connect, TPS & others), contract compliance, and supplier adoption of required tools (including Avetta, Accurate or SR audit requirements).

The role requires strong Deliver Results, Earn Trust, Hire and Develop the Best, Insist on Highest Standards and Ownership.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Experience managing procurement teams with direct experience in supplier/supply chain management
- Experience in people management
- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks
- Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)
- Experience with MS Office Professional Suite and excellent working knowledge of MS Excel
- Experience running metrics reports, analyzing data to identify problems and using data analysis to generate and explain metrics
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Supply chain or Procurement certifications
- Advanced Analytics skills and experience
- Significant previous experience in Procurement/Operations/Supply Chain/Logistics/Ecommerce

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Enterprise (Retail, Restaurant & CPG)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a highly motivated Senior Solutions Architect to join our North American Retail team. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to some of the world's largest Everyday Essentials companies - including health and beauty, grocery, convenience, enterprises operating tens of thousands of locations globally, processing millions of transactions annually, and serving millions of customers daily.

This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working with some of the best and brightest engineers, architects, and technical managers while developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies in the world.



Key job responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Customer Advisory
• Serve as the trusted technical advisor and primary SA for strategic enterprise retail accounts, building deep relationships with C-suite technology leaders and influencing their cloud strategy
• Own the end-to-end technical engagement: from discovery and architecture design through implementation support, optimization, and ongoing innovation
• Lead Well-Architected Reviews and design sessions for complex, multi-region architectures supporting thousands of store locations globally
• Develop and present Technical Account Plans that align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives (e.g., stores expansion goals, loyalty program growth, supply chain transformation)
• Conduct executive briefings, white-boarding sessions, and technical deep-dives with customer leadership and their technology partners
• Architect solutions for retail-specific workloads including:
- Point of Sale (POS) systems processing thousands of transactions per second across tens of thousands of locations
- Supply chain platforms providing end-to-end traceability, IoT-based tracking, and AI-assisted anomaly detection across complex multi-tier distribution networks
- Loyalty and personalization engines serving hundreds of millions of consumers with real-time, context-aware offers
- Edge computing architectures enabling AI inference, computer vision, and operational intelligence at the restaurant level
- Voice AI solutions leveraging natural language understanding and real-time ordering

A day in the life
Your week might include: whiteboarding a supply chain traceability architecture with a customer's VP of Engineering on Monday; presenting a GenAI-powered restaurant operations solution to C-suite executives on Tuesday; conducting a Well-Architected Review of a POS modernization initiative on Wednesday; collaborating with ProServe and SI partners on a supply chain AI proof-of-concept on Thursday; and authoring a technical blog post on edge computing patterns for multi-location enterprises on Friday. You'll spend approximately 25-60% of your time on-site with customers and at industry events.

About the team
About the Role
As a Senior Solutions Architect on the Retail Technology team, you will work directly with enterprise customers navigating complex digital transformation journeys. You will operate at the intersection of cloud architecture, artificial intelligence, supply chain modernization, and edge computing, helping customers unlock competitive advantage through technology at massive global scale.

Retail enterprises present uniquely compelling technical challenges: real-time transaction processing across thousand of locations, supply chain orchestration spanning hundreds of logistics partners and millions of weekly deliveries, AI-powered personalization for loyalty programs reaching hundreds of millions of consumers, and edge computing architectures that must function reliably in every retail environment worldwide.

You will be the primary technical point of contact for strategic enterprise accounts, owning the technical engagement and ensuring customers successfully architect, build, and optimize solutions on AWS. You will drive executive-level conversations on technology strategy while simultaneously diving deep into system design, conducting architectural reviews, and prototyping solutions.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 6+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a technical role within a sales organization
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

title: IT Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Operations Technology Solutions (OTS) Field Delivery organisation is seeking an IT Program Manager to provide program management across the service, support, and project portfolios in the UK & Ireland. This is a great opportunity for an individual looking to develop a career in IT program management within a fast-paced, operational environment.

You will have the opportunity to expand your program management capabilities and take responsibility for the governance, reporting, and continuous improvement of the UK Field Delivery portfolio. This role focuses on driving Field Delivery initiatives—supporting portfolio health, process improvement, and cross-functional coordination—rather than direct management of large-scale deployment programs.

The IT Program Manager will support planning and execution of various IT infrastructure and service initiatives across Amazon's First, Middle, and Last Mile operations. You will work with internal local teams, regional OTS leadership, and global PMO cross-functional peer groups to guide the success of programs that support company growth. The role requires effective project management skills alongside strong communication skills to coordinate team members belonging to different teams and reporting lines. We are looking for a well-organised person who will proactively look for ways to contribute to Amazon, both in portfolio management and operational support. Up to 10% travel within the UK & Ireland expected.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and maintain the UK Field Delivery program portfolio, providing clear visibility of status, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements to senior leadership

- Define and drive governance mechanisms, reporting cadences, and escalation paths for Field Delivery initiatives

- Establish and measure Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for program and project performance across the UK portfolio

- Support resource demand forecasting and capacity planning for Field Delivery teams

- Drive process improvement initiatives using data and metrics to identify inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions

- Partner with cross-functional teams including Deployment, Field Support, Engineering, and Service Management to align priorities and remove blockers

- Support the definition, testing, and adoption of program management tooling and standard operating procedures

- Represent UK Field Delivery in regional and global PMO forums, ensuring alignment on standards and best practices

- Proactively manage change control and communicate impact on project scope; identify risks, issues, and devise contingency plans

- Keep key partners informed of portfolio and project progress while maintaining documentation; remain committed to exceptional internal customer service

- Update or develop documentation on processes critical to successfully delivering Field Delivery initiatives

About the team
The Operations Technology Solutions (OTS) Field Delivery organisation is responsible for ensuring Amazon's operational sites across the UK & Ireland have the IT infrastructure, support, and services they need to run effectively. We sit at the intersection of technology and operations, our teams deliver hands-on support, manage IT assets, and execute initiatives that keep fulfilment centres, delivery stations, and logistics sites running.

We work with cross-functional peer groups to support new facility launches, expansions, and the deployment of new business solutions. We are a collaborative, customer-obsessed group that values ownership, bias for action, and continuous improvement. You will join a team of IT managers, engineers, and support professionals who are passionate about solving problems at scale and delivering results for our internal customers across First, Middle, and Last Mile operations.

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in program or project management
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Comfortable in a customer-facing role requiring solid organisational capability alongside excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment while prioritising and managing multiple responsibilities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

title: Sr. Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Description
Help shape the future of fulfillment alongside passionate, talented people who are obsessed with delivering for customers. As a Senior Operations Manager at our ELP1 building in El Paso, TX, you'll be at the helm of a large-scale operation that delivers for millions of Amazon customers every day. This is your opportunity to lead, innovate, and make a measurable impact on one of the world's most customer-obsessed supply chains. Be part of something extraordinary from day one.

What You'll Do
Own the operation – Take full accountability for budgetary performance, people development, and operational excellence across your functional area (Inbound or Outbound).
Lead and develop leaders – Manage, coach, and mentor a team of Operations and Area Managers, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable while building the next generation of Amazon leaders.
Drive continuous improvement – Champion Lean initiatives, process innovations, and quality programs that push your team and the FC to exceed business goals.
Deliver a world-class customer experience – Ensure safety, quality, and performance standards are met or exceeded every single day.
Collaborate cross-functionally – Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety, IT, and peer leaders to secure resources, share best practices, and drive site-wide success.
Cultivate ideas – Source and nurture innovative ideas from your team, translating them into actionable improvement plans that raise the bar across the network.
Share best practices – Take proactive steps to ensure best practices are shared across all departments, shifts, and the broader network.

Additional Job Elements to this Hands-On Leadership Role
Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
Walking in the FC and around area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
Continual standing and/or walking an average of 5 miles daily
Ability to work in construction / distribution environments that may be noisy, unlit, unheated, not air-conditioned
Able to access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)

Fun Facts About This Location
ELP1 is an Amazon Robotics (AR) Sortable Fulfillment Center located in El Paso, TX a unique, bilingual border city and the largest city on the U.S.-Mexico border
El Paso is one of the safest large cities in the United States, consistently ranking among the top for low crime rates
Situated in the Chihuahuan Desert at the western tip of Texas, El Paso enjoys over 300 days of sunshine per year earning it the nickname "Sun City"
Just minutes from the Franklin Mountains State Park, the largest urban park in the contiguous U.S., offering over 100 miles of hiking and mountain biking trails with stunning desert panoramas
Rich cultural heritage: El Paso blends Southwestern, Mexican, and Native American influences, with world-class Tex-Mex cuisine, historic missions dating back to the 1600s, and a thriving arts district downtown
Outdoor recreation: The area offers access to Hueco Tanks State Park, a world-renowned rock climbing destination, as well as the Rio Grande for kayaking and the nearby Guadalupe Mountains National Park
Year-round activities: Hiking, rock climbing, mountain biking, stargazing in some of the darkest skies in Texas, and community events including the Sun City Music Festival and Fiesta de las Flores

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work flexible hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays
- 7+ years direct management experience, including a salaried workforce, in a manufacturing, production or distribution environment
- Prior experience with performance metrics, process improvement and Lean techniques
- Prior experience with the full staffing lifecycle, including interviewing, hiring, performance management, promotions and termination

Preferred qualifications

- Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situations
- Interest in long-term career development through assignments in multiple FCs across the nation
- Experience with a contingent workforce during peak seasons
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations or related field. MBA preferred

descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations
Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers.
https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Basic qualifications

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program for Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.


Key job responsibilities
• Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
• Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
• Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
• Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.
• Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
• Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
• Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
• Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
• Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
• Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
- Knowledge of critical data center equipment
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
- Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
- Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:

As an Operations Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, inclusive leadership for the teams you supervise. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for supervising a team of Area Managers and their direct reports: meanwhile, you will report to the Site Lead of your Fulfillment Center. The quality of your leadership is key to achievement in this role: you’ll motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with that of the business.

Another key aspect of your role will be to coordinate on numerous process improvement projects, with the aim of streamlining all activities, both for yourself and the team members you supervise. The ideas, innovation and leaps out of the status quo that you come up with could very well be rolled out across the Amazon network: this immense opportunity is yours for the taking.

title: Program Specialist, Network Control Center, Network Control Center
descriptionHtml:
Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.


We are seeking a Program Specialist to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. The NCC detects, manages, and resolves high-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be at the center of that response — running incidents end-to-end, driving cross-functional coordination under pressure, and ensuring leadership has the information they need to make decisions fast.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage high-severity incidents (Sev1/Sev2) impacting Amazon CS customers by running bridge calls and coordinating with Service Delivery, Product, Engineering, PR, Legal, and Security Operations teams to drive resolution
- Triage technical and operational incidents, assess customer impact, and coordinate with relevant teams to identify root cause and resolution path
- Initiate and manage proactive customer communications including website/app banners, IVR updates, and mass notifications to reduce anxiety contacts during known issues
- Protect contact channels by identifying known-issue volume and ensuring customers with genuine issues can reach Customer Service without congestion
- Provide regular, timely updates to senior leadership with clear customer impact assessments, resolution timelines, and status indicators
- Dive deep into incident data, identify systemic problems, and present solutions and preventive measures to leadership
- Develop, maintain, and execute Standard Operating Procedures for incident response scenarios, including coordination playbooks for cross-functional teams
- Track service health metrics and coordinate with stakeholders to mitigate customer impact during capacity constraints or system degradation

Basic qualifications

- Work flexible shifts including nights, weekends, or holidays in a 24/7/365 environment
- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology

title: Sr. Advanced Manufacturing Engineer – Modeling & Drafting, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is seeking a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer with advanced 3D modeling and 2D drafting expertise to join our Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) team. You will leverage deep proficiency in CAD modeling and production drawing creation to oversee the transition of complex self governed robotic systems from design to production, applying Design for Excellence (DfX) principles across a global supply chain.

The Amazon Robotics (AR) Operations organization manufactures high-quality robotics and gets the right materials to the right place at the right time to enable our automated solutions. It's a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon globally, and is powered by data and performance indicators.

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply manufacturing technology in robotics and software to solve real-world problems that will transform our customers' experiences. We invent new improvements every day. We will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

This role will report to the Head of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering. You will be responsible for applying advanced modeling and drafting skills alongside DfX principles to influence product designs and transition a wide range of self governed robotic solutions from design to production. You will create and interpret complex 3D models and 2D production drawings, work cross-functionally to develop suppliers, manage product lifecycle changes, oversee manufacturing readiness assessments, and drive technical root cause for supplier defects. The successful candidate will combine expert-level CAD proficiency with broad manufacturing engineering knowledge, and be willing to "roll up sleeves and do what needs to get done" to consistently deliver results.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, review, and redline complex 3D parametric models and 2D production drawings to ensure manufacturability, proper tolerancing, and compliance with GD&T standards.
- Provide Design for Excellence (DfX) guidance and feedback on electromechanical designs at concept and detailed design phases, leveraging modeling expertise to validate design intent.
- Develop detailed manufacturing-intent drawings and model-based definitions (MBD) to communicate critical-to-quality features to suppliers.
- Guide best practices on manufacturing tolerances using GD&T; perform tolerance stack-up analyses using 3D models to identify interference and assembly risks.
- Launch tooling with accelerated schedules. Assess project risk and drive mitigation plans using model-based simulations.
- Review external production processes, identify risk, and mitigate — using 2D drafting deliverables to clearly define supplier requirements.
- Qualify production processes based on dimensional data, control plans, and process capability (Cpk) requirements.
- Drive internal and external PFMEA and DFMEA reviews, referencing model geometry and drawing specifications.
- Solve technical problems across a broad set of manufacturing commodities (mechanical and electrical).
- Guide manufacturing readiness assessments (MRL) for NPI programs through production ramp.
- Evaluate and approve Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) across mechanical and electrical commodities, assessing manufacturing, supply chain, and cost impacts — authoring or revising drawings and models as needed.
- Evaluate production, supplier, and field failures for root cause analysis and resolution using 8D, 5-Why, and Fishbone methodologies.
- Mentor team members and design engineers on producibility best practices, drafting standards, and modeling techniques.
- Propose design changes that will enhance product sustainability and scalability, producing updated models and drawings to support implementation.
- Shepherd Statistical Process Control (SPC) implementation at suppliers; conduct Gauge R&R and process capability studies.
- Up to 30% travel required.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer on the Advanced Manufacturing Engineering team, you'll start your day in CAD — reviewing 3D models for manufacturability concerns and redlining 2D drawings to refine GD&T callouts before releasing to suppliers. Mid-morning, you might join a design review with hardware engineers, using your modeling expertise to flag tolerance stack-up risks, recommend geometry changes, or drive cost-out through design simplification. After lunch, you could be generating production-intent drawings for a new tooling package, guiding a PFMEA session with a key supplier, or analyzing SPC data to qualify a new production tool. You'll collaborate daily with cross-functional stakeholders across Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management, and you'll see the direct impact of your modeling and drafting skills as designs move from prototype to high-volume global production.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
AME is the scalability engine within AR Operations. We bridge innovation and execution by integrating DfX principles early in the engineering process. The team is currently supporting multiple NPI programs across next-generation robotic platforms, with significant growth in scope and complexity.
