title: Senior Security Engineer, AWS Human Access Security
descriptionHtml:
AHAS reduces the risk of human and operator access to AWS production systems and customer environments. As the Senior Security Engineer embedded with an AHAS software development team, you own the security design decisions for the operator-access tooling this team builds — tooling that engineers across AWS depend on to request, scope, and audit their access. You define what constitutes the highest-risk operator access, quantify it with data, and partner with teams across AWS to move that access to lower-risk patterns or remove it.



Key job responsibilities
- Define what counts as high-risk human access to production systems and the data they hold. You identify the access patterns (standing credentials, broad emergency access, unscoped remote sessions, unreviewed privilege elevation) that carry the greatest risk, and you rank them with data rather than opinion.
- Drive design decisions that lower access risk by default: scoped and time-bound credentials, reviewed privilege elevation, and auditable emergency access, so systems stay secure without depending on operator discipline.
- Partner with engineering teams across the organization to reduce risky access. You turn your risk model into concrete remediation, negotiate adoption, and measure the reduction over time.
- Build the measurement and detection capabilities that show where risky access exists and whether it is trending down, and use that data to prioritize the work.
- Investigate security issues involving human access and turn each one into a durable improvement in the tooling or the risk model, not a one-off fix.
- Mentor software and security engineers, raise the bar through design and code review, and represent your team's security posture to leadership and partner teams.

A day in the life
Most days come down to one question: who can reach critical production systems, and how do we make that access safer? You dig into the data, find the access patterns that carry the most risk, and decide what to tackle first. Then the part that matters most: you take each finding to the software engineers you work with and build the fix into the tooling, so the identification becomes automatic instead of something you teams have to discover. You'll also win over teams across the company to build tools and mechanisms to remove the risk completeley. Find the problem, then automate it away.

About the team
AWS Human Access Security (AHAS) is a security and engineering team with one mission: make it safe for people to operate the systems that run AWS. Every engineer who touches production is our customer, and we build the tools they use to understand their access and reduce their risk. We pair security engineers with software engineers so good security is built into the product, not bolted on afterward. We care about measurable impact, clear thinking, and shipping fixes that stick. If you want your work to lower real risk across a huge fleet, join us.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship background in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools experience
- 5+ years of work in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans experience
- 5+ years of (non-internship) scripting, programming, and security code review in common programming languages experience
- Knowledge of at least two of the following programming languages: Scala, Java, Python, C/C++, or Go
- Experience (non-internship) in scripting, programming, and security code reviewing in a common programming language
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
- Experience with security in service-oriented architectures/microservices and web services

title: Sr. Vendor Consultant, RBS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
About Vendor Consultant Program
Vendor Consultant Program in Amazon RBS organization is to own operational business metrics and associated tasks for JP AVS vendors. These include business metrics that require minimal financial judgement or commercial negotiations needed. We aim to deliver this through a dedicated team of vendor consultants, who will act as the primary owner of business metrics for their assigned set of vendors. Our primary customer is our vendors, who subscribe to the AVS service with the intent to get a customized service that will augment their growth on Amazon. To be able to delight our customer, we will aim to provide a high-quality service that exceeds our vendor’s expectations by driving their growth on Amazon by improving metric performance.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated Sr. Vendor Consultant to lead the Marketing Operations service pillar within Vendor Consultant Program. In this role, you will leverage your deep expertise in Marketing Operations to design scalable operational solutions that improve vendor business performance. You will own end-to-end workflows across marketing-related operational activities, driving key business metrics. You will work closely with Vendor Consultants, JP Retail team, global partner teams, and technology team to standardize processes, eliminate operational defects, and build automation solutions that improve both operational efficiency and vendor outcomes.
This role requires strong analytical thinking, program management, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement capabilities.


Key job responsibilities
-Own the Marketing Operations service pillar by driving improvements across key business metrics, including Retail GV, Ads Spend, and Deals Operations.
-Design and optimize scalable end-to-end workflows to improve operational efficiency, service quality, and vendor outcomes.
-Lead cross-functional initiatives with Product Families, Vendor Consultants, and global stakeholders to deliver operational excellence.
-Analyze business performance, identify root causes, and implement data-driven solutions through process optimization and automation.
-Serve as the Marketing Operations subject matter expert by establishing best practices, standardizing operations, and providing functional guidance across the organization.

About the team
The RBS VCP program supports AVS Signature vendor growth by owning and improving input KPIs (VGP) across Availability, IDQ and Marketing Ops metrics. By transferring ownership of such metrics and associated operational tasks to RBS VCs, we eliminate the operational burden on Brand Specialists, thereby improving AVS productivity.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above
- Fluent in both Japanese and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- 3+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, e-commerce, retail operations, vendor management, or a related field, with a proven track record of driving business metric improvements.
- 2+ years of program or project management experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with experience driving process optimization and operational excellence.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using SQL, Python, Tableau, or other data analytics and visualization tools.
- Experience developing automation or GenAI-enabled solutions to improve operational efficiency.
- Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.

descriptionHtml:
Für unseren Standort in Kobern-Gondorf suchen wir nach einem Techniker, Meister (z. B. staatlich geprüfter Techniker, Elektromeister, Industriemeister Metall) oder vergleichbaren Fachkräften als Teamleiter:in Instandhaltung (interne Bezeichnung: Sr. RME Technician). Falls Du für die Stelle umziehst und Deine Heimatadresse mindestens 80 km vom Standort entfernt ist, unterstützen wir Dich mit einem Umzugsbonus i. H. v. 6.045$.

Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Sr. RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

*** Die Stelle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einem rotierenden Dreischichtsystem, welches Samstage, Nachtschichten sowie Rufbereitschaft umfassen kann. ***

Wir bieten:
- Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon
- Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive beschränkter Mitarbeiteraktien (Restricted Stock Units durch die Amazon.com, Inc.)
- Umzugsbonus: Bei min. 80 km Entfernung vom Standort, Umzugsbonus von 6.045$
- Eine kostenlose Lebens- und Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung und Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
- Mitarbeiterrabatte auf amazon.de sowie Amazon Extras (z.B. Rabatte in Reisen, Restaurants, Unterhaltung, Elektronik, Heim etc.)
- Pendlerleistungen: Kostenloses Parken oder Kostenübernahme für das Deutschlandticket
- Familienbonus (Einmalzahlung für Eltern in Elternzeit)
- Vermittlungsservices für die Betreuung von Kindern, Senioren und Menschen mit besonderen Bedürfnissen
- Ein kostenloses Mitarbeiterhilfeprogramm (auch für Familienmitglieder) für eine Beratung bei beruflichen oder privaten Angelegenheiten
- Hervorragende Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem globalen Unternehmen

Key job responsibilities
- Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
- Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf
- Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
- Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen
- Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk

A day in the life


Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren.
Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften.
Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK). Zusätzlich eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation als Staatlich Geprüfter/Anerkannter Techniker, Industriemeister, Handwerksmeister oder oder mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung. Alternativ Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Hochschulstudiums im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Erfahrung in der Automatisierung und Instandhaltung von Förderanlagen
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Grundsprachkenntnisse in Englisch ODER fortgeschrittene Englischkentnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Grundsprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und die Bereitschaft, es zu verbessern

- Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Fremdfirmen

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. title: Area Manager, Early Career (2027) – New England/ CT, RI, MA, VT, NH, ME
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit (https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits) to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers.


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.

Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.

Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.

End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

descriptionHtml:
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) organization is seeking a Senior Executive Assistant to support the Global Vice President of Workplace Health and Safety. You will operate as a true strategic partner to the VP, driving operational excellence through complex calendar management, travel planning, and organizational rhythms. You will work closely with the Chief of Staff to ensure the VP's office runs seamlessly. This role is based in Bellevue, WA.

As the Lead EA, you will serve as a trusted advisor to the VP and senior leadership team, someone who anticipates needs, connects dots across the organization, and drives outcomes without waiting to be asked. You will also directly manage and mentor the Second EA within the VP's office, ensuring a resilient two-EA model with well-defined responsibilities and consistent, high-quality delivery. Beyond the VP's office, you will help develop and mentor a team of 18 EAs across the WHS organization, building mechanisms that ensure high-quality support for senior leadership. This role requires exceptional judgment, full autonomy, and the ability to operate with discretion at the highest levels of the organization. It offers significant leadership development opportunities and direct influence on how a global safety organization operates.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and drive end-to-end calendar management for the VP, including strategic scheduling, complex prioritization across time zones, and proactive conflict resolution.
• Lead space management strategy: represent the team in GREF meetings, drive space planning decisions, manage escalations, and deliver quarterly reporting to leadership on seating and capacity.
• Design and execute team-building programs and organizational events; develop scalable playbooks and best practices for hub offices globally.
• Earn Trust by cultivating deep relationships with safety leadership, operations partners, HR, legal, finance, and cross-functional stakeholders. Serve as a strategic liaison across WHS and the broader Amazon EA community.
• Manage complex domestic and international travel logistics, optimize travel processes, and oversee expense reporting with a focus on accuracy and compliance.

A day in the life
Your day starts with a strategic review of the VP's calendar and priorities for the week ahead, identifying conflicts, preparing briefing materials, and aligning with the Second EA on task distribution. By mid-morning, you're leading a cross-functional sync, resolving an escalated scheduling conflict, and coaching the Second EA. Afternoons bring rapid reprioritization: executive-level meeting prep, last-minute leadership requests, and decisions on behalf of the VP's office. Some days you're designing a new organizational rhythm; other days you're fielding competing priorities from multiple directors while keeping the VP's schedule on track. By the end of the day, the leadership team operates seamlessly because you anticipated needs before they arose.

About the team
Our team exists for one reason: to ensure that the more than one million Amazon employees and partners around the world go home safely every day. title: Senior IP Executive, Japan, Global IP & Literary Acquisitions
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies, TV shows, and adaptations based on other storytelling formats. Prime Video is now available in more than 200 countries. Amazon Studios is a movie and series production company. We are seeking a dynamic Senior IP Executive to work across Japan and the US, to help identify and partner with Manga and Anime properties for adaptation to screen. A successful candidate is proactive and excels at building relationships and trust, has relationships with publishers, and industry professionals in Japan, and is excited to strategize across multiple creative teams and business affairs worldwide to help secure a path and facilitate on screen adaptation.


Key job responsibilities
- Serves as the primary Japan IP liaison to the Head of Global IP Acquisitions, providing market intelligence, property assessments, and strategic recommendations on adaptation targets
- Acts as a trusted creative partner to the Head of Japan, International Originals aligning IP pipeline with the Japan slate's creative direction and production priorities
- Bridges the Global IP Team and Japan International Originals Team ensuring continuity of communication, creative intent, and deal terms across territories
- Leads Japanese IP sourcing for the Global TV & Film team on English-language or multi-lingual productions, navigating cultural nuances and rightsholder expectations
- Champions and facilitates Japanese-language adaptation opportunities for the Japan International Originals team
- Works closely with JP creative teams to approach publishers for IP sourcing — partners with our teams in all publisher outreach
- Cultivates and maintains deep relationships within Japan's publishing, anime, and manga industries to surface early-stage opportunities before they reach the open market
- Scouts, evaluates, and prioritizes adaptation-worthy properties, maintaining a comprehensive tracking pipeline with clear strategic rationale
- Provides expert counsel on the optimal acquisition path for each property — assessing rightsholder dynamics, competitive landscape, and structural deal considerations
- Shapes and guides creative pitch materials to align with rightsholder sensibilities and maximize the likelihood of securing rights
- Owns the rightsholder relationship end-to-end throughout the acquisition process — serving as the single point of trust and accountability
- Serves as the ongoing liaison between rightsholders and US/Global productions adapting anime or manga properties, ensuring creative alignment and rightsholder confidence throughout production
- Manages all rights verification for Japanese IP of interest to creative teams across the organization
- Drives cross-functional collaboration with internal stakeholders (legal, business affairs, creative, production) and external partners to move opportunities from identification to execution

About the team
The Global IP & Literary Acquisitions Team works across all movies, TV, and animation teams to find source material to adapt to screen, works to understand and drive fandoms, and manages our library of IP.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Fluency in Japanese (does not require Business level Japanese)
- 5+ years in publishing, entertainment, or related fields
- Passion and expertise in Anime and Manga

Preferred qualifications

- Prior experience identifying creative opportunities, facilitating pitches and communication to secure IP for adaptation
- Strong Japanese and English translation skills
- Deep relationships with publishers and within the broader media & entertainment industry

descriptionHtml:
DCEO (データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ) 部門では、ファシリティエンジニア・技術者を広く募集しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンウェブサービス（AWS）のデータセンターを支える、施設内の電力設備や冷却設備などを安定稼働させることが責務です。DCEOの一員として、サーバーやネットワークなどのIT機器を収容する施設で働くことで、お客様のアプリケーションやWebサイトなどの稼働を24時間365日継続できるよう、社会インフラに貢献できる業務です。

弊社は 2006 年の設立以来、クラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアとして、ITインフラの世界に変革をもたらしました。現在は世界中で何百ものデータセンターを運営しており、急成長中の新興企業、大企業、主要な政府機関など、何百万ものお客様をサポートしています。データセンターがあることで、日本だけでなく世界中でクラウドコンピューティングサービスが利用できるようになり、お客様に信頼していただいている弊社の革新的な技術にいつでもアクセスできるようになっているのです。

本ポジションでは、世界最大級のITインフラの維持管理業務に関わる事ができます。そしてあなたがデータセンターのキャリア形成に必要なトレーニングやスキルをご提供します。データセンターでのキャリアにご興味ある方は是非ご応募ください！

#aws-jp-dc-ap

Key job responsibilities
* データセンター施設内の機械及び電気設備の保守管理
* お客様のダウンタイムを最小限に抑えるための設備障害対応
* 設備の故障や保守、拡張等に伴う技術的な問題の調査、解決
* データセンターで使われている機器の設置や撤去

A day in the life
* データセンター内のオフィス、サーバー室、空調機械室、電気室等様々な場所を移動しながら、他のメンバーと一緒に　シフト勤務で、お客様のためにクラウドコンピューティングを24時間365日稼働が継続できるよう取り組みます。
* データセンター内の機械及び電気設備の監視および制御を行います。
* メンテナンス作業を安全かつスムーズに行うために、計画を立案して万全の準備を行います。
* 機器のメンテナンスサービスを提供するベンダーを管理します。
* データセンターで使用されるサーバーやハードウェア機器の設置や取り外し、及びその他の部品や消耗品の配送などを行うチームと協力して作業します。
* 施設のオペレーションコストの削減に取り組みながら、イノベーションを推進します。

About the team
データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズでは、日々安全とセキュリティ、そしてお客様に最高のクラウド体験を提供することに取り組んでいます。私たちはお客様のニーズとビジネス上の要求を満たすために、施設と設備の運用及び保守を担当しています。またアマゾンでは社員がトレーニングや認定を受けるための支援や、英語学習のサポートを提供しています。

私たちのインクルーシブな文化は、あなたがお客様に最高の結果をもたらすことを可能にします。私たちは従業員の多様性を称えるだけでなく、多様な働き方を称賛しています。

Mentorship and Career growth
あなたのこれまでのご経験にかかわらず、ご活躍いただけるキャリアパスを用意しています。先輩社員からの知識の共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリアアップに役立つリソースが準備されており、より総合的なプロフェッショナルへの成長を支援します。

title: Principal Software Engineer, Device Cloud Core Services
descriptionHtml:
The Device Cloud Core Services organization owns and operates foundational services that cater to a number of critical customer experiences including device-identity, device registration, and device management. These solutions cater to all Amazon first-party devices and other third-party devices, smart-home devices, mobile applications and services that connect to the Amazon cloud on behalf of customer scenarios that originate through these devices.

The organization is looking for an experienced and talented Principal Engineer that has experience and passion in building large-scale web service solutions and has a penchant on building IoT cloud solutions.
As an Amazon.com Principal Engineer you’ll be a technical leader. You’ll help establish technical standards and drive Amazon’s overall technical architecture and engineering practices. You’ll work on Amazon’s hardest problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs. You’ll think globally when building systems, ensuring Amazon.com builds high performing, scalable systems that fit well together. Amazon.com Principal Engineers are pragmatic visionaries who can translate business needs into workable technology solutions. Your expertise is deep and broad; you are hands on, producing both detailed technical work and high-level architectural designs. As a PE you get to connect with a strong PE community at Amazon, contributing and learning from PEs across the company.

As a PE in the Amazon Device Management Systems org you will deliver solutions to help our enterprise customers run their businesses effectively. You will define the technical strategy, identify the right long-term architecture for the device-businesses roadmap. While building the architecture, you will be required to focus on the following tenets: security, availability, simplicity and efficiency. While you will have a high visibility as you will work with several engineering teams and their technical and product senior leadership, you will need exceptionally strong technical skills, strong business acumen, analytical skills, and be able to deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. You will lead the architecture to support enterprise use cases.


Key job responsibilities
• Define the long term technical strategy and architecture vision for device management, leveraging new technologies to deliver features to our customers
• Think big and continuously pitch for foundational solutions that will help device businesses to use these solutions, where applicable, instead of building their own.
• Define technical approach to ensure data privacy is considered while providing foundational solutions.
• Partner with each device team to understand their customer needs and influence adoption of new services
• Re-architect our services to support enterprise use cases
• Possess expert knowledge in performance, scalability, enterprise system architecture, and engineering best practices.
• Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the Amazon developer community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.
• Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience.

Basic qualifications

• 10+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
• Knowledge of object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
• Proven track record of leading large-scale projects
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred qualifications

• Experience designing and building large-scale systems in a multi-tiered, distributed environment
• Experience influencing groups outside their own VP from architecture perspective
• Ability and willingness to multi-task and learn new technologies quickly

title: Process Improvement manager, Amazon Customer Excelence System
descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Amazon Logistics部門（AMZL)のAmazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) チームでは、プロセス改善を担うProcess Improvement managerを募集しております。

【役割と業務内容】
ACESチームは、配送拠点(以下デリバリーステーション)の安全、品質、生産性を改善し、お客様の必要な時に商品を届けられる仕組みを構築し、カスタマーエクスペリエンスを高める役割を担っています。ACESチームは、デリバリーステーションでの配送効率を向上させるため、新規システム、仕組みの導入や改善プロジェクトを推進します。海外のAmazonで新規適用されたシステム、仕組みを日本のデリバリーステーションに適合させ導入、展開を推進します。新規導入したシステム、仕組みについては、データ分析と現場分析の両面から確認し改善をします。また、デリバリーステーションの全工程を理解し、安全、品質、生産性の向上に繋がるアイテムを抽出し改善を進めます。改善は、Operationのデータや現場観察からムダを定量化し、優先度決めをし、PDCA cycleを回します。Amazon デリバリーステーション全てに改善施策を適用できるようスケーラビリティーを考慮した上で標準化をし、拡大していきます。上記を、デリバリーステーションの管理者や各関係者と協業し業務を遂行していただきます。本ポジションでは、業界問わず業務プロセスに課題があった場合に自ら課題解決が出来る経験がある方を求めております。具体的にはシステムから抽出したデータを用いて問題分析を行い、問題を特定するだけでなく、現場訪問などの事実に基づく対策推進や改善を多くの関係者を巻き込みながら主導出来る経験がある方を求めております。ACESチームでは、物流業界出身の方のみならず、製造業、コンサルタントなど多様なバックグラウンドのメンバーが活躍しています。勤務日の半分程度、出張も含めた現場での業務が発生します。

【本ポジションの魅力】
本ポジションは海外（North America、EU）のデジタリゼーションの先端を走るAmazonのリソースを活用した、新たなビジネスモデル（物流領域）の構築をリードし、日本のマーケットに大きな影響を与える事が出来ます。この連携を通じて、先進的な業界動向を学ぶ事が出来る他、海外の関係者との連携を通じて多様性のある考え方、人的ネットワークの構築や改善のアプローチ手法なども体得する事が出来る魅力的なポジションになります。各プロジェクトを通じて日本各地のデリバリーステーションメンバーとの協業が可能であり、実際の配送業務を観察する事で地域のお客様へのカスタマーエクスペリエンス向上を身近に感じる事が出来ます。

関連情報
・所属部門:ラストマイル(AMZL)
・職種:プロジェクトマネジメント
・勤務地:東京オフィス

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request for support, please visit https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/jp.

オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み（Japanese Only）

Key job responsibilities
デリバリーステーションの安全、品質、生産性の改善にあたっては、Amazonのネットワークで取得できるデータを定量的、論理的に分析し、問題点を深く理解します。データから確認できた問題点について現場の状況と合致しているか現場訪問をし確認します。また、Amazonネットワークで取得できるデータのみでは不足している場合は、現場でのムダの定量化（現場時間測定）、定性的データ（現場メンバーからのヒアリング）の取得を実施し、問題を深堀し、改善を実行します。改善の適用においては、日本のデリバリーステーションだけでなく、海外(North America、EU)のデリバリーステーションへのスケーラビリティも考慮し、標準化した上で拡大をします。

A day in the life
本ポジションは、実際の改善活動を各デリバリーステーションメンバーと連携をしながらリードしていくため、連携が必要な関連部署は多岐に渡ります。具体的には
・海外の同様の活動をしている組織との連携
・Process Improvementを実施するための現場拠点長及び現場メンバーとの連携
カイゼン内容が広範囲に渡る場合はデータや事実に基づいた生産性及びコスト低減の予測を明確化した上で、関連部署を巻き込んだプロジェクト推進が必要になります。

About the team
ACESチームでは、様々な業界からの出身者、多国籍なメンバーで構成されています。多様性の理解と心理的安全性を確保した業務環境の構築を推進しています。Weeklyで、AmazonのOur Leadership Principleについてのdiscussion、情報共有や問題解決を論理的に実践する方法の共有を通じて、日常的なコミュニケーションやリレーションシップの向上だけでなく、お互いの知識や知見を共有し、自己を高め合えるような組織作りにも注力しているチームです。

Basic qualifications

- 4年制大学学士号または同等の業務経験
- 業界を問わず、業務改善に関する知識経験、または、プロジェクトに携わった経験
- ビジネスレベルの日本語・英語力（読み書き、会話）

Preferred qualifications

- LeanやTPSを活用した現場での改善推進経験 データベース関連の経験や知識 (SQL, Access, MySQL, Redshift, MS SQL Server、Excel, Visual Basic, Windows operating systems)
- インクルーシブなカルチャーへの貢献や多様性に富んだグループで働くことに対して前向きであること

title: Continuous Improvement Specialist | UAE National only, ACES TREX
descriptionHtml:
The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class last mile operation. Amazon Logistics aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible.

To continue to drive process excellence within our Last mile Delivery business, we are currently looking for a TREX (Transportation Excellence) Field Support which we call internally ACES Specialist.

As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Specialist, you will drive process standardization across SA operations. As a member of the TREX team itself, you will contribute to the optimization of the delivery stations operations, providing station with sufficient knowledge and appropriate tools to improve quality related KPIs.

Your goal is to lead LM quality agenda by solving complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes. Creating effective communication plans to provide visibility to all impacted teams of the organization will help you to enable overall process alignment.


Key job responsibilities

- Onground support & firsthand contact for station management regarding process improvements and benchmarking
- You will work on effective change processes and contribute to network standardization via best practice sharing.
- You are in charge of monitoring the logistics and delivery success through set in station and on road performance indicators.
- You will set up actions plans and execute them to drive current performance to benchmark rates.
- In this position, you are a key driver for successful order execution thus positively influence our customer satisfaction.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Lean methodologies
- Experience driving projects to improve operations and support-related processes
- Experience using the entire MS Office suite, especially Excel
- Experience in problem solving and delivering results

title: Supervisore Caposquadra di Manutenzione
descriptionHtml:
***La posizione è disponibile presso i nostri centri logistici (Delivery Stations) situati nelle regioni Lombardia, Lazio, Piemonte, Veneto, Emilia-Romagna e Toscana. I candidati potranno essere presi in considerazione per una delle sedi presenti nelle regioni indicate, sulla base delle preferenze espresse durante il processo di selezione e delle esigenze aziendali.***

Il nostro team di ingegneria della manutenzione e dell'affidabilità è un elemento chiave dell'impegno di Amazon verso l'innovazione. Questo team si assicura che gli strumenti e le tecnologie che utilizziamo evolvano e si adattino ai cambiamenti allo stesso ritmo di Amazon. Come tecnico/a senior di ingegneria della manutenzione e dell'affidabilità, ci aiuterai a stare sempre un passo avanti, adottando le ultime tecnologie e identificando modi nuovi e più efficienti di lavorare. In questo ruolo, presterai particolare attenzione ai nostri processi per aiutare a rispettare gli esigenti standard che ci guidano e implementerai miglioramenti per continuare a progredire.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica e Trasporti. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 2 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

La retribuzione annua lorda minima per questa posizione è indicata di seguito. La retribuzione indicata corrisponde a un impiego a tempo pieno.
Per un impiego a tempo parziale, la retribuzione sarà adeguata proporzionalmente.

Amazon si riserva il diritto di offrire una retribuzione e/o un livello superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a. Il pacchetto retributivo di Amazon può includere un bonus di assunzione. Inoltre, il/la candidato/a potrebbe avere diritto a partecipare a un piano di assegnazione di azioni vincolate (RSU) gestito in modo indipendente da Amazon.com Inc. negli Stati Uniti.

Il team di selezione condividerà la retribuzione finale e l'eventuale piano di azioni vincolate, se applicabile, in base alle competenze e ai requisiti.

Oltre ai benefici previsti dalla legge e quelli applicabili al CCNL di riferimento, potrebbero essere previsti ulteriori benefici aziendali, soggetti a termini aggiuntivi.

Key job responsibilities
- Applicare le migliori pratiche nell'uso sicuro delle apparecchiature.
- Lavorare a stretto contatto con il personale tecnico in turno per supportarne lo sviluppo e fungere da primo punto di contatto.
- Risolvere i problemi delle apparecchiature per ridurre i tempi di fermo operativo, in modo che i pacchi possano essere elaborati il prima possibile.
- Aiutare a trovare modi per migliorare continuamente i sistemi e omogeneizzare i processi in tutta la rete dell'UE

A day in the life
In ogni turno, guiderai un team assicurandoti che tutti i suoi membri dispongono del materiale necessario e che questo funzioni perfettamente. Ciò implica la supervisione dei processi per garantire il rispetto delle normative e delle politiche, nonché assicurare che venga eseguita la manutenzione preventiva pertinente per aumentare il tempo di attività delle apparecchiature.

A partire da ciò che osserverai durante i tuoi turni, proporrai miglioramenti destinati ad aumentare l'efficienza e la produttività dei nostri sistemi e, successivamente, implementerai tali cambiamenti in tutti i nostri centri dell'UE. Dovrai inoltre utilizzare strumenti come Scada per supervisionare i processi al fine di garantirne le prestazioni, oltre a collaborare strettamente con il tuo supervisore diretto nelle attività amministrative.

Il tuo luogo di lavoro sarà in uno dei nostri centri operativi. Lavorerai per turni, che possono includere alcuni fine settimana e notti. Man mano che acquisirai esperienza in questo affascinante settore di Amazon.

About the team
Il nostro team di ingegneri della manutenzione e dell'affidabilità (RME) si occupa di garantire che i nostri sistemi funzionino a pieno rendimento. Ci caratterizziamo per la nostra grande competenza tecnica e la nostra eccellente capacità di lavoro di squadra, guidati da responsabili con grande esperienza. Il nostro lavoro comprende la manutenzione, la riparazione e la risoluzione dei problemi relativi alle apparecchiature in tutta la nostra rete mondiale di centri di distribuzione. Il team dispone di una serie di profili dirigenziali che si occupano di supervisionare lo sviluppo di tecnologie affascinanti, alcune delle quali esistono solo in Amazon.

Il nostro team si occupa della maggior parte degli aspetti tecnici di Amazon, svolgendo compiti che vanno dall'installazione di sistemi automatizzati di imballaggio alla supervisione della manutenzione generale di un centro o alla riparazione di apparecchiature chiave di distribuzione. Ciò include l'adattamento degli edifici alla legislazione vigente, affinché tutto il personale sia al sicuro e le nostre strutture funzionino con la massima efficienza possibile. Il team RME, come accade in altri dipartimenti di Amazon, offre numerose opportunità di progredire professionalmente.

Tutto il nostro lavoro ruota attorno alla riduzione dei periodi di inattività nei centri operativi cruciali di Amazon, affinché i clienti ricevano i loro ordini in tempo

Basic qualifications

- Diploma di istruzione secondaria superiore.
- Vasta esperienza in un ruolo manageriale in ambito tecnico.
- Vasta esperienza professionale in ambito elettrico e meccanico.
- Vasta esperienza nell’automazione o in contesti che prevedono l’utilizzo di macchinari per la movimentazione di materiali.
- Conoscenza avanzata della lingua italiana, parlata e scritta, e conoscenza di base della lingua inglese.

Preferred qualifications

- Le qualifiche preferenziali non sono requisiti obbligatori per candidarsi a una posizione in Amazon. Se possiedi tutte le qualifiche richieste di cui sopra, non esitare a inviarci la tua candidatura: saremo felici di esaminarla!
- Esperienza professionale in contesti lavorativi che prevedono il ricorso a molteplici imprese esecutrici esterne dislocate su più sedi.
- Comprensione dei sistemi di controllo basati su PLC e dei requisiti di conformità con le disposizioni normative.

title: Process Assistant, RSR
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Process Assistant (Full-time)

Since opening our virtual doors in 1995, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further. Our entire business works hard to delight our customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, fluid and intentional. That can be described in one of our core Leadership Principles, which is Bias for Action. This means that our teams band together, roll up their sleeves, and aren’t content with just standing still. We’re aiming to become the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is an exciting organization within Amazon dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces.

Process Assistants are part of the Last Mile operations in RSR and play a crucial role in this rapidly growing team. Process Assistants are responsible for daily management of department duties including: allocating labor, leading meetings, assigning job duties, providing work direction and communicating with internal and external suppliers.

Responsibilities:
• Track and report ATS/labor hours
• Occasionally assist with production duties, train associates and verify SOP (standard operating procedure) compliance
• Ensure successful area performance through tracking and reporting metrics
• Independently assess all aspects of associate work performance and provide timely and detailed feedback
• Participate in Operational Excellence initiatives
• Maintain a full understanding of workflow and daily production goals
• Review and update SOP’s as required
• Ensure work areas remain clean and are properly equipped
• Identify and address safety hazards within the work area, and participate in safety initiatives
• Coach associates on ways to work safely at all times
• Ensure all job injuries are reported timely in accordance with established policies and procedures
• Provide vacation coverage for Area Managers

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

Preferred qualifications

- Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree, and/or prior Amazon experience
- Awareness and willingness to use OPEX tools and techniques
- Demonstrates problem solving and analytical skills
- Ability to communicate effectively (written and verbal) across various levels of an organization
- History of meeting/exceeding departmental goals
- Experience leading teams
- Capable of providing direction to team members using independent judgment
- Organization and time management skills

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Frankenthal - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Du bewirbst dich auf unseren Talent Pool für Logistikpraktika mit Start ab Januar 2027. Durch eine frühzeitige Bewerbung profitierst du von:

* Frühzeitiger Berücksichtigung für verfügbare Positionen
* Bevorzugtem Zugang zu gewünschten Standorten und Startdaten
* Größerer Flexibilität bei der Terminplanung im Interviewprozess

Unser vorläufiger Zeitplan: Interviews beginnen im September, das Role Matching startet voraussichtlich im Oktober. Dieser Zeitplan kann sich je nach geschäftlichem Bedarf ändern.

Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. title: Quality Control Engineer, Integrated Project Quality (IPQ)
descriptionHtml:
The Quality Control Engineer (QCE) plays an essential role in AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery’s (DCCD) Integrated Project Quality (IPQ) program. This position is responsible for overseeing and executing quality assurance and control (QAQC) processes throughout the lifecycle of data center construction projects, ensuring that all work meets AWS's high standards for quality, safety, and performance.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
1. Lead the implementation of QAQC processes throughout data center construction projects, from pre-design to turnover phases and beyond.

2. Review design documents and provide feedback on constructability, maintainability, and quality assurance measures.

3. Develop and maintain quality control plans, factory/field inspection checklists, and relevant documentation.

4. Conduct onsite QAQC inspections for installation activities, ensuring compliance with AWS standards and specifications.

5. Coordinate with third-party Quality Control Agents/Vendors (QCA) to ensure comprehensive QAQC.

6. Facilitate regular QC meetings with stakeholders to review and address quality-related issues.

7. Monitor and report on quality metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) throughout the project lifecycle.

8. Identify, document, and track quality defects or non-conformances, ensuring timely resolution.

9. Compile and deliver comprehensive quality control turnover packages for each project phase.

10. Conduct final quality reviews and walkthroughs with key stakeholders prior to project handover.

11. Facilitate knowledge transfer to end customers on QAQC processes and lessons learned.

12. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing quality data and proposing process enhancements.

13. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Construction Management, Commissioning, and Data Center Engineering Operations to ensure seamless project execution.

14. Stay current with industry best practices and AWS-specific quality standards, incorporating them into quality control processes.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for! The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
· Primarily work in and support multiple Data Centers by Deploying, Servicing, and Upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

· Audit, maintain, and manage computer enterprise asset management systems for BMS and EPMS installations
· Manage small to medium size projects and programs.
· Perform point to point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

title: Sr. Product Mgr, Tech, AWS Messaging Services
descriptionHtml:
Sr. Product Manager - Technical — AWS Messaging Services

About the Team

AWS Messaging Services power the backbone of modern distributed applications. Our portfolio includes:

Amazon MQ (AMQ) — A managed message broker service for Apache ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ that makes it easy to migrate to the cloud. Amazon MQ provides compatibility with industry-standard messaging APIs and protocols, enabling customers to move from on-premises brokers without rewriting application code.

Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) — A fully managed message queuing service that enables decoupling and scaling of microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications. SQS eliminates the complexity of managing and operating message-oriented middleware, letting developers focus on differentiated work.

Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) — A fully managed pub/sub messaging and mobile notification service that enables high-throughput, push-based, many-to-many communication between distributed systems, microservices, event-driven serverless applications, and mobile devices.

Together, these services process trillions of messages monthly and are foundational to how customers build reliable, scalable, and loosely coupled architectures on AWS. From startups to the world's largest enterprises, customers depend on our messaging services for mission-critical workloads — including financial transactions, order processing, IoT telemetry, real-time analytics, and event-driven computing. When our services are unavailable or degraded, customer applications stop working. The stakes are high and the impact is massive.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Manager - Technical to define product strategy and drive roadmap execution for AWS Messaging Services. You will own the customer experience end-to-end — deeply understanding how developers, architects, and enterprises use messaging to build distributed systems, and shaping our services to meet their evolving needs. You will work backwards from customer problems to define features that make it easier, faster, and more cost-effective to build reliable applications at any scale

- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more AWS Messaging services (SQS, SNS, Amazon MQ)
- Write compelling narratives (PRFAQs, 1-pagers, 6-pagers) to define new product opportunities and gain leadership alignment
- Deeply understand messaging patterns (point-to-point, pub/sub, event-driven architectures, FIFO ordering, fan-out) and how customers apply them to solve real problems
- Partner with engineering, design, science, and business teams to deliver high-quality features on time

title: Bezpečnostný špecialista , WHS
descriptionHtml:
V Amazon je bezpečnosť a pohoda našich zamestnancov absolútnou prioritou. Naši špecialisti BOZP zohrávajú zásadnú úlohu v tom, aby tomu tak bolo. V tejto pozícii zavedieš nevyhnutné opatrenia, aby všetci na tvojom pracovisku pracovali v bezpečnom a zdravom prostredí. Je to praktická príležitosť robiť každý deň rozdiel v životoch ľudí. Proaktívnym zabezpečovaním ich bezpečnosti im tiež dodáš istotu v ich úlohách a motiváciu k najlepším výkonom.

Key job responsibilities

Monitorovanie výkonnosti pracoviska podľa stanovených KPI a tvorba plánov zlepšenia procesov.
Zavádzanie programov BOZP a organizácia školení.
Analýza bezpečnostných metrík a trendov incidentov s cieľom pomôcť kolegom plánovať zodpovedajúce zdroje pre oblasti s najvyšším rizikom.
Vykonávanie auditov na zabezpečenie súladu pracoviska s príslušnou legislatívou BOZP a implementácia riešení pri identifikácii rizík.


A day in the life
Budeš pracovať na jednom z našich pracovísk — distribučnom centre, triediarne alebo doručovacej stanici. Prítomnosť na mieste ti umožní pozorne sledovať procesy. Okrem zabezpečovania súladu s predpismi BOZP budeš identifikovať potenciálne problémy a príležitosti na zlepšenie. To znamená úzku spoluprácu s ľuďmi v celej firme, aby si poznal/a riziká, ktorým čelia, a zhromažďoval/a dáta pre nájdenie múdrejších a bezpečnejších spôsobov práce. Budeš tiež pripravovať školenia a ďalšie programy, aby všetci dodržiavali nové bezpečnostné postupy a dosahovali nové štandardy.

About the team
Tím Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) zohráva kľúčovú úlohu pri zabezpečovaní duševnej a fyzickej pohody našich zamestnancov v práci. Náš tím spolupracuje s vedúcimi, zamestnancami a miestnymi úradmi na všetkých našich pracoviskách a zabezpečuje dodržiavanie politík Amazonu a právnych predpisov a bezpečnosť našich pracovných prostredí. Tím ponúka rôznorodé príležitosti — od technikov bezpečnosti po programových manažérov. Bez ohľadu na tvoju pozíciu budeš prispievať k rozvoju a implementácii bezpečnostnej stratégie v celej sieti.

Basic qualifications

- Bakalársky titul alebo rovnocenná úroveň kvalifikácie v súlade s Európskym kvalifikačným rámcom (EQF).
- Znalosť slovenskej legislatívy BOZP.
- Plynulá znalosť slovenčiny a veľmi dobrá znalosť angličtiny (B2), písomne aj ústne.
- Bezpečnostný technik (BT) certification

Preferred qualifications

- Preferované kvalifikácie nie sú nutné na podanie prihlášky v Amazone. Ak spĺňaš všetky vyššie uvedené základné kvalifikácie, radi sa s tebou zoznámime.
- Skúsenosti s metodológiami Lean, 5S alebo Kaizen.
- Skúsenosti s plánovaním alebo riadením ekologických iniciatív.
- Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking to hire a Network Technician to join our growing team within Networking. Your responsibilities would involve delivering the hardware, configuration and fiber connectivity of interdependent scaling projects across several data center locations. You will work closely with both internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution in association with Technical Program Managers.

Key job responsibilities
• Working closely with our Network Engineering & Network Technical Project Manager teams to ensure fast, smooth rollout of established designs and products.
• Managing work priorities through ticketing system and workflows & collaborating with various stake holders to remove project obstacles.
• Troubleshooting networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low-level application interaction.
• Troubleshooting cabling infrastructure connectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords.
• Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment.
• Completing customer requests via Remedy trouble ticketing system and project management workflows.
• Participating in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware.
• You will be required to travel, up to 20% travel outside traditional work area may be required possibly including international travel


A day in the life
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Senior Optical Communication Engineer, Amazon Leo for Government
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering team is a multi-disciplinary technology team involved in developing and delivering targeted and scalable solutions for custom satellite and ground applications. The ALG Engineering team works closely with the core LEO team, and addresses the needs of specific customers (such as government agencies). The Senior Optical Communication Engineer will play a pivotal role in the team delivering innovative and fast-paced analysis and design for both space and ground optical systems and sub-systems.

As a Senior Optical Communications Engineer you will play a crucial role developing satellite communication systems, optical satellite links, digital signal processing and networking between both space-to-space and space-to-ground systems. Working with a dynamic team of cross discipline engineers, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining optical communication devices with bus agnostic interfaces, space-to-ground capabilities, tunable modems, long range backhaul performance, and seamless integration of unique waveforms. We provide engineering solutions for achieving free space optical communication systems. We work hand in hand with hardware, software, product and operations teams to deliver solutions that seek to extract more capability from our baseline and onboard new technologies into our next generation systems.
The Senior Optical Communications Engineer will play a pivotal role on the Amazon Leo for Government Engineering team delivering innovative and fast-paced free space Optical Communication solutions.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define optical communication system requirements and architecture for our satellite constellation.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define optical communication system requirements and architecture for our satellite constellation.
• Develop and optimize optical communication system hardware and software components, for real time communication ensuring efficient resource utilization and reliable performance.
• Implement and test product designs that demonstrate functional and performance capabilities
• Contribute to system integration efforts, working closely with hardware engineer to ensure seamless interaction between software and hardware components.
• Participate in reviews, identify areas for improvement, and maintain high standards to ensure optical communication system quality and reliability.
• Debug and troubleshoot software and hardware integration issues, employing tools and techniques to identify and resolve anomalies.
• Collaborate on designing and executing test plans to validate the functionality, performance, and security of optical communication systems
• Keep up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, and apply relevant advancements to enhance the performance and capabilities of Amazon Leo's optical communication systems.

Security Clearance: Candidates may be required to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI, so you must be a U.S. citizen for consideration.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

A day in the life
As a Senior Optical Communication Engineer you will be responsible for leading the design, development and implementation of unique solutions to integrate and interoperate with Amazon Leo products and customer terminals. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams inside and outside of Amazon. You implement industry best practices while you guide the designs from requirements gathering through deployment. This role is hands on and will require an ability to build and test hardware and software optical communication systems. You will need to be flexible and responsive to high priority issues

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, or equivalent
- 8+ years of experience designing and developing optical systems
- 4+ years experience with free space optical communication systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects

title: Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, AGS Brazil FSI
descriptionHtml:
As an AWS Customer Solutions Manager, you'll guide customers through their multi-year cloud transformation journey, ensuring seamless collaboration across AWS teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. You'll serve as a trusted advisor, orchestrating strategy and execution while solving complex cloud adoption challenges at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with customers to understand their cloud adoption goals and guide them through each phase of their transformation journey, from initial planning through operational excellence.
- Coordinate across AWS teams to ensure aligned execution, breaking down silos between sales, support, solutions architecture, and professional services to deliver integrated customer solutions.
- Develop and manage customer engagement plans that translate strategic objectives into actionable milestones, tracking progress and adjusting approaches based on business outcomes.
- Lead customer business reviews and executive briefings that communicate progress, address challenges, and identify opportunities for expanded AWS adoption and innovation.
- Identify and advocate for new AWS services and solutions that address customer needs, bringing creative approaches and tools to solve complex technical and operational challenges.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll work directly with customers navigating their cloud adoption, helping them understand the operational, educational, and governance aspects of their AWS journey. You'll coordinate across multiple AWS teams—including sales, support, solutions architecture, and professional services—to plan and support large-scale workload migrations. Your day might include translating strategic customer initiatives into executable plans, leading business reviews and executive briefings, or facilitating knowledge-sharing sessions that align technical solutions with business goals. You'll also identify opportunities to introduce new AWS services and tools that address emerging customer challenges, working collaboratively with your peers to drive innovation and operational excellence.

About the team
We're a global team dedicated to helping customers succeed in their cloud transformation. Our vision is to make cloud adoption accessible, efficient, and impactful for organizations of all sizes. We work closely with customers across industries, understanding their unique business challenges and helping them unlock the full potential of cloud technology. You'll collaborate with a diverse group of technical experts, account leaders, and customer teams who are committed to delivering exceptional outcomes. We value inclusive perspectives, continuous learning, and a culture where everyone contributes to our shared success. Our team embraces flexibility and supports a healthy balance between work and personal life, recognizing that our best work happens when we're energized and supported both professionally and personally.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Mental Health and Well-Being (MHW), Glamazon, and Women at Amazon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Mechatronics Engineer, Amazon Robotics (AR)
descriptionHtml:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world problems that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

We are seeking a highly skilled Mechatronics Robot Analyst to join our team developing advanced robotic hardware technology. This role focuses on comprehensive performance evaluation, design validation, and optimization of robotic systems at scale. You will create detailed technical reports examining robot dynamics, kinematics, and performance characteristics to support the development and deployment of innovative automation solutions. - Be able to collaborate directly with customers to align on requirements, discuss tradeoffs, communicate concepts clearly, etc

- Design and adaptation of holistic hardware solutions for ambiguous problems with fluid requirements

descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations
Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.
