https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Dortmund - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.


Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.

A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:

• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2026 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.

title: Data Centre Facility Manager (Engineering Operations)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be accountable for:
· Setting and maintaining the highest standard for safety and actively promoting a world-class safety culture
· The key performance metrics for a significant number of large scale Data Centres distributed across multiple AWS owned and Co-location sites (hosted by 3rd party service providers.) by continuously driving improvements while delivering performance against said metrics
· Delivering 100% uptime on all customer supporting infrastructure
· Strategic planning and execution of all corrective and preventative maintenance activities on all mission-critical infrastructure
· Managing strong technical teams with responsibility for the training and/or development of others to ensure operational excellence and career development
· Successful delivery of strategic projects on critical infrastructure
· Successful delivery of build-out and retrofit of facility infrastructure in existing and new regional locations
· Managing vendor performance by consistently setting high standards, driving accountability and conducting regular performance reviews
· Risk Management: adopt and plan corporate risk strategy.
· Critical Event Response readiness (planning, escalation/incident management, customer impacting event management response and recovery.)
· Experience in working and managing within complex organizational matrix, manage and grow relationships between cross-functional teams.

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 6 or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.

A day in the life
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or relevant Engineering discipline or demonstrable equivalent (lesser qualification + equivalent work experience)
- Several years’ experience in a high-volume mission-critical operational environment (eg. data center, healthcare, high technology manufacturing, large scale production, aviation maintenance) preferably 7x24x365 operational experience & responsibilities
- First-hand knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, employee relations, leadership techniques, operational performance, and coordination of people and resources
- Full EU/ IT driving license.

Preferred qualifications

- Several years relevant industry related experience
- Demonstrate key electrical and mechanical competencies and theory
- Know and apply safe electrical practice according to guidelines set by relevant electrical safety supervisory bodies
- Have a strong working knowledge and experience of the purpose and infrastructure of a Data Center
- In-depth knowledge of UPS, backup generator systems and generic mechanical-room infrastructure such as chillers, Cooler Units, and fan controls

You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient AI and cloud architectures. You’ll drive technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.

Building relationships to understand our customers is key. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.

You’ll also act as an evangelist in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. title: Operations Manager, Verification Risk Management Operation KYC / SVR
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform.

Amazon is seeking an Operations Manager to join our VRMO team, reporting to the Level 6 Leader. You will be responsible for providing the overall management for a team of 120-150 employees and direct leadership to the operations team, overseeing and developing employee performance and process improvement activities.
The job holder will be responsible for building and adhering to maintaining SOP’s, implementing, managing and reporting through Metrics, Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators. Furthermore, they will adhere to all aspects of our VRMO Trust & Safety Tenets to protect the Amazon.com brand globally and maximize trust in our end to end systems with buyers, sellers and all other customers.

You will be working in a fast-paced environment where every day brings new challenges and new opportunities. You should thrive and have demonstrated success in an environment, which offers ambiguously defined problems, big challenges, and quick changes. You are expected to balance big thinking with detailed execution and solid cross-functional collaborative results-oriented work. You should have excellent business and communication skills and be able to work with senior management globally, site peers and wide business stakeholders as well as legal owners to develop and define mutually agreeable solutions. This position will involve regular communication and engagement with senior management. Cross-team coordination, project management and executive level presentation skills will be key to success. This is a highly visible and impacting role within VRMO. You will be expected to work with the program team to scale processes within the function to better serve new sellers during the on-boarding process.

Key job responsibilities
Manage a team of managers and an overall operations team of between 120 and 150 employees.

Ensure high quality and high volume productivity within the jobholder’s organizational units.

Play a critical role in building management depth by providing guidance and mentorship to all levels of leadership within your organizational units, as well as serving as a role model.

Develop employees and their skill sets to expand the team capabilities and provide growth opportunities for future Amazon.com leaders including application of succession planning at all levels across all teams.

Manage and execute for defined metrics and quality, maintain clear metrics on our investigation handling volumes, performance, and decision quality.

Achieve operational excellence and drive process improvement in our service level agreements (SLAs) for all processing activities.

Analyze the key levers of the business to identify bad debt trends and proactively take action to eliminate root cause defects.

The manager's success will be measured by their ability to drive operational efficiencies across all processing areas whilst improving internal and external customer experience.

Keys to success in this role include exceptional leadership, analytical, managerial, interpersonal, and project management skills. This role blends operations, product management, customer service, global strategy, finance, and usability.

- 13+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
- 6+ years of team management experience

- Experience across the domain of risk management & fraud

title: Content Security Engineer, GME Security
descriptionHtml:
The Content Security team protects pre-release content across Amazon Global Media and Entertainment. This Content Security Engineer role combines hands-on production security advisory with technical execution: securing content creation workflows, researching and developing next-generation protection measures, and maintaining the cloud infrastructure and tooling that power our security mechanisms. You will work directly with studio and film production teams across the content creation lifecycle (pre-production, production, post-production, and delivery) while also driving forward-looking initiatives to address emerging threats, including those introduced by generative AI. You will also leverage AI and automation to scale and mechanize content security operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the primary content security advisor to film and series production teams, providing tailored guidance on secure workflow design: editorial environment setup, Aspera file transfer configurations, cloud storage architecture, on-set networking, and remote collaboration tools
- Assess internal and external content processing architectures (large enterprise to boutique post houses) to securely deploy and maintain content networks and equipment
- Manage security assessments of 3rd party services and tools supporting Amazon Studios, including intake of production team requests and end-to-end vendor security coordination
- Research, evaluate, and pilot next-generation content security measures such as forensic watermarking, audio/video fingerprinting, and content tracking technologies
- Contribute to the team's strategy for securing pre-release content against generative AI threats, including AI-driven extraction, reconstruction, deepfake misuse, and model training on unreleased assets; translate emerging risks into actionable controls and standards
- Maintain and enhance AWS infrastructure and applications supporting Content Security operations, and build internal security tooling to automate workflows such as access governance, audit reporting, and compliance monitoring
- Write and maintain lightweight automation (Python/scripting) to support security tooling, audit workflows, and operational reporting
- Develop and iterate security standard operating procedures tailored to each studio and production team
- Provide regular written updates on program status, risk posture, and incident findings

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores
Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 3+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non-internship) experience
- 3+ years of any combination of the following: threat modeling experience, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security experience
- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
- Knowledge of industry-based security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques
- Knowledge of usage or integration experience with common cloud-hosted services

title: Process Expert, ACES, Yard E2E Excellence

descriptionHtml:
As a DevOps Engineer at Veeqo, you will be in charge of continuously improving the resiliency and security of the systems that make Veeqo's products and features possible. Collaborate with 5 product engineering teams (2PTs) who depend on shared infrastructure

A day in the life
You start the day triaging alerts and monitoring dashboards. If on-call, you're first responder for production issues.

Mid-morning is infrastructure delivery: provisioning resources, writing Infrastructure-as-Code, or reviewing change management plans.

After lunch, you're helping product teams debug deployment failures, identifying root causes, and adding automation to prevent recurrence.

Later, you prepare your own production changes (patching, upgrading, or scaling) with proper testing, documentation, and peer approval.

No two days are identical. Some are project-heavy, others operationally heavy. The constant: end-to-end ownership. You design it, build it, deploy it, and operate it.

You will contribute to well-written findings and reporting, support the prioritisation of issues in line with business objectives and regulatory expectations, and over time build confidence working with stakeholders to align on practical solutions and help verify that issues are addressed appropriately.

Key job responsibilities
- Executes assigned audit tasks and test steps on well defined components of audits within agreed timelines, under guidance from more senior auditors.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

Key job responsibilities

Identify opportunity for sales and profit from multiple dimensions, and translate them to action plans with priority calls. Audit business teams’ assumptions and plans. Translate opportunities to business goals, with key inputs which matters to the outputs, identify road-blocks, ensure proper and sufficient action plans are developed, and track the delivery.

title: Account Consultant , Financial Deduction Vendor Consultant Program
descriptionHtml:

The Financial Deduction Vendor Consultant Program (FD VCP) works with Amazon AVS Retail Vendors and internal stakeholders who are facing supply chain defects that lead to financial deductions. The service provides a dedicated support aimed to identify and sustainably resolve the defects causing financial deductions. We are seeking a Financial Deductions (FD) Consultant to join our team.
The FD Consultant is a strategic role that combines financial analysis, vendor management, and process optimization responsibilities. This professional manages a portfolio of companies within the VCP FD program, focusing on provinding investigation findings, improving financial metrics such as ISR, PPV, Chargebacks, Vendor Returns etc. through data-driven analysis and proactive vendor engagement. They serve as an essential bridge between vendors and internal stakeholders, conducting deep-dive analyses of financial data, leading vendor-facing Kaizen sessions, and implementing improvement plans while maintaining strong relationships with all stakeholders involved. The role demands expertise in financial operations, data analysis, and stakeholder management, as they work to optimize processes, develop automation initiatives, and provide mentorship to team members. Through their comprehensive understanding of financial deductions and vendor operations, they enhance vendor experience (VX) while ensuring operational excellence and driving continuous improvement across the organization.


Key job responsibilities
Business Impact
Manage and optimize the FD VCP program vendor portfolio, focusing on key performance metrics such as ISR, PPV, Chargebacks etc. Implement preventive measures and action plans to drive vendor performance while enhancing overall vendor experience. Streamline interactions between vendors and internal teams to improve efficiency and support quality.
Dive Deep, Data Analysis & Reporting
Conduct comprehensive financial data analysis to identify deduction patterns and root causes through thorough auditing and utilization of internal systems. Prepare and distribute detailed reports to all levels of stakeholders, ensuring effective communication of findings and insights.
Stakeholder Communication
Cultivate strategic relationships with internal and external stakeholders to gain a deep understanding of vendor financial deduction metrics and activities. Lead Kaizen sessions, manage cross-functional communications, and handle escalations while providing regular updates to vendors and senior management. Represent the team in project reviews and operational meetings, delivering data-driven presentations and supporting internal teams in financial metric performance.
Operations & Process Excellence
Independently execute and optimize financial deductions processes while identifying and implementing tactical solutions for operational challenges. Drive continuous improvement initiatives, develop comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and actively participate in Correction of Error (COE) processes. Support quality audits and spearhead efficiency improvements across operations.
Team Support
Provide mentorship and training to new team members, fostering their professional growth and development. Support talent acquisition efforts and manage resource allocation and capacity planning to ensure optimal team performance and efficiency.
Process Improvement & Innovation
Design and implement small-scale automation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity improvements. Conduct systematic analysis to identify upstream issues and develop process improvements aligned with organizational goals. Support the launch of new programs, categories, and features to foster innovation and growth.

- Bachelor's degree

- Proficiency in data analysis and business metrics

- Experience in e-Commerce or retail/vendor management
- Ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders

title: Demand Generation Sales Leader, Growth team
descriptionHtml:
The Demand Generation (DG) team focuses on identifying and acquiring new customers, accelerating the growth of existing customers, building and progressing high-quality pipeline toward customer outcomes, and developing a talent flywheel that contributes to scaling diverse early career professionals across the AWS Global Sales organisation.
As a Demand Generation leader, you will lead a team of Demand Generation Representatives (DGRs) in identifying, engaging, and acquiring new customers through various prospecting motions in partnership with a complex, cross-functional team of sales leaders, marketing professionals, technical specialists, and Partners. You will exercise ownership in support of strategic efforts to accelerate customer adoption of AWS services, penetrate new markets and verticals, while educating and building trust with internal stakeholders such as field and inside sellers and executive leaders to deliver results for the business. This role is a core part of the AWS Frontline Sales Management (FLM) community, contributing directly to the field sales leadership ecosystem where you will provide in-depth sales coaching and mentoring to your team of early career professionals to help them exceed quarterly KPIs and goals, build sales acumen and leadership skills, and ultimately guide them in their career growth within the AWS Global Sales organisation. You will shape how your team engages customers across the sales cycle, coaching team members to take ownership of customer outcomes rather than activity alone.


Key job responsibilities
● Lead, coach, and develop a team of Demand Generation Representatives responsible for identifying and acquiring new customers through effective outbound and inbound prospecting, scheduling customer meetings, and generating qualified opportunities for Field Sales progression.
● Manage team to performance KPIs and goals including outbound calls, meetings scheduled, opportunity creation ($ and # warm-hand off and closed-won), and marketing lead (MQL) follow-up.
● Be the trusted advisor and voice of Demand Generation within the FLM sales leadership team, engaging regional/segment sales leaders and cross-functional teams through monthly business reviews, QBRs, and cross-functional roundtables.
● Identify internal and external challenges and build scalable mechanisms that drive solutions and impact for your immediate team as well as your extended stakeholder organisation.
● Partner with Marketing, Partner Sales, Solution Architects, FLM peers, and Operations teams to align demand generation efforts with broader business objectives and drive customer outcomes end-to-end.
● Attract, hire, onboard, and retain top talent. Build a strong talent bench through deliberate succession planning, internal development pathways, and proactive pipelining of future candidates to ensure team continuity and readiness for growth.
● Leverage AI-powered tooling to drive team efficiency, enabling reps to focus on high-propensity customer engagement over manual administrative tasks.


About the team
The Demand Generation team sits within the Cloud Sales Center (CSC) and operates as the tip-of-the-spear for AWS customer acquisition and growth. DGRs perform customer outreach through calls, emails, and messages to generate qualified opportunities which are handed off to Cloud Sales Reps (CSRs) and Account Managers (AMs) to nurture and progress to revenue. The function develops early-career sales talent through a structured graduate and intern program, with clear progression paths to Senior DGR, CSR, and Account Manager roles.
DG Managers are frontline sales Managers (FLMs) responsible for team performance, talent development, stakeholder engagement, and operational excellence. They work closely with APJ and Area Leadership to implement regional strategy, drive operational planning initiatives, and build mechanisms that scale across the organisation. As part of the broader FLM sales team, DG Managers participate in shared leadership development, cross-functional sales cadences, and contribute to the collective field sales strategy.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technology related sales, business development or equivalent experience
- Experience meeting revenue targets and quotas
- Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, and web-based meeting applications
- Experience hiring and growing top talent
- Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting
- ● 3+ years of people management experience; managing teams of 5 or more

Preferred qualifications

- ● Experience in B2B Cloud, SaaS, or enterprise technology sales environments
- ● Experience leading teams through sales cycle progression beyond initial qualification, including opportunity advancement and customer conversion
- ● Experience developing and executing multi-modal, targeted prospecting campaigns
- ● Familiarity with marketing-to-sales lead flow processes (MQL to SQL, SQL to SQO)
- ● Experience with sales engagement tools (e.g., Boost, Outreach) and prospecting platforms (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator)
- ● Experience with opportunity qualification frameworks (e.g., BANT, MEDDPICC)
- ● Familiarity with AI/ML-powered sales tools, signal-based prospecting, or agentic workflow platforms
- ● Track record of developing talent pipelines and progressing individual contributors into expanded sales roles

title: Senior Instandhaltungstechniker:in
descriptionHtml:
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

Key job responsibilities
Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf
Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen
Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk

A day in the life
Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren.
Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften.
Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln.



About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

- Technical writing to support change management program

- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

- Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- Can bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working

- Can walk on job sites in uneven terrain
- Can work at heights and from ladders

- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of data center engineering experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling
- Experience in data center engineering
- Can perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired

title: Sr. Manager, Software Development, Elastic File System
descriptionHtml:
Lead the technical vision and strategy for one of AWS's most critical storage services, managing multiple engineering teams building the world's most scalable, elastic, and fully managed cloud file storage. Your decisions will directly impact millions of active file systems, exabytes of stored data, and customers ranging from startups to the world's largest enterprises.

Key job responsibilities
- **Build and develop engineering leadership**: Hire, mentor, and advance engineering leaders and senior engineers, creating an inclusive environment where technical talent can grow and contribute meaningfully to strategic initiatives.

- **Define strategic technical vision**: Own a strategically important area of EFS architecture—such as the data plane, metadata service, or replication systems—and establish a 3–5 year technical roadmap that addresses the needs of large, critical customer bases.

- **Drive architectural excellence**: Contribute to distributed systems design discussions, identify systemic risks and opportunities across the storage stack, and champion solutions that improve security, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

- **Influence across organizational boundaries**: Partner with teams across S3, EBS, FSx, and the broader AWS ecosystem to reach consensus on technical direction, influence peer roadmaps, and deliver cohesive solutions that advance cloud storage capabilities.

- **Establish operational excellence**: Create mechanisms to inspect service quality, customer experience, and operational health, while fostering a culture of innovation that encourages simplification and continuous improvement.


A day in the life
You'll spend your time balancing strategic leadership with hands-on technical engagement. Your day might include architecting solutions for distributed file system challenges, mentoring engineering leaders on complex technical decisions, and collaborating with peer teams across AWS Storage to advance cloud infrastructure capabilities. You'll participate in design reviews for critical components like metadata management and storage tiering, then shift to performance calibration conversations with your team leads. title: PM, Customs Brokerage, Amazon Customs & Trade
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customs and Trade (ACT), a licensed customs broker and subsidiary of Amazon, is seeking an experienced Program Manager to drive operational excellence and strategic execution across our U.S. customs brokerage operations. This individual contributor role sits at the intersection of compliance, process design, and cross-functional program delivery. You will translate deep customs expertise into scalable operational frameworks, measurable performance improvements, and streamlined workflows that support ACT's growing import volume and expanding customer base. If you are energized by building structure in complex regulatory environments and influencing outcomes across large, distributed teams, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
Develop and execute operational strategy for customs brokerage activities, including planning, automation initiatives, and process optimization across U.S. import operations
Design, refine, and standardize customs operating procedures in collaboration with operations, compliance, finance, and technology partners to build repeatable and reliable performance structures
Create and own program metrics to gauge performance, surface defects, and identify trends; translate data into actionable recommendations for senior leadership
Lead end-to-end program delivery for customs initiatives, including scope definition, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder communication
Serve as a subject matter expert on U.S. CBP regulations, HTS classification, entry documentation, and trade compliance requirements, providing guidance that shapes operational decisions
Partner with product, technology, and business intelligence teams to identify and implement automation and tooling solutions that reduce manual effort and improve compliance outcomes
Coordinate cross-functional alignment across operations, legal, finance, and human resources to connect policies, standard operating procedures, and internal controls to measurable compliance improvements
Streamline communication and change management across stakeholder groups and operations teams in multiple geographies to prevent siloed work streams and ensure consistent execution
Identify continuous improvement opportunities and build mechanisms to institutionalize gains over time

A day in the life
The day typically begins with a review of program metrics: entry volumes, error rates, cycle times, and open action items from ongoing initiatives. From there, you might lead a working session with operations and technology partners to scope a new automation feature, then shift to drafting or refining an SOP based on a recent gap identified in the data. Afternoons often involve syncing with legal or finance on a policy change, reviewing a change management communication before it goes to field teams, or building a metrics brief for a senior leadership review. This role does not manage people directly; it manages programs, processes, and influence across a complex, high-stakes regulatory environment. The decisions you shape here affect thousands of import entries per day.

About the team
Amazon Customs and Trade is transforming how businesses navigate international trade at scale. ACT operates as a federally licensed customs broker, combining deep regulatory expertise with Amazon's culture of innovation and operational rigor. The team is building the infrastructure, tooling, and processes that define modern customs brokerage, and program managers here play a central role in connecting strategy to execution. ACT values data-driven decision making, continuous improvement, and raising the compliance bar. You will work alongside customs brokers, trade compliance specialists, product managers, and operations leaders across a fast-moving, high-volume environment.

- Experience developing operational processes and data insights

title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer, Amazon Leo Power Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

In this role you will design the power converters that fly on Amazon Leo satellites. You'll own topology selection, magnetics design, and prototype validation for custom DCDC converters that power the constellation. Your designs go from simulation to bench to orbit.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Own power converter design end to end: topology selection, magnetics design, control loop compensation, prototype build, characterization, and validation.

Lead architecture trades that balance efficiency, mass, thermal, and reliability. Your recommendations determine what gets built.

Design, simulate, and build prototype converters. When something doesn't behave, get to the bottom of it and fix it.

Lead design reviews and set the technical bar for power on the satellite.

Define power specifications and interface requirements that govern how subsystems interact with the power system.

Analyze power system interactions and ensure EMI/EMC compliance across designs.

Mentor engineers and provide technical direction to programs integrating your designs.

Work closely with mechanical, thermal, and systems teams to close budgets and solve problems within real-world constraints.

A day in the life
You might spend the morning working through magnetics tradeoffs for a new isolated converter, then head to the lab to characterize a prototype you designed. After lunch you're leading a design review, helping a team understand the limits of a converter they're adopting. Then you're back at your desk refining a simulation that caught a thermal issue before it became expensive. The work is varied, technical, and yours.

About the team
The Power Electronics Design team owns power for the entire satellite. We design our own converters, qualify our own magnetics, and write our own specs. A single converter design can cover multiple subsystems, and a single qualification unlocks a component for the entire constellation. Small team, outsized impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 5+ years of experience designing switching DCDC power converters including topology selection, magnetics design, and control loop compensation
- Experience taking power electronics designs from concept through production
- Experience with both isolated and non-isolated converter topologies in production hardware
- Experience with measurement, troubleshooting, and debug of power electronics in a lab environment
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans, and test procedures

Preferred qualifications

- Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering with focus on power electronics
- Custom magnetics design (transformer and inductor development, core/material selection, loss analysis)
- Experience with resonant converters, flyback, forward, and multi-phase topologies
- EMC/EMI design and mitigation for switching converters
- Simulation-driven design methodology (LTspice, PLECS, or equivalent)
- Experience in aerospace, satellite, or high-reliability hardware environments
- Deep understanding of power semiconductor tradeoffs (Si, SiC, GaN)
- Experience with reliability analysis, derating, and worst-case circuit analysis
- Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers

title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer, Annapurna Labs, Artificial Intelligence Hardware
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs (our organization within AWS) designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

As a member of the Annapurna ML/AI Mechanical Thermal Engineering team, you'll own the end-to-end thermal and mechanical architecture for ML/AI accelerator platforms — from initial concept through production deployment and ongoing fleet operations. You'll design mechanical and cooling solutions for some of the highest power-density silicon in the industry, balancing performance, reliability, cost, and operational efficiency at massive scale.

This is a technically challenging role requiring you to operate in ambiguity and at a fast pace. You'll collaborate across silicon design, electrical engineering, firmware, manufacturing, supply chain, and operations teams to deliver platforms that power AWS ML/AI services at global scale.

Key job responsibilities
As a Cloud Hardware Development Engineer (Thermal/Mechanical), you will:

Platform Ownership

Own the complete thermal and mechanical design for ML/AI accelerator platforms — from rack-level infrastructure down to chip packaging, including mechanical packaging, structural integrity, and interconnect systems

Define thermal and mechanical design requirements, establish design targets, and drive cross-functional alignment that enables parallel development across hardware, firmware, and software teams

Deliver production platforms through the full lifecycle: concept, design, analysis, prototyping, validation, manufacturing ramp, and fleet operations

Thermal & Mechanical Design

Design and optimize cooling solutions (air and liquid) for high-power-density ML/AI accelerators

Develop detailed CFD models, compact RC models, and structural FEA for SoC/package thermal analysis and mechanical integrity

Design rack manifolds, cold plates, and data center liquid cooling interfaces for at-scale liquid-cooled deployments

Develop and validate mechanical structures including chassis and enclosures for manufacturability, reliability, and serviceability. Owning tolerance stack-up analysis, GD&T, and DFM for high-volume manufacturing methods (stamping, bending, extrusion, die-casting)

Own mechanical design of integrating high-speed interconnect subsystems including cable cartridges, backplane connectors, and mating interfaces — defining alignment, gatherability, insertion force, and serviceability requirements

Perform structural FEA for shock, vibration, and transportation loads to ensure mechanical integrity across the product lifecycle

Fleet Operations & Reliability

Participate in on-call rotations monitoring fleet thermal telemetry for emergent issues

Perform root cause analysis of thermal and mechanical failures in production, implementing firmware updates, hardware modifications, or operational procedure changes

Cross-Functional Leadership

Drive design standardization

Engage with ODMs and component suppliers to drive design optimization, cost reduction, and supply chain resilience

Lead design reviews, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to the technical direction of the broader organization

Influence chip packaging decisions and establish validation methodologies

About the team
In 2015, Annapurna Labs was acquired by Amazon Web Services (AWS). Since then, we have developed products that power every layer of the AWS cloud, including AWS Nitro, Graviton processors, and custom ML/AI accelerators — Trainium for training and Inferentia for inference — that enable customers to build and run generative AI applications at scale.

The ML/AI MTE team is part of the Annapurna ML/AI hardware development organization. We design and deliver the thermal and mechanical systems for every generation of custom ML/AI accelerator hardware — from chip package through rack-level infrastructure. Our platforms operate at massive scale across AWS data centers globally, with current programs including next-generation Trainium and Inferentia systems featuring liquid cooling at scale.

- BS degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 7+ years industry experience in Mechanical and Thermal design in electronics packaging
- Experience in thermal and performance measurements and characterization on SoCs, Servers, or related Systems
- 3+ years of experience in SoC Thermal modelling and IC package transient thermal response
- Experience with chip package, system mechanical & thermal design for air-cooled and liquid-cooled systems
- Experience with tolerance analysis (stack-up/GD&T) and sheet metal or precision-machined component design for electronics packaging
- Experience with production fleet support: telemetry analysis, root cause analysis, and defining mitigation strategies
- Experience leading cross-functional technical projects spanning silicon, firmware, mechanical, and operations teams

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of generic mechanical room infrastructure such as chillers, cooler units, and fan controls
- Experience in mentoring, leading, or managing more junior engineers
- Knowledge of SoC thermal/mechanical design methodology, power modeling and thermal analysis techniques
- Tool familiarity: Ansys Icepak, FloTherm, Cadence Celsius, PTC Creo, and Solidworks
- Proficiency in 3D CAD modeling and engineering drawings per ASME Y14.5 (GD&T) standards
- Programming experience: Bash script, Shell script, Linux, Python, and Lua. Familiarity with working in a Linux environment
- Knowledge of various types of technologies used for heatsink solutions, Thermal Interface Materials (TIMs), and liquid cooling technologies
- Knowledge of hardware and software based thermal/power management control algorithms
- Experience with liquid cooling system design: rack manifolds, cold plates, quick-disconnect fittings, CDU integration
- Experience with mechanical design of high-density interconnect systems (cable cartridges, blind-mate connectors, backplane assemblies)

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS SageMaker AI
descriptionHtml:
At AWS SageMaker AI, we're making it easy to build state-of-the-art foundation models on the cloud. Instead of hand-chaining data prep, distributed training, evaluation, and deployment across thousands of GPU and AWS Trainium devices, Model Factory lets teams express the whole lifecycle as a single, contract-validated workflow — orchestrated, reproducible, and fully managed. As LLMs and Generative AI scale, Model Factory is the platform that turns frontier training research into a reliable, repeatable pipeline for our internal teams and customers.

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to help design, build, and operate the distributed systems at the core of this platform — the orchestration engine, compute integrations, SDK and contract layer, and the infrastructure that runs large-scale training and customization jobs. You'll own components end-to-end, from design through delivery and on-call operations, and work closely with the ML scientists and platform teams who depend on Model Factory every day. You'll turn requirements into robust, scalable, supportable services that fit cleanly into the overall architecture, uphold a high engineering bar, and grow your scope and technical leadership as you go.

A successful candidate has a strong software-engineering foundation, writes high-quality distributed-systems and services code, communicates clearly, and is motivated to deliver results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

title: Escalations Manager, AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention Escalations
descriptionHtml:
AWS protects millions of customer accounts from fraud, abuse, and financial risk every day. When our enforcement actions create friction for legitimate customers - a suspended account, a blocked payment instrument, a spend restriction, someone needs to own the resolution, communicate with the customer, and fix the system so it doesn’t happen again. That someone is you.
We are looking for a Risk Manager to join the AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention Escalations team in Seattle. This is a high-judgment role with direct exposure to VP-level stakeholders, enterprise account teams, and cross-functional engineering leaders. You will be the US West hours decision-maker for fraud escalations.
The successful candidate will own two areas:
1. Payments and Fraud Escalation Management: End-to-end resolution of customer escalations from AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention actions (non-payment suspensions, compromise enforcements, payment instrument fraud blocks, spend restrictions)
2. Real-Time Fraud Engagement: Leading P&FP’s presence in leadership visibility channels where service teams, principal engineers, and account teams flag suspected fraud for rapid investigation and resolution
This role requires making irreversible enforcement or reinstatement decisions under time pressure, drafting internal deep dive summaries and customer communications that pass legal review, and balancing customer experience against fraud risk, often with incomplete information.


Key job responsibilities
Escalation Management

• Own end-to-end resolution of customer escalations originating from AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention actions
• Conduct deep-dive investigations into disputed actions, determine root cause, draft customer-facing communications and participate in customer engagement meetings as representative of AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention
• Identify patterns in escalation drivers and propose process/policy improvements to reduce recurrence

Real-Time Fraud Engagement

• Monitor and respond to leadership visibility for rapid investigation
• Triage incoming signals, coordinate enforcement decisions with science and detection teams, and communicate outcomes to senior stakeholders within SLA
• Serve as the P&FP Escalations voice during US West business hours for cross-functional fraud discussions involving VP/Director-level participants

Process & Operational Excellence

• Own the escalation playbook - build, iterate, and document SOPs that scale across a follow-the-sun team (Seattle + India)
• Build relationships with Payments Product Managers, Loss Mitigation Engineering, and P&FP Science to ensure escalation feedback informs roadmap priorities
• Represent Escalations in P&FP operational meetings, MBRs, and cross-org working groups



About the team
AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention protects every AWS customer transaction - from sign-up through billing to enforcement. The Escalations team sits at the intersection of customer experience and Payments and fraud prevention systems, handling the cases where automated or manual enforcement actions create customer friction. We investigate what went wrong, communicate with customers through their account teams, and drive improvements across detection, policy, and process to prevent recurrence.

We operate follow-the-sun with team members in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Berlin, and Seattle. The Seattle seat provides critical US West hours coverage when senior leadership, service teams, and enterprise account teams are most active.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience making enforcement decisions under ambiguity and time pressure
- Experience communicating investigation outcomes to senior stakeholders (Director/VP level)
- Experience working with cross-functional teams (engineering, data science, product, legal)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS services, cloud infrastructure, or SaaS payment systems
- Experience with fraud detection models or risk-based decisioning frameworks
- Familiarity with payment processing concepts (chargebacks, payment instruments, billing disputes, collections)
- Experience building or improving operational SOPs for escalation or investigation teams
- Experience leading or mentoring junior investigators/analysts
- SQL proficiency or experience querying large datasets for investigation support
- Track record of identifying systemic issues from individual cases and driving process improvements

descriptionHtml:

Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.


Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern

• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.

• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.

A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

title: Business Analyst II, Verification Risk Management Ops- Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Verification & Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk.

VRMO designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant.

We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.

We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real-time and close to real-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.

Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, QuickSight/Tableau/PowerBI and scripting languages (Python/JavaScript) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess.

title: Engineering Operations Technician/Técnico de Operaciones de Ingeniería, Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
Join our team and become a critical problem-solver in the world's most innovative cloud infrastructure ecosystem. As a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician, you'll apply your electrical or mechanical expertise to ensure the seamless operation of global cloud systems, directly contributing to the stability of one of the world's largest information system infrastructures.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Engineering Operations Technician is a hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation responder. If you like to use apply your electrical and mechanical skills to solve problems, we’d like to meet you. Your work will help to maintain one of the world's largest information system infrastructures.

*Please note that this role involves working on a shift rotation that includes working early mornings, nights and weekends. Our sites are often in areas without public transportation links and would require access to your own transportation to the work location.

Key job responsibilities
Maintain Safety Standards: Follow and uphold the highest safety protocols, actively encourage a strong safety culture, and collaborate with other teams to identify and remediate safety risks and issues.

Perform Operational Monitoring: Conduct routine rounds and take daily operational readings of electrical and mechanical equipment, including UPS systems, switchgear, circuit breakers, automatic transfer switches, diesel generators, chillers, HVAC systems, exhaust fans, variable frequency drives, and transformers.

Troubleshoot Equipment Issues: Diagnose and resolve operational events within established service level agreements, applying your electrical and mechanical knowledge to restore systems to optimal performance.

Coordinate Maintenance Activities: Supervise contractors performing servicing and preventive maintenance on critical facility equipment, ensuring work meets standards and timelines.

Support Facility Operations: Contribute to the overall reliability and efficiency of data center operations through consistent attention to equipment performance and facility needs.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll be the technical guardian of our data center operations, working hands-on with electrical and mechanical equipment that powers our cloud infrastructure. Your day involves taking routine operational readings of critical systems—monitoring temperatures, voltages, and currents across equipment like UPS systems, generators, chillers, and HVAC units. You'll respond to operational events, troubleshooting issues within established service level agreements and collaborating with contractors during preventive maintenance activities. You'll also participate in safety initiatives, identifying and helping remediate potential risks while fostering a strong safety culture across the facility. Your work directly impacts the reliability and performance of our global infrastructure.

About the team
We are an Infrastructure Operations team dedicated to maintaining the backbone of cloud technology. Our mission is to ensure that the systems supporting millions of users operate reliably and efficiently. We work collaboratively across multiple disciplines—electrical, mechanical, and control systems—to solve complex operational challenges. You'll join a group of skilled technicians and engineers who are committed to continuous improvement and safety excellence. Together, we're building the foundation for innovation, and your contributions will help us achieve our vision of world-class facility operations. We serve internal teams and customers globally who depend on our infrastructure to power their businesses.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Knowledge of generic mechanical room infrastructure such as chillers, cooler units, and fan controls
- Knowledge of key electrical competencies and theory
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish
- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a relevant engineering discipline
- Experience in operations of critical facilities which require in-depth knowledge in electrical, mechanical, and control systems and Data Center engineering experience

descriptionHtml:
Prime Air is Amazon's drone delivery service, using autonomous drones to safely deliver packages to customers in under an hour. Our mission is to build a safe, reliable, and efficient drone delivery system that transforms the way packages are delivered to customers worldwide.

To deliver on that mission, Amazon is looking for talented candidates who combine superb technical and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively.

This is an onsite role based in Seattle, WA, with limited travel expected (approximately 10–15%). In this role, you'll join the Structures and Payload team under Drone Fleet and Production (DF&P) as a Production Liaison Engineer supporting the current fleet of vehicles in service. You will be responsible for ensuring a high degree of technical reliability within drone operations for Amazon fulfillment networks, working closely with design engineering staff and powering a flywheel of continuous improvement in the drone system. Partnering with the drone Structures and Payload team, you will provide engineering analyses and solutions to improve system reliability and performance. A successful candidate will leverage data-driven insights to identify opportunities and lead implementation of system improvements. Strong cross-functional engineering fundamentals (mechanical, electrical, software development basics) are essential, as well as strong technical communication and documentation skills. Your ability to translate complex system functions into digestible insights and summarize effectively with stakeholders at all levels will be critical to success in this role.

This position may require a deemed export control authorization for compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Placement is contingent on Amazon's ability to apply for and obtain an export control license on your behalf.

Key job responsibilities
• Investigate drone system performance for anomalies, deliver solutions to operations and maintenance team escalations
• Lead cross-functional system investigations with engineering, maintenance, and operations teams to optimize drone system performance metrics, and drive improvements
• Develop innovative hardware designs for our emerging drone systems and improve existing hardware to optimize performance and enhance customer experience
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven insights to establish benchmark standards and reduce operational burdens
• Work with the Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality organizations as well as vendors to ensure a smooth product launch and sustaining
• Develop and maintain documentation for technical procedures
• Communicate effectively across all organizational levels, presenting strategies and results to senior leadership and operational partners


A day in the life
As a Field Operations Engineer on the Prime Air team, you will be embedded with the Product Support Organization (PSO) serving as a the first line liaison between operator/maintainer experiences and design engineering improvements or mitigations. In this position, you will bring a unique perspective informed by direct operational data and customer feedback to spearhead system improvements, and address engineering problems discovered in the field. You will be a critical bridge between operations and design engineering.

About the team
The Structures and Payload team is responsible for the entire vehicle structure and systems that interface with the vehicle payload, and providing engineering support for the Assembly and Test organization. The Field Operations Engineers on this team are the direct link between production operations and design engineering, ensuring that design and reliability challenges are resolved quickly and fed back into the design process for continuous improvement.
