title: Sr. Electrical Design Engineer, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Sr. Electrical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective electrical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want YOU! At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience. If you can design an electrical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data center, and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit. As we grow we are structuring our team to own more of our engineering in house. Engineers will be responsible for taking designs from concept to the permit and construction document set. You must be capable of defining critical equipment specifications and approving equipment submittals. Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

At Amazon team work is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel should be up to 20% of your time and in-person collaboration efforts in your assigned office location.


Key job responsibilities
- Data center electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create a construction document set.
- Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
- Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes.
- Review and approval of equipment submittals.
- Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
- Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems.
- Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
- Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed.
- Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

A day in the life
You'll start your day connecting with global team members to review ongoing projects. You might analyze energy efficiency data, collaborate on innovative cooling solutions, or mentor fellow engineers. You'll participate in design reviews, engage with vendors, and contribute to sustainability initiatives that shape our environmental footprint.

About the team
We are a diverse group of engineers committed to revolutionizing data center design. Our team values creativity, sustainability, and continuous learning. We support each other's growth while working on projects that impact millions of customers worldwide. Our inclusive environment encourages sharing ideas and celebrating collective achievements.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

descriptionHtml:

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. Upon completing your internship, you will be required to present a safety research paper and share the findings of your project with the leadership team. title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Music - Catalog Quality
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.

The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist, you will own the design and development of end-to-end systems. You’ll have the opportunity to create technical roadmaps, and drive production level projects that will support Amazon Science. You will work closely with Amazon scientists, and other science interns to develop solutions and deploy them into production. The ideal scientist must have the ability to work with diverse groups of people and cross-functional teams to solve complex business problems. Other responsibilities include:

- Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and product managers to define and frame business problems as ML or optimization tasks.

descriptionHtml:

From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in space-based systems design.

We are looking for the next member of our avionics development team who are building critical components for Amazon Leo satellites. We are looking for an exceptional engineer who combines superb technical and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to deliver hardware.

You will help define requirements, drive high-quality hardware designs, and ensure robust execution from development into production. Working closely with peer engineers, you will lead critical technical efforts while partnering across systems, firmware, manufacturing, and integration teams to solve complex problems.

You’ll operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, tackling challenges that have not been solved at scale and contributing to the development of engineering standards across the organization. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun, and make a positive impact on tens of millions of people!

title: Kierownik Obszaru /  Kierownik Logistyki / Kierownik Magazynu - Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Lokalizacja: Dobromierz (woj. dolnośląskie)

Dział operacyjny to serce firmy Amazon. Ten kluczowy segment naszej działalności zapewnia, że realizujemy i wysyłamy zamówienia w sposób efektywny, dzięki czemu nasi klienci otrzymują swoje zakupy na czas. Osoba na stanowisku Area Manager dokłada wszelkich starań, aby centrum logistyczne, w którym pracuje działało sprawnie, co pozwala nam wychodzić naprzeciw oczekiwaniom klientów. Kieruje zespołem, który troszczy się o zachowanie bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i wysokiej jakości naszych działań, a także podejmuje się realizacji wielu projektów w całej naszej sieci, mających na celu zwiększenie wydajności.

Key job responsibilities
- Tworzenie, nadzorowanie i promowanie kultury bezpieczeństwa i zadowolenia z pracy
- Analizowanie i wdrażanie modyfikacji w celu zapewnienia jakości i wydajności na stałym, wysokim poziomie
- Nadzorowanie projektów mających na celu usprawnienie procesów, optymalizację wydajności i podniesienie jakości usług dla klientów w obrębie swojego obszaru odpowiedzialności
- Analizowanie wydajności zmiany w stosunku do stosownych celów biznesowych i wprowadzanie działań mających na celu osiągnięcie doskonałości operacyjnej
- Współpraca z innymi managerami w celu standaryzacji procesów na zmianach

A day in the life


Osoba na tym stanowisku pracuje w systemie zmianowym w jednym z naszych centrów logistycznych, zapewniając jego najwyższą możliwą wydajność. Głównym zadaniem Area Managera jest kierowanie i napędzanie kultury bezpieczeństwa oraz utrzymywanie jakości i standardów wydajności na zmianach. Area Manager nadzoruje również usprawnienia procesów w swoim obszarze i napędza ich wdrażanie. Typowy dzień jest tutaj niezwykle zróżnicowany i obejmuje rozmaite czynności, od rutynowego zarządzania zespołem i codziennych obowiązków operacyjnych, po doskonalenie procesów i szeroko zakrojone zadania operacyjne w sytuacjach awaryjnych. Osoba ta jest również mentorem dla nowych managerów.

About the team
Nowe centrum logistyczne Amazon w Dobromierzu (woj. dolnośląskie, okolice Wrocławia) to jedna z najnowszych i najbardziej zaawansowanych inwestycji w naszej europejskiej sieci operacyjnej. Obiekt o powierzchni ok. 200 000 m² został zaprojektowany z myślą o maksymalnej efektywności operacyjnej oraz komforcie i bezpieczeństwie pracy.

W codziennych operacjach pracowników wspiera ponad 5000 robotów oraz nowoczesne systemy automatyzacji, które usprawniają procesy kompletowania i wysyłki zamówień. Centrum będzie odgrywać kluczową rolę w obsłudze klientów w regionie, zapewniając szybkie i niezawodne dostawy.

To także miejsce budowania kompetencji przyszłości – zarówno w obszarze operacji, jak i technologii – w dynamicznym, międzynarodowym środowisku.

Centrum logistyczne to miejsce, w którym firma Amazon stawiała swoje pierwsze kroki. Ze skromnego zespołu sprzedawców książek przekształciło się ono w wysokorozwiniętą korporację o zasięgu ogólnoświatowym, która każdego dnia obsługuje ponad 1,5 miliona zamówień. Osoby pracujące w centrach logistycznych stanowią fundament naszej działalności, a ich wysiłki pomagają nam w ekspansji naszej firmy na nowe rejony oraz w rozszerzeniu wachlarza świadczonych przez nas usług. Korzystając z najnowszych technologii, stale poszukujemy sposobów na zwiększenie i udoskonalenie gamy oferowanych przez nas produktów – dostarczanych szybko i tanio.

Nasze zespoły w centrach logistycznych są pierwszym ogniwem w łańcuchu dostaw przyczyniającym się do realizacji zamówień klientów w tempie, z którego tak słyniemy. Pracujemy w centrach logistycznych, które stanowią serce prężnej sieci operacyjnej firmy Amazon i określane są niekiedy jako „pierwszy kilometr”, ponieważ to właśnie tutaj większość przesyłek rozpoczyna swoją podróż. Pomagamy również zarządzać dynamicznie zmieniającymi się składami magazynowymi i umożliwiamy realizację szybkich dostaw 24 godziny na dobę.
W naszych centrach logistycznych pracuje wiele różnych osób, bo oferujemy perspektywy dla osób o każdym poziomie umiejętności i wykształcenia. Niektórzy z nas zajmują się bezpośrednio towarami, inni analizują dane, pomagając wszystkim w firmie w podejmowaniu trafnych decyzji.

Minimalne wynagrodzenie zasadnicze dla tego stanowiska jest wskazane poniżej. Amazon zastrzega sobie możliwość zaproponowania wyższej wartości wynagrodzenia zasadniczego, w zależności od posiadanych umiejętności, kompetencji i doświadczenia kandydata. Amazon kieruje się zasadą całkowitego wynagrodzenia, w związku z czym oprócz wynagrodzenia zasadniczego mogą być przewidziane dodatkowe składniki wynagrodzenia, takie jak premia rekrutacyjna oraz możliwość uczestnictwa w programie akcji zastrzeżonych (RSU) prowadzonym niezależnie przez Amazon.com Inc. w USA. Zespół rekrutacyjny poinformuje Cię o ostatecznej kwocie wynagrodzenia zasadniczego oraz o wszystkich przysługujących dodatkowych składnikach wynagrodzenia, w zależności od umiejętności i wymagań.Dodatkowe świadczenia przysługują na warunkach obowiązujących w Spółce i obejmują m.in. plany emerytalne, dodatkowe ubezpieczenie zdrowotne, dodatkowe ubezpieczenie na życie, ubezpieczenie podróży służbowych, kartę MultiSport, dofinasowanie do posiłków w stołówce firmowej, kod rabatowy dla pracowników i program zniżek pracowniczych (EDC/Extras) oraz Program Wsparcia Pracownika (EAP – prywatne i poufne doradztwo i wsparcie).Minimalne wynagrodzenie zasadnicze dla tego stanowiska wynosi 9,683 PLN miesięcznie.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie wyższe
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w kierowaniu zespołem
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w komunikacji z szerokim gronem partnerów biznesowych, w tym ze współpracownikami i z przełożonymi
- Umiejętność wykorzystywania danych analitycznych i empirycznych do podejmowania decyzji i rozwiązywania problemów
- Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego i polskiego w mowie i piśmie

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do starania się o stanowisko w Amazon. Z przyjemnością zapoznamy się z kandydaturą osób, które posiadają wszystkie wyżej wymienione kwalifikacje podstawowe.
- Doświadczenie z narzędziami Lean, Six Sigma i technikami Kaizen
- Doświadczenie nabyte w innym środowisku logistycznym
- Odpowiednia znajomość pakietu MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

title: Senior Maintenance Technician, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
- Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes
- Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
- Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
- Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
- Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardize processes across the Brazil network

A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an BR-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

Basic qualifications

- High school diploma, or equivalent
- Experience working with CMMS software, or experience in planning, scheduling and auditing maintenance activities
- Experience in automated conveyors systems and controls, electrical and electronic principles, preventative maintenance procedures, blueprint and schematic reading, industrial electrical, industrial controls, industrial electronics, Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programs, National Electrical Code (NEC), work order management
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in vendor management
- Experience with robotic maintenance

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switchgears, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems. They provide 24/7 shift coverage which could include 12 hour shifts, rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day work weeks.

title: Network Planning PM II, Amazon Fulfillment Experience
descriptionHtml:
Join us in designing and optimizing Amazon's end-to-end fulfillment network topology to deliver faster speed, lower cost, and higher capacity across the region. In this role, you will apply supply chain engineering and network modeling expertise to shape the physical and operational architecture of our transportation network, including node placement, lane structure, middle-mile routing, and capacity allocation decisions. Working within the Transportation and Network Planning team, you will have the opportunity to make significant impact by developing network design frameworks and infrastructure recommendations that define the future footprint and flow of our regional fulfillment operations.

As a Program Manager II, you will collaborate across multiple teams to evaluate and design network configurations that balance delivery speed commitments, cost-to-serve targets, and volume growth across geographies. Your ability to translate operational constraints and demand patterns into concrete network design proposals — from lane activation and deprecation to node coverage expansion and topology simplification will drive strategic planning across our fulfillment network. This position offers the chance to directly shape Amazon's transportation infrastructure and network evolution, working with talented professionals dedicated to building the most efficient, speed-optimized fulfillment network of the future.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and deliver complex, cross-functional programs focused on network design logistics and fulfillment operations, working autonomously while seeking guidance as needed.
- Develop and execute strategic business plans to improve delivery speed metrics month-over-month, making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources.
- Analyze supply chain data to identify optimization opportunities and develop solutions that enhance the end-to-end fulfillment network performance.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and partner teams to implement network improvements that balance operational efficiency with customer experience.
- Apply process improvement methodologies to enhance system quality and operational excellence across the fulfillment network.

A day in the life
Your typical day involves developing multiple business plans focused on speed metric improvements and tracking month-over-month performance. You'll analyze data from across the fulfillment network, identify opportunities for optimization, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions. You'll participate in regular business reviews to share insights and progress updates, while also managing stakeholder relationships to ensure alignment on key initiatives designed to enhance our fulfillment capabilities.

About the team
We are the Fulfillment Experience team! Fulfillment Experience (FX) performs a centralized function supporting the MX Operations with data, plans, and required systems set up, taking care of the full flow of a customer order. FX team's responsibilities scope covers: Network Strategic Design, Network Transportation Planning, Program Management and External Fulfillment/Reverse Logistics Operations. Our goal is to develop a supply chain network that delivers customer orders in time, at the fastest, lowest cost, and most reliable way.

Inclusive team culture
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
 
Work Life Balance
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
 
Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will work in a fast-paced, high-energy environment where no day is ever the same. You will utilize financial modeling expertise to transform complex data into actionable insights that influence upper leadership decisions and drive operational excellence.

Your analytical skills will be instrumental in identifying risks, opportunities, and process improvements within the returns network. This position offers significant data mining opportunities, exposure to senior leadership, and the chance to be a key member of the decision-making team within the Return Center (RC). As Amazon continues to expand its fulfillment network, you will play a critical role in supporting operational and financial excellence in an organization committed to growth and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
Business Finance Support:

- Use solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models and analyses with little guidance; draw conclusions and make recommendations that deliver results and drive improvements.
- Independently align financial and operational analyses with business partners, challenging assumptions when necessary.
- Provide analysis and recommendations to leaders to support operational and growth business decisions and plans.
- Proactively identify opportunities to resolve finance defects and improve, automate, standardize or simplify business tools and processes across teams and organizations.

No day in Operations is ever the same! As a Senior Financial Analyst of the Reverse Logistics team you will work in a fast-paced, high-energy and ever-changing environment. title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver's License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. Because this position requires Associates to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position is regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT's Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver's license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.

Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.

title: Loss Prevention Specialist, Security and Loss Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Specialists. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external parties (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards

A day in the life
As a Loss Prevention Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events.

During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality.

You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters.

Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Sitting within the Security Operations organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:

• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation

Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

title: Software Dev Engineer III, AWS Elastic Beanstalk
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elastic Beanstalk is looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE3) to help build and extend the service. Elastic Beanstalk is how developers get an application running on AWS without becoming infrastructure experts — you upload your code, and we handle capacity provisioning, load balancing, auto scaling, and application health monitoring.

Our team builds the orchestration system at the center of the service: the public API, the workflow system that provisions and mutates customer environments, the health monitoring subsystem, the eventing pipeline, and the AWS Console experience. We are also in the middle of the most significant architectural expansion in the service's history — extending Elastic Beanstalk to run on Kubernetes and EKS, while continuing to support the millions of environments already running on our classic architecture. Doing both at once, without customer disruption, is a genuinely hard distributed systems problem.

If you are someone who is passionate about building high quality services, delighting developers, and reducing the distance between "I have code" and "it's running in production," this job is for you. You will be joining a small team where an SDE3 has real design ownership from day one — you will lead design and implementation efforts on services used at AWS scale, and act as a force multiplier for the engineers around you.

To learn more about AWS Elastic Beanstalk, visit https://aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/.

Key job responsibilities
Design and Development: Take ownership of designing, developing, testing, and deploying services that facilitate a seamless "build from source" experience.
Scalability and Resilience: Work on ensuring that the service runs and scales reliably and efficiently.
Collaboration: Engage with a talented and diverse team to collectively architect and implement modern products. Embrace different backgrounds, experiences, and viewpoints to foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

title: Sr, Manager, UX/Design, Talent Acquisition-Tech
descriptionHtml:
Hiring is one of the most consequential decisions a person makes or receives, and the tools that power it are becoming genuinely agentic. We are seeking a Senior Manager of UX to lead the design and research organization behind our hiring portfolio at exactly this inflection point.

This is a rare leadership role. The products your team shapes increasingly act on behalf of the people who use them: drafting job descriptions, surfacing candidates, generating assessments, flagging risks, and moving work forward. The underlying systems are probabilistic. The experiences your team designs must not be. Your core challenge is building and leading a team that can translate AI systems operating on confidence, inference, and ranked signals into interactions that feel trustworthy, purposeful, and in control — where users understand what the system did, why, and what happens next.

You are a people leader with dual accountability: you own experience strategy across the full hiring portfolio, and you build the team, culture, and craft bar that make world-class work repeatable — not dependent on any one person. You partner as a peer with Principal Engineers, senior PMs, and Research and Product leaders from strategy through launch. You influence product direction and long-term business strategy, and you set the quality bar by developing the people and mechanisms that hold it.


Key job responsibilities
**Lead and grow the UX organization.** Build, structure, and develop a high-performing team of designers and researchers. Own hiring, org design, headcount planning, and resourcing across the portfolio. Set clear performance expectations, give direct and developmental feedback, manage performance, and actively drive career growth - including contributions to the promotion process. Recruit and raise the bar on talent.

**Own experience vision and strategy across the hiring portfolio.** Set the north star for Recruiter Hub, Hiring Hub, and Candidate Hub as a coherent, connected system - not three products. Define how users move between surfaces, how context transfers, and how the portfolio adds up to more than its parts. Lead this vision through your team rather than solely through your own hands.

**Define the agentic interaction model for hiring - through your team.** Own the strategy for experiences where AI acts on behalf of recruiters and hiring managers: delegation surfaces, approval flows, correction mechanisms, confidence transparency, and escalation paths. Establish the principles for when the system should act, when it should ask, and what trust looks like when it gets something wrong - and hold the team accountable to them.

**Establish scalable mechanisms and cross-product standards.** Create the interaction models, experience principles, design patterns, and measurement systems that govern AI-assisted hiring surfaces across the portfolio (e.g., UX/CX benchmarking, customer-frustration tracking, ongoing experience measurement). Ensure the system speaks one language at the human-AI boundary and that quality scales across partner teams rather than depending on heroics.

**Set and hold the design excellence bar.** Act as creative director for quality across the portfolio. Partner with and develop design and research leaders to raise the floor on visual craft, interaction quality, research rigor, and storytelling. Establish the review mechanisms and standards that make the bar visible and durable.

**Influence product and business direction.** Work with senior leadership to identify where design and research unlock product strategy, not just execute it. Bring recruiter, hiring manager, and candidate insight into roadmap decisions before requirements are written. Contribute to OP1/OP2 and 3-Year Plan (3YP) efforts, and be a named voice in strategic tradeoffs across major products and product suites.

**Own strategic communications.** Own research narratives, experience strategy documents, executive readouts, and quarterly status updates within and outside the organization. Make design and research rationale legible to non-designers and make the business case for quality to executive leadership.

**Drive rigor and delivery through the team.** Ensure the team uses research, behavioral data, and usability findings to diagnose the real problem before proposing solutions, and that specifications function as behavior contracts partners can build against. Ensure engineering partnership through delivery and close the gap between intent and reality.


A day in the life
You start your morning in a portfolio review - but you're not critiquing pixels, you're developing judgment. A designer walks through the AI-generated candidate summary feature; you name the three places where the model's uncertainty isn't surfaced and coach the team on why that matters for trust, so they catch it themselves next time. By mid-morning you're in a product strategy session with the PM and Principal Engineer on the Candidate Hub, where a roadmap capability threatens to fragment the experience into a fourth surface - you reframe the conversation and align leadership on the connected-system alternative.

In the afternoon you're working org problems: a hiring loop for a senior researcher, a career-development conversation with a design lead who's ready to grow, and a resourcing tradeoff across two teams competing for the same headcount. You end the day reviewing your team's craft bar - not to approve work, but to make sure the standard is visible, shared, and getting higher without you in the room.


About the team
Talent Solutions Product Design & Research designs the products that power how Amazon hires: the tools recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and candidates use across the full hiring journey. We own the end-to-end experience across the Recruiter Hub, Hiring Hub, and Candidate Hub, and we are at the leading edge of what it means to put AI into consequential, human-centered workflows.

We are building agentic products in a domain where trust is not optional. Our AI systems recommend, rank, predict, and increasingly act. Our design work determines whether people trust those systems enough to rely on them, understand them enough to correct them, and feel good enough about the experience to advocate for it. We are designers, researchers, and strategists who work backward from the people we serve, hold an unusually high bar for craft, and believe that the experience of being hired - or of hiring someone - matters.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of leading multi-discipline Design teams (ie. visual design, interaction design, user research, etc.) experience
- 5+ years of people management experience, including hiring, developing, and managing designers and/or researchers
- Experience owning experience strategy and setting the quality bar across multiple products or a product suite
- Experience partnering with senior Product, Engineering, and Research leaders to influence product and business strategy

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in system design
- Track record of developing leaders and contributing to promotion and career-growth processes

title: Space Systems Modeling and Analysis Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Space Systems Modeling and Analysis Engineer to develop and deploy high-fidelity computational models of multi-orbit space architectures supporting satellite communications (SATCOM), navigation warfare (NAVWAR), space-based sensing and targeting (SBST), and missile warning and tracking (MWT) missions. In this role, you will build fast, parallelizable simulations of proliferated constellations across LEO, MEO, and GEO. You will model space-to-space crosslinks, space-based RF and EO/IR sensors, as well as ground segment architectures. You will perform constellation-level operational availability analysis that goes beyond link coverage to account for real-world operational impacts such as downtime due to routine on-orbit maintenance, ground gateway availability, and disturbances from both ground- and space-based threats. You will support trade studies on constellation design, link budgets, timing architectures for alternative positioning/navigation/timing (Alt-PNT) frameworks, and sensor coverage geometries. Your work will directly inform architecture decisions that ensure resilient space systems in contested and degraded environments.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop, validate, and maintain high-fidelity models of multi-orbit constellations (pLEO, MEO, GEO) for SATCOM, NAVWAR, SBST, and MWT mission areas
- Design and execute large-scale, parallelizable simulations to evaluate constellation performance, coverage, and resilience under nominal and degraded conditions
- Perform trade studies and sensitivity analyses on constellation design parameters, sensor geometries, and network topologies
- Model ground segment architectures including radar systems, ground entry points, and ground-based command and control infrastructure
- Model space-based threats including maneuverable satellites, counter-space systems, and electromagnetic warfare effects on space architectures
- Model Alt-PNT frameworks including timing budget analysis and navigation warfare scenarios
- Analyze Space Data Network (SDN) architectures including space-to-space crosslinks, exchange points, and network service orchestration
- Develop sensor performance models for multi-phenomenology detection (infrared, radar) across missile warning and moving target indication missions
- Support architecture decisions by quantifying system resilience, capacity, and performance under adversarial conditions
- Produce technical documentation, trade study reports, and briefings for engineering and program leadership
- Collaborate with systems engineers, mission architects, and government stakeholders to translate operational requirements into simulation parameters

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline
- 3+ years of experience developing physics-based models and simulations of space systems (orbital mechanics, constellation design, RF link analysis, or sensor coverage)
- Experience modeling systems across multiple orbital regimes (LEO, MEO, GEO)
- Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, or C++ for numerical modeling and data analysis
- Demonstrated experience with parallelizable or high-performance computing approaches for large-scale simulations
- U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

Preferred qualifications

- Master's or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Applied Physics, or related field
- Familiarity with SATCOM network modeling, including link budgets, spectrum management, and mesh network topologies
- Familiarity with resilient constellation design principles including proliferated architectures, self-healing networks, and degradation analysis
- Knowledge of space domain awareness, conjunction assessment and mitigation
- Experience with Alt-PNT framework modeling and timing budget analysis
- Experience with ground-based and space-based threat characterization (counter-space systems, maneuverable satellites)
- Experience modeling missile warning/tracking sensor architectures, including multi-phenomenology detection and infrared sensor performance
- Experience with moving target indication (MTI) or kill-chain closure modeling
- Proficiency with simulation frameworks such as STK, GMAT, or custom Monte Carlo engines
- Experience with parallel computing libraries

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, AWS Networking: MONA
descriptionHtml:
AWS runs one of the largest networks in the world, and MONA (Management, Out-of-Band Networks, and Automation) alone owns over one million physical devices across its full lifecycle. We are in the critical path for every new data center powering the AI revolution.

We build the in-house software that solves our hardest network business problems — controllers, software-defined networking (SDN), and planning systems. For example, we own a controller for agentic network auto-remediation, and the planning software that plans every new data center down to capacity and ports. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to be a technical leader and force multiplier: you will partner with the engineering manager to shape our software strategy while continuing to design and build these systems at fleet scale. If you want the scope to influence what we build and how we build it — and to keep building it yourself — this is that role.


Key job responsibilities
- Partner with the engineering manager to shape the team's software strategy — architecture, roadmap, and long-term vision — for the in-house systems behind a 1M+ device network (everything we run, we build ourselves).
- Design and build the in-house systems that solve our business problems — controllers, software-defined networking (SDN), and planning software — end-to-end, architected to scale with robust tests and metrics.
- Own and evolve our controller for agentic network auto-remediation that detects and resolves network issues automatically.
- Build the planning software that plans every new data center — capacity, racks, and ports — and deploys new network fabric.
- Own out-of-band management-plane services: serial console access to every server and router, plus managed connectivity such as SSH.
- Drive correctness and safety for automation acting on production networks: idempotency, guardrails, and observability that proves work actually happened.
- Lead design reviews, raise the operational-excellence and code-quality bar, and mentor engineers.
- Participate in on-call and help lead high-severity incident response.


A day in the life
No two days look the same. One morning you are whiteboarding with the manager and a principal engineer on how to evolve the control plane for the next wave of AI data centers; the next you are deep in a greenfield auto-remediation service that resolves faults automatically instead of paging a human at 3am. title: Amazon Tour Leader, Amazon Tours
descriptionHtml:
Amazon recherche des Tour Leaders enthousiastes et engageants pour animer des visites immersives de 90 minutes dans nos Centres de Distribution Robotisés de pointe. En tant que Tour Leader, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la mise en valeur de la technologie Amazon, de nos processus innovants et de nos équipes dédiées auprès d'un public varié. Ce poste offre une opportunité unique de mettre en lumière l'histoire d'Amazon, notre engagement à être le Meilleur Employeur au Monde, et nos objectifs ambitieux dans le cadre du Climate Pledge. Nous recherchons une personne enthousiaste, dotée de bonnes compétences en communication et d'un souci du détail pour offrir des visites informatives et engageantes de son centre de distribution. Le candidat idéal est passionné par la technologie, le développement durable et la création d'expériences client exceptionnelles.

À la fin de chaque journée, vous examinerez les retours des participants aux visites et contribuerez aux efforts d'amélioration continue du programme.

Amazon is seeking enthusiastic and engaging Tour Leaders to lead immersive 90-minute in-person tours of our state-of-the-art Robotics Fulfillment Centers. As a Tour Leader, you will play a crucial role in showcasing Amazon's technology, innovative processes, and dedicated workforce to a diverse audience. This position offers a unique opportunity to highlight Amazon's rich history, our commitment to being Earth's Best Employer, and our ambitious Climate Pledge goals. We are seeking an enthusiastic individual with good communication skills and attention to detail in providing informative and engaging tours of their fulfillment center. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

At the end of each day, you'll review feedback from tour participants and contribute to continuous improvement efforts for the tour program.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduire plusieurs visites de 90 minutes par jour, en offrant une expérience engageante et informative aux visiteurs.
- Développer une connaissance approfondie des processus logistiques d'Amazon, de la technologie robotique et de l'histoire de l'entreprise.
- Communiquer efficacement des concepts techniques complexes à des publics ayant des niveaux de connaissances techniques variés.
- Mettre en avant l'engagement d'Amazon en matière de développement des employés, de sécurité et de bien-être.
- Sensibiliser les visiteurs aux initiatives de développement durable d'Amazon et au Climate Pledge.
- Veiller à ce que les groupes de visiteurs respectent l'ensemble des protocoles de sécurité et des réglementations du site.
- Entretenir des relations positives avec le site et participer aux activités d'engagement communautaire.
- Former l'équipe d'Ambassadeurs et de Proxys.
- Répondre aux questions des participants de manière précise et professionnelle.
- Collaborer avec les équipes du centre de distribution pour rester informé des derniers développements et processus.
- Maintenir et mettre à jour le contenu des visites pour refléter les nouvelles technologies et initiatives de l'entreprise.
- Collecter et transmettre les retours des participants afin d'améliorer l'expérience globale.

- Conduct multiple 90-minute tours per day, providing an engaging and informative experience for visitors.
- Develop a deep understanding of Amazon's fulfillment processes, robotics technology, and company history.
- Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge.
- Highlight Amazon's commitment to employee development, safety, and well-being.
- Educate visitors about Amazon's sustainability initiatives and the Climate Pledge.
- Ensure tour groups adhere to all safety protocols and facility regulations.
- Maintain positive site relationships and participate in site & community engagement activities
- Train Ambassador & Proxy team
- Respond to questions from tour participants accurately and professionally.
- Collaborate with fulfillment center teams to stay updated on the latest developments and processes.
- Maintain and update tour content to reflect new technologies and company initiatives.
- Collect and report feedback from tour participants to improve the overall experience.

A day in the life
En tant que Tour Leader dans un Centre de Distribution Robotisé Amazon, votre journée sera dynamique et stimulante. Vous commencerez par consulter le planning des visites du jour et préparer les supports nécessaires. Avant chaque visite, vous accueillerez les visiteurs, effectuerez un briefing sécurité et distribuerez les équipements de protection requis.

Pendant les visites, vous guiderez les groupes à travers les différentes zones du centre de distribution, en expliquant l'interaction entre les associés et les systèmes robotiques. Vous montrerez comment les commandes clients sont traitées, préparées, emballées et expédiées avec une efficacité remarquable. Tout au long de la visite, vous intégrerez des anecdotes sur l'histoire d'Amazon, notre engagement envers le développement des employés et nos efforts en matière de développement durable.

Entre les visites, vous aurez le temps d'actualiser vos connaissances, de mettre à jour le contenu des visites et de collaborer avec vos collègues au sein de notre équipe mondiale. Vous pourrez également participer à des sessions de formation pour perfectionner vos compétences et rester au fait des dernières innovations d'Amazon.

As a Tour Guide at an Amazon Robotics Fulfillment Center, your day will be dynamic and engaging. You'll start by reviewing the day's tour schedule and preparing any necessary materials. Before each tour, you'll greet visitors, provide safety briefings, and distribute required protective equipment.

During the tours, you'll guide groups through various sections of the fulfillment center, explaining the intricate dance between human associates and robotic systems. You'll showcase how customer orders are processed, picked, packed, and shipped with incredible efficiency. Throughout the tour, you'll weave in stories about Amazon's history, our commitment to employee growth, and our sustainability efforts.

Between tours, you'll have time to refresh your knowledge, update tour content, and collaborate with colleagues on our global team. You may also participate in training sessions to enhance your skills and stay current on Amazon's latest innovations.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe passionnée de Tour Leaders et de responsables de programme à travers le monde, dédiée à mettre en valeur l'innovation d'Amazon et son engagement envers l'obsession client. Notre équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec différents départements du centre de distribution, notamment les opérations, la robotique, les ressources humaines et les équipes développement durable. Nous sommes un groupe collaboratif qui valorise la créativité, l'apprentissage continu et la capacité à inspirer les autres. En rejoignant cette équipe, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer au développement du contenu des visites et de façonner la perception du public sur les opérations logistiques d'Amazon.

Ce poste offre une opportunité passionnante d'être à la pointe des avancées technologiques d'Amazon tout en développant des compétences précieuses en prise de parole en public et en engagement client. Rejoignez-nous pour partager l'histoire d'Amazon et inspirer la prochaine génération d'innovateurs!

You'll be joining a passionate team of Tour Leaders and program managers around the world that are dedicated to showcasing Amazon's innovation and commitment to customer obsession. We're a collaborative group that values creativity, continuous learning, and the ability to inspire others. As part of this team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the development of tour content and help shape the public's perception of Amazon's fulfillment operations.

title: Sr. ECAD Systems Engineer, Configuration Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a software-fluent ECAD Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer to join the Engineering Practice & Configuration Management team. This role mirrors the mechanical domain's custom tooling function-you will build the integration tooling and automation that connects EE design systems (Xpedition, EDM, Teamcenter) into a seamless, reliable configuration management backbone.

You will build the connective tissue between EE's core design systems—Xpedition, EDM, and Teamcenter—creating intelligent automation for IDX exchanges, component synchronization, and BOM reconciliation that eliminates manual handoffs and scales with the program. This will result into a world-class tooling velocity and cross-system reliability for the EE domain.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Custom Integration Tooling: Design, build, and maintain automation that synchronizes data across Xpedition, EDM, and Teamcenter-keeping the 6000+ part component library dimensionally consistent and properly linked across all systems
• BOM Reconciliation Automation: Build tooling that guarantees Teamcenter BOM, Xpedition BOM, and supply-chain BOMs match at design release; enable where-used analysis; flag missing or dropped components; block PCBA release when parts are out of sync or unreleased
• IDX Exchange Improvement: Automate and harden the ECAD-MCAD collaboration workflow (IDX process); implement the validated scheme file as default configuration; build guardrails that prevent protocol deviations that destroy design history
• Build-to-Design Loop Closure: Pull as-built BOM data from supply-chain systems and contract manufacturer red-lines back into engineering tools, enabling true end-to-end data accuracy
• Component Dimensional Integrity Tooling: Build automated verification that detects and prevents dimensional mismatches of component definition between EDM and Teamcenter to enable identification PCBA-to-enclosure fitment failures in CAD and before fabrication
• Release Workflow Automation: Develop release gates and automated checks that enforce component maturity requirements, BOM consistency, and data completeness before PCBA release approval
• Tooling Backlog Ownership: Maintain and prioritize the EE tooling backlog (mirroring mechanical's 47+ item backlog); partner with the EE Configuration Manager to identify highest-impact automation opportunities
• Cross-Domain Integration: Ensure EE tooling integrates cleanly with existing in-house designed mechanical tooling infrastructure for unified cross-domain workflows
• Developer Documentation: Maintain technical documentation for all custom tooling, APIs, and integrations to ensure sustainability and team knowledge transfer

A day in the life
You will be responsible to work across multiple engineering functions to understand the daily pain points of a responsible engineering and translating those into the custom ECAD tools for EE domain.

About the team
The Configuration Management team develops and governs the engineering systems, standards, and processes that ensure spacecraft design data remains accurate, traceable, and controlled throughout the product lifecycle. While the organization originated as a traditional design support function, it has evolved into the engineering authority for product data management and engineering configuration.

The team defines how engineering information flows throughout the digital engineering environment, including Product Lifecycle Management workflows, mechanical and electrical design tool integration, engineering data management, and the interaction between Teamcenter, Siemens NX, Mentor, and other engineering platforms. They also develop tooling and automation that improves engineering productivity while maintaining data integrity across these systems.

In addition to managing engineering data, the organization serves as the company's subject matter experts in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing. They develop engineering standards, mentor design engineers, and promote best practices that improve drawing quality, manufacturability, and technical consistency across the organization.

The team also defines and continuously improves the organization's configuration and change management processes for hardware, requirements, and engineering documentation. They work closely with software organizations to strengthen integrated hardware and software configuration control while ensuring traceability throughout the development lifecycle. Today the organization facilitates Engineering Change Committee and Configuration Control Board activities while actively developing increasingly automated workflows in partnership with the Engineering Information Systems team. These efforts continue moving the organization toward a more efficient, data driven approach to engineering governance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
- 5+ years of experience in engineering tooling development, PLM integration, or ECAD systems administration
- Proficiency in software development (Python, Java, or C#) with demonstrated ability to build production-quality automation tools
- Hands-on experience with PLM/PDM system APIs (Teamcenter SOA/RAC preferred)
- Experience with ECAD tools and data formats (Mentor/Siemens Xpedition preferred; familiarity with EDM component library management)
- Understanding of PCBA design workflows, BOM structures, and engineering release processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Xpedition Automation API and EDM programmatic interfaces
- Familiarity with IDX (Incremental Design Exchange) workflows between ECAD and MCAD systems
- Experience with NX/Teamcenter integration and NX Open API
- Track record of building cross-system data synchronization solutions in engineering environments
- Experience with CI/CD practices for engineering tool deployment
- Knowledge of manufacturing BOM formats and contract manufacturer data exchange requirements
- Experience in aerospace, satellite, or high-reliability electronics manufacturing environments
- Demonstrated Amazon's Leadership Principles, particularly Invent and Simplify, Bias for Action, and Deliver Results

Key job responsibilities
Deployment & Commissioning
• Execute on-site commissioning activities for sorters, conveyors, and automated work cells.
• Provision, configure, and validate Linux-based IPCs, PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, and field devices per project standards.
• Perform I/O checkouts, network validation, and phased system bring-up activities.
• Execute commissioning and test plans, including sequencing, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
• Support dry runs, functional testing, and integrated system testing through startup and handover.
Troubleshooting & Technical Support
• Serve as the primary on-site technical resource for controls, networking, and system integration issues.
• Diagnose and resolve industrial networking problems (e.g., IP conflicts, VLAN issues, switch configuration, fieldbus communication faults).
• Troubleshoot PLC logic, device configuration, safety interlocks, and system-level faults across electrical, controls, and mechanical boundaries.
• Perform structured root-cause analysis and support implementation of permanent corrective actions.
• Document issues, resolutions, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement and future deployments.
On-Site Technical Leadership
• Provide day-to-day technical direction to technicians, electricians, and commissioning support personnel during system deployment.
• Coordinate closely with system integrators, OEMs, and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues and unblock progress.
• Ensure compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, and commissioning best practices during installation and testing.
Integration & Handover
• Validate equipment functionality against design specifications, controls standards, and operational requirements.
• Support integration of equipment into Warehouse Control Systems (WCS) and higher-level orchestration layers.
• Participate in turnover activities, ensuring systems are stable, documented, and ready for operational ownership.
Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve commissioning efficiency, reliability, and repeatability.
• Contribute to the development and refinement of commissioning tools, test procedures, and deployment standards.
• Provide feedback to design and integration teams to improve future system designs and deployment outcomes.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with networking fundamentals including hands-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc.
- Willingness to travel up to 50% for on-site commissioning and deployment support.
- Hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, EtherCAT, or Modbus TCP.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts in an IEC 61131-3 environment (e.g., structured function blocks, reusable control architectures).
- Experience supporting large-scale commissioning projects such as automated warehouses, conveyor and sorter systems, or complex manufacturing environments.

title: Program Manager, AU Global Store
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

We are looking for a Program Manager for the AU Global Store business. Based from our Sydney office, you'll own the commercial levers that bring the right international products to Australian customers at the right price, working across local and global teams to grow the Global Store proposition.

Amazon Global Store is an integral pillar of the Amazon.com.au proposition that today offers high demand international products, locally to AU customers. We are an innovative business focused on building a leading customer experience around our growing range of relevant international products sourced from Amazon's global stores. We work with Amazon's wider global business network, across teams such as search, customer experience, vendor management, engineering, marketing, logistics, finance, legal and compliance to tailor the best that Amazon has to offer globally into a proposition that best suits local customers' needs.
________________________________________________

There are also a great range of benefits that make Amazon a great place to work, including our popular Dogs At Work program which has been proven to lower stress and boost morale and is now running successfully in our corporate offices around Australia.

Our commuter benefits scheme allows employees to save on the cost of getting to and from work while Amazon also offers subsidized health insurance for employees and their dependents on top of salary continuance (income protection), and life insurance.

Amazon has all kinds of jobs for all kinds of people, and prides itself on hiring individuals with all types of background and experiences and celebrates diversity of leadership and thought as a key component in its mission to create the most customer-centric company in the world.

This position requires full-time in-office presence 5 days per week at our CBD location.

Key job responsibilities
To excel in this role, you will:

- Enjoy a high degree of ownership: Drive the commercial levers for Global Store, from identifying high-potential international selection, to building promotional and marketing strategy, to understanding and shaping pricing levers.
- Collaborate effectively across teams: Build productive working relationships with cross-functional partners including search, engineering, marketing, logistics, finance, and compliance across multiple geographies.
- Use data to drive commercial outcomes: Proactively dive deep into metrics to identify opportunities and risks. Build analyses that inform recommendations and track performance of initiatives you own.
- Navigate ambiguity: Work across multiple geographies, teams, and systems where processes are not always defined and priorities can shift. Use judgement to move forward when information is incomplete and align stakeholders around a path when there is no single right answer.
- Technology and AI Adoption: Embrace AI and new technologies, diving into Amazon's tools and systems quickly and confidently to find faster, smarter ways to operate.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment: Demonstrate strong organisational skills and effectively prioritise competing demands across multiple workstreams, escalating appropriately when priorities conflict.
- Embrace a growth mindset: Demonstrate resilience, curiosity, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning, including adapting quickly to Amazon's ways of working such as document-led meetings, narrative writing, and a culture of high-velocity decision making.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on growing the AU Global Store business by working across multiple teams and geographies. You might start your day analysing sales data, then identifying marketing opportunities to support upcoming events, then move into strategy sessions with local and international teams to plan how to expand product offerings. You'll collaborate with colleagues in vendor management, pricing, marketing, finance, and compliance to bring the best of Amazon's global selection to Australian customers at compelling prices. Throughout the day, you'll balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem-solving, whether that's developing execution plans, troubleshooting challenges, or analysing selection gaps to prioritise your next opportunity.

About the team
We are building an innovative business that serves as a key pillar of Amazon.com.au, bringing international products to customers who want access to a broader selection. Our team works collaboratively across Amazon's global network to understand what Australian customers need and translate that into tailored solutions. We're focused on creating a leading customer experience while driving sustainable business growth. When you join us, you'll be part of a group that values curiosity, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams to solve complex problems together.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Sr Program Manager, Retail Business Services
descriptionHtml:
Senior Program Manager, Purchase – Retail Business Services
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead strategy and execution for Shopping Mission Completion, ensuring customers can seamlessly discover, evaluate, and purchase products across the Amazon store.

About Amazon
Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the widest of selection at low price that drives Amazon’s flywheel.

About the Team
The vision of Retail Business Services (RBS) Organization at Amazon is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by improving customer experience and enabling our Selling Partners (SPs) to grow their business with Amazon. RBS provides catalog augmentation and correction technologies for the Amazon selling community. Our solutions ensure information in Amazon's catalogs is both complete and comprehensive enough to give our customers a great shopping experience every time.

Role Overview
RBS is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead a Strategy for Shopping Mission Completion for Customers. Amazon Store Walk analysis uncovers critical defects across the Amazon shopping journey; spanning across product discovery, evaluation, and purchase completion. These systemic problems impact the customer shopping journey, from how customers discover and evaluate products to their ability to complete purchases. These issues are categorized into four key defect themes: Data, Search, Catalog and Customer Experience. To resolve these issues, we recommend a coordinated, cross-functional engagement with partner teams that will improve overall customer shopping experience . This role will be at the center of collaboration between multiple world wide teams in re-imagining the purchase experience for customers.

Key job responsibilities
Shopping Mission is an essential part of the consumer experience and can fundamentally influence the way customers shop on Amazon as well as shape their perception of Amazon.
As a Senior Program Manager - Purchase, you will
- Think Big and own vision for building a Strategy that enables customers to complete their shopping journey.
- Disambiguate the problem space and size the problem and opportunity for RBS
- Be responsible for end-to-end business strategy, goal setting, program management, review and collaboration mechanisms.
- Break down ambiguous problems into clear abstract use cases and solution workflows for Tech and Product teams.
- Be responsible for end to end program management with multiple parallel tasks.
- Establish accountability with partner teams and influence them without authority on a common goals.
- Identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
- Be responsible for reporting and review mechanisms and communication to Leadership (Flash updates, WBR, QBR, Deep dives)

To be successful in this role, you should be comfortable and confident liaising with remote global teams in business, design and technology at senior leadership levels. You will solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You will be data-driven and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).

Representing the voice of customers, you will be an evangelist for the program vision, maintaining support for your cause, keeping engineering teams energized and excited, and driving your program roadmap at all levels. You will be very comfortable with written communication skills and a proven track record of delivering projects from concept to launch.

About the team
The 'Shopping Mission' program is part of the Customer Experience vertical of RBS. The program is responsible for defining the Vision and long term strategy of improving Customer Experience through improving the quality of Amazon products. RBS is the global sponsor of the program, bringing together multiple world-wide product, design and engineering teams to execute in a federated manner.
