title: Senior Technical Account Manager,  Amazon Smart Vehicles
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a passion for Automotive? Do you want to challenge the status quo of the in-car experience? Do you want to be the technical authority helping Japan's leading automakers build the future of the digital cabin? If you answered yes to these questions, we have a dream job for you. We are building the next generation voice-forward in-cabin experience that delights customers, increases safety, and brings the future of digital cabin to life. We are looking for a highly driven, technically deep, and customer-obsessed technical account manager to serve as the trusted technical advisor to leading Japanese automotive manufacturers including Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, and Subaru.

Based in Tokyo, you will be the on-the-ground technical leader for Japan, working closely with the global Amazon Smart Vehicles team to design, architect, and deliver voice AI solutions for Japanese automotive manufacturers. You'll be at the forefront of translating innovative genAI voice experiences into production-ready architectures for Japan's leading OEMs, helping them accelerate their technological capabilities and digital transformations through hands-on technical engagement.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary technical advisor and solutions architect for Japanese automotive OEMs including Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, Subaru, and other key manufacturers
• Design and present end-to-end solution architectures for in-cabin voice AI, integrating Amazon's genAI capabilities with OEM-specific vehicle platforms, infotainment systems, and cloud infrastructure
• Build and maintain deep technical relationships with Japanese OEM engineering leaders, chief architects, and platform teams, navigating complex organizational structures and cultural nuances
• Lead technical deep-dives, proof-of-concept engagements, and architecture workshops with OEM engineering teams to validate solution fit and accelerate adoption
• Partner with business development to support deal progression by providing technical credibility, solution scoping, and architecture proposals during complex commercial negotiations
• Develop and deliver technical presentations, demos, and reference architectures tailored to Japanese OEM requirements, including edge vs. cloud deployment trade-offs and EdgeLite positioning
• Provide regular technical status updates and integration progress reports in English to global leadership, leveraging AI tools for Japanese-to-English communication as needed
• Navigate Japanese automotive engineering processes and technical evaluation frameworks, understanding system integration requirements, validation criteria, and homologation standards
• Work closely with internal stakeholders (AWS Solutions Architecture, Product Engineering, Partner Engineering) and global Amazon Smart Vehicles team to coordinate technical strategies and integration roadmaps
• Collaborate with product, engineering, and platform teams to translate customer technical requirements into product feature requests and influence roadmap priorities
• Evaluate and address technical objections, competitive positioning, and integration challenges specific to the Japanese automotive market
• Represent Amazon Smart Vehicles at Japanese automotive technology conferences, developer events, and customer technical reviews
• Provide technical market intelligence and competitive architecture insights from the Japanese automotive sector to inform global product and engineering strategy


A day in the life
You'll be driving technical engagement activities on the ground in Tokyo — leading architecture workshops with OEM engineering teams, conducting solution deep-dives, building proof-of-concepts, and advancing multiple concurrent integration efforts. Your day involves navigating Japanese engineering culture, managing complex technical stakeholder relationships, designing solutions that bridge Amazon's genAI voice platform with diverse vehicle architectures, and keeping global engineering and leadership teams informed of technical progress in English. You'll balance hands-on technical execution (writing architecture documents, building demos, troubleshooting integrations) with strategic thinking about how Amazon's technology stack best fits Japan's automotive platform landscape.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- 6+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries experience
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Experience in technical support, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
- • 10+ years of experience in the automotive industry with focus on infotainment systems, embedded software, voice/AI integration, or technical solutions architecture
- • Track record of leading technical evaluations and proof-of-concept engagements in competitive environments with long validation cycles typical of automotive industry
- • Experience designing integration architectures for automotive platforms; understanding of Japanese automotive technical evaluation and supplier qualification processes
- • Deep technical knowledge of automotive software stacks and platforms (Android Automotive, QNX, Linux), hardware platforms (Qualcomm, Nvidia, Renesas SOCs), genAI/LLM architectures, speech-to-speech pipelines, and edge computing deployment in automotive environments

Preferred qualifications

- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Bachelor's degree
- • Experience working with automotive Tier 1 suppliers (Denso, Aisin, Continental, Bosch, Harman, Alps Alpine) on system integration or platform development
- • Deep understanding of competitive technical landscape in automotive voice AI and infotainment, particularly in Japanese market (Cerence, Google Automotive Services, Apple CarPlay architectures)
- • Experience with Japanese OEM engineering organizations and technical decision-making processes at Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, Subaru, or similar manufacturers
- • Hands-on experience with voice AI/NLU/ASR systems, conversational AI frameworks, or large language model deployment in resource-constrained environments
- • Knowledge of automotive middleware, AUTOSAR, vehicle APIs, and connected vehicle cloud architectures
- • Understanding of Japanese automotive industry technical standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., driver distraction guidelines), and platform certification processes

descriptionHtml:
The Ads Partnerships Lead (APL) is the single-threaded owner of advertising revenue and go-to-market strategy for assigned creator partnerships. This role exists to close a critical gap between creator partnerships and advertiser demand by owning what we sell, how we sell it, and how we win commercially.

We are seeking an APL to be the commercial architect and execution lead for a major creator partnership in the Wellness / Personal Growth category. This role is ideal for a commercially minded operator who thrives at the intersection of sales strategy, media monetization, and creator-led branded content. Existing commercial relationships with advertisers in the space are a strong plus.


Key job responsibilities
Go-To-Market & Commercial Strategy
• Define what we sell and how we win commercially for assigned creator partnerships.
• Build and maintain master sponsorship packages, including pricing logic, product mix, commercial terms, and SLAs, in partnership with the Commercial Strategy team.
• Own launch strategy for new shows and major tentpoles, including sales narratives, positioning, and operationalization (e.g., ensuring products are correctly set up and bookable in Salesforce).
• Identify and unlock incremental monetization opportunities beyond standard media, including new formats, experiential events, and bonus content.
• Ensure solutions are scalable, repeatable, and adopted by Sales.

Demand Generation & Sales Enablement
• Drive sales adoption of creator-specific packages and solutions.

title: Design Technologist, eShop
descriptionHtml:
Help shape the future of AI-powered creative production at Amazon. As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production - shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale.

We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth.

In this role, you will:

• Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production-grade visual content
• Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions
• Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best
• Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production-ready capabilities
• Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling

This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver - someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.



Key job responsibilities
• Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
• Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering - translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions
• Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity
• Evaluate AI-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness - applying both technical metrics and creative judgment
• Support the fine-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation
• Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality results at scale across content types
• Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows
• Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities - assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership
• Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI-created assets efficiently
• Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently
• Participate in cross-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements

A day in the life
In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI-generated image outputs -tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers - solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale.

About the team
Our team builds how hundreds of millions of customers see products - through photography, video, CGI, and increasingly through Generative AI. We are a global network of creatives, technologists, and scientists unified by one mission: make every product look its best, at extraordinary scale. Our culture values builders who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. We ship fast, learn from what breaks, and believe the best creative work happens when art and technology push each other forward.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of experience in front-end technology, engineering, or UX prototyping
- Coding samples in front-end programming languages
- Available online portfolio demonstrating relevant work
- Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front-end development
- Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users
- Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments
- Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/Node.js, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design
- Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, and source control (Git)
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team
- Knowledge of video production, live streaming technologies, studio workflows, edit and post-production techniques, production calendars and staffing

title: Senior Accelerator Engineer, Cloud AI/ML server team
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 5, 2026

Do you want to become the go-to GPU expert for the world's largest Artificial Intelligence accelerator fleet, and grow that expertise faster than anywhere else in the industry?

This is a role where you will deepen your GPU expertise at a pace and scale that doesn't exist outside of hyperscale cloud, working directly with the industry's leading GPU vendors, analyzing behaviors across hundreds of thousands of accelerators, and defining standards that govern production deployment. If you have started to develop GPU or accelerator depth and want a position where you own the full lifecycle at fleet scale, this is the role!

AWS Hardware Engineering is looking for a Senior Hardware Development Engineer to own the technical roadmap across all AI accelerator platforms in the organization. You will be the single-threaded owner of GPU lifecycle from defining hardware, firmware and diagnostics requirements, qualification through field operations and translating fleet-scale failure data into vendor action.


Key job responsibilities
GPU Component Lifecycle & Strategy

- Own the technical relationship with vendors across all platforms in the portfolio: roadmap alignment, escalations, partnerships.
- Own qualification of new GPU SKUs and baseboard assemblies during NPI bring-up -- define test plans, acceptance criteria, and production readiness gates
- Define and maintain GPU firmware qualification criteria across the org -- pass/fail gates, staged rollout policy, regression detection methodology
- Drive RMA strategy: build failure evidence packages, negotiate acceptance criteria with vendors, manage submission quotas and pipeline velocity

Fleet-Scale Failure Analysis

- Lead root-cause analysis on fleet-wide GPU failure modes (component errors, PCIE interface errors, thermal events, link degradation, manufacturing escapes) using telemetry, event log data, and vendor diagnostics
- Set GPU health standards: define the metrics, thresholds, and alerting that platform teams execute against
- Define GPU fleet health dashboards: identify relevant telemetry, failure rate trends, replacement pipeline status, firmware version distribution, qualification status

Vendor Engagement & Cross-Team Leadership

- Represent the organization in technical discussions with leading vendor’s engineering -- translate fleet-scale patterns into prioritized vendor action items
- Partner with server teams to ensure consistent GPU operational practices; provide expertise without owning their execution
- Present GPU fleet health, replacement pipeline status, and qualification progress to senior leadership (VP-level) regularly
- Mentor engineers on GPU failure analysis methodology




A day in the life
No two weeks look the same. You might be engaging with our GPU vendor's engineering team on future roadmap options and how upcoming architecture changes affect our technical strategy. You might be defining technical requirements to enable AWS to optimize how we deploy and manage GPUs at scale -- translating fleet failure patterns into firmware feature requests. You might be analyzing thermal and error behaviors across tens of thousands of systems to develop predictive models that catch failures before they impact customers. Or you might be building the data package that proves a manufacturing defect to a vendor and recovers millions in component value.

What's consistent: you are the GPU component owner. You see every failure mode, every firmware release, every new SKU qualification. You develop expertise at a rate that isn't possible when you only see one system at a time -- here you see hundreds of thousands, and you use that scale to become the person both AWS and our vendors turn to for answers.

Located in Cupertino, Seattle, or Denver, you work with global hardware teams, vendor engineering, and cross-AWS accelerator initiatives.


About the team
AWS Hardware Engineering designs and delivers next-generation cloud infrastructure -- the servers, accelerators, and storage platforms that power AWS. Our team builds and operates custom AI accelerator systems at global scale, spanning GPU platforms from manufacturing through multi-year fleet operations. We are directly responsible for the most expensive and supply-constrained components in the AWS fleet.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- 7+ years of hardware design and development experience for server, compute, or large-scale infrastructure platforms

Preferred qualifications

- 7+ years hardware engineering experience
- Direct experience with data center GPUs and associated tooling
- Experience developing or influencing server roadmap
- Track record of influencing vendor engineering priorities through failure evidence
- Familiarity with GPU thermal management, power delivery, and PCIe and interconnect architectures
- Experience with firmware lifecycle management at scale (qualification, staged rollout, regression detection, rollback)
- Comfortable presenting to VP-level audiences
- Experience working horizontally across multiple platform teams without direct authority
- Strong data analysis skills at fleet scale (statistical failure modeling, trend detection, threshold setting)

title: Loss Prevention Expert, Security & Loss Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Expert. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external stakeholder (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards
• Own Security and Loss Prevention-related projects on the local, regional, and country level


A day in the life
As a Loss Prevention Expert, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area.

You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in our processes and you identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality.

Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our Security and Loss Prevention plan.

About the team
Sitting within the Global Security Operations organization, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:


• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation



Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing re-occurrence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in law enforcement or a security-related profession
- 2+ years of law enforcement or security-related experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing and implementing investigative tactics, including interviewing and documentation

title: Staż w dziale operacji i logistyki -  Okmiany (Chojnów) 2027
descriptionHtml:
Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.
Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:
Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin


Key job responsibilities
Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.
Kluczowe obowiązki stanowiska:

* Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników

* Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy

* Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych

* Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.

* Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.

* Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.

* Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.

* Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.



A day in the life
Dzień z życia stażysty
Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.


About the team
O zespole
Społeczność stażystów:

* Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowania.

Wsparcie:

* Program stażowy obejmuje kompleksowy system wsparcia, w tym cotygodniowe dyżury dla stażystów, specjalistyczne wsparcie IT i HR oraz zespół programowy dbający o Twój sukces. Dzięki temu otrzymasz wskazówki i pomoc niezbędne do osiągnięcia sukcesu.

Sesje szkoleniowe:

* Dzięki specjalnym sesjom szkoleniowym jeszcze bardziej rozwiniesz swoje umiejętności, uzyskując dostęp do najnowocześniejszych platform szkoleniowych Amazon i wiedzy liderów branży. Te ustrukturyzowane możliwości rozwoju przygotują cię do kolejnego kroku w karierze.

Możliwości:

* Po pomyślnym ukończeniu stażu możemy rozważyć zatrudnienie Cię na stanowisku dla absolwentów lub zaproponować drugi staż, co pozwoli Ci kontynuować drogę zawodową w Amazon. Dodatkowo otrzymasz konkurencyjne miesięczne wynagrodzenie, wsparcie w relokacji oraz dostęp do szeregu świadczeń pracowniczych.

Daty rozpoczęcia stażu w ciągu roku:

* Przyjmujemy stażystów, którzy mogą rozpocząć pracę w dowolnym momencie od stycznia do lipca 2027 r. Każdego miesiąca organizujemy 1–2 dni wdrożeniowe dla nowych pracowników.

title: Risk Manager II, Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV)
descriptionHtml:
Selling Partner Trust and Store Integrity (TSI) is responsible for creating a trustworthy shopping experience across Amazon stores worldwide by protecting customers, brands, selling partners, vendors and Amazon from fraud, counterfeit, and abuse as well as providing world‐class support and building loyalty with Amazon’s millions of selling partners (3P and 1P). The Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) team within SPS protects Amazon customers and stores by launching investigative projects and detection mechanisms by deep diving key events within the bad actor lifecycle to detect abuse at the earliest point and close the gap for bad actors. Our growth requires highly skilled candidates who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, a tenacity to get things done, thrive in an environment of ambiguity and change, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems. We value individual expression, respect different opinions, and work together to create a culture where each of us is able to contribute fully. title: Senior Inference Engineer, AGI
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Inference Engineer to own inference for real-time multimodal
conversational AI. This is a full-stack inference role: you will work across the entire path a model
takes from research to production — shaping model architecture so it is servable, building the
real-time runtime that serves it within hard latency budgets, and building the offline systems
that train and reinforce it.

You will operate at the boundary of Science and Inference, taking frontier-scale speech and
audio models and making them run within real-time latency budgets on production hardware.
You will co-design architectures with scientists to make them inference-friendly from inception,
own the low-latency streaming serving path, and build the training and reinforcement-learning
infrastructure that closes the loop. You will have the compute, data, and runway to solve
problems that few teams in the world are positioned to tackle.

As a Senior Engineer, you will own a significant area of the inference stack end to end, drive its
technical execution, contribute to the team's roadmap, and work closely with scientists and
hardware partners to ensure our models run fast enough to feel human in real time — and at a
cost that makes them viable at scale. You may go deep in one of the areas below while
contributing across the others.

Key job responsibilities
Model Architecture & Inference Co-Design
• Partner with research scientists to make model architectures servable from inception —
surfacing the latency, memory, and cost implications of architecture choices before they are
locked in
• Implement and optimize the inference path for large-scale multimodal models — attention
and KV-cache mechanisms, multimodal/autoregressive decoding, and the compute
primitives on the critical path
Apply efficiency techniques across the stack — quantization (per-tensor/per-channel/per-
group, INT8/FP8/BF16), speculative decoding, operator fusion, and paged KV-cache — and
quantify their quality/latency trade-offs
• Develop and tune high-performance kernels for critical operations where off-the-shelf
implementations leave performance on the table, integrating them into production serving
with minimal overhead
• Profile end-to-end performance with tools such as Nsight Compute/Systems and roofline
analysis to identify and eliminate bottlenecks in large-scale inference workloads
Real-Time & Interactive Runtime
• Own the real-time serving path for streaming multimodal conversational AI, meeting sub-
second, streaming latency budgets under concurrent session load
• Build and tune continuous batching, scheduling, and preemption to balance throughput
against per-request latency SLAs for interactive workloads
• Customize production serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, PyTorch) for real-time streaming
generative models that fall outside standard LLM serving patterns — sustained low-latency
output under concurrent session load
• Implement multi-GPU inference (tensor parallelism, collective communication) for latency-
critical paths, and drive cost toward parity with existing production baselines
• Establish latency, throughput, and cost benchmarking, and publish the operational metrics
that gate deployment
Offline Systems: Training, RL & Evaluation Infrastructure
• Build and scale the offline inference systems behind post-training — high-throughput rollout
generation and reward-model serving for reinforcement learning (RL/RLHF/RLAIF)
• Ensure train/serve consistency — that the inference path used in RL and evaluation
faithfully matches production online behavior (e.g., parity across sampling and logit
processing)
• Work with the evaluation team to enable offline inference that captures the quality
dimensions unique to real-time conversation — latency sensitivity, audio quality, and
interaction naturalness

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning
- 2+ years of hands-on experience optimizing inference for neural models — not just using inference frameworks, but profiling and improving them
- Strong understanding of deep learning architectures (transformers, attention mechanisms, autoregressive decoding) and their application to speech/audio or other multimodal domains
- Production track record delivering latency-constrained, real-time inference systems under concurrent load
- Experience with GPU performance optimization — memory hierarchy, occupancy, KV-cache management, and the accelerator programming model
- Demonstrated ownership of a technical area — driving execution for a workstream and collaborating effectively across scientists and engineers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with production LLM/multimodal serving internals (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM): scheduler, batching, block manager, sampler customization
- Hands-on experience building real-time or streaming AI systems — speech, audio, or video — with hard latency budgets
- Experience authoring custom GPU kernels (CUTLASS, Triton, raw CUDA/PTX), fused attention (FlashAttention-style), or quantized GEMM
- Familiarity with model-compression and efficiency techniques — quantization, pruning, distillation, speculative decoding, long-context optimization
- Experience building offline inference or rollout/reward-serving infrastructure for reinforcement learning or large-scale evaluation
- Experience with distributed training and post-training pipelines (SFT through RL) — parallelism strategies, training stability, and multi-accelerator communication (NCCL, NVLink)
- Familiarity with multiple hardware backends (NVIDIA GPU, AWS Neuron/Trainium, edge accelerators) and how architecture choices affect inference latency, memory, and cost
- Background in speech-to-speech or audio generative models (codec models, autoregressive audio generation), speech recognition, or speech synthesis
- Experience shipping research to production at scale — models serving real users, not just benchmark results
- Contributions to open-source inference/kernel projects (vLLM, CUTLASS, FlashAttention, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, or similar)

title: Sr. Builder - Mobile (Platform), Ring
descriptionHtml:
Ring is redefining how millions of people interact with their homes every single day. As a Senior Builder on the App Platform team, you won't just write code — you'll set the technical direction for one of the most widely-used connected device applications in the world. Native mobile is the foundation our customers rely on, and we need engineers with deep iOS or Android expertise — ideally both, or equivalent depth in a cross-platform framework like React Native — to architect what comes next.

This is a role for someone who sees AI not as a buzzword but as a fundamental shift in how software is built, tested, shipped, and maintained. You'll champion an AI-powered software development lifecycle across the mobile organization, influencing how hundreds of engineers build applications. Your mastery of modern mobile development — Swift, Kotlin, React Native, the latest platform APIs, modern architectural patterns, and the tooling that surrounds them — will be instrumental in charting Ring's path toward faster iteration cycles without sacrificing the quality and performance our customers expect at scale.

The App Platform team sets the overall technical direction for mobile development across Ring and Blink. You'll be a key member of this team, making decisions that ripple across our entire mobile engineering organization.

Key job responsibilities
You will:

- Define and drive the technical strategy for Ring's mobile architecture, balancing development velocity with the performance and reliability customers expect from a home security product
- Champion AI-powered development practices across the mobile organization — from AI-assisted code generation and automated testing to intelligent code review and predictive quality assurance
- Architect mobile solutions that serve tens of millions of daily active users on iOS and Android
- Establish frameworks, SDKs, tooling, and best practices that accelerate feature development, improve code quality, increase testability, strengthen observability, and streamline the path from idea to production
- Drive continuous improvement in CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, modularization, and release engineering for large-scale codebases
- Mentor and influence engineers across the organization, raising the bar for mobile development practices and fostering a culture of technical excellence and experimentation
- Partner with product, UX, backend, and infrastructure teams to deliver cohesive features that span the full stack of Ring's connected device ecosystem

A day in the life
As a Senior Builder on the App Platform team, you will:

- Shape the future of how Ring builds mobile software — your architectural and tooling decisions will define the development experience for teams across the organization
- Tackle novel challenges that come with operating a large-scale production application serving millions of daily users
- Experiment with and operationalize AI-powered development workflows, identifying where AI can eliminate toil, catch defects earlier, and accelerate delivery
- Engage in deep technical discussions about application architecture, rendering performance, state management, and platform-specific tradeoffs with some of the best mobile engineers in the industry
- Build platform capabilities and infrastructure that protect millions of homes — your work has real, tangible impact on people's sense of safety and connection

About the team
Ring's App Platform team is the technical backbone of our mobile development organization. We own the cross-cutting concerns — architecture, tooling, frameworks, performance, and developer experience — that enable dozens of feature teams to ship high-quality software to tens of millions of users. We combine the ambition and speed of a startup with the scale, resources, and impact of Amazon. If you want to work on problems where your decisions matter at massive scale, and where you have the freedom to chart a genuinely new course, this is the team.

You'll work closely with senior leadership every day. title: Software Development Engineer, Agentic Workspaces - Watchtower
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon WorkSpaces has protected and empowered enterprise work for over a decade and we are now reimagining what a workspace is. We are building Agentic WorkSpaces: a platform where the workspace itself is an active partner in how you work not just infrastructure that delivers applications. Today more than a million users rely on WorkSpaces daily; tomorrow those WorkSpaces will host AI agents alongside humans—agents that code, troubleshoot, analyze, and act on behalf of their users governed by the same identity and security policies as the people they serve. We compete with Microsoft Citrix and Omnissa and we intend to leapfrog them by building the workspace that was designed for the agentic era not retrofitted for it.

Agentic WorkSpaces' Watchtower team is the layer that makes this possible from the inside of every WorkSpace: telemetry, health, secure communications both inbound and outbound, Agentic AI platforms for qualification of operating systems instances and applications. Our mission is to provide robust monitoring automation and operational capabilities that ensure the reliability and performance of WorkSpaces Instances. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design build and operate the services that secure and maintain WorkSpaces for humans and increasingly for the AI agents that work beside them across every supported OS and identity provider. You will own end-to-end delivery of features and systems within Watchtower - from design through deployment and operations - holding a high bar for availability latency and security.

You are customer-obsessed technically deep and energized by solving hard problems. You think big about what the workspace of the future looks like - a unified agent shipping to two platforms from one codebase an identity model that treats human and agents as first-class citizens and autonomous troubleshooting that resolves issues before users notice - and then you build the systems to get there. You thrive in ambiguity make sound trade-off decisions with incomplete information and hold yourself accountable for results that matter. You want to solve challenging problems in operating systems identity AI and desktop platform engineering at a scale that impacts more than a million users daily.

descriptionHtml:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. *Coordinate with maintenance scheduling teams to ensure 100% completion of required maintenance activities while minimizing impact to data center operations.
*Manage multiple concurrent projects across various sites, including improvement initiatives from conception to completion.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors and contract partners, ensuring adherence to SLAs and quality standards.
* Effectively manage operational budgets and resource allocation across multiple programs.
* Foster a culture of safety and continuous improvement, implementing best practices and driving team development.

The Services Manager is responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive maintenance strategies, managing technical teams, and maintaining exceptional uptime standards for power distribution systems that support mission-critical infrastructure. This role requires maintaining better than 99.999% reliability while optimizing operational efficiency and managing resources effectively.

- 3+ years of people management and team development experience
- 3+ years of engineering work managing large-scale services experience
- 3+ years of working in a data center or other mission critical environment with an emphasis on building and equipment operation experience

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

Moderniser les bases de données à l'aide de RDS, Aurora, DMS et des outils de conversion de schéma

title: Software Development Engineer Intern, Annapurna Labs - 2027
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

About the team
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon at Amazon - including Graviton (our server processors), Trainium and Inferentia (our machine learning training and inference accelerators), and the Nitro system that powers modern EC2. We own the full stack, from silicon through the software that makes it work (compilers, runtimes, drivers, and the frameworks that let customers run workloads on our hardware). As a Software Development Engineer Intern, you'll write the software that turns custom silicon into products used by millions.

Where you might land:
Annapurna has software teams spanning the full stack, and we work to place you on a technical team aligned with your interests and strengths. Example teams and focus areas include:

- Compiler development for ML accelerators (Neuron SDK, MLIR, LLVM)
- ML runtimes and frameworks (integration with PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)
- Low-level systems software, firmware, and device drivers
- Performance optimization and kernel development for custom silicon
- Distributed training and inference infrastructure
Once you join, we partner with you and our hiring managers to match you to a team where your background and interests fit best, so your project is something you're genuinely excited to work on.

As an SDE Intern, you'll contribute to real production software, which may include:

- Designing, implementing, and testing software across the stack - from low-level systems code to compilers, runtimes, and tooling
- Writing efficient, maintainable code in languages such as C, C++, or Python
- Optimizing software performance on custom hardware (Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia)
- Debugging complex issues across the hardware-software boundary
- Collaborating with hardware, compiler, and systems teams to deliver features end-to-end
- Documenting your work and presenting results to the team
You'll be paired with a mentor and manager who will scope your project, support your growth, and set you up to deliver meaningful, measurable impact by the end of your internship.

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a final graduation date of December 2027 or later
- Programming experience in at least one modern language such as C, C++, Java, or Python
- Coursework or project experience in data structures, algorithms, and software design
- Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: operating systems, computer architecture, or systems programming

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
- Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
- Can show strong verbal and written communication skills
- Pursuing a degree with a focus on systems, compilers, computer architecture, or high-performance computing
- Experience with low-level or systems programming in C/C++ (memory management, concurrency, performance optimization)
- Familiarity with compilers (MLIR, LLVM, TVM), ML runtimes, operating systems internals, or distributed systems
- Exposure to machine learning frameworks and an understanding of how models run on hardware
- Prior internship, research, or open-source contribution experience in systems, compilers, or ML infrastructure

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities
- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

Our greatest challenge is protecting buyer trust without unjustly harming good selling partners. To strike the right balance, we invest in mechanisms which allow us to accurately identify and mitigate risk, and to quickly correct and learn from our mistakes. This strategy includes continuously evolving enforcement policies, iterating our Machine Learning risk models, and exercising high‐judgement decision‐making where we cannot apply automation.

The Global Product Verification (GPV) team supports the Perfect Order Experience (POE) organization goals and objectives by acting as a reliable product authentication and verification service for third-party products sold on Amazon by authenticating risky offers and establishing ground truth. As GPVs’ Lab Metrology Technician you will support expanding and scaling the use of metrology-based applications and techniques, e.g. X-Ray, Digital Multimeter, Spectrometer, Load testers, etc. to aid in establishing authenticity of products. You will use a combination of scientific methods and technical skills to test and evaluate products, and leverage your thorough understanding of industry regulations and guidelines. You will collaborate directly with GPVs investigations team to develop new metrology-based product analysis tools and mechanisms including leveraging AI to drive efficiencies and scale. In addition you will work closely with GPV leadership in driving the strategic vision for metrology to support POE’s long-term goals and objectives, including regional expansion efforts.

In addition to above the Lab Metrology Technician is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, precision, and reliability of all measurement instruments, acting as a crucial quality assurance authority on behalf of GPV and POE. This includes maintaining measurement standards, enforcing strict calibration schedules, adhering to regulatory protocols (like ISO/IEC 17025, cGMP, and FDA), and managing documentation for all measurements and equipment, including all safety and compliance requirements. In addition to technical skills, the Lab Metrology Technician must have strong problem-solving and analytical abilities and be able to work independently but most importantly, collaboratively with team of investigators.


Key job responsibilities
* Overseeing all metrology-based tools and systems enabling investigators to conduct product analysis at scale
* Maintaining and calibrating laboratory equipment, and ensuring the laboratory is clean and organized
* Interpreting, analyzing, and communicating results to relevant stakeholders
* Providing weekly/monthly reporting (KPIs) of impact and output of lab
* Following standard operating procedures and good laboratory practices
* Participating in internal and external audits, and maintaining a thorough understanding of regulatory requirements
* Generating and updating standard operating procedures and test methods
* Troubleshooting laboratory issues and recommending solutions
* Providing support to other team members as needed
* Maintaining accurate and detailed records of all testing performed

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working cross-functionally and across regions
- Experience in oral and written communication
- Experience in trust and safety compliance or risk
- Experience using Excel and SQL

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of professional experience
- 4+ years of hardware development, test lab, or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Master's degree in engineering, physics, or equivalent
- ASQ’s Certified Calibration Technician (CCT) or Coordinate Metrology Society (CMS) Level-One/Level-Two
- Proficiency with laboratory information management systems (LIMS).

title: Senior Software Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

On Agentic WorkSpaces our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do: with access to real applications real interfaces and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications they need to see what agents did control what agents can do and prove both to auditors. Our team builds the systems that make this possible. We record every agent desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail enforce policy on every tool call before it executes pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions and package the evidence for compliance frameworks.

We are seeking an exceptional Senior SDE to own the identity architecture at the foundation of this system. When an agent acts inside a user's desktop session it inherits that user's identity. Every downstream system then attributes the agent's actions to the human. Solving this means deciding how agent identity is established propagated across protocol and service boundaries and preserved through to policy enforcement and audit. These decisions determine whether the rest of the governance stack - attribution enforcement approval evidence - can be trusted at all. You will make foundational architectural calls write code mentor the engineers around you and drive consensus with partner teams whose identity models were built for humans. This is a high-visibility high-ownership role on a small team solving problems with no established playbook. If you do your best work in ambiguity and want your technical decisions to set the direction for how enterprises govern AI agents this team is for you.

Key job responsibilities
• :
• Own the end-to-end identity architecture for agent governance: how agent identity is established propagated and preserved across desktop sessions protocol boundaries and downstream services * Design attribution and audit systems that distinguish agent actions from human actions within the same session at the infrastructure level where agents cannot tamper with the record * Own policy enforcement architecture including authorization models that evaluate agent actions before they execute * Evaluate build-vs-leverage decisions across identity and authorization primitives including assessments of existing internal and external components for reuse * Drive technical consensus with partner teams whose identity and permission models predate autonomous agents * Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and design reviews * Communicate architectural decisions and tradeoffs to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders

A day in the life
Your mornings are usually free for focus work - architecture deep dives and hard problems. Around 11 you'll have standup then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews CR feedback or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're presenting to leadership. You're the person who knows the system most deeply - and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high - but we believe we can move fast do exceptional work and have a full life outside of it.

We're a small team building two greenfield projects within Agentic WorkSpaces. We're moving fast enough that our team name is still taking shape - but our engineering culture is well established. Here's what you can expect from AWS:

ABOUT AWS:

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

descriptionHtml:

Sie sind verantwortlich für die Führung des technischen Teams inklusive dem Aufbau einer Sicherheitskultur auf höchstem Niveau. Sie gewährleisten eine hohe Anlagenverfügbarkeit für den Standort und arbeiten eng mit dem europäischen Engineering Team zusammen, um zukünftiges Wachstum zu fördern. Zusätzlich treiben Sie die Umsetzung von netzwerkübergreifenden Verbesserungsinitiativen und die Implementierung neuer Standards an Ihrem Standort.

Key job responsibilities
- Gesamtverantwortung für das Instandhaltungsteam sowie für alle automatisierten Sortier- und Fördersysteme, Flurförderfahrzeuge und gebäudetechnischen Anlagen.
- Sicherstellung einer höchstmöglichen Verfügbarkeit aller Anlagen und die Implementierung moderner Instandhaltungsansätze wie Condition Based Maintenance (CBM).
- Sicherstellung der schichtübergreifenden Störungsbeseitigung an allen technischen Systemen.
- Implementierung aller notwendigen Sicherheitsstandards und einer proaktiven Safety-Kultur im Team.

- Planung und Einhaltung des Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsbudgets für den Standort.
- Auswertung von relevanten KPI´s zur Analyse der technischen Anlagen und interner Prozesse.

title: Logistics Trainer
descriptionHtml:
Il personale è il cuore pulsante delle nostre attività operative e la formazione è essenziale affinché ogni dipendente possa dare il meglio di sé. In qualità di Trainer per Amazon, svolgerai un ruolo cruciale nell’onboarding e nel potenziamento delle competenze dei nostri dipendenti. Ti assicurerai che i nostri dipendenti dispongano delle competenze e delle conoscenze necessarie per tutelare la propria sicurezza, per operare in modo efficiente e perché sappiano cogliere opportunità di crescita professionale in Amazon, fino a diventare, eventualmente, i nostri futuri leader. Affiancherai persone in ogni fase della carriera, dai neoassunti ai manager.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizioni. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Key job responsibilities
Garantire formazione e coaching secondo gli standard di Amazon.
Esaminare le percentuali di completamento dei programmi formativi nelle varie sedi e migliorarli, in collaborazione con manager e altri membri del team.
Raccogliere feedback ed evidenziare aree con opportunità di miglioramento dell’esperienza formativa.
Collaborare con i team per individuare ambiti in cui è necessario colmare lacune nella formazione e nella crescita professionale.
Aiutare a monitorare metriche come: sicurezza, qualità e processi nelle varie sedi.
Impartire formazione e coaching ai collaboratori affinché possano offrirli a loro volta ai team locali.

A day in the life
Il ruolo di Trainer consiste nell’illustrare gli standard relativi ai nostri processi e garantirne l’applicazione. Erogherai a dipendenti Amazon e collaboratori esterni una formazione di alta qualità, che punti i riflettori sulla sicurezza, la cultura e le procedure in vigore nei singoli siti, assicurando anche un’accoglienza calorosa per i neoassunti. In qualità di Trainer, farai in modo che tutti rispettino gli standard operativi più elevati. Saprai offrire feedback costruttivi per aiutare chi è in fase di formazione a crescere e sviluppare le corrette competenze.

Lavorerai presso una delle nostre sedi operative, dove offrirai formazione in presenza e online a team che coprono diversi turni. All’occorrenza offrirai supporto anche ad altre sedi. Lavorerai in modo autonomo, ma ti interfaccerai regolarmente con il personale e le gli stakeholder della tua sede.

About the team
Le consegne in tempi record per cui Amazon è celebre non sarebbero possibili senza il team di Amazon Transportation Service (ATS). Entrandone a far parte, lavorerai in un ambiente variegato, il cui ruolo è cruciale per il successo dell’azienda. Grazie alle reti di trasporto aereo, marittimo e su strada, nonché all’appoggio dei nostri centri di smistamento provvisti di soluzioni tecnologiche all’avanguardia, aiuterai ad assicurare la massima efficienza dei trasporti in Amazon. Il nostro team raccoglie dati, li analizza, affinché in un secondo momento possa prendere le giuste decisioni migliorative. Il team ATS ha un ruolo chiave nel rendere Amazon più innovativa ed efficiente.
Mettiamo sempre la sicurezza al primo posto, perché il nostro personale è la nostra priorità. E ci affidiamo all’esperienza dei nostri dipendenti per garantire che i pacchi raggiungano la loro destinazione in modo rapido, economico e sostenibile.

Basic qualifications

- Comprovata abilità nel comunicare con chiarezza, compresa vasta esperienza nell’erogazione di formazione di gruppo e nella creazione di comunicazioni mirate e materiali formativi.
- Buona padronanza del pacchetto MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) in contesti di uso professionale.
- Piena padronanza della lingua italiana.

Preferred qualifications

- Le qualifiche preferenziali non sono requisiti obbligatori per candidarsi a una posizione in Amazon. Se possiedi tutte le qualifiche richieste di cui sopra, non esitare a inviarci la tua candidatura: saremo felici di esaminarla!
- Esperienza nel coaching, mentoring o nell’insegnamento.
- Vasta esperienza nella gestione simultanea di molteplici priorità talvolta discordanti.

title: Creative Director, Brand Innovation Lab, US
descriptionHtml:
As a Creative Director on Amazon's Brand Innovation Lab team, you will be leading teams in creating one-of-a-kind campaigns for a wide range of global brands from creative brief to launch.

You'll work with a team of art directors, copywriters, designers, strategists, solutions managers, creative technologists and content producers to create innovative work by coming up with ideas that connect brands to the Amazon canvas (45+ Amazon brands including Alexa, Twitch, IMDb, Prime Video). You'll lead projects and own client relationships, focusing on creating work that benefits the end customer and pushes the creative envelope.

You'll investigate Amazon/3P data to form insights that inspire high-level strategies and campaign frameworks that solve business needs across a variety of verticals including Hardlines, Beauty, Toys, and Insurance. You will leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to push creative boundaries, drive efficiency, and unlock new storytelling formats for advertisers.

You will think across Amazon platforms and beyond, manage complex projects, and create tailored content across channels driving the marketing objectives of clients. You will effectively communicate with key stakeholders and external media and creative agencies. You will work with senior leadership to create processes and establish best practices that drive creative and operational excellence. And finally, you will work towards preserving the team culture of collaboration, teamwork, innovation, inspiration, and foster positive internal and agency relationships.

Key job responsibilities
- Raise the bar on creative excellence across campaign work
- Own and grow client relationships by establishing trust through creative excellence, proactive communication, and a deep understanding of advertiser goals and category dynamics
- Define the creative strategy for multiple advertisers
- Use strategic research and/or data to develop campaign insights and ideas
- Concept, pitch, design, and execute first-of-its-kind ad campaigns and experiences for global brands, from developing the creative brief to launch
- Defend and champion great ideas through intelligent and persuasive creative rationales
- Champion the end customer in every creative decision, ensuring campaigns deliver genuine value and utility to Amazon customers while meeting advertiser objectives
- Explore and integrate AI-powered creative tools (generative imagery, dynamic content, personalization engines) into campaign development
- Bring deep expertise in the end-to-end creative production process, ensuring multi-channel executions are executed at the highest quality while meeting timelines, budgets, and technical specifications
- Independently creative direct campaigns and collaborate with internal teams, clients, and external agency partners
- Direct creative disciplines outside your area of functional expertise and provide feedback in all stages of the creative development process
- Mentor and inspire art directors, copywriters, designers, program managers, developers, and content producers to create customer-focused solutions that deliver on client objectives
- Provide in-depth understanding of art-direction and copywriting for all formats—digital, print, out-of-home, video, and more
- Make creative trade-off decisions between teams, clients, and end-customer needs
- Measure and evaluate current processes within the department and improve them through documentation

A day in the life
- Review and improve campaign ideas, scripts, and presentation decks
- Present campaign pitches to brand clients and their media/creative agencies
- Partner with the Alexa team to create a campaign for a brand
- Create an AI-powered interactive shopping experience for a brand's new product launch or customer experience
- Explore generative AI tools to develop personalized creative assets at scale for our advertisers
- Work through creative messaging feedback with Legal and PR
- Write documentation to improve creative processes
- Review video edits for a brand's sponsorship of a PV or Twitch series as part of their full-funnel campaign

About the team
Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) is an award-winning team that conceptualizes and executes bespoke advertising experiences for global brands—including SharkNinja, L’Oreal, LEGO, and State Farm—who invest in media with Amazon Ads, scaling successful campaign elements as new products or features in existing products. Our global team of storytellers and innovators includes creatives, strategists, design technologists, engineers, producers and more, collaborating to create customer-obsessed solutions across the Amazon canvas (Alexa, Twitch, Prime Video, Fire TV, etc.) that are customized to our advertisers' goals.

Check out BIL's recent campaigns here:

https://brandinnovationlab.amazon/

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
- Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
- Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
- Experience managing creative (internal team of designers, copywriters, external agencies and freelancers)
- Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
- Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.
