Process Improvement and Prevention

- Develop systemic process improvements to reduce non-conformance volume and improve receiving throughput
- Refine inspection criteria and acceptance standards based on NC trend data and engineering feedback
- Develop pre-approved dispositions for known, recurring conditions to accelerate NC cycle time
- Build supplier qualification strategies (reduced inspection, skip-lot, source inspection qualification) based on demonstrated supplier performance
- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) from a receiving quality perspective, ensuring inspection readiness for new or changed parts

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Serve as the primary quality representative for receiving inspection non-conformances
- Work directly with Receiving Inspection, Supplier Quality, Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Supply Chain teams to resolve non-conformances
- Provide quality engineering support to inspectors on defect identification, acceptance criteria interpretation, and NC documentation standards
- Collaborate with fellow MQEs and PSQEs to share learnings and improve mechanisms across the business
- Communicate and present quality status, risks, and improvement plans to leadership

Systems and Compliance

- Serve as subject matter expert for SAP QM as it relates to receiving inspection non-conformance workflows and quality record management
- Ensure NC processes comply with AS9100 quality management system requirements
- Develop and maintain NC categorization standards to ensure consistent defect coding and accurate reporting

title: Data Center Operations Tech, Data Center Operations (DCO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
As Data Centre Operations Tech, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
• You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
• You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
• You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
• You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
• You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

About AWS

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Battery Pack Mechanical Design Engineer II, Amazon Prime Air - Electric Propulsion Subsystem
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Battery Pack Mechanical Hardware Development Engineer II to join our Drone Electric Propulsion Subsystem (EPS) team. In this role, you will be a significant and autonomous contributor, solving difficult hardware engineering problems related to battery systems. You will design, develop, and validate battery packs from concept through production, working on high-voltage battery systems that push the boundaries of performance, reliability, efficiency, and safety.

This position requires an engineer who demonstrates strong technical depth in battery pack design while also exhibiting the system-level thinking and influence characteristic of our most impactful contributors.

Key job responsibilities
Design & Development:
•Design mechanical architecture for high-voltage Li-Ion battery packs, including cell arrangement, modules, enclosures, structural supports, and interconnections.
•Create detailed 3D models and manufacturing drawings using CATIA with GD&T.
•Develop cell-to-module and module-to-pack packaging concepts balancing energy density, safety, and manufacturability.
•Design and integrate thermal management systems and sealed, IP-rated enclosures.
Analysis & Validation
•Perform FEA (structural, vibration, thermal) and tolerance stack-up analysis to validate designs.
•Plan and execute prototype builds, validation testing, and root-cause failure analysis.
Safety & Compliance
•Design to high-voltage safety requirements including creepage/clearance, isolation, and HVIL.
•Incorporate thermal runaway mitigation and ensure compliance with applicable standards (UN 38.3, UL 2580, IEC 62133, etc.).
•Develop verification test plans to verify designs against DO-160 and DO-274 standards
•Support DFMEA and design-for-safety activities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
•Partner with electrical, BMS, systems, and safety engineers on mechanical and interface requirements.
•Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, and suppliers on DFM/DFA, tooling, and sourcing.
•Participate in and present at design reviews.
Documentation & Process
•Maintain engineering documentation and manage changes through PLM.
•Support project planning with estimates, timelines, and risk assessments.
Continuous Improvement
•Identify opportunities to improve cost, weight, safety, and manufacturability.
•Contribute to team design standards and best practices.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 4+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- Demonstrated experience taking a mechanical design from concept through prototype to production.
- Battery pack mechanical design: cell-to-pack architecture, module design, cell holders, busbar integration, enclosures, and structural support for prismatic, cylindrical, or pouch cells.
- CAD proficiency: SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, or NX for 3D modeling, GD&T, and detailed drawings.
- Sealing and enclosure design: IP-rated enclosures, gaskets, potting/encapsulation, and pressure equalization/venting.
- Understanding of high-voltage safety practices, creepage and clearance requirements, and isolation/insulation coordination.
- Familiarity with thermal runaway mitigation and propagation prevention (venting, barriers, intumescent materials).
- Interface knowledge with the BMS (Battery Management System), contactors, fuses, HVIL (high-voltage interlock loop), and service disconnects.
- Awareness of cell chemistry behavior and how it drives mechanical/thermal requirements.
- DFM/DFA (design for manufacturing and assembly), and experience with joining methods relevant to packs (laser/ultrasonic/resistance welding, adhesives, fastening).
- Tolerance analysis and experience working with suppliers on tooling, injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, or extrusions.
- Prototyping, bring-up, and validation testing (environmental chambers, vibration tables, HALT/HASS).
- DFMEA and design-for-safety methodology.
- Familiarity with PLM systems and engineering change management.
- Soft Skills & Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Strong collaboration with electrical, BMS/firmware, systems, safety, and manufacturing teams.
- Requirements definition, design reviews, and clear technical documentation.
- Root-cause analysis and structured problem solving (8D, DMAIC, fishbone).

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 3+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- Thermal management: designing cooling systems (liquid cold plates, air cooling, phase-change or immersion), thermal interface materials, and managing heat generation/dissipation across the pack.
- Structural/mechanical analysis: FEA for stress, vibration, shock, and drop; tolerance stack-up analysis.
- Experience in automotive, aerospace, marine, or grid-storage battery systems.
- Scripting/simulation tools (MATLAB, Python) for design automation or thermal modeling.
- Experience with fast-charge thermal design and high-C-rate applications.

アマゾンジャパンAmazon Logistics(以下、AMZL)部門のセントラルオペレーションチームでは急速に拡大している物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルネットワークを円滑に運営するために注文数の予測や配送ドライバー台数の計画、運用方法を改革していくことを目指したオペレーションを構築します。そのため、イノベーションと問題解決に情熱を持ち、世界最高レベルの顧客体験を創造する能力を持つLogistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターを募集しています。日本にある全てのAMZLデリバリーステーション(以下、DS)をサポートする重要な役割を担っていただきます。

Key job responsibilities
全国のDSの配送オペレーションを横断的にサポートしていただく役割を担って頂きます。支える役割を担っていただきます。具体的には荷物量の予測からドライバーの配車計画、配送ルート作成、当日のリアルタイム対応まで、マネージャーやチームと連携しながら以下の業務を遂行します：

3. パフォーマンスの可視化・報告: 日次・週次のオペレーションレポートを作成し、改善機会をマネージャーに提案する
4. オペレーション拡大時の準備・実行: セールイベントや新規サービス・システム導入時に、手順変更の検討・標準作業手順書（SOP）の作成・トレーニング教材の構築を行い、円滑な導入を推進する
5. 業務標準化・改善の推進: チームメンバーとステークスホルダーと協力し、データに基づいた業務プロセスの改善と標準化を推進する

A day in the life
あなたの1日は、全国のDS状況をリアルタイムで把握することから始まります。シフト開始時に朝礼を行い、当日の業務内容を確認します。配送計画、リアルタイム対応、改善推進など、専門チームごとに担当領域が分かれており、あなたの強みや適性に応じたチームに配属されます。
シフト中は、複数のモニターで状況を監視しながら、配送計画の策定・調整業務を行います。突発的な遅延や天候変化に対応する場面もあります。あなたが支えるのは、デリバリーステーションに荷物が届く前からお客様の手元に届くまでの全プロセスです。1人で判断するのではなく、チームメンバーと連携しながらリアルタイムで最適な解決策を見つけていきます。
また、日々のオペレーション対応だけでなく、「もっとこうすれば効率的になるのでは？」というアイデアをチームに提案し、改善プロジェクトを主動していただきます。前職での経験や視点を活かして、新しい仕組みづくりに貢献できる環境です。


About the team
■セントラルオペレーション■
セントラルオペレーションは複数のチームからなる300人を超える大規模な組織です。大多数は日本語を母語とするメンバーですが、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが世界中から集まっています。多様性(DEI)が尊重され、安心して働ける環境です。

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており、仕事とプライベートの両方を充実させることができます。

まずは試してみることを大切にしています。好奇心を持って学び、時にはリスクを取りながら、よりよい成果に繋げていく文化があります。

■キャリアパス■
Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターからキャリアをスタートし、チームのマネージャーとなった実績も多数あります。また、社内公募制度を通じて、国内外の他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。

Basic qualifications

- 高校卒業以上
- PCスキル（WordやExcelなどで文書作成や表作成ができる能力）、但し業務を通じて向上させる意欲があること）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（文書の作成・読解能力）
- 翻訳を活用しながらでもコミュニケーションをとることができる英語力

Preferred qualifications

- 4年制大学での学士号
- チーム内でリーダーシップを発揮し、プロジェクトを完遂した経験
- マネジメント経験（人数・期間は問わず）
- 定量的なデータ分析をもとに、業務改善・標準化を実施した経験
- SQLを使用したデータ取得や、VBAをた業務自動化の実務経験
- ビジネスレベルの英語力

title: Senior Product Manager, IES - Emerging Stores
descriptionHtml:
This role is part of the IES Shopping team and owns the mission of helping every emerging shopper instantly discover, understand, and act on the best value available to them — surfacing personalized savings across the shopping funnel from Home page to Cart — driving purchase confidence and conversion across emerging markets worldwide.

Emerging shoppers are highly price-sensitive and compare offers across retailers — yet face a fragmented value landscape: savings are scattered across different promotion types with no unified view of their true net effective price. Shoppers miss applicable savings, struggle to compare cost-to-own, and abandon purchases because the "best price" is unclear. This role exists to unify that value narrative at scale — combining all savings instruments into a single, transparent, personalized view and ensuring every shopper can maximize savings and make every purchase feel affordable.

Key job responsibilities
-Define and drive the long-term Value CX vision and roadmap — Own the multi-year strategy for savings discovery and value communication across emerging markets. Translate business strategy and voice of shopper into a prioritized, logically sequenced product roadmap. Create buy-in with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

-Own execution from requirements through launch — Partner with UX and engineering to develop high-quality requirements, manage scope, and deliver key capabilities on time. Create and execute go-to-market plans, drive adoption, and continually optimize based on performance metrics.

-Partner across business and technology teams — Influence Payments, Affordability, Marketing, and global platform teams to integrate savings instruments into a unified value experience. Drive prioritization of emerging-market requirements in global partner roadmaps.

-Operate with strategic range — Be equally comfortable generating a 3-year vision and executing hands-on, day-to-day problem solving with quick, effective action plans. Prepare and present business reviews to senior management.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Responsable d'équipe logistique junior
descriptionHtml:
En tant que Responsable d'Équipe Logistique Junior chez Amazon, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans notre mission : permettre à des millions de clients de recevoir leurs commandes à l'heure promise. Chaque jour, vos décisions et votre leadership auront un impact direct sur la satisfaction de nos clients au sein de notre réseau européen


Key job responsibilities
Vos responsabilités clés

- Porter au quotidien notre engagement premier - la santé et la sécurité de nos collaborateurs - en veillant au respect des standards et en promouvant une culture de sécurité exemplaire
- Fédérer et développer une équipe de 20 à 100 collaborateurs aux parcours variés, en créant un environnement de travail motivant où chacun peut s'épanouir et progresser
- Piloter la performance de votre périmètre et la qualité des processus pour garantir à des millions de clients une expérience exceptionnelle
- Etre moteur de l'amélioration continue des processus, en vous appuyant sur vos collaborateurs et sur l'analyse des données pour viser l'excellence opérationnelle
Pour cela, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les autres services sur site et au sein de notre réseau logistique

A day in the life
Journée type

Chez Amazon, nous avons développé des méthodes de management qui ont fait leurs preuves à l'échelle mondiale. En nous rejoignant, vous bénéficierez d'un parcours d'intégration structuré, de formations à nos standards opérationnels et d’un accompagnement par des managers expérimentés. Ce rôle est une opportunité unique d'apprendre le management de terrain au cœur de nos opérations et de progresser rapidement vers des responsabilités importantes au sein d'Amazon.

About the team
À propos de l’équipe

Selon votre profil et vos aspirations, vous pourrez évoluer dans l'un des environnements suivants :

- Centres de distribution (Customer Fulfilment): Ces entrepôts modernes sont le point de départ de notre chaîne logistique. Nos équipes y assurent la réception, le stockage et la préparation des commandes, garantissant une gestion efficace des stocks et une expédition rapide vers nos clients
- Centres de tri (Amazon Transportation Services): Ces hubs logistiques sont au cœur de notre réseau de distribution. Nos équipes y orchestrent le tri et l'acheminement des colis entre les centres de distribution et les agences de livraison, optimisant les flux pour assurer rapidité et précision
- Agences de livraison (Amazon Logistics): Ces sites représentent le dernier maillon de notre chaîne logistique, au plus près des clients. Nos équipes y coordonnent les livraisons du dernier kilomètre, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec nos partenaires pour offrir une expérience clients exceptionnelle

Les postes à pourvoir suivent le rythme des équipes opérationnelles, et vous travaillez en horaires décalés.

Basic qualifications

- Vous avez obtenu(e) votre diplôme universitaire avant la date de début OU diplomé(e) au cours des 24 derniers mois
- Vous êtes au minimum titulaire d’une licence (bac+3)
- Vous disposez d’excellentes capacités de communication en français et en anglais
- Vous faites preuve de fortes capacités d'analyse et avez le goût pour les données

Preferred qualifications

- Stage, alternance ou première expérience en environnement industriel/logistique
- Expérience en gestion de projet ou en animation d'équipe
- Maîtrise des outils bureautiques

title: Elektroniker / Elektriker / Mechatroniker (m/w/d), RME
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Mindestens zweijährige Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Handwerk
- Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von industriellen Produktionsanlagen
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung mit zustandsorientierter Überwachung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Druck- und Applikationsmaschinen
- Erfahrung in der Störungssuche und Wartung von Förder- oder Automationssystemen

title: Sr. Supply Chain Manager, EU Carrier Health

title: Senior Business Coach, DSP Business Coach Team
descriptionHtml:
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses.

The Senior Business Coach (BC) helps Amazon improve the flexibility and quality of its delivery network in the Americas—to help fuel a $4B investment in rural communities bringing even faster delivery to our millions of customers in less densely populated areas. This role’s primary focus is supporting DSP operations across the broader Americas delivery network, with particular emphasis on rural market expansion and mature-state optimization. Specifically, BCs support DSPs in making business decisions that enable them to build healthy, sustainable businesses. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs, supporting business planning and strategy and helping owners address business and operational challenges.

Key job responsibilities
As Senior Business Coach (BC), you will manage a portfolio of Delivery Service Partner (DSP) owners within the Amazon delivery network. With the evolution of delivery modes and rural expansion planned for 2026, and continued strategic expansion into 2027, this role is integral to our program's evolution. Sr. BCs provide strategic guidance to DSP owners throughout their business life-cycle of their relationship with Amazon—from pre-launch preparation through mature-state optimization. You will facilitate solution-oriented approaches to remove business obstacles and drive continuous improvement in financial performance, operational efficiency, and safety standards across the network. The position requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, including operations managers, program directors, compliance officers, legal counsel, and finance teams. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, strategic problem-solving skills, and the ability to implement data-driven recommendations that create meaningful change both internally and externally.

Key job responsibilities
Operational Excellence & Financial Advisory
• Lead DSP owners through critical business phases including launch, operational scaling, and seasonal demand optimization
• Provide comprehensive consultation on financial management and operational optimization
• Support development of scalable business processes to ensure consistent performance metrics
• Navigate program evolution by helping owners implement and adapt to strategic changes within traditional DSP operations, including new service types and offerings such as rural delivery expansion and delivery capabilities
• Conduct data-driven business reviews, delivering performance insights and competitive benchmarking analysis

Business Development & Program Management
• Evaluate and interview potential candidates for the DSP program, ensuring alignment with program standards and objectives
• Guide strategic planning and execution of network capacity management

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Enhancement
• Foster strong DSP community engagement through coordination of local events and regional initiatives
• Build and maintain productive relationships with regional stakeholders
• Identify operational inefficiencies and champion process improvements across the network
• Design and implement solutions to enhance overall program effectiveness and DSP owner experience

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor and primary account manager, combining strategic insight with practical business acumen to drive sustainable growth and operational excellence across the DSP network.

A day in the life
Strategic Leadership & Decision Making
• Drive both strategic initiatives and tactical execution to achieve business objectives
• Leverage industry expertise to establish priorities, optimize account management strategies, and develop sustainable long-term solutions
• Navigate ambiguous business environments to formulate clear strategic direction and influence cross-functional priorities
• Demonstrate sound judgment in solution design, balancing complexity with efficiency

Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Lead resolution of complex business challenges through detailed analysis and effective escalation management
• Foster collaborative relationships across multiple business units and organizational levels
• Develop and maintain strong partnerships with key stakeholders through exceptional relationship management
• Deliver compelling verbal and written communications, including executive-level presentations and strategic recommendations

Location & Travel Requirements
• Position is headquartered at our Nashville or Manhattan Hub
• Work arrangement includes structured mix of office presence, field travel, and remote work days. One week per month is dedicated to in-office collaboration at respective/team’s Hub. Significant field engagement is required: minimum 3 days per week of travel for 3 weeks monthly to support portfolio of Delivery Service Partners
• Must be comfortable with regular travel and maintaining a flexible schedule

The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional problem-solving capabilities, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence outcomes in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

About the team
ABOUT AMAZON LOGISTICS
At Amazon Logistics (AMZL), our goal is to provide customers with an incredible package delivery experience through the last mile of the order. To achieve this goal, we partner with a network of small independent delivery businesses (Delivery Service Providers) and the independent contractor community (Amazon Flex) to deliver customer orders. Utilizing continuous improvement initiatives and creative thinking, our Delivery Station teams ensure that millions of packages reach their final destination as efficiently as possible.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of account or relationship management, small business logistics, or retail/vendor/supplier management experience
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of account or relationship management, small business logistics, or retail/vendor/supplier management experience

title: Principal Worldwide Specialist - AI Inference, Data & AI GTM
descriptionHtml:
Are you a strategic leader who thrives on ideating and building innovative, dollar-needle-moving campaigns from scratch that reshape how customers adopt GenAI? AWS is seeking a Principal Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist to own and evolve the worldwide GTM strategy for AI Inference through Amazon SageMaker AI. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise in distributed inference systems and sharp business judgment to set the strategic direction for SageMaker AI Inference adoption globally. You will identify whitespace opportunities, architect high-impact campaigns that move revenue at scale, and build repeatable mechanisms that the worldwide field organization can execute autonomously. You will operate with minimal context, rapidly synthesizing ambiguous signals from customers, product teams, and market dynamics into clear strategic recommendations absorbable by L10 leaders. You will challenge prevailing assumptions, pressure-test existing motions, and drive team-wide change that raises the bar on how AWS goes to market with AI Inference. You will take your insights from customer engagements and market intelligence to influence service evolution, roadmap prioritization, and long-term product strategy.

Key job responsibilities
You will bring your combined deep technical acumen in clustered computing frameworks/distributed systems and seasoned business judgment to architect the worldwide GTM strategy for Amazon SageMaker AI Inference. You will ideate and build innovative campaigns from scratch—identifying net-new market segments, designing quantified value propositions, and constructing self-service mechanisms that move the revenue needle at scale without requiring your direct involvement in every deal. You will operate as a force multiplier, elevating the productivity and value of Geo-aligned field teams, GenAI Solution Architects, Product Managers, and Marketing Managers by codifying best practices, creating high-leverage enablement frameworks, and mentoring specialists across geos to independently execute complex sales motions.
You will define and own the end-to-end sales motion strategy including customer segmentation frameworks, qualification criteria with quantitative thresholds, positioning of differentiated value through ROI models and competitive battle cards, and scalable mechanisms and campaigns that compress sales cycles. You will challenge existing assumptions about what works—pressure-testing current motions with data, killing underperforming plays, and replacing them with higher-ROI alternatives. You will execute selectively through high-signal direct customer engagements while building the playbooks, tooling, and enablement that empower Geo Data & AI specialists to prospect, develop pipeline, and close business independently worldwide.
As the principal authority on AI Inference GTM, you will synthesize complex technical and market dynamics into crisp, insight-driven narratives absorbable by L10 leaders and VP-level customer stakeholders alike. You will help customers reason through the landscape of AI Inference workloads (spanning agentic, real-time, batch, and traditional ML use cases), evaluate emerging open-source technologies versus native capabilities, and make sound cost/performance/quality trade-off decisions at scale. You will build and present compelling product demos, own the competitive positioning narrative, and handle objections with data-backed conviction from both internal AWS teams and external customers. You will architect the customer evidence flywheel—securing quotes, cultivating public references, and partnering with Marketing to build case studies that become self-sustaining demand generators. You will synthesize insights from outbound engagements, competitive intelligence, and market trends into written recommendations that directly influence service roadmap prioritization and long-term product strategy for AI Inference.

A day in the life
As the principal owner of a critical segment of the SageMaker AI business worldwide, you will context-switch fluidly across strategic and executional activities: You will analyze propensity models and market signals to identify the highest-leverage customer cohorts, then work with field leaders to architect engagement strategies that open doors to VP/C-level AI Platform stakeholders. You will lead consultative conversations with senior customer leaders, listening deeply to uncover latent needs, walking them through quantitative and qualitative differentiators with live demos, building custom TCO models, and securing commitment to workshops, PoVs, or PoCs. You will author and continuously refine the sales motion playbook—not just updating assets, but rethinking the underlying strategy based on win/loss analysis and shifting market dynamics. You will design and deliver enablement programs that make field teams self-sufficient, reducing dependency on central specialists. You will lead customer-facing webinars and represent SageMaker AI Inference at flagship AWS events. You will write crisp, insight-rich documents—product feedback memos backed by customer evidence, market landscape analyses, and strategic recommendations—that directly shape roadmap decisions in sessions with product leadership. You will proactively identify and drive team-wide improvements: new mechanisms, process changes, or strategic pivots that raise the bar for the entire GTM organization.

We are a team of Generative AI Go-to-Market specialists with a unique blend of technical/specialist sales, product management, and technical business development backgrounds, driving global adoption and expansion of Amazon SageMaker AI as a flagship AWS managed GenAI Service.

title: Facility Operations Center Engineer, ADC InfraOps FOC
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth! Amazon is a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers.

The Data Center Infrastructure Operations organization is looking for an individual with proven skills to help support our Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Facility Operations Center. The Facility Operations Center is responsible for 24X7 monitoring of the data center’s physical infrastructure. This team will ensure that the customer experience will be optimal and gratifying by way of consistency, reliability and attention to detail.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of Data Center Infrastructure as well as have proficient computer and communication skills. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite operations teams. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels. If you are passionate about the customer experience, you think and act globally, and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, then this is be the place for you!

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with Polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Able to properly respond, acknowledge, investigate, and dispatch critical alarms
- Monitor the facility infrastructure platform
- Perform change management tasks
- Create and issue tickets
- Follow verbal and written directions
- Have an intermediate level of understanding of critical infrastructure
- Proficient computer and communication skills
- Required shift-work, overtime, and/or rotating schedules to support a 24X7 environment (Rotating shift work equates to weekends, nights, holidays and overtime shifts)

A day in the life
The Facility Operations Center (FOC) serves as the centralized 24/7 remote monitoring center for AWS data center’s critical physical facilities infrastructure systems.

We support availability by assisting internal teams in communicating prompt and accurate alarm and event notifications.

The FOC ensures safety across all AWS data centers by enforcing Change Management policies and is the communication hub during emergency and normal operations.


About the team
The Facility Operations Center (FOC) is a singular support team which proactively monitor the life-safety systems and the infrastructure equipment alarms (e.g., chillers, temperature sensors, generators, UPSs, switchgear, breakers, PDUs, and ATSs) that provides power and cooling to the platform 24x7x365.

We support Data Center Engineer Operations teams who are responsible for the operation of infrastructure equipment. Our role is to ensure that critical alarms are properly Responded to, Acknowledged, Investigated, and Dispatched (RAID). Additionally, the FOC serves as a communications hub during both standard and emergency operations.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Experience in technical support, or experience troubleshooting and documenting findings
- 1+ years of customer facing IT role or physical security systems/infrastructure work experience
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with BMS and EPMS control systems and data collection or trending
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 3+ years of customer service experience

title: Lead Support Engineer, Mobility, Amazon LEO Enterprise Customer Support
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of over 3,000 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.




Key job responsibilities
We are seeking a Lead Support Engineer to join our Enterprise & Mobility Support team. The Lead Support Engineer is the senior technical lead for enterprise and mobility satellite connectivity customers. You define the product support layer behind fleet monitoring, tooling, and in-service operations. The ideal candidate has significant product support engineering experience in satellite communications, has led investigations across hardware, software, and operations teams, managed field engineers, and turned technical findings into program decisions that improve reliability.

• Define BITE fault taxonomies, impact classifications, and alerting thresholds for connectivity systems
• Build the playbook where one doesn’t exist. When a new system, failure mode, or customer scenario has no documented path, define the support approach and escalation logic from scratch
• Establish monitoring requirements, telemetry data points, and fault thresholds. Work with Product and Hardware Engineering to determine tracking and visualization (LRU health, connectivity KPIs, firmware states, telemetry pipelines)
• Look beyond individual faults. Review how systems are deployed end-to-end (terminals, network, software, ground infrastructure) and identify where designs will break under scale or stress before they reach service.
• Serve as the escalation authority for recurring or fleet-wide issues. Drive root cause analysis and coordinate resolution with Hardware, Software, Network Operations, and Product
• Manage a team of Support Engineers across one or multiple customers, including workload assignment, mentoring, and performance development.
• Break down complex problems into assignable pieces so multiple engineers can work in parallel. You manage the investigation, findings and conclusion, end-to-end.
• Conduct MTBF analysis, reliability trending, failure mode identification, and hardware/software investigations using repair-shop data, service-bulletin history, and field failure reports
• Author and maintain troubleshooting SOPs, work instructions, and decision trees that Support Engineers execute daily in the field
• Own the technical customer relationship. Lead the technical components of MBRs and QBRs, and present on in-service status, fleet performance, and top issues
• Drive product enhancement requirements by identifying gaps in monitoring data and validating that telemetry reflects actual system health
• Provide structured feedback to Product Management on field observations, reliability trends, and improvement opportunities
• Identify recurring hardware and software incidents and coordinate with engineering teams to plan and release fixes or modifications
• Establish triage processes for incoming incidents: severity classification, reproduction steps, and handover packages produced within SLA
• Support Entry into Service (EIS), retrofit, and new customer onboarding from a technical readiness perspective
• Quantify Cost of Non-Conformance (CoNC) for in-service incidents to target engineering investment and backlog reduction
• Lead alignment across Engineering, Product, Operations, and the customer when priorities conflict. Bring teams to agreement on resolution approaches for contentious issues
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, guiding trade-off decisions across cost, performance, instrumentation depth, and operational risk
• Own the quality bar for solutions. Fixes should be maintainable, scalable, and simplify existing approaches rather than add complexity
• Contribute to hiring. Participate in interview panels, assess candidates against the technical bar, and help calibrate promotion readiness for the team


Work in a rotating shift schedule, including weekdays, and weekends, with the requirement to be available for on-call duties as needed to ensure continuous operational coverage.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
In this role, you will serve as the conduit between field Support Engineers, internal engineering teams (Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Network Operations, Product), and enterprise customers. You will define what to monitor and why: fault taxonomies, telemetry pipelines, alerting thresholds, and the data requirements behind proactive support. You will lead investigations into recurring issues, improve fleet reliability, manage a team of Support Engineers, and own the technical customer relationship. You will balance hands-on escalation work with longer-term priorities: shaping how the support model evolves, influencing the product roadmap based on what you see in the field, and deciding where the team invests time versus accepts risk.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in technical troubleshooting or similar
- 8+ years of experience in satellite communications, in-flight connectivity, maritime connectivity, or equivalent enterprise connectivity systems in field support and/or in-service product support engineering roles.
- Industry-specific experience in connectivity systems product support in lieu of formal degree qualification (Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field is a plus)
- Experience leading hardware and software investigations: root cause analysis, failure mode identification, and resolution of recurring issues
- Experience with MTBF/MTBUR analysis, reliability trending, and using repair data to improve fleet performance
- Experience defining monitoring thresholds, data requirements, and fault taxonomies for in-service support tooling
- BITE (Built-In Test Equipment) fault interpretation across hardware and software systems
- Experience with Linux-based system diagnostics, log analysis, and network troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi-Fi)
- RF troubleshooting experience including VSWR, insertion loss testing, and satellite terminal diagnostics
- Experience producing executive-level technical presentations and leading customer business reviews
- Experience managing or leading a team of field or support engineers, including workload planning, mentoring, and performance management
- Ability to translate technical issues into actionable program decisions for non-technical stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Prior product support engineering or engineering management experience at a connectivity, IFEC, or satellite communications OEM
- Comfortable going deep in one area while picking up enough in adjacent systems (network, software, hardware, RF) to connect the dots when problems cross domains
- History of documenting and sharing what you’ve learned, whether through tech talks, written best practices, or industry events
- Experience managing incident backlogs of 100+ concurrent cases with structured triage and escalation processes
- Experience using data analytics to define KPIs, build threshold-based alerting, and support predictive maintenance
- Prior on-site field engineering experience embedded at customer operational facilities
- Experience with software release coordination, service bulletin management, and configuration/change control
- Knowledge of Entry into Service (EIS) processes, certification requirements, and OEM integration workflows
- Experience quantifying Cost of Non-Conformance and driving engineering investment decisions based on field data

descriptionHtml:

title: Power DVT Engineer, Power DVT Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a Power DVT (Design Verification Test) Engineer on the Amazon LEO avionics team, you will own the complete design verification lifecycle for power electronics systems destined for Low Earth Orbit. You will bridge design intent and flight-ready hardware by developing comprehensive test strategies, executing rigorous validation campaigns, and driving cross-functional collaboration across power design, SI/PI, FPGA, firmware, and system integration teams. Your technical leadership will ensure our satellite power systems meet stringent space-grade requirements while mentoring junior engineers and establishing scalable test methodologies that accelerate our mission to deliver global broadband connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Design Verification Planning
- Develop comprehensive Design Verification Plans (DVPs) in collaboration with power design engineers, SI/PI engineers, and system integration teams.
- Apply Design for Testability (DFT) principles during design reviews, ensuring test point accessibility, boundary scan implementation, and built-in self-test capabilities.
- Focus on design verification from subsystem testing through functional testing and system performance validation.

Test Development & Execution
- Develop test methodologies and fixtures as needed.
- Develop and maintain test scripts in collaboration with design and firmware engineers.
- Use software simulation tools to model circuits and systems, analyze performance, identify failure modes, and optimize designs.
- Ensure proper test execution, data collection, review, and system requirement verification.
- Own and manage comprehensive test procedures and execute system and board-level test plans.

Technical Problem-Solving
- Troubleshoot and propose viable fixes when faced with electrical failures.
- Develop practical, cost-effective solutions that address root causes and prevent future occurrences.
- Maintain requirements traceability during testing and solve integration and test problems in real time.

Leadership & Collaboration
- Provide technical support to less experienced engineers during DVT execution, actively unblocking technical challenges and accelerating their development through hands-on guidance.
- Lead small groups of DVT engineers across multiple designs.
- Participate in reviews with cross-functional teams and management about test readiness and DVT results.
- Conduct test readiness reviews and align with stakeholders on data review activities.
- Coordinate between engineering, test lab, technicians, and schedule testing resources.

Data Analysis & Documentation
- Collect test data, perform data analysis, and document results.
- Work closely with cross-functional teams to coordinate testing activities and analyze results.

A day in the life
You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and work with multiple technical teams at Amazon LEO in different locations. As a member of the Power Design Verification Test Team, you will develop hardware tests and test automation for verification of various avionics systems. This cross-functional role requires constant interaction with multiple HW/SW design teams and end-users.

About the team
Power DVT Team validate the satellite power systems to survive space. We execute comprehensive verification from subsystem testing through flight-ready hardware. We develop automated test strategies, troubleshoot electrical failures, and ensure space-grade requirements compliance. We bridge design intent to operational satellites delivering global broadband.

title: Maintenance Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo Satellite Manufacturing is seeking an experienced Tech Ops Engineer II (Maintenance Engineer) to join our Equipment Engineering & Maintenance team at SEA133 in Kirkland, WA. In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for critical manufacturing equipment, providing technical leadership for preventive and corrective maintenance operations across automated production systems, robotics, material handling, and process-critical equipment supporting satellite manufacturing production.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

You will work independently with limited guidance, using your technical judgment to identify and resolve equipment issues that directly impact production throughput and uptime. Your decisions will directly impact manufacturing output, equipment reliability, and short- and long-term team goals.

Key job responsibilities
- Deliver with limited guidance; use technical judgment to identify and resolve site-level manufacturing equipment issues impacting production
- Develop risk assessments and operational dashboards covering critical manufacturing equipment and systems
- Plan and schedule complex maintenance tasks requiring coordination across production, engineering, and vendor teams
- Provide oversight and direction for day-to-day equipment maintenance activities in partnership with the Maintenance Manager
- Create workflows, technical documents, emergency procedures, SOPs, JHAs, and task lists to improve team efficiency and reduce equipment downtime
- Provide technical guidance to create, establish, and perform complicated preventive/corrective maintenance procedures on automated manufacturing equipment
- Evaluate and identify equipment deficiencies; make moderate to high complexity risk trade-offs based on current production conditions and equipment status
- Supervise highly complex troubleshooting and troubleshoot high-complexity electro-mechanical problems on production-critical systems
- Influence across production, process engineering, and external vendor teams; mentor and develop less-experienced technicians
- Optimize process improvements for operational excellence; create process improvement plans focused on equipment uptime and reliability
- Coordinate vendor work considering scope, production schedules, and required authorizations
- Support implementation of Ignition SCADA and related controls systems for manufacturing equipment monitoring


A day in the life
Your morning starts with a scan of overnight CMMS entries before attending the team's daily standup — prioritizing equipment issues against production schedule and coaching a tech through a PLC fault. By mid-morning, you're deep in root cause analysis on a recurring fault, coordinating with the OEM vendor on parts.

After lunch, you're reviewing SCADA alarm trends, updating dashboards, and drafting a process improvement plan. You wrap up in a cross-functional sync with Production, aligning on priorities that keep the line running.

No two days look the same, but every day balances hands-on problem solving with strategic thinking.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Maintenance Group (LMG) delivers world-class uptime through preventive maintenance excellence, ensuring maximum reliability and availability for manufacturing production equipment. We qualify and maintain critical production and test equipment including electrodynamic shakers, thermal vacuum chambers, thermal cycling chambers, and space simulation systems, while serving as the essential bridge between production teams and Facilities Management. We are committed to the highest standards of safety, efficiency, reliability, and operational effectiveness to support successful achievement of satellite manufacturing goals, leading to a successful LEO constellation.

- Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- 4+ years of industrial maintenance experience
- Experience in the mechanical or controls field, or experience with electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment
- Experience interpreting mechanical and electrical drawings
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
- Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains
- Experience maintaining robotic systems, automated conveyance, or complex material handling equipment
- Experience creating and implementing SOPs, JHAs, and emergency procedures for manufacturing equipment
- Experience with Ignition SCADA or similar industrial SCADA platforms

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Leo Autopilot
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to write code that operates real spacecraft in orbit? We're building the autonomous system that decides what every satellite in our constellation does, when it does it, and how it recovers when something goes wrong — all without a human in the loop for routine operations. This isn't about building another web service; it's about creating software that continuously manages an entire fleet of satellites at scale, making critical decisions under real physical constraints.

This Senior role offers a rare combination: the depth of hard systems problems — planning and scheduling under physical constraints, coordinating across a large fleet, designing safeguards you have to trust with spacecraft — alongside the ownership that comes with a small team and an expanding charter. Because the constellation and its software are both still growing, the architecture decisions you make now will run for the life of the fleet, and your work connects directly to delivering reliable broadband to people who don't have it today.

Export Control:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with our peer teams and customers to design suitable software systems to fulfill the mission needs.
- Develop cloud native software systems in Java and Python.
- Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build highly-available software services.
- Design and develop performant software systems that meet the mission criteria and requirements.
- Help on-board and mentor new team members.
- Lead technical roadmap definition efforts and decide which features and performance improvements to build.

A day in the life
You start the day with your team, aligning on what's shipping and where you can unblock each other. Most of your time goes to building: designing services, writing and reviewing code, and hardening systems that operate real spacecraft. You work closely with operators and mission teams, watching how they handle tricky situations, spotting patterns, and turning them into automation. Some weeks you go deep on a single system; others you're connecting several so they work as one. You'll also take turns supporting the systems you build, which keeps you close to how they behave in the real world.

About the team
Our mission is to operate a satellite constellation autonomously. We're building software that changes how satellites are managed: the ground sets the intent and guardrails, and the system schedules work, coordinates across the fleet, and recovers from faults on its own — with people supervising outcomes instead of issuing commands one at a time.

We're a small team with a large and expanding charter, which means engineers here have real influence over architecture and direction. We care about operational excellence, clear thinking, and building systems we can trust with spacecraft. You'll collaborate closely with operations, mission planning, and hardware teams, and you'll see your work make a direct difference for customers who don't have reliable broadband today.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Custom SoCs (System on Chip) live at the heart of AWS Machine Learning servers. As a member of the Cloud-Scale Machine Learning Acceleration team you’ll be responsible for the design and optimization of hardware in our data centers including AWS Inferentia, our custom designed machine learning inference datacenter server. Key job responsibilities
As an ASIC Design Engineer, you will:

• Develop and implement high-performance, area and power-efficient RTL designs to meet project specifications and targets

• Conduct in-depth analysis of designs, microarchitectures, and architectures to optimize trade-offs between features, power consumption, performance, and area requirements

• Create microarchitectures, implement SystemVerilog RTL, and deliver synthesis and timing-clean designs with appropriate constraints

• Execute lint and clock domain crossing quality checks to ensure design integrity

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including architects, fellow designers, verification specialists, pre- and post-silicon validation teams, and synthesis, timing, and back-end experts

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in ASIC design, proficiency in SystemVerilog, and excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with high-performance and power-efficient designs is highly desirable.

title: Manufacturing Test Engr Intern, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Lab126 is the research and development team behind Kindle, Fire TV, Echo, Echo Show, Ring and other Amazon devices. Within Lab126, the Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) Manufacturing Test Engineering (MTE) team builds the test systems that verify every device before it reaches a customer. Our stations run on contract manufacturer lines across Asia and North America, and they decide what ships.
MTE is rebuilding factory test around data and AI. We generate test plans with large language models, inspect assemblies with computer vision, and stream every factory measurement into an analytics platform engineers query directly. An intern here works on that platform, not beside it.
You will join a live new product introduction program and own one scoped piece of the factory test solution, from concept through deployment on a production line.

Key job responsibilities
• Write and debug test software (Python, C/C++) for RF, audio, camera, sensor and power test stations
• Build fixtures and bench setups that prove out a new test method before it reaches the line
• Analyze production test data for yield loss, false failures and test time reduction, and quantify what your change recovers
• Run Gauge R&R, correlation and test limit studies for new stations
• Write the test plan your station ships with, and present your results to the team

A day in the life
You start the day with overnight yield and test time data from the factory, then debug a test script or fixture in the lab with your mentor. Afternoons go to a design review with hardware engineers, a DOE on a new sensor test, or a sync with our contract manufacturer team in Asia.
You get a named mentor, a weekly one on one with your manager, and a written project scope on day one. The term closes with a project presentation to AME leadership.


About the team
AME MTE is a global team across Sunnyvale, Shanghai, Shenzhen and Hanoi, and we own manufacturing test for the full Amazon Devices portfolio, from first prototype through mass production. Two positions define how we work: a failure that passes on retest is not fixed, and a number that cannot be recomputed is not evidence.

Basic qualifications

- Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, with a graduation date after the internship term
- Completed coursework or project work in at least one of: electronics, signal processing, embedded systems, test and measurement
- Programming experience in Python, C#, C++ or MATLAB, and Git based development
- Available for a 12 week internship starting summer, 2027 in Hanoi, Vietnam

Preferred qualifications

- Test automation or instrument control.
- Able to read schematics and work with an oscilloscope, DMM and power supply
- Cpk, Gauge R&R and DOE, and data analysis with pandas, JMP or Minitab
- Exposure to RF, audio or camera test, or to embedded firmware development
- Prior internship, study or research experience in electrical, automation, communication or manufacturing

title: Solutions Architect, AWS Industries, Energy & Utilities
descriptionHtml:
Imagine being a part of a team where your ideas can help reshape the future of the Energy industry and improve the lives of many. Here at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you'll work with a talented & inclusive team while using the latest technologies to help our customers accelerate the global energy transition.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated technologist who possess a deep understanding of the Oil & Gas industry. You will have a business mindset, technical depth, and have strong interpersonal skills to build the future with us as a Solutions Architect - supporting one or some of the largest Energy companies in the world.

You will work with customer line of business owners to solve their biggest business problems and help them attain new levels of performance. You will leverage AWS’ leading AI and cloud services to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address business problems and accelerate the customer cloud journey. These solutions always have the customer and their experience at the center of everything we do.

You will adeptly interact, communicate and partner with other teams at AWS such as product, marketing, and professional services, and represent your team to executive management. You possess a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. Your dynamism, creativity and passion for excellence will make a positive impact with your customer.

If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while inspiring the impossible, come build the future with us.


Key job responsibilities
As an AWS Solutions Architect, you will have ownership of the technical relationship with customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, operational efficiency and best-practice architectures.

Internally, you will be an advocate acting on behalf of the customer to help drive continual improvements to the AWS platform, sharing their needs and wants to inform the roadmap of AWS features and services. You will also help shape the future of the Solutions Architecture organisation by helping to hire, coach and mentor others.

In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures with the worldwide AWS Solutions Architect community. You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelise and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

A day in the life
There is no typical day. A representative week includes leading a 2-hour architecture review with the customer's platform engineering team on data lake modernization, driving deep technical discussions on design trade-offs. You'll spend a day on-site at the customer's office conducting discovery sessions with new business units, having lunch with the VP of Digital to discuss their AI roadmap and influence strategic direction. Mid-week, you'll build and refine a generative AI demo using RAG architecture for automated drilling report summarization, sync with your account team to align on messaging, and brief specialist teams on complex workloads. You'll present Well-Architected reviews to the customer's cloud center of excellence, write competitive displacement patterns for peer Solutions Architects, participate in hiring debriefs, and lead community sessions to share reference architectures that scale beyond your direct delivery.

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their AI and cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. You'll work directly with a diverse top range of customers in UKI to help them make optimal technical decisions in their AI/ML journey, balancing innovation with practical constraints and compliance requirements. You'll have the opportunity to build enduring relationships with these organizations and establish yourself as a trusted technical advisor in the rapidly evolving field of Generative AI and Machine Learning.

Key job responsibilities
1. Technical Expertise & Solution Design: Provide customers with deep technical expertise in Generative AI and Machine Learning technologies, designing innovative solutions that help them meet strategic business objectives using AWS products

2. Customer Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to line of business, AI, Data, and C-suite leaders, translating complex technical concepts into business value and guiding their AI transformation journey

3. Technical Leadership: Lead architectural reviews, workshops, and proof-of-concepts to advance customers' technical objectives and validate proposed solutions

4. Thought Leadership: Share best practices through AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures, and helping to educate the broader technical community

5. Product Feedback & Innovation: Gather customer insights to inform AWS product teams about market needs and opportunities, contributing to the evolution of AWS GenAI/ML services based on real-world implementation experience

6. External Representation: Serve as a thought leader in the Generative AI space, representing AWS at industry events and conferences, such as AWS Summit and re:Invent

You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing machine learning solutions, including model training, deployment, and inference at scale, with working knowledge of AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, and scikit-learn. You have a background in a customer-facing technical role (solutions architect, ML engineer, data scientist, or technical consultant) and can communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including C-suite executives. You hold domain expertise in one or more of: natural language processing, computer vision, generative AI, recommendation systems, or conversational AI.

Ideally, you also have experience with large language models (LLMs), foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, or agentic AI architectures. Hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Q, or Amazon Rekognition is highly valued. Experience architecting end-to-end ML pipelines including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and production deployment (MLOps) would further strengthen your candidacy.

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, the Leadership Principle "Strive to be Earth's Best Employer" challenges us to create a safer, more productive, and higher performing environment, reinforcing that nothing is more important than the safety and well-being of our teams. At AWS Health and Safety, we take that challenge seriously. Our Programs team sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and people, driving the initiatives and standards that protect employees and partners across the globe. We believe that great safety outcomes are built on great programs, and we are looking for passionate, driven individuals who are ready to roll up their sleeves, collaborate across teams, and make a meaningful impact at scale.

The AWS Health and Safety (H&S) team is an expanding, dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer-facing enterprises and products.
