title: HR Business Partner, PXT
descriptionHtml:
Was wäre, wenn deine Arbeit den Alltag von Tausenden von Menschen positiv verändern könnte? Bei Amazon tut unser People eXperience and Technology (PXT) Team genau das — wir gestalten eine Arbeitskultur, in der sich jeder Mensch sicher, einbezogen und befähigt fühlt, sein Bestes zu geben.



Als HR Business Partner:in stehst du im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission. Dies ist eine praxisnahe Individual-Contributor-Rolle — ohne direkte Personalverantwortung — in der du in direkter Partnerschaft mit den Führungsteams deiner Standorte echten, sichtbaren Einfluss erzielst. Du überführst organisatorische Prioritäten in konkrete Maßnahmen, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und arbeitest Seite an Seite mit den Campus-Führungskräften, um das Mitarbeitererlebnis kontinuierlich zu verbessern.



Du verantwortest das End-to-End-Mitarbeitererlebnis an deinen Standorten: von Feedback-Mechanismen und Anerkennungsprogrammen bis hin zu Arbeitsplatzstandards, die Vertrauen schaffen, Engagement fördern und Leistung nachhaltig steigern. Diese Rolle ist standortbasiert und umfasst regelmäßige Mobilität zwischen mehreren Standorten innerhalb deines regionalen Campus.

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement

- Förderung einer offenen Zwei-Wege-Kommunikation zwischen Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften durch Instrumente wie Voice of the Associate, Rundtischgespräche und GEMBA-Walks

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Engagement-Strategien und Anerkennungsprogrammen, die Mitarbeitende spürbar wertschätzen

- Schaffung eines Umfelds, in dem sich alle Mitarbeitenden sicher, gehört und einbezogen fühlen

- Regelmäßige und sichtbare Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche — frühzeitige Anzeichen von Desengagement erkennen und aktiv darauf reagieren



Operational Excellence & Standortstandards

- Regelmäßige Standortbegehungen zur Bewertung der Arbeitsbedingungen und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Amazon-Standards

- Zusammenarbeit mit Standortleitungen und Safety-Teams, um Sicherheitsprogramme an deinen Standorten konsequent umzusetzen

- Leitung von Community-Initiativen an deinen Standorten in Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Netzwerk sowie den Teams für Public Policy und Public Relations

- Steigerung der Standorteffektivität durch die Identifikation systemischer Muster, Behebung von Ursachen und konsequente, faire Anwendung von Richtlinien



Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung & Technologie

- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um aufkommende Trends zu erkennen, Herausforderungen frühzeitig zu antizipieren und proaktive Lösungen umzusetzen

- Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen, KI-Tools und Self-Service-Plattformen — bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung eines persönlichen Service in entscheidenden Momenten



Strategische PXT-Führung

- Partnerschaft mit der Standortleitung, um operative Anforderungen mit Amazons Werten und Personalstrategie in Einklang zu bringen

- Coaching von Business Leaders zu effektiven Personalmanagement-Praktiken — einschließlich Leistungsfeedback, Teamentwicklung und Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen

- Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen durch Verstärkung von Botschaften, Abbau von Widerständen und Begleitung von Führungskräften bei der Übertragung von Veränderungen in lokale Routinen

- Umsetzung zentraler PXT-Prozesse unter Aufbau von Vertrauen und Einfluss durch fundiertes unternehmerisches Denken

A day in the life
Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen — und genau das macht diese Rolle so spannend. Dein Arbeitsalltag ist eine dynamische Mischung aus strategischem Denken und praktischer Problemlösung. Du nutzt fortgeschrittene Analysen und KI-gestützte Tools, um Trends zu erkennen, die Bedürfnisse deiner Standorte zu antizipieren und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die das Arbeitsplatzerlebnis wirklich verbessern.



Vom Coaching der Führungsteams bis hin zur Förderung von HR-Prozessexzellenz arbeitest du eng mit Field Leaders an operativen Zielen und der Effektivität des Teams zusammen. Du verbringst wertvolle Zeit auf der Betriebsfläche — baust Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen auf, führst Standortbegehungen durch, moderierst Mitarbeiter-Feedback-Runden und leitest strategische Initiativen, die nachhaltige Verbesserungen schaffen.



Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt von deiner Fähigkeit ab, organisatorische Dynamiken zu navigieren, Veränderungsinitiativen zu leiten und in unklaren Situationen fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Durch unternehmerisches Denken, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und starke Partnerschaften trägst du dazu bei, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich alle Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen.

About the team
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) ist das Team hinter der „letzten Meile“ — dem letzten Schritt, der Pakete in die Hände unserer Kundinnen und Kunden bringt. In Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferpartnern verbinden wir kreatives Denken mit kontinuierlicher Verbesserung, um täglich Millionen von Produkten zuzustellen. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten und gleichzeitig globale Lösungen für Konzepte wie Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants voranzutreiben.

Basic qualifications

- Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Arbeitsrechts
- Erfahrung im Personalwesen in einem internationalen, dynamischen und kundenorientierten Umfeld
- Erfahrung in einem Call Center, Distributionszentrum oder Produktionsumfeld
- Erfahrung in der Betreuung von gewerblichen Mitarbeitern
- Erfahrung mit MS Office-Tools und HR-Informationssystemen
- Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation

Preferred qualifications

- Master-Abschluss in Personalmanagement
- Erfahrung im Personalwesen in Unternehmen mit 250-500 oder mehr Mitarbeitern

title: Kierownik Obszaru / Kierownik Logistyki / Kierownik Magazynu - Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Dział operacyjny to serce firmy Amazon. Ten kluczowy segment naszej działalności zapewnia, że realizujemy i wysyłamy zamówienia w sposób efektywny, dzięki czemu nasi klienci otrzymują swoje zakupy na czas. Osoba na stanowisku Area Manager dokłada wszelkich starań, aby centrum logistyczne, w którym pracuje działało sprawnie, co pozwala nam wychodzić naprzeciw oczekiwaniom klientów. Kieruje zespołem, który troszczy się o zachowanie bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i wysokiej jakości naszych działań, a także podejmuje się realizacji wielu projektów w całej naszej sieci, mających na celu zwiększenie wydajności.

Key job responsibilities
- Tworzenie, nadzorowanie i promowanie kultury bezpieczeństwa i zadowolenia z pracy
- Analizowanie i wdrażanie modyfikacji w celu zapewnienia jakości i wydajności na stałym, wysokim poziomie
- Nadzorowanie projektów mających na celu usprawnienie procesów, optymalizację wydajności i podniesienie jakości usług dla klientów w obrębie swojego obszaru odpowiedzialności
- Analizowanie wydajności zmiany w stosunku do stosownych celów biznesowych i wprowadzanie działań mających na celu osiągnięcie doskonałości operacyjnej
- Współpraca z innymi managerami w celu standaryzacji procesów na zmianach

A day in the life


Osoba na tym stanowisku pracuje w systemie zmianowym w jednym z naszych centrów logistycznych, zapewniając jego najwyższą możliwą wydajność. Głównym zadaniem Area Managera jest kierowanie i napędzanie kultury bezpieczeństwa oraz utrzymywanie jakości i standardów wydajności na zmianach. Area Manager nadzoruje również usprawnienia procesów w swoim obszarze i napędza ich wdrażanie. Typowy dzień jest tutaj niezwykle zróżnicowany i obejmuje rozmaite czynności, od rutynowego zarządzania zespołem i codziennych obowiązków operacyjnych, po doskonalenie procesów i szeroko zakrojone zadania operacyjne w sytuacjach awaryjnych. Osoba ta jest również mentorem dla nowych managerów.

About the team
Centrum logistyczne to miejsce, w którym firma Amazon stawiała swoje pierwsze kroki. Ze skromnego zespołu sprzedawców książek przekształciło się ono w wysokorozwiniętą korporację o zasięgu ogólnoświatowym, która każdego dnia obsługuje ponad 1,5 miliona zamówień. Osoby pracujące w centrach logistycznych stanowią fundament naszej działalności, a ich wysiłki pomagają nam w ekspansji naszej firmy na nowe rejony oraz w rozszerzeniu wachlarza świadczonych przez nas usług. Korzystając z najnowszych technologii, stale poszukujemy sposobów na zwiększenie i udoskonalenie gamy oferowanych przez nas produktów – dostarczanych szybko i tanio.
Nasze zespoły w centrach logistycznych są pierwszym ogniwem w łańcuchu dostaw przyczyniającym się do realizacji zamówień klientów w tempie, z którego tak słyniemy. Pracujemy w centrach logistycznych, które stanowią serce prężnej sieci operacyjnej firmy Amazon i określane są niekiedy jako „pierwszy kilometr”, ponieważ to właśnie tutaj większość przesyłek rozpoczyna swoją podróż. Pomagamy również zarządzać dynamicznie zmieniającymi się składami magazynowymi i umożliwiamy realizację szybkich dostaw 24 godziny na dobę.
W naszych centrach logistycznych pracuje wiele różnych osób, bo oferujemy perspektywy dla osób o każdym poziomie umiejętności i wykształcenia. Niektórzy z nas zajmują się bezpośrednio towarami, inni analizują dane, pomagając wszystkim w firmie w podejmowaniu trafnych decyzji.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie wyższe
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w kierowaniu zespołem
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w komunikacji z szerokim gronem partnerów biznesowych, w tym ze współpracownikami i z przełożonymi
- Umiejętność wykorzystywania danych analitycznych i empirycznych do podejmowania decyzji i rozwiązywania problemów
- Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego i polskiego w mowie i piśmie

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, MADS
descriptionHtml:
Every day, advertisers and partners worldwide measure the success of their Amazon Ads campaigns through the data Programmatic Reporting delivers: billions of aggregated datapoints that AI agents, machine learning models, and analytics engines around the world now depend on as AI reshapes how advertising is planned and optimized. The Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) organization at Amazon Ads is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive the largest, most cross-cutting programs behind that data.

Programmatic Reporting owns Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, the interfaces advertisers and partners worldwide use to consume Amazon Ads measurement data. Behind them sit the pipelines that source, transform, and deliver that data, processing billions of aggregated datapoints on Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg, and AWS. Delivering this data accurately, freshly, and cost-efficiently requires programs that span multiple engineering teams, product management, and partner organizations across several sites and regions.

You take on the programs that don't yet have a shape, where the strategy is still forming, the right sequencing isn't obvious, and what success even looks like has to be defined before anything can be planned. You bring order to that ambiguity across the many engineering, product, science, and partner teams spread over multiple sites and regions, and you build the mechanisms that keep delivery predictable at that scale. The guidance, standards, and operating cadence for how these programs run are yours to shape. You operate with real technical depth: you read the designs, ask the sharp question in an architecture review, and, when the direction is wrong, you challenge the strategy, the architecture, or the way the organization is structured to deliver, and back it with a concrete alternative. You do this as a trusted advisor to the organization's senior leaders: you frame the decision, the tradeoff, and your recommendation for audiences that run from the working team all the way up to the organization's most senior leadership, and you help shape where they invest. And you run programs the way this team builds them: instrumented, automated, agent-assisted. Status, rollups, and dependency tracking largely assemble themselves, freeing your own hours for the judgment calls no tool can make. You influence without authority, and you make the teams around you, and yourself, faster.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery of the largest, most ambiguous cross-team programs across pipelines, query engines, APIs, and data integration, where the plan has to be created, not just followed.
- Partner with senior and principal engineers, product leaders, and senior leadership to shape strategy and roadmap in ambiguous spaces, defining what the plan should be, not just executing it.
- Build and sequence the program (scope, milestones, success criteria), and drive resolution of risks, blockers, and dependencies before they slip delivery.
- Establish the operating mechanisms, increasingly automated and agent-driven, that keep delivery predictable across sites and regions.
- Advise senior leaders on where to invest and on the org-wide mechanisms and structure needed to deliver at scale.
- Frame decisions and recommendations for audiences from the working team up to the most senior leaders, with a clear point of view and the data behind it.
- Drive technical tradeoffs across data freshness, accuracy, cost, and time-to-market, escalating crisply when alignment is needed.
- Coordinate launches and deprecations of reporting interfaces across engineering, GTM, partner, and solutions-architecture teams.
- Grow the next tier of leaders: mentor TPMs and engineers, raise the bar on delivery practice, and contribute to hiring and promotion decisions.

About the team
The Programmatic Reporting team builds the data interfaces that power how advertisers and partners measure their Amazon Ads outcomes. We own Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely data to advertisers and partners worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of data engineering and developer experience, and increasingly extends into GenAI-powered interfaces and data lake integrations.

We move fast, think in systems, and obsess over data quality. This role is a chance to take on challenging delivery problems with real room to build the guidance and mechanisms behind them. The team is based in Toronto and partners with teams across multiple sites.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

title: Senior UX Designer, Amazon Ads
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Ads Creative Experiences Design team is responsible for how advertisers create, manage, and optimize their campaigns across Amazon's advertising ecosystem. We are looking for a dynamic and innovative problem solver to join as a Sr. UX Designer who will work with a team of talented product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver best-in-class advertiser experiences. We need a highly motivated, creative, and passionate UX Designer to drive customer-focused advertising solutions that empower businesses of all sizes to reach their goals.

As a Sr. UX Designer on the Advertiser Experiences team, you should be comfortable prototyping and communicating design ideas at varying levels of fidelity. You have a solid understanding of how applications are built and use that knowledge to design solutions that are both desirable and feasible. You approach your craft with an AI-native mindset, actively integrating AI tools and capabilities into your research, ideation, and delivery process to move faster and raise the quality of your output. The ideal candidate will be able to visualize an experience in the abstract, break down complex use cases, and drive the vision into solid design deliverables.

You think first from the advertiser's perspective, use research and data to influence your designs, set relentlessly high standards for yourself, and deliver best-in-class experiences. You thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment and embrace the idea that failure is a critical part of innovation. You balance your passion for inspired, compelling, elegant yet simple designs with a highly analytical nature, precise execution, and a relentless drive to design, build, and deliver.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end UX design for one or more advertiser experience product areas, from concept through launch
• Translate complex advertising workflows and ambiguous problem spaces into clear, intuitive, and visually compelling designs
• Leverage business requirements, usability findings, and market research to develop scenarios, use cases, and requirements
• Adopt emerging AI capabilities into your design workflow to increase speed and quality of output
• Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups that communicate design intent
• Drive design decisions through user research, data analysis, usability testing, and industry best practices
• Build cross-functional relationships to promote collaboration and efficiency
• Contribute to and evolve the Advertiser Experiences design system for platform consistency
• Present design work and rationale to senior leadership, advocating for the advertiser experience
• Proactively manage your work queue, timelines, and expectations; communicate tradeoffs when needed

About the team
The Amazon Ads Creative Experiences Design team designs the experiences advertisers use to create and manage ad creatives. Our work spans AI-powered Creative Skills (image and video generation), agentic creative workflows, multi-format campaign builders, creative preview and optimization experiences. We define the AX vision for what every creative experience must address — and ship patterns that teams adopt at scale.

We value designers who own ambiguous problems end to end, define patterns that scale without them in the room, exercise backbone to protect the advertiser experience, and tie their work to measurable business outcomes.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience
- Experience with UX design of complex workflows
- Experience defining and maintaining design patterns and UX standards
- Experience in delivering design solutions for projects of large scope and complexity

Preferred qualifications

- Experience acquiring user data (e.g., conducting usability studies, performing user research) and creating personas and journey maps
- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)
- Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality design solutions

title: Principal Business Development Tech, APAC, Prime Video Ads
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Publisher Monetization（APM）は、Amazonが運営するストリーミングサービス（Prime Videoを含む）において、ブランドがオーディエンスにリーチするための広告ソリューションを開発・提供する組織です。Prime Video Adsは、映画・ドラマシリーズ・ライブスポーツ・オリジナル作品といったプレミアムかつブランドセーフなストリーミングTV広告枠を提供し、全世界で数億人の月間視聴者にリーチしています。広告事業が国内外で急速に拡大する中、アジア太平洋地域におけるストリーミングTV広告の未来を描く戦略リーダーチームの構築を進めています。

本ポジションでは、APAC地域（日本、オーストラリア/ニュージーランド、インド）におけるPrime Video Adsの広告事業成長戦略を一気通貫で担うPrincipalレベルのBusiness Development - Technologyリーダーを募集します。APAC地域の広告需要に対する戦略的ゼネラルマネージャーとして、新規広告主セグメント・新規市場への拡大を推進しながら、Prime Videoの収益成長を牽引します。新規ビジネス機会の発掘、既存広告チャネルのスケール拡大、複数年にわたる戦略策定の推進、そしてSales、Product、Finance、Marketingの各チームと連携したプロダクト戦略・プライシング・Go-to-Market戦略への提言が主な責務です。

Principalレベルのリーダーとして、APACの広告ポートフォリオ全体の戦略方針を策定し、ストリーミングTV広告市場のホワイトスペースや新興トレンドを特定し、シニアリーダーシップに対して投資フレームワークや長期的な需要戦略を提言していただきます。エグゼクティブレベルでのエージェンシー・ブランドとの折衝、プロダクトの商業化に関する議論、社内ビジネスレビューのいずれにおいても同等のレベルで活躍し、広告主の需要シグナルとAmazonの広告プロダクトエコシステムを繋ぐハブとして機能していただきます。

求める人材像としては、広告戦略、プロダクト商業化、クライアントリレーションシップマネジメントの交差領域に深い専門性を持つビジネスデベロップメントリーダーです。広告、メディア、またはストリーミング業界での10年以上の実務経験を有し、うちアジア太平洋地域での実績が相当程度あることを期待します。大規模な収益目標のオーナーシップを持ち、定量的なビジネス成果を創出してきた実績に加え、エージェンシーホールディングカンパニー、ブランド広告主、社内クロスファンクショナルチームなど、複雑なマルチステークホルダー環境を推進してきた経験を求めます。

Amazon Publisher Monetization (APM) is responsible for developing and delivering advertising solutions that enable brands to reach audiences across Amazon's owned and operated streaming properties, including Prime Video. Prime Video Ads offers premium, brand-safe streaming TV inventory across movies, series, live sports, and originals, reaching hundreds of millions of monthly viewers globally. As our advertising business continues to scale rapidly in new and existing international markets, we are building a team of strategic leaders who will shape the future of streaming TV advertising in the Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking a Principal Business Development - Technology leader to own the end-to-end advertising growth strategy for Prime Video Ads across APAC (Japan, Australia/New Zealand, and India). This individual will serve as the strategic general manager for the region's advertising demand, leading expansion into new advertiser segments and markets while driving revenue growth for Prime Video. They will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, scaling existing advertiser channels, leading multi-year strategic planning efforts, and influencing product, pricing, and go-to-market strategies in collaboration with Sales, Product, Finance, and Marketing teams.

As a principal-level leader, you will set the strategic direction for APAC's advertising portfolio, identify whitespace opportunities and emerging trends in the streaming TV advertising market, and influence senior leadership on investment frameworks and long-term demand strategy. You will operate with equal fluency across executive-level agency and brand engagements, product commercialization discussions, and internal business reviews, serving as the connective tissue between advertiser demand signals and Amazon's advertising product ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned business development leader with deep expertise at the intersection of advertising strategy, product commercialization, and client relationship management. They bring 10+ years of progressive experience in advertising, media, or streaming, with significant time spent in markets across the Asia-Pacific region. They have a demonstrated track record of owning revenue outcomes at scale, driving measurable business results, and navigating complex multi-stakeholder environments involving agency holding companies, brand advertisers, and cross-functional internal teams.

Key job responsibilities
- 日本、オーストラリア/ニュージーランド、インドにおけるPrime Video Adsの需要戦略を、2〜3年の計画視野で一気通貫でオーナーシップを持つ
- Sales、Product、Finance、Engineeringの各チームのステークホルダーと緊密に連携しながら、広告主の需要創出、プロダクト導入促進、収益の多角化に焦点を当てたビジネスプランを策定・実行する
- 新たな業種や顧客セグメントへの広告主基盤の拡大戦略を特定・実行し、ポートフォリオの集中リスクを低減しながら、持続可能な長期収益基盤を構築する
- 市場セグメンテーション、広告主インサイト、競合インテリジェンスに基づきビジネスゴールを定義し、導入状況をトラッキングしセールスの実行を最適化するための仕組みを構築する
- 新たな広告プロダクトの商業化をリードし、ProductチームおよびSalesチームと連携してプライシング、パッケージング、Go-to-Market戦略を策定する
- APAC地域全体において、エージェンシーホールディングカンパニーやブランド広告主とのエグゼクティブレベルのリレーションシップを構築・維持し、戦略プランニングの場においてPrime Video Adsのサブジェクトマターエキスパートとしての役割を担う
- 広告主からのフィードバック、競合動向、業界トレンドなどのシグナルを統合・分析し、Productロードマップの優先順位付けに反映するとともに、組織の投資判断に影響を与える
- Sales、Marketing、Product、Programの各チームと連携し、広告主のニーズへの対応、プロダクトの改善、成長を阻害する商業的・オペレーショナルな障壁の解消をクロスファンクショナルにリードする
- ビジネスレビュー、戦略プランニング資料、複数年フォーキャスト、セグメント別ディープダイブを作成し、シニアリーダーシップにプレゼンテーションを行う
- 広告主の獲得・維持、マルチプロダクト導入、収益の質を向上させるための主要ビジネスメトリクスを定義・分析する
- APAC地域の主要な業界イベントや戦略的な広告主エンゲージメントにおいて、Prime Video Adsを代表する


- Own end-to-end demand strategy for Prime Video Ads across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, and India, with a 2 to 3 year planning horizon
- Develop and execute business plans focused on advertiser demand generation, product adoption, and revenue diversification, working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Product, Finance, and Engineering teams
- Identify and implement strategies to expand the advertiser base into new verticals and customer segments, reducing portfolio concentration and building sustainable long-term revenue streams
- Define business goals based on market segmentation, advertiser insights, and competitive intelligence, then establish mechanisms to track adoption and optimize sales execution
- Lead product commercialization for new advertising capabilities, including defining pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies in partnership with Product and Sales teams
- Build and maintain executive-level relationships with agency holding companies and brand advertisers across the region, serving as the Prime Video Ads subject matter expert in strategic planning conversations
- Synthesize signals across advertiser feedback, competitive dynamics, and industry trends to inform Product roadmap priorities and influence organizational investment decisions
- Lead cross-functional collaboration to address advertiser needs, refine product offerings, and resolve commercial or operational barriers to growth in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Program teams
- Prepare and present business reviews, strategic planning documents, multi-year forecasts, and segment deep dives to senior leadership
- Define and analyze key business metrics to drive advertiser acquisition, retention, multi-product adoption, and revenue quality
- Represent Prime Video Ads at key industry events and in strategic advertiser engagements across the region

A day in the life
このポジションでは、APAC地域におけるPrime Video Adsの複数年にわたる成長戦略の策定と実行に注力します。日常業務としては、地域のビジネスヘルスメトリクスをレビューして差異や新たなトレンドを特定すること、エージェンシーやブランドのリーダーとの戦略的な対話を通じて市場ニーズを把握すること、そしてSalesチームやProductチームとクロスファンクショナルに連携して広告主の成長を阻害する障壁を解消することが含まれます。広告主のセグメンテーションデータや競合動向の分析に時間を費やし、その後、戦略的な提言、ロードマップの優先順位、収益パフォーマンスを伝えるリーダーシップレビュー向けの資料作成に取り組みます。新たな広告プロダクトの商業化をリードし、ProductチームやFinanceチームと連携してプライシングやパッケージング戦略を策定します。また、シニアセールスリーダーシップと直接連携し、地域の優先事項のアラインメントを図り、エージェンシーのプランニングサイクルにおいてPrime Video Adsが効果的にポジショニングされるようにします。本ポジションでは、複数のタイムゾーンや広告市場の成熟度が異なるマーケットを横断して活動することに抵抗がないことが求められます。

In this role, you will focus on developing and executing the multi-year growth strategy for Prime Video Ads across APAC. A typical day includes reviewing regional business health metrics to identify variances and emerging trends, engaging in strategic conversations with agency and brand leaders to understand market needs, and partnering cross-functionally with Sales and Product teams to resolve barriers to advertiser growth. You will spend time analyzing advertiser segmentation data and competitive dynamics, then shift to preparing materials for leadership reviews that communicate strategic recommendations, roadmap priorities, and revenue performance. You will lead commercialization efforts for new advertising products, working with Product and Finance teams to define pricing and packaging strategies. You will also work directly with senior Sales leadership to align on regional priorities and ensure Prime Video Ads is positioned effectively in agency planning cycles. The role requires comfort operating across multiple time zones and markets with different levels of advertising maturity.

About the team
私たちは、Amazon Publisher Monetization内の戦略チームであり、Prime Videoの広告事業における将来の需要を形作ることに注力しています。私たちのBDT組織は、戦略インテリジェンスおよび需要形成のレイヤーとして機能し、新たなビジネス機会の特定、プロダクト導入の推進、そして複数年にわたる収益成長を実現するための商業戦略の構築を担っています。Sales、Product、Marketing、Finance、Engineeringと緊密に連携し、広告主と視聴者の双方に意義のある成果をもたらす広告ソリューションを市場に届けています。チームはAmericas、EMEA、APACをカバーしており、各リーダーがそれぞれの担当地域ポートフォリオにオーナーシップを持ちながら、グローバルイニシアチブにも貢献しています。

We are a strategic team within Amazon Publisher Monetization focused on shaping the future demand for Prime Video's advertising business. Our BDT organization operates as a strategic intelligence and demand-shaping layer that identifies emerging opportunities, drives product adoption, and builds the commercial strategies that unlock multi-year revenue growth. We partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering to bring advertising solutions to market that deliver meaningful results for advertisers and viewers alike. The team covers Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with each leader owning a defined regional portfolio and contributing to global initiatives.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Experience leading advertising revenue strategy or demand generation for a video streaming, OTT, or connected TV platform, with a demonstrated track record of scaling monetization in Japan market.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience as a founder or executive focused on related segments, or as a practice leader or business unit owner

title: Sr. UX Researcher Mixed Methods, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company - which starts with Customer Service (CS). We are seeking a Senior UX Researcher to re-imagine Amazon's suite of Voice of Customer products (VoC), which are critical for analyzing customer feedback, identifying trends, and driving proactive solutions across Amazon. Our VoC products are used by teams globally across Amazon to identify and eliminate product and service defects, making it a crucial platform for improving customer experience worldwide. Your ability to synthesize complex research findings, metrics, and business requirements into clear design narratives will be crucial for building alignment and driving change. This role is crucial in shaping how Amazon understands and responds to customer needs at scale. Success requires both creative problem-solving and strategic communication to drive meaningful improvements to the customer experience.

As a Senior UX Researcher for the Voice of Customer product space, you will plan and execute a research roadmap to inform the vision VoC tools that leverage the latest machine learning and AI capabilities to help analyze customer feedback patterns, identify emerging issues, and drive proactive solutions. You will produce insights to develop best-in-class experiences (including user interface designs, user flows, interaction models, and lightweight prototypes) in a fast-paced, startup-like environment. Working closely with product management, engineering, and the UX team, you'll take projects from early-stage concepts to launch. You are a pragmatic researcher who can translate complex data into actionable insights that serve diverse internal users, from business analysts to senior leadership.

This role will be responsible for designing and conducting generative and evaluative user research on next-generation experiences for customer service contact handling. This team is looking for an experienced UX Researcher with a deep understanding of design research methods and how to apply them during the product development cycle. The candidate should have demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing a research roadmap based on organizational needs, and designing, running, and communicating user research to the design team, product, tech, and leadership. The candidate should understand that collaborative work, and both giving and getting feedback early and often, leads to the best work outcomes. They will work closely with the studio's team of researchers who partner with other customer service verticals, with designers and product managers within their vertical, and content designers to solve highly ambiguous and multi-faceted problems. This role includes the intellectual challenge of simplifying highly technical problems in elegantly simple ways that can make customer interactions effortless and intuitive.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner closely with design and product teams to understand blockers, prioritize multiple stakeholders' needs, and build a research road path
- Communicate and refresh plans on a regular basis to ensure relevancy
- Identify the best qualitative methods based on research questions, timelines, and resourcing
- Define and execute (and, when necessary, invent) research methods appropriate to the questions at hand, including, but not limited to, interviews, observations, surveys, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations
- Synthesize primary and secondary data types and perform quick yet thorough analyses, leading to focused, insightful, and actionable findings
- Build upon existing research/frameworks that other team members have conducted

A day in the life
In this role, you will be responsible for driving and implementing research strategies. You will interact daily with team members to understand and guide research needs, both defined and undefined. You will be required to work with minimal direction and be capable of working quickly while delivering high-quality outputs. You will work on overlapping projects, which requires the ability to multi-task and juggle competing priorities. The right candidate will have a deep understanding of user research methods and best practices, a nimble, creative, and pragmatic approach, while pushing the boundaries of agile research.

About the team
The team you will be working with is very supportive and understands that growing as a studio means growing as individuals. There are ample opportunities to learn new skills and expand your scope. The studio has a culture that encourages speaking openly and candidly when issues arise. The team works well together and makes time for relationship building - a good sense of humor is always appreciated.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of proven success leading User Research projects with demonstrated impact experience
- 5+ years of hands-on work with: field research, ethnography, lab-based user testing, remote testing, paper prototype testing, iterative prototype testing, concept testing, and survey design experience
- Bachelor's degree in HCDE, Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field
- Experience in leading User Research projects with demonstrated impact
- Experience with field research, ethnography, lab-based user testing, remote testing, paper prototype testing, iterative prototype testing, concept testing, and survey design
- Experience with all aspects of research (study design, recruiting, moderation, analysis, reporting)
- Experience with behavioral data collection, quantitative data analysis, and statistics
- Have a portfolio demonstrating past work experience and deliverables (e.g., study plans, reports, personas)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Human Factors, HCDE, Cognitive Psychology or equivalent
- Experience in a technical field (software development, network development, IT, other related)
- Experience with UX Research in non-US markets
- Experience working in a highly Agile/Scrum environment

title: Facility Operations Center (FOC) Engineer, Facility Operations Center
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive on solving real-time problems that keep critical infrastructure running? As an Operations Technology II engineer within the Facility Operations Center (FOC), you will remotely monitor data center power and cooling systems across the globe, acting as the first line of response when alarms fire. Your analysis and quick decision-making directly protect the availability of AWS Data Centers and the millions of customers who depend on them. If you enjoy working with complex mechanical and electrical systems in a fast-paced environment and want to grow your technical expertise, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Analyze alarm monitoring systems in real time, identify abnormal conditions, and execute established escalation processes to protect data center availability.
- Review work requests submitted by field technicians for compliance with safety and operational standards, ensuring work is authorized before execution.

A day in the life
Your shift begins with a handoff briefing and a review of active alarms and open tickets from the prior watch. Throughout the day you monitor dashboards covering power, cooling, and fire-protection systems, triaging alerts and coordinating remotely with onsite engineers. Between alarm events you review incoming work requests for compliance, document findings, and collaborate with teammates to refine response procedures. The FOC operates on a follow-the-sun model, so your fixed daytime schedule supports 24/7 coverage without overnight shifts.

About the team
The Facility Operations Center is the command center for AWS Data Center operations, providing continuous global monitoring 24/7/365 through a follow-the-sun model. Our work is guided by three pillars: Safety, Security, and Availability. We are an inclusive team that values collaboration, clear communication, and a shared commitment to keeping AWS infrastructure reliable for customers worldwide. If you want to make a tangible impact on cloud reliability at a global scale, the FOC is the place to do it.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Neuron, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to be part of AI revolution? At Amazon our vision is to make deep learning pervasive for everyday developers and to democratize access to AI hardware and software infrastructure. In order to deliver on that vision, we’ve created innovative software and hardware solutions that make it possible. AWS Neuron is the SDK that optimizes the performance of complex ML models executed on AWS Inferentia and Trainium, our custom chips designed to accelerate deep-learning workloads.

This role is for a software engineer in the Compiler team for AWS Neuron. As part of this role, you will be responsible for building next generation Neuron compiler which transforms ML models written in ML frameworks (e.g, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX) to be deployed AWS Inferentia and Trainium based servers in the Amazon cloud. You will be responsible for solving hard compiler optimization problems to achieve optimum performance for variety of ML model families including massive scale large language models like Llama, Deepseek, and beyond as well as stable diffusion, vision transformers and multi-model models. You will be required to understand how these models work inside-out to make informed decisions on how to best coax the compiler to generate optimal implementation instruction. You will leverage your technical communications skill to partner with internal and external customers/stakeholders and will be involved in pre-silicon design, bringing new products/features to market, ultimately, making Neuron compiler highly performant and easy-to-use.

Experience in object-oriented languages like C++/Java is a must, experience with compilers or building ML models using ML frameworks on accelerators (e.g., GPUs) is preferred but not required.

Experience with technologies like OpenXLA, StableHLO, MLIR will be added bonus!

Explore the product and our history! https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-guide/neuron-cc/index
htmlhttps://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

Key job responsibilities
You will design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform Neuron compiler’s performance, stability and user-interface. You will work side by side with chip architects, runtime/OS engineers, scientists and ML Apps teams to seamlessly deploy state of the art ML models from our customers on AWS accelerators with optimal cost/performance benefits. You will have opportunity to work with open-source software (e.g., StableHLO, OpenXLA, MLIR) to pioneer optimizing advanced ML workloads on AWS software and hardware. You will also work on building innovative features that will deliver best possible experiences for our customers – developers across the globe.

A day in the life
As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in compiler architecture, you’ll create compiler optimization and verification passes, build features surface features and peculiarities of AWS accelerators to developers, implement tools to analyze numerical errors, and resolve the root cause of compiler defects. You’ll also participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal (other Neuron SDK and Amazon wide teams) and external stakeholders (open-source communities). Lastly, work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

About the team
About the Team

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at Amazon, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of experience writing production grade code in object-oriented languages such as C++/Java.
- Experience in compiler design for CPU/GPU/Vector engines/ML-accelerators.
- Experience with OpenSource compiler toolset like LLVM/MLIR.
- Experience with the following technologies: PyTorch, OpenXLA, StableHLO, JAX, TVM, deep learning models, and algorithms.

title: Automation Planning Manager, NA Automation Deployment Planning
descriptionHtml:
NA Last Mile Automation Planning team is seeking a qualified Automation Planning Manager to join the NA Automation Deployment Planning team within Worldwide Engineering & Innovation (WWEI). This team is responsible for the planning, deployment coordination, and implementation tracking of automation programs across AMZL, RSR, and SSD delivery station networks including ADTA (Auto Divert to Aisle) new launch and retrofits, Mechlite conveyance installations, and new innovation deployment planning.

In this role, the individual will have direct responsibility for managing site-level deployment timelines and project execution for assigned automation programs and regions. The Automation Planning Manager will serve as the central coordinator between a multitude of stakeholders including Entitlements,) Pre-Construction, Construction, Start-Up Execution, Design Engineering, WHS, Capacity Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and automation vendors. This role calls for an individual who over-indexes on ownership to de-conflict multiple competing projects at each site and drive timely delivery of automation milestones.
This role’s scope necessitates the ability to solve ambiguous issues, provide effective solutions to gaps between teams, processes and systems, and maintain clear line-of-sight into site-level schedules that feed network-wide automation deployment goals.


Key job responsibilities
• Manage site-level project timelines for automation deployments for automation innovation programs across assigned vendors and programs, ensuring alignment between design, construction, equipment delivery, and site readiness milestones.
• Serve as the single-threaded planning owner for assigned sites, coordinating across Entitlements, Pre-Construction, Construction, Start-Up Execution, Design Engineering, WHS, Capacity Engineering, Supply Chain and Operations.
• Track and escalate vendor/integrator dependencies, material delivery timelines, and FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) schedules to ensure on-time deployment.
• Solve complex problems that pose risk to project delivery and key milestones through inquisitive deep dives with stakeholder Subject Matter Expert (SME) input.
• Compile, manage, and report on weekly project metrics including deployment pulse checks, site readiness status, and permitting progress.
• Support the Daily/Weekly Program Calls by providing site-level status updates and escalation items.
• Clearly communicate project issues and risks to senior leaders in writing and via in-person/remote meetings.
• Assist in the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to improve deployment planning efficiency and cross-team handoffs.
• Identify opportunities to reduce spend in assigned regions through analysis of available assets, business needs, and returns on investment.
• Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, including OP planning cycles and network optimization deadlines.
• Up to 10% travel required.


A day in the life
Your day starts with a quick scan of overnight vendor updates and site status changes, then moves into the Daily Automation Call where you provide deployment updates for your assigned sites. Throughout the day, you coordinate across Construction, Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Startup Execution, Capacity Planning, and assigned vendor teams to resolve permitting questions, track equipment shipments, and unblock site readiness milestones. title: Revenue Cycle Consultant, Healthcare Finance Operations
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Healthcare Finance Operations Services as a Revenue Cycle Defect Analyst focused on identifying, documenting, and validating revenue cycle defects that impact financial performance. In this role, you will serve as a critical individual contributor responsible for defining defects within billing, collections, cash application, and denial management processes. You will hypothesize about potential defects, design and execute experiments to prove their existence and impact, and package findings into structured defect analyses that enable technology and operations teams to implement solutions.

Through data-driven analysis and manual review, you will identify patterns among aged receivables, analyze billing and cash receipts reports, and surface trends that contribute to revenue leakage, claim denials, and operational inefficiencies. You will leverage your knowledge of AI-assisted analytics and statistical methods to strengthen the rigor of your findings, ensuring that each defect paper provides clear evidence, quantified impact, and actionable root cause analysis.

The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare revenue cycle expertise, demonstrates exceptional analytical capabilities, possesses an eye for detail and process improvement, and has a proven ability to translate complex data into clear, evidence-based documentation. Experience with statistical methods, AI-enabled tools, and a passion for experimentation are highly valued.

The Finance Operations organization works with every part of Amazon to provide procure-to-pay, revenue-to-receipt, real-estate and facilities, operations accounting and operations excellence services with the highest level of controllership at the lowest cost to the company. We provide the backbone systems and operational processes which completely, accurately, and validly pay Amazon's suppliers, invoice our customers and report financial results. Amazon is quickly building the Finance Operations capabilities in the healthcare industry by creating the Healthcare Finance Operations Services.


Key job responsibilities
In this analytical role, you will identify and investigate revenue cycle defects across billing, collections, cash application, and denial management processes. Your primary focus will be discovering issues through data analysis, forming hypotheses about root causes, and running targeted experiments to validate your findings before packaging them into structured documentation for stakeholder action.

- Analyze coding, charge capture, billing, cash receipts, and accounts receivable reports and activities to identify defects, anomalies, and trends that impact revenue, cash flow, and operational efficiency
- Hypothesize about potential defects based on observed patterns, denial trends, and system behaviors, then design and execute experiments (through analytics or manual review) to prove or disprove defect existence and quantify impact
- Package validated defects into structured defect analyses that clearly articulate the problem, evidence, root cause analysis, quantified financial impact, and recommended resolution path for technology and operations stakeholders
- Leverage AI-enabled tools and awareness of emerging AI/ML capabilities to enhance defect detection, automate pattern recognition, and improve the speed and accuracy of analytical workflows
- Apply statistical methods and experimental design principles to ensure rigor in defect validation, including appropriate sampling, significance testing, and data-driven conclusions
- Identify trends and categories among aged receivables, denial patterns, and payer behaviors; provide clear, actionable feedback to stakeholders to improve results and prevent recurrence
- Identify trends and develop insights that ultimately reduce cost and improve revenue lift
- Analyze workflow and operational procedures to identify opportunities for improved reimbursement; document findings and present recommendations to leadership
- Produce clear, well-structured technical writing including defect analyses, root cause analyses, and process documentation that effectively communicates complex findings and processes to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Coordinate cross-functionally to analyze data drivers, develop comprehensive insights, and present clear, actionable findings to key stakeholders including technology teams, operations, and finance
- Contribute to the evaluation of AI initiatives and explore how automation, machine learning, and robotic process automation (RPA) can enhance defect detection and resolution workflows

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 3+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience within registration, scheduling, billing, cash collection, cash application, or denial management/follow-up
- Medical billing experience with an understanding of healthcare reimbursement processes, third-party payer guidelines, and compliance requirements
- Demonstrated ability to analyze processes and information, identify problems and trends, and develop effective solutions and strategies
- Strong technical writing skills with the ability to clearly document findings, articulate complex issues, and communicate effectively in written form to diverse stakeholders
- Ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, and exhibit problem-solving skills with an exceptional eye for detail

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience in a hospital or physician provider setting
- Coursework or applied experience in statistics, experimental design, or quantitative research methods
- Professional certifications such as CPC (Certified Professional Coder) or CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
- Awareness of AI/ML tools and their application to data analysis, pattern recognition, and process automation in revenue cycle contexts
- Experience writing structured analyses, research papers, or technical documentation that translates complex findings for diverse audiences
- Extensive knowledge of critical business processes including Coding, Charge Capture, Billing, Collections, Cash Application, Dispute and Denial Management
- Knowledge of system interfaces with Accounts Receivable and experience identifying incomplete or inaccurate data and determining root causes
- Experience creating process improvements through analysis and automation
- Experience with electronic health record systems and clearinghouse platforms

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Deployment Planner to join our growing Planning and Implementation team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The team responsibilities involve scoping and planning interdependent capacity scaling projects and new network capacity deployments across several data center locations. They will review project forecasts and assure physical infrastructure resources are available for their execution.

The Network Deployment Planner will work closely with infrastructure supply chain & procurement, network engineering and technical program managers to plan and deliver customer capacity to the local data center installation & deployment technicians to facilitate smooth capacity execution.

The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.

This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.

descriptionHtml:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? We apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world problems that delight our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet.

Amazon Robotics (AR) is located in the greater Boston area, the epicenter of robotics innovation. Our diverse team of engineers come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots and mechatronic systems. Having our offices, labs, test floors and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in robotic movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive data, and much more.

We operate across multiple manufacturing sites, working cross-functionally with engineering, supply chain, and operations teams globally to deliver high-quality robotic systems at the pace innovation demands.

The Process Engineer will be responsible for the development, installation, validation, and optimization of complex manufacturing processes and systems used to produce robotics. descriptionHtml:
Amazon Freight, a key pillar within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Account Management team. You will serve as the primary operational partner for Amazon Freight's largest enterprise shippers, owning the customer relationship, identifying systemic issues that impact their experience, and coordinating cross functional teams to drive resolution.



Key job responsibilities
• Own the enterprise customer operational relationship across all freight modes (TL, IMDL, LTL), serving as the single threaded point of contact for your accounts' operational points of contact

title: Sr Data Solutions Architect, Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of data with us! Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a senior, experienced, and motivated Data Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA) to help our Strategic Accounts customers architect the next generation of data platforms that power agentic AI and advanced analytics workloads. You should possess a unique balance of deep technical expertise in modern data technologies, business acumen, and exceptional interpersonal skills. In this role, you will partner with our most valuable customers to design enterprise-wide data strategies that connect siloed data across organizations in secure, scalable, and innovative ways using AWS, partner, and open-source data technologies.

You will make a significant impact working directly with customer executives, forming trusted relationships as you help them define and execute their data modernization roadmaps.
You will collaborate with AWS service teams to influence product direction and advocate for new features and capabilities based on Strategic Accounts needs. Our customers are industry leaders, and if you have what it takes to guide these critical accounts through complex data transformation initiatives, AWS wants to talk to you.

The ability to bridge database, storage, analytics, and artificial intelligence technologies is essential for the Data SSA function. You should demonstrate strategic thinking about business challenges in the Agentic AI era and articulate technical solutions to address them. As a trusted customer advocate, you will develop comprehensive data technology strategies for our largest Strategic Accounts customers operating in complex, multi-faceted environments. You will interface with customer leadership to build relationships and enable them as data strategy champions. You will guide customers in designing advanced cloud-based data architectures, implementing innovative technologies across AWS services (including Amazon RDS, Aurora, Redshift, Athena, EMR, Glue, Kinesis, MSK), partner solutions (Snowflake, Databricks), and open-source frameworks (Spark, Flink, Trino), while adopting the best cloud practices for databases, storage, and analytics services. You will share your successes and learnings with the broader AWS SA community.

title: Security Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. We are looking for a Security Engineer to join the FDE security team and help secure production AI systems deployed in customer environments.

You will conduct security reviews, write security tooling, perform threat modeling, and implement controls that protect AI systems built by FDE engineers. You work alongside FDE delivery pods in customer environments, getting hands-on with production code, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML pipelines. You learn fast, ship fast, and build security into the system rather than bolting it on after the fact.

This is a hands-on security engineering role where you spend most of your time writing code, reviewing architectures, and testing systems. You work with senior security engineers who will mentor you, but you own real security deliverables from your first engagement. If you want to learn AI security by doing it, in production, at enterprise scale, this is the role.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.


Key job responsibilities
- Conduct security design reviews, code reviews, and architecture assessments for production AI systems (agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, orchestration layers, model integrations) under guidance from senior security engineers
- Perform threat modeling and penetration testing for AI/ML applications deployed in customer environments; identify vulnerabilities and work with FDE engineers to implement fixes before production release
- Build and maintain security automation: scanning tools, CI/CD security gates, guardrail testing scripts, secrets detection, and dependency vulnerability checks for forward-deployed AI systems
- Implement security controls for AI-specific threats: prompt injection prevention, output filtering, data isolation, model API endpoint hardening, and guardrail configuration
- Support security incident response for FDE-delivered production AI systems; assist with triage, root cause analysis, and remediation under senior engineer guidance
- Document security findings, patterns, and remediation guidance as reusable playbooks and runbooks that benefit future FDE engagements
- Contribute to the FDE security accelerator library: reusable modules, templates, and reference configurations that help FDE engineers build secure AI systems faster
- Requires up to 25% travel

A day in the life
You start the morning running your automated security scan against a new Bedrock-powered application an FDE pod shipped overnight, triaging the findings and filing issues for two real vulnerabilities. Mid-morning you pair with an FDE engineer to fix an IAM policy that's overly permissive for their multi-agent orchestration system. After lunch you're writing a Python script that automates guardrail bypass testing for the team's standard deployment pattern. You close out the day joining a threat modeling session led by a senior security engineer, where you learn how to assess data flow risks in a customer's RAG pipeline. Every week you're working on a different AI architecture, building skills you can't get anywhere else.

About the team
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to build production AI systems. AWS invested $1B in this initiative. We move at the speed of the customer: demonstrating ROI in weeks, not quarters. We are customer-obsessed. We lead customers toward outcomes, build together, and leave behind scalable patterns. Security is our enabling function: without it, nothing goes to production. Our culture is people-first, anti-burnout, bold, and engineering-excellence-driven.

title: Senior S&OP Planner, AWS S&OP Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of technical infrastructure program managers, software engineers, data specialists, supply chain specialists, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for planning and execution while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) designs, delivers, and operates the global data-center fleet that powers every AWS service. Our servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling assets in more than 245 countries and territories. We tackle some of the world’s most complex supply-chain problems so our customers can innovate without limits.

The Senior S&OP Planner leads the AIS Demand & S&OP team inside the CDSA (Capacity Delivery, Supportability & Analytics) organization. You will own the 0-2 year server-material Demand Plan of Record (POR) as well as transition plan for assigned server platforms. Your charter is to keep demand, supply, and financial plans in lock-step while building the automation and mechanisms that let AWS scale its GenAI and Core infrastructure faster, cheaper, and more sustainably. Success requires exceptional judgment, a builder’s mindset, and the ability to influence at all levels—from front-line planners to VP- and SVP-level business owners.



Key job responsibilities
- Own the global S&OP cycle – Drive an end-to-end, monthly/quarterly cadence that aligns AWS demand signals with supply, power, and capital plans.

- Deliver a trusted demand signal – Produce a single source of truth that reconciles financial plans, sales & growth outlooks, NPI roadmaps, transition ramps, and prior POR commitments.

- Run executive planning forums – Frame one-way vs. two-way-door decisions, articulate trade-offs, and secure leadership alignment across AIS, EC2, S3, EBS, Finance, and Energy.

- Architect planning systems – Guide software teams in automating demand-, supply-, and scenario-planning workflows (e.g., Connect, o9, Infor, Manhattan); own interim manual mechanisms until automation is in place.

- Build decision frameworks – Develop constrained-planning models that surface risks and levers under power, permitting, or component shortages.

- Measure what matters – Define KPIs and dashboards that quantify forecast accuracy, inventory turns, build-plan adherence, and capacity-delivery cycle time.

- Champion continuous improvement – Sponsor digital-transformation sprints that simplify processes, eliminate waste, and raise planning maturity across AIS.

descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE-I, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.

Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and intern/co-ops should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.

Please note that by applying to this role you would be considered for Software Development Engineer summer intern and spring/fall co-op roles on various Robotics teams. You will be able to provide your preference of location and start date during the application process but, we cannot guarantee that we can meet your selection based on several factors including but not limited to the availability and business needs of this role. Finalization on the location and start dates available will be provided to you at the time of job offer.


Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
• Design and develop scalable solutions using cloud-native architectures and microservices in a large distributed computing environment.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.
• Build and maintain resilient distributed systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective.
• Leverage and contribute to the development of GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.
• Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
• Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.
• Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
• Design, develop and test software components that interact with fulfillment center technologies, such as robotics, material handling equipment, computer vision, and cloud services.


A day in the life
As an SDE intern/co-op, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns/co-ops throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship/co-op, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

descriptionHtml:
