AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Technician, you are a primary resolver for your support team, and are skilled at troubleshooting one or more operating systems. You are able to troubleshoot and solve all but the most complex infrastructure issues. Issues are escalated to the appropriate resolver groups when necessary. You create and maintain documentation on technologies you support and are able to convey SOPs to junior staff. You understand all aspects of the equipment you support. You know how to innovate and make decisions on his/her own, but also know how to take direction when it is given, paying attention to all details involved.

You are able to execute small projects on your own and work with your manager in planning and executing larger local projects. You act as an escalation point for junior technicians. You understand all aspects of the equipment you support.

Position may include rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day/night work weeks, and may change based on the needs of the business. Travel may be required up to 10% of the time. This position will fill an opening at one of multiple separate sites.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma, or A+ or CND (Certified Network Defender) or Network+ or Security+
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
- Knowledge of hardware platforms
- 1+ years of computer networking experience, or experience in computer networking

title: Logistics Specialist, Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

Amazon is seeking a logistics professional for our Amazon Web Services Team in the Aurora, CO area.

Logistics Specialists will perform operations across three key areas: Warehousing, Transportation, and Data Centers. This role involves monitoring inventory levels and conducting cycle counts to ensure adequate stock is available for build and repair activities. Process inbound and outbound shipments, manage Inventory Management Systems, and oversee chain-of-custody processes for our customers.

A Logistics Specialist will operate both independently and within team settings. They will expedite processes, triage, and resolve logistical issues as they arise. Additionally, the role includes transporting parts between locations using sprinter vans, trucks, or various powered equipment such as forklifts or electric pallet jacks.

Specialists should be comfortable and willing to regularly drive a variety of motorized vehicles, including box trucks up to 26' in length. Due to interstate operating authority commerce regulations, candidates must be at least 21 years or older. Candidate must hold a valid state-appropriate driver’s license, be able to obtain their Driver Qualification File (DQF) and or a Commercial Driver’s License (CDL). Candidate must obtain & maintain a DOT Med Card and be eligible to drive in accordance with Department of Transportation (DOT) requirements.

This position involves frequent lifting, pushing, and pulling of materials and products. Logistics Specialists will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company. They must also maintain the cleanliness, organization, and safety of all work spaces.

Preferred candidates will have experience working in a warehouse or distribution environment, as well as experience and knowledge of reverse logistics processes. This future Amazonian must possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, commitment to Operational Excellence, and adhere to strict safety standards.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Receive parts, maintain inventory, and check-out parts as needed to Data Center Technicians and Engineers
- Load and unload shipments and transport parts, racks, and equipment between different locations, including localized driving of a variety of transportation vehicles
- Attend company provided fork lift operator training
- Complete company provided training in driving box trucks up to 26’ in length
- Handle sensitive/classified materials
- Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts
- Occasionally work is in an office environment
- Work overtime as required

Perform the following tasks:
- Lift loads of up to 40 pounds and carry them for short distances
- Participate in group lifts of 41 pounds or more
- Frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in a noisy environment
- Stand, sit, and walk for prolonged periods of time
- Occasionally be exposed to temperatures between 40 and 90 degrees, and will occasionally exceed 90 degrees

title: PhD Economics Intern – Structural IO, Summer 2027
locations: New York City, NY, United States
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Economics is seeking Structural IO Economist (STRUC) Interns who are passionate about applying structural econometric methods to solve real-world business challenges. STRUC economists specialize in the econometric analysis of models that involve the estimation of fundamental preferences and strategic effects. In this full-time internship (40 hours per week, with hourly compensation), you'll work with large-scale datasets to model strategic decision-making and inform business optimization, gaining hands-on experience that's directly applicable to dissertation writing and future career placement.

By applying to this role, you are automatically being considered for all our available STRUC internships in 2027.

Key job responsibilities
As a STRUC Economist Intern, you'll specialize in structural econometric analysis to estimate fundamental preferences and strategic effects in complex business environments. Your responsibilities include:
- Analyze large-scale datasets using structural econometric techniques to solve complex business challenges
- Applying discrete choice models and methods, including logistic regression family models (such as BLP, nested logit) and models with alternative distributional assumptions
- Utilizing advanced structural methods including dynamic models of customer or firm decisions over time, applied game theory (entry and exit of firms), auction models, and labor market models
- Building datasets and performing data analysis at scale
- Collaborating with economists, scientists, and business leaders to develop data-driven insights and strategic recommendations
- Tackling diverse challenges including pricing analysis, competition modeling, strategic behavior estimation, contract design, and marketing strategy optimization
- Helping business partners formalize and estimate business objectives to drive optimal decision-making and customer value
- Build and refine comprehensive datasets for in-depth structural economic analysis
- Present complex analytical findings to business leaders and stakeholders

Basic qualifications

- 3rd year or greater PhD student in Economics or related field

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of data analysis languages (e.g., R, Stata, Python, etc.) or other statistical software

title: Software Development Engineer II , Amazon Fulfillment Technologies - Inbound
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) Inbound builds the systems that move inventory into Amazon's fulfillment network at massive scale. We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II with deep data engineering expertise to independently own the large-scale data infrastructure that powers intelligent decision-making across the inbound supply chain. You'll design and build the batch and streaming pipelines, data models, and processing systems that turn petabytes of raw supply-chain data into reliable, well-governed datasets. You'll partner closely with Applied and Research Scientists to feed and productionize Machine Learning (ML) systems, and you'll raise the engineering bar for how the team builds and operates data at scale.

Key job responsibilities
• Independently design, build, and operate scalable, reliable data pipelines (batch and streaming) that ingest, transform, and serve large volumes of supply-chain data.
• Own data modeling, data warehousing, and the design of curated datasets that serve analytics, reporting, and Machine Learning (ML) use cases.
• Build and maintain feature engineering pipelines and feature stores that supply ML models with high-quality, low-latency data.
• Lead design reviews and make sound technical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and operational complexity for your area of ownership.
• Own data quality, lineage, and observability across the datasets, pipelines, and services you build, and drive systemic improvements to reliability.
• Partner with Applied and Research Scientists to operationalize ML workflows, including feature delivery, training data preparation, and model-scoring pipelines.
• Deliver robust, well-tested, production-quality software and drive engineering best practices (code reviews, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), monitoring, operational excellence).
• Diagnose and resolve complex production and data issues; participate in on-call and reduce operational load through automation.
• Mentor SDE I and early-career engineers and influence the technical roadmap for the team's data platform.


About the team
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) Inbound builds the software and science that move inventory into Amazon's fulfillment network — from the moment a supplier ships product to the point it's received, stowed, and ready to fulfill customer orders. Operating at the scale of billions of units across a global network of fulfillment centers, our team owns the data infrastructure and intelligent systems that make inbound flow faster, more accurate, and more cost-efficient. We work at the intersection of large-scale data engineering and applied Machine Learning (ML), partnering closely with Applied and Research Scientists to turn petabytes of supply-chain data into decisions that ship every day. If you're excited by hard distributed-systems problems, real-world scale, and building the data foundations that power automation and optimization across Amazon's supply chain, you'll find a high-ownership, high-impact home here.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building complex software systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Strong Python proficiency and experience with SQL at scale
- Experience building and owning batch and streaming data pipelines in production environments
- Experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hive, Presto, or similar distributed computing frameworks)
- Experience building data models and ETL/ELT pipelines that serve both analytics/reporting and ML workloads (feature engineering, preprocessing, training data management)
- Experience collaborating with science or ML teams to take models from prototype to production (training data preparation, feature delivery, model-scoring pipelines)
- Experience with data quality, validation, or observability practices for production datasets
- Experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools (e.g., Amazon Q Developer, Copilot, Kiro, or similar) to accelerate software delivery
- Solid software engineering fundamentals (testing, CI/CD, code review, production operations)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience deploying ML models to production environments
- Experience designing and optimizing large-scale data architectures (data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouse patterns)
- Experience with MLOps tooling (SageMaker Pipelines, Step Functions, MLflow, or similar) for operationalizing model training, scoring, and deployment workflows
- Experience partnering cross-team with SDEs to design and ship ML-integrated services or systems
- Experience using agentic workflows to generate, test, and iterate on code, infrastructure, or pipeline components at scale
- Experience with prompt engineering and LLM APIs
- Experience with ML evaluation frameworks (especially for generative AI / LLM outputs)
- Experience with data lineage, cataloging, and observability tooling at scale
- Experience with streaming data processing (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink)
- Experience with data orchestration tools (Airflow, Step Functions, AWS Glue workflows)
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform)
- Experience building metrics and reporting infrastructure consumed by business stakeholders
- Background in supply-chain, logistics, fulfillment, or operational environments

title: Construction Estimator, AMER Estimating and Cost Control
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Our Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD) organization builds and scales the infrastructure that powers AWS. We are seeking a Construction Estimator specializing in mechanical scope to join the newly formed AMER Estimating and Cost Control (ECC) organization as a discipline subject matter expert.

This is a technical individual contributor role. You will provide blue-badge, bottoms-up mechanical estimating capability for AWS data center construction across AMER and even globally in collaboration with EMEA and APJC Regional Estimating functions. Your focus spans the full mechanical scope of a data center — chilled water and cooling systems, CRAHs/CRACs and air handling, pumps and piping, chillers and cooling towers, refrigerant and liquid-cooling systems, plumbing, and the mechanical content of controls and commissioning packages.

You will collaborate globally with estimating teams across all AWS regions on BOD cost inputs that inform design standards. When Design Engineering introduces a mechanical design change or innovation, you are the first call — delivering rapid, discipline-specific cost impact assessments that enable informed decisions. This role is foundational to ECC’s mission of creating a structured feedback loop between estimate and actual, so estimates improve every cycle.


Key job responsibilities
- Produce detailed, bottoms-up mechanical construction cost estimates — chilled water and cooling systems, CRAHs/CRACs, air handling, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, piping, liquid-cooling, and plumbing
- Collaborate globally with regional estimating teams on Basis of Design (BOD) mechanical cost inputs that - Deliver rapid cost impact assessments for mechanical PDCM intercepts, first-of-kind designs, and innovation proposals from Design Engineering
- Support new regions planning with mechanical estimates for market entry — pre-Cost Breakdown Structure cost intelligence where local pricing data is thin
- Perform detailed mechanical quantity takeoff and pricing from flow diagrams, equipment schedules, specifications, and design documents at all design stages
- Develop and maintain the mechanical cost database — unit rates, $/ton and $/MW parametric models, and equipment pricing reflecting current market conditions and AWS standards
- Serve as the mechanical estimating SME for Estimating Managers, reviewing and validating 3P vendor mechanical estimates
- Analyze mechanical subcontractor pricing, bid tabulations, and awarded contracts to identify trends, anomalies, and cost optimization opportunities
- Benchmark mechanical estimates against portfolio actuals through the estimate-to-actual feedback loop with Cost Control
- Contribute to estimating tools and templates, incorporating lessons learned from completed projects into improved mechanical estimating methodologies


A day in the life
Your morning begins with a quantity takeoff on a Design intercept from Design Engineering — a proposed cooling system change (e.g., a shift in liquid-cooling approach) that could reduce installed cost but adds complexity. You model the delta against the current BOD mechanical estimate and prepare a cost impact memo for DE’s design review.

Midday, you join a global call with mechanical estimating counterparts in EMEA and APJC to align on BOD mechanical cost inputs — chilled-water $/ton, CRAH pricing, and piping unit rates — for the next design standard revision. Your AMER actuals are the benchmark. Afterward, an Estimating Manager asks you to gut-check a 3P vendor’s mechanical estimate; you spot a piping and pump-sizing assumption that doesn’t match the latest flow diagrams and flag it.

You close the day updating your mechanical cost database with final account data — a chiller package landed 6% above estimate in a competitive-bid market. You document the driver and adjust unit rates for the next round of estimates.


About the team
AMER Estimating and Cost Control (ECC) is a newly formed organization within DCPD that unifies Estimating and Cost Control under a single leader. ECC provides end-to-end cost lifecycle ownership — from initial estimate through final account.

You will be one of several Discipline Estimators (Electrical, Mechanical, CSA) working alongside the Estimating Managers who cover cluster groups across AMER, all reporting to the Manager, Construction Estimating (Chief Estimator Equivalent). Estimating provides the inputs — methodology, rates, benchmarks, discipline takeoffs, and 3P vendor products — that support Preconstruction’s owned estimates and CAR deliverables. Your electrical expertise directly supports both project-level estimating and global design standard development.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
- 5+ years of experience in mechanical/HVAC construction cost estimating for commercial, industrial, or infrastructure projects
- Demonstrated experience with detailed mechanical quantity takeoff and pricing from flow diagrams, equipment schedules, and specifications
- Strong knowledge of chilled-water and cooling systems, air handling, chillers, pumps, piping, and mechanical installation practices

title: Senior Manager, Software Development, Prime Video Commerce Tech
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer acts on - every subscription, rental, purchase, and renewal - is the moment they pay, powered by a set of world-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.

We are the Prime Video Payments team: the voice of the customer at the point of purchase and the engine of Prime Video's global growth. We define, design and deliver payment experiences for our customers WW, across devices. We are also at the forefront of AI innovation - reimagining how customers interact with our commerce surfaces, and how intelligence removes friction from payments to acquire, engage, and retain more customers.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Software Development Manager on the Prime Video Offers team, you will:
- Own a major pillar of the commerce platform end-to-end. You'll lead large engineering teams of 10+ engineers each, responsible for critical services and customer journeys that determine what every Prime Video customer can buy, rent, or subscribe to - and at what price. You own the architecture, the delivery, the operations, and the customer experience.
- Drive a multi-year architectural transformation. You'll own key pieces of this transformation, making decisions that shape how the system works for years to come.
- You will lead and drive conversations across multiple Amazon businesses on driving Prime Video's Payments strategy; and own goals of highest visibility.
- Build and scale high-performing engineering teams. You'll hire, develop, and retain senior engineering talent. You'll grow engineering managers into stronger technical leaders, and develop senior engineering leaders toward Principal readiness. You'll create a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and customer obsession.
- Set the bar for customer health and operational health. Our services are on the critical path for every PV transaction. You'll own customer-facing reliability first - ensuring customers never see a broken experience - and drive operational excellence through monitorability, availability targets, cost efficiency, and mechanisms that scale.
- Partner across organizations to deliver at scale. The work requires deep collaboration across Amazon businesses. You'll represent your pillar in executive leadership forums, negotiate priorities, and drive alignment on shared interfaces and dependencies.
- Balance execution with strategic investment. You'll deliver on high-visibility goals while simultaneously investing in the architectural improvements that make future delivery faster. You'll make the trade-offs and communicate them clearly.


A day in the life
You might start the day reviewing customer health metrics and operational dashboards, then move into a technical design review for a new cross-product capability. After lunch, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and VP+ leadership, making trade-off decisions on what to prioritize. Later, you're coaching an engineering manager through a difficult people situation, then joining a team celebration for a successful launch. You end the day connecting with your teams over activities that build site strength and community locally.

About the team
We are the Prime Video Commerce Payments team in Bengaluru - engineers across all levels and managers who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We're proud of what we've built, and we're just getting started.
We are a worldwide team, and we operate like one. That means working across time zones with genuine empathy - understanding that your counterpart in Seattle or London has a life outside of work, just as you do, and that great collaboration doesn't require anyone to sacrifice their personal time.
Inclusivity isn't a value we list on a slide - it's how we work. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard, regardless of level, background, or tenure.

If you are looking to work in a space that directly impacts how your friends and family interact with Prime Video, this role is for you.

title: Sr. Satellite Hardware Engineer, Bus Structures
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Amazon Leo is building a next-generation satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity around the world. Success requires engineers who can think beyond individual components and understand how every subsystem comes together to form a reliable spacecraft.

As a Spacecraft Hardware Engineer on the Bus Structures team, you will help define the physical architecture of our spacecraft. Working across Mechanical, Electrical, Thermal, RF, Propulsion, Manufacturing, Test, and Systems Engineering, you will develop structural solutions that integrate every subsystem into a cohesive, manufacturable, and flight-ready vehicle.

This role combines structural design with spacecraft integration. You will evaluate complex engineering tradeoffs involving structural performance, manufacturability, thermal interfaces, assembly, transportation, testing, launch vehicle integration, and on-orbit operations to ensure the spacecraft performs as an optimized system rather than a collection of individual subsystems.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop spacecraft structural hardware and vehicle architectures.
- Integrate multiple spacecraft subsystems into a cohesive mechanical design.
- Perform engineering trade studies balancing structural performance, manufacturability, mass, cost, schedule, and integration requirements.
- Develop detailed mechanical designs from concept through production.
- Collaborate across Mechanical, Electrical, Thermal, RF, Manufacturing, and Systems Engineering.
- Support structural analysis, qualification testing, manufacturing, and launch integration activities.
- Resolve hardware issues through root cause analysis and engineering problem solving.
- Contribute to the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) release process and configuration of flight hardware.

A day in the life
As a Spacecraft Hardware Engineer, you'll spend your day solving multidisciplinary engineering problems that span the entire spacecraft. One meeting may focus on integrating a new propulsion component into the vehicle, while the next evaluates structural changes needed to improve manufacturability or simplify assembly. You'll participate in design reviews, develop structural concepts, support qualification testing, work with manufacturing teams, and collaborate with engineers across nearly every technical discipline. Every decision contributes to building a spacecraft that is structurally sound, manufacturable, launchable, and ready for years of successful operation in orbit.

About the team
The Bus Structures team is responsible for the physical realization of the spacecraft. Beyond designing the primary and secondary structure, we develop the overall vehicle architecture and ensure every subsystem integrates into a cohesive spacecraft. We provide the system-level perspective necessary to balance structural performance, thermal performance, RF accommodations, manufacturability, assembly, transportation, launch vehicle integration, testability, and operational success.

As the primary vehicle integration authority, our team works across every engineering discipline to optimize the spacecraft as a complete system rather than individual subsystems. We also own the final mechanical configuration through the Product Lifecycle Management release process, ensuring the vehicle definition remains consistent throughout development and production.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- Experience in the design of complex mechanical products and equipment at volume
- Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects
- Experience with CAD tools and engineering documentation.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing aerospace, spacecraft, defense, automotive, or other highly integrated hardware systems.
- Experience with structural analysis, finite element analysis, or mechanical testing.
- Experience with product integration, systems engineering, or multidisciplinary design trade studies.
- Experience supporting hardware through qualification, manufacturing, and production.
- Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and engineering change processes.
- Experience balancing competing technical requirements across multiple engineering disciplines.
- Understanding of mechanical design fundamentals, structural analysis, materials, and manufacturing processes.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

You will be the recognized data authority for the organization, owning the long-term view of our BI architecture and how it fits together across systems, and setting the standard for how insights are produced, trusted, and acted upon.

You'll operate in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, working with limited guidance alongside product managers, engineers, and operations leaders. You will not just build dashboards, you will shape the analytics strategy for the org, decide where to invest, and lead large initiatives that require the coordinated work of multiple data professionals.

The Problems You'll Solve

Our supply chain generates massive amounts of data, but data alone doesn't drive change, insights do. You'll take on the intrinsically hard, undefined problems: Where are the systemic bottlenecks slowing content delivery, and what is the root cause across the pipeline rather than the symptom? Which partner workflows need to be re-architected? How do we predict and prevent supply chain issues before they impact customers?

You will own the data lineage end to end, developing deep understanding of and influence over the technical systems that generate the data, how metrics are aggregated, and how the resulting business intelligence is consumed, interpreted, and acted upon by the business. When problems are pervasive or persistent, you drive them to root cause, and your fixes may unblock related teams across the organization.

What Makes This Role Different

You'll be a strategic partner and a key influencer in team strategy, shaping how Prime Video manages relationships with content partners and optimizes the entire supply chain. You will anticipate, and where appropriate influence, stakeholders' future requirements rather than react to them. You will show good judgment making trade-offs between team investment (prioritization, data retention policy, infrastructure cost) and business need, and you will only advocate for new BI solutions when they are genuinely necessary.

Your work directly influences how quickly and efficiently we bring content to millions of viewers worldwide, and you will ensure the team is stronger because of your presence but does not require your presence to succeed.

Key job responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of BI solutions in complex and/or ambiguous problem areas, taking the long-term view of how each solution fits the team's architecture and lifecycle, and proactively fixing architecture deficiencies
Own and influence data lineage across the organization, from how data is generated through how metrics are aggregated to how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon
Lead large, multi-person BI projects: decompose them into parallel workstreams for yourself and other data professionals, and reassemble the work into a cohesive, successful launch
Drive BI engineering best practices and set standards for the org (operational excellence, code reviews, syntax and naming conventions, metric definitions, alarms); ensure solutions are accurate, timely, accessible, and actionable
Build inventive, robust, scalable, and extensible data pipelines, data models, and dashboards from multi-dimensional datasets that others can easily maintain and build upon
Resolve the root cause of pervasive or persistent problems, influencing decisions across teams and building consensus to find and drive the best path forward
Understand and articulate the capabilities and limitations of the systems you work with (e.g., cluster size, concurrent users, data classification) to both technical and non-technical audiences, clarifying what is possible today versus what requires technology investment
Build fast prototypes using Amazon AI tools (Kiro, Claude CLI, QuickSuite) and translate them into production-grade data products, selecting optimal tools by balancing speed, efficiency, and scalability
Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders verbally and in writing, and influence their decisions and future requirements

About the team
We are part of the central Product and Data Team within the Partner Experience & Supply Chain organization at Prime Video. Our structure and scope is a hybrid model where we collaborate closely with our tech teams to build data products that solve problems affecting PV customers and our internal stakeholders.

We optimize the supply chain and deliver the highest standard of video streaming content to our customers. Our team is the trusted analytical powerhouse that drives unified data solutions, making Prime Video the preferred entertainment destination for customers worldwide.

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
- 8+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
- 5+ years of SQL experience
- 4+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
- 4+ years of developing automated reporting experience
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
- Prior experience with AWS services across data storage, querying, transformation, and visualization (QuickSight, Redshift, Athena, S3, Glue, Lambda)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- 1+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
- Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining

- Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets

title: Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) Engineer, AWS
descriptionHtml:
G'day! You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?

You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.

Your Opportunity

Imagine being the calm, decisive voice at the centre of one of the world's most advanced data centre operations. As a Facilities Operations Centre (FOC) leader, you'll stand at the nexus of physical infrastructure and digital innovation - the person who ensures Australia's most critical cloud infrastructure never misses a beat.

You're building something from the ground up - a newly developed 24x7 Facilities Operations Centre that will become the nerve centre for data centre operations across the region. Every Large Scale Event, every Critical Site Event, every electrical and mechanical system pulse flows through your team.

Benefits
- Learning & development - AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
- Health, income protection and life cover - Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you
- Military differential pay launching in Australia - Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving
- Employee Assistance Program - Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family - mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
- Family-building benefit - Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching
- Amazon Extras & employee discount - cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Key job responsibilities
You'll be the operational heartbeat of our data centre infrastructure - the person who transforms real-time data into decisive action and ensures our customers experience nothing but seamless, uninterrupted service.

Your days will be defined by impact. You'll monitor the full spectrum of our facilities infrastructure platform, reading the signals that others miss and acting before issues become incidents. When the unexpected strikes - and in a 24x7 environment, it will - you'll be the point of contact that internal and external teams turn to for clarity, coordination, and calm leadership.

But you're not just responding to events; you're preventing them. You'll contribute to outage post-mortem analysis, turning every incident into an opportunity to strengthen our systems. You'll develop communication and escalation protocols that sharpen your team's response times and elevate performance across the board. You'll build and refine the tools that give your team a technological edge.

When emergency recovery efforts demand coordination across multiple teams and time zones, you'll be the person who brings order to complexity - ensuring the right people have the right information at the right time. Your meticulous attention to record-keeping will create the institutional knowledge that makes your team stronger with every passing day.

Perhaps most importantly, you'll grow this team to a standard of operational excellence that sets the benchmark for the industry. You'll mentor, develop, and inspire the next generation of operations professionals who will carry this mission forward.

This is shift work in a 24x7 environment, including weekends and holidays - because the infrastructure never sleeps, and neither does your commitment to protecting it.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of construction or project management, or 1+ years of electrical or mechanical engineering experience
- 2+ years of data center engineering or operations experience

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience with computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- 3+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

title: Senior Specialist Solutions Architect, Security, APJC Customer Security
descriptionHtml:
Help Japan’s enterprises secure their entire estate — across AWS, other clouds, on-premises, and endpoints.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Security Solutions Architect to join our Japan field security team. You will operate as part of a Market Development Unit (MDU) paired with a Security Sales Specialist, working together to help customers across Japan adopt AWS security services and ISV partner integrations to protect workloads wherever they run.

This is a pre-sales role with deep technical substance. Your Security Sales partner drives pipeline and commercial engagement; you provide the technical depth to shape solutions and close. Day-to-day, this means running technical workshops, building proof-of-value engagements, crafting architectures that map to real customer environments, and demonstrating how AWS security services — anchored by Security Hub — solve production security challenges across hybrid and multi-cloud estates.

We are looking for someone from a pre-sales or product background who has spent time positioning and demonstrating security products to customers. You understand what makes a technical win convert to adoption and can speak credibly about cloud security architectures. You are comfortable prototyping within customer environments: standing up a proof-of-value, configuring a service against real data, and iterating on the spot. You are equally at ease discussing risk posture with a CISO as you are whiteboarding a GuardDuty + Security Hub architecture with a security engineering team.

Experience positioning security tooling in competitive or multi-vendor environments is a strong signal. Familiarity with the broader security ecosystem — SIEM, EDR, CNAPP, CSPM — and how AWS services integrate with or replace those capabilities will serve you well. Deep AWS experience is not required at entry; we can teach the services. What we need is someone who can run a room, prototype under pressure, and turn a technical conversation into a customer outcome.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with a Security Sales Specialist to drive adoption of AWS security services among Japanese enterprise customers. Run proof-of-value engagements that convert to production deployments and help customers consolidate fragmented security tooling onto AWS native and ISV partner capabilities.
- Design and recommend security architectures that span AWS, other clouds, on-premises data centres, and endpoint fleets. Meet customers where they are, leveraging Security Hub Extended and partner integrations to provide unified visibility and protection.
- Collaborate with ISV partners to position the right combination of AWS native and partner capabilities for each customer’s environment and security requirements.
- Build lasting customer relationships as a trusted security advisor. Balance immediate security improvements with long-term security objectives, working within each customer’s business risk appetite.
- Develop and share reference architectures, best practices, blog posts, and other content that scales security knowledge across customers and the broader field community.
- Feed customer voices back to AWS product teams through feature requests and direct engagement. Stay current with industry trends and advocate for action when AWS should respond.
- Work in coordination with account teams — sales representatives, generalist SAs, and other specialists — to deliver a unified customer experience.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing a proof-of-value deployment you configured last week for a financial services customer — Security Hub aggregating findings across their AWS accounts, Azure subscriptions, and on-prem endpoints via a partner integration. The results are compelling and you prepare a summary for the follow-up call with their CISO.

Mid-morning, you join your Security Sales partner for a first meeting with a manufacturing customer exploring cloud security consolidation. They currently run separate SIEM, EDR, and CSPM tools across three environments. You whiteboard an architecture showing how Security Hub Extended, GuardDuty, and an ISV partner can replace two of those tools while improving coverage. The customer’s security engineering team pushes back on a specific detection gap — you take a note and commit to prototyping a solution back at the AWS office before the next session.

After lunch, you run a technical workshop for a retail customer’s cloud team on threat detection patterns using GuardDuty and EventBridge. You close the day by drafting a blog post on a multi-cloud security architecture pattern you’ve seen work across several customers, and reviewing a product feature request you’re submitting based on feedback from this week’s engagements.

No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you are the technical half of a partnership that helps Japan’s enterprises secure their entire estate on AWS.

You understand that a successful program needs to solve meaningful problems for our customers, for our business, and for our technology. You will work with engineers, designers, and our business teams to build a global marketplace product that expedites Amazon’s expansion worldwide.

title: 運行調達・物量管理スペシャリスト（輸送オペレーションセンター担当）, Relay Operation Center, Ops-Capacity Procurement
descriptionHtml:
Amazonで配送する数百万点の貨物の出荷物量を自身で制御してみませんか？
Amazon Transportation Services(ATS)部門の輸送オペレーションセンターでは、年間数億にのぼる商品を、お客様とお約束したお届け日時を正確に守るため、幹線輸送ネットワークを管理・運営しております。
お客様との約束通り商品を適時お届けすることは、当社サービスの基盤となっていますが、ECの普及などに伴い、物流・小売業界環境は変化し、競争が激化する一方で、国内の物流需要と供給のバランスは厳しさを増しています。
このような中で、サービス品質の向上は不可欠な課題となっています。
今回、全国規模の倉庫と配送拠点を結ぶ幹線物流の管理運営部門であるRelay Operation Center(ROC)のうち、キャパシティコントロールについてオペレーション・業務改善を行うOps-Capacity Procurement（OCP）メンバーを募集いたします。
Ops-Capacity Procurement（OCP）チームは、ROCの中において幹線輸送の発注、キャパシティコントロール、緊急増便におけるオペレーションプロセスを確立、正確性を担保しお客様の信頼を維持しながらコストを最小化し、Amazonに収益性をもたらす役割を担っています。

今回募集する物量管理スペシャリストは、Amazonの貨物に対する集車率を増加させ、Network全体での配送物量最大化を目的としています。具体的には発注された台数に対して適切なキャパシティコントロールを行い、お客様へのお届け予定日のお約束を守る事と出荷物量の最大化を両立するために、Last mile Teamと連携して業務フローの整理・実行を行います。
全国規模のネットワークを俯瞰的かつ最適な視点から業務を管理頂ける方を募集いたします。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Quick Sight - Structured Data Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Quick is a decision intelligence service for the AI era. Today, thousands of enterprises and millions of users rely on Quick to connect their data, generate insights, and turn decisions into action — whether through interactive dashboards, embedded analytics woven into the products their customers use, natural language experiences that let any knowledge worker ask a question and get an answer they can act on immediately or fully managed tools that they can build and deploy for their stakeholders. 1000s of ISVs and SaaS companies have already built Quick into the fabric of their applications, powering experiences for millions of end users who benefit from intelligent, data-driven products. That is the kind of reach we operate at — and we are just getting started.

We are now at an inflection point. The convergence of structured data analytics, natural language interfaces, and agentic AI is rewriting the rules of what a decision intelligence service can do — not just for analysts, but for every knowledge worker in an enterprise. Quick sits at the center of this shift. We're building the service that lets an enterprise analyst build a governed dashboard in minutes, an ISV embed AI-powered analytics into their product with a few API calls, and a business leader ask a question in plain English and receive an insight they can turn into action before the day is over. The same service. The same governed data. One experience that scales from a single user to an entire organization — unlocking productivity, surfacing new opportunities, and accelerating businesses that are powered by data.

We are hiring a product leader for structured data analytics product team to own critical parts of this journey. This role spans some of the most consequential product areas in cloud analytics and decision intelligence today:

The data and intelligence foundation — how enterprises bring structured and unstructured data together under a unified semantic and governance layer that powers both BI reporting and AI-driven insights that turn into action.
Embedding and ISV enablement — how thousands of companies build differentiated, analytics-rich products on top of Quick's capabilities, and how we make that experience so seamless it becomes the default choice for every builder.
Business model and growth strategy — how we design packaging, pricing, and adoption pathways that make it effortless for customers to start, experiment, and scale with us — turning first deployments into enterprise-wide commitments.

What unites these roles is a shared profile: a deeply technical product leader who is equal parts strategist and practitioner. Someone who can see the three-year arc of a market and then roll up their sleeves to ship the next release. Someone who works backward from the customer's deployment — not from a requirements document — and who measures their own success by whether the customer succeeded. Someone who sees a nascent, fast-growing business not as a risk but as a canvas.

Quick is a business that is growing, evolving, and actively being shaped by the people on this team. You will have a direct and visible thumbprint on a service that is becoming the decision intelligence layer for enterprises and AI-powered products alike. The decisions you make — about what we build, how we package it, who we build it for, and how we bring it to market — will define how thousands of organizations and millions of knowledge workers experience data, make decisions, and take action in the age of AI.

If you are a builder who gets energy from ambiguity, who thinks in systems but ships in increments, and who wants to be at the frontier of where decision intelligence meets artificial intelligence — we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive product delivery in deep partnership with engineering, applied science, and design. Drive product specifications, make crisp tradeoff decisions, and ensure high bar on the quality and user experience
- Be hands-on with the technology. Whether that means understanding how a semantic model resolves a natural language query, how an embedded analytics SDK integrates into a partner's React app, or how a pricing SKU flows through AWS billing — you operate at the level of detail where real product decisions are made.
- Own broad customer journeys from first contact through enterprise-wide adoption for critical engagement. Partner with GTM and Sales teams to design onboarding pathways, migration playbooks, and growth motions that reduce friction, accelerate time-to-value, and turn successful deployments into organization-wide productivity gains.
- Engage directly with enterprise customers, ISV partners, and AWS field teams. Turn what you hear into product conviction — not just feature requests, but insight into where the market is moving and what customers will need before they know to ask for it.
- Directly contribute to business outcomes — adoption, revenue, competitive win rates, customer retention. Use data relentlessly to prioritize, to make the case for investment, and to communicate progress to senior leadership.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing customer adoption metrics and operational dashboards, then shift into a working session with engineering and design partners to refine an upcoming feature launch. After lunch, you could be authoring a technical white paper or preparing a strategic narrative for leadership review. Later, you may lead a session with C-suite Data and AI executives on how their enterprise data can be turned into business outcomes using AWS analytics. Throughout it all, you bring clarity to tough trade-offs and ensure every stakeholder has the context they need.

About the team
Our team is focused on building and evolving externally facing services that empower businesses of all sizes to succeed. We operate with a strong sense of ownership and collaborate closely with science, research, engineering, design, marketing, and sales partners to deliver AI powered products that customers love and see how they can accelerate business value. We value decisiveness, curiosity, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to raising the bar for one another while being deeply technical and obsess about working backwards from customer problems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)
- 7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
- 5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- * Experience building AI powered analytics and large data solutions preferably in a SaaS, PaaS product.
- * Experience with SaaS pricing for ML/AI powered products

title: Snr Manager Design Engineering - India, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
As the Senior Manager, Design Engineering - India, at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL), you'll play an integral role in our engineering leadership team. A highly effective group of architects and structural, civil, mechanical, electrical and controls engineers. This team is responsible for continuously innovating on behalf of our customers whilst delivering the highest quality engineering solutions for our capacity delivery projects. You will have a direct hand in project outcomes. You'll shape design direction and improve design delivery across all India projects. You'll also set the design procedures and protocols for developing future systems.

You'll work with many parts of the AWS organisation, with external engineering partners, with permitting and regulatory bodies. You'll also engage the wider community in India on technical matters relating to data center development. That means bringing an AWS engineering view to industry bodies and forums, standards and building code committees, and policymakers.

Amazon's data centers are industry-leading examples of innovation in sustainability, energy efficiency, resiliency and cost-effectiveness. We're known for our speed to market and reliability. This role sits within the team responsible for the design of critical data center facilities in India. Our design team is at the forefront of creating and delivering innovative products. It's a diverse, upbeat group that is changing the face of cloud computing.

We continue to grow and are looking for team members who can support our speed to market, raise the bar and want to keep growing professionally. Amazon's work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. We give strong support to continuous learning and employee development.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Leading a multidisciplinary team of engineers in the design of critical data center infrastructure systems across India.
Chairing weekly design meetings with internal engineering teams, internal customers and external consultants to resolve design issues, keep design milestones on track and escalate where needed.
Driving process improvements across design delivery.
Creating and tracking metrics on the cost, quality and duration of design. This includes collecting data from construction and commissioning teams as designs are implemented, so lessons learned feed back into future designs.
Establishing capital project design budgets, contributing to complex business cases for existing and new AWS Region deployments in India, and working with AWS Finance to secure project funding.
Working with AWS engineering leads to schedule engineering resources and influence design changes based on internal customer needs.
Partnering with internal customers to establish project scope, schedule and deliverables.
Engaging the wider community in India - industry bodies and forums, standards and building code committees, and government and regulatory agencies - on technical matters relating to data center development, in partnership with AWS Public Policy.
Owning design document control, including the document controller's workflow and audits of deliverables.


Key job responsibilities
Leading a team of engineers/architect in the design of data center critical infrastructure systems in India • Facilitating weekly meetings with internal stakeholders, external consultants, permitting authorities and community stakeholders to address design issues, meet design milestones and escalate as needed. • Driving process improvements. • Creating and tracking metrics related to cost, quality and duration of design as well as collecting data from construction and commissioning teams as designs are implemented. • Establishing capital project design budgets and contributing to complex business cases for existing region and new region deployment in India. • Collaborating with AWS finance teams to secure funding for projects. • Working in partnership with AWS Engineering leads to schedule engineering resources and influence design changes based on internal customer needs. • Partnering with internal customers to establish project scope, schedule and deliverables. • Managing document controller’s workflow and audit of deliverables • Lead weekly staff and project readiness meetings with stakeholder teams; • Drive best practices on the team, deal with ambiguity and competing objectives, and proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks; • Use creativity, good judgment and significant innovation in evaluating, simplify and developing project procedures including document control, tracking project metrics and inter-team information dependencies; • Identify continuous improvement strategies focused on variety of project phases including real estate due diligence, planning, design, permitting and construction; • Engage with an experienced engineering discipline leads, influencing roadmaps, priorities and process working across multiple teams including capacity delivery, site selection, utilities, due diligence, design, construction and commissioning.; • Report on status of development, quality, operations, and performance to management; • Write effective narratives and present them concisely and effectively to Directors and VPs; • Establish a mature team optimized for operational excellence, using standard project management, communication protocols and automated systems; • Have joint managerial oversight of additional employees in India including but not limited to, all Architects, Electrical, Mechanical, Colo, Structural, Controls, and Field Engineers in India;

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Electrical, Mechanical, Structural Engineering or equivalent field
- 10+ years of data center design, HVAC design, or related product development experience
- Experience leading multidisciplinary design across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural and controls disciplines on large-scale capital projects. Experience managing design budgets, schedules and delivery teams comprising internal resources supplemented with external design consultants.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience defining data center system-level architecture, documenting performance and equipment requirements, creating and communicating conceptual designs, and creating and maintaining project documentation
- Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience engaging industry bodies, standards or building code committees, regulators or government agencies on technical matters, e.g. Bureau of Indian Standards committees, including the National Building Code

descriptionHtml:
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS), and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support, Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies - including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
The Role

As a TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services - including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support, and risk management.
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager here: https://bit.ly/3aHfaE0
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

title: Principal Program Manager, Whole Foods Market Central Kitchen Strategy, Whole Foods Market Culinary Merchandising
descriptionHtml:
Whole Foods Market is seeking a Principal Program Manager to help shape the future of how we produce freshly prepared food in centralized commissary kitchens. This is a strategic, senior role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and can define strategy where little exists today. Working across Amazon VP organizations and with senior leadership at WFM and Amazon, you will lead a significant, complex initiative from concept through execution, building the business case, aligning stakeholders, and standing up the mechanisms needed to deliver. The ideal candidate pairs deep strategic program management experience with a strong understanding of food service, kitchen production, supply chain, food safety, and multi-unit retail operations, and can influence and align senior leaders across culinary merchandising, supply chain, operations, finance, and technology.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for a significant, complex initiative, driving clarity where the business problem and strategy are not yet fully defined.
- Build out business cases and financial plans, framing capital, operational, and strategic tradeoffs for senior leaders and grounding recommendations in data.
- Partner across merchandising, supply chain, operations, quality assurance and food safety, finance, technology, and other functional teams to align the organization on a coherent operating model and clear ownership.
- Establish the planning, forecasting, and performance mechanisms needed to run the program and measure its success.
- Design and launch pilots to validate our strategy, including clear learning plans, and create the stage gates that govern how and when the program scales.
- Prepare and drive executive-ready reviews, business cases, and PR/FAQ and narrative documents, representing complex decisions and tradeoffs clearly to VPs and, when needed, SVPs.
- Identify and mitigate program risks, building in the redundancy and contingency needed to protect continuity of service to stores and customers.
- Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and best-practice sharing.
- Travel Requirements: Approximately 30% travel to facilities, stores, and partner sites may be required.

About the team
Our team is at the heart of transforming how customers experience fresh, prepared food at Whole Foods Market and Worldwide Grocery Stores. We set the category strategy and define production models that shape what lands on shelves and in shopping baskets across hundreds of stores nationwide. We work at the intersection of food, data, operations, and retail, partnering closely with supply chain, private brands, operations, e-commerce, finance, and technology to bring innovative, high-quality food programs to life. Our culture rewards curiosity, deep ownership, and creative problem-solving. If you are energized by building something new that directly shapes what customers eat every day, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience owning program strategy and end to end delivery
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

- Deep knowledge of food production and kitchen operations, supply chain and distribution, and the associated food safety and regulatory controls.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality
- MBA
- Experience working in a physical store
- Experience designing or scaling fresh food production and distribution networks.
- Working knowledge of food safety systems (HACCP), allergen and labeling requirements, and quality assurance at scale.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a GTM Planning Lead to drive data-driven Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy and analysis within the Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) Sales organization. This role sits at the intersection of statistical analysis and GTM strategy, translating complex data into actionable insights that shape how WWPS designs territories, measures the effectiveness of coverage models, and evaluates emerging strategic initiatives.

The successful candidate will own three interconnected analytical workstreams:

Territory Design & Coverage Segmentation Analytics: Leading the quantitative analysis that underpins WWPS territory design decisions. This includes econometric regression analyses measuring how territory composition (industry purity, coverage segment purity) drives pipeline creation, building and maintaining implementation frameworks, and developing data packs that translate coverage frameworks into territory-level parameters for each division.
GTM Strategy Effectiveness Measurement: Designing and executing analytical studies that measure the impact of strategic GTM initiatives—such as FinOps strategic engagement, partner-led indirect sales motions, and greenfield coverage models—using control group methodologies and statistical rigor to quantify what is working and inform investment decisions.
Productivity Analysis & Benchmarking: Partnering with Finance to develop and refine productivity metrics frameworks, contributing to quarterly productivity reviews with senior leadership, and bench-marking seller performance across coverage segments, industries, and geographies to surface insights that drive operational improvements.
This role requires someone who combines strong quantitative skills with the business acumen to translate statistical findings into executive-ready narratives, and the cross-functional influence to drive adoption of data-backed recommendations across a complex, matrixed organization.


Key job responsibilities
Design and execute econometric analyses (regression, Shapley value decomposition) to quantify how territory composition variables—segmentation, industry, territory size—drive pipeline creation and sales outcomes across WWPS territories.

Own the WWPS Coverage Segment Implementation Framework, translating coverage segmentation principles into territory design parameters, benchmarks, and implementation guidance for each division.

Build and maintain data repositories and conduct territory inspections with stakeholders ahead of annual planning cycles.

Design analytical studies measuring the effectiveness of strategic GTM initiatives using control group methodologies to isolate impact and inform investment decisions.

Develop and review productivity metrics and bench-marking frameworks, contributing to quarterly reviews presented to GTM leaders and division leadership.

Synthesize complex analyses into executive-ready narratives and business cases for division leaders, informing coverage strategy decisions, emerging GTM investments, and opportunity prioritization.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Geo GTM leaders, Sales Operations, FSO, Enablement, and industry specialists to validate findings and integrate analytical insights into territory design and sales motions.

Develop and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and analytical tooling enabling territory purity tracking and coverage segment monitoring at scale.
