title: Supply Chain Manager III, Global Transportation Services (GTS) Planning
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the tools and processes that make supply chain planning faster and smarter? Amazon's Global Transportation Services (GTS) Planning Products team is looking for a Supply Chain Manager III to define problems, design solutions, and drive productivity improvements across our outbound transportation network planning operations. As the team invests in using AI to automate manual planning processes and build more robust systems, this is a compelling time to join and shape how that transformation takes hold.

This is a highly collaborative, individual contributor role where you will work side by side with planners to understand their workflows, identify improvement areas, and write clear problem statements. From there, you will partner with technology teams to build tooling solutions and with operational partners to implement process changes. You will work with optimization models, capacity planning tools, and product management tools to turn undefined challenges into concrete products. If you thrive in ambiguity and want visibility with senior leadership, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Define problem statements by embedding with planners to understand planning workflows, then partner with technology teams to design and deliver tooling solutions — including optimization models and capacity planning tools — that improve productivity across the outbound transportation network.
- Analyze supply chain planning data to identify root causes behind performance gaps and propose scalable process or system improvements, with a focus on automating manual processes through AI-driven approaches.
- Lead weekly product update meetings with leadership, business, and tech stakeholders, and prepare monthly and quarterly business reviews to communicate progress, trade-offs, and recommendations.
- Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to implement technical improvements to reporting and planning mechanisms.
- Develop metrics and monitoring dashboards that enable stakeholders to track planning performance and make informed decisions.

A day in the life
Your work is almost entirely collaborative and roadmap-driven. You might start the morning reviewing capacity planning outputs or optimization model results to refine a problem statement, then meet with planners to validate your findings. After lunch, you could be in a working session with a tech team scoping requirements for a new AI-powered automation tool. Later in the week, you run a product update meeting with leadership, business, and tech stakeholders to share progress and align on priorities. You will also prepare and present monthly and quarterly business reviews, giving you regular visibility with senior leaders.

About the team
The GTS Planning Products team keeps Amazon's outbound transportation network planning processes current and pushes them forward. We are investing in AI and automation to replace manual workflows with robust, scalable systems. We build solutions for the broader planning organization and partner with carrier teams, tech teams, and operations to integrate these into our planning tools. This role offers growth in the product space — you will build expertise in optimization models, capacity planning, and the latest tooling trends while developing deep knowledge of network planning. Through business reviews and product launch communications, you will gain regular exposure to senior leadership and the chance to shape how Amazon plans transportation at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

title: Security Engineer SoC, Devices and Services Security
descriptionHtml:
The Role
Have you wanted an opportunity to find security issues in the chips and low level software that enables various Amazon digital products? Are you able to find bugs in chips by reviewing design and code and by performing tests? This position will provide you with a unique opportunity to do both

The Security team is responsible for identifying security flaws and guiding device business to achieve secure hardware architecture for chips used in Amazon devices like Fire TV, Eero, Alexa, Ring to name a few. This team partners with business team and performs chip level security testing, secure chip architecture design and advisory, system review, security review for Secure boot code, bootloader code and firmware.

In this role, you will:
*Help guide the secure development of devices at Amazon, from security design, threat modeling to code reviews, security testing and fuzzing
*Propose, research and develop tools and techniques to improve the security posture of devices at scale
*Provide technical security expertise and consultation to device product teams
*Identify security risks and work with product engineers to create mitigations
*Develop new security policies and procedures
*Empower others to improve their security acumen by promoting awareness and developing training materials
*Participate in projects that develop new intellectual property

About the team
About AmSec:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
- Knowledge of hardware security mechanisms, including secure boot, trusted execution environments

- 3+ years of hands on experience for the following: system level threat modeling, secure code reviews, cryptography, SoC level security fundamentals

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields
- Experience using scripting languages, such as Python, Perl, Linux bash
- Experience with hardware, system and network security, including use of cryptography in these verticals

title: Software Development Engineer II, Omnichannel Metrics (OCM) - Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS)
descriptionHtml:
Every time an advertiser runs a campaign on Amazon, they want to know: did it drive sales at Target, Walmart, Costco, and hundreds of other retailers? Omnichannel Metrics (OCM) answers that question — and we're just getting started. We build the ML-powered attribution systems that connect billions of ad impressions to real-world purchases across the entire retail landscape, processing massive-scale panel data to give advertisers measurement insights no competitor can match. OCM is one of Amazon Ads' highest-growth products, directly responsible for unlocking advertiser investment by proving the full omnichannel value of Amazon media.

Right now, we're shipping some of the most ambitious projects in MADS: Fine-Grained OCM that breaks attribution down to category and retailer level for the first time, OCM for Autos bringing omnichannel measurement to the automotive vertical, OCM Local building location-based foot traffic measurement for restaurants and retail, a Combined Methodology that unifies our Panel and Circana measurement into a single omnichannel view, and international expansion of the Unified Panel to 8 new marketplaces. Looking ahead to 2027, we're building real-time streaming attribution, integrating LLMs for agentic report generation and automated campaign optimization, expanding into healthcare and home services verticals, and launching causal incrementality measurement. The problems are genuinely hard — privacy-safe identity resolution at scale, calibrating ML models across sparse panel data, building streaming systems that produce daily estimates from weekly ground truth — and the ambiguity is high. You won't be handed a spec; you'll be defining what to build and how.

As an SDE II, you will own the architecture and delivery of major system components end-to-end. You'll make technology choices that shape how OCM scales from thousands to tens of thousands of active studies, design distributed data pipelines processing billions of events in Spark/EMR, and build the AI-powered features that transform OCM from a reporting tool into an autonomous measurement platform. You'll work across Scala, Java, and Python, with deep expertise in big data technologies (Apache Spark, Kestrel, EMR), AWS infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, Step Functions, CDK), and data modeling for both relational and non-relational systems.

You will lead technical design reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the engineering bar across the team. You'll partner directly with applied scientists on ML model productionization and with product managers to translate ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. This is a team where an L5 engineer has outsized impact — we're small enough that your architectural decisions become the system, and high-visibility enough (S-team and VP-level goals) that leadership sees the results.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, has a track record of delivering complex distributed systems in fast-moving environments, and gets energized by problems that sit at the intersection of big data, ML, and product. You're not just looking for a job — you're looking for a team where you can shape the technical direction of a product that's redefining how the advertising industry measures success.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build scalable data pipelines processing billions of ad impression and panel receipt events using Spark/EMR on Kestrel, powering omnichannel attribution for thousands of active advertiser studies
- Lead architecture decisions for OCM's calibration, report generation, and data processing systems spanning multiple pipelines across multiple AWS accounts
- Own end-to-end delivery of major product features — from technical design through production launch — including real-time streaming attribution, AI-powered report generation, and new vertical measurement frameworks
- Drive operational excellence across OCM's distributed systems: improve observability, eliminate silent failures, and build self-healing capabilities to meet advertiser SLAs
- Mentor junior engineers, raise the bar on code quality through design reviews and CRs, and establish engineering best practices across the team
- Partner with applied scientists and product managers to translate ML model requirements into production-grade systems that serve advertiser-facing measurement products

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the overnight calibration pipeline run, investigating why a study's attributed sales look anomalous. After standup, you pair with an applied scientist to optimize a Spark job that processes panelist receipt data against ad exposure signals. In the afternoon, you lead a design review for a new streaming architecture that will reduce OCM's reporting latency from weeks to days. You close the day reviewing a CR from a teammate building LLM-powered receipt data extraction. Your work directly impacts how major brands like Procter & Gamble, Hasbro, and Scotts Miracle-Gro measure and optimize billions in advertising spend across Amazon and beyond.

About the team
Omnichannel Metrics (OCM) is part of MADS (Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science) within Amazon Ads. We answer the question every advertiser asks: "Did my Amazon ad drive sales at Target, Walmart, and other retailers?" Our team builds the ML-powered attribution systems that measure off-Amazon impact using panel data from millions of shoppers. We're a high-impact team in startup mode — shipping features that directly unlock advertiser investment and competing head-to-head with Google and Meta's measurement offerings. We value ownership, technical depth, and moving fast.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape the future of virtualized networking in one of the world's largest public clouds?

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) NX Platforms team owns the packet processing pipeline running beneath every EC2 instance — adding encryption, firewalls (security groups), routing, billing, and monitoring to every packet on every host across our worldwide fleet of 9M+ hosts in more than 30 regions. Our vision: deliver bare-metal networking performance while raising the bar on EC2's security, availability, and reliability — unlocking capabilities only possible through true Software Defined Networking (SDN).

We are growing fast and looking for senior systems engineers who can deliver ultra-high performance — our goal is processing millions of packets per second on a single CPU core. If you have a passion for systems software engineering — kernel development, embedded systems, or high-performance networking — this is a unique opportunity to define the next generation of the platform powering all new EC2 instance families and VPC features for years to come.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Lambda
descriptionHtml:
Serverless technologies are dramatically changing the business landscape for AWS customers large and small. AWS Lambda changed how the world builds software. Developers write code, and Lambda runs it: no servers to provision or patch, and no capacity to plan. Every month, Lambda runs trillions of invocations for millions of customers, from startups to the largest enterprises. It powers web backends, APIs, data pipelines, event-driven apps, and AI agents.

We're looking for experienced engineers to help lead our global-scale Lambda data plane. The data plane is the set of distributed systems that receive, route, place, scale, and run every function invocation. It has to be fast, secure, and highly available at huge scale. We're also taking serverless into new areas. That includes new compute options like Lambda Managed Instances, first-class support for web applications, and richer ways to process events at scale. As a senior engineer, you'll set the technical direction for these capabilities and turn it into production systems. A successful team member will exhibit creativity, empathy, and optimism as we push the boundaries of serverless computing in the cloud. We are inspired by what has come before and motivated to create what comes next.

You'll thrive in this role if you are interested in large scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems, low latency request processing, and p100 anomalies. You are capable in one or more programming languages and open to learning new ones. You include customer experience when discussing engineering alternatives and value creating APIs that make "the right thing, the easy thing." You value operational sustainability and advocate for eliminating flaky tests as soon as possible. You also think having fun goes together with tackling hard problems like supercomputing, high availability, and building loosely coupled gRPC-based microservices, all while continuing to securely and reliably handle massive traffic with millisecond latency.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the architecture and design of large-scale, highly available, low-latency data plane systems that handle customer traffic across AWS Regions
- Set technical direction across teams, balancing near-term delivery with long-term architecture, and influence the Lambda roadmap
- Own complex, ambiguous problems end to end, from customer need to design, implementation, deployment, and operations
- Drive major improvements in invoke latency, scaling speed, efficiency, security, and resilience

title: Sr. Product Manager - Technical, AWS Governance
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping organizations manage governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) at cloud scale? AWS is building a new AI-powered GRC service that delivers continuous compliance, real-time risk quantification, and governance for AI agent workloads. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to own and drive critical product areas as we scale this service for enterprise adoption.

About the Opportunity

The GRC market is $60B+ and undergoing a fundamental transformation. Point-in-time audits are becoming untenable as enterprises operate across multi-cloud and hybrid environments that change daily. AI agents are proliferating faster than compliance programs can adapt. No incumbent GRC vendor has a credible solution for continuous, AI-native governance. AWS is uniquely positioned to win here — and we're building the team to make it happen.

In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, requirements, and go-to-market for a core set of capabilities within a new cloud-native GRC service. You will work backwards from enterprise GRC buyers — compliance officers, risk managers, CISOs, and audit teams — to define what we build and why. You will partner with engineering, science, UX, marketing, sales, and legal to deliver capabilities that win in a competitive and rapidly evolving market.

This is a high-ownership role. You will define the product vision for your area, author PRFAQs and requirements documents, make pricing and packaging decisions, and drive adoption post-launch. You will operate at the intersection of deep domain expertise in compliance/audit/risk and strong technical product management fundamentals.

Key job responsibilities
Leverage deep audit and compliance expertise — direct experience conducting, managing, or overseeing audits — to define product requirements that solve real practitioner pain points

Own the product strategy and roadmap for a core domain within a new AI-powered GRC service — from vision through delivery and adoption

Work backwards from enterprise GRC customers to define requirements, acceptance criteria, and prioritization

Author PRFAQs, pricing narratives, and requirements documents that align engineering execution with customer outcomes

Partner with engineering leads to make architecture tradeoffs, scope MVPs, and drive sprint-level execution through a multi-pod organization

Define and drive go-to-market strategy including positioning, sales enablement, customer onboarding, and partner ecosystem plays

Leverage deep domain knowledge of compliance standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, NIST, EU AI Act), audit workflows, and risk management to inform product decisions

Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer telemetry to identify opportunities and inform prioritization

Work cross-functionally with marketing, field sales, solution architects, professional services, and GSI partners to drive enterprise adoption

Represent the service in customer meetings, industry events, and executive reviews

Influence cross-AWS strategy by collaborating with adjacent governance and security teams to deliver integrated experiences

A day in the life
On a typical day, you might review customer feedback from a Fortune 500 enterprise, author a requirements for a new capability, meet with engineering to finalize scope for the next release train, join a customer call with a solution architect to understand an auditor's workflow, analyze service telemetry to identify adoption blockers, and sync with marketing on positioning for an upcoming industry event. You will work across time zones with a globally distributed team. The pace is fast, the problems are complex, and the opportunity is massive — you'll be defining a new category in cloud-native GRC.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Marketing Manager, Chariot Marketing — Cross-Channel, Cross-Category Marketing (XCM)

About the Role
Cross-Channel, Cross-Category Marketing (XCM) aims to be the most culturally aware, creatively breakthrough, and measurably effective marketing organization in the world. We strengthen the brand, grow the business, and reduce cost for Amazon. Within XCM, Chariot Marketing owns the worldwide marketing strategy for Amazon's branded delivery fleet, packaging experiences, and emerging physical media channels.

We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who combines exceptional writing with sharp analytical thinking to lead brand-building initiatives that operate at global scale. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of creative strategy, channel invention, and data-driven decision-making — someone who can draft a compelling creative brief in the morning, pressure-test a measurement framework over lunch, and align a room of cross-functional stakeholders by end of day.

Key Responsibilities
Global Portfolio Strategy. Own the end-to-end marketing strategy for Amazon's owned and operated channels globally — developing campaigns that reinforce Amazon's brand across marketplace priorities (e.g., Prime, Amazon Retail). Own creative briefing and guide creative development and timelines through close coordination with Creative, Operations, and Product. Drive the strategic roadmap for emerging channels, building the business cases to bring new capabilities from concept through validation to scale.

Operations, Marketing & Business Integration. This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy and operations. You will partner directly with operational teams to understand fleet deployment schedules, label print and application workflows, packaging specifications, and delivery station logistics — then translate those realities back into marketing plans that are both ambitious and executable. Success requires fluency in the operations of the physical channels — you do not need to own these systems, but you must be able to ask the right questions, identify risk, and ensure that marketing commitments match operational capacity.

Strategic Communications & Decision Framing. Write recommendations, stakeholder updates, and strategy documents that are concise, insight-led, and built to drive decisions. Translate complex program narratives into clear strategic recommendations that build alignment and move work forward. Frame alternatives with specificity — articulate trade-offs, estimate business impact, and distinguish one-way from two-way doors.

Analytical Rigor & Measurement. Partner with Science and Operations teams to define campaign measurement frameworks, evaluate performance against target perceptions and high-value actions (HVAs), and translate complex data into clear strategic recommendations. Conduct performance deep-dives, build learning agendas, and set the strategic measurement priorities for the channel. Identify when data is directional versus conclusive and communicate uncertainty with intellectual honesty.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management. Lead alignment across a broad stakeholder ecosystem spanning internal Amazon teams, Creative, Legal, Science, Operations, and Global marketing teams. Navigate competing priorities, resource constraints, and partner escalations across organizations. Serve as the connective backbone between teams — educating cross-functional partners on channel strategy, managing expectations, and driving shared understanding of how the work ladders up.

What Success Looks Like
Within 90 days, you have authored or refined the current batch of campaign briefs, established relationships with key cross-functional partners, and developed a point of view on what's working and what needs to change. Within six months, you are the person stakeholders seek out when they need a crisp recommendation backed by evidence — and the person the team trusts to put the right words on the page. Within a year, you have measurably advanced the strategic position of Chariot Marketing's brand-building programs and are shaping the roadmap for what comes next.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or equivalent
- Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder programs across business functions and geographies
- Demonstrated track record of exceptional written communication — from creative briefs to QBRs

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- Experience in go-to-market planning or scaling marketing programs across digital or physical channels
- Background working with analytics or data science teams across measurement (A/B testing, hold-out experiments) and personalization models
- Comfort operating in ambiguity — able to pair high judgement with available data to make recommendations and drive strategy forward

title: Principal Global Account Manager - IT/ITeS Industry, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to own the AWS relationship with one of the world's largest System Integrators and reshape how tens of thousands of its developers build software? AWS is seeking a Principal Account Manager to serve as the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / large IT & ITeS customer, owning AWS revenue and driving developer productivity and AI adoption across the customer's global engineering workforce.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / IT & ITeS customer, you will own the end-to-end global sales relationship with an organization whose core asset is a global developer workforce numbering in the tens or hundreds of thousands. This is a role for a leader with roughly twenty years of experience who can operate at the highest level of ownership, set global account strategy, and orchestrate a large, distributed virtual team across geographies. Your central mandate is to make AWS the platform on which the customer's engineers build, and to drive a measurable step-change in their developer productivity through the AWS AI stack. You will own the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) motion end to end, from IDE and code generation through testing, deployment, and operations, embedding AWS AI tooling into how the customer's developers work every day. You will align regional sellers across NAMER, EMEA, and India, engage the customer's most senior executives, define a multi-year global strategy, structure the largest and most complex commercial constructs, and represent the voice of the customer inside AWS to shape product roadmaps and investment priorities.



Key job responsibilities
• Own the Global Account Strategy: Serve as the single global owner for the account. Define and drive a multi-year global account plan that aligns AWS capabilities with the customer's worldwide business objectives and engineering roadmap.
• Drive Developer Productivity at Scale: Make AWS the default platform for how the customer's global engineering workforce builds. Drive adoption of Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, and the broader AWS developer tooling stack across the customer's delivery teams, and tie adoption to measurable gains in developer throughput, code quality, and time-to-delivery.
• Own the AIDLC Motion End to End: Own the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle motion across the account. Embed AWS AI tooling into every stage of the customer's software lifecycle, from requirements and code generation through automated testing, code review, deployment, and operations, and convert developer-level adoption into enterprise-wide standardization.
• Sell the AWS AI Stack: Position AWS as the customer's platform of choice for AI and GenAI. Drive adoption of Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, Amazon SageMaker, and the broader AWS AI and data stack across the customer's engineering, product, and internal-productivity use cases worldwide, and convert early experimentation into production workloads at scale.
• Drive a Large-Scale Global Migration Motion: Lead the migration of the customer's on-premises, co-located, and competitor-cloud workloads to AWS at global scale, and drive the consumption growth that follows across every region.
• Drive a Global, Multi-Geography Sales Motion: Lead one consistent global motion across NAMER, EMEA, India, and other regions. Set global revenue objectives, then align and mobilize regional account teams to execute against a single coherent plan rather than disconnected local efforts.
• Executive Relationship Building at the Highest Level: Establish and sustain relationships with the customer's most senior global executives, including the CEO, CTO, Chief Digital Officer, and engineering and delivery leaders. Position AWS as the customer's primary strategic cloud provider and influence board-level technology and engineering decisions.
• Structure the Most Complex Global Deals: Lead the largest multi-year, multi-region commercial engagements, including EDPs, PPAs, global framework agreements, and custom pricing constructs. Navigate complex global procurement, legal, and commercial processes across multiple jurisdictions.
• Orchestrate Extended Teams: Operate as the single-threaded global leader, orchestrating across regional Account Managers, Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver unified outcomes for the customer.
• Global Revenue Ownership and Forecasting: Own global revenue targets for the account, build and manage a healthy worldwide pipeline, forecast accurately across regions, and drive consumption growth across developer tooling, GenAI, data and analytics, migration, and modernization.
• Segment Strategy Shaping: Contribute to AWS's global GSI and IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace across the account. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities and product direction.
• Lead Without Authority: Set direction for a large virtual team that does not report to you. Align senior stakeholders across AWS regions and functions, resolve conflicting regional priorities, and drive execution through influence.
• Mentor and Raise the Bar: Coach senior and junior Account Managers across the account team, share best practices for global account management, and act as a role model for how AWS engages its most strategic customers.


A day in the life
As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / IT & ITeS customer, you own the worldwide sales relationship and are responsible for driving the customer's developer productivity and AI transformation on AWS. Your day combines global strategy, senior executive engagement, cross-region orchestration, and complex deal leadership.

A typical day may include:
• Global Strategy and Alignment: Reviewing the global account plan, analyzing developer-tooling and AI adoption metrics alongside consumption and pipeline across regions, and aligning NAMER, EMEA, and India account leads on shared priorities and resourcing for the largest opportunities.
• Executive Engagement: Running global steering committees and executive briefings with the customer's engineering and business leadership, and joining regional business reviews to keep the worldwide plan on track.
• Driving the Developer and AIDLC Motion: Working with the customer's engineering leaders on rollout plans for Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, and the AWS AI stack, reviewing adoption and productivity data, and removing blockers to enterprise-wide standardization.
• Internal Orchestration: Engaging Solutions Architects and Product teams on technical proposals and roadmap needs, and coordinating across time zones with regional account teams.
• Deal Leadership: Advancing the most complex global commercial engagements, structuring multi-region agreements, and removing blockers across legal, procurement, and commercial functions in multiple countries.
• Advocacy: Bringing the voice of the customer into AWS, informing product and developer-tooling roadmaps, and representing AWS at senior customer and industry forums.



About the team
The GSI and IT/ITeS team owns AWS's sales relationships with the world's largest System Integrators and technology services organizations, global companies whose competitiveness depends on how fast and how well their developers build. You will own the global relationship for one of these customers and work with a collaborative, high-energy team that values customer obsession, ownership, and results at global scale.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve

title: Senior HR Partner AWS Builder Experience Team, BeXT AIS
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Builder Experience Team (BeXT) as a Senior Data Center HR Partner and make every day better for the Builders who power AWS. This is a 100% on-site role where you'll serve as the strategic HR partner to cluster operations leadership across multiple clusters. You'll operate with significant autonomy — applying senior judgment in precedent-setting situations, designing scalable mechanisms, and coaching site leadership teams through the most complex people challenges in a rapidly growing business.
What we are looking for:

Adaptability. Manage multiple scenarios across clusters utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, and influence — often in precedent-setting situations where no clear playbook exists.

High Judgement. Make high-stakes decisions independently in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations. Navigate complexity with composure and serve as a go-to advisor for HRPs and site leadership.

Strategic Thinking. Connect sentiment trends, workforce data, and operational signals across clusters to identify systemic patterns. Translate cross-cluster insights into scalable recommendations that shape leadership action.

Influencing. Influence multiple levels of the organization across clusters — from builders to senior site leaders and cross-functional partners — without direct authority. Lead integrated people strategies through partnership.

Coaching. Develop site leadership capability at scale — designing structured coaching approaches and building manager strength across a portfolio of leaders.


Key job responsibilities
Builder Advocacy: Build trust through consistent floor/onsite presence, site walks & gemba walks across multiple clusters. Ensure execution and efficacy of onsite listening mechanisms, identifying and leading strategies based on risk patterns. Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders, ensuring they feel fully engaged in their work and valued for who they are. Independently manage relationships with employee representative boards.

Strategic Partnership: Serve as the primary HR partner to cluster operations leadership across multiple clusters, developing proactive strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience. Perform cross-cluster systemic risk detection — connecting sentiment trends, workforce data, and operational signals to provide recommendations to site leadership and HRBPs. Coordinate cross-cluster communications in partnership with site leadership. Present at monthly All Manager and All Team Meetings.

HR Expertise: Apply senior judgment to problem-solve across talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations — including precedent-setting cases where policy is insufficient or ambiguous. Lead high-complexity employee relations matters, navigating Amazon Policies with senior judgment. Lead workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations and Labor Relations. Drive resolution of systemic pay, internal transfer, and hiring defects in partnership with central teams. Build procedural policy/governance standards (e.g., SOPs) designed for adoption across clusters.

Leadership Development: Design and deliver scalable manager capability programs, coaching site leadership through decision-making with empathy and sound judgment. Identify development opportunities through data, sentiment patterns, and onsite observation. Educate leaders on HR operating model standards and drive adoption across clusters. Support interviews for site manager and technical manager roles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with HRBPs, Centers of Excellence (COEs), Employee Relations, and Labor Relations to deliver integrated people strategies across multiple clusters. Partner with New Hire Experience teams on orientation, onboarding, and lifecycle support for new site launches. Mentor HRPs and drive peer enablement. Manage through ambiguity in a fast-paced, continuously innovating environment.

Role Requirements

This is a 100% Onsite role and requires the ability to travel to assigned Data Center sites across multiple clusters within a region (estimated 30–40% travel).

Data Center environments are 24/7 operational facilities; flexibility to support off-shift populations and respond to time-sensitive people matters is expected.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; leadership is demonstrated through influence, mentorship, and cross-functional partnership.



A day in the life
You'll conduct site walks across clusters with Operations, Safety, and Deployment leadership — staying close to what's happening on the ground while maintaining the altitude to spot patterns across sites. You'll analyze sentiment data and roundtable feedback to detect systemic risk, then partner with cluster leadership to translate those patterns into action. You'll coach site leaders through complex, high-stakes people decisions, lead workplace investigations, and design mechanisms and SOPs that drive consistency across your portfolio. You'll mentor HRPs, coordinate with cross-functional partners on integrated people strategies, and manage employee representative board relationships independently.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
- 7+ years of progressive HR experience, including experience in HR business partner, HR generalist, or HR site partner roles
- Experience supporting hourly/frontline populations of 100+ employees in an operations or manufacturing environment
- Experience leading workforce planning and people strategy through organizational change (site launches, expansions, restructuring, or closures)
- Demonstrated experience in employee relations including conducting investigations and managing complex, high-risk ER cases
- Working knowledge of federal and state employment law

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Human Resources Management
- Experience assessing management and executive talent
- Experience developing and administering HR compensation plans
- Experience in human resources with companies supporting 250-500 or more associates
- Master's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Experience in data center, critical infrastructure, construction, or technology operations environments
- Experience supporting a multi-site or multi-cluster scope across a geographic region
- Track record of building scalable HR programs, mechanisms, or standard work from scratch in a greenfield or high-growth environment
- Strong data analytics capability — experience using workforce data to drive insights and inform people strategy
- Experience partnering with and influencing senior leadership
- PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification

title: エリアマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は埼玉県三郷市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、エリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実にお届けされるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
■業務内容■
「エリアマネージャー」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、「People First」の考え方で、各種プロジェクトをリードし、またピープルマネージメントを行っていただきます。また、「エリアマネージャー」は拠点の全ての工程を担当し、上司の示す部署全体の方針や安全・品質・生産性の年間目標に沿って、担当工程における改善を積み重ね、日々の計画、進捗、実績管理に責任をもち活動いただきます。

具体的な業務は以下の通りです。

主な責任と職務内容：
① チームメンバーの育成とサポート
現場の最前線にいるマネージャーとしてチームメンバーと積極的に関わり、メンバーからの意見に基づく職場改善によりエンゲージメントを高めます。また、数名から数十名のチームのマネージャーとして、業務上の知識・スキル、アマゾンカルチャー等の指導を行うことはもちろん、部下の悩みに傾聴し、問題の解決に向けて自ら動きます。さらに、部下の勤怠や労働時間等の把握、管理を適切に行います。

② 担当プロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上
マネージャーはそれぞれ特定のプロセスを担当し、そのプロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上をリードします。日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、作業環境の改善、トレーニングの進捗管理など多岐にわたる改善活動が該当します。問題を特定し、対策を立案し、チームメンバーを巻き込みながら実行に移し、結果を出していくことが求められます。

③ 日々のオペレーション対応
物流拠点のすべての工程を管理し、商品の管理からお客様へお届けするまでの一連の流れの中で計画を立案し管理していただきます。日々のオペレーションにおいてお客様にお約束した納期を確実に守るため、物量の上振れや下振れ、急な労働力不足、システムトラブル等の変動要素に際し、適切に判断して対応していくことが求められます。

④ プロジェクトリーダーとして改善を推進
Amazonでは日々改善が推進されています。エリアマネージャーは通常業務と並行して、安全上のリスクや生産性を改善するプロジェクトのリーダーとして拠点内の年次/月次プロジェクト活動を推進します。これらのプロジェクトにおいては関連部署との協業等も含まれます。



A day in the life
シフト勤務（日勤・夜勤、土日祝含む交代制のシフト勤務になります。）


About the team

descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都葛飾区を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をAmazonのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シニアエリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

また社内システムを用いて各種計画の進捗・実績管理などを実施。現場と連携し、生産性向上を実現していきます。

今の生産性を維持するのではなく、改善を図って向上させるのがAmazonのシニアエリアマネージャーです。
業務改善プロジェクトなどの進行・取りまとめ役となり、最新テクノロジーの導入や工程の見直し等検討し、教育プランの策定も行います。

title: Sr. Robotics Applied Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building robotic systems that combine frontier AI, sophisticated control, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is an opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.

We are seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to develop tactile- and force-driven manipulation policies for highly dexterous, multi-fingered robotic hands and grippers. In this role you will research and build policy learning algorithms that enable robotic hands to perform grasping and in-hand manipulation in unstructured, real-world environments, using touch and force feedback as first-class signals rather than afterthoughts. Much of this work is grounded in reinforcement learning.

To be successful you need to be highly motivated, dive deep, and deliver to the highest standards. You will demonstrate strong working knowledge of modern policy learning methods, with expertise in taking algorithms from simulation onto real hardware. That means being comfortable working against real physical constraints and treating sim-to-real as a core research problem rather than optimizing for benchmark numbers alone. You will work across tactile signal processing, contact-rich manipulation, sim-to-real transfer, and multi-modal sensor fusion to build robust solutions for autonomous grasping, dexterous re-orientation, and fine motor control. You will bring the desire to learn from new challenges, and the problem-solving and communication skills to work within a highly interactive and experienced team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and train manipulation policies that leverage tactile and force feedback for dexterous grasping, in-hand manipulation, and contact-rich tasks, using reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or hybrid approaches.
- Drive sim-to-real transfer, closing the gap between simulated and physical performance on real robotic hands.
- Shape objectives and control strategies with the hardware in mind, accounting for how motors and actuators actually behave: transmission ratios, torque versus power, backdrivability, and thermal limits.
- Build simulation-based and on-robot evaluation frameworks, with benchmarks and metrics that make tactile perception and policy performance systematically comparable across iterations.
- Own scientific and technical projects within the tactile sensing and manipulation workstreams, driving from research concept through deployment on physical robotic systems — and, at the senior level, set direction across a workstream.
- Collaborate with hardware, mechanical design, firmware, and controls teams — and with partner applied science organizations — to translate research advances into deployable robotic capabilities, and to inform sensor and actuator design decisions with policy-level requirements.
- Publish at top-tier venues and build collaborations with the external research community.
- Contribute to a strong scientific bar on the team through code and design review, and mentor engineers and interns working on real-world manipulation and sensing problems.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a standup alongside hardware and controls engineers reviewing overnight sim-to-real training runs on a multi-finger gripper, debugging why a grasp policy that worked in simulation is slipping on a real sensor array. Mid-morning you join the weekly tactile sensing workstream to align on sensor integration milestones and share early results from a contact-state estimator you have been prototyping. After lunch you spend a focused block iterating on a reinforcement learning reward formulation, testing variations in simulation before queuing runs on the cluster. Later you pair with a mechanical engineer to review sensor placement trade-offs on an upcoming gripper revision, then wrap the day by drafting a short experiment write-up and sketching next steps for a conference submission.

No two days look exactly the same: one week you may be collecting teleoperated demonstrations on the physical robot to seed an imitation learning pipeline; the next you could be deep in a codebase refactor to support a new tactile modality. Throughout, you balance hands-on research — writing algorithms, running experiments, analyzing data — with cross-team collaboration and mentoring. The common thread is moving from research insight to working capability on real hardware, with a tight feedback loop between simulation and the physical world.

About the team
Our is developing next-generation manipulation capabilities for highly dexterous multi-fingered grippers and hands. Our work spans tactile sensor development, manipulation policy learning, and the tight integration of sensing hardware with intelligent control software. We are building systems that can feel, adapt, and manipulate with human-level dexterity.

You will join a team working at the frontier of tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation, helping define how robots perceive and interact with objects through touch. Because we build the hands as well as the policies that drive them, you will have a direct line to the sensor, actuator, and mechanism designs your algorithms depend on — and real influence over how they evolve. This is an opportunity to solve hard problems across perception, learning, and physical interaction alongside a team of scientists and engineers building toward real-world deployment.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Research or applied experience in one or more of: tactile sensing, manipulation policy learning, contact-rich manipulation, dexterous grasping, or multi-modal perception for robotics
- Experience deploying learned policies or control algorithms on physical robotic hardware

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading technical initiatives and key deliverables
- Experience bridging research with practical engineering implementation in physical robotic systems
- Hands-on experience with modern tactile sensing hardware and tactile signal processing
- Strong publication record at major robotics/ML venues (e.g., RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR), including impactful first-author work in tactile sensing or dexterous manipulation
- Experience developing manipulation policies using reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or foundation models for contact-rich tasks
- Demonstrated experience with sim-to-real transfer for tactile-enabled manipulation
- Familiarity with both learned and classical approaches to contact dynamics, including impedance and admittance control
- Experience with force and torque control, and with proprioceptive force estimation on torque- or current-controlled actuators
- Experience with robotics simulation stacks (e.g., Isaac, MuJoCo) and robot modeling (URDF)
- Experience with teleoperation and demonstration-collection pipelines for dexterous hands
- Familiarity with multi-finger or multi-contact gripper platforms

title: SAP Production Planning Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building an SAP S/4HANA platform that unifies our robotics business into a single digital thread, and Production Planning sits at the heart of how we plan, source, and build — at the speed our robotics roadmap demands. This role exists to make design-to-build cycles dramatically faster, layering automation and AI on top of a clean SAP PP core. As the SAP Production Planning Solution Architect, you will own the solution architecture for the PP domain end to end — translating how the business forecasts, plans materials, and executes manufacturing into a coherent, standard-first design that scales. A central focus of this role is the configuration of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and the integration of SAP PP with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), so that engineering, planning, and manufacturing execution flow as one connected thread. You will build the Business Process Designs (BPDs) hand in hand with business, operations, and the integrated technical team, work backwards from plan-to-produce and manufacturing reporting requirements, and ensure the architecture is designed around how the business actually operates while connecting cleanly to the broader supply chain, procurement, quality, and finance. Beyond stabilizing the core, you will drive a program of innovation on top of the SAP PP base to compress design-to-build cycles. These automation and AI layers — SAP Business AI and Joule, generative and agentic AI on SAP BTP (AI Core / AI Foundation), RAP-based and low-code accelerators, and CPI/Integration Suite orchestration — sit cleanly alongside a clean-core S/4HANA foundation.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the SAP Production Planning (PP) domain on S/4HANA, translating plan-to-produce business requirements into a coherent, scalable, standard-first design.
- Own the MRP architecture — configure classic MRP and MRP Live, planning strategies, lot-sizing procedures, MRP areas, and consumption-/forecast-based planning — to balance service levels, inventory, and manufacturing capacity.
- Own the integration between PLM and SAP PP, designing how engineering BOMs, material masters, Engineering Change Management (ECM), and document links flow into production master data and stay synchronized with product revisions.
- Own the integration between SAP PP and the Manufacturing Execution System (MES), designing production order dispatch, confirmations, component consumption, goods movements, and real-time production feedback, along with genealogy, serialization, and back-flushing requirements.
- Build the Business Process Designs (BPDs) for the PP domain, working hand in hand with business stakeholders, operations, and the integrated technical team to align on standard process adoption, exceptions, and trade-offs.
- Work backwards from how the business plans and builds — demand management, S&OP, BOMs, routings, work centers, production versions, capacity planning, and production/process orders — to ensure the PP architecture meets operational needs across discrete, repetitive, and process manufacturing.
- Design for manufacturing reporting needs — production cost, variance, yield, and capacity analytics — ensuring the PP design captures the right data to meet management and statutory reporting requirements.
- Own the integration requirements connecting PP to adjacent domains — Materials Management (MM), Quality Management (QM), Warehouse Management (WM/EWM), and Finance (FICO) — ensuring plan-to-produce connects cleanly to procurement, quality, fulfillment, and product costing.
- Lead PP standard-versus-custom decisions, favoring configuration and clean-core extensions over core modifications, and set the design patterns and integration standards the delivery team builds against.
- Drive innovation on top of the SAP PP base — lead automation and AI layers built on SAP Business AI / Joule, generative and agentic AI on SAP BTP, and RAP-based or low-code accelerators — to compress design-to-build cycles, accelerate configuration and testing, and augment planners, while keeping the core clean and upgrade-safe.
- Build master data standards, planning governance, controls, and audit and compliance requirements into the PP design from the start, rather than retrofitting them.
- Serve as the senior technical authority for the PP domain through design and configuration reviews, prototypes, and hands-on resolution of the hardest PP configuration and integration problems, mentoring functional analysts.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- 10+ years of experience working in ERP implementation
- 5+ years of experience leading the Production Planning domain in an ERP implementation
- Experience across discrete and repetitive manufacturing environments
- Experience configuring SAP Production Planning (PP) on S/4HANA in at least one full-lifecycle implementation

Preferred qualifications

- Experience integrating SAP PP with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), including engineering BOMs, Engineering Change Management (ECM), and master-data replication
- Experience integrating SAP PP with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for production order execution, confirmations, and production data exchange
- Experience building Business Process Designs (BPDs) in partnership with business, operations, and integrated technical teams
- Experience architecting plan-to-produce end to end and integrating PP with MM, QM, WM/EWM, and Finance (FICO) for product costing
- Experience leading standard-versus-custom decisions and evaluating design trade-offs on controls, auditability, and upgrade-safety
- Experience with SAP clean-core design concepts, including design and build using non-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI and data & analytics
- Experience driving innovation on top of core SAP PP — building automation and AI layers with SAP Business AI / Joule, generative and agentic AI on SAP BTP (AI Core / AI Foundation), and RAP-based or low-code accelerators — to shorten design-to-build cycles

title: Software Engineer- Annapurna Labs (Tel Aviv / Haifa, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs and builds the custom silicon and systems software that power Amazon Web Services at scale — including **Nitro** (the hardware and hypervisor platform behind every modern EC2 instance) and **Graviton** (Amazon's Arm-based server processors used by millions of customers worldwide).

We are looking for talented **graduate software engineers** to join our Nitro and Graviton systems software teams. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll write low-level, high-performance software that runs directly on Amazon-designed chips — the kind of work where the code you write in your first year runs in production across the world's largest cloud. You'll be mentored by senior engineers, ramp up on real systems from day one, and grow into an expert in embedded and systems software.

If you love understanding how things work all the way down to the hardware, this is the team for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, test, and debug embedded and systems software (firmware, drivers, low-level services) for Amazon's Nitro and Graviton platforms.

- Write and optimize code primarily in **C** and **C++**, working close to the hardware.

- Collaborate with hardware, silicon, and verification engineers to bring up new chips and platforms.

- Debug complex issues across the software/hardware boundary using logic analyzers, JTAG, and system-level tooling.

- Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and the continuous improvement of our software and processes.

- Learn continuously — from senior engineers, from the systems, and from a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

A day in the life
No two days look exactly alike, but a typical one might include:

- Picking up a task from your team's backlog — a new driver feature, a firmware bug, or a bring-up item on a new chip revision — and pairing with your mentor to scope it.

- Writing and reviewing C/C++ code, then running it on real Amazon-designed hardware in the lab (or on emulation/simulation before silicon arrives).

- Debugging an issue that spans the software/hardware boundary — reading logs, attaching a debugger over JTAG, or reasoning through a trace with a hardware engineer sitting next to you.

- Joining a design discussion or code review where your questions and ideas are genuinely wanted — junior engineers here are expected to think, not just execute.

- Wrapping up by pushing your change through CI and watching it move toward production that serves millions of AWS customers.


You'll start with plenty of support and a clear ramp-up plan, and take on more ownership as you grow. Learning is part of the job, every day — and you'll always have experienced engineers around you to learn from.

About the team
Why Annapurna Labs

- Work directly on the silicon and software that run **the world's largest cloud** — real scale, real impact, from your first months.

- Deep technical mentorship from some of the best systems and silicon engineers in the industry.

- A rare chance to work across the full stack — from transistors to hypervisors — in one place.

- A culture of ownership, learning, and building things that matter.

Basic qualifications

- - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related field
- - Solid programming foundations in **C** and/or **C++**.
- - Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and computer architecture.
- - Ability to read and write clear, correct, maintainable code.
- - Fluent English (written and spoken).

Preferred qualifications

- - Academic projects, internships, or personal projects involving embedded systems, firmware, device drivers, operating systems, or low-level programming.
- - Familiarity with Linux, the Linux kernel, or real-time operating systems (RTOS).
- - Exposure to computer architecture concepts (CPUs, memory hierarchies, virtualization) — Arm architecture a plus.
- - Experience with hardware/software co-development, debugging tools, or scripting (Python, shell).
- - Curiosity, ownership, and a strong desire to learn how systems work end to end.

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: IT Senior Real Estate Transactions Manager, EU Real Estate
descriptionHtml:
The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

Are you ready to manage high-impact real estate transactions that shape how Amazon operates and grows? As a Transaction Manager III, you will lead complex lease, renewal, and build-to-suit transactions across a dynamic portfolio. You will define transaction strategies where none exist, navigate ambiguity, and drive results that directly influence network capacity and long-term business goals. This role calls for someone who is resourceful, collaborative, and skilled at turning data into actionable recommendations — someone who thrives when partnering across teams to solve real problems with real consequences. If you are energized by negotiation, strategic thinking, and making things happen in the world of commercial real estate, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead complex real estate transactions — including leases, renewals, acquisitions, dispositions, and build-to-suit deals — from strategy development through execution, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and network capacity goals.
- Drive due diligence activities by evaluating reports, identifying risks, onboarding new providers, and aggregating data from multiple sources to deliver clear recommendations to internal and external partners.
- Oversee critical-date reporting and portfolio management processes, ensuring accuracy and quality while identifying opportunities to optimize asset value and mitigate risk across the portfolio.
- Build and maintain strategic relationships with brokers, developers, landlords, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams, managing expectations and aligning priorities to reach consensus on transaction decisions.
- Author effective narratives and present recommendations to senior leadership, clearly communicating trade-offs, progress, and outcomes while proactively identifying process improvements that streamline project delivery.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing critical-date reports and preparing a cash flow analysis for an upcoming lease renewal. By midday, you are leading a call with a developer and internal partners to align on milestones for a build-to-suit project, flagging risks and proposing solutions in real time. In the afternoon, you draft a narrative summarizing transaction options for a director review, then connect with your broker to evaluate new market opportunities. Throughout it all, you are mentoring teammates and finding ways to simplify how your team works.

About the team
Our team is at the center of Amazon's real estate strategy, ensuring the right spaces are secured to support business growth. We work closely with business units, legal, finance, and external partners to deliver transactions that have a tangible impact on how Amazon serves its customers. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a willingness to challenge assumptions in pursuit of better outcomes. If you are looking for a team where your expertise in real estate transactions will directly shape Amazon's future, this is the place for you.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in architecture, engineering, business, management, real estate or another related field

- Fluent in English and Italian (speaking, writing, and reading)

title: Data Center Operations Technician, Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.

Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.

title: Global Web Publishing Lead, Amazon Supply Chain Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) is seeking an experienced Global Web Publishing Lead to join the ASCS Global Websites team. This role is central to how ASCS delivers and scales web content across multiple domains and international markets — combining hands-on publishing execution with program management and analytics.
Amazon Supply Chain Services opens Amazon's world-class logistics network to businesses of all sizes — enabling sellers and shippers to leverage the same fulfillment, transportation, and supply chain capabilities that power Amazon. As we continue to scale globally, our web presence is critical to how we connect with customers across markets.
As the Global Publishing Lead, you will own publishing operations across the ASCS web ecosystem — driving content delivery, finding publishing efficiencies, and coordinating cross-functionally to ensure content flows consistently across all domains and regions. You will own the day-to-day publishing rhythm, manage the contractor resource, and drive process improvements that enable the team to do more with less. You will also own the localization program end-to-end — managing translation workflows, regional content publishing, and localization QA across all international sites. Additionally, you will serve as the team's analytics execution engine — building dashboards, executing A/B tests, and producing the performance reporting that informs strategic decisions.
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, operationally strong, and energized by bringing structure to fast-moving content operations. You take ownership of your work, communicate proactively with stakeholders, and constantly look for ways to improve processes and deliver results more efficiently.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead global publishing operations across all ASCS web properties, coordinating cross-functionally with content, product marketing, editorial, and regional teams to ensure timely, high-quality content delivery
- Identify and implement publishing efficiencies — streamlining workflows, reducing cycle times, automating repetitive tasks, and establishing scalable processes that grow with the portfolio
- Own the website localization program end-to-end: manage translation vendor relationships, coordinate regional content publishing, run localization QA, and ensure culturally appropriate experiences are delivered on time across all international markets
- Manage the publishing contractor, assigning work, reviewing output quality, and ensuring coverage across all domains and regions
- Build and maintain web performance dashboards in Adobe Analytics, tracking traffic, conversion, engagement, and page speed; produce bi-weekly and monthly performance reports for the team and leadership
- Supports A/B and multivariate testing by QAing test implementations, flagging conflicts with scheduled publishing, and ensuring test pages meet content and formatting standards before going live
- Own the publishing intake queue and P1/P2/P3 triage process, ensuring requests are prioritized appropriately and blockers are escalated
- Partner with the Web Strategy & Program Lead on new market launches, transitioning ongoing regional publishing into the localization program once initial site setup is complete; coordinate with the Experimentation Lead to ensure testing schedules do not conflict with publishing timelines.


About the team
The Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) Global Websites team is responsible for the web presence that powers ASCS marketing worldwide. We build, manage, and scale the digital experiences that connect Amazon's supply chain solutions — including fulfillment, transportation, and logistics services — with businesses across multiple regions and languages. Our team operates at the intersection of marketing, technology, and customer experience, driving innovation in how we deliver web content at global scale.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with basic HTML, website management and content management systems (CMS)
- Experience in a multi-language publishing environment, including globalization for translation
- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or equivalent
- 4+ years of experience in web publishing, web operations, content operations, or digital program management
- Experience with web analytics platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics) and building dashboards or reports to track site performance
- Experience managing vendors, contractors, or external agency resources
- Demonstrated ability to improve and scale operational processes in a fast-paced environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in A/B testing
- Knowledge of mobile and web design patterns and accessibility standards
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience with Brightspot CMS or similar enterprise CMS platforms
- Working knowledge of SEO best practices and how they inform content publishing and page optimization
- Experience supporting international web properties or multilingual content operations
- Experience creating and managing intake/triage processes for content or publishing requests

title: Instock Manager, WWGS Inventory Management
descriptionHtml:
Join the Worldwide Grocery Store Inventory Management Team in reshaping the future of grocery shopping for our customers. The North America Inventory Management organization is seeking an Instock Manager to join the Shrink & Quality team. This role will support shrink reduction and inventory health across the grocery network, with a particular focus on Sub Same Day and Grocery Fulfillment Center (FC) operations. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with Inventory Management, Category, Operations, Finance, Business Intelligence and Tech teams to identify shrink drivers, translate data into actionable insights, and drive actions that improve inventory health and reduce waste.

- Own recurring analysis and reporting of shrink performance, identifying site-, category- and ASIN-level drivers and escalating emerging risks.

- Support development and execution of shrink-reduction initiatives across SSD / FC.
