title: WHS Manager, Workplace Health & Safety
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are committed to ensuring our operations ensure a safe and healthy workplace. As our 3P quick commerce operations continue to evolve in a demanding work environment, we are seeking a dedicated Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to lead our 3P WHS team. The ideal candidate will have experience of operating in complex supply chains, across multiple jurisdictions with both under the roof and on the road risk management. They will develop and implement safety standards in this unique operating environment, lead projects to raise safety awareness, and support management's efforts to ensure compliance with all program expectations and applicable regulations. With your proactive approach, you will help drive a safety culture by conducting regular audits, managing safety metrics, and providing guidance on safety-related processes across our quick commerce operations. You will play a crucial advisory role for associates and managers while helping investigate accidents, near misses and incidents to determine root causes and implement preventive measures.

Key job responsibilities
• Conduct regular site visits across dark stores to evaluate safety conditions in fast-paced, high-throughput environments, providing practical recommendations to reduce risk and improve operational safety.
• Perform risk assessments and safety audits covering in-store and on-road operations, rider activities, material handling, and equipment usage, ensuring compliance with local regulatory requirements.
• Monitor, analyze, and report on safety performance metrics, incident data, and leading indicators, identifying trends and prioritizing risk areas within quick-commerce operations.
• Develop and implement new safety controls, procedures, and mitigation measures tailored to dark store layouts, rapid picking processes, and rider dispatch activities.
• Ensure compliance with Amazon supply chain, WHS, and third-party safety policies, as well as applicable local and regional regulations across assigned countries.
• Lead daily/weekly safety briefings, stand-ups, and safety discussions with operations teams and third-party partners to reinforce safety expectations in high-tempo environments
• Support incident, near-miss, and serious injury investigations, ensuring timely reporting, accurate documentation, root cause analysis, and corrective action tracking.
• Support safety training completion for associates, riders, and third-party partners, and verify training effectiveness through observations, audits, and engagement.
• Attend and actively contribute to regional and cross-functional WHS meetings, representing quick-commerce safety risks, trends, and priorities.
• Own and drive country or regional WHS continuous improvement projects related to quick-commerce operations, extending beyond individual scope where required.
• Build the WHS team, hire and develop the best and provide coaching and guidance to team members.

About the team
This role is dedicated to providing Workplace Health and Safety support to the Quick Commerce team. Quick Commerce (QC), also known as Amazon Now, is Amazon's ultra-fast delivery service designed to get orders to customers in under 30 minutes. Here are some key things to know about Quick Commerce: What It Delivers:
• High-frequency everyday essentials like groceries, fresh produce, perishables, and household staples
• Delivered from strategically located micro-fulfillment warehouses
• Utilizing multiple transport nodes including motorbikes, e-bikes, walkers
Where It Operates:
• Currently available in UAE, KSA and Egypt
• Growing rapidly with plans to TR and ZA

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing a team
- 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in WHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience
- A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent), or NVQ Level 3
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
- Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent degree) in a health and safety-related subject

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience of safety management in both under the roof and on the road operations.

title: On Site Medical Representative, OnsiteMedicalRepresentive
descriptionHtml:
El Representante Médico en Sitio (OMR, por sus siglas en inglés) es el profesional de salud responsable de la atención médica de primer contacto en el Centro de Distribución o Estación de Entrega. Su función principal es atender lesiones y malestares de los asociados mediante primeros auxilios, identificar de forma proactiva riesgos ergonómicos y de seguridad en las tareas operativas, y contribuir a la implementación del programa de bienestar del sitio.
#AmazonMexico


Key job responsibilities
• Realizar la clasificación inicial (triaje) de asociados que se presenten con lesiones o malestares, brindar primeros auxilios y, cuando sea necesario, canalizarlos a un proveedor médico externo.
• Documentar y mantener actualizados todos los registros de atención médica proporcionada a los asociados.
• Administrar los botiquines de primeros auxilios: llevar el control de inventario, reabastecer insumos y asegurar que el equipo utilizado esté limpio y en condiciones de uso.
• Capacitar a gerentes y asociados en temas de prevención, primeros auxilios y protocolos de emergencia.
• Elaborar y entregar bitácoras diarias de actividad al equipo de liderazgo del sitio.
• Generar un análisis mensual de todos los incidentes de salud y seguridad ocurridos en el sitio.
• Asistir y participar de forma constante en las reuniones de inicio de turno ("stand-up").
• Rotar turnos según las necesidades operativas del sitio. Este puesto es presencial y no admite trabajo remoto.

A day in the life
Reportarás directamente al Gerente de WHS (Seguridad, Salud y Bienestar en el Trabajo). Serás el representante médico asignado a un sitio específico, donde administrarás la sala de AmCare: atenderás casos de prevención de salud ocupacional y emergencias médicas, gestionarás el inventario y la adquisición de insumos médicos, e inspeccionarás periódicamente el equipo de emergencia (DEA, camillas, botiquines). Serás responsable de mantener la confidencialidad de la información médica de los asociados y de garantizar el acceso controlado a la sala de AmCare.

About the team
Cultura de equipo incluyente
En Amazon abrazamos nuestras diferencias y estamos comprometidos con seguir fortaleciendo nuestra cultura de inclusión. Ofrecemos experiencias de aprendizaje anuales y continuas. La cultura de inclusión de Amazon se refuerza en nuestros 14 Principios de Liderazgo, que recuerdan a los integrantes del equipo buscar perspectivas diversas, aprender y ser curiosos, y ganarse la confianza.
Equilibrio entre vida personal y laboral
Creemos que lograr el equilibrio adecuado entre tu vida personal y profesional es fundamental para la felicidad y la realización a lo largo de la vida. Ofrecemos flexibilidad de horario y te animamos a encontrar tu propio equilibrio entre tu trabajo y tu vida personal.
Mentoría y crecimiento profesional
Nuestro equipo está dedicado a apoyar a los nuevos integrantes. Contamos con una amplia variedad de niveles de experiencia y antigüedad, y estamos construyendo un entorno que celebra el intercambio de conocimiento y la mentoría. Nos importa tu crecimiento profesional y buscamos asignar proyectos con base en lo que ayude a cada integrante del equipo a desarrollarse como un profesional más completo.

Basic qualifications

- • Título de Licenciatura como Médico Cirujano o Licenciatura en Enfermería.
- • Cédula federal vigente.
- • Tarjeta vigente que acredite la aprobación de un curso de Primeros Auxilios, RCP y uso de DEA emitida por la American Heart Association o la Cruz Roja Americana, o bien, disposición para obtenerla dentro de las primeras cuatro semanas posteriores a la contratación.
- • Manejo de productos y aplicaciones de Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Preferred qualifications

- • Certificación como Técnico en Urgencias Médicas (EMT-Básico) por la Cruz Roja o institución equivalente.
- • Conocimiento básico de formatos del IMSS y documentación administrativa relacionada con salud ocupacional.

title: Business Analyst, Network Strategy & Performance, Network Strategy and Performance
descriptionHtml:
Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. They operationalize the long- and short-term staffing plans, working cross-functionally with site Operations, planning teams, training, finance, and others. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset.

Key job responsibilities
• Create and accurately maintain CSA shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL).
• Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL.
• Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities.
• Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery.
• Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan.
• Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences.
• Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need.
• Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages.
• Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. Highlight and communicate metrics impacting the operation that could impact service levels, customer experience, and business process.
• Build and maintain validation checks, dashboards, and automated alerts to catch defects early — before they impact customers or operations.
• Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs.
• Apply AI tools to develop automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.


About the team
The Network Strategy and Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.
We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.
The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

- 2+ years of experience in business analysis, data analysis in supply chain domain or related analytical role.

- Proficient in Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots) and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Quick Sight, or Power BI.
- Experience in financial/business analysis — defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights.
- Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and ambiguous environment, combining analytical rigor with sound judgment.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present analysis clearly and concisely to senior stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

- Demonstrated experience building automation solutions using Python, R, or similar tools.
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into workflows to drive efficiency and developing side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks.
- Understanding of network planning, workforce management, or contact center operations.

title: S&OP Manager, Integrated Business Planning
descriptionHtml:
The S&OP Manager owns Brazil Retail's weekly and monthly S&OP cycle end-to-end: reconciling demand and supply, translating the plan into an executive-grade narrative, and orchestrating the cross-functional decisions that come out of it. This is a Business Planner & Orchestrator role, going beyond the statistical forecasting analyst. The S&OP Manager doubles down on the business inputs, the "so what," and the cross-functional alignment that turn a forecast into a decision.
The person in this role is the connective tissue between Vendor Managers, Finance/FP&A, SCOT, Operations, and IBP leadership on the weekly and 3–month planning horizon.

Key job responsibilities
Own the monthly S&OP cycle:
- Run the Brazil Retail weekly S&OP process and reports: demand review (NWD), supply review (NVF), financial reconciliation, executive readout.
- Reconcile topline and product family (PF)-level demand with buying, inventory, and Finance targets; land a single approved consensus plan per cycle.
- Author the S&OP narrative for the MBR and cross-functional forums for Retail

Consume OP1/OP2 as inputs; own the tracking loop
- Receive OP1 and OP2 approved plans from the Business Planning pillar and Finance as inputs to the S&OP cycle.
- Track actuals vs. OP plan weekly and monthly at topline and PF level; publish variance with named business drivers, not "unknown" placeholders.

title: Software Development Engineer, Ads AI Core Infrastructure (ACI), Ads AI Core Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Ads, we're re-imagining the advertising landscape through advanced generative AI technologies and AI agents, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands online. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle — from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights.

The Ads Agent Fabric team delivers the AI infrastructure platform that accelerates agentic application development from months to weeks. We build the agent-builder SDK with pre-integrated Ads features, developer tools that accelerate the develop, test, and model evaluation lifecycle, and a fully-managed stateful runtime with integrated access to Ads services, data, and foundational models. Our platform solves core production challenges: managing execution state across multi-step reasoning and multi-agent orchestration, enabling resumability through checkpointing and task queues for long-running workflows, and providing memory primitives that enable stateful experiences where agents remember and learn across sessions.

You will build Tier-1 services to handle millions of requests per day, while maintaining response latencies in the milliseconds and meeting strict SLA requirements. You will develop distributed solutions with service-oriented architecture to build high-performance platforms powering the next generation of AI-driven advertising experiences. Our systems and algorithms operate on massive datasets using distributed frameworks. In this role, you will design new and rebuild existing solutions for the fast-growing scale of agentic infrastructure — including stateful runtime services, and pre-built platform components that agent-builder teams rely on to ship production agents.

You will not merely go through the full software development cycle but more importantly drive appropriate technology choices for the business, lead the way for continuous innovation, and shape the future of AI-powered advertising at Amazon.

We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun-loving team building at the forefront of AI agent infrastructure. We are entrepreneurial and have a bias for action with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on the future of AI agents in the Amazon Advertising business.

A successful candidate will have the satisfaction of seeing their work power thousands of AI agents serving millions of advertisers globally, broaden their technical skills across distributed systems and ML infrastructure, and work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation.



Key job responsibilities
SDE-2s are autonomous contributors to their team's software. You deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle including working backwards from customers, software design, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and documentation.

SDE-2s coach others on producing high-quality code, using processes such as code review as a teaching mechanism. They ensure that when their software fails, the root cause is identified and eliminated with a permanent fix. They ensure the software they produce can be maintained and extended by those not familiar with the code by writing clear documentation and making good design choices.

SDE-2s participate in an inclusive, constructive dialogue with other team members and members of closely related teams. They train new team members on how their software is constructed, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.



About the team
Agent Fabric is Amazon Ads' AI infrastructure platform. We extend AWS AgentCore with advertising-specific capabilities and a managed, stateful runtime, cutting agent development from months to weeks. We own the platform end-to-end: the agent-builder SDK, the runtime that executes agents in production, and the knowledge and governance layers that keep it safe and accountable at scale. Our systems are in the critical path for GenAI projects across Amazon Advertising.

Stateful Runtime & Orchestration: an orchestration framework that turns a single agent turn into durable, resumable work: async conversations that persist after a turn ends and notify on completion, scheduled and event-driven workflows, and multi-step DAG execution with fan-out, cancellation, and retry. Checkpointing, task queues, and short- and long-term memory let agents resume and learn across sessions.

Knowledge Base: the RAG Knowledge Base that grounds advertiser answers across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP, reporting, and optimization. We run the KB agent, an OpenSearch vector index, and a daily ingestion pipeline spanning published and partner-curated content, with eval gates that enforce retrieval quality before every rebuild.

Pre-Built Ads Components: delegated advertiser authorization, privacy-safe logging, policy guardrails, real-time data access, and context handoff between agents.

Metering & Throttling: metering every invocation across model calls, tool calls, memory operations, and session time, then enforcing per-user and per-advertiser limits on a sub-millisecond path to protect the platform from abuse.

Operational Excellence: parallelization for low latency, human-in-the-loop approvals, end-to-end tracing, security isolation, cost attribution, and versioned deploys with rollback.

descriptionHtml:

Do you dream of working in a role where your talent with Sound, Acoustics and next-generation data center design can be merged? Do you want to expand your current knowledge of building systems while providing input from your previous experience? Have you ever wondered what it is like to be able to influence construction on a global scale? YES! Then keep reading….

In this role you will influence all aspects of acoustics and sound mitigation for mechanical design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our global fleet of data centers. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the various sound mitigation features that our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance-based design approaches. As an Owner, you will strive to ensure the acoustic features of our buildings comply with local ordinances and will work with our due diligence teams to identify, measure, study, and report on the local considerations around our data center sites. You will review all design disciplines to ensure they meet the site acoustic requirements described in our design standards. In some cases, you will oversee and review this work and in other cases you will perform the work yourself.

As the team’s subject matter expert, you will ensure that contractors have the information they need to build our data centers the way we expect them to, and that our operations teams are well equipped to operate and maintain them as needed to meet our goals. As part of this role you will work with internal and external stakeholders, including design, construction, commissioning, operations, vendors, and other service providers, as well as local building officials. title: SLAM Software Engineer, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
RIVR, an Amazon company, is building Physical AI by deploying autonomous robots for real-world doorstep delivery. Operating daily in diverse urban environments, RIVR's robots continuously learn from and navigate the millions of scenarios encountered during deliveries. By owning the full stack from software to hardware, RIVR is purpose-built for safety, reliability, and the customer from day one.

Our robots require precise and real-time localization, which they achieve by utilizing onboard sensors such as IMUs, lidar, cameras and GNSS. In environments without existing maps, the robot must dynamically create a map while simultaneously localizing itself within it. As our next SLAM Engineer on a growing team, you will be an expert in laser- and camera-based localization techniques and SLAM and enhance these capabilities. You will shape our robots’ ability to navigate with pinpoint precision, and you will be part of a team focused on enabling our robots to navigate autonomously. If you are passionate about robotics and driven to innovate in SLAM and localization, we encourage you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.

Key job responsibilities
Develop state-of-the-art, online and offline localization and SLAM algorithms by fusing information from cameras, LiDARs, IMU, GNSS, and other sensors.
Design, validate, and improve algorithms on challenging real-world data.

Contribute to the dynamic mapping of the environment using data continuously gathered from ongoing robot deployments.

Assist in the creation of robust sensor calibration systems that perform reliably in complex and unpredictable environments.

Support the development of an efficient workflow to accurately capture ground truth data, and maps of deployment sites for algorithm evaluation.

Contribute to the implementation of deployment-ready code for the real robot, optimized for the robot’s computational constraints.

Create and maintain documentation and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

Basic qualifications

- A minimum of 3 years of industry or research experience.
- Background in computer vision, robotics or autonomous driving, with experience in areas such as 3D visual or LiDAR SLAM, place recognition, structure from motion, filtering, or Bayesian estimation.
- Strong mathematical fundamentals including linear algebra, vector calculus, probability theory, and mathematical optimization.
- Ability to write production-level code in modern C++, and prototype efficiently in Python.
- Experience with deploying SLAM or localization algorithms on hardware platforms.
- Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a similar discipline.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with state of the art deep learning algorithms for SLAM and localization.
- Publications at top-tier conferences.
- Experience with ROS/ROS2.

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to be part of AI revolution? At Amazon our vision is to make deep learning pervasive for everyday developers and to democratize access to AI hardware and software infrastructure. In order to deliver on that vision, we’ve created innovative software and hardware solutions that make it possible. AWS Neuron is the SDK that optimizes the performance of complex ML models executed on AWS Inferentia and Trainium, our custom chips designed to accelerate deep-learning workloads.

This role is for a software engineer in the Compiler team for AWS Neuron. As part of this role, you will be responsible for building next generation Neuron compiler which transforms ML models written in ML frameworks (e.g, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX) to be deployed AWS Inferentia and Trainium based servers in the Amazon cloud. You will be responsible for solving hard compiler optimization problems to achieve optimum performance for variety of ML model families including massive scale large language models like Llama, Deepseek, and beyond as well as stable diffusion, vision transformers and multi-model models. You will be required to understand how these models work inside-out to make informed decisions on how to best coax the compiler to generate optimal implementation instruction. You will leverage your technical communications skill to partner with internal and external customers/stakeholders and will be involved in pre-silicon design, bringing new products/features to market, ultimately, making Neuron compiler highly performant and easy-to-use.

Experience in object-oriented languages like C++/Java is a must, experience with compilers or building ML models using ML frameworks on accelerators (e.g., GPUs) is preferred but not required.
Experience with technologies like OpenXLA, StableHLO, MLIR will be added bonus!

For this reason, eligibility for this role will be limited to individuals who pass a security screening, as required by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and TSA (as applicable).

This position is therefore designated as a safety sensitive position and is subject to mandatory pre-employment and, where permitted, post-hire drug testing.


A day in the life
The AvSec Manager will ensure the security of Amazon's associates, assets and data at an AIR Cargo facility. You will lead site compliance with TSA regulations, Amazon Policies and Procedures, and local regulations. This includes developing and driving engagement strategies for Amazon associates and leaders, to drive compliance. A successful candidate will become a subject matter expert on site security infrastructure, policies and procedures, and regulatory compliance. AvSec is a liaison with any law enforcement or government/regulatory officials that visit the site.

Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll contribute to strategic security initiatives. You'll analyze incident trends to identify systemic issues, participate in regional security planning discussions, provide input on policy development, and help shape AvSec's approach to emerging aviation security challenges. This role provides a pathway to develop strategic thinking skills while maintaining strong tactical execution.


About the team

The organization is committed to identifying and mitigating risk to people, Amazon assets, Amazon brand and regulatory compliance through the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of best-in-class aviation security procedures, standards and guardrails between which Amazon operates. By supporting our customer teams at fulfillment centers and AIR sites to implement process improvements, mitigate risk, resolve equipment issues, and implement new processes to improve performance, AvSec contributes to safe and secure transportation of air cargo to our customers.

title: Finance Manager, Prime Video APAC
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video Marketing is entering a defining chapter. Over the next three years, our content slate scales meaningfully, and marketing must grow its impact faster than its budget. Getting there depends on making sharper investment choices — concentrating spend behind the biggest opportunities, rebalancing toward high-growth markets, building scalable channels, and reinvesting automation-driven savings into working media. Finance is central to making those choices with rigor and conviction.
We are looking for a Finance Manager to serve as the finance business partner to Prime Video Marketing across the APAC region, working alongside the APAC Marketing Director (based in Mumbai). This is first and foremost a strategic business partnering role: you will shape investment decisions, drive allocation rigor, and own the measurement that connects marketing spend to customer and business outcomes. You will also partner closely with Worldwide Prime Video Marketing Finance and the Worldwide Marketing team to align on approach and ensure regional plans and learnings connect to the global picture.
This is a builder’s role at the intersection of finance, marketing, and technology — helping deliver the multi-year marketing strategy, not just report on it.


Key job responsibilities
- Strategic business partnering: The trusted finance partner to the APAC Marketing Director and marketing leaders, bringing financial framing and a clear "so what" to decisions across the region.
- Investment decisions and allocation: Drive rigor in how marketing invests — translating growth opportunity, revenue per subscriber, and effectiveness into a defensible allocation across markets, channels, and titles, and calibrating targets to performance.
- Measurement and ROI: Own the financial view of marketing effectiveness and return, standardizing metrics (ROAS, cost per incremental outcome, incrementality) to shift spend toward the highest return.
- Marketing efficiency: Help the business do more with each dollar and reduce the cost of getting marketing to market.
- Planning: Support OP1/OP2 and long-range planning, coordinating inputs and co-authoring leadership narratives.
- Enabling AI-driven outcomes: The business builds the AI; Finance ensures the intended outcomes and savings land, and is AI-savvy enough to build the dashboards the business needs.
- Vendor and agency economics: Evaluate fees and vendor selection and quantify build-vs-buy trade-offs.
- Worldwide partnership: Align methodology with WW PV Marketing Finance and Marketing and connect regional plans to the global view.
- Reporting: Consolidate APAC inputs into a single view; lead close and variance analysis.
- Process improvement: Drive automation across consolidation and reporting.

A day in the life
- You partner with marketing leaders across APAC to pressure-test investment decisions, reallocating toward the outcomes and markets where each dollar works hardest.
- You surface insights on efficiency, incrementality, and return, and bring a crisp point of view to management.
- You build and maintain the dashboards and views — increasingly using AI-enabled tooling — that give the business timely visibility into marketing performance and efficiency.
- You work with vendor, agency, and automation stakeholders to sharpen the economics of how marketing is produced and delivered.
- You act as the connective tissue between APAC marketing teams, Worldwide Marketing Finance, and regional finance — ensuring marketing financials are accurate, consistent, and clearly communicated.

About the team
This role sits within APAC Prime Video Finance, part of Prime Video International Finance. We operate as business partners who shape investment decisions — not scorekeepers — bringing financial credibility and a business-partnership mindset to how marketing invests across the region. The role works closely with Worldwide Prime Video Marketing Finance and business team as key partners. AI and automation are a growing part of how marketing operates; the business team, with Product & Tech, develops these capabilities, and Finance partners with them to ensure the intended outcomes are realized and measured. Mumbai-based, collaborating across time zones.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science), or Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
- Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

Preferred qualifications

- CMA or CPA, or MBA in finance, accounting or related field
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in commercial finance business partnering or FP&A (at a multinational organisation), including influencing senior business partners and challenging assumptions
- Experience analyzing data quantitatively and using customer research, data and metrics to back up assumptions, identifying opportunities, and assessing the efficacy of marketing programs
- Experience in similar environments, or experience working with and managing third party vendors

descriptionHtml:
Drive transformation for leading Healthcare & Life Sciences organizations while shaping the future of patient care, drug discovery, and clinical innovation through AWS cloud and AI solutions.

Partner with senior leaders at global HCLS enterprises to accelerate their cloud adoption journey, delivering measurable business outcomes and strategic value.

About the Role

Customer Solutions Managers (CSMs) at AWS are obsessed with accelerating customer cloud adoption and driving measurable value from cloud investments. As a CSM in Healthcare & Life Sciences, you'll partner with senior leaders and engineering teams at global organizations to strategize and manage their end-to-end cloud and AI transformation journeys.

We help Healthcare & Life Sciences organizations adopt advanced cloud and AI solutions while migrating existing workloads to the cloud. Together with customers, we shape and execute strategies to build mindshare and broaden the use of AWS offerings across their enterprises.

If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

You will be a critical partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with large scale cloud transformations and helping shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.

You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. You will manage cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live events and transitions are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.

You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. You will be a peer leader, have the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate and lead virtual teams. Your enterprise cloud experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.

You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers for adopting them. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions and driving innovation, and also be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of customers’ successful migration to AWS.


Key job responsibilities

1/Accelerating AWS Adoption through Delivery and Execution

2/Identify & Align on Strategic Opportunities: CSMs work with the Customer Account team to work backwards from the customer to identify and pursue strategic cloud opportunities. These strategic cloud opportunities can include but are not limited to large-scale migrations, GenAI, data and analytics, digital innovation, high performance computing, product innovation, and business agility.

3/Customer Enablement, you will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams.

4/Implement governance structures to effectively govern both our partnership with the customer, and the customer’s adoption of AWS.
These interconnected focus areas will enable CSMs to effectively drive cloud adoption, pursue strategic growth opportunities, and empower customer success - all of which are critical to achieving the Automotive & Manufacturing IBU’s objectives. By aligning CSM activities, goals, and opportunities under these focus areas, the Automotive & Manufacturing CSM team can ensure a disciplined, customer-centric approach that maximizes business impact and revenue realization for AWS.

CSMs play a critical role supporting account teams/customers throughout the sales process, and the customer's cloud transformation journey, whilst consistently demonstrating measurable value to the customer regardless of engagement model.
CSMs are able to effectively coordinate cross-functional resources, drive disciplined project delivery, and quantify the tangible business benefits that customers realize through their cloud transformation initiatives. This holistic approach to customer engagement, coupled with the CSM's deep understanding of the Automotive & Manufacturing Industry and AWS capabilities; positions CSMs as trusted advisors who can guide customers through every stage of their cloud journey - from initial strategy and planning to migration, modernization, and ongoing optimization.

This position requires 15% - 30% travel across the calendar year to the customer.

Exceptional ability to lead through influence across diverse stakeholder groups

Critical thinking and self-motivation with proven ability to navigate ambiguity

Data-driven decision maker who uses metrics to measure success and drive improvements

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with ability to tailor messaging to different audiences

Innovative mindset with passion for solving complex customer challenges

title: Employee Relations Manager, Employee Relations
descriptionHtml:
The North American Employee Relations (ER) team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfillment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, this position’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories. This position focuses initially and primarily on proactive initiatives designed to promote employee experience. The ER Manager demonstrates the ability to collaborate with and influence stakeholder including, but not limited to: field operations managers, human resources, safety, legal and contractors; to analyze multiple levels of employee and partner feedback to identify risks and gaps; to create, audit, and sustain positive workplace relations programs; and to design and conduct positive workplace relations training that drives best practices. The position also works reactively on crisis-oriented situations that may arise at a single site/station, with a geographic region, or network-wide and typically must be successfully addressed under severe time constraints. Ability to balance time between projects, proactive initiatives, and crisis-response is a critical component for success in the position.

The Employee Relations Manager will possess employee relations expertise, excellent judgment, and highly developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills. The Manager will be comfortable both presenting to senior leaders and communicating with frontline employees. The successful Manager will be a strong project manager, capable of independently owning large-scale, network-wide projects. The Manager will quickly become an important “source of truth” regarding whether the organization is meeting its core values and principles.

This is a full-time position that reports to an Employee Relations Principal. The successful candidate must be capable of traveling domestically at least 50% of the time with potential for additional travel when necessary, and at times with short notice. descriptionHtml:
Do you want to own the financial strategy for a sub same day supply chain network from the ground up? Do you thrive in ambiguous, high-growth environments where you get to build the frameworks rather than inherit them? Do you want to be the finance leader who shapes how Amazon thinks about cost, routing, and investment for its fastest-scaling delivery program? If so, SSD Supply Chain Finance is looking for a Finance Manager with a record of achieving results.

The SSD Finance team owns the end-to-end cost architecture for Amazon's Same-Day Delivery network, the platform that ties together Amazon's biggest bets in Grocery, Drones, Ultra-Fast, and Robotics. This role will serve as the finance owner for the sub same day inbound supply chain, Amazon's fastest growing inbound freight and fulfillment program for general merchandise within the sub-same day network, managing lane-level transportation economics (cost per mile, utilization, total cost per unit), building cost models for new routing strategies, and partnering with Supply Chain and Operations leaders to drive the right investment decisions as the network scales.

The successful candidate will demonstrate an ability to influence business owners, support thoughtful decision-making, and adapt to a rapidly-evolving environment where the data infrastructure and planning frameworks are still being built. They will collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Operations, and Transportation, bring excellent verbal and written communication skills, and drive the highest-priority work forward in an environment where priorities shift weekly. A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to build financial models that directly inform network design decisions, partner with operations leaders on cost performance, and solve complex problems across inbound freight routing, carrier economics, and capacity planning that shape the future of Amazon's delivery network.

Key job responsibilities
• Owning the freight-in cost framework for the General Merchandise network, including lane-level cost per mile analysis, utilization tracking, and total cost per unit decomposition across Distribution Center to Same-Day Fulfillment Center, North American Customer Fulfillment to Same-Day Fulfillment Center, and 1DC to Same-Day Fulfillment Center lanes

• Building financial models and cost bridges for weekly and monthly business reviews that land on Director and Vice President desks, translating operational variances into actionable recommendations

• Partnering directly with Supply Chain and Operations leaders to validate routing assumptions, challenge capacity plans, and quantify trade-offs for network expansion decisions

• Identifying opportunities to reduce inbound transportation costs through data analysis, benchmarking key performance indicators, and developing new metrics where none exist today

• Contributing to planning cycles (Operating Plan, Quarterly Guidance) by building bottoms-up cost forecasts for a network that is actively scaling, requiring judgment calls on assumptions with limited historical data

• Implementing solutions to simplify, automate, and scale financial reporting processes, including contributing to AI-powered automation initiatives for Weekly Business Review reporting and entitlement tracking

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Finance Transformation and Analytics - North America Customer Fullfillment
descriptionHtml:
Finance is all about the numbers... unless you work in NACF Finance; here it is knowing the numbers and so much more. Amazon operates the most complex retail fulfillment network in the world, delivering billions of packages to hundreds of millions of homes and businesses every year. North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) Finance provides the cost controllership, return-on-investment analysis, and financial insight that keep the economics of that network healthy. We translate operational KPIs into financial impact so our stakeholders have the most reliable, up-to-date information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.
This is a perfect role for a finance expert with highly advanced data skills, or a data expert with strong ability and genuine interest in finance. You know how to turn large, messy datasets into advanced analysis, automation, and metrics that move the business. You view problems as treasures, you dive deep to find the root cause, and you are comfortable when your ideas and mechanisms are tested daily. You will sit at the center of a Hub-and-Spoke analytics team whose mission is to own the outcome of the NACF finance analytics function, not simply to produce more dashboards.


Key job responsibilities
1. Serve as an expert in both Finance and Data, bridging the gap between finance and data teams. Build deep understanding of the key cost-of-fulfillment drivers across the NACF network along with the related finance, accounting, and controllership systems and data.
2. Use solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models and analyze complex business problems with limited guidance.
3. Own the efficiency of financial reporting for a business area, identify and resolve complex data-integrity issues with stakeholders, and build data-analysis processes that are scalable and auditable.
4. Collect, analyze, and manage quantitative data and create meaningful metrics and tools that drive cost reduction and process improvement.
5. Write systems queries to gather finance data and perform data mining and analysis using Excel, SQL (required), and Python.
6. Lead root-cause analysis that uncovers core issues in the data, then partner with Operations to improve their competitive position and profitability.
7. Enable finance stakeholders to navigate data-driven solutions and datasets so they can confidently self-service their needs.
8. Apply AI to raise your own productivity and to automate financial workflows: use large language models and agentic development tools (for example AWS Kiro, Claude Code, and similar) to build analyses, tooling, and automation faster than traditional methods allow.
9. Identify, lead, and execute opportunities to improve, automate, standardize, or simplify finance tools and processes across teams and organizations.
10. Work with data-source providers and tech teams to ensure key decision data is accurate, automated, and timely.
11. Communicate data clearly and concisely, in writing and verbally, adjusting your style to the audience to make complex finance issues understandable. Draw conclusions, make recommendations, and challenge partner assumptions when necessary.


A day in the life
No two days in NACF Finance look alike. You will work in a fast-paced, high-energy, and ever-changing environment alongside Operations, Product, Tech, and Procurement partners. One day you may be building a cost model for a network initiative, the next automating a reporting process with an AI-assisted toolchain, the next root-causing a data defect that is distorting a leadership metric. You move with purpose and speed, think like an owner, and treat every day as Day One.

About the team
NACF Finance Transformation & Analytics is a centralized, Hub-and-Spoke analytics team that supports the full North American Customer Fulfillment network. The team is the front door for finance analytics: rationalizing the reporting landscape into one source of truth, delivering advanced analytics and deep-dive root-causing, and building AI-first automation that lets finance spend less time assembling data and more time answering the hard questions. You will partner with Senior Leaders across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Procurement, Accounting, and Technology as a trusted financial advocate and business partner.

title: Consumer Insights Manager (Japan), Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video reaches hundreds of millions of customers across more than 240 countries and territories, offering the broadest selection of movies and TV shows — all on demand, at any time, on any device. As we continue to grow, understanding what our customers want to watch next is at the heart of everything we do.

The Prime Video APAC Programming & Insights team is looking for a Consumer Insights Manager to lead customer-focused primary and secondary research projects across the region. In this role, you will serve as a center of customer voice for Prime Video in APAC — working closely with cross-functional stakeholder teams to shape customer-obsessed content and business strategies. You will partner with regional counterparts to build a strong insights foundation, establish scalable research mechanisms, and deliver actionable insights that inform decisions on a daily basis.

This role is based in Tokyo and primarily owns the audience insights roadmap for Japan, while also contributing to wider APAC Insights initiatives.

This role requires independent ownership of research deliverables. The ideal candidate will bring deep experience across a wide range of consumer research methodologies — both quantitative and qualitative. They will have robust experience creating strategic, actionable business recommendations from complex datasets, and hands-on expertise managing primary customer research studies and navigating stakeholder needs. They will skillfully manage multiple competing priorities to ensure high-quality, timely delivery of research, and thrive as a self-starter in environments of change and ambiguity.



Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end management of bespoke and streamlined consumer research projects — from ideation through delivery — including writing RFPs and questionnaires, analyzing primary and secondary data, and reporting results to stakeholders.
- Lead in-depth studies and conduct meta-analyses to produce consolidated learnings that support mid- and long-term business strategy.
- Design and implement scalable research mechanisms that ensure consistent insights delivery, contextualized with broader entertainment industry trends.
- Build collaborative relationships with cross-functional teams across Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, partnering with stakeholders to design consumer-focused research plans aligned with business goals.
- Collaborate on internal team initiatives to standardize best practices, streamline processes, and enhance impact.
- Contribute to the team's operational planning, including roadmap prioritization and resource coordination.

A day in the life
Your days will be varied — you might start by hosting a kickoff call to align on the scope of an upcoming research study with cross-functional teams, then review and respond to an ad-hoc audience insights and data request. By midday, you could be attending an org-level business review to provide audience inputs on emerging business questions at both service and title levels. Afternoons might focus on analyzing ongoing streamlined study data and writing a full report with rigorous analysis accompanied by actionable recommendations. Throughout it all, you will balance operational precision with strategic thinking across multiple studies and initiatives concurrently running at different phases across Business Planning, Content, Marketing, and Programming — and represent and advocate for the Prime Video customer in all analyses and meetings.

About the team
This role sits within the APAC Regional Programming & Insights team. The Insights function owns the full audience insights remit at both regional and local levels — covering Australia/New Zealand, Japan, and Southeast Asia — and drives customer-obsessed decisions across Business Planning, Content, Marketing, and Programming. The team serves as a trusted, strategic partner for cross-functional stakeholders.

As part of a broader regional team with colleagues throughout APAC, you will benefit from shared best practices while driving impact for your local audiences and business — Japan.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 5+ years of professional experience in market research or consumer insights
- Hands-on experience leading primary research studies, including both quantitative (e.g., online surveys) and qualitative (e.g., focus groups, ethnographies) methodologies
- Experience creating and delivering research reports and executive summaries that translate data into actionable business recommendations
- Experience communicating research findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the entertainment industry
- Experience on the research vendor side or within the insights function of a media, entertainment, or consumer business company
- Experience presenting research results and recommendations to senior leadership
- Demonstrated ability to operate with significant autonomy in ambiguous environments
- Understanding of marketing, measurement, and insights frameworks (e.g., brand tracking, campaign effectiveness)
- Experience with applied statistics, predictive analytics, and mixed-methodology research

title: Engineering Operations Tech (shift), Data Centre Engineering Operations (DCEO)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Critical Facilities Technician to join our Data Centre Engineering Operations (DCEO) team. In this role you will support the operation, monitoring and maintenance of the electrical and mechanical infrastructure that powers AWS cloud services.
AWS data centres operate 24/7 and rely on highly reliable power and cooling systems. As a technician in this environment, you will perform hands-on maintenance, equipment inspections, and troubleshooting to ensure infrastructure systems operate safely and reliably.
You will work as part of a team responsible for maintaining mission-critical equipment including power distribution systems, generators, UPS systems and cooling infrastructure.
This role operates on a shift rotation supporting 24/7 data centre operations.


Key job responsibilities
• Perform planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance on electrical and mechanical infrastructure systems
• Conduct routine plant inspections and equipment checks to ensure systems are operating correctly
• Monitor alarms and system performance using Building Management Systems (BMS) and other monitoring tools
• Assist with fault finding and troubleshooting across infrastructure systems including power distribution and cooling equipment
• Support operation and testing of critical systems including diesel generators, UPS systems, switchgear and cooling equipment
• Supervise specialist vendors performing maintenance or repair activities on site
• Follow permit-to-work and safety procedures for all maintenance and operational activities
• Participate in incident response and support troubleshooting during infrastructure events
• Maintain accurate maintenance records and operational logs
• Support testing activities including generator tests and infrastructure failover exercises


A day in the life
• Performing daily plant inspections across electrical and mechanical infrastructure
• Monitoring alarms and system status through the Building Management System (BMS)
• Responding to infrastructure alerts and assisting with initial troubleshooting
• Carrying out planned preventative maintenance tasks on site equipment
• Supporting generator tests and infrastructure system checks
• Supervising vendors performing maintenance activities
• Completing shift logs, plant status reports and operational handovers


About the team
The Data Centre Engineering Operations (DCEO) team is responsible for maintaining the critical infrastructure that supports AWS data centres. Our technicians operate and maintain complex mechanical and electrical systems that provide reliable power and cooling for AWS cloud services.
The team works in a highly operational, safety-focused environment, where attention to detail and strong technical skills are essential to maintaining service availability.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Experience working with electrical or mechanical infrastructure systems
- Hands-on experience performing maintenance, inspections or troubleshooting on plant equipment
- Willingness to work in a shift-based environment supporting 24/7 operations

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data center engineering
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience in managing and troublshooting network and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Electrical or mechanical qualification (apprenticeship, diploma or equivalent experience)
- Experience working in data centres, industrial facilities, manufacturing plants or critical environments
- Familiarity with Building Management Systems (BMS) or similar monitoring systems
- Experience working with permit-to-work or safety management systems

As a responsible engineer, you’ve learned never to make changes to production systems without a plan, so you reviewed then executed changes following a change management process to one of the production systems in your care. Later in the week, you help to resolve your team’s backlog of operational issues. You round off the week by writing a cool script that you shared with your team which helps get to root cause faster of a hard problem that you diagnosed earlier.

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Collectors
descriptionHtml:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for exceptional software development engineers to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 68 quadrillion metric observations per month and growing fast! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might root-cause a collection issue affecting a fleet of hosts, ship a new feature in one of our agents, take a change upstream to OpenTelemetry, or design a solution to a performance or footprint problem you have never seen before. You translate customer and internal requirements into designs, weigh the tradeoffs, and break the work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of senior and principal engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems.

About the team
We own telemetry collection for CloudWatch: the agents that run on millions of hosts and containers across AWS and gather the metrics, logs, and traces that everything else in CloudWatch is built on. Our software is written in Rust and Go and built on OpenTelemetry, and we contribute back to those open-source communities. We are a growing team in Dublin, and our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, low-overhead way to collect the telemetry their systems produce.

We invest in growing our engineers from day one. You will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers.

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Strong programming skills in at least two of the following: Rust, Go, Java, C++, Python

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Open-source enthusiasm and contributions (e.g. a GitHub portfolio, or contributions to projects such as OpenTelemetry)

title: Senior Product Manager — Billing and Accounting, Amazon Shipping
descriptionHtml:
Ready to build Amazon's next $100B business? We're not just entering shipping, we're transforming how billions of packages move around the globe. By evolving Amazon's legendary fulfillment engine into an agile, intelligent shipping network, we're creating a system that continuously optimizes to deliver on time, every time, for every business and every customer. Every shipment is more than just a box, it spins the flywheel faster, enhancing our logistics network through scale, speed, and intelligence. As we increase density and reach, we're revolutionizing shipping for all businesses while strengthening Amazon's own delivery capabilities, reducing costs and accelerating deliveries across our entire ecosystem.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager for Billing and Accounting in Amazon Shipping. This role exists to make getting paid effortless and trustworthy for our shippers, and predictable and well-controlled for the business, as we consolidate fragmented, region-specific billing systems into a more standardized flow.

You'll own execution of defined product workstreams across the invoice-to-cash lifecycle: how charges are billed, how invoices are presented, how customers pay, how disputes and adjustments are resolved, and how transactions reconcile to the ledger. You'll drive consolidation of legacy and interim billing systems, close functional gaps, and ensure accurate, compliant, and controlled financial outcomes across every marketplace we operate in. You'll turn complex billing and accounting requirements into clear product definitions, and partner across operations, pricing, payments, credit risk, accounting, tax, and engineering to deliver them.

You'll work at the intersection of finance, operations, and engineering, translating regulatory, accounting, and customer requirements into crisp product requirements, and turning them into billing experiences that scale as the business grows.

You'll collaborate closely with:

-Billing Operations teams who manage day-to-day shipper interactions on invoices, payments, and disputes
-Payments and Credit Risk product owners whose capabilities your billing workstreams depend on
-Pricing teams introducing new charges and rate structures that our systems must bill for
-Accounting teams who own the ledger and require accurate, compliant, and controlled financial records
-Tax (VAT) teams who own compliance and filings
-Engineering teams building the billing and accounting platform
-Senior leadership setting financial strategy and controls for the business

WHO ARE YOU?
You're a product leader who is equally comfortable digging into an invoice reconciliation, writing a crisp product narrative, and walking an accounting or operations leader through a control tradeoff. You have strong product sense and build the right thing, not just build the thing right, within a defined charter. You bring real financial and data fluency, enough to partner credibly with accounting, tax, and finance on controls and compliance, and with engineers on data and systems, and you understand how billing, invoicing, and reconciliation actually get done day to day. You decompose an undefined problem space into a clear, sequenced set of deliverables, define the metrics that matter, and let them guide prioritization. You communicate crisply across functional, operations, and leadership audiences, and you balance a bias for action with the judgment to know a one-way door from a two-way door. You're a strong owner who is right a lot, and you measure success by customer and business outcomes, accurate billing, on-time payment, clean reconciliation, and reduced disputes, not features shipped. You thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where product decisions directly impact billing accuracy, reconciliation, dispute rates, and cash flow across a rapidly scaling business.

Key job responsibilities
Product Execution & Delivery
- Own execution of defined billing and accounting product workstreams within the charter, connecting accurate, frictionless financial experiences to growth and control across the business
- Write the product narratives and requirements that define new capabilities and drive alignment across operations, pricing, accounting, tax, and engineering
- Balance near-term operational and compliance needs with longer-term investment in a consolidated billing platform
- Work with engineering to deliver billing and accounting capabilities into the platform and the tools operations teams use every day
- Make sequencing and scope tradeoffs to deliver impact incrementally while protecting live financial operations
- Define clear acceptance criteria for operational and accounting adoption

Metrics & Business Impact
- Own billing accuracy and reconciliation outcomes as primary success measures, along with supporting measures of dispute rate and days-sales-outstanding
- Establish mechanisms for continuous visibility, baselining, and proactive risk identification
- Quantify the impact of billing and accounting improvements on revenue assurance, cost to serve, and customer trust, and communicate results to leadership

Cross-Functional Influence
- Build alignment across operations, pricing, payments, credit risk, accounting, tax, and engineering through clear narratives and data
- Represent the voice of shippers and operations teams in product decisions
- Drive adoption of new billing and accounting capabilities across regions as systems consolidate

About the team
Amazon Shipping is the parcel shipping arm of Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), Amazon's portfolio of freight, distribution, fulfillment, and parcel shipping solutions, extending the logistics network built for Amazon's own operations to businesses of all types and sizes.

Billing & Payments sits at the financial heart of that flywheel. Every shipment a customer trusts us to move must be priced, billed, paid, and reconciled accurately, at massive scale, across currencies, geographies, and payment methods. Get this right, and shippers pay with confidence, disputes fall, and cash flows predictably. As Amazon Shipping grows, this team is building the billing and payments foundations that let the business scale without friction.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience delivering billing, invoicing, payments, or other financial-systems products
- Experience delivering billing, invoicing, payments, or other financial-systems products.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field, or a Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent) and experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, macros, SQL, visualization tools - Tableau, Quicksight, etc.
- Experience working with Finance, Accounting, Tax, and Payments partners as direct stakeholders

title: Fleet Operations Manager, Amazon Transportation Services
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) Mexico and help build our growing trailer fleet from the ground up. As a Fleet Operations Manager, you will own the daily tactical execution of Amazon's trailer fleet during a pivotal scaling phase; directly shaping fleet utilization, availability, cost-to-serve, and carrier performance. You will be the single point of contact for fleet operations: asset assignment, yard control, inspections, preventive maintenance, carrier coordination, and incident response. Working cross-functionally with First and Middle Mile site teams, Finance, and carrier partners, you will keep the fleet running reliably today while laying the operational foundation for the sites and regions we expand into tomorrow. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role where your execution and the data behind it inform decisions made at the most senior levels. This is your chance to help build and shape the future of our trailer fleet program from its earliest, most defining stage.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the weekly trailer assignment across sites and drive intra-week reassignments as demand shifts; making the calls that keep the network balanced under pressure.
- Run daily yard status reviews, classify fleet availability, and orchestrate relocations to maximize how hard every trailer works.
- Lead daily performance syncs with the carrier partner operating the fleet, setting the priorities and relocations for the day.
- Be the first responder for operational incidents and resolving within a increasing service level or escalating with a structured, decision-ready proposal.
- Coordinate pre-trip and post-trip inspections and drive preventive maintenance compliance to protect fleet uptime.
- Manage repair tickets end-to-end, tracking out-of-service units and return-to-service dates to minimize downtime.
- Build the daily operational reporting and clean datasets that leadership trusts to make scaling decisions.
- Design and tighten standard operating procedures for check-in/check-out and incident handling as the fleet grows into new sites and regions.

A day in the life
Your morning starts at the yard, one glance tells you which trailers are ready, which are stuck, and where the day's risks are hiding. You act before small problems become expensive ones. When a breakdown hits, the clock starts and you own it: coordinate the repair, keep the sites moving, resolve it fast. The rest of your day, you turn messy operations into the clear signals leaders trust to decide where we grow next. Every trailer you unblock sharpens how this fleet scales; from the sites we run today to the regions we're about to open. You help forge what comes next.

About the team
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS), a high-powered, dynamic team shaping middle-mile transportation execution and developing innovative concepts to enhance the ATS Network, now building and scaling Amazon's own trailer fleet in Mexico to drive the best customer experience, reliably and cost-efficiently, every time.

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

The AWS Networking organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Networking team. As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you will build systems that manage mission-critical networks with high availability and low operational overhead. You will work closely with internal and external software development teams to develop new products such as automated switch provisioning, automated event detection, and continuous workflow testing that improve the security and availability of our networks.

ADC Networking owns the entire lifecycle - design, build, deployment, scaling, sustaining engineering, and operations - of our networks connecting between and within the data centers for a dedicated customer region, interconnections to customer networks, and the solutions that enable remote access to these regions from secure operations facilities. You will develop, evolve, and optimize these systems, to help protect our customers and provide an improved experience.

Successful candidates have experience building highly distributed mission-critical systems, are self-directed, and love to work on challenging and complex problems. You are a passionate coder, who values simplicity of implementation leading to highly maintainable code that is well documented and easy to follow. Experience with computer networking concepts is preferred.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
You will drive software development initiatives to continually deliver new capabilities that meet the needs of our customers worldwide. Your experience leading software development projects will help us implement automated solutions across a variety of applications and systems.

You will:

- Lead projects to disambiguate and solve challenging distributed systems problems on a global scale.
- Develop best in class software systems for automating Amazon's network.
- Be responsible for the design, implementation, and quality of services you deliver.
- Learn, design, and build cloud-computing systems for a diverse set of customers and contribute to documentation of process and procedures.
- Use and develop tools and processes that collect & rationalize data from different sources and frameworks to reduce workloads.
- Use data to measure success and take responsibility for the quality of your service and, regardless of their source; Strive to prevent faults from impacting your customers.
