descriptionHtml:
The AWS Hardware Supply Chain Security (HSCS) organization is looking for a Hardware Security Operations Manager who has a passion for security and the curiosity to analyze and report conclusions on the integrity of AWS hardware at any stage in its life cycle. You will lead a team of hardware security engineers and work alongside them, both doing the technical work and growing the people who do it. You will partner with professionals around the world to help assess and mitigate risks in partner manufacturing and logistics, contribute to new mechanisms for defense and response, and analyze the ever-shifting threat landscape to help us prioritize continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to build and lead a team in a supportive, collaborative environment while helping secure the future of the cloud.

The HSCS organization exists to set the bar for AWS hardware life cycle security from design through end of life and drives durable mechanisms to meet requirements. If you have experience in areas such as modern semiconductor manufacturing and test, hardware/firmware analysis, or supply chain security, and you enjoy developing others, your expertise is needed more than ever and we are interested in talking to you.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with experience diagnosing and troubleshooting electronics PCB assemblies, including proficiency with test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, X-ray systems, shredders, and decap tools. They will demonstrate strong analytical judgment in interpreting test results and applying findings, supported by a solid understanding of hardware security fundamentals. They will have experience leading engineers or technicians, setting priorities for a team, and holding a high bar for the quality of technical work.

Key job responsibilities
Lead, hire, and develop a team of hardware security engineers, including setting goals, giving regular feedback, and managing performance
Plan and prioritize team workload across projects, balancing customer commitments, operational needs, and long-term capability building
Perform hands-on testing, automation, root cause analysis, and engineering artifact generation alongside the team
Own the development and review of SOPs for operation, equipment, testing, and analysis, and make sure the team follows them consistently
Review and approve engineering reports with the internal team and internal customers before publishing
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal customers and partner teams on the team's work, escalations, and results
Define and track operational metrics for the team and report status and risks to leadership
Drive a security mindset and provide guidance across all functions and operations

Manage lab equipment, assets, and resources, including identifying capability gaps and proposing investments
Lead continuous improvement efforts that increase the automation and efficiency of operations

In this role you will lead a team that assesses risks to AWS infrastructure by validating hardware security controls through inspection and testing of devices across the whole lifecycle, from suppliers through decommissioning. You will split your time between leading the team and doing the work. On a given day you might review a test plan with an engineer, troubleshoot a board on the bench, walk an internal customer through findings, and meet one on one with a team member about their development. You will implement, refine, and execute testing plans that use both simple and advanced techniques, oversee their execution, direct revision and follow-on testing, and make sure the analysis and reporting meets the bar before it goes out. descriptionHtml:

Shifts will be assigned upon starting in the role and could be subject to change based upon business need.

ABOUT AMAZON

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly employees and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with speed in which we can make items appear on their doorsteps. Rural Super Rural (RSR) is a subset of R2L dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces. Come build the future with us!

title: Hardware Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own

As an Infrastructure Reliability Engineer you will be proactively driving the reliability risk identification, assessment and mitigation for datacenter infrastructure & Security equipment (Example: Air Handling Units, LV Generator, Liquid Cooling, Power Gen, Chillers etc.). You will also be responsible for root cause analysis of critical equipment failures and drive the continuous improvements to improve datacenter availability & security for AWS customers. You will work closely with both internal and outside partners including suppliers to drive key aspects of product specification, risk identification plan and execution. You must be ownership minded, independent, action and results oriented to succeed in an open collaborative environment.

The candidate should have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based approach to develop and implement both analytical and empirical approaches for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during product design, manufacture as well as deployment stages. The individual should be able to drive AWS application-specific requirements in carrying out both lifecycle environmental and operational stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical, chemical and mechanical stresses so to identify overstress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. Candidate should be capable of evaluating not only product design quality/reliability risks, but also have the skills and experiences in assessing electronics manufacture process related quality/reliability issues. Knowledge of statistical techniques and models is required to analyze test as well as field data.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification and the associated vendor selection and qualification requirements. The candidate will be expected to use knowledge of process capability for electronic component production as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical to quality and reliability metrics.

At the system level, the individual will develop datacenter system level reliability model and related reliability quantification and risk analysis for datacenter configuration optimization. The candidate will be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and data analytics.

During sustaining stage, candidate will be responsible for monitoring product performance in the field and will be responsible to drive root cause analysis of any critical failures and the associated corrective and preventive actions. The individual should also be able to drive effective vendor auditing and quarterly review process to drive the continuous improvements of datacenter availability.

The successful candidate should be considered as an expert in the reliability engineering field and have a proven track record of success in not only product reliability leadership, as well as business negotiations and program management. Strong skill-set in problem analysis and solving as well as communication and vendor management are necessary. Candidates should also be able to travel within US and internationally.

title: Product Manager - Technical, ASCS Legal
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Legal is seeking a hands-on, AI-native Product Manager – Technical to transform how legal work gets done for Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS). This is a technical product role requiring deep architecture influence, sitting at the intersection of ASCS’s engineering roadmaps and the legal risks our team manages. You will spend the majority of your time building working AI agents and automation, and shaping how ASCS products are built alongside engineering.

As the ideal candidate, you bring enough technical depth to have credibility with the engineering teams you work with. You can dive into technical detail with engineers and drive constructive discussion, ask the right questions about technology choices and architecture trade-offs, spot risks and failure modes, recognize when the technical information you have been given is inaccurate or not yet well understood, and know when a design is complex enough to warrant a principal engineer’s review. You pair that with hands-on building: you have configured AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, and no-code and low-code platforms yourself, with the judgment to know when a tool is good enough to ship and the discipline to measure whether it actually gets used. And you carry enough legal-adjacent fluency (which is to say, you have worked alongside lawyers and understand why a privacy or commercial position matters) to be trusted in both the engineering room and the legal one. You read a manual process, separate the genuine judgment from the scaffolding, and you redesign the work so AI carries the process and the legal team is freed to focus on the judgment.

This role involves access to confidential legal information and requires a high level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

Key job responsibilities
Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that scale the legal team’s impact, which includes client-facing tooling that synthesizes existing legal guidance into interfaces that problem-solve quickly.

Own a clear customer experience and roadmap for legal tooling, and make the ongoing strategic decisions about direction and priorities that the product requires.

Engage credibly with ASCS engineering teams early in their roadmaps, evaluate technical proposals and architecture trade-offs, and shape design decisions alongside engineering to influence technical direction for compliance.

Identify technical intersections where compliance can be built into the product, foresee the consequences of design choices, and surface the associated legal risks back to the legal team.

Think big about how automation makes coordination unnecessary rather than merely faster, which enables the team to amplify and scale its impact.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Certificate Services
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to work at the intersection of security, encryption and every internet-connected device in the world? We're looking for Software Development Engineers to build the services that help our customers secure their websites, APIs and devices with digital certificates that just work.

Our organization owns everything "certificates" for Amazon. That includes AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) for managing TLS and other X.509 certificates, AWS Private Certificate Authority (PCA) for private certificate issuance, and AWS Signer for code signing. Our services help customers create, manage, and deploy digital certificates based on strong cryptography and public-key infrastructure (PKI) best practices.

Certificate lifetimes are getting shorter and Post-Quantum cryptography is coming, while certificates now secure everything from IoT devices to AI agent workloads. Demand for content signing is growing as creators and publishers look for ways to prove their work is original. Customers need certificate management that runs without manual work at any scale. Certificates sit underneath almost every secure connection on the internet, so the systems you build here protect customer traffic across AWS.

We want engineers who question the status quo and push leadership and peers to do the right thing for the right reasons. Good ideas come from every level of the team, and we act on them.

You'll choose the right technology for the problem and learn AWS's distributed-systems and deployment-safety practices. If you don't know certificates or PKI yet, you'll learn them here.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and operate distributed services where security and availability can't be compromised.

Take ambiguous requirements, clarify the problem with customers and partner teams, and deliver the simplest design that solves it.

Own features end to end, from design through testing, deployment, and operations, and make trade-offs between new features and operational work.

Participate in on-call, find the root cause of production issues, and deliver permanent fixes rather than workarounds.

Improve how the team builds and operates software, including tooling, testing, and deployment safety.

Write clear design documents and system documentation, give design and code review feedback, and mentor other engineers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 3+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution, or experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: web application development, penetration testing, mobile security, cryptography, public key infrastructure, forensic security, IP security, SSL/TLS, computer viruses and malware, network security, trusted security, trusted execution, threat intelligence, IoT security implications, or authentication

title: Coordinating Producer, LATAM, Prime Video Live Sports
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of Amazon's dynamic Live Sports Production team. We are looking for an experienced Coordinating Producer to serve as a centralised production lead across all our live sports properties in the LATAM region.

The Live Sports team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to customers worldwide, across all Prime Video product lines and devices. We are responsible for the on-screen customer experience and drive production excellence and consistency through all our delivery.

The growing volume and complexity across our properties demands a dedicated editorial presence in the LATAM region. This role will function as a first point of contact on all daily operational delivery across our soccer and NBA properties, ensuring consistency in our LATAM output, resolve any immediate vendor concerns in close collaboration with the EU and US internal production teams. Our operations is purpose-built around the needs of an expanding, multi-sport live portfolio rather than a single traditional broadcast network structure. We are defining and building as we evolve, and this person must be excited to roll up their sleeves and help establish the systems, relationships and workflows that will scale with us as our rights portfolio grows in LATAM.

This role requires deep knowledge and experience within live sport editorial production and programming, including current knowledge of the broadcast landscape in Brazil (and preferably the LATAM region) and have established relationships within the industry. The role will work in lockstep with EU and US production leads to define production deliverables across each property and set content strategy. The role will also work closely with internal stakeholders within Business, Marketing and Advertising Sales to ensure commercial needs of our business are operationalised. Additionally, this role will partner directly with our LATAM Production vendors to establish best practices, define operational standards for how vendors will deliver for us, and ensure alignment on processes and expectations across the vendor landscape.

The successful candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You possess the ability to manage high volume of tasks and varied projects quickly with autonomy, react with urgency to situations that demand immediate attention, and have a proven track record of end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment.

Key job responsibilities
Production Oversight & Execution – Oversee all LATAM Live Sports production, ensuring quality and consistency across properties with regular reporting on delivery. Operationalise property launches alongside Production Operations, contributing to budget discussions, aligning spend with editorial ambitions, and partnering with Technical Operations for best-in-class broadcast delivery. Own daily operational delivery, lead property syncs, and attend on-site and studio productions to provide vendor support. Lead vendors in troubleshooting editorial and operational issues through live productions, providing timely resolution and post-event escalation as needed.

Creative Direction & Editorial Standards – Act as editorial lead across the LATAM portfolio, building content strategy in collaboration with EU and US editorial leads. Use local knowledge, viewership data, and performance metrics to drive continuous improvements in production delivery. Build awareness of broadcast innovations, recommending editorial and programming changes that enhance production CX and delight customers.

Vendor & On-Screen Talent Management – Maintain oversight of on-screen talent line-ups, ensuring vendors contract, schedule, and coordinate talent to a high bar. Provide clear deliverables for production vendors and lead regular syncs to guide editorial execution and provide timely feedback.

Internal Stakeholder Management – Partner with the LATAM business lead to oversee the full production portfolio, representing production in local-territory discussions. Collaborate with Marketing and Advertising Sales to operationalise integrations, balancing editorial quality with promotional activities.

- Knowledge of the television and media industry
- Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
- Experience of digital sports content creation, strategy, audience development, or business development experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Applied Scientist II, Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience (GRAISE)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a talented Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

Key job responsibilities
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions

Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions

Own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment — collaborating with software and ML engineers to ensure models meet latency, throughput, and reliability requirements at production scale

Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements

Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency

Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes

Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems

Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team

A day in the life
As an Applied Scientist on the GRAISE team, you'll spend your days analyzing model performance from overnight experiments, collaborating with engineers to deploy computer vision models to production, and prototyping new approaches using multimodal learning with store video and sensor data. You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

About the team
The GRAISE team (Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience) within World Wide Grocery Store Tech (WWGST) builds foundational AI and machine learning systems that power Amazon's in-store grocery technologies. We develop domain-specific models that solve uniquely complex challenges in grocery — from smart shopping carts and inventory intelligence to personalization and store operations. Our mission is to create technology which makes grocery shopping more convenient, economical, personalized, and enjoyable for customers while empowering retailers with operational efficiency

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms experience
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with large sets of data and deriving practical insights
- 2+ years of deep learning, computer vision, human robotic interaction, algorithms implementation experience
- Experience developing and evaluating data annotation and data quality metrics
- Demonstrated ability to take a model from research prototype to production deployment — including performance profiling, latency optimization, and working within serving infrastructure constraints
- Track record of clearly documenting experiments, writing technical design documents, and communicating results to cross-functional partners

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

title: Senior Product Manager Tech, EFS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon EFS (Elastic File System) is looking for a dynamic and seasoned product leader to help define and build the future of cloud-based file storage. Customers around the world rely on Amazon EFS to provide scalable, elastic, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective shared file storage to support their growing infrastructure needs. Within EFS, you will work with a team that delivers fully managed, cloud-native file storage services with diverse customers ranging from startups to well-known enterprises. As a member of the broader Storage Services Product Management team, you'll join other highly respected product and engineering leaders to create the future of cloud file storage.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior PMT, you will own product strategy and delivery across the Amazon EFS portfolio, including Amazon S3 Files. Launched in April 2026, S3 Files is built on EFS to provide a shared file system for data in Amazon S3. Your customers are developers, builders, and IT teams running production workloads on AWS.
* Define the vision, PR/FAQs, and multi-year roadmap for EFS and S3 Files, working backwards from what customers are building, from ML training and data preparation to agentic AI, analytics, content management, and container storage.
* Drive integrations with AWS compute, AI, and analytics services and partners, along with core file system features, making smart tradeoffs on scope, schedule, and one-way doors.
* Partner with engineering on technical design, evaluating proposals for scale, performance, and extensibility, and define API requirements.
* Own pricing, packaging, messaging, and go-to market, and enable sales and solutions architects to drive adoption and migrations.
* Engage directly with technical customers, and own escalations through resolution, including the on-call rotation.
* Define success metrics, run business reviews, and drive operational improvements and cost reductions.
* Communicate strategy and results to AWS leadership, and mentor other PMs.


A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might start with a customer's engineering team, learning how they run workloads on EFS and S3 Files and what they need next. Later you work through a new feature design with engineering, defining performance requirements and weighing which decisions are hard to reverse. In the afternoon you might dig into usage data to see where customers get stuck, or help a solutions architect size a file system for a scaling workload. Throughout, you are the voice of the customer, turning what you hear into what the team builds next.

About the team

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 5+ years of P&L management and pricing experience
- 5+ years of creating written docs for development of new products experience

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
What if the data you engineer could stop fraud before it happens - and protect millions of AWS customers worldwide?
The Payments and Fraud Data Platform team within AWS Payments & Fraud is the backbone of one of the most critical missions at AWS: ensuring every transaction is safe, every suspension is justified, and every customer experience is seamless. We process petabytes of data daily, powering the ML models, rule engines, and real-time reporting systems that allow us to detect bad actors.
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is passionate about building large-scale data systems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to work at the intersection of big data, machine learning, non-payment and fraud prevention.

Key job responsibilities
Architect & Build Petabyte-Scale Data Pipelines - Design, develop, and optimize batch and near-real-time data pipelines using Amazon Managed Airflow (MWAA), Fargate, EMR, Apache Iceberg, and Amazon Redshift to ingest, transform, and serve data at massive scale.
Power ML & Rules Engines - Deliver high-quality, timely datasets that fuel non payment and fraud detection ML models and business rule engines, directly impacting fraud prevention and non-payment suspension accuracy.
Build Intelligent Data Access Layers - Design and implement a Smart Query & Data Access Analyzer that profiles query patterns, identifies hot data, and automatically promotes frequently accessed datasets into hot memory tiers (e.g., OpenSearch, DynamoDB DAX, Redshift RA3 caching) for sub-second retrieval.
Create Natural Language SQL Interfaces - Leverage Amazon Bedrock and LLM (large language models) to build a natural language-to-SQL generation tool that empowers analysts and stakeholders to query complex fraud datasets conversationally - no SQL expertise required.
Develop Real-Time Dashboards & Insights - Build rich, interactive dashboards using Grafana and internal tooling that provide real-time visibility into fraud trends, pipeline health, data quality metrics, and operational KPIs.
Curate a Living Data Dictionary - Design and maintain a comprehensive, searchable data catalog and dictionary that provides rich metadata, lineage, and documentation - improving discoverability and self-service analytics across the organization.
Champion Data Quality at Scale - Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the entire data lifecycle.
Secure & Govern Sensitive Data - Implement encryption, fine-grained access controls, audit trails, and compliance frameworks to protect highly sensitive payments and fraud data.
Monitor, Optimize, Repeat - Build observability into everything , proactive alerting, pipeline performance tracking, SLA monitoring, and intelligent auto-remediation to ensure five-nines data reliability.

About the team
The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team protects AWS and its customers from fraud, abuse, and account compromise at global scale. We build highly scalable, batch and near real-time systems that ingest billions of signals daily, process petabytes of data, and make timed decisions to stop bad actors from account registration through the entire customer lifecycle. Our platform is built on a modern, cloud-native architecture designed for petabyte-class batch processing. Our stack includes Amazon MWAA orchestrates workflows, while EMR and Fargate handle scalable data processing. Amazon Redshift powers our data warehouse, complemented by an Apache Iceberg lakehouse for open table format flexibility. DynamoDB and OpenSearch drives search and analytics, and Amazon Bedrock serves as our AI/ML foundation. Development is accelerated with Kiro, an AI-powered IDE, and Grafana provides full-stack observability.
We are a team of builders who care deeply about customer trust and love solving complex problems at massive scale.

descriptionHtml:
Interested in building the distributed systems that let customers customize foundation models at scale? The SageMaker Training and Model Customization team builds the services customers use to fine-tune and post-train models against their own accuracy, reliability, and cost targets. We are hiring a Software Development Manager to lead the team that owns those capabilities.

Model customization is the fastest-moving layer of the machine learning stack. Post-training has moved from supervised fine-tuning to reinforcement learning against verifiable rewards, and from single-turn tasks to agentic training where a model learns by acting in an environment over long trajectories. Each shift changes the shape of the workload. Reinforcement learning puts an inference engine inside the training loop. Agentic training adds environments and tool calls, and moves the bottleneck from one run to the next. Your team turns each new technique into a capability customers can use, without rebuilding the platform every time the research moves.

Underneath the techniques, this stays a hard distributed systems problem. Training jobs run across large accelerator fleets for days at a time, and a single node failure can stall the job. The team works in PyTorch and across frameworks including Verl, FSDP, Megatron and vLLM, and contributes upstream to the open source projects the platform depends on.

As the manager you own the team and its charter. You will hire and grow engineers, set technical direction with your senior engineers and product managers, and decide what the team does and does not build. You own the roadmap and defend its tradeoffs with leadership. You own the service in production, including on-call health, operational metrics, and the requests that come with sitting in the critical path of customer training workloads.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the team's charter and roadmap, and defend its tradeoffs with senior leadership.
- Hire, develop and retain engineers in a specialized field with a scarce talent pool.
- Set technical direction with your senior engineers, applied scientists and product managers.
- Decide what the team builds, and what it does not.
- Turn new post-training techniques into supported customer capabilities on a predictable schedule.
- Own the service in production, including on-call health, availability and operational metrics.
- Improve training throughput and cost per run across large accelerator fleets.

A day in the life
Your morning starts in a design review. The team is working out how to keep an inference engine and a training engine in the same loop for reinforcement learning without leaving accelerators idle, and the answer will shape the future of the platform. You deep dive into possible scenarios, because at this scale a node dies routinely and recovery has to be normal rather than exceptional.

Then a charter call. A new post-training technique is three months out of the research literature and two customers are already asking for it. With your senior engineers and product manager you decide whether it becomes a first-class capability, a recipe on top of what you already have, or a no. That decision is yours to make, and the industry does not wait for it.

You spend an hour in 1:1s, including a career conversation with an engineer who wants to own the parallelism work. After lunch you sit a hiring debrief and make the call. Later you meet the applied scientists to understand what they have validated, and you argue about sequencing.

You close the day writing a page for leadership: what you are not building this half, and why that is the right trade.

About the team
We build the managed services customers use to customize foundation models. A customer brings a task, a dataset, and a way to score a good answer. Our services run the post-training loop on their behalf. We own that entire path, from the customer-facing API down to the training session infrastructure and the accelerator fleet it runs on.

That makes this a foundational charter. Model customization is how a customer turns a general model into one that is theirs, and every customization experience on SageMaker is built on what we deliver. When we add a technique, it becomes available to every customer on the platform. When we make the training loop faster, every customer's job gets cheaper.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing teams, or experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience with PyTorch, JIT compilation, and AOT tracing
- Experience with deep learning libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, MxNet Research publications in computer vision, deep learning or machine learning at peer-reviewed workshops, conferences or journals
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems
- Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Fulfilment by Amazon, Selling Partner Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's inventory identity system was built two decades ago for a simpler world — one product, one barcode, one country, one tracking number. That assumption now constrains some of the largest strategic bets Amazon is making: a global inventory pool that lets sellers stock once and sell everywhere, multi-box fulfillment for products like furniture and gym equipment and a cross-border fulfillment network that treats inventory as truly fungible across regions.

We are looking for a Senior PMT to drive the vision for FBA Identity — a foundational transformation of how Amazon identifies, tracks, and fulfills physical products. You will own the product strategy and execution for globalizing inventory identity, decoupling barcodes from tracking numbers, and enabling a single product to be represented as multiple independently fulfillable units. This is not an incremental feature. It is a platform shift that touches 600+ downstream systems, requires sustained alignment across four engineering organizations (FBA, AFT, Catalog, SCOT), and directly unlocks billions in combined addressable opportunity across multiple programs.

You will work directly with Principal Engineers, Senior Principal Engineers, and VP-level leaders across Amazon's supply chain to define the architecture, run experiments in live fulfillment centers, and ship changes that compound across every program built on top of inventory identity. If you want to work on infrastructure that reshapes how Amazon's entire fulfillment network operates — and see your decisions show up in the experience of millions of sellers — this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product vision and roadmap for modernizing how Amazon identifies and tracks physical products across its global fulfillment network. Translate a multi-year platform transformation into concrete, shippable milestones that deliver incremental business value at each stage — unlocking new product categories, new geographies, and new fulfillment models along the way.

Drive cross-organization alignment across four engineering organizations that each own critical pieces of the architecture. You are the person who ensures they move together, resolves competing priorities, and keeps the program on track through a cross-org governance model with leadership.

Design guardrails, reversible rollout plans, and structured pilots that let us move fast without breaking the network.

Write the business case and technical requirements to quantify trade-offs across seller experience, fulfillment cost, and operational complexity, make recommendations, and present to leadership for investment decisions.

Shape the AI-accelerated execution strategy. This program leverages AI for discovery, deduplication, anomaly detection, and inference across complex product hierarchies. You will identify where AI compresses timelines and where human judgment remains essential.

Represent FBA in cross-VP goal-setting during OP planning. You will author the goal proposals, defend the investment asks, and ensure partner organizations formally commit resources.

A day in the life
You start with a design review alongside Principal Engineers, debating how a proposed change impacts fulfillment center tooling — and pushing back when a solution adds seller complexity.

Mid-morning, you review pilot results from two FC types, draft a remediation plan for newly discovered system dependencies, and escalate one issue to the relevant stakeholders.

After lunch, you present the quarterly roadmap to Directors and VPs, walking through sequencing trade-offs and landing a decision on what ships first.

You close the day writing a one-pager that translates a technical architecture choice into the business case leaders need to fund.

About the team
FBA powers commerce for millions of sellers and hundreds of millions of customers. The Identity team sits at the intersection of catalog, fulfillment, and supply chain — the layer that determines what a product is to Amazon's network, how it moves, and where it can be sold. Amazon's supply chain is evolving from regional networks into a single global system. Multi-box products, cross-border fulfillment, virtual multipacks, and inventory sharing all depend on a modernized identity layer. This team is building it. The decisions made here remove constraints that block billions in opportunity across the organization.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Just Walk Out builds technology enables a new kind of stores with no lines and no checkout—you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!

Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you’re done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earths’ most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware.

As a Software Development Manager, you will own delivery of cross functional initiatives to build new features and improve Just Walk Out experience. You will manage a team of 6-10 software development engineers to build and enhance the shopping experience in Just Walk out stores.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for an individual that thrives by creating high-bar engineering culture. Beyond a strong engineering, data storage/modeling, visualization, and front-end background, a successful candidate will have experience successfully leading teams, developing people, and building a scalable infrastructure. We are looking for someone that is a self-starter, someone that approaches complex business questions with data and curiosity, and a person that dives below the surface to identify the root cause and "so what" rather than just superficial trends

About the team
Just Walk Out (JWO) is an AWS technology that eliminates checkout lines using computer vision, sensors, & AI. JWO operates across multiple countries, spanning stadiums, airports, college campuses, & Amazon fulfillment centers. We run multiple business models - including vision-based stores & RFID checkout - & we're growing fast. As we scale into new markets & verticals, we're deploying LLMs for shopper support, building AI agents that can operate autonomously, & re-architecting our platform to serve multiple businesses across countries with varying tax, privacy, & regulatory requirements.

As an Amazon Worldwide (WW) Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Ground Gas Specialist you will help protect one of the safest real estate programs in the world. You will partner with stakeholders and teams across Amazon to develop and run our ground gas mitigation program in continental Europe, spanning standards and policy development, implementation, and execution; your work directly reduces environmental and human-health risk across our facilities.
To be successful you will bring strong contaminated-land and ground gas or vapour-intrusion expertise, including risk assessment, mitigation system design, construction, operations, maintenance, and monitoring (OMM); you will understand how ground gas and vapour intrusion are regulated within European contaminated-land frameworks and be able to extend that understanding across the countries in scope. We welcome experienced geo-environmental generalists with demonstrable ground gas exposure, and Amazon will sponsor specialist accreditation and training to deepen your expertise.
This role is based in continental Europe and covers Amazon's European portfolio, coordinating country-specific regulatory work through qualified local partners and consultants. Travel is variable and project-driven, concentrated during site investigation, construction, and startup phases; it is not a fixed continuous commitment.



Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Provide a single point of contact to internal teams to develop, understand, and execute Amazon's ground gas program in continental Europe, coordinating country-specific coverage through qualified local consultants and partners.
• Complete due diligence reviews of properties to assess ground gas risk.
• Complete reviews of mitigation system designs, construction plans, and construction verification, startup testing, and OMM data.
• Inspect and/or oversee field personnel inspecting systems during construction, startup, and operation to evaluate conditions and confirm design and operating assumptions.
• Oversee and direct field personnel providing OMM including developing scopes of work, coordinating and scheduling OMM events, evaluating field reports, and acting-on and implementing follow-up actions.
• Support legal, property owner, construction management, preconstruction management, consulting, transaction management, business leadership, and facility operations teams and partners on ground gas risks and intrusion mitigation systems, and operations, maintenance, and monitoring (OMM).
• Support and train a wide range of facility operations teams and partners on mitigation systems, monitoring equipment, and OMM.
• Review work performed by contractors, developers, and consultants, including local specialists retained for country-specific regulatory work.
• Prioritize and lead multiple projects and assignments concurrently.
• Represent Amazon at appropriate levels with property owners and their representatives, consultants, and legal advisors to maintain professional and effective relationships.
• Travel across continental Europe as needed to support site work, concentrated around active project phases.

- Experience in compliance, audit or risk management
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- A Bachelor degree (or equivalent level of qualification in line with the European Qualifications Framework) in Geology, Environmental Science, Chemistry, or Chemical, Environmental Engineering, or Civil Engineering
- Proven experience serving as an environmental technical resource, program specialist, or project manager, with demonstrable exposure to ground gas or vapour intrusion
- Experience contributing to the development and implementation of standards, policies, or programs, with demonstrable exposure to ground gas or vapour intrusion
- Knowledge or experience regarding the operation, maintenance, and/or monitoring of environmental mitigation systems, ideally including ground gas / vapour intrusion systems and remote monitoring equipment

You will lead complex, high-value AI sales engagements across NHS England, ICSs, NHS Trusts and the health arm's-length bodies, developing and executing the go-to-market plan for AWS AI services, including Amazon Bedrock, Kiro and Quick Suite, across UK Healthcare.

Working with senior clinical, digital and operational leaders, you will position AWS as the AI platform of choice for transforming care at scale. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy to build pipeline and close deals that matter.

Key job responsibilities

- Compete effectively, differentiating AWS AI against alternative platforms with deal structures that work within public sector procurement routes

title: Manager I, Operations, Centralised Monitoring Response System Auditing
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.

Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a fast-growing Last Mile support function – AMZL CO (Amazon Logistics Central Operations). AMZL CO is responsible for centrally supporting daily planning and execution of functions that impact Delivery Station (DS) operations across Routing, Scheduling, On-Road and Payments workstreams. The Marcopolo program under AMZL CO strives to operate heavily repetitive processes for NA, EU and JP COs, with standardized mechanisms, tools and technology and with a vision is to build a global Center of Excellence for Last Mile (LM) CO services across WW marketplaces in next 3 years. As a Manager I, Operations in the organization, this role will lead the operations management (tactical execution) charter for Driver support workstream supporting NA/EU. This role will influence and advice multiple senior level leaders and stakeholders.

Responsibilities of a NOC Manager I:
We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.

In this role, the manager will work with stakeholders from multiple partner teams to manage Integrated Centralised Monitoring and Response System Auditing function & improve program performance along with lead a team of people managers overseeing operations for a team size of 30+ associates. Manager may be expected to operate in different shift structures (for instance - 6PM IST OR 8PM IST onwards) depending on business requirements.

The Manager would be responsible to evolve the processes and mechanisms with the growing complexities in the network by working across multiple stakeholders like configuration and design teams. The individual will drive improvements and automations to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.

This position also manages the planning and execution of the team’s goals, including segmentation of business goals, measurement of goal attainment, evolving and driving various improvements in Business to increase its effectiveness in driving results. They would drive quality and productivity in the team via continuous coaching and feedback mechanisms, scope out team's career development plans through performance assessment, drive associate engagement through 1-1s and team building activities, dive deep and drive action on insights from connection scores, manage exceptions and prepare dive deeps on escalations from Ops, represent the team in Business reviews (WBRs/MBRs), strategize and implement the associate shift planning and rostering to effectively meet the program requirements.
The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL would be an added advantage. They should be be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, analytical, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. They will need have excellent communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders.. They will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.

Key job responsibilities
• Responsible for performing operational audits across miles in FCs, SCs, Lastmile and GSF.
• Prepare audit reports enclosed with findings, visual interpretations captured during audits.
• Working with operational stakeholders to aligning audit related binaries, key operational processes to be covered in audits
• Preparing SOPS, weekly business reviews, newsletters, help-texts, simulations to assist associates in performing audits
• Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
• Track the deliverables of the NOC-ICMRS team, work closely with the operations leadership and drive audit closures.
• Must be willing to share on-call rotations in support of alarms, security incidents, and critical service outages.
• Enhance, track, and report on metrics which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements so that the desired outcomes are achieved to plan and in a timely manner.
• Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, training and documentation
• Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all key goals and metrics

Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree or 3+ equivalent professional experience
• 2+ years of experience in control room management, risk management, supply chain management, or other related field
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
• Good critical thinking skills and attention to detail
• Experience with security equipment such as CCTV cameras and video review system

Preferred Qualifications
• Be solutions-focused, customer-focused, and always deliver excellent follow-up.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment
• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Résumé du poste

L’énergie qui fait tourner le monde | Découvrez les carrières dans les Opérations

Les postes dans les Opérations chez Amazon vous placent au cœur de la façon dont les choses circulent, d’un simple clic jusqu’à la porte du client.
Vous contribuerez à concevoir, améliorer et faire fonctionner des systèmes qui relient les personnes, les produits et les lieux, à grande échelle. Vous prendrez des responsabilités dès le début, travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes pour résoudre des défis concrets, et verrez les résultats directs de vos décisions lorsqu’elles atteignent les clients chaque jour.
Ici, l’impact de ce que vous construisez n’est pas abstrait : il est visible, immédiat et significatif — il maintient en mouvement l’une des opérations les plus complexes au monde.
C’est ici que votre parcours prend forme, à travers l’action, la responsabilité et la possibilité d’évoluer dans de multiples directions.


Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

- Développer une connaissance approfondie des fonctions RH au sein des opérations dynamiques d’Amazon
- Participer aux efforts de communication interne afin d’aligner les équipes de plusieurs pays, en favorisant la collaboration et le partage d’informations
- Aider à élaborer des plans et des supports de formation répondant aux besoins de développement évolutifs des différentes équipes, afin de soutenir la croissance des collaborateurs et collaboratrices
- Découvrir les fonctions RH au sein de l’organisation Amazon au sens large et se tenir informé(e) des meilleures pratiques
- Apporter un soutien aux employé(e)s d’Amazon sur diverses questions quotidiennes liées à la présence, à l’engagement, à la rémunération et à d’autres sujets RH
- Assister les équipes RH dans les routines opérationnelles quotidiennes et les tâches administratives
- Participer à des revues de processus afin d’identifier des opportunités de simplification et d’automatisation, en améliorant l’efficacité
- Compiler des statistiques du personnel, des rapports et des évaluations de performance complets afin d’éclairer la prise de décision
- Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables opérationnel(le)s afin d’aligner les stratégies et initiatives RH sur les objectifs et priorités de l’organisation


A day in the life
Une journée type

Chaque journée est un peu différente en tant que Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations. Ce stage vous plongera dans les RH au sein d’une organisation mondiale, avec la possibilité de travailler sur des projets couvrant différents domaines RH — des relations sociales et de la formation à la rémunération et à l’analyse des effectifs. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser des données sur les effectifs afin d’identifier des tendances et de formuler des recommandations pour votre équipe, puis votre après-midi à accompagner un dossier de relations sociales ou à collaborer avec des responsables opérationnel(le)s sur une initiative de formation.
La fonction RH d’Amazon est profondément intégrée à l’activité ; ainsi, quel que soit le projet sur lequel vous travaillez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à utiliser les données et la réflexion analytique pour orienter les décisions. Vous appliquerez vos compétences en résolution de problèmes et vos compétences techniques à des défis concrets, tout en développant d’importantes compétences en communication et des compétences comportementales professionnelles grâce à une expérience pratique. Avec un(e) mentor(e) dédié(e) qui accompagnera votre développement tout au long du programme, vous découvrirez comment les RH s’associent à l’activité pour stimuler la croissance et l’excellence organisationnelle — offrant une base solide pour une carrière dans les ressources humaines.
Remarque : vous devez avoir le droit de travailler dans le pays d’emploi à la date de début.


About the team
À propos de l’équipe

Communauté des stagiaires :
En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d’une communauté dynamique et bienveillante qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, développerez votre réseau et participerez à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des thèmes tels que la durabilité, afin d’explorer vos centres d’intérêt variés.

Accompagnement :
Le programme de stage offre un solide dispositif d’accompagnement, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu’une équipe programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela vous garantit l’encadrement et l’aide nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions d’apprentissage :
Des sessions d’apprentissage exclusives développeront encore vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d’apprentissage de pointe d’Amazon et à l’expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à l’étape suivante de votre carrière.

Opportunités :
À l’issue réussie du stage, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de jeune diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours avec Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d’un salaire mensuel compétitif, d’un soutien à la relocalisation et d’un accès à une gamme d’avantages réservés aux employés.

Dates de début des stages tout au long de l’année :
Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour un début à tout moment entre janvier et septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons 1 à 2 journées d’intégration pour les nouveaux et nouvelles arrivant(e)s.

Basic qualifications

- Actuellement en dernière année et préparant une licence ou un master universitaire en RH, administration des affaires, psychologie, marketing, sciences sociales, droit ou dans un domaine connexe (à orientation sciences humaines), ou dans une discipline similaire
- Disponible pour un stage à temps plein (35 heures/semaine) et s'engager sur un stage de 6 mois
- Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais et le français à un niveau C1 ou supérieur
- Obligatoire de pouvoir signer une convention de stage avec l'université de l'étudiant(e)

Preferred qualifications

- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d'utiliser les données pour orienter les décisions
- Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec diverses parties prenantes
- Curiosité, proactivité et volonté avérées d'apprendre et de se développer dans un environnement dynamique

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

title: Delivery Partner Manager, UKIE DPM
descriptionHtml:
The Delivery Partner Manager is an equal parts advisor and operating partner to Delivery Service Partners (DSP’s). Amazon’s team of Delivery Partner Managers assist and guide our DSP business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses within Amazon Logistics (AMZL). The Delivery Partner Manager will help kick start a net new business as well as being the bastion for expected excellence our partners strive towards. They will guide and advise on how to improve the businesses. The Delivery Partner Manager will work alongside Regional on The Road (OTR) managers in areas of dual purpose related to transition of responsibility of execution of planning and DSP capability.
The Delivery Partner Managers find and execute value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business, with focus areas around DSP sentiment, safety, compliance, performance and reliable capacity. As trusted advisors, Delivery Partner Managers work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are set up for success, whilst working to deliver quality.
The Delivery Partner Managers will work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. They will collaborate frequently with a wide array of integrated internal stakeholders such as Partner Relations (PAR), Value Added Service (VAS), Legal, fleet and network health to name a few. The Delivery Partner Managers support owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. They facilitate and execute Monitoring and Enforcement Policies (MEP) and build two-way feedback channels with OTR teams, DSPs and WW/EU Product and strategy.
The Delivery Partner Manager will be required to work flexibly and will be required to travel between multiple sites to engage with business owners weekly to carry out their role effectively.

The role is field based and requires a significant level of travel as well as requiring flexibility to work a variety of hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays.

The role location can also be based in: DBN5, DBR1, DCR2, DCR3, DHA1, DHA2, DIG1, DIP1, DME4, DNN1, DNR1, DRG3, DRH1, DRM2, DRM4, DRM5, DSS2, DXE1, DXN1, DXW3, DBR2, DHW1

Key job responsibilities
• Safety: Partnering with OTR Safety and OTR Regional Managers to ensure business safety compliance.
• Performance: Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak period.
• Performance: Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch (this will be on the basis of a net new launch only)
• Performance: Coach and ensure effective upskilling and utilisation of AMZL tools.
• Performance: Deep dive to identify customer metric improvement opportunities.
• Performance: Champion the consistent application of Last Mile processes within Delivery Stations – challenge UTR processes that impact OTR.
• Performance: Coaching business owners to run compliant, safe and high performing companies (SLS metric deep dive)
• Experience: Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
• Experience: Developing the relationship between Amazon and our DSP partners (DSP sentiment improvements)
• Experience: Communication alignment to DSP business owners following close collaboration with OTR partners.
• Be the voice of the DSP within and represent them within the AMZL business.
• Experience: Improve driver standards to protect brand image.
• Capacity Management: Work with the DSP’s to deliver effective ramp plans and pipeline goals ensuring driver supply is achieved to meet peak volume demands.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- Experience managing contingent workforce in a business with peak season
- Experience in account management or managing customer relationships

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in client or vendor facing roles with a focus in relationship management and negotiation skills
- Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights
- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources or related field
- Experience using analytical, account management, and productivity tools, such as, Oracle Business Intelligence, SalesForce, Tableau, or similar
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma

title: System Engineer, Graviton Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind AWS (Amazon Web Services) Graviton — the industry's most advanced Arm-based server CPU — and we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

Our Graviton System group owns the design, manufacturing, and health of the Arm-based server fleet powering Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud). We work close to the metal — across firmware, board bring-up, diagnostics, and hardware debug — to keep servers running and return failed units to production fast. In close partnership with design partners, data center operations, and hardware engineering teams, we bring new server platforms into the fleet and drive them to launch faster, healthier, and more reliably, at a scale that directly impacts millions of customers around the world.
If you are a systems, HW, or SW engineer who thrives on hard problems at the intersection of hardware and software, enjoys root-causing failures on real servers, and wants to see your work make a measurable difference across a global fleet — we would love to talk.

We're looking for a System Engineer with Software or Hardware Engineering background to be part of defining, shaping and integrating solutions to next generation of our cloud platforms.

We are looking for an exceptional engineer to own the development, testing, and monitoring of the manufacturing health of Amazon Graviton server products. You will be part of a team integrating new silicon, hardware, firmware, and software into a revolutionary system architecture.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead triage, debugging, and root cause analysis of systems in AWS data centers
• Enhance troubleshooting capabilities and drive closure of in-fleet problems
• Analyze customer workflows and requirements to provide targeted resolutions
• Collaborate with Annapurna Labs monitoring team and root cause teams to improve product quality and reliability in fleet operations
• Represent the customer voice by providing fleet operation insights and requirements to Annapurna Labs' ASIC design, software development, QA, and architecture teams
• Develop and maintain training materials, quality documentation, and collateral to improve in-fleet operations
• Design and implement tools and scripts to support projects and customize solutions based on requirements
• Travel as needed, approximately 2-4 times per year

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related fields
- Knowledge of scripting languages (bash, python, etc.)
- 8+ years of experience as System Engineer; experience working with systems, including software, firmware, and hardware components

Preferred qualifications

- Computer architecture knowledge
- High-speed interfaces knowledge and debug capabilities- PCIe, Ethernet, DDR etc.
- Experience with server (x86 / ARM) design or architecture.
- Experience with operating systems, networking, and remote debugging.
