title: Controls Design Engineer, Controls Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an exceptional Controls Design Engineer to join our Data Center Global Services (DCGS) Controls Design Engineering (CDE) team. This role will focus on Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) design standards and coordination across AWS's global data center portfolio.

The Controls Design Engineering team is responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing global data center design standards with a focus on controls, automation, and electrical power monitoring systems. As the primary owner of BMS/EPMS specifications, Controls Points Lists (CPL), Basis of Design (BOD) documents, and scope of work within AWS's infrastructure engineering organization, CDE ensures consistency and excellence across all data center control systems.

In this role, you will serve as a single point of contact for multiple internal and external stakeholders across:
• New construction builds (Leased/Owned, Build-to-Suit, and Colocation facilities)
• Legacy site enhancement and retrofit projects
• Data center support projects
• Special initiatives and innovation projects

You will drive significant cost reductions by minimizing change orders, eliminating scope gaps between contractors, reducing construction schedule delays, optimizing vendor pricing, and decreasing project management and engineering labor costs through standardization and clear documentation.

The ideal candidate brings a comprehensive knowledge in data center environmental controls systems, IT infrastructure, networking, mechanical facility operations, electrical power monitoring, and project management, combined with strong leadership and collaboration skills.

If you are passionate about customer experience, think and act with a global perspective, and want to contribute to sophisticated innovations in building controls and automation for the world's largest cloud infrastructure, we want to hear from you.

Key Job Responsibilities:
Technical Leadership & Standards Development
• Develop and maintain deep expertise in building operations, mechanical plant strategies, BMS/EPMS programming concepts, control diagrams, industrial HVAC systems, electrical lineups, one-line diagrams, and complex environmental and electrical concepts
• Apply knowledge of data center redundancy, mechanical failure strategies, Single Point of Failure (SPOF) analysis, energy and water conservation best practices, and data reporting analytics
• Create, maintain, and disseminate specification documents and Basis of Design standards for global projects
• Develop and maintain project-specific Scope of Work (SOW) documents incorporating global design standards
• Drive innovation of new solutions to support team initiatives and company goals

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:
• Serve as the central point of contact for multiple internal and external groups regarding BMS/EPMS controls standards
• Lead and facilitate collaboration with construction teams, controls programmers, MEP/ACS engineers, Design Engineering, Colocation Regional Engineering (CRE), and project managers to accomplish initiative goals
• Coordinate personally with regional project managers to review and finalize project SOWs
• Manage and prioritize requests for information across new construction builds, existing facility support, and legacy site enhancement projects

Vendor & Procurement Management:
• Lead vendor selection processes, bid reviews, and RFI support and coordination
• Evaluate and approve Modbus Device Templates (MDT) for electrical meters and control devices
• Review vendor submittals and technical documentation for compliance with AWS standards

Operations & Support:
• Operate successfully in high-security, mission-critical environments while maximizing productivity and maintaining safety standards
• Interact with AWS cloud services and applications to present, archive, and analyze accumulated control system data
• Participate in on-call rotations to support the global data center control system infrastructure

title: Software Development Manager, AWS ElastiCache
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MemoryDB is a durable, Valkey-compatible in-memory database that delivers microsecond read and single-digit-millisecond write latency with the durability and strong consistency of a primary database — removing the need for customers to run a separate cache and database. It achieves this by storing the entire dataset in memory while persisting changes through a distributed transactional log, giving customers in-memory speed together with data durability, consistency, and recoverability. MemoryDB powers demanding, latency-sensitive workloads at scale for AWS customers worldwide.

This team also owns the durability foundation that now extends beyond MemoryDB into Amazon ElastiCache. ElastiCache is a fully managed caching service for Valkey, Redis, and Memcached delivering microsecond latency at any scale, and it is adding durability options built on the hard-won lessons and core technology from MemoryDB. You will lead engineering for both the MemoryDB service and the shared durability capabilities that bring data durability to ElastiCache — a high-leverage charter at the center of AWS's in-memory data strategy.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead this team. This is a people-leadership role for a seasoned manager who can own the technical direction, operational excellence, and delivery of a core AWS database service and its expanding durability charter, while growing and developing a team of software engineers. You will manage a team of ~15 engineers across a range of experience levels, partner with product and principal engineers on multi-year strategy, and be accountable for the availability, durability, and
performance of services that customers trust with their most critical data.

You will own the full lifecycle of your team's software — from design and development through deployment and operations — where correctness, durability, and latency are non-negotiable. If you are energized by distributed systems problems, high-scale operations, and building strong engineering teams, we would like to talk to you.

- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience

title: SDE III, WW Returns and ReCommerce
descriptionHtml:
Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.

As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.

descriptionHtml:

Would you enjoy diving deep into operating and improving some of the largest software systems humanity has ever built? Do the challenges that come of driving technical, business, and cultural change to improve the reliability, performance, and efficiency excite you?

The AWS Managed Operations (MO) organization was founded iwith the objective to reduce operational load and toil through long-term engineering & Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) projects. Managed Operations (MO) is building the best-in-class engineering and operations team that will own the day-to-day operations for AWS Regions; improving the availability, reliability, latency, performance and efficiency to operate AWS regions.

- Build solutions to innovate our solutions to agentic-first interfaces
- Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
 - Define system requirements, participate in the development and delivery of operability-related features such as system health monitoring, diagnostics, repair, and other self-healing automation
- Develop or further existing application and system management tools and processes that reduce manual efforts and increase overall efficiency

Generative AI & Accelerated Development

- Demonstrated ability to leverage Generative AI tools and AI-assisted development environments to accelerate prototyping, development, validation, and testing workflows
- Experience using AI-powered code generation and review tools to rapidly iterate on infrastructure automation scripts, configuration templates, and systems tooling and to automate investigative, diagnostic, or operational tasks
- Ability to apply GenAI capabilities to accelerate test case generation, integration testing, and validation of complex infrastructure components — reducing cycle times without sacrificing quality or security rigor
- Comfort using GenAI tools to rapidly synthesize technical documentation, compliance frameworks, and architectural patterns — accelerating research and decision-making in ambiguous problem spaces
- Awareness of the responsible use of GenAI in security-sensitive environments, including understanding of data handling boundaries, model limitations, and appropriate human-in-the-loop validation practices



A day in the life
You will split your time approximately 60/40 between operating production systems and driving long-term improvements to the reliability, availability, and performance of those systems.

What a Typical Week Looks Like:

- Root cause analysis & remediation — Investigate production issues such as deployment failures, identify underlying bugs, and implement fixes to restore system health.
- Systems-level problem solving — Identify patterns across individual / service incidents, design solutions that address entire classes of problems, and collaborate with your team to refine those designs.

title: Program Manager-Investigation Excellence Team, Central Operations
descriptionHtml:
Investigation Excellence (IE)
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step and a day to look forward to new challenges. And today is that day for you. It's your day to be part of something great. A day to make your ideas come to life and your day to join a company that redefines itself every day. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon.

investigation Excellence Overview
Investigation Excellence (IE) is the deep-dive team within ATS Central Operations, owning root-cause investigation across Amazon's European Transportation Surface Transportation network. IE dives deep into every DEA miss — tracing VRIDs from origin to destination, separating true root cause from recovery, and ensuring each disruption is attributed to the right controllable owner. Rather than accepting metrics at face value, the team operates at the lowest level of detail, audits the data themselves, and stays connected to the specifics. IE plays a critical role in giving the network an honest, accurate picture of performance — which is what allows the right teams to fix the right problems and keep Amazon serving customers on time.

Purview of a Program Manager
As a program manager within Investigation Excellence, your role centers on diving deep into transportation execution data to uncover the true drivers behind DEA misses, and on inventing and simplifying the way we investigate — turning manual, repetitive deep dives into scalable, automated solutions (e.g. Kiro, Quick investigation tooling). You will own root-cause classification and attribution logic, drive accuracy and standardization so investigations can be consistently applied across teams, and monitor performance metrics to drive continuous improvement. You hold a high bar for quality and data integrity, look for ways to eliminate effort rather than add it, and foster cross-functional collaboration. Above all, you provide leadership and direction that keeps IE operating as a high-performance, self-sufficient investigation team — focused on efficiency, accuracy, and simplification.

Key job responsibilities
- On-going generation and creation of reporting.
- Analyzing data to outline any reasons for under/over performance and take actions to improve performance.
- Support the delivery of productivity targets for all KPI's
- Ensure accurate recording and reporting of metrics.
- Work closely with leadership to identify “hot spots” and take appropriate actions to minimize any impacts.
- Communicate and interact effectively with operations and support functions to provide internal customers with information/data needs in a timely manner.
- Evaluate and implement opportunities for improving workflow processes and automation of processes. (Using Excel VBA or in any other tool)
- Raise awareness to any areas for development or recognition.
- Convert all excel reporting to tool (Quick sight, SQL, Tableau etc).

A day in the life
Typically begins the day by reviewing and analyzing data to track key performance indicators and identify trends. They collaborate with various departments to gather information and ensure accurate reporting, while also preparing and presenting reports to stakeholders to inform decision-making processes. Additionally, they may oversee the development and implementation of reporting systems and processes to streamline operations and improve efficiency.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Knowledge of SQL
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in MS Access and SQL
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

title: Applied Scientist II, International and Emerging Stores Payments
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to translate cutting-edge science into products that expand financial access for millions? At International and Emerging Stores Payments (IESP), we build payment solutions for communities and geographies that Amazon's selection and prices do not yet reach because of payment barriers. These markets make up roughly 80% of the world's countries and 85% of its population.

As an Applied Scientist II on our team, you will design, build, and ship machine learning and generative-AI solutions that remove those barriers and advance financial inclusion, working at the intersection of research and production alongside scientists, engineers, and economists. If you are a curious, self-motivated researcher who turns ambiguity into clarity, we would like to hear from you.

What you will work on:

• Build models that recommend the most suitable payment method for each customer—for example installments, cards, or local payment options—and identify the right customers to reach, balancing customer preference, cost, and risk.
• Take models to production behind a real-time, low-latency personalization layer that serves live shopping traffic at scale.
• Build multi-agent generative-AI systems that turn unstructured inputs—customer feedback, documents, and operational data—into reliable, decision-ready insight, with verification that guards against model hallucination.
• Help customers discover and adopt installments and alternative payment methods.
• Design and analyze large-scale online experiments and causal measurement to validate real customer and business impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models, and deploy production-ready solutions to complex customer and business problems.
• Conduct rigorous scientific research: form hypotheses, run experiments, evaluate model performance, and iterate on approaches within your domain of expertise.
• Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code that integrates smoothly into larger systems and meets a high bar for operational excellence.
• Partner with engineering to take your models to production, and with scientists across related payments ML teams to solve shared, complex problems.
• Contribute to team roadmaps, priorities, and technical direction; mentor peers and provide constructive feedback on research and code.
• Publish at peer-reviewed venues and file patent applications where appropriate.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing experiment results and refining model architectures based on new insights. Throughout the day you will alternate between writing research code, analyzing data, and discussing technical approaches with teammates, working closely with engineering to build your ideas and take them to production. You will regularly present findings and propose new ideas, and you may write research papers and submit patent applications.

About the team
We are the science team for International and Emerging Stores Payments. We build solutions that directly shape how customers pay and that drive conversion across Amazon's fast-growing international markets—and there is no shortage of hard science and engineering problems, since these markets span most of the world's countries and the majority of its customers. We value scientific rigor, creative problem-solving, and a genuine commitment to learning and growth. If you are excited about building impactful solutions and advancing financial inclusion through applied science, we would love to have you join us.

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience

- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Supply Chain Business Insights
descriptionHtml:
Help shape the data foundation behind one of Amazon's fastest-growing supply chain networks — and put AI in the hands of the people who move millions of packages across Mexico every day. This is your chance to build the pipelines, analytics, and cloud-native solutions that turn raw data into trusted, accurate intelligence for an organization at the forefront of GenAI adoption.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the MX Supply Chain BI team, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytical tools that power decisions across Mexico's Supply Chain — from network planning and capacity to last mile operations. You will work with large-scale datasets on AWS, write production-grade Python code, deploy cloud-based solutions, and partner with stakeholders across 10 functional areas to deliver insights that drive operational performance. You will contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform and help embed GenAI and ML capabilities into the analytics portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/big-data pipelines using AWS services following medallion-architecture best practices

Write production-grade Python code for data transformation, automation, statistical analysis, and integration with AI/ML workflows

Build high quality datasets with robust metadata for agents to consume and give insights to our stakeholders.

Deploy and manage cloud-native data solutions on AWS through infrastructure-as-code based deployments.

Collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain functional areas (Topology, S&OP, Network Planning, Middle Mile, Last Mile, Sort Centers, Operations) to translate business questions into analytical solutions

Contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform (Apache Iceberg on serverless AWS), ensuring data quality, governance, and single-source-of-truth standards

Write and optimize complex queries on SQL, Spark SQL and PySpark across large-scale datasets to support reporting, ad-hoc analysis, and metric development

Establish and follow engineering best practices including code reviews, testing, monitoring, documentation, and logging best practices.

Proactively identify opportunities to improve data availability, reduce time-to-insight, and automate manual reporting processes

Support the team's GenAI/ML initiatives by preparing governed, high-quality datasets and contributing to data products that enable agentic and self-service AI workflows

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing pipeline health dashboards and resolving any data quality alerts from overnight ETL runs. By mid-morning, you're deep in Python — building a new data transformation module. After a quick stand-up with your peers, you jump into a working session with a Last Mile stakeholder who needs a new metric added to their operational dashboard; you scope the requirement, write the code and push for your peers to review before lunch.

You wrap up the day by prototyping a data integration that will expose a new dataset to the team's GenAI agent through the MCP — a small step that will let operations leaders ask natural-language questions about network speed and compliance. No two days are the same, but every day your work makes Supply Chain decisions faster, smarter, and more trusted.

About the team


MX Supply Chain Business Insights owns the data, insights, and analytics that power how Amazon's Mexico Supply Chain organization understands its business, measures its customer experience, and makes decisions. The team serves 10 functional areas with growing cross-LATAM collaboration with Brazil.

Our team works together to deliver the data infrastructure, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting that underpin MX Supply Chain's most critical business metrics, while also developing full stack applications to gather and process data. We are at an inflection point: as we embed GenAI across the portfolio and scale an AI-ready data lakehouse across LATAM, the decisions our stakeholders make depend on data they can trust, access quickly, and act on confidently.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling
- 3+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
- Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Experience building and operating a cloud-based architecture

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business
- Experience with forecasting and statistical analysis

title: Sr. Preconstruction Manager, Prime Air Expansion
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Pre-Construction Manager within Prime Air (PA) Expansion, you are Amazon's senior owner's representative during the pre-construction phase. You source and engage Architects of Record (AORs), coordinate design completion, permitting, and contract execution for your assigned locations. Pre-construction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You own project budgets, oversee design management, select external vendor partners, and lead project procurement. You show excellent judgment when driving project escalations and make difficult trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs, defending those decisions to internal stakeholders.

Beyond project delivery, you contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks. You write effective narratives and present complex decisions and trade-offs to Directors and VPs. You actively recruit, mentor, and develop other pre-construction managers.

This role requires 20% regional travel on a yearly basis.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Lead coordination with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and managing escalations with excellent judgment
- Own project budgets and oversee spend approvals across all assigned preconstruction projects
- Lead external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement functions; ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, driving detailed discussions, and achieving high-level alignment and consensus
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

About the team
If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.

How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and most importantly safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what's to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos).

Amazon Prime Air is revolutionizing delivery through autonomous drone technology, aiming to deliver packages to customers in 30 minutes or less. Our breakthrough technologies, including advanced BVLOS (Beyond Visual Line of Sight) capabilities and sophisticated detect-and-avoid systems, have earned FAA approvals and are setting new standards in autonomous delivery.

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses

title: Sr Technical Program Manager - Business Process, Infrastructure Reliability and Quality (IRQ)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Infrastructure Reliability and Quality (IRQ) Team owns the Quality and Reliability of critical infrastructure equipment for the lifecycle of equipment. This includes leading Design for Reliability (DFR) and Design for quality (DFQ) effort for AWS Infra New Product Development (NPD), supporting/sustaining the existing AWS critical infra equipment fleet by identifying systemic equipment issues, driving root cause analysis (RCA) corrective action to mitigate the risk in the AWS fleet.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for Quality and Reliability for the Mechanical and Power Generation Products, you should be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally. You will lead multi-discipline and highly technical program teams. You should have experience of driving quality and reliability initiatives in a complex engineering environment and will have worked as a technical project manager on increasingly complex projects. Your experience includes data center infrastructure technologies including HVAC, power distribution systems, security devices and controls. You will generate and maintain enhanced reporting, meaningful KPIs, and process/automation improvements to ensure team efficiency and visibility of the portfolio efforts to critical stakeholders and leadership.

You will partner with other engineering teams, purchasing team and project execution/delivery teams regularly. You will make strategic decisions regarding specific projects and overall program direction. You will be capable of connecting long-term strategies with rapid growth patterns of AWS, as well as guide specific operational needs of the business.

You must be adept at identifying and communicating upcoming risks, issues, and bottlenecks as well as be instrumental in resolving those issues, often cross multiple departmental boundaries to achieve your goal. You must possess a strong sense of organization, communication and team building skill-sets that foster robust working relationships for both internal and external stakeholders.



Key job responsibilities
This Senior TPM will lead end-to-end business process optimization and operational excellence programs for IRQ (Infrastructure Reliability & Quality) - designing and implementing scalable workflows, owning department-level dashboards and executive reporting, and driving team efficiency initiatives where both operational rigor and continuous improvement are non-negotiable.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and execute end-to-end business process improvement programs across the IRQ department, identifying inefficiencies, standardizing workflows, and implementing scalable solutions
- Learn and understand the AWS data center lifecycle and IRQ's role within it, globally, to inform process design and reporting strategies

- Project manage the IRQ operations portfolio across scope, schedule, resources, risk, and reporting - ensuring alignment with department goals and organizational priorities

- Design, build, and maintain IRQ dashboards, reports, and metrics frameworks that provide real-time visibility into team performance, project health, and key quality indicators

- Interface with IRQ Engineering teams to document, standardize, and optimize work-product inputs/outputs and handoff processes globally

- Sync with TPMs, Product Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to align IRQ operational deliverables and reporting cadences to major program milestones

- Develop and implement workflow automation and process improvements that reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and accelerate decision-making across the IRQ organization

- Work with internal tool owners and platform teams to evaluate, adopt, and integrate business intelligence and project management tools that enhance IRQ team productivity

- Own the creation and maintenance of standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and team playbooks for IRQ workflows

- Define and track team efficiency metrics (cycle time, throughput, utilization, SLA adherence) and drive accountability through data-driven insights

- Manage reporting timelines and deliver bi-weekly progress updates to executive leadership and key partners on operational health, process improvements, and team performance

- Build and present department-level metrics, KPI dashboards, and operational status to executives on a regular cadence

- Develop business cases to align internal leadership on investments in tools, processes, and resources that improve IRQ operational efficiency and scalability

- Drive internal team members and remove roadblocks to ensure timely delivery of process improvement initiatives

- Build strong end-to-end team mechanisms, including intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and feedback loops that foster a culture of continuous improvement

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: Regional Safety Manager, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join the world class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Regional Safety Manager. As the Regional Safety Manager, you will own the Health and Safety function of your respective area as well as supervise a team of Health and Safety Managers responsible for similar daily safety functions.

You will be responsible for improving the health and safety of our data centers, advancing safety culture, and protecting our employees. Each day you will work with our data center engineers, the people who make the cloud go. They are working with electrical switching equipment, large scale air handling mechanical systems, and critical IT gear.

You will work closely with experts in security, construction, operations, logistics, compliance, corporate counsel, and human resources to further the global health safety program. You will partner with employees as well as contractors to achieve health and safety goals and improve our already strong safety culture. You will work in a fast-paced environment where our operations are rapidly changing, advocating safe changes in the face of new infrastructure, new tools, and new products/processes.

This role is for a qualified and experienced people leader. The primary responsibilities of the role are to own the safety strategy for a multi-cluster portfolio of geographically localized data centers and to manage a team of Health and Safety Managers across those sites. You will set the vision and define the safety strategy for your regional portfolio, design the right team structure and mechanisms to meet long-term business goals, and achieve consensus on priorities with senior operations partners. The PDX portfolio is in a period of growth, expanding across established sites and builds, so you will anticipate future growth and investment needs and build a workforce strategy to match.

You will have managed a team of safety professionals and will be able to demonstrate how you improved the performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. You will manage succession planning, hiring, coaching, managing performance, and promoting. You will be knowledgeable in US occupational safety regulations, including OSHA recordkeeping requirements (29 CFR 1904), as well as industry best practices related to hazard recognition and mitigation in critical infrastructure environments.

You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives.

You must be an effective communicator, sending clear, concise, and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and in public speaking forums. You will write compelling strategic narratives, including QBR and operating plan inputs, and present them effectively to Directors and VPs. You will advise, instruct, and train company safety professionals, as well as operations personnel, on safety policies and procedures. You will also drive learnings from incidents to prevent recurrence across sites and raise the bar on investigation quality across your portfolio.

This role requires regular travel across a geographically distributed set of data center sites.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the safety strategy and lifecycle of complex cross-functional safety programs across a multi-cluster ADC portfolio
- Manage and develop a team of Health & Safety Managers across multiple sites and geographies.
- Implement and ensure compliance with health and safety standards, policies, and practices that meet or exceed regulatory requirements, including safety management systems, training, and risk assessments.
- Own regional MBR and QBR narratives; analyze safety metrics and trends across the portfolio, deep-dive performance gaps, and design strategic responses.
- Conduct cadenced reviews of investigation quality; ensure narratives meet IRB standards before closure and own escalation decisions for high-severity events.
- Partner with construction managers to ensure risks are identified and mitigated prior to live operations as new capacity comes online.
- Influence senior operations Directors and cross-functional partners across Facilities, Construction, Security, and Legal to drive controls adoption at scale.
- Anticipate future growth and investment needs across clusters and build workforce and succession strategy to match a rapidly scaling portfolio.
- Consult and partner with the AWS compliance and legal teams for regulatory interpretations and guidance.
- In order to be qualified for this position, you must be able to obtain and hold TS Clearance within 18 months of being in role.
- All other duties as assigned.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Salesforce is at the center of how AWS moves deals from opportunity to signed contract. Today that path still runs through manual reviews, disconnected systems, and repeated data entry. Experience building and launching hardware products is a must. Experience in the sustainability space is a plus but not required. The ideal candidate will have experience leading a new or existing customer device from concept to release, proven ability to develop strategic vision based on the customer, and excellent verbal and written communication skills with senior leaders across all stakeholders. title: Sr Engagement Manager | Gestionnaire senior de l'engagement, Public Sector Professional Services | Services professionnels du secteur public
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a deep passion for utilizing technology to empower businesses? Would you like to have a career that supports customers and partners reach their outcomes faster and cheaper through Cloud Services?

We are hiring a Senior Engagement Manager capable of leading internal AWS, external partners, and customer teams to deliver AWS cloud products and services that enable our customers to realize their business outcomes. You will need to draw on your customer-facing skills and technical acumen to understand customer requirements and enable them to implement their digital transformation projects.

You will be collaborating with many stakeholder groups to support requirements gathering and scope definition. You will be working on an ongoing basis to proactively implement best practices for our customers and help identify and close project gaps working with all levels of organizations. Typical engagements include: Cloud Strategy and Business Case Development, Cloud Suitability and Migration Assessments, Cloud Architecture Design and Implementation, On-Premise to Cloud Migrations, and Cloud Organizational Alignment.
--------------------------------------
Avez-vous une passion profonde pour l'utilisation de la technologie afin d'outiller les entreprises? Aimeriez-vous poursuivre une carrière qui aide les clients et les partenaires à atteindre leurs objectifs plus rapidement et à moindre coût grâce aux services infonuagiques?

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) gestionnaire principal(e) de l'engagement capable de diriger des équipes internes d'AWS, des partenaires externes et des équipes clients afin de livrer des produits et services infonuagiques AWS qui permettent à nos clients de réaliser leurs objectifs d'affaires. Vous devrez mettre à profit vos compétences en relation client et votre sens technique pour comprendre les exigences des clients et les accompagner dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation numérique.

Vous collaborerez avec de nombreux groupes d'intervenants pour soutenir la collecte des exigences et la définition de la portée des projets. Vous travaillerez de façon continue à mettre en œuvre de manière proactive les pratiques exemplaires pour nos clients et à cerner et combler les lacunes des projets en collaboration avec tous les échelons des organisations. Les mandats typiques comprennent : l'élaboration de stratégies infonuagiques et d'analyses de rentabilité, les évaluations d'admissibilité et de migration vers l'infonuagique, la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures infonuagiques, les migrations de l'infrastructure sur site vers l'infonuagique, ainsi que l'harmonisation organisationnelle liée à l'infonuagique.

Key job responsibilities
Delivery
• Collaborate with AWS field sales, pre-sales, training, and support teams to seek to understand our customers’ needs, their business, how success is defined, and ensure that we are exceeding expectations in developing and delivering customer outcomes.
• Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle to ensure successful delivery. This includes developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, project milestones, budgets and defining success criteria.
• Manage engagement goals and lead teams to achieve customers’ business outcomes by managing issues, risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
• Work with stakeholders and AWS sales teams to amend the contractual scope, financials, and expected timelines
• Ability to take ownership, work under pressure, stay within budget, and meet deadlines
• Hold internal and external teams accountable, redirect when needed, and manage customer expectations throughout engagements.
• Works effectively in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and able to take proactive steps to ensure teams meet or exceed customer expectations.
• Ability to be self-directed and effective working independently, yet equally comfortable contributing in a global team environment
• Results-oriented, prioritizes work activities, plans and stays organized in order to meet commitments.
• Ensures AWS and Partner teams meet or exceed customer business objectives

Solutions
• Lead individuals, teams, or multiple groups and play an active role in analyzing project goals, creating a plan to achieve those goals, and then guiding AWS team members, customer stakeholders/SMEs and potentially other third parties to achieve those goals while understanding the client environment and any limitations to execution.
• Actively looks for ways to improve process efficiencies and effectiveness.
• Ability to apply strategic thinking and demonstrate understanding of requirements to execute.
• Ability to make decisions guided by policies, procedures and business plans with limited guidance.
• Ability to apply business and financial acumen to achieve measurable business results for customer success.
• Support and influence the sales lifecycle by engaging clients in defining next phases of cloud projects as appropriate to meet client needs.
• Participate in practice development by contributing to the development of practical solutions and methodologies, and the development of knowledge sharing artifacts.

Communication
• Excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills with team members and audiences of all levels.
• Ability to build relationships with various customer and internal AWS stakeholders which consists of senior leadership teams (C-level execs, SVP/VP, Directors) and project level resources such as SMEs.
• Plans and oversees the preparation and distribution of project communications.
• Understand the operating styles of others as well as team/client relationships, team dynamics, and adjusts behavior accordingly to succeed. Recognizes environmental or cultural nuances and adapts.
• Foster an inclusive and diverse work environment.

Team Work
• Proven success in working with teams and executive leadership in a complex customer environment.
• Team player who effectively integrates, motivates and builds relationships with cross-functional team members (local or remote), sponsors, key stakeholders, executives, and other individuals or organizations involved with or affected by the project.
• Proven experience working in a matrix environment, managing multiple stakeholders.
• Excellent people management skills, including the ability to influence, negotiate and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
This is a customer-facing role. You may be required to travel to customer locations to deliver professional services when needed when travel resumes. We offer a flexible work environment to help you balance your work and personal life, while still remaining customer obsessed.
-----------------------------------------
Livraison
• Collaborer avec les équipes de vente, d'avant-vente, de formation et de soutien d'AWS sur le terrain afin de chercher à comprendre les besoins de nos clients, leur entreprise, la façon dont le succès est défini, et veiller à ce que nous dépassions les attentes en matière de développement et de livraison des résultats clients. • Planifier, organiser et gérer toutes les phases du cycle de vie des projets afin d'assurer une livraison réussie. Cela comprend l'élaboration et la gestion de plans de gouvernance de projet, de calendriers de projet, d'objectifs d'équipe, de jalons de projet, de budgets et la définition de critères de succès.
• Gérer les objectifs des mandats et diriger les équipes afin d'atteindre les résultats d'affaires des clients en gérant les enjeux, les risques, les décisions, les dépendances et les mesures à prendre.
• Travailler avec les intervenants et les équipes de vente d'AWS pour modifier la portée contractuelle, les aspects financiers et les échéanciers prévus.
• Capacité à prendre en charge les responsabilités, à travailler sous pression, à respecter les budgets et les échéances.
• Tenir les équipes internes et externes responsables, réorienter au besoin et gérer les attentes des clients tout au long des mandats.
• Travailler efficacement dans un environnement dynamique où les priorités changent et être en mesure de prendre des mesures proactives pour s'assurer que les équipes répondent aux attentes des clients ou les dépassent.
• Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et efficace de manière indépendante, tout en étant également à l'aise de contribuer au sein d'une équipe mondiale.
• Axé(e) sur les résultats, priorise les activités de travail, planifie et demeure organisé(e) afin de respecter les engagements.
• S'assurer que les équipes d'AWS et des partenaires atteignent ou dépassent les objectifs d'affaires des clients.

Solutions
• Diriger des individus, des équipes ou plusieurs groupes et jouer un rôle actif dans l'analyse des objectifs de projet, la création d'un plan pour atteindre ces objectifs, puis guider les membres de l'équipe AWS, les intervenants/experts en la matière du client et potentiellement d'autres tiers pour atteindre ces objectifs, tout en comprenant l'environnement du client et les contraintes liées à l'exécution.
• Rechercher activement des moyens d'améliorer l'efficacité et l'efficience des processus.
• Capacité à appliquer une réflexion stratégique et à démontrer une compréhension des exigences pour mener à bien l'exécution.
• Capacité à prendre des décisions guidées par les politiques, les procédures et les plans d'affaires avec un encadrement limité.
• Capacité à appliquer un sens des affaires et des finances pour obtenir des résultats d'affaires mesurables favorisant le succès des clients.
• Soutenir et influencer le cycle de vente en mobilisant les clients dans la définition des prochaines phases des projets infonuagiques, selon les besoins des clients.
• Participer au développement de la pratique en contribuant à l'élaboration de solutions et de méthodologies concrètes, ainsi qu'au développement d'outils de partage des connaissances.

Communication
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite, verbale et en présentation avec les membres de l'équipe et les auditoires de tous les niveaux.
• Capacité à établir des relations avec divers intervenants internes d'AWS et clients, y compris les équipes de haute direction (cadres de niveau C, PVP principal/VP, directeurs) ainsi que les ressources au niveau des projets telles que les experts en la matière.
• Planifier et superviser la préparation et la distribution des communications de projet.
• Comprendre les styles de fonctionnement des autres ainsi que les relations d'équipe/client, la dynamique d'équipe, et adapter son comportement en conséquence pour réussir. Reconnaître les nuances environnementales ou culturelles et s'adapter.
• Favoriser un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié.

Travail d'équipe
• Succès démontré dans le travail avec des équipes et la haute direction dans un environnement client complexe.
• Esprit d'équipe qui intègre efficacement, motive et établit des relations avec les membres d'équipes interfonctionnelles (locaux ou à distance), les commanditaires, les intervenants clés, les cadres et les autres personnes ou organisations touchées par le projet.
• Expérience avérée de travail dans un environnement matriciel, gérant de multiples intervenants.
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des personnes, y compris la capacité d'influencer, de négocier et d'obtenir des résultats par l'entremise d'autres personnes qui ne sont pas des subordonnés directs.

Il s'agit d'un poste en contact avec la clientèle. Vous pourriez être appelé(e) à vous déplacer chez les clients pour offrir des services professionnels au besoin, lorsque les déplacements reprendront. title: Applied Scientist II, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
descriptionHtml:
Can a large language model read a regulatory change and draft the requirements and control tests that follow from it, accurately enough for a Compliance Officer to sign off? How do you train a breach-risk model when confirmed breaches are rare, arrive months after the event, and mean different things to Compliance, Assurance, and the regulator? What does a model have to prove before a Compliance team acts on its output?

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Data and Analytics team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the data, analytics, and modeling layer that RCS runs on, from regulatory reports and filings to the intelligence that tells Compliance Officers and our first line of defense (1LoD) partners where risk concentrates and which controls hold. You build the machine learning (ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems in that layer, take them into production, and own the evaluation science that lets Compliance rely on them.

The work spans 3 areas: risk models that score which open risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches; GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage; and the evaluation science behind every model and agent the team ships. Financial crime compliance is the first domain, and its constraints shape the science: threats change faster than control sets adapt, and every output faces internal audit and external examination. Once an approach proves out, you carry it into the next compliance domain across the RCS portfolio.

You own problems from formulation to production: framing the science question with Compliance and 1LoD partners, designing experiments and backtests, building and validating models, and shipping them into the pipelines, reports, and tools that RCS teams use. The stack includes Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Lambda, and your partners include data scientists, data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and software development engineers across RCS.

The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement, writes production-quality code alongside their models, and stays comfortable when the evaluation set does not exist until they build it.

Key job responsibilities
• Formulate ambiguous compliance problems as ML and GenAI problems with Compliance and 1LoD partners, and choose methods that fit the data, the risk, and the audit standard
• Develop risk models that learn from rare, delayed, and noisy labels to score which risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches, and calibrate them so a score carries a defensible meaning
• Build GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage
• Design the evaluation for every ML and GenAI system you ship: golden sets that compliance experts label, metrics suited to rare outcomes and generated text, and release criteria a system meets before Compliance relies on it
• Deploy and monitor models in production with software development engineers, including drift detection, performance tracking against realized outcomes, and retraining criteria
• Explain model decisions, quantify uncertainty, and document methodology so Compliance Officers, auditors, and examiners can trace how a system reached each output
• Create reusable science components, such as feature sets, scoring services, and evaluation harnesses, so an approach that works in financial crime compliance extends to the next domain without a rebuild
• Review peer models for statistical soundness, mentor data scientists and engineers on ML methods and experimental design, and publish or patent where the work and confidentiality allow


About the team
Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. RCS operates as the second line of defense under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.

RCS's mission is to apply specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:
• Streamlined license acquisition that enables Amazon's financial services expansion
• Management of existing business risks across the organization
• Comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
• Innovative solutions such as Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
• A proactive, intelligence-led framework for compliance operations

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in financial modeling, or experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment
- Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda

descriptionHtml:
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

Behind every click, stream, and cloud service is real hardware — and someone needs to make sure it gets where it needs to be. As a Logistics Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help manage the supply chain that keeps our data centers running, from receiving and tracking parts to ensuring the right equipment is in the right place at the right time.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Logistics Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

- Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Supply Chain, Logistics, or a similar discipline who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

About the Role

You will join a creative, dynamic team of Logistics Specialists dedicated to providing world-class customer service — and you will be part of operating the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure.

This hands-on role supports our procurement and supply chain operations. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do
- Monitor inventory levels to ensure proper stock levels are maintained
- Receive parts, maintain inventory records, and check out parts
- Load and unload shipments and transport parts between different locations
- Assemble, address, stamp, and arrange for the shipment of merchandise and materials
- Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations
- Unpack incoming shipments and verify contents
- Maintain precise records of all commodities going in and out of the facility

Physical Requirements

- Regularly lifting and moving up to 16 kilograms (approximately 35 pounds) unassisted, and participating in group lifts for heavier items
- Lifting loads of up to 22 kilograms (approximately 49 pounds) and carrying them for short distances
- Continuously climbing and descending stairs safely (applies to sites with stairs)
- Reaching and stretching to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
- Pushing or pulling heavy objects into position

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

title: Sensor & Robotics Test Engineer, Leo Ground Systems
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.


Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:
- Become a key member of the Ground Systems Integration and test team working directly with our site build teams.
- Lead development, integration, and ongoing build operations of ground gateway antenna and terminal test systems, both fielded and in build.
- Work closely with implementation teams to troubleshoot issues, perform data driven analysis of results, and make recommendations for improvements and corrective actions.
- Support the rest of the Ground Systems team along with our suppliers in the identification and execution of design corrective actions improve site build defects and improve site built automation efforts
- Lead in the development of optimized field deployment integration and operational readiness test programs
- Lead in the development of automated tests that further improve in site build defect discovery and correction enabling deployment of Leo's innovative Ground Gateway System
- Communicate regularly on status, risk, and change control.
- Help teams reduce exposure to classic failure modes.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



A day in the life
As a Sensor & Robotics Test Engineer, you will provide leadership supporting execution of Leo's ground integration and site build test activities. You will become a subject matter expert on the Leo ground system design and will be called upon frequently as such to support critical troubleshooting activities. You will help develop and will work extensively with the Gateway terminal test systems to validate supplier product updates relative to site deployment and troubleshoot system issues.

About the team
The Ground Systems team is responsible for the architecture, design, build, and installation of Leo's Ground and TT&C Gateways. Our Ground Gateways enable high data rate, low latency communications between Leo points of presence and our Low Earth Orbit Satellite constellation. The team works closely with Ground Infrastructure Services, Networks, Regulatory, Payload Test, and RF Systems teams to ensure Leo provides a seamless customer experience.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
- 4+ years in integration and test and/or product verification and validation roles
- 2+ years using RF and Network test equipment associated with SATCOM communications
- 2+ years in development and deployment of automated tests

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in development, integration, and commissioning of Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) or Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite communication systems, especially with respect to Ka-band satellite ground station equipment such as parabolic full-motion antennas, RF equipment, modem, and site support equipment.
- Experience with communication system test equipment such as Vector Spectrum Analyzers, Vector Signal Generators, Power Supplies, and Oscilloscopes
- Experience with identification, development, and deployment of design for scale product improvements including maintaining configuration control discipline
- Experience supporting system engineering development efforts including meeting cost, schedule, and performance goals
- Experience with software languages such as Python and analytics software such as PowerBI, Tableau, or Grafana

title: Area Manager II, Operations, Fulfillment Center - Fixed, Operations
descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon we are currently seeking for Managers to support our Customer Fulfillment team.

This is an excellent opportunity to be part of the AU Fulfillment Center (FC) leadership team during its phase of expansion and growth, whereby you get to define the process flows and shape up standard work routines as the operations scale up.

As a Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, inclusive leadership for the teams you supervise. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for supervising a team of Associates and a department. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance.


Key job responsibilities
1. Determining, implementing and monitoring purchasing, storage and distribution
strategies, policies and plans - AMs implement and monitor storage and distribution
strategies across FC workflows (receive, stow, pick, pack, ship). They analyse shift
performance against business objectives and drive operational excellence plans.
They oversee projects to streamline processes and optimise productivity across the
network.
2. Preparing and implementing plans to maintain required stock levels at minimum
cost - AMs maintain inventory accuracy and work to meet customer demand while
optimising productivity and cost. They conduct planning sessions and use
advanced analytics to balance competing priorities including stock availability.
3. Negotiating contracts with suppliers to meet quality, cost and delivery
requirements - AMs collaborate cross-functionally with support teams (Engineering,
Quality Assurance, Loss Prevention, HR) to develop plans meeting business
objectives — managing internal "supply" of labour, equipment and process inputs
to meet quality, cost and delivery targets. Specifically, in Dev's role as a Vendor
Return AM, he will be liaising directly with supply chain and external vendors
4. Monitoring and reviewing storage and inventory systems to meet supply
requirements and control stock levels - AMs directly maintain inventory accuracy,
review department-wide metrics, and diagnose root causes of performance gaps.
FC workflows (stow, pick) are fundamentally about managing fast-moving inventory
in storage systems.
5. Operating recording systems to track all movements of supplies and finished
goods, and ensuring re-ordering and re-stocking at optimal times - AMs use
Amazon's WMS (Warehouse Management Systems) to track product movement
through receive → stow → pick → pack → ship. They monitor KPIs and use data
analysis to ensure optimal workflow timing.
6. Liaising with other departments and customers concerning requirements for
outward goods and associated forwarding transportation - AMs work collaboratively
with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices and partner crossfunctionally. The FC's core mission is ensuring customer orders are delivered at the
right time — coordinating the "First Mile" handoff to middle-mile and last-mile
transportation.
7. Overseeing the recording of purchase, storage and distribution transactions - AMs
oversee operational recording systems across all FC workflows, tracking millions of
customer orders through storage and distribution. Data-driven decision-making is a
core requirement of the role.
8. Directing staff activities and monitoring their performance - This is the primary
function — AMs lead teams of 80–120+ associates, motivating, mentoring,
coaching, managing safety, quality, attendance and performance. They conduct
performance management and develop the next generation of leaders.
9. Provision of products and services to meet customer or client requirements - The
entire CF mission: "ensuring customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the
right location" — handling 1.5M+ orders daily, focused on being Earth's most
customer-centric company.

Basic qualifications

- Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams.
- More than 6 months experience as Area Manager.
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
- Experience in employee and performance management experience.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Proven ability in establishing and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyze the data you generate.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with performance metrics, process improvement and Lean techniques.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills.
- Experience with a contingent workforce during peak seasons.
- Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen methodologies would be highly advantageous.

The Process Technician will work closely with cross-functional engineering, test, quality and operations teams on flight hardware integration processes. In short, you will be responsible for a majority of the most critical tasks to process and integrate the LEO satellite for launch, ensuring high quality, workmanship and safety standards are adhered to on a daily basis.

Valuable skills and experience for this role include a variety of aerospace operational disciplines, including mechanical assembly, propellant loading (or similar spacecraft pneumatic/propulsion operations), pneumatic and electrical control system troubleshooting/rework, and rigging/crane/forklift operations

title: Logistics Specialist, Data Center Operations, SYD InfraOps
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Logistics specialists play a vital role in the success of Amazon Web Services by providing the right part, in the right place at the right time. Your contribution to this success would be maintaining the onsite parts room in AWS Data Centres, by managing the custody of computer hardware through their entire lifecycle. This involves receiving parts, safely storing parts, picking and delivering parts to hardware technicians, cycle counts, and shipping faulty hardware back to the vendor.

You will work closely with Data Centre Operations and Engineering teams to ensure reliable functioning and repair activities to support our customers, while adhering to our operational tenants of safety, security and availability.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintaining inventory levels to ensure that stock items are available to support build and repair activities.
- Receiving parts, checking shipments and issuing parts as needed for internal customers.
- Loading and unloading shipments and transporting parts between different sites.
- Maintaining accurate stock records for all items within our care.
- Maintaining the cleanliness, organization, and safety of all workspaces using 5S principles.

A day in the life
In this hands-on position, your day will be spent carrying out Logistical support functions for our Data Centers. This will involve physical control and processing of spare parts transactions, consumables stock replenishment, and cycle counting of stock.

The role will require some travel between sites in the Sydney Metro area to successfully complete tasks such as cycle counts, receiving stock, replenishing stock, and returning defective equipment. Own transport to travel between sites will be required. You may be required to go into the Data Center after hours and over weekends on some occasions.

Amazon Operates with a principle of safety first. With this principle, we take significant care to ensure all employees operate in a safe manner and have appropriate tools to support them in undertaking their roles safely. The activities below are required with the safety principle applied:
- Loading and unloading shipments.
- Standing, sitting, and walking (including stairs) for prolonged periods of time.
- Willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and kneel.
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance.
- Push or pull heavy objects of up to 16kg into position and participate in group lifts of 20kg or more.
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment.
- Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts.
- Work in an office and warehouse environment where the noise level is low to moderate.

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからDirectorまで、多様なBackgroundを持つメンバーとのCross-functionalワークを通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【キャリアパス】
Operations Managerは、大きな組織をリードしリージョンやネットワークの取り組みを実行する次のSite LeaderまたはSenior Operations Managerへと成長することが期待されます。また、Supply Chain、Transportation、およびLogisticsなどAmazon のオペレーションのあらゆるOpportunityを模索することもできます。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
- オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
