- メンバーがより生産的で、パフォーマンスが高く、多様性があり、インクルーシブになるようサポート、指導し、動機付けします。チームメンバーの個人的な成功に対するビジョンとコミットメントを持って、共感を持ってリーダーシップを発揮し、楽しく仕事をし、メンバーに楽しんでもらいましょう。
- Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
- 年間のオペレーション計画を編成し、日次/週次の生産計画と実績確認、短期/長期の需要変動対応、3PLを含む関係者との調整を通じて、コストを管理しながら、年間のオペレーション計画を実行します。
- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は埼玉県三郷市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をAmazonのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シニアエリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

また社内システムを用いて各種計画の進捗・実績管理などを実施。現場と連携し、生産性向上を実現していきます。

title: Software Development Engineer, BigMesh, Traffic Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Want to build a Service Mesh that powers Amazon at scale?

Amazon Traffic Engineering delivers managed compute and networking solutions that help engineers build secure, highly available, and scalable services — all on top of AWS technologies. We drive the foundational infrastructure, tools, and best practices behind Amazon's global SOA expansion.

As an SDE on the BigMesh team, you'll build centralized traffic management and networking solutions handling security, authentication, authorization, load balancing, and routing for Amazon's most critical services. Your work will directly improve availability, efficiency, and developer productivity by turning complex SOA concerns into managed abstractions that "just work."

We use Golang, Rust, and Java. If you're new to any of these, our onboarding will get you up to speed. Come help make developing software at Amazon more seamless and flexible!

Key job responsibilities
- Own the full software development lifecycle for Service Mesh features, from design through implementation, testing, and production readiness.

- Write high-quality, maintainable code in Golang, Rust, or Java that meets Amazon's engineering standards.

- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and senior engineers to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions for traffic management and connectivity.

- Design and build networking features (load balancing, routing, throttling, authentication) used by thousands of Amazon services.

- Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, architecture discussions, and knowledge sharing.

- Identify and drive process improvements that increase team efficiency and system reliability.

- Participate in on-call rotation to resolve production issues and proactively mitigate operational risks.

A day in the life
- Ship code for high-impact Service Mesh features used across Amazon
- Debug complex connectivity and dependency issues alongside partner teams
- Review designs and guide Away-Team engineers on best practices
- Advise stakeholders on technical trade-offs and effort estimates
- Triage and resolve production issues during on-call rotation

About the team
You'll be joining the Big Mesh team, the team that owns services and connectivity solutions for Amazon's internal services.

As part of this team, you'll be responsible for the ensuring we continue to develop better connectivity solutions for our Amazon teams and simplify/remove the hurdles the builders face as they navigate the complex networking architecture at Amazon.

The team is always looking for ways to improve the engineer experience through process improvements and automation. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to these efforts and help shape the team's engineering practices.

By joining this team, you'll play a critical role in delivering the core functionality that powers Amazon's internal connectivity solutions. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the shopping experience of millions of Amazon customers worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Principal Product Manager- Technical, Amazon Finance Technology
descriptionHtml:
Imagine being at the forefront of revolutionizing the tax industry with innovative technologies. As a Principal Product Manager – Technical in the FinTech Tax Technology team, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of tax products and solutions that empower businesses and individuals to navigate the ever-evolving landscape of tax regulations and compliance requirements.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for driving the product strategy, technical roadmap, and delivery of our innovative tax product suite. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and subject matter experts, to translate complex tax requirements into robust, scalable, and secure software solutions and ensure our products meet the evolving needs of our customers and comply with complex tax regulations.

Join our team and be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization that values excellence, collaboration, and a passion for leveraging technology to simplify the complexities of tax.

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Product Manager - Tech, you will lead new, large product initiatives to define the long-term strategy and vision to meet emerging customer needs and tax regulations. You will handle complex product development and business management scenarios, proactively identifying gaps/opportunities to then develop a suite of products to solve the problems.


• Define product strategy, roadmap, and vision for tax product portfolio, while contributing to the technical design of new product features.
• Capture and translate complex tax requirements, regulations, and customer needs into technical specifications, user stories, and innovative user experiences
• Drive alignment across cross-functional teams and tax leadership on product feature, business, and strategies
• Manage end-to-end product development lifecycle
• Build, maintain, and communicate comprehensive product launch plans, tracking deliverables, milestones, risks, and bottlenecks
• Own customer engagement and communication for product updates
• Establish KPIs, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement of product performance
• Provide mentorship to other product managers on the team

About the team
The Finance Technology Tax team builds technology to support Amazon’s global tax teams (our customers). Our customers need to ensure that Amazon is compliant with the increasingly complex tax regulations. We build systems to enable our customers to perform tax functions including, calculations, payments, filing, tax audits, and recovery at the scale demanded by Amazon’s business operations. We prioritize solutions based on our ability to deliver exponential value in the following four dimensions: 1) supporting business growth while reducing cost to serve 2) ensuring compliance and reducing risk 3) improving customer experience, and 4) providing accurate, complete, and timely data.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience technical product management
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

title: AWS Technical Consultant (TAM), Enterprise Support NZ
descriptionHtml:
Join AWS as we invest NZ$7.5 billion in New Zealand over the next 15 years. We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to join our Enterprise Support team and work directly with New Zealand's most ambitious Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) as they build, scale and innovate on AWS.

As a TAM in our ISV segment, you'll be the trusted technical consultant for software companies that are shaping industries across New Zealand and beyond. You'll help ISV customers architect for scale, optimise their cloud operations and accelerate their product roadmaps on AWS. Your day will involve conducting application reviews, leading operational readiness assessments, driving adoption of AWS services that unlock new capabilities and presenting insights at business reviews that influence customer strategy.

This isn't a reactive support role. It's a consulting role where you earn trust through deep technical expertise and deliver measurable impact. You'll work across the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and migration through to optimisation and innovation, solving complex technical challenges alongside some of the sharpest engineering teams in the country.

You'll be part of a growing Enterprise Support team in New Zealand, backed by the depth of AWS's global technical community. You'll develop your skills across cloud architecture, security, cost optimisation and operational excellence while contributing to Technical Field Communities and earning AWS certifications.

If you want to work at the intersection of cloud technology and software innovation, and you're ready to have a direct impact on how New Zealand's ISVs build and grow, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the primary technical advisor to ISV customers, helping them architect, optimise and scale their software products on AWS
- Conduct Operational Reviews, operational readiness assessments and architecture deep-dives tailored to SaaS and multi-tenant workloads
- Drive operational excellence across customer environments by identifying risks, reducing cost and improving reliability before issues impact production
- Lead technical discussions on incident management, trade-offs and risk mitigation, translating complex scenarios into clear recommendations for both engineering teams and senior leadership
- Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate customer outcomes through AWS service adoption, cost optimisation and architectural improvements
- Deliver business reviews that provide actionable insights, track progress against customer goals and strengthen the strategic relationship
- Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services and Account Managers to deliver coordinated support across the customer lifecycle
- Enable customer teams through targeted workshops, hands-on labs and technical enablement sessions that build lasting cloud capability
- Lead service event reviews and pre-launch planning to ensure customers are prepared for critical launches and operational milestones
- Engage with stakeholders across all levels, from platform engineers to CTOs, earning trust through technical depth and consistent delivery

A day in the life
No two days are the same, but here's what a typical day might look like.

Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and findings across your customer portfolio, identifying any emerging risks before they become incidents. You notice one customer's database latency has been trending upward and flag it for a deeper review later in the week.

Mid-morning, you lead an Well-Architected Review with a SaaS customer who is preparing to expand into a new market. You work through their multi-tenant architecture, identify areas where they can improve resilience and reduce cost, and leave them with a prioritised set of recommendations they can action immediately.

Over lunch, you join a cross-functional call with the account team to plan an upcoming business review for one of your largest ISV customers. You pull together operational insights, service adoption trends and risk reduction metrics to ensure the review delivers real strategic value.

In the afternoon, you run a hands-on workshop with a customer's engineering team on observability best practices, helping them instrument their platform so they can detect and resolve issues faster. This is the kind of enablement that builds lasting capability and earns trust.

Later, you spend time preparing a pre-launch review for a customer about to release a major product update. You assess their architecture for readiness, review their scaling strategy and ensure their operational runbooks are solid before go-live.

Between meetings, you're contributing to your Technical Field Community, reviewing a SpecReq from a colleague and catching up with your ESM on a customer risk you've been tracking. Every day is a mix of deep technical work, strategic thinking and relationship building.


About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Hands on experience working with AI

Preferred qualifications

- Professional experience with AWS and/or other cloud offerings such as Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.
- Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating, transforming or modernising legacy customer solutions to/in the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a DevOps perspective, including understanding of best practices, tools, CI/CD, etc.
- Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)

title: Transportation Program Manager, ROC Quality Management
descriptionHtml:
■ポジション概要
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) 部門では、年間数億にのぼる商品をお客様とお約束したお届け日に安全かつ正確にお届けすべく、日本全国のAmazon物流拠点を結ぶ大規模な幹線輸送ネットワークを構築・運営しています。1日5,000運行を超えるこの複雑なネットワーク運営の中核を担うRelay Operation Center (ROC) において、幹線輸送における品質を管理するQuality Management (QM) チームのメンバーを募集します。
ROC QMチームは以下の3つの機能を有し、それぞれの品質水準を高めることで、お客様に最上のサービスを提供します。

(1) 幹線輸送（出荷拠点から配達拠点まで）における輸送期日遵守率の品質管理・改善
期日順守率全体の数値管理を行います。また輸送キャパシティや拠点での処理能力を超過することで発生する貨物の滞留への初動対応、および中期的な対応精度の向上と最適化に取り組みます。

(2) ネットワーク拡大や時季的要因で変動する遅延リスクに対する幹線トラック定刻運行の品質管理・改善
トラックの運行は、大型連休や物流の繁閑期、気象条件、交通事故など、様々な要因の影響を受けます。このような環境下において、社内外のステークホルダーと連携し、輸送品質の安定的な維持・向上を実現します。

(3) 天候災害発生時（台風・大雪など）の品質維持と早期回復に向けたプロセス管理
自然災害が配送網に与える影響を予測・分析し、お客様へのお届け予定日時の調整や配送網の復旧オペレーションを指揮します。また、災害対応プロセスの構築や改善を通じて、安定した配送サービスを実現します。

■本ポジションの魅力
業界経験を問わず、課題解決や業務プロセス改善に意欲的に取り組めるメンバーが活躍できる環境があり、以下のような魅力があります。
- インパクトの大きさ：ROCは日本におけるAmazonの輸送ネットワークの中核を担う組織です。全国のネットワークに影響を及ぼす意思決定に携わり、出荷拠点や配達拠点の担当者、運送会社とも連携した大規模なアクションをリードすることができます。
- キャリア成長機会：オペレーション構築、データ分析、プロセス設計など、幅広いスキルを習得できます。将来的にはチームマネジメントの経験も積むことが可能です。また、物流において特定領域に限定されず、セントラルオペレーション、倉庫業務、プランニングなど、総合的な知見を習得できます。
- グローバル対応力：EUや北米で実践されているベストプラクティスの導入に関わることができます。また、希望に応じて海外のテクノロジーを日本のオペレーションに最適化して導入するプロジェクトにも参画できます。

Amazonの輸送オペレーションの仕組みづくりに携わりながら、様々なスキルを磨くことができます。あなたの経験と可能性を活かし、世界最高品質のECサービスの実現に共に取り組みませんか。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
- チームのイニシアティブを理解して、担当する業務領域におけるプロジェクトを推進する。
- 管理指標やデータを分析することで現状の課題を見出し、解消のためのアクションやKPIを策定・実行する。
- 業務プロセス上の異常を検知し、要因分析と改善に向けた対応を実施する。

A day in the life
[50%] 品質指標の改善に向けたデータ分析、ステークホルダーとの調整を含むプロジェクト推進
[30%] チームが管理する業務プロセス改善、イレギュラー対応
[20%] ドキュメント、作業手順書の作成

勤務地：品川オフィス

出社形態：週5日出社（フルタイム勤務）

勤務日：月曜日〜金曜日（原則平日勤務）

勤務時間：9:00〜18:00（実働8時間）

休日・休暇

About the team

Basic qualifications

- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（会議ファシリテーション および ビジネス文書作成 が可能なレベル）
- 中級レベルのExcelスキル（SUMIF関数、VLOOKUP関数、ピボットテーブルを使った分析経験）

title: Senior Partner Development Manager, ANZ Partner Team
descriptionHtml:
The AWS ANZ Partner Organisation is looking for an experienced Global Systems Integrator (GSIs) Partner Development Manager. GSIs are the world's largest consulting, technology services and professional services firms, with global reach, deep industry practices and long-standing advisory relationships with the boards and executive teams of major organisations. You will own a small portfolio of our most strategic consulting partners. You will build the executive relationships, joint business plans and practice investments that make AWS the platform of choice for the large-scale transformation programs these firms deliver for enterprise customers.

You sit at the intersection of alliance management, business development and market development. You will build trusted relationships with senior partner leaders, including local country and alliance leads, managing partners and industry practice heads. You will also work closely with AWS's global alliance teams to turn global agreements and investments into local results. Your focus is on creating new pipeline through your partners. You will do this by shaping their go-to-market priorities on cloud migration, modernisation, data and generative AI, building differentiated industry solutions on AWS, and finding new demand in their client base. You will also drive the capability investments that grow their AWS practice, such as certifications, competencies and specialised teams. You will use data, AI tools and disciplined operating rhythms like QBRs and executive sponsor reviews to manage these relationships consistently, while going deep on the partner initiatives that matter most.

The ideal candidate combines business, consulting and technology fluency. You can hold a strategic conversation with a GSI country managing partner about market direction and joint investment, then pivot to working with solution architects and partner practice leads on a new offering. You understand how professional services firms run their business: utilisation, practice economics, partner incentives and the alliance landscape across multiple cloud providers. You use that understanding to build compelling joint plans that grow the partner's AWS business and turn into new pipeline and long-term revenue.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and execute a partner business strategy for a small portfolio of Global Systems Integrators across Australia and New Zealand, working with AWS global alliance teams to turn global agreements and investments into local plans and results.
- Build and manage executive relationships with senior partner leaders, including country and alliance leads, managing partners and industry practice heads. You will be a trusted advisor and the primary AWS point of contact for your partners.
- Create new partner-originated pipeline through joint business and go-to-market plans, including industry solutions, offerings, demand generation and executive programs that find new demand in the partner's client base.
- Assess partner capabilities and guide investment in priority practice areas such as migration, modernisation, data and generative AI, including certifications, competencies and specialised AWS teams.
- Own reporting on partner performance, pipeline creation and business plan attainment through a consistent rhythm of QBRs and executive sponsor reviews. You will also champion your partners across AWS sales, solutions architecture, marketing and Partner Sales teams, influencing without authority.
- Mentor and develop others within the partner organisation, contributing to team capability and operational excellence.

A day in the life
Your day balances executive partner engagement with building your partners' AWS business. You might start by reviewing pipeline and practice metrics, then join AWS global alliance leads to plan how a new global investment lands locally. Mid-morning you lead a quarterly business review with a partner's country leadership. After lunch you shape a new generative AI offering with a solutions architect and an industry practice head. Later you meet a managing partner to find new demand in their client base. Between meetings you keep AWS sales, solutions architecture, marketing and Partner Sales aligned with your partners' practices.

About the team
Why AWS? AWS is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud, trusted by organisations from startups to Global 500 companies. We pioneered cloud computing and haven't stopped innovating since.

Our Culture We're a team that values curiosity, inclusion, and continuous learning. Our employee-led affinity groups and events celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. You'll find mentorship, knowledge-sharing, and career development woven into everyday work.

Work-Life Harmony We believe great work and a fulfilling personal life go hand in hand, and we build flexibility into how we work.

Basic qualifications

- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience setting up and managing a sales pipeline
- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience with or in a Global Systems Integrator.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking
- Experience working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications

descriptionHtml:

Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated Associate Solutions Architect to help accelerate customer adoption within the AWS Europe Central organization where you will be working with Enterprise customers in Romania across all industries and tech domains.

As an Associate Solutions Architect at AWS, you’ll build technical relationships with customers and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey.
You will be working alongside a Senior Solutions Architect, allowing you to understand the role, daily activities, and get experience from tenured Amazonians.

You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their projects.

Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs and wants to inform the roadmap of AWS features. In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to implement or document cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. Solution Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, whiteboarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities

•Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
•Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
•Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
•Responsible for supporting the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling.

A day in the life

•Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
•Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
•Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
•Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.

About the team
About AWS

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance

title: Senior Construction Safety Manager, WHS Construction Safety
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a Senior WHS Construction Manager to own construction safety across a region. In this role you set construction-safety standards and programs, hold vendors accountable across multiple concurrent projects, and drive compliance from contractual agreement through project close-out. You develop the standard operating procedures that scale safe construction across the network.

Key job responsibilities
- Own construction-safety standards and programs across a region and multiple concurrent projects.
- Establish and enforce H&S compliance within vendor contractual agreements.
- Develop standard operating procedures that scale safe construction across the network.
- Run vendor business reviews and use data and metrics to drive continuous improvement.
- Present regional construction-safety performance and risk to senior stakeholders.

A day in the life
You own the construction-safety agenda for a region spanning multiple countries and projects. Your day mixes program work - writing standards and SOPs, running vendor business reviews, analysing safety performance - with hands-on judgement on the highest-risk construction activity. You partner with commercial, project and vendor leaders to build safety into contractual agreements, and you present regional safety performance and risk to senior stakeholders. You set the approach that construction managers and vendors across the region follow.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in engineering (electrical, mechanical, civil or industrial).
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience in English language communication skills (C1), both written and verbal.
- Track record of implementing safety standards across construction projects.
- Experience owning construction-safety programs and managing vendors/contractors across multiple sites.

Preferred qualifications

title: Cloud Support Engineer (German & English speaking), Support Engineering (German & English speaking)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) arbeitet an einer Zukunft, in der jedes Unternehmen mit Amazon-KI-Teammitgliedern innoviert. Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, entwickeln wir KI-Lösungen, die menschliche Fähigkeiten verbessern und ganze Geschäftsbereiche transformieren. Wir schaffen durchgängige Produkte, die sofort begeistern und überzeugen – sie machen Komplexes einfach und Schwieriges möglich, ganz ohne Cloud-Erfahrung. Wir beginnen mit Kunden, die die Zukunft annehmen, und bauen Brücken, um den Rest dort abzuholen, wo er steht. Wir verfolgen ambitionierte Chancen mit Überzeugung und suchen Macher, die diese Denkweise teilen.

AWS hat im Januar die European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) gestartet. Um diese Initiative voranzutreiben, suchen wir aktiv Support-Ingenieure in diesem Bereich.

Amazon Web Services ist Marktführer und technologischer Vorreiter im Cloud-Geschäft. Als Mitglied des AWS-Support-Teams für die ESC stehen Sie an vorderster Front dieser transformativen Technologie und unterstützen eine globale Liste von Unternehmen und Entwicklern, die ein wachsendes Angebot an Diensten und Funktionen nutzen, um ihre geschäftskritischen Anwendungen in der ESC zu betreiben. Fließende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch sind Voraussetzung. Als Cloud Support Engineer agieren Sie als „Cloud-Botschafter" für alle Cloud-Produkte und statten unsere Kunden mit den nötigen Werkzeugen und Strategien aus, um das Beste aus ihrer Produkt- und Support-Investition herauszuholen. Weitere Informationen zur ESC finden Sie in unserem Blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/ Möchten Sie die neuesten Cloud-Computing-Technologien nutzen? Haben Sie Interesse daran, Kunden bei Anwendungsarchitekturen und Integrationsansätzen zu unterstützen? Sind Sie mit Best Practices für Anwendungsserver und Netzwerke vertraut? Möchten Sie Teil eines kundenorientierten Technologieteams sein, das dazu beiträgt, den Erfolg von Amazon Web Services (AWS) als führende Technologieorganisation sicherzustellen?

Wenn Sie sich in dieser Beschreibung wiederfinden, könnten Sie die Person sein, die wir suchen! Wir sind ein Team, das Cloud Computing mit Leidenschaft lebt und davon überzeugt ist, dass erstklassiger Support entscheidend für den Erfolg unserer Kunden ist.

Voraussetzungen für die Bewerbung:
* Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich.
* Für diese Rolle müssen Sie Staatsangehöriger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates sein.
* Amazon bietet Umzugsunterstützung für erfolgreiche Bewerberinnen, die innerhalb der Europäischen Union umziehen.
* Diese Position beinhaltet Rufbereitschaft.

Key job responsibilities
• In erster Linie handelt es sich um eine Kundenservice-Rolle – in der Cloud.
• An einem typischen Tag ist ein Support Engineer hauptsächlich dafür verantwortlich, Kundenanfragen über verschiedene Kontaktkanäle zu lösen, darunter Telefon, E-Mail und Web-/Live-Chat. Sie werden fortgeschrittene Fehlerbehebungstechniken anwenden, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu erarbeiten, und Kundeninteraktionen vorantreiben, indem Sie gemeinsam mit den Kunden die eigentliche Ursache eines Problems tiefgehend analysieren.
• Neben der Bearbeitung eines breiten Spektrums technischer Probleme kann ein AWS Support Engineer auch neue Mitarbeitende coachen, Schulungen entwickeln und durchführen, bei komplexen Problemen oder Initiativen zur Kontaktvermeidung mit Entwicklungsteams zusammenarbeiten, an Einstellungsverfahren mitwirken, Tools/Skripte zur Unterstützung des Teams schreiben oder mit der Führungsebene an Prozessverbesserungen und strategischen Initiativen arbeiten, um ein besseres Kundenerlebnis und die Einhaltung der globalen AWS-Standards, -Praktiken und -Richtlinien sicherzustellen.
• Diese Rolle erfordert die Flexibilität in Rufbereitschaft und perspektivisch in Schichtarbeit zu arbeiten.

A day in the life
AWS Global Services umfasst Experten aus dem gesamten AWS-Umfeld, die unseren Kunden beim Design, Aufbau, Betrieb und der Absicherung ihrer Cloud-Umgebungen helfen. Kunden innovieren mit AWS Professional Services, erweitern ihre Kompetenzen mit AWS Training and Certification, optimieren mit AWS Support and Managed Services und erreichen ihre Ziele mit AWS Security Assurance Services. Unsere Expertise und aufkommenden Technologien umfassen AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product und das Generative AI Innovation Center. Sie werden Teil eines vielfältigen Teams technischer Experten in Dutzenden von Ländern, das Kunden dabei unterstützt, mehr aus der AWS Cloud herauszuholen.

About the team
Amazon schätzt vielfältige Erfahrungen. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle bevorzugten Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten erfüllen, die in der Stellenbeschreibung aufgeführt sind, ermutigen wir Kandidat*innen, sich zu bewerben. Wenn Ihre Karriere gerade erst beginnt, keinem traditionellen Weg gefolgt ist oder alternative Erfahrungen umfasst, lassen Sie sich nicht davon abhalten, sich zu bewerben.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) ist die weltweit umfassendste und am weitesten verbreitete Cloud-Plattform. Wir haben das Cloud Computing als Pioniere vorangetrieben und nie aufgehört zu innovieren – deshalb vertrauen Kunden, von den erfolgreichsten Start-ups bis hin zu Global-500-Unternehmen, auf unsere leistungsstarke Palette an Produkten und Diensten, um ihre Geschäfte voranzutreiben.

Wir legen Wert auf eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Beruflicher Erfolg sollte nie auf Kosten von Einschränkungen im Privatleben gehen – deshalb sind flexible Arbeitszeiten und -modelle Teil unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wenn wir uns sowohl am Arbeitsplatz als auch zu Hause unterstützt fühlen, gibt es nichts, was wir in der Cloud nicht erreichen können.

Hier bei AWS liegt es in unserer Natur, zu lernen und neugierig zu sein. Unsere von Mitarbeitenden geführten Interessengruppen fördern eine Kultur der Inklusion, die uns befähigt, stolz auf unsere Unterschiede zu sein. Regelmäßige Veranstaltungen und Lernerfahrungen, darunter unsere „Conversations on Race and Ethnicity" und die AmazeCon-Konferenzen, inspirieren uns, unsere Einzigartigkeit stets zu leben.

Wir heben unsere Leistungsstandards kontinuierlich an, da wir danach streben, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu werden. Deshalb finden Sie hier endlose Möglichkeiten zum Wissensaustausch, Mentoring und weitere Ressourcen zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung, die Ihnen helfen, sich zu einer vielseitigeren Fachkraft zu entwickeln.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience in managing and troublshooting network
- Excellent Oral/Written communication skill in the English and German language.
- A bachelor’s degree in Information Science / Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field OR equivalent 6 + months experience in a technical position.
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in system administration, and troubleshooting any operating system (Linux and/or Windows) and networking (HTTP/s, TCP/IP, DNS, OSI model, routing, switching, firewalls, LAN/WAN, traceroute, iperf, dig, CURL or related)
- Experience in one of the following areas: Databases, Big Data, Analytics, Security, Development languages (Python, Ruby, PHP, Java, .NET, C#, JavaScript), Storage or Content Delivery, DevOps, Windows, Linux or Networking

title: HR Business Partner, PXT
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner is responsible for operational excellence and organizational health at assigned site(s), serving as an individual contributor partnering directly with Field Leaders and site leadership teams. This role is accountable for the end-to-end employee experience, owning site-level feedback mechanisms, recognition programs, and environment standards that shape trust, engagement, and performance.
You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility, supporting multiple sites within your region (campus) with regular mobility across assigned locations.

Employee Experience & Engagement
• Foster two-way communication between employees and leaders through feedback mechanisms like Voice of the Associate, roundtables, and GEMBA walks
• Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs, including budget planning and employee appreciation activities

Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology

Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making. title: HW Lead Engineer, Nitro Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind the custom silicon and systems at the heart of AWS (Amazon Web Services) infrastructure — we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

Our Nitro Cards ("K2") are present in each and every server deployed at AWS, continuously innovating across new technologies, new server platforms, and new cloud services.
Nitro Cards serves critical roles in the server control plane and data path — delivering better performance, greater stability, and higher availability to customers at a global scale.
We work closely with the Nitro Silicon and Nitro Firmware and Software teams across definition, development, and mass production to optimize product value and accelerate time-to-market.
We learn from large-scale production health data and feed those insights back to continuously improve our products and processes.
Our success depends on world-class designs and the ability to deliver them on time, at scale, and with the best possible value for our customers — handling massive scale and the rapid integration of emerging technologies.

We are looking for a HW Lead Engineer to help define, shape, and integrate cutting-edge solutions for the next generation of our cloud platforms.
As a Card Lead Engineer in the Nitro/K2 team you will be responsible for defining Annapurna Labs’ Network Interface Card (NIC) hardware for the Compute a storage servers type, owning the development and validation of Nitro cards,  including readiness for mass production.
You’ll provide leadership in new technologies of the HW interfaces, bringing them to large-scale deployment, in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience. This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you’ll work with technical experts, senior leaders, and multiple areas of technology.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the design and sustain of the Nitro Smart Network Interface Card for CMRI vertical use cases.
- Work with joint design partners and manufacturing sites, to enable healthy mass production of the Nitro card.
- Review, identify, and qualify second-source electrical components, to enable continuity of supply.
- Analyze and debug design/manufacturing/integration issues.
- Continuously assess process capabilities and innovate to simplify processes, reduce costs, and shorten the time cycle of Nitro cards’ development and manufacturing.
- Collaborate with members of cross-functional teams, to gain knowledge and improve product design,  processes, and quality.
- Work with customers, to optimize the entire value stream and put together joint processes that will lead to improved time cycle and lower costs.
- Willing to travel abroad one or two times a year, for a week at a time.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical  Engineering or in related field.
- At least 8 years' experience leading hardware products from design to mass production: life cycle, components selection, schematics, layout, thermal, mechanical design, review, hardware-software interfaces, and production testing.
- At least 6 years’ experience in high-speed board design and practical hardware lab.
- Design/lab experience with at least at one of the following interfaces: DDR , PCIe , Practical experience with high-speed lab equipment.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with mass production products.
- Experience with  Networking/Storage/Linux.
- Knowledge and  understanding of HW PCB architecture and design.
- Experience with CPLD/FPGA coding and simulation.
- Technical leadership, Matrix work with multiple teams.
- Practical experience writing scripts.

title: Security Program Manager, AWS Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a Security Program Manager to be responsible for building and improving processes for project management and project planning and working across all levels and functions of the organization. The role is responsible for the life cycle management of data center physical security systems and technologies including, but not limited to: Access Control, Intrusion Detection, and Video Surveillance systems. Stakeholders include construction, facilities engineering, cabling groups, finance and procurement, among others. A successful Security Program Manager in this role will not be afraid to dive deep, ask challenging questions about complex and ambiguous activities, and get stuff done.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the key business partner working directly with service business partners and internal stakeholders (primarily infrastructure, physical security and operations teams).
- Collaborate with engineers, technicians, project managers, and Sr. Leaders to develop your programs.

title: Delivery Trainer, RSR
descriptionHtml:
Since opening our 'virtual' doors in 1995, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further. Our entire business works hard to delight our customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, fluid and intentional. That can be described in one of our core Leadership Principles, which is Bias for Action. This means that our teams band together, roll up their sleeves, and aren’t content with just standing still. We’re aiming to become the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is an exciting organization within Amazon dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces.

Amazon is seeking self-motivated Driver Trainers to join our team and help build a network of customer-centric Delivery Associates in the communities where we operate. As a Driver Trainer, you have a passion for mentoring others; you are comfortable teaching and guiding conversations in large groups; and you believe in hands-on training and conducting drive-alongs with Delivery Associates to instill safe practices.

As a Driver Trainer, you are responsible for establishing the right driver training culture in your delivery station, setting up the training experience, and independently instructing training sessions. You educate Delivery Associates on the foundational safety, quality, and productivity aspects that are an important part of the Delivery Associate daily routine. You enable the success of Delivery Associates by adapting to different learning styles and taking a hands-on training approach to demonstrate what good looks like. You exhibit Learn and Be Curious by answering all Delivery Associates’ questions and finding the answers if you are not sure of the correct response.

As a Driver Trainer, you are expected to lead by example and demonstrate the Amazon Leadership Principles at all times. In this position you will play a key role in keeping our commitment to exceed customer expectations by ensuring Delivery Associates are set up for success to deliver customer orders, large or small, on time at the right place.

Due to interstate operating authority commerce regulations, candidates must be at least 21 years or older. Candidate must hold a valid state-appropriate driver’s license, be able to obtain and maintain their Driver Qualification File (DQF), and be eligible to drive in accordance with Department of Transportation (DOT) requirements.


Key job responsibilities
•Facilitate daily training classes for up to 30 people, including in-station classes and drive-alongs
• Partner with Delivery Service Partners (DSPs), Operations Managers, Area Managers, and Learning Teams to coordinate, facilitate, and measure training related activities.
• Have a detailed understanding of processes, expectations, and training requirements for all drivers across the various driver programs in operation.
• Provide timely and accurate reporting on the completion of trainings, compliance, safety, and maintenance duties.
• Execute to the standard, always working to ensure that the content and experience complement the safety, quality, and legal procedures as defined.
• Educate and audit driver safety and compliance standards such as: driver vehicle inspection reports, hours of service, trip planning and safe road driving practices.
• Track and monitor performance including on road ride behinds to measure on-road quality, adherence to standards, and identify re-training and process improvement opportunities.
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck as scheduled using approved equipment (dolly, etc.), with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Work outside and drive different motor vehicles over the road.
• Drive in accordance with DOT requirements.
• Stay connected to the operation by participating in on-road processes on a regular basis
• Be a resource to the delivery station for driver training-related questions
• Work as a peer trainer on an as needed basis to support the business.
• Motivate, coach, and provide feedback to Delivery Associates during Training
• Travel to multiple sites within 50 miles of the home station and have reliable transportation
• Operate and navigate a 26,000 pounds or less vehicle
• Track performance and provide identified retraining and process improvement opportunities to further develop non-CDL driver, DOT regulated training.
• Effectively operate a GPS
• Associate may be required to gain DOT Regulation Qualification as a condition of the role
• Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Valid and active driver's license
- Are 21 years of age or older
- Authorized to work in the United States
- Eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements
- Must be able to obtain and maintain a Driver Qualification File

Preferred qualifications

- Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree, and/or prior Amazon experience
- Demonstrates problem solving and analytical skills
- Ability to communicate effectively (written and verbal) across various levels of an organization
- History of meeting/exceeding departmental goals
- Experience leading teams
- Capable of providing direction to team members using independent judgment
- Organization and time management skills
- Experience delivering training both to individuals and groups
- 2+ years of professional driving experience

- Knowledge of instructional theories: adult learning, on the job learning, knowledge management theories, virtual and classroom instruction

title: Applied Scientist, Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI)
descriptionHtml:
Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly.

The Mission
Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale.

What You'll Build
You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations.

Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI.

This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions.

What We're Looking For

* Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models
* Track record of building scalable ML systems
* Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale
* Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI

Ready to work on AI safety challenges that define the industry? Join us.


Key job responsibilities
The Responsible AI (RAI) team is at the forefront of building AI systems that are safe, ethical, and trustworthy. As an Applied Scientist-II, you'll be a key contributor to end-to-end Responsible AI solutions—developing and refining algorithms that detect and eliminate false information, building models that identify vulnerabilities exploited by bad actors, and training systems that understand human values across diverse cultures. Working alongside world-class engineers and scientists, you'll apply state-of-the-art NLP and computer vision techniques to content classification and safety challenges—turning cutting-edge research into production systems that protect millions of customers daily.

But here's what makes this role exciting: you'll grow into a future leader. You'll contribute to identifying, defining, and mitigating AI safety risks early—helping protect customers before they're impacted—while building deep expertise in responsible AI. You'll work within multi-agent architectures, implementing components where distributed AI systems maintain human oversight and control. Every model you build and every experiment you run—from consensus-driven reasoning modules to orchestration components—will directly strengthen trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale.

A day in the life
As a Responsible AI Scientist, you're at the frontier of AI safety—experimenting with breakthrough techniques that push the boundaries of what's possible. You partner with engineering to transform research into production-ready solutions, tackling complex optimization challenges. You brainstorm with Product teams, translating ambitious visions into concrete objectives that drive real impact. Your expertise shapes critical deployment decisions as you review impactful work and guide go/no-go calls. You mentor the next generation of AI safety leaders, watching ideas spark and capabilities grow. This is where science meets impact—building AI that's not just intelligent, but trustworthy and aligned with human values.

About the team
Our team pioneers Responsible AI for conversational assistants. We ensure Alexa delivers safe, trustworthy experiences across all devices, modalities, and languages worldwide. We work on frontier AI safety challenges—and we're looking for scientists who want to help shape the future of trustworthy AI.

The term “sensitive content” includes within its scope a wide range of categories of content such as offensive content (e.g., hate speech, racist speech), profanity, content that is suitable only for certain age groups, politically polarizing content, and religiously polarizing content. The term “content” refers to any material that is exposed to customers by Alexa (including both 1P and 3P experiences) and includes text, speech, audio, and video.

title: Process Improvement Specialist, GOX - Ops Excellence
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it.

The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network.

Your core loop is straightforward: understand what the region needs, partner with technology teams to expand the solution to meet that need, then support the local ACES team in rolling it out on the ground. You will listen to operators and leaders to surface real problems, translate those needs into clear requirements for tech partners, and enable local teams to adopt the solution and sustain it without constant central support. Stakeholder management is the largest part of this job.

Analytics is the backbone. You will mine and interpret large-scale operational datasets to find where a region's gaps are, quantify the opportunity behind each solution, and validate through rigorous pre and post analysis that expanded tools actually move the metrics that matter. You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners.

We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch.

Please note: this role is based in the EU and can be located at any EU node. It requires up to 35% travel, primarily within the EU, with occasional travel to partner regions to support rollouts and stakeholder engagement.

Key job responsibilities
- Act as the primary bridge between EU GOX solutions and regional Operations teams, owning the end-to-end expansion of EU tools and mechanisms into a new network.
- Engage deeply with regional Ops stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs, pain points and priorities, and translate them into a clear, data-backed solution roadmap.
- Perform data mining and analysis across multiple systems (Redshift, Athena and other warehouses) to identify the region's gaps, quantify the opportunity, and prioritize which EU solutions to expand.
- Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization) to perform root cause analysis and connect systemic issues to shop-floor and customer delivery impact.
- Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) that let regional stakeholders detect problems ahead of customer impact.
- Develop assessments, readouts and reports that communicate rollout progress, adoption and quantified business impact to regional and EU senior leadership.
- Identify and manage the risks, dependencies and cross-region differences (regulatory, network, systems) that affect successful adoption.
- Build a repeatable, data-backed playbook for expanding EU solutions into new regions that scales to additional workstreams over time.


About the team
The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon's EU fulfillment network and beyond, working at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved and delivered. GOX builds the standards, tools and daily management mechanisms that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight. This role extends solutions proven in the EU into new regions, equipping local Operations teams to deliver flawless fulfillment: on time, at speed and at the lowest cost.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
- Experience in program or project management, delivering initiatives from concept to execution.
- Experience with reporting and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or other BI packages.
- Experience working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams, including operations.
- Experience working with operations and business teams to communicate problem impacts and understand business requirements.
- Experience with hands-on SQL coding and working with large, complex data sets to design models and scenarios.
- Experience communicating and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including presenting complex, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field.
- Experience in operations, transportation, or supply chain.
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements.
- Experience rolling out tools, processes, or mechanisms across multiple sites or regions.
- Experience with data warehouse architectures, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and analytic tools and environments.
- Experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, Athena, AWS Glue, EMR, Lambda, and IAM.
- Python programming experience for data manipulation (pandas, numpy) and basic statistical analysis.
- Experience partnering with technology teams to translate business needs into system requirements and new features.

title: Security Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. We are looking for a Security Engineer to join the FDE security team and help secure production AI systems deployed in customer environments.

You will conduct security reviews, write security tooling, perform threat modeling, and implement controls that protect AI systems built by FDE engineers. You work alongside FDE delivery pods in customer environments, getting hands-on with production code, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML pipelines. You learn fast, ship fast, and build security into the system rather than bolting it on after the fact.

This is a hands-on security engineering role where you spend most of your time writing code, reviewing architectures, and testing systems. You work with senior security engineers who will mentor you, but you own real security deliverables from your first engagement. If you want to learn AI security by doing it, in production, at enterprise scale, this is the role.


Key job responsibilities
- Conduct security design reviews, code reviews, and architecture assessments for production AI systems (agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, orchestration layers, model integrations) under guidance from senior security engineers
- Perform threat modeling and penetration testing for AI/ML applications deployed in customer environments; identify vulnerabilities and work with FDE engineers to implement fixes before production release
- Build and maintain security automation: scanning tools, CI/CD security gates, guardrail testing scripts, secrets detection, and dependency vulnerability checks for forward-deployed AI systems
- Implement security controls for AI-specific threats: prompt injection prevention, output filtering, data isolation, model API endpoint hardening, and guardrail configuration
- Support security incident response for FDE-delivered production AI systems; assist with triage, root cause analysis, and remediation under senior engineer guidance
- Document security findings, patterns, and remediation guidance as reusable playbooks and runbooks that benefit future FDE engagements
- Contribute to the FDE security accelerator library: reusable modules, templates, and reference configurations that help FDE engineers build secure AI systems faster
- Requires up to 25% travel

A day in the life
You start the morning running your automated security scan against a new Bedrock-powered application an FDE pod shipped overnight, triaging the findings and filing issues for two real vulnerabilities. Mid-morning you pair with an FDE engineer to fix an IAM policy that's overly permissive for their multi-agent orchestration system. After lunch you're writing a Python script that automates guardrail bypass testing for the team's standard deployment pattern. You close out the day joining a threat modeling session led by a senior security engineer, where you learn how to assess data flow risks in a customer's RAG pipeline. Every week you're working on a different AI architecture, building skills you can't get anywhere else.

About the team
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to build production AI systems. AWS invested $1B in this initiative. We move at the speed of the customer: demonstrating ROI in weeks, not quarters. We are customer-obsessed. We lead customers toward outcomes, build together, and leave behind scalable patterns. Security is our enabling function: without it, nothing goes to production. Our culture is people-first, anti-burnout, bold, and engineering-excellence-driven.

title: HR Partner, Human Resources, NASC PXT
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Partner role offers an exceptional opportunity to build your career in human resources, focusing on employee experience, engagement, leadership development and HR operational excellence.

As an HR Partner on the NASC PXT team, you will support PXT operations through consistent standard work execution, relationship-building, and timely issue resolution. With a visible presence across site operations, you'll foster team culture, support engagement, and coach leaders on PXT practices. You'll create positive employee experiences while building your skills in navigating increasingly complex issues and influencing without authority. Success in this role comes from building strong partnerships, demonstrating sound judgment, and maintaining a customer-centric approach. You'll learn to use data-driven insights and HR technologies to enhance the employee experience while developing core HR capabilities that will serve as the foundation for your career growth.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Support a positive employee experience by executing key programs, reinforcing workplace standards, and partnering with PXT and Operations to create a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and supported.

- Execute standard work with consistent quality and timeliness, meeting established service level agreements (SLAs) and maintaining accurate documentation of HR processes and employee interactions.

- Provide frontline employee support by responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and ensuring appropriate resolution or escalation of employee matters. Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

- Assist in running and monitoring feedback channels such as roundtables, floor walks, and employee engagement activities. Support issue tracking and follow-up, partnering with senior PXT team members to drive resolutions and improvements in employee experience.

- Coach frontline leaders on behaviors that impact engagement and retention. Reinforce expectations and guide leaders in selecting and effectively utilizing available tools to improve team communication, recognition, and performance conversations.

- Support the execution of site-level engagement, communication, and culture-building initiatives. Coordinate logistics, gather feedback, and monitor effectiveness.

- Learn to track and summarize PXT-related data (e.g., attrition/attendance trends, hiring data, employee sentiment). Help prepare insights for site reviews or team discussions.

- Promote the use of self-service tools to resolve routine employee and manager questions. Help identify recurring gaps and escalate opportunities to improve tool usability or adoption.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing standard work execution with responsive employee support. You'll maintain consistent presence on the operations floor, engaging directly with hourly employees and partnering with leaders to address concerns and drive engagement initiatives. Operating under the guidance of senior team members, you'll execute core HR processes while ensuring quality service delivery.

Through data tools and HR technologies, you'll assist in tracking metrics and identifying trends, while developing your ability to build trust through personal interaction. You'll support employee engagement activities, help coordinate feedback channels, and assist in coaching and development of others. When complex issues arise, you'll seek guidance from senior team members, learning to navigate challenging situations while developing sound judgment.

Success in this role comes from maintaining organized routines, demonstrating strong follow-through, and building effective partnerships with both the PXT team and operations leaders. This role requires excellent organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

About the team

The NASC HR teams partner to deliver the best customer experience that is resilient to variability and solutions-focused in a rapidly-changing environment. We enable our teams to operate with autonomy in a diverse workforce structure and we foster a culture where people connect, develop and deliver together.

descriptionHtml:

This leader will own the strategy and execution of complex, multi-dimensional partnerships that span the full technology stack -- from silicon and AI models to operating systems and consumer applications -- and will serve as a domain expert in one or more critical technology areas.

title: Senior SDE, VPC Lattice
descriptionHtml:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS.

EC2 Networking is one of the foundational services that enabled customers to move to the cloud. We manage the traffic flowing through one of the largest networks in the industry, handling billions of requests. VPC Lattice is how we are re-inventing application networking — giving customers a fully managed way to connect, secure, and observe services across accounts and VPCs without the undifferentiated heavy lifting of building their own networking layer.

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to help scale the next generation of our networking architecture and control plane. As Lattice adoption accelerates, the hard problems are increasingly about scale, elasticity, and reliability: how the control plane provisions and propagates configuration across tens of thousands of endpoints, how it stays consistent and fast as the fleet grows by orders of magnitude, and how we evolve the data path without disrupting live customer traffic. This is a senior role for an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, large-scale technical problems end to end and raise the bar for the engineers and teams around them.

A successful candidate is a technical leader who can decompose a hard, loosely-defined problem into a sequence of deliverable milestones, drive the design across team and service boundaries, and bring other engineers along. You are comfortable going deep on distributed-systems fundamentals — consistency, throughput, failure modes, operational safety — and equally comfortable zooming out to influence multi-year architecture. You raise the operational and quality bar for the whole team, not just your own code.

Key job responsibilities
Own the architecture and implementation of control-plane-scaling systems that keep VPC Lattice fast, consistent, and reliable as the fleet grows by orders of magnitude.
Lead the design of ambiguous, large-scale technical problems end to end — from a loosely-defined goal to a sequence of shippable milestones with clear tradeoffs documented.
Drive technical decisions that span team and service boundaries, building alignment with partner teams across EC2 Networking, PrivateLink, and the broader UC organization.
Set and enforce the bar for operational excellence — observability, failure isolation, safe deployment, and the ability to evolve the data path without disrupting live customer traffic.
Identify and remove whole classes of operational and scaling risk rather than one-off defects, and leave the team's software measurably better and easier to maintain.
Mentor and grow engineers on the team: raise the quality of designs and reviews, develop others' judgment on distributed-systems tradeoffs, and multiply your impact through the people around you.
Invent on customers' behalf, turning high-demand internal and external requirements into durable, well-engineered capabilities.

About the team
We are scaling the next generation of VPC Lattice and PrivateLink — a very successful, fast-growing product with a strong multi-year vision, a great team, and genuinely interesting distributed-systems and networking problems to solve. The work unlocks features in high demand from both internal and external customers while hardening the control plane for the scale that growth demands. Please reach out to me (Ehren Graber) for more information, or click Request Informational through the posted job. Thank you!

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, EU DSP Finance
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape how Amazon pays and supports its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)? The DSP Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to help drive rate card and payment improvements that directly affect the DSP and driver experience. In this role, you will build financial models, analyze complex data, and deliver recommendations that inform how we structure payments and pricing for one of Amazon's key delivery programs. You will partner with finance leaders, product managers, and program managers across the Last Mile organization to turn data into decisions that matter.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain financial models and reports that support DSP rate card and payment initiatives, converting data into clear findings and recommendations for leadership.
- Audit reporting accuracy across your business area, identify root causes of data discrepancies, and partner with stakeholders to resolve issues and strengthen financial controls.
- Lead improvement projects that automate processes or reduce defects in financial reporting, delivering measurable results while managing competing priorities and deadlines.
