- Communicate your analysis through written summaries and presentations, translating complex finance topics into clear takeaways for both finance and non-finance audiences.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing DSP payment data, checking for anomalies and validating that recent rate card changes are flowing through correctly. Mid-morning, you work through a financial model that tests different pricing scenarios for an upcoming business review with Last Mile leadership. After lunch, you join a working session with product managers to walk through your findings and align on next steps. Later, you pick up a process improvement effort — perhaps automating a recurring report or updating documentation so your teammates can build on your work.

About the team
DSP Finance supports Amazon's Delivery Service Partner program by providing the financial analysis and reporting that guide how we pay, price, and invest in our delivery network. The team works closely with Last Mile product and program teams to ensure every financial decision is grounded in accurate data and sound analysis. We are currently focused on improving DSP rate cards and payment structures, and we are looking for someone who is curious, resourceful, and ready to contribute to work that directly impacts thousands of delivery partners.

title: Propulsion Lab Engineer, Amazon Leo GNC & Propulsion
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

The Propulsion Lab Engineer will be a key member of Amazon Leo's Propulsion Manufacturing team, combining deep technical expertise with strong collaborative skills. This role will lead the development and optimization of electric propulsion manufacturing infrastructure while working across engineering disciplines. The ideal candidate will drive technical solutions for manufacturing challenges, implement process controls, and maintain critical lab equipment, while effectively partnering with Design, Quality, Systems, and Test engineers to translate requirements into robust manufacturing processes. Success in this role requires both hands-on technical leadership and the ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration to achieve manufacturing excellence.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Build or Test development and production hardware in accordance with SOPs, work instructions, and engineering drawings, including component and subsystem fabrication (machining, 3D printing, rapid prototyping).
• Conduct detailed inspections and testing of production and reworked hardware to validate functionality, performance, and conformance to specifications.
• Navigate MES/SAP systems in support of production operations.
• Execute failure analysis and root cause investigations on non-conforming propulsion hardware.
• Execute hardware rework tasks as needed.
• Work with Responsible Engineers and Mfg. Engineers to diagnose and solve issues resulting in yield and throughput improvements.
• Identify and/or lead process improvement initiatives to increase rework efficiency, reduce scrap rates, maintain 5S standards and improve first-pass yield.
• Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve integration challenges, validate rework procedures, provide design-for-manufacturability feedback, and implement corrective actions.
• Support the development and improvement of assembly and test procedures based on hands-on build experience and design-for-manufacturability feedback.
• Take loosely defined requests from engineers, clarify requirements, and develop a concrete plan of lab work owned through completion.
• Prioritize and manage a personal work queue against team goals, sequence builds and tests to prevent blockers and keep multiple efforts moving concurrently with limited supervision.
• Coordinate task execution within assigned work streams, track progress, and flag schedule or resource risks.
• Support and maintain Test and/or Mfg. team tool program for development and production stations.
• Collaborate with Amazon Leo facility team and support preventative maintenance for development and production test chambers.
• Support with Propulsion lab organization and floor space layout.
• Operate shop tools and lab equipment effectively and safely.
• Train and mentor team members on rework techniques, lab systems, tools, safety protocols, and quality standards.
• Document technical issues, rework procedures, resolutions, and lessons learned.
• Track and report on rework metrics including cycle time, yield rates, defect trends, and scrap reduction.


A day in the life
The Propulsion Lab Engineer will perform a variety of tasks involving support for both Mfg. and Test infrastructure and executing on these actions. Lab Engineers will work closely with both Technicians and Manufacturing/Responsible Engineers to identify process improvements to improve both Mfg. and Test efficiency and optimization. The Lab Engineer will actively monitor Mfg./Test infrastructure, equipment health, station status, and process performance with the intent to proactively identify and action issues that could impact the efficiency, throughput, and/or overall health of the department before they escalate into production blockers.

A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced production environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment for quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.


About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team is responsible for the design, development, and testing of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.

Basic qualifications

- Experience planning and maintaining lab facilities for optimal efficiency and creating new processes when necessary
- • Associate’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience in a related STEM field.
- • 4+ years of experience in the assembly, integration, calibration, and test of aerospace hardware in a development or production environment.
- • Experience executing qualification test campaigns for aerospace or defense hardware.
- • Experience in hardware design and validation of components, subsystems, and systems.
- • Experience with hardware rework, assembly/disassembly, or precision manufacturing operations.
- • Experience with precision torque, measurement, and inspection devices (e.g., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters).
- • Experience planning and maintaining lab facilities for optimal efficiency, including managing lab resources, equipment, and supplies.
- • Experience tracking and coordinating lab tasks across concurrent activities using ticketing or project management tools.
- • Experience contributing to and developing engineering documentation, procedures, and SOPs for complex working processes.
- • Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred qualifications

- • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent STEM field.
- • Experience working with vacuum and/or pressurized gas systems.
- • Experience with test execution software such as Test Stand, LabVIEW, and Python.
- • Experience with testing of production hardware designed for space environments.
- • Experience building, commissioning, and maintaining test racks and testing infrastructure.
- • Experience with tube fabrication and orbital tube welding (OTW).
- • Experience scheduling and delivering high-impact test and Mfg. infrastructure scope.
- • Experience working with FOD, ESD-sensitive hardware, and cleanroom requirements, including contamination control protocols.
- • 2+ years of experience contributing to or owning a calibration and equipment tracking system.
- • Experience supporting automated test sequences or system characterization routines.
- • Background in continuous improvement frameworks (Six Sigma, Lean, 5S).
- • Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, macros, SQL, and visualization tools (Tableau, Quick, Grafana).
- • Experience running user trials, beta testing, field testing, or collecting customer feedback.
- • Experience working with hardware and software teams for setting up, testing, and troubleshooting prototype devices.
- • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to document technical findings clearly.

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We’re seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to help drive this mission forward. You'll partner with Operations leadership to weave safety into the fabric of our daily operations, using data-driven insights to create innovative solutions that reduce risk and enhance productivity. Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

title: Software Development Engineer III, Machine Learning Annapurna - System Integration
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build AI-powered tooling that keeps custom silicon running reliably at scale? In Annapurna Labs at Amazon Web Services (AWS), we sit at the intersection of software and hardware, designing the systems that detect failures, generate repair instructions, and automate qualification for Trainium products. As a Software Development Engineer III, you will lead the technical design and delivery of this tooling platform — combining generative AI techniques with deep hardware knowledge to solve problems that few teams in the industry encounter. With hardware complexity and scope expanding rapidly, this is a rare opportunity to shape how we bring the next generation of custom chips to operational stability.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver generative AI-based tools that identify complex hardware failures, dynamically create repair instructions from hardware system designs, and automate the qualification framework for post-new-product-introduction hardware changes on Trainium systems.
- Own system design decisions across the tooling software stack, evaluating tradeoffs in scalability, maintainability, and performance while partnering with silicon design and operations teams on cross-functional technical discussions.
- Collaborate with hardware design and sustaining teams to align tooling updates with upcoming silicon changes, creating the right integration checkpoints to ensure successful delivery.
- Drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team through code reviews, design reviews, and mentorship — raising the quality bar and helping fellow engineers grow.
- Evaluate and refine generative AI model outputs used in the tooling platform, applying responsible AI practices to ensure accuracy and reliability at production scale.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing system health metrics for the tooling platform, then join a design review where a teammate walks through a new generative AI model for automated failure diagnosis on Trainium hardware. You ask probing questions that sharpen the approach. After lunch, you pair with an engineer to work through a tricky data-modeling problem, then shift to a cross-team sync with hardware design engineers to align on upcoming silicon changes that will require updates to your qualification automation. Later, you write a technical document outlining how the tooling will scale to support the next generation of Trainium products.

About the team
Our team within Annapurna Labs builds the AI-powered software tooling that ensures Trainium systems meet operational stability targets before handoff to sustaining teams. We work at the intersection of software and silicon alongside systems development engineers, software development engineers, and hardware engineers — a cross-functional mix that is rare even within AWS. As Annapurna Labs continues to expand its custom chip portfolio, we are investing in new generative AI capabilities and scaling our platform to keep pace. If you are excited about solving problems where software meets hardware at industry-leading scale, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, GTM Lead, Fashion & Fitness Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Go-to-Market Lead, Category Marketing This role is responsible for developing and leading the category marketing strategy for an assigned F2 business area, including Fashion, Sports & Outdoors, or Licensed Sports. Serving as the single-threaded marketing partner to category leadership, this leader translates business priorities, customer insights, assortment strategies, and commercial goals into annual and seasonal go-to-market plans that drive traffic, engagement, and growth.

The Go-to-Market Lead owns the category's integrated marketing roadmap, including campaign calendaring, investment prioritization, Tier B targeted activations, Tier C foundational programs, and category contributions to Tier A tentpole moments. They develop a clear point of view on where marketing can most effectively support category growth, align cross-functional teams around prioritized customer moments, and ensure plans are grounded in measurable category objectives.

This role partners closely with Business, Creative, Product, BI, and Traffic & Targeting teams. The Go-to-Market Lead provides the category inputs required to inform NASM and channel planning, including assortment priorities, deal calendars, customer audiences, launch milestones, and business goals.

Key job responsibilities
Category Marketing Strategy & Planning
• Develop the annual and quarterly marketing strategy for an assigned category, translating business goals into clear customer, campaign, and investment priorities.
• Establish the category's marketing narrative, strategic pillars, target audiences, and role within the broader F2 Integrated Marketing portfolio.
• Identify the customer missions, seasonal shifts, cultural moments, launches, and category-specific opportunities where marketing can generate incremental business impact.
• Build integrated plans that connect category priorities across campaigns, customer experiences, content, creative, and traffic-driving channels.
• Identify emerging category trends, customer shifts, and growth opportunities that inform marketing strategy and investment recommendations.

GTM Ownership & Campaign Prioritization
• Own the category's annual and seasonal GTM calendar, balancing business priorities, customer relevance, operational readiness, and available marketing capacity.
• Lead Tier B targeted and Tier C foundational GTM activations from initial business intake through strategy, executional alignment, launch, and performance review.
• Represent the category's priorities and customer needs within Tier A tentpole planning, including major shopping events, seasonal campaigns, and cross-F2 initiatives.
• Develop clear GTM briefs that define the customer problem, business opportunity, audience, value proposition, success metrics, dependencies, and activation approach.
• Establish prioritization recommendations when category requests exceed available marketing, creative, or channel capacity.
• Ensure campaigns have clear launch criteria, accountable owners, measurable objectives, and documented decisions.

Category Partnership & Business Leadership
• Serve as the primary marketing partner to category leadership and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the category's financial goals, assortment strategy, deal calendar, customer dynamics, and operational roadmap.
• Translate category inputs into actionable marketing recommendations rather than functioning solely as an intake or execution partner.
• Partner with category leaders to identify where marketing can meaningfully accelerate growth and flag areas where business, selection, pricing, or operational readiness may impact campaign effectiveness.
• Lead annual and quarterly planning discussions that align category stakeholders around the highest-impact marketing priorities.
• Provide category leadership and Directors with visibility into upcoming campaigns, investment recommendations, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.

Cross-Functional GTM Leadership
• Partner with Creative and Stores teams to ensure customer experiences and traffic-driving assets reflect a consistent category strategy and value proposition.
• Work with Product and Technology teams to identify customer experience requirements, launch dependencies, merchandising needs, automation opportunities, and readiness risks.
• Partner with Finance and category teams to recommend category marketing budget allocation across campaigns, programs, and customer moments.
• Provide the Traffic & Targeting Lead with category goals, priority audiences, assortment inputs, deal details, timing, and campaign requirements to inform channel and NASM planning.
• Partner with BI and channel teams to define measurement plans and interpret performance across campaigns and customer touchpoints.
• Drive timely decisions, escalate unresolved dependencies, and maintain alignment across teams throughout the GTM lifecycle.

Performance Management & Leadership Narratives
• Own category-level marketing performance reporting, including campaign results, customer insights, business impact, lessons learned, and recommended actions.
• Develop the marketing sections of category MBR and QBR narratives for senior leadership.
• Connect individual campaign results to broader category trends, strategic priorities, and investment decisions.
• Establish repeatable mechanisms for tracking category plans, launch health, marketing contribution, and progress against annual goals.
• Use performance insights to refine future campaign strategy, audience priorities, activation criteria, and budget allocation.

A day in the life
• Meet with category leadership to review business performance, assortment priorities, upcoming launches, and areas where marketing support could accelerate growth.
• Translate annual or seasonal business goals into an integrated GTM strategy and prioritized category marketing calendar.
• Lead a cross-functional campaign working session to align Product, Stores, Creative, Traffic & Targeting, and Analytics partners on launch readiness and success metrics.
• Review a proposed category activation and determine whether it has a clear customer insight, differentiated value proposition, sufficient selection, and measurable business opportunity.
• Provide the Traffic & Targeting Lead with category inputs for NASM and channel planning while maintaining accountability for the overall category strategy.
• Develop an MBR or QBR narrative that explains performance, identifies key drivers and headwinds, and recommends actions for the next planning period.
• Advise senior leaders on campaign prioritization, investment tradeoffs, launch risks, and the category’s forward-looking marketing roadmap.
About the team

About the team
F2 Integrated Marketing (F2M) owns the Go-to-Market process for time-bound, business-backed moments across Fashion, Sports & Outdoors, Premium, Licensed Sports, and Luxury. We translate business priorities into customer-facing marketing activations that drive traffic, conversion, and engagement across shopping events, holidays, cultural moments, sports and entertainment, launches, and mission-based customer needs.
The Category GTM team serves as the strategic marketing interface to each F2 business. We develop category-level marketing strategies, establish annual and seasonal priorities, lead targeted and foundational GTM programs, and ensure category goals are represented within larger F2 tentpole moments. We work in close partnership with Traffic & Targeting, Creative, Stores, Product, Analytics, Finance, and central marketing teams to turn business opportunities into cohesive and measurable customer activations.

- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience communicating results to stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Program Manager, Defence, Worldwide Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Program Manager supports the delivery of cloud transformation and priority initiatives for Australia's Defence Organisation, helping keep them on schedule and aligned to customer outcomes. This role coordinates day-to-day project activities, tracks progress across workstreams, maintains visibility of risks and dependencies, and supports the planning and execution of Think Big initiatives and priority engagements that demonstrate how AWS can address Defence's most pressing capability challenges.

You will support a portfolio of initiatives designed to deepen AWS's partnership with Defence. This includes Think Big engagements that help Defence leaders envision how cloud can address their strategic challenges, as well as priority delivery programs that demonstrate tangible value. You will be the connective tissue that keeps these initiatives moving: coordinating across internal teams, maintaining stakeholder engagement rhythms, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

In this role, you can expect to travel interstate approximately 10% of the time.

Key job responsibilities
Program Management: Support the end-to-end coordination of priority Defence initiatives from concept through delivery, including tracking dependencies across AWS teams (Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, Partners), maintaining initiative timelines, and ensuring deliverables are on track and aligned to customer outcomes.

Project Support: Support the delivery of cloud and transformation projects, maintaining schedule adherence and quality standards across assigned workstreams.

Stakeholder Engagement: Support customer engagement activities with Defence stakeholders, coordinating logistics, tracking actions, and maintaining alignment on project milestones. Prepare briefing materials, maintain stakeholder maps, and support the rhythm of engagement across Defence Groups and Services.

Program Coordination: Prepare materials for and support facilitation of weekly alignment meetings, program updates, and cross-team coordination sessions to keep delivery teams synchronised. Support the planning and coordination of Think Big events, executive briefings, and priority initiative workshops with Defence customers.

Milestone Tracking: Coordinate with technical delivery teams, solutions architects, and operations to track milestone progress, flag dependencies, and maintain accurate schedule documentation.

Tracking & Reporting: Maintain project trackers, dashboards, and status reports; provide regular updates on progress, risks, and blockers.

Risk Monitoring: Monitor and report on milestone-level risks and issues impacting project schedules; escalate per established protocols and support development of mitigation strategies.

Process Improvement: Contribute to process improvement initiatives, using data and metrics to support efficiency and delivery quality.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you don't meet all of the qualifications listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path or includes non-linear experiences, that's something we value — don't let it stop you from applying.

title: Site EHS Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We're seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to directly impact associate well being while driving operational excellence.

As a WHS Manager, you'll be the site's safety champion, leading our Global WHS Program implementation. You'll combine hands-on safety management with strategic thinking to protect our most valuable asset – our people. Your role bridges the gap between safety requirements and operational success, requiring both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. Working closely with Operations leadership, you'll drive safety initiatives that make a real difference. You'll conduct comprehensive risk assessments, analyze safety data, and implement practical solutions that protect associates while supporting productivity. Your ability to build relationships and influence positive change will be essential as you help shape our safety culture. You'll lead safety compliance efforts, conduct thorough site audits, and analyze incident trends to target improvements where they matter most. Managing our first aid program and emergency response capabilities, you'll ensure immediate care is always available. Your analytical skills will transform safety data into actionable insights, while your leadership abilities will help engage associates in our safety mission.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site


For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management, or 2+ years of Amazon Safety (blue badge/FTE) experience

- Distribution Center or Manufacturing EHS experience with mix of exempt and non-exempt employees at a site of at least 250 people
- Master's degree
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment.
- Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization.
- Certified Safety Professional
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with site leader
- Ability to develop and implement department goals and strategies.

title: Snr Specialist Analytics SA – ASEAN, WWSO Data APJC
descriptionHtml:
In this role, as a Specialist Solutions Architect, you will be the analytics expert for customers across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam. You will help them build and operate analytics, search, and streaming workloads, and partner with them to design **agent-ready data platforms**: open, governed foundations that let AI agents search, process, and analyse data to support decision-making. The work spans the full range of modernisation, from moving on-premises Hadoop and legacy data warehouses to an open lakehouse on Apache Iceberg and S3 Tables, through to semantic search, natural language data exploration, and RAG-based insight generation.

ASEAN is one of the fastest-growing data markets in the world, and many customers are still deciding where their data platform will live. You will work with banks, telcos, retailers, public sector agencies, and digital natives as they make that decision, often in head-to-head evaluations against Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Fabric, and GCP BigQuery. Grounded in deep analytics expertise, you will bring a broad perspective that spans databases, ML, and security, and you will advise on governance and access control as much as on performance and cost.

You will build reference architectures, demos, and workshops with your own hands and scale them across six countries through account teams and partners. Partners deliver much of the analytics work in ASEAN, so enabling them to land complex platforms such as SageMaker Unified Studio is a core part of the role. You will also carry the voice of ASEAN customers back to the AWS analytics, search, streaming, and generative AI service teams to shape their roadmaps.

Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences. Every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it for ASEAN. If you see that shift as an opportunity and want to co-create new value with customers across the region, come join us and build the future together!

Key job responsibilities
- Provide deep technical expertise in analytics, search, streaming, and governance (Redshift, Athena, EMR, Glue, Kinesis, MSK, OpenSearch, Lake Formation, DataZone, SageMaker Unified Studio, S3 Tables, QuickSight) across ASEAN's enterprise, public sector, and digital-native customers

- Design agent-ready data platforms on open lakehouse, Iceberg, zero-ETL, RAG, and semantic search

- Lead architecture reviews, immersion days, proofs of concept, and migrations (MAP) off Hadoop, legacy warehouses, and third-party platforms

- Win competitive evaluations against Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Fabric, and GCP BigQuery

- Enable partners and build repeatable assets that scale across six countries

- Carry customer feedback and competitive signals back to service teams to shape the roadmap

A day in the life
Your customers span Financial Services, Telecommunications, Retail, Public Sector, and Digital-Native companies. One morning you run an open data platform workshop in Singapore; by lunch you are designing governed data access for a Manila bank's first production agents. In the afternoon you build a RAG proof of concept with OpenSearch and Bedrock for a Jakarta retailer, then help a partner unblock a SageMaker Unified Studio rollout, before sending field feedback to the Redshift service team. You travel regularly across a region where the decisions customers make today will set their data platform for the next decade.

About the team
The WWSO Data & AI team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. This role sits on the APJC Data team alongside Analytics, Database, and Storage Specialist SAs and GTM Specialists across five geos. In ASEAN, you work closely with the Analytics GTM Specialist, the Database and Storage Specialist SAs, the partner team, and account teams in each country to deliver holistic data outcomes. If you thrive on going deep on technology, love building for customers, and measure success by the architectures you've shaped, this is the role for you.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding experience
- Experience defining data center system-level architecture, documenting performance and equipment requirements, creating and communicating conceptual designs, and creating and maintaining project documentation
- Experience working with technical and business stakeholders from global cross-functional teams
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience
- Deep hands-on experience with analytics technologies, including data warehousing (e.g. Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, Teradata), data lakes, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink), search (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), and data governance.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience and demonstrated industry leadership in the fields of database or data warehousing, data sciences and big data processing
- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Bachelor's degree
- Experience designing agent-ready data platforms (open lakehouse, Iceberg, zero-ETL, RAG, semantic search)
- Experience across multiple Southeast Asian markets and building reusable assets at scale
- Fluency in English required; a Southeast Asian language (e.g. Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, Vietnamese) is a plus

title: Operations Manager, AMZL-Delivery Station
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It's driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you'll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
- Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
- Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You'll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You'll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you'll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You'll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles 'last mile' delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers' delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our 'under the roof' associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our 'on the road' people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

- Experience in people and stakeholder management
- A degree or equivalent qualification
- Proficiency in English, both verbal and written (CEFR C1), and in German (CEFR C1)
- Relevant experience in using quantitative and qualitative data to support business decisions
- Relevant experience in key areas of production and supply chains

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
- Experience in Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
- Experience in a similar logistical working environment

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow

2026 Business Intelligence Engineer Internship - France

Do you enjoy solving complex problems and troubleshooting products? Are you passionate about developing test strategies, finding, and tracking bugs to resolution, and innovating on behalf of customers? Do you want to be a part of a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and contribute to one of the most visited sites on the Internet?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate on behalf of our customers. The intense focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Business intelligence engineers use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.

The challenges business intelligence engineers solve for at Amazon are big and affect millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. Our path is not always simple, so we are selective about who joins us on this journey. There is a certain kind of person who takes on this role at Amazon – someone who is excited by the idea of creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company whose ship cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

The Amazon University Talent Acquisition Team are looking for ambitious students to join us as interns at the heart of our core consumer business! Internships are flexible in length to fit in with your university’s placement scheme.

- Développer des solutions analytiques
- Reconnaître et adopter les meilleures pratiques en matière de reporting et d'analyse : intégrité des données, conception des tests, analyse, validation et documentation

title: Operations Manager, Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

The applicable collective agreement (CCNL) for this role is Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. The position is classified at Level Quadro or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
- Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
- Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Italian
- Experience in data-driven business operations processes
- Experience managing teams
- Bachelor's degree
- Relevant experience in key areas of production and supply chains
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you

title: Construction Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
CBA for Employees Of Telecommunication Sector (Level 7) / CCNL per i dipendenti di imprese esercenti servizi di telecomunicazione

As a Construction Project Manager you will be a part of a creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry leading examples of energy efficient, cost effective designs.

The Construction Project Manager is responsible for the management of General Contractors on one or more data center construction sites, including oversight and review of all disciplines including civil, structural, architectural electrical, mechanical, controls and commissioning.

The Construction Project Manager is also responsible for managing the administration of construction contracts and/or development contracts ensuring full compliance including all commercial elements.

Key job responsibilities
Be based from the MXP site construction offices - be Amazon’s eyes and ears on the project and our first responder if an issue is identified.
Travel to other data centers, Amazon offices or vendor premises as required to support the current project or undertake training. Opportunities may also exist for international travel.
Manage General Contractors on one or more data center construction sites, including oversight and review of all disciplines including civil, structural, architectural electrical, mechanical, controls and commissioning.
AWS' motto is 'work safe or not at all' and you will set the local example, raise observations and work with the GC to achieve bar raising safety standards with no tolerance for unsafe behaviors.
Undertake strategic and tactical commercial management of construction contracts, including managing the commercial administration of contracts to ensure compliance
Work with general contractors, developers and vendors to deliver efficient and high-quality project turn-overs.
Inspect and review construction work including site safety, project quality control, support of the commissioning process and review of submittals and other project documents for compliance with contract documents
Review civil, electrical and mechanical designs to create construction project scope for requests for proposal and variations.
Support negotiations with general contractors and internal procurement partners and evaluate bids/proposals/claims with detail and accuracy.
Record and report key construction/commercial metrics, including internal schedule, cost and budget reporting and forecasting
Lead on analysis and resolution of claims and major variations
Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center, work collaboratively to mentor, support and develop more junior team members

A day in the life
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: Applied Scientist, Prime Video Commerce Insights
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next
generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and
movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.

Prime Video Commerce's mission is to present the right offer to the right customer at the right time — across subscriptions, channels, and transactional video, in every market and on every device. Our science team replaces static business rules with ML-driven decisions that personalise the entire commerce journey, from discovery through checkout and beyond. We operate at scale across hundreds of millions of customers, and we are expanding into new frontiers — combining the latest advances in agentic and generative AI, behavioural simulation, and causal inference to understand the impact of our decisions before they reach customers.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Prime Video Commerce Insights team in London. You will develop and deploy customer-facing models, understand customer behaviour at scale, and explore emerging techniques that help us make better decisions faster. This is a delivery focused role within a high-visibility multidisciplinary group of engineers and scientists, focused on improving the customer experience for Prime Video.

Key job responsibilities
- Research, design, and implement machine learning approaches (e.g. reinforcement learning and recommendation systems) that personalise across different customer touch points.
- Collaborate with engineers to deploy and integrate successful experiment results into large-scale, complex Amazon production systems with low latency.
- Design and execute rigorous experiments to demonstrate the technical efficacy and business value of your methods.
- Act as a subject-matter expert and help define the science roadmap and research agenda in line with organisational priorities and production constraints.
- Provide machine learning thought leadership to technical and business leaders, thinking strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
- Work with technical product managers to work backwards from what matters to customers and deliver ML-backed solutions.
- Share results with the team and wider scientific community through documents that are both statistically rigorous and compellingly relevant.



A day in the life
You will be a research leader and innovator within the Commerce Insights organisation. You will collaborate with talented engineers and senior leaders to solve problems that are uniquely challenging at Amazon's scale: personalising commerce decisions across multiple business lines, balancing competing objectives, and positively impacting hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. The problems here are technically deep — combining large-scale ML, causal reasoning, and behavioural modelling in a domain where every decision carries real revenue and customer-experience consequences. Your research will ship to production and move metrics that matter.

About the team
You will join a team of engineers and applied scientists with a proven track record of solving highly complex, ambiguous problems — work that has produced patents and publications at top-tier conferences. The team has direct visibility to senior Prime Video leadership and collaborates broadly across Commerce, Content, and Platform teams to shape how customers discover, subscribe to, and engage with video content. This is a team that operates at the intersection of rigorous research and real-world impact, where your ideas move from whiteboard to production for hundreds of millions of customers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Experience in building machine learning models for business application
- Professional non-internship experience in a relevant field (CS, CE, ML)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code
- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent qualification/experience

title: Premium Support Business Development Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, AWS Enterprise Support
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.


As Premium Support BDM for Startups, you will be part of the Enterprise Support organization and own the go to market strategy for Support across the startup segment. Your goal is to grow adoption of paid Support offerings among startups while maintaining target margins, and to use Support as a lever that accelerates startup growth on AWS. You will engage founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders to understand why they need Premium Support (or why not), what pain points they face as they scale, and what stops them from investing in support earlier. You will sharpen our Support proposition for startups, including differentiated offerings by funding stage, value and ROI versus price, and programs tied to VC and accelerator programs. You will design and run controlled experiments to drive commercial innovation, quantify how Support drives AWS platform adoption and startup retention, and enable the Startups sales team to tell a compelling Support story. You will also work with partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings for startups.

The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and is comfortable working across internal functions and geographies.

Key job responsibilities
- Engage founders, technical leaders, VCs, accelerators, partners, and Startups field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support and Unified Operations Services, plus other new products launched throughout the year
- Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support Services adoption across startup stages (seed, Series A through growth, and AI native scale ups) and identify levers for improvement
- Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support Services adoption, such as trials, stage based offers, and launch readiness programs
- Review and analyze Enterprise Support Services pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers and offers fit startup budgets and burn rates
- Quantify impact of Enterprise Support Services adoption on AWS Platform adoption, startup retention, and graduation to larger commitments, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
- Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners - Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per startup segment. In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
-Work with stakeholders across Startups Sales, Premium Support, Enterprise, and the AWS Activate and VC programs
- Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
- Drive Enterprise Support Services deals end to end with Sales

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Migrations, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in leading large-scale portfolio assessment and application disposition for enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS — assigning R-strategies (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retire, Retain, Relocate) and designing wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on migration best practices, risk mitigation, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end migration assessment process, ensuring adherence to AWS well-architected principles, optimizing wave sequencing, and managing risks throughout the programme lifecycle.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

- Own Portfolio Assessment for assigned application estates (1,000+ servers), scoring applications across multiple dimensions using Technical Designs and CMDB data
- Apply the migration decision tree to assign R-strategies (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retire, Retain, Relocate) and document the rationale in Architecture Decision Records
- Build and maintain dependency maps (e.g. via ModelizeIT), resolving conflicting data between tooling output and application-owner interviews
- Design wave plans: group applications by dependency, balance capacity, respect regulatory frozen zones, and coordinate across geographies
- Run Tech Bridge sessions with customer application owners to validate disposition decisions and unblock migration paths
- Feed wave planning into AWS Transform, ensuring move groups are sized, sequenced, and ready for factory execution
- Proactively identify and escalate risks to wave timelines, then propose and drive mitigations before they become blockers
- Collaborate with Security, Networking, and Replatform teams so cross-cutting dependencies are addressed in wave sequencing

title: Distribution & Commercial Strategy Lead, Amazon Travel & Events
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) operates a global corporate travel program spanning 60+ countries and serving hundreds of thousands of employees. The Supplier & Category Strategy (SCS) team owns all supplier relationships within AT&E, driving enterprise-wide savings while continuously improving the traveler experience.

We are seeking a Distribution & Commercial Strategy Lead to own the commercial agreements, distribution economics, and channel strategy that govern how Amazon's negotiated supplier inventory reaches the booking tools and platforms travelers use. This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, supplier economics, and the broader travel ecosystem. This individual is responsible for defining the commercial terms, cost structures, and contractual frameworks through which employees access travel inventory across channels. This role also interfaces across Amazon business units, partnering with AWS, Advertising, and Operations teams to ensure commercial agreements and distribution strategies reflect the full breadth of Amazon's supplier relationships and leverage our collective scale.

This is a buyer-side role with a seller-side vocabulary: the ideal candidate understands GDS economics, NDC content flows, agency models, and rate parity structures, and uses that knowledge to negotiate from strength, optimize distribution costs, and ensure Amazon's program captures maximum value from every supplier relationship. The travel industry is undergoing a structural transformation as NDC and direct distribution reshape content access and legacy intermediary models evolve. This role develops the distribution and commercial strategy that positions Amazon to lead through that transformation.


Key job responsibilities
Commercial Strategy & Distribution Economics
- Own the commercial strategy for how distribution agreements are structured across TMCs, OBTs, GDS providers, and content aggregators — defining the contractual frameworks that govern transaction fees, incentive structures, content access terms, and commercial economics across channels
- Define commercial term segmentation by channel type, supplier tier, and category, ensuring terms are tailored to the economic profile and strategic value of each distribution relationship
- Design and manage the portfolio of supplier relationships that drive the content into our booking channels across distribution solutions
- Define channel segmentation by travel type (air, hotel, ground) and traveler population, and set adoption targets by channel based on cost, compliance, and traveler experience
- Own channel-level cost of distribution: transaction fees, GDS segment costs, OBT licensing, TMC service fees, and technology overhead
- Model total cost of acquisition by channel, incorporating direct costs, compliance rates, policy savings, and traveler productivity impact
- Ensure distribution agreements complement — not conflict with — supplier-direct negotiated rates, allotment commitments, and exclusivity terms
- Manage contract lifecycle: renewals, amendments, SLA enforcement, and performance-based renegotiation triggers for distribution suppliers
- Monitor channel leakage and develop strategies to drive bookings toward preferred managed channels
- Evaluate emerging distribution models (NDC-native aggregators, direct-connect platforms, AI-powered booking interfaces) for fit within the AT&E ecosystem
- Develop the annual distribution budget and forecast; present channel economics to AT&E leadership

Content, Data & Accreditation
- Partner with Tech & Data Solutions (T&DS) team to integrate connecting Amazon's inventory and booking systems to distribution channels via APIs, NDC, GDS, and XML feeds
- Ensure negotiated rates, corporate fares, and preferred supplier content load correctly across all distribution channels monitor content load accuracy and troubleshoot gaps
- Partner with T&DS on the connectivity roadmap: NDC adoption, GDS optimization, direct-connect buildout, and data pipeline architecture
- Partner with TD&S to ensure booking data flows back from all channels for spend visibility, policy compliance reporting, duty-of-care tracking, and travel risk management
- Evaluate and manage content aggregation strategy (ATPCO, third-party content sources) to maximize fare and rate coverage
- Develop a holistic understanding of travel ecosystem economics — how distribution channels, payment mechanisms, accreditation models, and supplier agreements interconnect, and where Amazon can unlock value by operating differently
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Compliance to understand accreditation requirements, costs, and benefits across jurisdictions

Pan-Amazon Commercial Development
- Support quarterly pan-Amazon strategy sessions with AWS, AB, Ads, and Operations, particularly where distribution and commercial decisions intersect with BU-specific supplier economics
- Identify cross-Amazon synergies where enterprise-wide supplier relationships create leverage for both content and distribution strategy as well as our business partners (AWS, Ads, etc)
- Align with Supplier Strategy to ensure distribution terms and channel architecture reinforce — rather than undercut — category-level supplier negotiations
- Represent distribution and commercial strategy in AT&E leadership planning, vendor QBRs, and cross-functional program reviews

Basic qualifications

- Experience communicating effectively with senior leadership
- 5+ years of progressive experience in travel distribution, corporate travel program management, TMC/OBT operations, or travel technology
- Deep understanding of travel distribution economics — GDS, NDC, direct connects, content aggregation models, and the cost structures of intermediary layers
- Demonstrated track record negotiating distribution agreements with GDS providers, TMCs, OBTs, or content aggregators
- Strong analytical skills — comfortable building and interpreting channel performance models, cost analyses, and business cases

Preferred qualifications

- Existing relationships with major GDS providers, TMCs, OBTs, or content aggregators
- Hands-on NDC implementation or migration experience (airline or corporate buyer side)
- Experience evaluating or managing agency accreditation processes and their commercial implications
- Revenue management or pricing background that informs channel-specific rate strategy
- Experience at a large-scale corporate travel program (Fortune 100 or equivalent volume)
- Understanding of centralized payment mechanisms (virtual cards, lodge cards, ARC/BSP settlement)
- Familiarity with duty-of-care data requirements, travel risk management, and how distribution architecture supports both
- Knowledge of Spotnana, BCD, Concur, or similar corporate travel platforms
- MBA or advanced degree preferred but not required
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Business, or a related field
- Direct ownership of channel-level P&L or distribution cost management
- Experience operating at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical connectivity
- Familiarity with agency accreditation frameworks (ARC, IATA, BSP) and how they relate to distribution economics

title: Software Development Engineer , DC Console/InfraMap
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 4, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon's Data Center Bridge (DC Bridge) organization builds and operates the software that runs AWS's worldwide data centers. The DC Console team is hiring an experienced frontend-leaning full-stack engineer to build the platform that lets every builder in DC Bridge ship data center operator experiences — not just the team that owns the console.

InfraMap is the UI for AWS data center power and cooling: real-time and historical visualization from world level down to individual sensors, used by Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), the Facility Operations Center (FOC), Field Engineering, Data Center Capacity Planning, and DCGS management to prevent and remediate Critical Site Events (CSEs) and Large Scale Events (LSEs). It has also become a bottleneck: every new page had to be built by one team, inside one monolith, on one deployment pipeline. DC Console exists to remove that constraint.

You should be a strong web engineer with real depth in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, React, browser fundamentals, and high-volume real-time UX — and you should be genuinely interested in build systems, deployment, and the mechanics of how frontend code gets to a browser, because half of this role is platform engineering. You should have a background in the fundamentals of software development, deep understanding of best practices across languages and technologies, and take personal pride in interfaces that operators trust during an incident.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the platform that lets engineering teams across the organization ship features into a shared operator console — independent packages, independent pipelines, composed into one product at runtime.
- Own the console shell: navigation, routing, page registration, and the shared services that feature teams build against so no team reimplements the same plumbing.

- Solve the cross-origin problems a federated frontend creates — authenticated module loading, edge authentication, content security policy, per-stage isolation, and graceful fallback when the module registry is unreachable.

- Deliver self-service onboarding: a template that gives a partner team a working module, account, CDN, and pipeline in one step, and support for teams that bring their own backend.

- Give each feature team visibility into its own module — health metrics, alarms, paging, and user reports — without them having to own the shell.
- Move existing pages out of the monolith as reference implementations, behind feature flags so any rollout can be reversed.
- Build and maintain real-time visualizations of power and cooling data that operators rely on during site events.
- Support the teams you onboard: office hours, design reviews, and security reviews that keep a federated frontend from fragmenting into ten different products.

A day in the life
You will write React and TypeScript against Cloudscape, and you will also write CDK, argue about version sets and pipeline self-mutation permissions, and debug why a module loads in alpha and 403s in beta. Development runs on personal stacks — a Midway-authed copy of the whole shell per engineer, aps deploy / aps hotswap against a shared CDN. The team leans hard on AI tooling (an in-house MFE agent package plus AWT and Cloudscape MCP servers) and expects you to extend it, not just use it.



About the team
DC Console is a small team inside DC Bridge, branched from InfraMap, with a charter that is deliberately platform-shaped: let builders across the organization manage, deploy, and create features hosted on InfraMap and DC Console independently of InfraMap core operations. We inherit InfraMap's tenets — security over user experience, user experience over speed to production, we visualize data rather than create it and always provide provenance back to the source, and we build global capabilities rather than one-off single-site solutions.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues.
