title: Expert(e) Sureté & Prevention des pertes, Security & Loss Prevention, WWOS
descriptionHtml:
Notre réseau opérationnel, reconnu pour sa rapidité, sa précision et son service exceptionnel, livre des millions de colis et de sourires aux clients Amazon chaque jour. Pour sécuriser notre réseau et assurer la continuité des opérations, nous recherchons des talents expérimentés et avec un grand sens du détail qui souhaitent rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Loss Prevention Expert. Dans ce rôle clé, vous assurerez la sécurité en tant que service, pour nos sites opérationnels tout au long de la chaîne logistique afin de protéger nos collaborateurs et de prévenir les pertes.

Key job responsibilities
• Soutenir la résilience de nos opérations commerciales en contribuant à la planification des urgences et des crises pour les sites sous votre domaine de responsabilité
• Contribuer à l'identification des vulnérabilités (par exemple, pertes, expérience des associés, amélioration des processus) et définir les actions d'atténuation appropriées tout en assurant le respect des normes juridiques et éthiques
• Servir de point de contact et coordonner les mesures de gestion des risques avec la direction locale et les parties externes (par exemple, les forces de l'ordre et les organisations syndicales) pour toutes les questions liées à la sécurité
• Assurer la conformité de vos sites par rapport aux normes de sécurité mondiales d'Amazon
• Être responsable des projets liés à la sécurité et à la prévention des pertes aux niveaux local, régional et national

A day in the life
En tant qu'Expert Sureté & Prevention des pertes, vous rejoindrez une équipe de professionnels de la Sécurité qui fournissent des services de sécurité aux clients professionnels de plusieurs sites au sein d'une zone géographique dédiée.

Vous effectuez des audits de sécurité physique réguliers et enquêtez sur les violations de politique, les incidents liés à la sécurité et les événements de perte. Au cours de vos enquêtes, vous collectez des informations en surveillant les systèmes et outils, en analysant des rapports de données et en menant des entretiens. Vos conclusions contribuent à identifier les vulnérabilités dans nos processus et vous identifiez et pilotez des mesures d'atténuation. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans le maintien de l'intégrité physique de nos sites en auditant et en surveillant l'état de santé de nos systèmes et, conjointement avec des experts en la matière et des fournisseurs externes, maintenez leur fonctionnalité.

Vous identifiez et agissez sur des initiatives visant à améliorer notre infrastructure de sécurité physique et contribuez directement à la planification budgétaire pour nos fournisseurs. Vous interagissez quotidiennement avec nos prestataires de services de sécurité pour assurer les services de sécurité de qualité et une expérience client fluide. Enfin, vous dispensez des programmes de formation et de sensibilisation liés à la prévention des pertes à d'autres équipes et gérez la mise en œuvre de notre plan de Sécurité et Prévention des Pertes.

About the team
Faisant partie de nos équipes Global Security Operations au niveau mondial, la sécurité et la prévention des pertes soutiennent la réalisation des objectifs commerciaux d'Amazon et le renforcement de notre marque en protégeant efficacement contre les menaces et en gérant les risques de sécurité et de prévention des pertes qui pourraient :

• Mettre nos associés et nos clients en danger
• Perturber la continuité de nos activités commerciales
• Causer des dommages à nos actifs
• Avoir un impact négatif sur la réputation de notre marque

Travaillant en partenariat avec nos parties prenantes, nous sécurisons la chaîne d'approvisionnement d'Amazon de bout en bout et promouvons la sécurité lors des discussions d'affaires. Nous le faisons en prévenant les risques et les vulnérabilités liés à la sécurité et à la prévention des pertes le plus tôt possible. Nous intervenons dans les incidents en cours pour en minimiser l'impact, ainsi qu'en enquêtant en profondeur sur les incidents liés à la sécurité afin d'identifier et d'éliminer les causes profondes, empêchant ainsi leur réapparition.

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme ou expérience en sécurité ou gestion des risques (services de sécurité, protection des biens, prévention des pertes, gestion des risques, gestion des stocks, enquêtes, chaîne d'approvisionnement, audit, conformité ou similaire)
- Expérience de travail avec la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) dans un environnement professionnel
- Maîtrise avancée du français écrit et oral
- Niveau B2/C1 en anglais écrit et oral

Preferred qualifications

- Un diplôme, un équivalent de diplôme ou une certification professionnelle
- Expérience des systèmes de sécurité physique, des techniques d'enquête et/ou de la gestion des agents de sécurité sous contrat
- Expérience pertinente dans le commerce de détail, les entrepôts, les centres de distribution, les services de livraison ou la chaîne d'approvisionnement
- Expérience dans la collecte et l’analyse de données
- Permis de conduire

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Annapurna Labs, Inc
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next-generation ML accelerator is a multi-die chiplet using state-of-the-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape-out and into production readiness.

This is not a status-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.
Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.
Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.
Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.
Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape-out critical.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.

About the team
The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
- Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
- Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.

Preferred qualifications

- Familiarity with HBM integration, die-to-die interfaces, or high-speed serial subsystems.
- Experience with leading-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
- Background in ML accelerator or high-performance compute silicon.
- Experience with multi-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2.5D/3D integration).
- Familiarity with HBM integration, die-to-die interfaces, or high-speed serial subsystems.
- Experience with leading-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
- Background in ML accelerator or high-performance compute silicon.
- Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large-scale chip development programs.

title: Business Analyst, Innovation lab
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.

The Innovation Lab is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. The BA will also support hands-on pilot execution on the floor when required.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
- Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
- Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day
- Monitor the health of DWP jobs, dashboards and data sources, and keep them reliable (target: 100% availability)
- Find and fix the root cause of data issues and trouble tickets (failed jobs, missing or mismatched data)
- Define the data plan for each pilot (metrics, baseline, collection method) before the trial starts
- Own the lab scorecard and daily pilot report, and prepare the data for weekly business reviews and leadership updates
- Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
- Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
- Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
- Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
- Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
- 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
- Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
- Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions

descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is building a Low Earth Orbit satellite constellation designed to provide connectivity to customers around the world.

We are looking for an experienced RF systems engineering lead with hands-on experience in direct-to-device (D2D) satellite and cellular systems. This role owns the RF performance of the service link between the satellite and standard commercial devices, from link budgets and RF requirements to lab, chamber, and over-the-air validation.

The ideal candidate has already worked on real D2D, NTN, satellite-to-cellular, or closely related systems and understands the RF characteristics of connecting satellites directly to commercial phones and devices. We are looking for someone who can lead the RF work across the system, set technical direction, and work effectively with satellite, RAN, device, and partner teams.

The successful candidate will combine broad cellular and service knowledge with strong customer and partner skills, strong ownership, and the ability to lead in a fast-moving, international environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the RF system performance of the D2D service link, including link budgets, uplink and downlink margins, interference, and coverage across elevation angles and device types.
• Define RF system requirements and allocate them across the satellite payload, phased array and beamforming, ground segment, and devices.
• Lead RF characterization and validation of the payload, phased array, and beamforming, including EIRP, G/T, sidelobes, out-of-band emissions, and adjacent-channel and adjacent-beam interference.
• Define and lead RF test plans in the lab, RF chambers, and over the air, from conductive and radiated tests to on-orbit measurements.
• Analyze device RF behavior on commercial phones and modules, including antenna performance, power classes, sensitivity, and coexistence with GNSS and Wi-Fi.
• Provide the RF design inputs and measurements (EIRP, out-of-band emissions, sidelobes, interference) that the Regulatory and Compliance team uses to demonstrate compliance, and design the RF system to meet the emission limits.
• Develop and improve RF measurement methods, calibration procedures, tools, and automation that scale across devices, satellites, and test locations.
• Act as the subject matter expert for RF systems across the satellite, ground, and devices.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a related field
- 8+ years of professional RF engineering experience, including at least 3 years in the Direct-to-Device (D2D) ecosystem, NTN, or direct satellite-to-cellular connectivity.
- Demonstrated experience owning RF link budgets, RF requirements, interference analysis, and RF characterization for satellite or cellular systems.
- Experience with RF test equipment and methods (signal generators and analyzers, network analyzers, channel emulators, anechoic chambers, over-the-air measurements).
- Working knowledge of 3GPP NR or LTE physical layer and RF requirements, including NTN.
- Experience working with commercial devices or chipsets in support of satellite or D2D services.
- Experience leading technical work across multiple engineering teams or partners.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with phased-array antennas and digital beamforming.
- Experience with mobile satellite service spectrum and the associated regulatory and coexistence requirements.
- Experience with RF test automation and data analysis tools.
- Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering teams, technology partners, customers, and leadership organizations.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites to deliver low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. With hundreds of satellites already in orbit and the service now in beta, we are scaling rapidly and building new features across the network.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Software Defined Networking (SDN) Control Plane team, you will lead the design and development of the Agents that runs in all the devices including satellites, customer terminals, gateways, and terrestrial infrastructure to drive network plans. You will tackle multi-dimensional problems at global, set technical direction for your team, and collaborate closely with hardware teams, scientists, embedded software engineers, and mission operations to shape how our network performs and grows.

Design and deliver embedded agent component for new business needs for Leo program, you will be defining conventions and technical solutions that guide the team's engineering direction. - You will solve performance and interfacing challenges working with multiple plan consumers. - Develop highly reliable and resilient software that will run on devices for multiple years, along with the operational tooling, dashboards, and observability features needed to monitor and maintain system health. - Collaborate with hardware teams, scientists, embedded software engineers, mission planning, and mission operations to ensure the control plane integrates cleanly across the broader Leo network. - Drive software quality across the full lifecycle — from technical design and code review through testing, deployment, and on-call operational support — while mentoring other engineers on best practices.

Your week balances focused, heads-down engineering with regular collaboration. About the team
The SDN Control Plane team builds and operates the brain of the Leo network. We own the distributed systems that route traffic across a growing constellation of LEO satellites, customer terminals, gateways, and terrestrial links. Our work directly determines the quality of service our customers experience. We are a collaborative, roadmap-driven team that values thoughtful design and operational rigor. You will receive guidance from peers and engineering leadership, and you will have the opportunity to grow your technical leadership skills by setting architectural direction and influencing decisions that span multiple teams.

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

descriptionHtml:

You'll influence partner teams and cabling vendors to adopt quality assurance checklists that validate conformance to both Amazon and jurisdictional standards during critical milestone checks for cable installation and testing activities.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech
descriptionHtml:
Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority. We are building a new generation of AI-native products to fundamentally change how Amazon identifies, understands, and eliminates the problems that create friction for selling partners. This is an opportunity to apply Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, and agentic AI to one of Amazon’s most complex problems: turning millions of fragmented seller signals into actionable intelligence and systematically eliminating the root causes behind them.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Tech to lead a strategic AI initiative focused on reducing the need for selling partners WW to contact Amazon by systematically identifying and eliminating the root causes of seller friction. The initiative, Root Cause Elimination (RCE), will build an intelligent, end-to-end system that brings together seller signals across contacts, escalations, audits, and other mechanisms and uses AI to generate insights, identify and consolidate root causes, quantify and prioritize their impact, recommend preventive actions, and continuously validate whether those interventions eliminated the underlying seller problem. The vision is to move from teams manually finding and reacting to individual defects to an intelligent system that continuously learns from seller experiences and helps Amazon prevent those experiences from recurring.

From Day 1, this leader will have ownership of a large, ambiguous product space and the autonomy to define the product vision, AI strategy, technical roadmap, and customer experience. You will partner deeply with Engineering and Science to define LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, machine-learning models, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and AI evaluation frameworks, while building experiences that enable Policy and Program teams to turn AI-generated intelligence into action. You will make high-judgment decisions about where AI can automate work, where human judgment should remain in the loop, and how the system earns trust as it scales globally.

The Senior Product Manager-Tech will be a bar-raising product leader and communicator who thrives at the intersection of AI, technology, and complex business problems. This role requires the ability to clearly articulate complex problems and solutions, align teams toward clear priorities, advocate for investment, and establish mechanisms that measure progress against shared goals. You will collaborate across Product, Engineering, Science, Operations, Policy, and Program teams and influence leaders across multiple VP-level organizations.

This is a global role with significant interaction with teams outside the United States and the opportunity to build a product from its earliest stages. The decisions made in this role will directly shape the experience of selling partners, how Amazon uses AI to identify and eliminate systemic seller defects, and our ability to build seller trust at scale. The opportunity is not simply to make existing processes more efficient with AI, but to build a fundamentally different way of finding and eliminating seller problems before they generate repeated friction and contacts.

Key job responsibilities
Define and evolve the product strategy and vision grounded in customer needs, internal insights, and external analysis.
Identify opportunities to improve the Selling Partner experience and translate them into products and features with clear business impact.
Own the product roadmap from concept to launch - prioritize ruthlessly for ROI, manage scope, and deliver a consistent cadence of high-quality releases.
Write clear, comprehensive requirements documents and partner with engineering to influence technical design, make tradeoffs, and unblock delivery.
Work directly with internal customers to understand their use cases, pain points, and existing solutions.
Drive execution by establishing clear ownership, project commitments, and reporting mechanisms that keep teams accountable.
Build and own cross-org mechanisms (QBRs, roadmap reviews, goal alignment) to drive visibility and coordinated execution across teams.
Communicate and evangelize product innovations to stakeholders and the broader selling community.
Query and analyze data to surface insights that inform strategy, prioritization, and business decisions at scale.

A day in the life
You will own the product roadmap deciding what gets built now, what comes later, and what doesn't make the cut.
You will use your technical instincts to challenge assumptions before they become expensive mistakes. You will think beyond the immediate ask and build products that hold up as needs evolve, not just patching today's problem but getting ahead of tomorrow's.
You will live in the tradeoffs by balancing what customers want, what the business needs, and what's technically realistic. When something is a bottleneck, you will find it. When something is inefficient, you will fix it. When there's no perfect answer, you will pick the best one and move.
You will ship. On time, with the right features, at a quality bar you're proud of. And then you will make sure people actually use it by evangelizing the value, making onboarding dead simple, and removing every reason someone might not adopt.
You will dive deep into data to inform your decisions, write clear documents for senior leaders, and guide cross-functional teams forward through influence and not authority. You will be equally comfortable in a technical design review and a strategy discussion, and you will thrive in an environment that moves fast and rewards clarity of thought.

About the team
As a part of WW Selling Partner Services (SPS), Selling Partner Trust strives to both a) ensure Selling Partners feel confident in growing their business with Amazon, and b) equip Selling Partners with the tools and information they need to maintain compliance with mandated regulatory requirements and adherence to Amazon policies. We build best-in class experiences for Selling Partners to sell in our store, understand and manage their business health, and remain compliant with Amazon’s policies and external regulation

- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Product Development Engineer, Annapurna Labs Silicon Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS-Annapurna Labs develops the silicon used in our most advanced machine learning accelerator servers at cutting-edge process nodes. These SOCs are used in massively scaled server clusters to provide the best hardware platform for our customers to run training and inference workloads.

We are seeking a Senior Silicon Yield Product Engineer to take full ownership of a product's yield across one or more test insertions — from wafer sort through package final test, system level test, and downstream card/server/fleet test. You will set the yield strategy for your product by identifying and prioritizing the cost and quality activities, aligning requirements with key stakeholders, and directing the work of other engineers to deliver against them. You will engage foundry, OSAT, DFT, supply chain, test, manufacturing, and system validation partners at a strategic level to define the cost, schedule, and resource models required to bring a new product to production. Because our final product is a server, not just the silicon, you will routinely stretch beyond traditional silicon product engineering boundaries — solving complex, cross-organizational problems that no single team owns. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, deep knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes, and expertise in statistical analysis are essential.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end yield of one or more products across wafer sort, final test, SLT, driving both systematic yield improvement and excursion response to targets you help define.
- Identify and address customer quality issues by monitoring downstream yields and quality from card test through customer utilization in production.
- Identify and prioritize cost, quality, characterization activities, and assign and coordinate the work across a team of engineers.
- Align product requirements with key stakeholders, and define and drive the cost, schedule, and resource requirements to successfully deliver a new product to production.
- Create new tools and analysis flows to keep pace with the rising complexity of Machine Learning products, and evaluate new tools and systems offered by external vendors.
- Engage strategically with DFT, supply chain, test, manufacturing, quality, foundry, and OSAT teams as a trusted resource counted on to solve complex problems requiring cross-organizational expertise.
- Lead functional and structural test coverage improvements at ATE and system through DOE planning and targeted characterization.
- Mentor junior engineers, identify knowledge and skill gaps within the team, and define growth paths for individuals and the organization.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 7+ years of semiconductor industry experience as a product/test engineer analyzing test data, including ownership of yield or test for a product at one or more insertions
- Experience using Python or other scripting languages for data analysis and automation
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct authority

Preferred qualifications

- Experience owning yield and performance optimization at system or ATE test on advanced FINFET nodes across a full product lifecycle
- Deep understanding of ATE test content (Scan, BIST, Functional, IO tests) and experience defining test limits and screening methodologies based on characterization
- Experience with power and performance characterization on high-performance chips
- Experience defining cost, schedule, and resource models for new product introduction (NPI)
- Knowledge of usage of ATPG scan diagnostics and SRAM bitmap analysis for FA and yield debug.
- Proficiency in statistical analysis tools (JMP, Python) and automation for semiconductor test data.
- Experience building automated analysis systems and interactive dashboards for yield and quality monitoring.
- Experience mentoring engineers and evaluating vendor tools/systems
- Familiarity with AWS services (SageMaker, S3, QuickSight, etc.) and ability to use these for automation

title: Corporate Counsel, Customer Protection and Enforcement
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Customer Protection and Enforcement team as a Corporate Counsel and help protect our customers from fraud and cybercrime schemes. You'll work at the intersection of law, investigation, and business strategy to develop enforcement approaches that stop bad actors and create safer experiences for our customers and partners worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
- Coordinate and support investigations into fraud schemes, working with internal investigators and external law enforcement to gather evidence and assess legal claims
- Advise business leaders and legal teams on applicable civil and criminal laws related to cybercrime, fraud, and enforcement options
- Develop and implement civil enforcement strategies, including litigation, settlements, and remediation approaches to stop harmful activity
- Build and maintain relationships with law enforcement agencies across multiple countries to facilitate criminal referrals and support prosecutions
- Contribute to long-term strategy development for combating malicious online activity that affects our customers and partners globally


A day in the life
As a Corporate Counsel on our Customer Protection and Enforcement team, you'll engage in dynamic work that combines legal analysis with investigative coordination. Your day might include reviewing evidence from fraud investigations, advising business leaders on the legal implications of enforcement actions, or collaborating with international law enforcement partners on criminal referrals. You'll move between detailed legal research on cybercrime statutes, strategy sessions with our investigations and policy teams, and communications with prosecutors in multiple countries. This role offers variety—one moment you're analyzing fraud patterns, the next you're helping shape our long-term approach to combating emerging threats that target our customers and partners.

About the team
We are a dedicated team within Amazon's legal department committed to protecting our customers, sellers, and business from fraud and cybercrime. Our work spans civil litigation, criminal prosecution support, and policy development across multiple jurisdictions. We collaborate closely with investigators, business leaders, law enforcement agencies, and policymakers to create comprehensive enforcement strategies. Our vision is to build a safer Amazon by staying ahead of evolving threats and working with global partners to hold bad actors accountable. When you join us, you'll be part of a group that values thorough legal analysis, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to protecting the communities we serve.

locations: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Amazon is seeking a motivated and data-driven category manager to support the Americas data center construction space. The candidate should have strong supply chain and procurement skills, engineering design, architecture, construction, analytical and financial acumen , and passion to dive-deep. Additionally, candidate must have proven skills in managing large-scale supply chain and procurement improvement projects.
As a Procurement Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for at least one services category and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to drive efficiencies, reduce risks, and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. You will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category.
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You will be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you will be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines, succeed in a fast-paced environment; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit.
A successful candidate will demonstrate:
· Proven experience driving large-scale process improvements resulting in measurable value
· High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
· Ability to think strategically and execute methodically
· Demonstrated ability to influence teams to adopt change utilizing smart technologies
· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where ambiguity exists and continuous innovation is desired
· Committed to learning and expanding professional and technical knowledge
· Demonstrated analytical, financial and quantitative skills and ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
· Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever is necessary; general manager / owner mentality
· Demonstrated ability to dive deep in understanding the product, our business, and the competitive landscape
· Ability to see ahead comprehensively and devise a strong plan of action, and ensure execution happens on time, every time
· Ability to get things done and produce conclusive, measurable results within time commitments
· Strong influencing skills




A day in the life

As a Procurement Manager on the Data Center Construction Procurement team, you will own the end-to-end commercial relationship with General Contractors (GCs) delivering AWS data centers. No two days look the same — you might be negotiating a Guaranteed Maximum Price in the morning, reviewing schedule recovery options with a project team at midday, and evaluating GC proposals for a new campus RFP by close of business.

Day to day you will:

Drive competitive sourcing events — develop RFP strategies, evaluate contractor qualifications, and lead award recommendations for some of the largest construction programs in the industry.
Negotiate and manage contracts — structure contract amendments, negotiate change orders, and hold GCs accountable to cost, schedule, and safety commitments.
Partner cross-functionally — work alongside Construction, Design, Legal, Finance, and Program Management to remove blockers, align on delivery milestones, and ensure data center capacity comes online on time.
Analyze cost and risk — benchmark GC pricing, identify cost-savings opportunities, and flag commercial risks before they become schedule impacts.
Influence at scale — develop procurement playbooks, contract standards, and lessons-learned that raise the bar across AWS's global data center portfolio.
You will support projects across multiple regions and have the opportunity to shape how AWS procures and delivers data center construction — locally and globally.

title: Lab Test Engineer, Environmental Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The Lab Test Engineer role is responsible for keeping aerospace environmental test production running smoothly. You will troubleshoot issues that technicians encounter during daily testing, resolving problems with test setup, equipment, and IT infrastructure. The Lab Test Engineer will be an expert for our various Automated Test Equipment (Test Racks) used during environmental testing. With your expertise in environmental testing procedures, equipment, and basic Python scripting, you will identify root causes and implement corrective actions to maximize productivity and product quality. Additionally, you are responsible for production support activities including ticket management, change management, monitoring, metrics, documentation, process development, host provisioning, and hardware management. You may also debug, evaluate, and resolve software issues for applications and services that will improve availability and performance. You will develop scripts and applications to automate redundant tasks and to improve operational efficiency. You will work cross-functionally with Development, QA, and other Support teams to maintain and improve availability and performance of Amazon LEO's production Automated Test Equipment.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintain, troubleshoot and improve test automation hardware supporting production testing
- Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical or software problems on the fly, working with an integrated cross-functional team of manufacturing engineers, test engineers, lab technicians and maintenance teams to resolve
- Perform RCCA of issues in production testing and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence
- Develop and maintain calibration procedures for RF test equipment
- Define and implement solutions to optimize and automate environmental testing
- Work with other engineers to refine test requirements and the methodologies to achieve those requirements
- Willing to “roll up sleeves and do what needs to be done” in a small, specialized, team environment
- Must be willing to work off shifts and weekends as required



A day in the life
The primary goal of this role is to ensure all automated production test racks remain fully operational, properly calibrated, and ready for use by production technicians. Daily responsibilities include planning and coordinating preventive maintenance with schedulers, organizing and tracking all rack calibration activities, and maintaining accurate documentation and hardware configuration data in partnership with supporting engineering teams.

This role also oversees the readiness of spare test racks, ensuring they are maintained, functional, and available for rapid swap-in when needed. It includes coordinating any required repairs to return equipment to operational status. Additional responsibilities include cataloging test harness requirements, monitoring inventory and life-usage of harnesses, and ensuring adequate spare coverage.

The engineer is expected to respond quickly to escalations from technicians, providing troubleshooting support and resolving operational issues with the test racks to minimize production downtime.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- 2+ years of experience testing, troubleshooting, and debugging automated test systems including electrical, mechanical, electronic, networking, and software systems
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field and/or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of production test station (automated test equipment) hardware/software design and factory deployment
- 2+ years of experience with electrical test equipment, data acquisition, and control software
- Experience writing/reading/debugging software in Python, C, C# or other language

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of hardware design, development, validation and delivery of embedded hardware product experience
- 2+ years of experience with environmental testing focusing on thermal and vacuum test processes
- 2+ years of experience working with RF test systems

Work hard. Have fun. Make history. At Amazon it is expected no more and no less from you. Ever since Amazon opened its doors, it has been an aim to become the most customer-centric company in the world. The BWS AVS Retail Vendor Specialist is a vital member of Amazon's Vendor Services team, focused on building and maintaining successful partnerships with vendors while driving mutual growth. Operating across five key pillars (Pricing, Selection, Availability, Marketing & Advertising), this role serves as an essential link between Amazon and its vendors, ensuring efficient execution of core services and operational excellence. The position requires a strong foundation in e-commerce fundamentals and the ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations for vendors. You'll help Amazon create the Earth's greatest shopping experience – a store featuring more products and brands with the most compelling content compared to any other online or offline store.

Key job responsibilities
Manage a portfolio of strategic vendors in the BWS category, serving as their primary point of contact and executing growth initiatives across the five AVS pillars
-
Work with functional experts to develop and implement Joint Business Plans that align with vendor business objectives and grow the account Year over Year
-
Monitor and analyze vendor performance metrics, providing regular insights and recommendations. Deliver weekly reporting with detailed commentary and specific action plans
-
Drive vendor adoption of Amazon tools and best practices to improve operational efficiency
-
Ensure optimal inventory management and supply chain efficiency for assigned vendors
-
Manage financial portfolio of our vendors, ensuring business continuity
-
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues and maintain service levels
- Execute basic marketing strategies to increase product visibility using Amazon's marketing tools

title: Accounts Payable Analyst, FinOps, FinOps Support Center - HQ2
descriptionHtml:
As part of the Amazon Global Finance Operations Services team, you will support the growth of Amazon FinOps. The candidate will work directly with vendors, offshore partners, vendor managers, and internal stakeholders to coordinate on-time and accurate payment of invoices. The candidate will participate in dive deep investigations into vendor payment data, drive process improvements, standardize processes, and eliminate root-cause defects within existing systems. The candidate must possess a strong passion for accountability, setting high standards, raising the bar, and driving results through constant focus on improving existing and future state operations, systems, and processes. This role is based in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full-time jobs. By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

• Partner with and influence upstream and downstream teams.

• Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and Amazon specific operational documents.

title: Head of Specialists, Global Financial Services, WWSO Industries
descriptionHtml:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

The ASP Specialist Organization is hiring a Head of Go-To-Market Specialists for the Global Financial Services (GFS) customer segment. The Specialist team for GFS is responsible for working with customers to accelerate their adoption of AWS for complex solutions, services, and workloads in domains that include Gen AI, High Performance Computing, large scale data processing and analytics, high performance storage, application and data modernization, and others.

AWS is looking for an accomplished leader with experience across product, business, and technology that has worked with large Enterprises and high-growth organizations in the Financial Services customer segment to accelerate their cloud-native journey for the role of Leader of Specialist Organization for GFS. In this capacity, the leader will be the single-threaded owner for specialists and work alongside the leadership team of the GFS industry team at AWS, look around corners to prioritize investments and will lead a team of Specialists and Solutions Architects that provide expertise across multiple domains. The Specialist team that this person will lead also acts as an aggregation point for feedback and input from all the customers in GFS that directly feeds into the roadmap for product and services team at AWS. While leading a team of technical, product, and business experts, you will lead domain-based discussions with C-level business and IT executives, IT leaders, architects, developers, and various lines of businesses. You will play a critical role in taking the voice of the customer and sharing it back to the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) team to ensure customer feedback is amplified to effectively influence our technology roadmaps and Go-To-Market plans. This role will contribute to the overall performance of the business globally measured by revenue growth, net new customers, and product and service influence. You will have overachieved throughout your career and built strong, deep relationships with F1000 and/or G2000 organizations.

The ideal candidate will possess both a business background that enables them to drive an engagement and interact at the CxO / VP level, as well as background that enables them to easily interact with IT operations leaders, software developers, and infrastructure and applications architects. They should also have a demonstrated ability to think analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions, and work across the business to set vision, objectives and to build consensus. A keen sense of ownership, drive, and desire to dive deep is a must.

In this role you will be accountable for:

- Leading the creation of the GFS GTM plan, as well as oversee tactical execution, of insight-based programs and go to market activities with a focus on expanding AWS market share within top customers, segments, and verticals
- Using your business acumen to drive revenue, develop sales programs and identify new markets and opportunities. You would work directly with the most interesting and demanding customers to understand their requirements and turn them into reality
- Partnering with AWS services and industry teams to identify workloads that impact our AWS solutions
- A background in mapping the application of technology to customer business scenarios that help our customers understand how to improve their operational outcomes through the use of AWS solutions
- Your excellent verbal and written communication skills will allow you build sales enablement tools, evangelize our platform with our enterprise and mid-market customers as well as our valued partners and serve as the primary Executive Briefing Center representative of the WWSO business
- Act as a trusted business advisor while deep diving into data, creating high impact programs, and tracking progress while tuning for desired results
- Be a leader of global, decentralized teams. You will guide cross functional teams to drive AWS adoption in the key workloads that use the WWSO portfolio
- Define, drive, measure, manage and coach on workload focused goals across the business

title: Delivery Consultant - AI/ML, AWS Professional Services WWPS Healthcare and Life Science
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 5, 2026

Are you excited about building software solutions around large, complex Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems? Want to help the largest global enterprises derive business value through the adoption and automation of Generative AI (GenAI)? Excited by using massive amounts of disparate data to develop AI/ML models? Eager to learn to apply AI/ML to a diverse array of enterprise use? Thrilled to be a key part of Amazon, who has been investing in Machine Learning for decades - pioneering and shaping the world’s AI technology?

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled ML Engineer to join our team as a Delivery Consultant at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS AI/ML and GenAI solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the ML project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure AI/ML and GenAI solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Implementing end-to-end AI/ML and GenAI projects, from understanding business needs to data preparation, model development, deployment and monitoring
2. Designing and implementing machine learning pipelines that support high-performance, reliable, scalable, and secure ML workloads
3. Designing scalable ML solutions and operations (MLOps) using AWS services and leveraging GenAI solutions when applicable
4. Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Applied Science, DevOps, Data Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Applications) to prepare, analyze, and operationalize data and AI/ML models

6. Sharing knowledge and best practices within the organization through mentoring, training, publication, and creating reusable artifacts

title: Data Center Infrastructure Delivery Manager, Nights
descriptionHtml:
Transform the backbone of digital infrastructure by leading a dynamic team that builds and maintains the critical networks powering global technology. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence, optimize data center deployment strategies, and create seamless connectivity solutions that support Amazon's massive technological ecosystem.

The Infrastructure Delivery Manager will manage the implementation and delivery of inbound capacity and equipment. This manager will be responsible for a growing team and will oversee their development and growth. The successful candidate will have experience managing and mentoring people, tracking budgets, providing strategic direction, and proposing technical solutions. This manager will ultimately be responsible for installing and delivering our network equipment and related infrastructures, as well as responsible for driving low voltage structured cabling across the Amazon data center platform.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate for this role you must have experience operating in large-scale data center or a background in telecom networks and display a demonstrated ability to think broadly and strategically, as this is needed to align the future of Infrastructure Delivery with the larger objectives of the business.
You will be responsible for managing a group of technicians who are installing and building server rack capacity for our customers. You must be passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to innovations in Data Center Infrastructure.

Managing and developing teams of technicians and engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring the highest levels of performance.

Delivering capacity to existing Data Centers

Helping build and bring online new Data Centers

Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve

Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors

Liaising with internal teams & management groups

Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers

Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes

Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.



This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role requires managers to conduct daily in person safety inspections, meetings, and operational tasks across Northern Virginia data center locations. Attendance in person at weekly regional manager staff meetings at AWS corporate locations (Herndon, VA) may be required.

About the team


Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of in a data center technology role experience
- 2+ years of TCP/IP networking, network cabling, fiber, optic types, and test equipment experience
- 2+ years of management/team lead function experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
- Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Understanding of networking infrastructure topology
- Certifications in a relevant field (CCENT, Network+, CCNA)
- Behavioral interviewing and hiring experience

title: Sr. Software Engineer-Agentic AI, Amazon Connect
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch Amazon Connect has become an AI leader transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Do you want to build the closed-loop platform that measures agentic AI quality and automatically improves it, alongside a team of innovative developers and scientists?

As a Sr. SDE on this team, you will design and build these systems end to end and partner closely with scientists to turn new science into capabilities customers can rely on. You will drive technical vision, influence product direction, and raise the engineering bar across the organization. You will be responsible for leading the team in building and maintaining capabilities within our best-in-class Agentic AI offering, as well as scaling those systems to support our customers' workflow orchestration automation needs.

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. title: HW Test Development Engineer, Amazon LEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are seeking a Hardware Test Systems Development Engineer to design, develop, and implement comprehensive test solutions for satellite payload phased array antenna hardware design verification. This role requires expertise in analog/digital hardware systems and design, power design, and automated lab test development. The ideal candidate will enhance our hardware design engineering verification process, ensuring our phased array antenna hardware meets rigorous performance specifications for space applications.

You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and have a drive to deliver results. You’ll have relentlessly high standards and be constantly looking for ways to improve. We are looking for individuals who want to reach beyond what is possible today. Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



Key job responsibilities
- Architect, design, build, and operate hardware test systems for satellite hardware design verification at the bring-up, sub-system, and system levels.
- Drive alignment with key partners and stakeholders on verification strategy.
- Collaborate with design engineers to define test requirements and acceptance criteria.
- Build quantitative models (test coverage, reliability, throughput) to inform design trade studies and design modifications.
- Analyze test data and generate comprehensive test reports with recommendations.
- Perform root cause analysis on test failures, lead corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement of the test systems.
- Optimize test coverage, reduce test time, and improve measurement accuracy.
- Stay current with emerging test technologies and industry standards.

A day in the life
Our time is balanced between utilization, critical support, and improvement of existing hardware test systems and designing future systems. This can be hands-on support troubleshooting or utilizing test systems, aligning with partner to define future test needs, and employing engineering best practices and tools. The tasks and daily focus change rapidly, and you will often take on exciting new responsibilities to ensure project success. Expect to address complex problems by diving deep into the data, identifying the scope of the issue, and creating innovative and functional solutions.


About the team
The payload team is responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, validation, qualification, and new product introduction to manufacturing for all satellite payloads. These systems will meet performance requirements as well as environmental and reliability requirements. To this end, the payload team collaborates closely with all the partner teams including silicon, power, mechanical, thermal, modem, RF/Coms system, and SW teams.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- Experience with test plan development, building the necessary test bench infrastructure, developing tests and verifying the design
- 5+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- 3+ years of development/programming/scripting language (Python/Java/Bash/Perl) experience
- Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control
- Experience using common electronics test equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, function generators, etc)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 1+ years of experience with signal and/or power integrity

title: Senior Business Affairs Specialist, Record Label Licensing
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about the intersection of music, media, and technology? Amazon Music is looking for a Business Affairs & Label Licensing Specialist to join our Content Acquisition Management (CAM) team in Tokyo. In this role, you'll play a central part in shaping how Amazon Music partners with artists, labels, and content creators across Japan — negotiating deals, managing licensing relationships, and helping bring new music streaming experiences to millions of listeners.

This is a hybrid role spanning deal negotiations for livestreaming and original content projects, commercial licensing operations with record label partners, and content expansion initiatives in the Japanese market. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, can context-switch between deal types, and brings deep knowledge of the music industry's commercial landscape.


Key job responsibilities
Business Affairs — Livestreaming & Original Content
- Negotiate and execute agreements for livestreams and original music content projects
- Define and standardize contractual terms across deal types; develop and maintain template agreements and framework deals
- Review deal terms to ensure alignment with global standards
- Collaborate with artist & label relations, content & editorial, business development, brand, and content operations teams
- Manage internal approvals, statement of work routing and finance/legal sign-off
- Negotiate with artist managers, talent agencies, festival promoters, and their legal representatives
- Develop best practices for negotiations across different deal types

Label Catalog Licensing
- Negotiate and support ongoing commercial licenses with record label partners in Japan
- Provide licensing consultation to internal teams
- Ensure licensing terms are correctly applied across service tiers and territories
- Support communications including translations, deal tracking, status updates, and key stakeholder relationship management
- Contribute to operational improvements including rights management systems and process documentation
- Coordinate with legal, finance, royalties and reporting, and catalog teams

Content Expansion Initiatives
- Support initiatives related to content strategy in the Japanese market
- Establish and manage relationships with local content providers to support content growth
- Collaborate with industry teams to identify and act on market opportunities

A day in the life
No two days look the same in this role. You might start your morning reviewing redlines on a livestream agreement, then shift to a licensing consultation call with the marketing team about a new promotional campaign. After lunch, you could be working with the legal team to finalize contract language for a label renewal, followed by a call with a distributor to explore new catalog partnerships. You'll regularly connect with global counterparts across time zones to align on standards and share market insights. This role offers a blend of strategic negotiation, operational rigor, and creative problem-solving.

About the team
The Record Label Licensing team at Amazon Music is at the heart of how we build and maintain partnerships with the music industry worldwide. Our Business Affairs function leads deal negotiations with industry partners — working to create fair, scalable, and innovative deal structures that power new content experiences for listeners. Our Label Licensing function manages the commercial relationships with our record label partners, ensuring operational excellence across rights management, partner engagement, and strategic consultation. Together, we help shape the future of music on Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of entertainment industry deal negotiation experience
- Experience in content negotiation, acquisition or business development
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Proficiency in English for collaboration with global cross-functional teams
- Working understanding of music rights (master recordings, compositions, performance rights) and how they apply to streaming, livestreaming, and original content
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to analyze and review contractual language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working at a record label, artist management company, artist talent agency, or similar field within the music industry
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
- Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
- Familiarity with royalty structures, per-play economics, and multi-tier streaming service models
- Experience with contract management tools and deal tracking systems
- Established relationships within the music industry in Japan

title: Senior Manager , Analog IP Design , Analog IP Design
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, is seeking an exceptional an exceptional leader to build and lead our next-generation internal Analog IP design team. This is a unique opportunity to create a world-class analog design center from the ground up, developing the critical IP blocks that power all of our custom silicon products, including Graviton (server CPUs), Nitro (networking/security accelerators) and Trainium (machine learning accelerators).

At Annapurna Labs, we think big in both scale and scope. We are building internal capabilities for cutting-edge analog IP that will define the next era of cloud infrastructure silicon. This role is an opportunity to shape the analog IP strategy across all our products and lead the team that delivers it.

Build the team: Recruit, hire, and develop a world-class analog/mixed-signal design team from the ground up. Define the org structure, roles, and growth path.

Define the IP strategy: Own the analog IP roadmap across all Annapurna Labs products. Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and drive internal capability development.

Drive execution: Lead the full design cycle from architecture through silicon validation — spec, schematic, layout, simulation, tapeout, and bring-up.

Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with SoC architecture, digital design, physical design, DFT, packaging, and system teams to integrate analog IP seamlessly.

Set technical direction: Define design methodologies, flows, and best practices. Evaluate and select EDA tools, PDKs, and foundry processes.

Innovate at scale: Develop IP that is reusable, portable across process nodes, and designed to meet the performance, power, and area (PPA) needs of multiple products simultaneously.



About the team
Why Annapurna Labs

Annapurna Labs designs the silicon that powers AWS — the world’s largest cloud platform. Our chips (Graviton, Nitro, Trainium, Inferentia) serve millions of customers globally. You will:

Work at the intersection of analog design and hyperscale cloud infrastructure

Build a team and IP portfolio that directly impacts AWS’s competitive edge

Have access to leading-edge process nodes and world-class foundry partnerships

Collaborate with top-tier silicon architects, system designers, and software engineers

See your designs deployed at unprecedented scale — millions of instances worldwide

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.
- 10+ years of hands-on analog/mixed-signal design experience in advanced CMOS nodes (7nm and below)
- 5+ years of proven engineering management experience, including building and scaling teams
- Deep expertise in one or more: high-speed SerDes/PHY, PLL/DLL, data converters, LDOs/power management, or I/O interfaces
- Track record of successful tapeouts and silicon bring-up in volume production
- Experience with design methodologies for IP portability and reuse across multiple process nodes
- Strong understanding of semiconductor physics, device modeling, and process technology

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with die-to-die interfaces (UCIe, HBI) or advanced packaging (2.5D/3D)
- Experience with integrated voltage regulators (IVR) for high-performance compute
- Experience leading analog IP development in a hyperscaler or large semiconductor company
- Familiarity with GPIO design for multi-standard (LPDDR, PCIe, ETH) compatibility
- Background in developing reusable IP platforms with configurable/parameterized architectures
- Experience in cloud/data center silicon or high-performance computing
- Strong publication record or patents in analog IC design

title: Senior Program Manager, External Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンジャパン オペレーションズ部門のEF（External Fulfillment）プランニングチームにて、シニアプログラムマネージャーを募集します。

【EFとは何か】
EFは、アマゾン自社のフルフィルメントセンター（FC）ではなく、3PLパートナーやメーカー・卸売企業が運営する物流拠点で注文処理・配送を行う事業です。大型品、重量品、温度管理品など、自社FCでは対応しにくい商材を中心に取り扱っています。このネットワークを拡大することで、お客様に幅広い品揃えと速い配送を提供し、アマゾンの事業成長を支えています。

【このポジションが担う仕事】
EF拠点のライフサイクル全体 — 新規物流センターの立ち上げと、稼働後の事業管理 — をオーナーとして担います。ローンチして終わりではなく、自分で立ち上げ、自分で運営する。それがこのポジションです。

【このポジションの特徴】
拠点開発からオペレーション設計、稼働後のパフォーマンス管理まで、ビジネスの全体像を見ながら意思決定できる立場にあります。既存の枠組みにない機能を持つ物流センターを構想し、アマゾンが新しい商材カテゴリーに参入する基盤を作る仕事でもあります。自分の仕事が、数百万人のお客様の配送体験に直接つながる実感を持てるポジションです。

物流、コンサルティング、製造業、その他どの業界出身でも構いません。複雑な課題を構造化し、スケールのある仕組みを作ることに面白さを感じる方からの応募を歓迎します。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

==

Imagine designing the logistics network that will define Amazon Japan's next chapter of growth.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to join the External Fulfillment (EF) Planning Team within Amazon Japan's Operations Division — a team that sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and innovation.

What is EF?
External Fulfillment operates fulfillment centers run by 3PL partners and vendors — not Amazon's own FCs. These sites specialize in large, heavy, and temperature-sensitive products that demand unique logistics solutions. By scaling this network, the EF team unlocks product selection that customers never thought they could get delivered fast — and delivers it at speeds that redefine expectations.

What you'll own:
You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of EF sites — launching new logistics centers and managing them as a business after go-live. This isn't project management that ends at launch; you build it, then you run it.

Why this role is special:
Few positions offer this vantage point. You'll see the entire business landscape — from site development to operational readiness to ongoing performance — and translate that view into action. You'll architect logistics centers with capabilities that don't exist yet, enabling Amazon to enter new product categories and business models. If you want to leave a visible, lasting mark on how millions of customers receive their orders, this is the role.

We welcome bold thinkers from diverse industries. Whether your background is in logistics, consulting, manufacturing, or something entirely different — if you thrive on complexity and want to build at scale, we want to hear from you.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
■ 新規EF拠点の立ち上げをリードする
新規EF物流センターの立ち上げプロセスをEnd-to-Endでオーナーとして推進します。サプライチェーン、リテール、不動産、3PLパートナーと連携し、委託先選定・契約交渉からオペレーション開始まで、拠点の立ち上げ準備を主導します。スケジュールを管理し、部門横断の課題を解消し、計画通りの品質でローンチを実現します。

■ ローンチ後の事業管理を推進する
拠点が稼働した後は、その事業パフォーマンスをオーナーとして管理します。P&Lの管理、3PLパートナーとのQBR主導、コスト最適化施策の立案・実行、オペレーションKPIのモニタリングを通じて、持続的なパフォーマンスを確保します。顧客体験やコスト目標に影響が出る前に、課題を先手で対処します。

■ 物流ネットワークの課題を解決する
ビジネス成長を阻害する物流上の課題を特定し、具体的な解決策を提案します。ネットワーク構成の見直し、新商材に対応する特殊機能を持つセンターの新設、既存拠点の機能改善など、関係部署と連携してスピード感を持って実行に移します。

■ ネットワークCapacity計画に参画する
需要予測やCapacity計画のプロセスに参画し、ネットワーク全体の状況を把握します。この理解をもとに、立ち上げタイミング、拠点規模、投資判断に対するインプットを行います。

==

■ Lead the Launch of New EF Sites:
Own the end-to-end launch process for new EF logistics centers. Coordinate with Supply Chain, Retail, Real Estate, and 3PL partners to drive site readiness — from vendor selection and contract negotiation through operational go-live. Manage timelines, resolve cross-functional blockers, and ensure each site launches on schedule and meets quality standards.

■ Drive Post-Launch Business Management:
Once a site is operational, own its business performance. Manage P&L, lead QBRs with 3PL partners, identify and execute cost optimization initiatives, and monitor operational KPIs to ensure sustained performance. Proactively address issues before they impact customer experience or cost targets.

■ Propose and Implement Logistics Network Solutions:
Identify logistics challenges that could constrain business growth. Propose concrete solutions — whether reconfiguring the network, launching specialized centers for new product categories, or improving existing site capabilities. Collaborate cross-functionally to turn proposals into reality at speed.

■ Participate in Network Capacity Planning:
Engage with demand forecasting and capacity planning processes to understand the broader network context. Leverage this understanding to inform launch timing, site sizing, and investment decisions.
