title: Digital Supply Chain Mgr, Linear Ops, PV Sports and Linear Tech, Linear Ops, PV Sports and Linear Tech
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of how customers discover and experience live television?

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events like Thursday Night Football and broadcasts of traditional television stations. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide.

The Linear Operations team enables the seamless delivery of television channels and pop-up stations on Prime Video through end-to-end channel lifecycle management, metadata orchestration, and quality assurance, supporting over 20+ global marketplaces. We're pioneering a new generation of digital supply chain to accelerate our market position and global reach.

We are seeking a talented Digital Supply Chain Manager who can help support our future as we grow our business around the world. If you are analytical and able to think big, with a passion for TV and movies, come join our highly collaborative team. You will have the opportunity to drive programs and grow professionally alongside your colleagues and own projects.

This role is located in Seattle, Los Angeles, New York, Austin or Arlington.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with product management, engineering, merchandising, operations, program teams, and external stakeholders to launch linear channels on Prime Video

• Track progress against goals and metrics, escalating obstacles to leadership to achieve program objectives

• Maintain reporting and dashboards for critical metrics, providing regular updates to management

• Execute programs with guidance from senior team members, managing content delivery and publishing workflows

• Identify operational roadblocks and build a backlog of tooling improvements

• Build relationships with partner teams and digital provider representatives

• Monitor metadata quality initiatives and systems to enhance customer experience

• Participate in process improvement efforts to optimize cross-team processes and improve delivery

• Partner with teams in India and Costa Rica to identify, standardize, and hand over tasks that drive efficiencies and scale operations

A day in the life
You will help define and execute programs to bring new linear channels to Prime Video, delivering a best-in-class customer experience through accurate and timely metadata. A successful candidate will be detail-oriented, analytical, customer-focused, and team-oriented, with strong organizational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.

About the team
We manage programs and workflows that deliver live streaming content to Amazon customers. We interact with media and metadata partners, manage onboarding and publishing processes, and define operational procedures to deliver engaging content to Prime Video customers. We build diverse teams where all voices rally around the customer to deliver delightful experiences. We seek people who want to shape both the customer experience and team culture. And we're fun!

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of equivalent experience
- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- 2+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 2+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- 2+ years of Digital Supply Chain Management (end-to-end digital workflows, metadata integration, and channel launch operations)

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Experience working at either a studio or cable/premium television network
- Experience with variety of digital media workflows
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, etc.
- Experience communicating technical concepts to a non-technical audience
- Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Sr. Digital Supply Chain Associate, PV Publishing Ops
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Image Associate to join our team, specializing in image correction, editing, retouching, and quality assurance. The ideal candidate will have the ability to deliver clean, web-ready image assets based on existing style guides and brand guidelines in a fast-paced production environment.
This position requires strong image editing skills, color correction expertise, acute attention to detail, and an understanding of digital image optimization for web, mobile, and big-screen platforms. The ability to manage multiple projects and handle high-volume image queues is essential.
The candidate will have a comprehensive understanding of image correction processes and software - specifically Adobe Creative Suite (with a focus on Photoshop) along with experience in digital production workflows. A keen eye for visual quality and consistency, and excellent communication skills are a must. An online portfolio demonstrating image editing and correction work is required.

Key job responsibilities
• Perform image correction, retouching, color grading, exposure adjustment, and cropping to meet brand standards.
• Edit and enhance key art, promotional graphics, and product imagery for digital platforms.
• Optimize digital images for web, mobile, and big-screen display ensuring proper resolution, file format, and compression.
• Ensure all image deliverables adhere to product/project guidelines and brand style guides.
• Follow and apply graphic templates, style guides, and image specifications consistently.
• Manage high-volume image queues and fulfill multiple project requests while meeting tight deadlines.
• Conduct quality checks on all image assets to ensure visual consistency and accuracy across deliverables.
• Demonstrate a command of image editing methods, tools, communication, and presentation skills.

About the team
Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV shows. From one service, we deliver versatility in numerous ways to watch hundreds of thousands of titles on the web, mobile devices, and hundreds of Internet-connected TVs, Blu-ray players, and set-top boxes.
Our mission is to be the premier destination for entertainment, offering customers an unmatched viewing experience across every screen and device.

Basic qualifications

- 1 to 3+ years of work experience in image editing, photo retouching, or graphic production in a creative agency or production environment.
- Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Photography, Visual Arts, or equivalent professional experience.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, with a strong focus on Adobe Photoshop.
- Solid understanding of image file formats (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, PSD) and web optimization techniques.
- Knowledge of color theory, image composition, and visual hierarchy.
- A portfolio demonstrating experience with image correction, retouching, and production-quality editing.
- Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot inconsistencies and quality issues.

Preferred qualifications

- Expert-level Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom skills with advanced retouching and compositing capabilities.
- Experience with batch image processing, automation (e.g., Photoshop Actions, scripting), and asset management workflows.
- Thorough knowledge of image correction workflows including color grading, skin retouching, background removal, and compositing.

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to solve real-world business challenges through innovative technology? Are you excited about working on cutting-edge, scalable services that directly impact millions of customers and sellers? Do you want to be part of a team that's at the forefront of e-commerce innovation in Japan? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!

At Amazon, we're looking for the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Our intense focus on customer obsession is part of our DNA, and it's why we're one of the world's most beloved brands.

Work with engineers, product managers, and partner teams to understand customer needs and translate them into well-defined technical requirements.

Design solutions for scoped engineering problems with guidance from experienced engineers.

Write, test, review, deploy, and maintain high-quality production code.

Help operate the services you build by monitoring system health, diagnosing problems, and improving reliability and operational mechanisms.

Use approved development and AI-assisted tools thoughtfully while remaining responsible for the security, correctness, and quality of your work.

We are committed to your growth and development. This combination of freedom, speed, impact, and learning creates an exciting environment where you can shape the future of e-commerce in Japan.

If you're ready to tackle exciting challenges and drive innovation in a key unique marketplace, come join our team at Amazon Japan!

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
- Experience in computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis)
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- Proficiency with at least one modern programming language (Java, Python, TypeScript, etc.) and standard professional software development tooling (Git, Linux, IDEs)

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer, BOM144 DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:

Operations and Maintenance:

· Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
· Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
· Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
· Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
· Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
· Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.

title: Sr. Data Scientist, EU FBA Supply Chain BIE team
descriptionHtml:
Do you see a seemingly impossible problem and instinctively think “I can figure this out”? Do you have insatiable curiosity and a drive to turn messy, ambiguous questions into rigorous, data-driven answers? Do you want your analysis to change how one of Amazon’s largest businesses runs its supply chain in Europe?

If so, this role is for you.

Our team owns the most ambiguous and complex analytical problems in EU FBA (Fulfilment by Amazon) Supply Chain. Leaders come to us when a question has no playbook: nobody has defined the problem yet; the data does not sit in a dashboard, and the answer needs both scientific rigor and sound business judgement.

As a Data Scientist on this team, you will define problems as well as solve them. You will design the analytical approach, choose methods from a wide toolkit (statistical modelling, experimentation, forecasting, optimization, and machine learning where it earns its place), and deliver insights that shape supply-chain strategy for our EU marketplaces.

A partner BI team in India owns classic data engineering, dashboarding, and periodic reporting, with support from colleagues in Luxembourg. The role therefore splits roughly 70% science and 30% BI enablement and partner-team support. Your focus stays on advanced, ambiguous data science, but you will also apply strong BI-engineering fundamentals (SQL, pipelines, self-service data, and clear reporting) to unblock yourself, support a newer and more junior partner team, and make your science land in the business.

You will work on problems such as forecasting inbound volumes and fulfilment-center capacity, measuring the causal impact of inbound placement and AWD (Amazon Warehousing and Distribution) adoption on cost to serve and seller in-stock rates, designing and analyzing seller-facing experiments on inbound and value-added services, and optimizing removal and recovery decisions for unsellable inventory. You will also help build generative AI (GenAI) tools and agents that put data science directly into the hands of the business.

You will work closely with product managers, program managers, supply-chain stakeholders, and partner data teams, translating between business needs and technical reality and building consensus on what the data says and what we should do about it.


Key job responsibilities
• Lead complex, ambiguous EU FBA Supply Chain problems autonomously, defining the problem and the solution approach rather than executing a predefined analysis.
• Select and apply the right data science methods (e.g. statistical inference, design of experiments, time-series forecasting, clustering and classification, and causal analysis) to deliver decision-grade insights with quantified impact.
• Partner with product managers, program managers, and supply-chain stakeholders to turn ambiguous business questions into tractable analytical problems, and present results to senior leadership.
• Source and combine complex, cross-domain datasets; write robust SQL and, where needed, build or refine the ETL pipelines and data models your analysis depends on.
• Set standards for reporting and self-service artefacts (e.g. Quick Sight or Tableau dashboards and KPI tracking) and unblock the business where needed, while the partner BI team owns build and run.
• Coach and support a newer, more junior partner BI team: share knowledge, review work, and help raise the analytical and engineering bar across locations.
• Drive best practices in analytical rigor, reproducibility, data quality, and operational excellence.


A day in the life
• Work with stakeholders to understand supply-chain priorities and reframe fuzzy questions into well-posed problems.
• Design the analytical approach, weigh trade-offs between methods, and validate your data, assumptions, and results.
• Write and review SQL and Python and strengthen the pipelines or reporting your analysis relies on.
• Communicate findings in written narratives and reviews for technical and management audiences.
• Mentor partner-team members and unblock BI work that supports the wider organization.


About the team
Our team owns the most ambiguous and complex analytical problems in EU FBA (Fulfilment by Amazon) Supply Chain. Leaders come to us when a question has no playbook: nobody has defined the problem yet; the data does not sit in a dashboard, and the answer needs both scientific rigor and sound business judgement.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in causal modeling like graphical models, causal Bayesian network, potential outcomes, A/B testing, experiments, quasi-experiments, and data science workflows
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
- Experience identifying and solving complex problems through data analysis
- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior management

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS Tools and Technologies (Redshift, S3, EC2)
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience with supply chain modeling and other statistical analysis tools
- Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring other engineers for best practices on data engineering
- Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets
- Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages

descriptionHtml:

The AWS Partner Network (APN) is core to how we help customers transform their businesses. You will be in the field with partners, driving joint go-to-market execution and accelerating revenue through active co-sell motions. - Ensure launches are outcome-driven — focused on adoption, usage, and revenue impact, not just output

- Establish and continuously improve repeatable processes for:
- Launch planning and execution
- Messaging and asset development
- Sales enablement
- Post-launch measurement
- Create clear frameworks, templates, and ways of working that enable the team to scale effectively

- Partner with Product and Lifecycle to ensure launches translate into real seller adoption and usage

- Use data to inform prioritisation, improve execution, and drive continuous improvement

Veeqo is Amazon’s free multi-channel shipping software, used by 100,000 ecommerce sellers to ship orders, sync inventory, and grow across marketplaces. We combine Amazon-level innovation with a fast-moving startup culture.

We’re building tools that help sellers ship smarter, list products faster, and scale efficiently across all their sales channels. As part of Amazon, we benefit from deep integrations, access to Amazon’s sellers and carrier programs, and a rapidly expanding feature set across shipping, inventory, reporting, listings, and more.

The Integrated Marketing team uses data, seller insights, and creative experimentation to raise awareness, drive adoption, and help sellers get value quickly. We’re a collaborative group of PMMs, lifecycle marketers, designers, and content specialists who ship fast and learn quickly. You’ll partner closely with the wider Marketing team, Product, Sales, Design, and Amazon orgs to bring new features to market.

title: Lead Associate
descriptionHtml:
This role requires open availability seven days a week, and flexibility to work at various sites within 10 miles of the primary Operations site in the New Orleans metro area (as needed).

Join our dedicated team and contribute to a dynamic culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, integrity, continuous learning, and fun. As a Lead Associate, you’ll be at the core of our fastest delivery operation, enhancing customer shopping experience. The ideal candidate possesses strong attention to detail, efficiently prioritizes tasks, demonstrates a willingness to learn, and maintains a commitment to delighting our customers.

What it’s like at our site(s):
1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide safe working conditions.
2. Surroundings. You'll be working in retail warehouse environment with various equipment– shopping carts, pallet jacks, stock dollies, and a variety of products, including food and alcoholic beverages. You'll also interact with our digital shopping technology.
3. Activity. Work involves frequent movement between different areas, standing while conducting most tasks, and some lifting. You may need to reach into coolers or freezers.
4. Noise level. Sound levels are minimal, what one would expect in a retail warehouse environment.
5. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, slip-resistant, closed-toe shoes are also required for safety. Additional protective and visibility gear may be required.
6. New site opening: If you’re applying to a site that hasn’t opened yet, you’ll help prepare the team for its first customer orders. This may include tasks like setting up shelving and unloading product deliveries. You’ll also have an extended training and onboarding period, which may be at a nearby Amazon site.

- Support, motivate, and model desired behavior for the rest of the team

title: Operations Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
P.S. - This is a Nightshift role
Wednesday-Saturday 00:00 - 10:30

Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
- Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
- Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
- Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
- Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
- Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience relevant experience working with data analytics and using metrics to identify problems
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.
- Experience of stakeholder management including building and maintaining professional relationships
- Experience in an operational environment, such as logistics, retail, hospitality, or customer service

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Migrations & Modernization, AWS Professional Services, DEU Central Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
This customer-facing role is exclusively for German speakers, requiring native or C1 German language proficiency.

As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
2. Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
3. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
4. Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for an enterprise customer's cloud migration, then jump into a working session with solution architects and engineers to refine a wave plan. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder alignment meeting with a customer's senior leadership team, translating technical trade-offs into business terms. Later, you may document reusable patterns from a recent engagement or coach a junior consultant on their delivery approach. Your work directly connects technical execution to customer business results.

About the team
Our Professional Services team at AWS partners with enterprise customers worldwide to accelerate cloud adoption and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes. We bring together consultants with deep technical skills and real-world delivery experience, working alongside customer teams and AWS Partners to tackle challenges across industries. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and building solutions that scale. As our customers pursue new opportunities in areas like generative AI and intelligent automation, you will play a central role in shaping how they leverage cloud technology for the future.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management
- 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture and implementation
- Experience leading complex and large-scale project delivery in migration programmes.
- Experience with portfolio assessment and application disposition on large VMware estates (1,000+ servers)
- Experience with wave planning: dependency grouping, capacity balancing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints
- Able to engage with application owners, infrastructure teams, and cross-functional workstreams (Security, Networking, Replatform) to validate dependencies and unblock migration paths
- Experience with application discovery and dependency mapping tools (e.g., ModelizeIT, AWS Application Discovery Service, or equivalent)
- Fluent in German and English

Preferred qualifications

- AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation) and in AWS migration services (e.g., MGN, DMS, AWS Transform, Migration Hub)
- AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) preferred
- Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python, PowerShell)
- Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR)
- Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Hands-on experience with VMware infrastructure discovery tools (RVTools, vCenter, ESXi clusters)
- Knowledge of database migration considerations (Oracle licensing, EC2 vs RDS, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
- Comfortable operating in complex, multi-vendor environments with incomplete documentation and conflicting data sources
- GenAI tooling experience for delivery acceleration (e.g., Amazon Q, Kiro)

title: Associate Solutions Architect Internship 2027
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. title: Process Improvement Specialist, EU FBA
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about making operations run smoother and more efficiently? Amazon is looking for a Process Improvement Specialist to join our EU FBA Support Operations team, where you will identify opportunities to enhance workflows, reduce waste, and drive meaningful results. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional partners to build and implement solutions that directly impact team performance and the associate experience.

You will bring a data-informed mindset and a knack for problem-solving to tackle real operational challenges. Whether you are analyzing process metrics, creating new standard operating procedures, or coordinating with stakeholders to roll out improvements, your contributions will help us deliver for customers more effectively every day. If you are a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong people management experience.

Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.

Key job responsibilities
• Analyze operational data and process metrics to identify inefficiencies, points of failure, and improvement opportunities within fulfillment center workflows.
• Build and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance team outputs, including developing standard operating procedures and automating repetitive tasks where possible.
• Collaborate with peers, managers, and partner teams to troubleshoot operational issues, escalate risks, and align on solutions that balance time and resources.
• Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate project status, track progress, and drive alignment on improvement plans, ensuring clear and concise updates across all levels.
• Monitor system performance and service levels through defined metrics, using findings to refine processes and sustain long-term operational gains.
• Support development and implementation of Automation through data-driven analysis by coordinating with wider organization and tracking progress
• Identify and implement sustainable improvements for operational excellence using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
• Execute strategic projects that deliver improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
• Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Support writing business and technical requirements documents
• Support establishment of business goals, metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
• Build relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to support scalable solutions

A day in the life
A typical day for an EU FBA Process Improvement Specialist will focus on executing Seller Experience initiatives and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. They'll split their work between identifying process gaps, performing execution support, implementing process improvements using Lean/Six Sigma methods. Additionally, you might start your morning reviewing performance dashboards to spot trends or anomalies in s key metrics. From there, you could spend time on observing a workflow firsthand, gathering input to engage directly with stakeholders, sellers and and manage what is working and what could be better. You might draft a new procedure based on your findings, coordinate with a partner team on an upcoming rollout, or present a recommendation to leadership. You will balance hands-on problem-solving with clear documentation and communication throughout the day.


About the team
Today, over 60% of worldwide purchases on Amazon are for products from third-party businesses, mostly from Small- and Medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses (our Selling Partners) to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns and customer service to Amazon, utilizing the capabilities that Amazon has built over the last 25+ years.

Our team is dedicated to making Amazon's fulfillment operations as efficient and reliable as possible. We focus on identifying what can be improved across processes, tools, and systems, then work together to turn those ideas into action. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do, and we partner closely with operations, learning, and technology teams to deliver results that matter.

We are building an inclusive environment where new ideas are welcomed and every team member has the opportunity to grow. If you are looking for a role where your analytical skills and initiative can make a real, measurable impact, this is the team for you.

- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in technical support

title: HV Power Gen Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is seeking a High Voltage Commissioning Engineer to become part of a AMER’s Amazon Commissioning (ACx) team, responsible for the commissioning and continuous innovation of the Medium Voltage and High Voltage infrastructure associated with our rapidly expanding data center foot print. Successful candidates shall be willing to travel and will be based in Herndon VA.

The responsibilities of the ACx Commissioning Engineer (CxE) include, but are not limited to, oversight and coordination of multi-discipline division of work related to pre-commissioning and commissioning of Amazon critical infrastructure construction and special projects. The CxE is responsible for managing and supporting vendors, providing multi-discipline input into the scheduling, design and planning of projects to contractors and other teams involved. Systems includes low, medium and high voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC, Chilled Water, BMS, EPMS and AWS proprietary systems.

In addition, the CxE will review all multi-discipline commissioning documents to ensure they are compliant with the basis of design, specifications and standards of the project. The CxE will lead concurrent projects to meet delivery schedule while maintaining compliance to health and safety, policies, standards and finances in all projects. The CxE also audits commissioning activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, safety and commissioning requirements, reporting to the ACx Regional Manager on commissioning progress and metrics for assigned projects.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Ads AI Core Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising is investing heavily in building AI-native data infrastructure, and our team sits at the center of that transformation. We own the Ads Real-Time Data Service and Advertiser Profiles: the systems that provide every advertising AI agent with immediate, structured access to advertiser context. Today, advertising agents and skills across Amazon depend on our platform to answer questions about campaign performance, budget allocation, brand positioning, and advertiser behavior within sub-second latency. We process billions of data points daily with 1-3 minute refresh cadences, serving millions of advertisers across all Amazon marketplaces worldwide.

Our team is part of Ads AI Core Infrastructure (ACI), the organization responsible for the foundational systems that make Amazon's advertising AI possible: knowledge bases, runtime environments, agent tooling, and the real-time data layer that connects them all. The programs you will lead span the full lifecycle: from defining the data model and onboarding new advertiser signal types, to coordinating cross-organization launches with agent teams, measurement systems, and advertising console experiences. You will own programs that touch 30+ engineering teams across 10 VP organizations, drive alignment between science teams developing new embedding and retrieval techniques and engineering teams productionizing them, and manage the rollout of platform capabilities to advertising agents and skills across Amazon's global advertising business. The work is technically complex (distributed systems, real-time streaming, large language model optimization), organizationally complex (multiple VP-level stakeholders with competing priorities), and time-sensitive (agent teams are shipping new advertiser experiences weekly and depend on our platform to keep pace).

Key job responsibilities
Program Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

You own the multi-quarter roadmap for Advertiser Data and Profiles across both our team and our partner teams. You define program milestones, success metrics, and delivery timelines. You write and present the program narrative for OP1/OP2 documents and monthly business reviews to Directors and VPs. You make data-driven trade-off recommendations when scope, resources, and timelines conflict, and you drive crisp decisions about what ships now versus what defers.

Cross-Organization Program Delivery

You manage programs spanning our platform engineering team, applied science teams building embedding and retrieval models, agent builder teams consuming our APIs, measurement and attribution teams depending on our data, and advertising console teams surfacing profile data to advertisers directly. You create and maintain program schedules that account for cross-team dependencies, negotiate resource commitments, and drive weekly execution cadence across all workstreams. When programs stall, you diagnose whether the block is technical, organizational, or resource-based, and you drive resolution through the appropriate path.

Technical Program Leadership

You understand distributed systems architecture well enough to participate in design reviews, challenge assumptions about data freshness and consistency guarantees, and ensure that what we commit to delivering is technically feasible within the stated timeline. You work with engineers to decompose large programs into independently deliverable milestones. You ensure that real-time ingestion pipelines, MCP server infrastructure, and profile computation systems meet their availability and latency commitments. You own the launch readiness process for platform features consumed by 30+ downstream teams.

Operational Excellence & Risk Management

You establish and maintain the mechanisms that keep programs healthy: status dashboards, weekly program reviews, escalation criteria, and stakeholder communication cadences. You proactively identify risks weeks before they become blockers and bring mitigation plans. You run retrospectives after major launches and drive the resulting improvements into team process. You own capacity planning coordination across our services during peak advertising seasons.

Stakeholder Communication & Influence

You are the single-threaded owner of program communication to senior leadership. You write documents that clearly articulate scope, timeline, risk, and trade-offs for Directors and VPs. You present at monthly business reviews and operational reviews. You build consensus across teams with different priorities by finding the framing that connects each team's goals to the program outcome. You manage expectations proactively, ensuring leadership is never surprised by delays or scope changes.



A day in the life
Morning: Program Execution and Unblocking

Your day starts with the program dashboard showing 3 of 4 workstreams green and one yellow: the real-time campaign ingestion pipeline is blocked on a schema change from the upstream data warehouse team. You write a concise status update to your Director with the issue, impact to timeline, and your proposed mitigation. You then join a 30-minute stand-up with your cross-team leads where you confirm the data warehouse team has scheduled the schema migration for next sprint. You update the program tracker, adjust the downstream timeline by 3 days, and notify the agent teams that their new campaign signals onboarding date shifted.

Mid-morning, you are in a design review with the platform engineers and an Applied Scientist. They are proposing a new context compression approach for high-cardinality advertiser data that would reduce token consumption by 35% but requires changes to the MCP server response format. You ask questions about backward compatibility, migration path for existing consumers, and latency impact. You determine this needs a phased rollout and work with the team to define the phases and success criteria for each.

Afternoon: Strategic Planning and Stakeholder Alignment

After lunch, you are drafting the Q4 roadmap section for the OP1 narrative. You are framing the Advertiser Profiles expansion in terms of what it enables for advertisers (richer recommendations, faster onboarding to new ad products) rather than the technical components. You coordinate with the product manager on the customer-facing narrative and with the science lead on which profile signals will be ready by launch.

You join a weekly sync with the three agent teams that are your largest consumers. They want real-time access to advertiser creative assets as part of the profile. You assess the engineering cost, negotiate a phased delivery (metadata first, full assets in Q1), and commit to a date for the first phase. You document the agreement and add the work items to the backlog.

Late Afternoon: Operational Reviews and Forward Planning

You run a 45-minute program review with your Director and the partner team leads. You walk through each workstream: what shipped this week, what ships next week, where the risks are. One risk surfaces: the data warehouse team is planning a schema migration that could disrupt our ingestion pipelines during peak season. You escalate this to your VP with a clear ask (timing coordination) and a proposed resolution path.

Before end of day, you review the launch readiness checklist for next week's release of a new profile data type to all advertising agents. Load testing passed, documentation is complete, the rollback plan is reviewed. You approve the launch and send the go/no-go communication to stakeholders.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: Sr. Security Engineer, Leo Security
descriptionHtml:
We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:

Redmond, WA, USA

Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Have you wanted an opportunity to secure an advanced satellite based broadband telecom service? The Leo Security team owns the security of product and operations of Leo end-to-end. We provide the necessary infrastructure and mechanisms to ensure the security of our satellite constellation and to protect the integrity and confidentiality of our customer data. Our team drives the research & development, deployment and operation of several mission-critical security systems and mechanisms. You will work in a start-up like environment, backed by Amazon’s infrastructure to bootstrap security mechanisms, and help instill the security culture in the organization.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
You and your team own the vulnerability management program for Leo systems across a large and heterogeneous fleet. The discovery, prioritization, and remediation actions themselves run on Amazon-wide mechanisms; your responsibility is to make sure those mechanisms actually work for Leo's unique fleet requirements, that coverage and risk-based prioritization hold up against how our systems are really built, and that gaps get closed. You will drive resolution of the high-severity and systemic vulnerabilities that matter most by coordinating across the teams that own them, and you will lead the burn down of long-term technical debt and risk so the fleet gets measurably safer over time.

You will be a guardian for security simplicity. Leo's builders should inherit security at scale in ways that are easy to consume and that do not pile on untold burden or distract from shipping a game-changing satellite internet service, and it is your job to make sure that promise holds. You will collect feedback from the builders living with these mechanisms, detect where security is becoming friction instead of a default, and push to simplify it, so that doing the secure thing stays the path of least resistance rather than a tax on building.

You will partner with builder teams and their leaders as a trusted advisor, helping them understand their risk, define security priorities, and secure their systems without slowing their delivery. You will assess technical debt and risk alongside them, provide strategic direction that addresses vulnerabilities and fortifies our products, help leaders measure their organization's security execution, and guide teams toward outcomes that produce products which safely handle customer data. Beyond any single engagement, you will instill a security culture that makes secure practices a default rather than an afterthought, and you will mentor builders who aspire to become security advocates and security engineers through 1-1 sessions and office hours, growing the next generation of security talent across the organization.

You will translate compliance and regulatory requirements into concrete, auditable engineering controls and evidence, keeping Leo continuously audit-ready rather than scrambling before each review. You will define and report the metrics that show whether the program is working, including coverage, time-to-remediate, SLA adherence, and residual risk, and you will use that data to drive decisions.

A day in the life
In this highly dynamic role, you will join a team that is collectively accountable for where our security investments deliver the most value and most simplify security for Leo's builders. Together you will decide where to focus, challenge each other's priorities, and share the hard problems rather than carry them alone. No two days look the same, and the judgment the team brings to where it spends its attention is at the heart of the job.

Teams will reach out for ideas on how to handle a wide variety of security problems, and you will be the person they trust to point them at the right answer. You can anticipate implementation questions like "What is the paved path for vulnerability management?", "This finding is flagged on my service but I think it is a false positive, how do I confirm it?", "I have a patch SLA I cannot meet without downtime, what are my options?", or "How do I keep this class of vulnerability from coming back?" You will help them cut through the noise, understand what actually matters for their systems, and get unblocked without slowing their delivery.

When you are not responding to builder teams, you will step back and evaluate overall org performance to find the architectural defects behind recurring findings. Rather than chasing each ticket, you will look for the pattern underneath: a misconfiguration that keeps reappearing across the fleet, a dependency that drags a whole class of services below the bar, a gap in coverage where risk is going undetected. You will propose new security scanning capability and threat detections to close those gaps, and you will push to fix problems at the source so they stop generating work for everyone downstream.

You will spend time in the data, reading the metrics that tell you whether the program is actually working: where remediation is stalling, which teams are trending the wrong way, where an SLA is about to slip, and where residual risk is concentrating. You will turn that signal into action, whether that means tuning how Amazon-wide mechanisms apply to Leo's fleet, driving a targeted campaign to burn down a specific risk, or raising a systemic issue to the leaders who own it. When a high-severity or systemic vulnerability lands, you will coordinate the response across every team that owns a piece of it and drive it to closure.

Through all of it, you will help Amazon maintain a high bar for customer security. Every mechanism you tune, every gap you close, and every builder you unblock adds up to a fleet that is measurably safer and a security experience that stays simple enough that builders can keep shipping.

descriptionHtml:

title: Software Development Engineer, Lambda Runtimes, AWS
descriptionHtml:
AWS Lambda’s goal is nothing less than to simplify and improve the experience of computing in the cloud for every developer on the planet, from start-ups to the largest Fortune 100 companies. Serverless computing is rapidly changing how every company thinks about building and delivering software solutions, and Lambda is leading this industry wide effort.

Our Team

AWS Lambda is growing its initiatives in Dublin, Ireland, with goals of continuing to define the Serverless revolution. Lambda teams in Dublin are part of lambda experience charter with mission to simplify the developer, operator, and administrator tasks in bringing code from desktop-development to a production service. If you’re excited by Serverless computing, programming languages and container/function interaction models, this role is for you. Join us and change how the world computes by enabling new frameworks that enable customers to build better software on top of AWS.

Lambda Experience Runtimes is one of the most customer visible and developer commented upon areas of Lambda. The Language Runtimes team are responsible for the curation, patching and deprecation of all the six Managed Runtimes that Lambda supports such as Python, NodeJS, Java, Ruby, Go, DotNet in addition to the custom runtime plus the associated lambda container images.

An ideal candidate has experience delivering new initiatives and be comfortable working closely with Customers. You should be aware of industry best practices & patterns in all aspects of building, releasing & verifying software. You should also be familiar with industry trends in programming languages, build tooling, and deployment spaces. You will own and help driving exciting new and existing initiatives in Lambda, while being capable of working on massive scale, high availability, and ambiguous performance problems as well as developer experience problems. This role will involve identifying and solving problems in different programming language ecosystems, enabling new customer facing functionality, and new programming paradigms in the Serverless ecosystem.

What does it take to succeed in this role?

A roll-up-your-sleeves type. Comfortable working in an environment dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of customers. Able to think about business opportunities, operational issues, and architectural diagrams in the course of a single conversation. Intellectually curious, always looking to learn, and a dedication to turning developers into fans. Someone who makes the team both productive and a fun place to work. Being excited to learn from others while bringing your own novel capabilities and perspectives.

On-Call Responsibility

This position involves on-call responsibilities, every builder on Lambda is also an owner. Nobody likes to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are well engineered, fault tolerant and meet a high quality bar before the go into production. Our customers expect nothing less. When we do get paged we work together as a team to resolve the root cause of the issue and nobody is left on their own to deal with an operational issue.

What you should expect?

If you’re excited by defining how modern and future software applications are built and want to help lead from the innovative edge, we guarantee that your work in our team will be ground-breaking and challenging. We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Together, we’ll deliver the next generation of industry-leading compute features and help every business from the smallest startups to the largest enterprises run their code in the cloud without the burden of infrastructure or scale (that’s our job). We’ll shape not just our own products, but contribute to the direction of AWS and the serverless industry.

Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.



Come help us change the world!

title: Senior HW Material Engineer, Nitro Team, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind the custom silicon and systems at the heart of AWS (Amazon Web Services) infrastructure — we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

The Nitro HW team at Annapurna Labs is looking for an experienced and technically deep Senior Material Engineer. In this role, you will be the primary technical owner for materials engineering across all Nitro card development — spanning PCB material selection and characterization, hybrid stackup design, and mechanical/thermal materials for the full Nitro portfolio. You will work cross-functionally with HW design, signal and power integrity, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to drive material decisions that balance performance, reliability, and long-term supply security.

As a senior engineer, this role goes beyond executing standard material engineering tasks. You are expected to challenge conventions, push the boundaries of what is achievable through rigorous experimentation, and introduce new materials and methodologies that enable next-generation Nitro cards hardware. You will lead complex material-related debug investigations during the cards development, define test and characterization methodologies, and represent Annapurna Labs with third-party vendors and suppliers as the technical authority for materials during card development and NPI.

Key job responsibilities
PCB Domain
- Own PCB material strategy for K2 cards: selection, qualification, and stackup design
- Challenge PCB construction defaults with full understanding of manufacturability risk
- Guide design teams on material selection for signal integrity and thermal requirements
- Lead material characterization experiments; own data analysis and decision outputs
- Introduce new PCB materials, balancing performance gains against qualification and supply chain risk

Mechanical & Thermal Domain
- Select and qualify TIMs, adhesives, encapsulants, and underfills for Nitro card assemblies
- Design vapor chamber and liquid cooling solutions for high-performance hardware
- Evaluate material performance under temperature cycling, vibration, and humidity conditions
- Define reliability test plans and own qualification data packages for NPI

Cross-Functional & Strategic
- Develop and socialize design rules, test methodologies, and manufacturing best practices
- Serve as materials engineering authority in design reviews, NPI gating, and supplier discussions
- Monitor EOL notifications, evaluate alternatives, and qualify drop-in replacements
- Mentor engineers, contribute to hiring, and raise the technical bar

About the team
Our Nitro Cards ("K2") are present in each and every server deployed at AWS, continuously innovating across new technologies, new server platforms, and new cloud services.
Nitro Cards serves critical roles in the server control plane and data path — delivering better performance, greater stability, and higher availability to customers at a global scale.
We work closely with the Nitro Silicon and Nitro Firmware and Software teams across definition, development, and mass production to optimize product value and accelerate time-to-market.
We learn from large-scale production health data and feed those insights back to continuously improve our products and processes.
Our success depends on world-class designs and the ability to deliver them on time, at scale, and with the best possible value for our customers — handling massive scale and the rapid integration of emerging technologies.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of direct experience in materials engineering for hardware products, encompassing PCB materials, laminate technologies, air and/or liquid cooling design aspects, and electronic assembly manufacturing processes
- B.Sc. or higher in Materials Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field
- Deep expertise in PCB laminate systems: familiarity with high-speed/low-loss dielectric materials, hybrid stackup design principles, and the trade-offs between material classes used in high-performance electronic assemblies
- Experience with high scale product manufacturing and working with remote vendors
- Strong analytical skills: ability to design experiments (DOE), analyze data rigorously, and draw actionable conclusions

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with high-speed PCB materials and hybrid stackup design in data center or server hardware
- Familiarity with IPC and JEDEC standards for PCB and assembly materials
- Background in cloud or hyperscale hardware, with understanding of reliability, thermal, and supply continuity demands
- Track record leading new material introduction (NMI) programs from selection through production release
- Experience managing supply chain risk: EOL components, second-source qualification, and procurement decisions
- Demonstrated organizational influence through technical standards, cross-team initiatives, or hiring contributions

title: Network Development Engineer, GCNA-D
descriptionHtml:
Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions? Would you like your work to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) Organization is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our EDGE team. Network Development Engineers partner with our broader Infrastructure organization on configurations standards and tools, and collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, and also deploy and sustain networking software tools.

AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) is the backbone that connects the global
AWS network. Focused on controlling the internet traffic that allows users to access their information
and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is responsible for building and
designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between data
centers and customers.


Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers will:
• Be responsible for deploying network infrastructure across all of our network fabrics that supports the Amazon Retail Service, Kindle, Payments and multiple AWS services.
• Deploy, scale and automate our network across multiple global datacenters. This includes existing footprints and greenfield locations.
• Drive scaling of current network designs to meet the demand of our customers.
• Create simple, repetitive deployment processes that increase both velocity and quality.
• Work closely with our internal customers on designs/solutions; bringing those designs/solutions from concept to production.
• Create and update our network standards and ensure that the network is deployed to these standards.
• Create and implement changes on the network.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allow us to scale at higher volume.


A day in the life
Engineers in the Internet Edge organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we evolve routing policy, implement traffic engineering solutions, grow our peering footprint, secure the “front door” from bad actors on the Internet, and architect the hardware platforms and network design to support any Amazon product that needs to reach end-users worldwide. Our infrastructure moves terabits of traffic to and from the Internet at any given moment, and represents one of the largest edge surface areas in the world, requiring complex solutions to ensure that capacity always stays ahead of demand. To accomplish that, our engineers develop automation, write software, and work with a wide range of partner teams to continually improve and automate our Internet connectivity in areas such as capacity delivery, configuration deployment, impairment detection, and traffic optimization. Internet Edge engineers make decisions on both a day-to-day and long-term strategic basis, which carry a large amount of responsibility and impact across all of Amazon’s products.
• Support an off-hours operations escalation pager rotation.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.


About the team
Internet Edge provides high-performing Internet connectivity for a wide range of use cases, such as retail (amazon.com), video streaming (Prime Video), content delivery (CloudFront), DNS (Route53), AWS services (such as EC2/S3), consumer devices (such as FireTV/Kindle/Echo), and more.

Within AWS Networking, the Internet Edge organization is responsible for connecting Amazon to the global Internet. With connections to thousands of unique external networks in hundreds of locations across the world, our mission is to deliver an Internet connectivity experience that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making Amazon the clear choice for our customers’ needs.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals and extensive experience in the application of IP protocols
- Knowledge of network analysis fundamentals and robust troubleshooting
- Experience in major internet routing protocols, specifically BGP and OSPF
- Experience with network operating systems such as Cisco IOS and Junos
- Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of IT best practice frameworks (ITIL, COBIT) and operational excellence concepts or methodologies
- Knowledge of network hardware and packet forwarding architectures
- Experience with Unix and scripting in Perl, shell, C or C++
- Experience working with customers to diagnose a problem and work towards resolution

title: Applied Scientist, Fulfilled-by-Amazon (FBA)
descriptionHtml:
FBA Science seeks an Applied Scientist to invent and build optimization models and algorithms that improve how Amazon plans and places seller inventory across its worldwide fulfillment network.

FBA moves the inventory of hundreds of thousands of sellers through a multi-echelon network of origin storage, national and regional distribution, and fulfillment centers — putting the right inventory in the right place, on time and at low cost. Operating this network is a constant stream of decisions: how much a seller should send, and where and when it should flow, all under scarce receiving and storage capacity. And these decisions are not ours to make alone — sellers choose what to send and how to respond to the options and incentives we offer, so we have to plan the network and shape seller behavior together. Solve it well and we drive out cost and speed up delivery, while making FBA the easiest way for a seller to grow their business. Our strategy is to make these decisions with science-driven technology, and because existing techniques rarely fit Amazon's scale and unique business needs, we invent new approaches and algorithms.

As an Applied Scientist, you'll develop optimization models and algorithms across FBA's inventory planning and placement systems. Your role will initially focus on joint replenishment and placement decisions. Your models will impact business decisions worth billions of dollars and improve the experience of every FBA seller.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the development of the replenishment, placement, and transportation-planning algorithms that decide how a seller's inventory flows across Amazon's fulfillment network.
- Design and implement large-scale optimization models and algorithms for complex inventory-planning problems, and the prediction and estimation layer they depend on.
- Partner closely with Product Managers and engineers to define high-impact problems, translate ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped science initiatives, and deliver actionable, science-driven solutions.
- Build and deploy science solutions into production pipelines, ensuring that models operate reliably at scale across a network serving hundreds of thousands of sellers.

A day in the life
You will own a science area with significant scope, impact, and high visibility, and your work will touch millions of products, hundreds of thousands of selling partners, and tens of millions of customers. You will be in the seller's critical path and you will be involved in every step, from idea generation and business analysis through research to the development and deployment of production-grade models. You will move between the optimization and the behavior. You are expected to make decisions about methodology, model architecture, and technology choices, and to strive for simplicity and demonstrate judgment backed by mathematical rigor. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and fellow scientists, and collaborate with the broader science community across Amazon to broaden the horizon of your work. You will be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a fast-paced, high-energy, highly collaborative environment where we value people who deliver results, know their subject deeply, and are eager to learn new areas.

About the team
Sellers play a vital role in Amazon’s ecosystem, integral to our mission of offering the Earth’s largest selection, lowest prices, and fastest delivery speed. FBA is an optional service that enables third-party sellers to outsource order fulfillment to Amazon, and leverage Amazon’s world-class facilities to provide customers fast delivery promise. With commitment to taking on even more of the supply chain and operational complexities on behalf of our selling partners, Amazon now provides an end-to-end suite of supply chain services. This comprehensive solution empowers sellers to reliably transport products from manufacturing sites to customers worldwide. The FBA team is the core group in charge of warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment and pricing, and a diverse range of recommendation services for sellers, as well as building the internal resource management systems. We work to learn seller behavior, understand seller experience, recommend right actions to sellers, design seller policies and incentives, and develop science products and services that empower sellers to grow their businesses. To do so, we build and innovate science solutions that leverage the right tools across different fields including operations research, economics, machine learning, statistics, and data analytics. Our culture is centered on rapid prototyping, rigorous experimentation, and data-driven decision-making.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Demonstrated ability to build complex optimization models from scratch and take them to production.
- PhD in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Preferred qualifications

- Track record of translating ambiguous business problems into well-defined science solutions with measurable impact.
- Proven ability to work effectively across product, engineering, and science teams.
- Experience with supply chain optimization, demand forecasting, inventory management, or transportation/logistics algorithms.
- Experience with reinforcement learning applied to sequential decision-making in operations or supply chain contexts.
- Experience with product selection or assortment optimization for capacity-constrained systems.
- Strength in mechanism design, auction theory, or game theory, particularly in settings involving strategic agents, capacity allocation, or market-based resource allocation.

Working closely with technical support teams and regional support managers, you will build a cohesive organization responsible for the safety, reliability, and performance of emerging robotics technology. This role requires independent judgment and comfort working with ambiguity in a complex, fast-paced, high-throughput environment where multi-tasking is essential.

- Partner with site-level reliability (RME) and controls teams to maximize advanced robotics system performance
- Identify, analyze, and resolve mechanical and system issues across the RTS product suite

Afternoons include designing tools, optimizing processes, and coordinating with regional managers on scaling strategies. Throughout, you're the critical link between field technicians and engineering teams.
