title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, OIS NANO
descriptionHtml:
Own the network and device technology infrastructure strategy for Amazon's fastest-growing Quick Commerce operation across an entire country. As the single-threaded infrastructure owner, you'll define the technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, and enable hundreds of sites to launch at unprecedented speed while maintaining enterprise-grade availability and cost optimization.

Key job responsibilities
As an TIPM with the Network and Assets for Nimble Operations (NANO) Team you will:
- Define country-level infrastructure strategy by establishing architecture standards and readiness criteria that guide all site launches, ensuring consistency and quality across the fleet
- Own end-to-end network infrastructure scope from vendor selection through service level agreement governance to financial outcome management, driving performance and cost efficiency
- Identify and recommend end-user equipment (associate-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers) that meet regional cost and performance targets, partnering with device technology teams for certification
- Establish playbooks, architecture standards, and deployment sequencing for the country, stepping in at escalation points where selections carry fleet-wide implications beyond execution-level authority
- Drive network availability outcomes, device fleet health, and financial performance across the country's fleet through structured vendor governance cadences and performance management

A day in the life
You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction compared to traditional models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor selections that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
We are the Network and Assets for Nimble Operations (NANO) team within Operations Infrastructure Services. We exist to solve a singular challenge: enabling Amazon Operations to launch and operate thousands of small-footprint sites at speed, at scale, and at a fraction of traditional infrastructure cost. We own the full infrastructure lifecycle — network strategy, vendor contracts, site launches, incident management, and financial governance — across India, United States, Middle East, United Kingdom, and Japan. Quick Commerce dark stores represent the overwhelming majority of our use cases today, scaling from approximately 500 sites to 3,000+ by 2028, with our enablement model extending to every emerging no-capex site type in Amazon's portfolio.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
- Experience in stakeholder and communication management
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 6+ years of program management experience in IT infrastructure delivery
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment while prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities
- Ability to successfully facilitate collaboration across multiple functions, departments, and levels
- Site launch experience of IT infrastructure (WLAN, LAN, end user equipment) in retail, distribution, logistics, or similar environments
- Complex program management capabilities
- Strategic technical decision-making
- Ability to establish processes and standards

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of data center, network engineering, and/or systems engineering experience
- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or experience in project management
- Experience in procurement, inventory and asset management of IT equipment as well as IT lifecycle
- Understanding of core IT infrastructure and service concepts
- Intermediate-level knowledge in one or more of: LAN, WAN, Wireless, Telecommunications, Systems Administration, Low voltage data cabling, or data facilities technologies

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site


Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Freight, a key pillar within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Account Management team. This is a customer facing relationship management role within our commercial organization. You will serve as the primary operational partner for Amazon Freight's largest enterprise shippers, owning the customer relationship, identifying systemic issues that impact their experience, and coordinating cross functional teams to drive resolution.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the enterprise customer operational relationship across all freight modes (TL, IMDL, LTL), serving as the single threaded point of contact for your accounts' operational points of contact
• Identify systemic operational defects impacting your accounts using performance dashboards and customer feedback. Quantify the problem in dollars, loads, and retention risk
• Coordinate cross functional teams to resolution: gather customer insights, understand requirements, bring the right internal teams together, align on the path forward, and ensure we deliver. You don't solve problems alone but you own making sure they get solved
• Own the customer facing performance narrative. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, produce recovery plans during performance degradation, and proactively communicate progress on open issues with timelines and measurable targets

Your day starts with account health dashboards, spotting a detention-charge trend at one customer's facilities and digging into its cause. The Enterprise Customer Success team is newly formed within Amazon Freight's commercial organization. title: Facility Operations Center Global Technical Specialist, ADC FOC
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 4, 2026

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. Amazon is a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers.

The Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Data Center Infrastructure Operations organization is looking for an individual with proven skills to join the ADC Facility Operations Center (FOC). The ADC FOC is responsible for 24/7 monitoring of data center physical infrastructure across air-gapped, isolated environments hosting classified workloads with no connection to the public internet.

The ADC FOC Technical Specialist is responsible for ensuring global continuity in training, qualifications, certifications, event management, and program delivery across multiple ADC FOC instances. The role combines technical subject matter expertise in data center infrastructure with the ability to develop and maintain programs that raise the technical bar, drive operational excellence, and deliver measurable improvements to the ADC FOC operation.

The Technical Specialist may own one or more of the following program areas: training development and qualification pathways, event management quality and optimization, or new site launch and colocation program delivery. All Technical Specialists operate as force multipliers for the ADC FOC, ensuring consistent standards, knowledge transfer, and program execution across all regions and partitions.

The ADC FOC Technical Specialist manages medium-to-high impact projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work and collaboration with internal and external support groups including engineering, controls, automation, DCEO, and data analytics teams. The role trains and supports ADC FOC engineers in their 24/7 monitoring and alarm notification responsibilities, including implementation of site, equipment, and design-specific training exercises covering EPMS, BMS, controls monitoring equipment, stand-by diesel generators, transformers, switchgear, breakers, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, and VFDs.

Operating within air-gapped environments presents unique challenges. The ADC FOC cannot leverage commercial FOC tooling directly, and extracting operational data requires additional controls, engineering systems, and customer approvals. The Technical Specialist will develop ADC-specific solutions, build and maintain programs that scale with the growth of the ADC business, and collaborate with commercial teams to share knowledge and adopt best practices where applicable.

The ideal candidate will act as a subject matter expert in data center infrastructure across various ADC data center designs. They will ensure overall availability and reliability meets or exceeds defined service levels. If you are passionate about the customer experience, think and act globally, and want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, this may be the role for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Operate independently with limited direct management across air-gapped ADC environments.
- Act as a technical escalation point for ADC FOC engineers and participate in an on-call rotation.
- Own and deliver one or more global ADC FOC programs, which may include but not limited to: training development and qualification pathways, event management quality and optimization or new site launch and colocation program delivery.
- Design, create, and launch learning content, practical assessments, workshops, web-based training, and instructor-led training programs. Measure and report on training health across all regions.
- Facilitate and deep dive customer-impacting events. Serve as the FOC point of contact in the Correction of Error (COE) process. Review After Action Reports (AARs) and drive global implementation of action items.
- Locate systemic infrastructure issues using data-driven analysis to drive solutions.
- Develop, update, and maintain ADC FOC runbooks to ensure consistent processes across all regions.
- Refine existing processes and create new standard processes for ADC FOC engineers and Team Leads. Create and maintain all ADC FOC technical documentation globally.
- Liaise with commercial FOC teams to share knowledge, adopt best practices, and align processes where applicable.
- Conduct drills that are region, building, or design-specific and identify team and individual growth opportunities. Establish performance benchmarks and conduct audits to drive effectiveness.
- Coordinate with partner teams during new site launches to ensure seamless implementation of FOC services and reduce burdens on existing operational workloads.
- Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience. Deliver global projects while influencing stakeholders through reports, process improvements, and narratives.
- Drive ownership of organizational and team-level goals.
- Mentor and guide the career growth of ADC FOC team members across regions.
- Work outside normal business hours to support the 24/7 operation of the ADC FOC.
- Travel is required.


A day in the life
The ADC FOC Technical Specialist operates across multiple ADC regions and clusters in air-gapped environments. Depending on the specialism, a typical day may involve reviewing event data and AARs to identify improvement opportunities, developing training content for upcoming qualification assessments, coordinating new site launch milestones with partner teams, progressing program deliverables, or collaborating with controls, DCEO, and commercial FOC teams. You will balance strategic program delivery with hands-on technical support, ensuring the ADC FOC maintains the highest operational standards across all regions.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- Experience with power management and power monitoring systems
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
- Knowledge of critical data center equipment

About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

This is a greenfield opportunity. Operate what you build—own monitoring, alarming, on-call, and incident response for your services. Drive high availability and low-latency targets.

Collaborate cross-functionally—work closely with product, finance, tax, risk, legal, and partner integration teams to translate requirements into working systems.

Work with a team of 7-8 SDEs, setting a high bar for engineering excellence, code quality, operational rigor, and customer obsession.
Be an engineering voice on the ground, driving local execution while staying tightly connected to the broader LATAM and global platform teams.
Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems for real-time underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Drive technical decisions on architecture, API design, data modeling, and system integration with internal services and external financial partners.
Navigate regulatory and compliance complexity—partner with legal, finance, tax, and risk teams to build technology that meets Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank, PIX, Open Finance).

title: Senior Customer Solutions Manager, Global Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join our Global Financial Services (GFS) team in London to work with a leading global Tier-1 bank. As a CSM, you will help customers realize sustained business value by accelerating their cloud transformation journey and driving innovation through advanced technologies including Generative AI, data analytics, and modern cloud-native architectures.

Are you passionate about shaping the future of the financial services industry by translating customer objectives into actions that realize long-term value through innovation? Do you have the business and technical savvy to earn trust with C-level executives and project team members alike? Have you delivered transformations for large enterprises with global operations, operating as multi-layered hierarchical organizations with complex stakeholder landscapes and decision-making processes?

At AWS we value critical thinking, self-motivation, and the ability to deal with ambiguity. You are detail oriented, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and are an exemplary communicator. Your technical expertise and operational excellence will influence your decisions and help drive robust customer solutions. We love people who innovate, use data to make decisions, and can express themselves thoughtfully. We want you to be passionate about delivering a great customer experience, and to love to reach and exceed goals.

As a trusted customer advocate, you will help a large global financial services organization understand best practices around adopting advanced cloud-based solutions, including Generative AI, modern data platforms, and cloud-native application development, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. Together with the customer, you will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS. We are also looking for individuals with a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and delivery challenges, with a particular interest in how AI/ML technologies can transform banking operations.

As an AWS Customer Solutions Manager (CSM), you will establish a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture and processes. You will lead the successful adoption of AWS, guiding customers through the people, process, and technology facets of their cloud transformation journey. You will serve as the customer's cloud journey coach and voice of customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. You leverage your communication, program management, technical, operations, and transformation acumen to understand your customer's strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and deliver successful, often industry-changing, customer outcomes on AWS.

Successful candidates are motivated by the customer's long-term success, have a mix of technical and business expertise, are data and detail driven, and have experience delivering large-scale programs. You are a proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and team levels. You collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, while navigating across geographical and organizational boundaries. You are a natural problem solver who steers through ambiguity and leads autonomously.

Key job responsibilities
- Cloud Adoption & Transformation: Work backwards from the customer's cloud business case to define the cloud migration / digital transformation strategy, guiding people, process, and operating model changes for customer success.
- AI/ML & GenAI Enablement: Help the customer identify and prioritize high-impact GenAI and AI/ML use cases. Guide exploration of Amazon Bedrock, large language models, RAG architectures, and modern data services to solve complex banking challenges. You will help drive transformation of customers' software development lifecycle (SDLC) with AI, and enable end-to-end workflows with Agentic AI and end-user AI productivity tools.
- People & Operating Model Change: Drive customers' people and operating model change for effective adoption of AWS. Establish education strategy to upskill technical and non-technical roles.
- Migration & Modernization: Accelerate migrations and broader adoption of AWS at scale. Partner with customers to install and mature Cloud Business Office capabilities.
- Governance & Executive Engagement: Work with customers to establish Cloud Leadership team and broader governance structures. Earn trust across all levels of the organization.
- Value Realization: Establish and manage an outcome-driven adoption plan. Report on customer maturity and adoption progress. Define success criteria and track measurable business outcomes.
- Thought Leadership: Knowledge share success mechanisms, mentor junior CSMs, and influence industry trends in cloud adoption for financial services.

A day in the life
You will be a cloud transformation advisor for a leading Tier-1 global bank, based in London. Your day involves engaging at all levels of the organization with key decision makers up to C-Suite and VP-level to align their cloud strategy with business outcomes, running executive steering committees, unblocking migration workstreams, and identifying high-impact GenAI use cases. You'll collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Account Managers, Professional Services, and AWS product teams to orchestrate the right resources at the right time. A key part of your role is organizing the extended account team to ensure we are bringing the best of AWS to the customer and driving rapid outcomes and value. No two days are the same: you might be presenting a cloud business case to a CTO in the morning, facilitating an AI workshop in the afternoon, and reviewing migration metrics with your delivery team by end of day.

About the team
The Global Financial Services (GFS) team at AWS works with the world's largest banks, insurers, capital markets firms, and payment providers to drive cloud adoption at scale. Our Customer Solutions Managers serve as trusted advisors to C-suite executives and technology leaders, helping them navigate complex regulatory environments while accelerating innovation. We operate across all major financial hubs globally and pride ourselves on deep domain expertise combined with technical excellence.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating. That’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
- Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams
- 7+ years of experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
- 3+ years of experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
- cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect - Associate

- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

descriptionHtml:

title: Principal Applied Scientist, Mission AI Lab, AWS Region Services
descriptionHtml:
Some of the hardest problems in security are waiting on models that do not exist yet. As a Principal Applied Scientist, you will create them. You start from the strongest models in the world and push them to excel at problems no off-the-shelf model has ever seen. This is one of the largest AI infrastructure programs AWS has ever taken on, and you will train on latest-generation GPU hardware, among the first anywhere to put it to work at this scale.

Much of this has no established playbook. There is no benchmark to tell you a model is ready, so you will invent both the method that gets it there and the measure that proves it. The lab is purpose-built for this work and you join at the start, helping shape its technical direction and building the methods and evaluations that carry forward into everything it does next.

This is a hands-on role. You will research the state of the art science, make the calls on how models are trained and evaluated, write code and work alongside the engineers who run the infrastructure, and partner directly with the analysts and operators who depend on the work. You will also explain what the models can and cannot yet do, in plain terms, to the people whose decisions rely on them.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end adaptation of frontier models for complex reasoning tasks, from supervised fine-tuning and post-training through reinforcement learning, delivered as production systems people can rely on in the field
• Define what "good" means for each task, building the evaluation sets, test harnesses, and metrics that measure model quality where no public benchmark exists
• Build and own the data pipelines that turn raw operational data into high-signal training and evaluation sets, including curation, quality scoring, provenance tracking, and strict leakage and contamination controls
• Judge when a problem needs a genuinely new method versus an extension of an existing one, and make the call with evidence
• Choose the training and adaptation methods, including parameter-efficient techniques, that turn serious dedicated compute into the largest gains in capability
• Extend adapted models into new priority domains, owning transferability, generalization, and calibration under real-world distribution shift
• Run data-preparation and human-in-the-loop feedback loops with the analysts who know the problems best, turning their expertise into better data and sharper evaluations
• Package methods and evaluations so they can be reused as the lab's work grows, and shared with Amazon's model teams
• Represent the lab's science in technical reviews and to program and technical leaders, surfacing what the models can do and where the risks are
• Help set the technical bar for the lab, and mentor scientists as the team grows

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing an overnight fine-tuning run against an evaluation suite you built, checking whether the adapted model beats the base on the metrics that matter most. Mid-morning, you work with the engineers who run the infrastructure to get a large training run moving and squeeze the most capability out of it. After lunch, you sit with domain analysts to turn their feedback into a cleaner, better-labeled evaluation set for a change-detection task, then decide whether the next gain calls for a new method or an extension of one you already have. You close the day documenting that method and evaluation so the rest of the lab can build on it, and writing a short, plain-language readout of what the model can and cannot yet do for the people who depend on it.

About the team
The Mission AI Model Lab is the science team behind AWS's Mission AI program. We take existing models and make them useful for problems that matter to national security, working on dedicated AI infrastructure built for exactly that. This lab is purpose-built and these are among its first scientists, so the people who join now help shape how it works and what it builds. We sit where frontier-model research meets national security delivery, and we value invention on genuinely new problems, evaluation we can defend, and plain talk with the people who rely on what we build.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on work in predictive modeling and analysis experience
- PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field
- Experience working in predictive modeling and analysis
- Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with leading experienced scientists as well as having a record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a career track in a business environment

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience
- Knowledge of problem solving, algorithm design and complexity analysis
- Experience creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art
- Current, active TS/SCI US Government Security Clearance
- Experience at a frontier AI lab, national lab, defense AI company, or government research program
- Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA-style methods) and efficient training within a fixed compute budget

title: Network Loss Program Manager, Amazon Transportation Brazil
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for the opportunity to create substantial impact on business profitability through the reduction of operational waste across one of Amazon's fastest-growing markets? The Network Losses Program Manager role in Brazil is that opportunity.

As a Network Loss Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end strategy and execution of network loss reduction across Brazil's Fulfillment Center (FC) and Transportation networks. You will be responsible for overseeing network loss metrics, driving operational improvements, and managing product implementations that eliminate shrinkage, damages, concessions, and undeliverable losses across the entire supply chain. The scope of impact spans Transportation Losses, FC Losses (Warehouse Lost, Warehouse Damage, FC Shrinkage, Item Missing), and seller reimbursement optimization — working in close collaboration with FC/Transportation Operations, ACES, SL&P, NCRC, Products, Finance, and RoW Network Losses teams.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Our team drives innovation while supporting continuous operational improvement. Brazil's network loss landscape presents a unique challenge: with several initiatives across three workstreams, a rapidly expanding warehouse footprint, and a complex reverse logistics network, this role requires someone who can connect the dots across multiple programs, drive accountability through mechanisms, and deliver measurable financial impact.

This opportunity requires excellent troubleshooting, problem solving, and the ability to succeed in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and technical environment. Ownership of work is extremely important, and candidates should have a proven record of driving operations, process fixes, and strategic initiatives to completion. The ideal candidate is motivated, data-driven, and agile — with strong cross-functional influencing skills and the ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels.

Key job responsibilities
1. Metrics Ownership: Own and manage Brazil's Network Loss metrics including Transportation Shrinkage, Warehouse Losses, Reimbursements and DPMO across In-Facility, In-Transit, and On-Road segments. Monitor success metrics on a daily/weekly basis through WBRs and MBRs. Deep dive operational data to identify root causes for losses across the network.

2. Product & Process Implementation: Drive product implementation in operations (e.g., URL compliance, TEP expansion, recovery mechanisms, repacking programs, reverse network design) and operational process solutions to eliminate losses. Partner with RoW Products to adapt global solutions to Brazil's context. Manage and expand loss recovery programs including 3P carrier. Track financial impact and drive accountability.

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with FC Operations, Transportation, Continuous Improvement, Quality, Loss Prevention, Finance to build visibility on loss themes, set up mitigation plans.

4. Reverse Logistics & ReLo Center: Support the design and operationalization of Brazil's Reverse Logistics (ReLo) Center, driving improvements in undeliverable grading, sellable yield, and recommerce recovery rates.

5. Standardization & Governance: Improve operational processes by standardizing metrics, SOPs, and governance mechanisms across Brazil's FC and transportation network.

6. Stakeholder Communication: Communicate results, risks, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership through structured mechanisms including WBRs, MBRs, and STL syncs.

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

title: Manager III, Software Development, Price Memory
descriptionHtml:
Every time a customer checks whether a deal is real or asks what a product cost last month, they rely on systems your team builds and operates. Amazon's Price Memory team owns the authoritative record of the prices customers saw and paid, and provides the historical price inputs that determine whether a deal is valid. This data feeds into customer-facing experiences and internal tools across Amazon. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead this team as it simplifies legacy validation systems, partners closely with customer experience teams, and moves toward a future where customers can independently verify savings claims.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a software development team responsible for Price Memory's pricing data systems, providing coaching, mentorship, and career development support while building an inclusive team culture.
- Own the technical vision and product roadmap for Price Memory's data platform and deal validation services, balancing near-term delivery with the longer-term goal of deprecating legacy systems and converging on a simpler architecture.
- Drive data quality and operational readiness across multiple deployment pipelines, establishing metrics and audit mechanisms that keep pricing data accurate and reliable for customers, Selling Partners, and internal consumers.
- Coordinate closely with experience teams and retail partners to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver high-quality software across the full lifecycle from design through deployment.
- Evaluate where generative artificial intelligence tools can augment team productivity and data quality workflows, applying responsible practices to ensure sound outcomes.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing data quality dashboards and operational metrics for your deployment pipelines, then sync with your engineers on sprint progress. Mid-morning, you join a design review where the team is working through how to retire a legacy validation path without disrupting downstream consumers. After lunch, you meet with customer experience and retail partner teams to align on cross-team dependencies and upcoming feature needs. Later, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report, discussing their growth goals and identifying stretch opportunities. You close the day connected to the details that keep pricing data trustworthy for millions of customers.

About the team
The Price Memory team answers a simple but important question for Amazon customers: "Is this deal actually a deal?" We own the record of prices customers saw and paid and supply the historical inputs that validate deals across Amazon. Our data powers customer-facing experiences and internal tools, and we coordinate closely with experience teams to ensure pricing information reaches customers accurately. Our work is high-visibility, directly shaping how shoppers evaluate savings. We are investing in simplifying our architecture and building toward a future where customers can confidently verify every savings claim. If you want to lead a team whose work is visible every time a customer checks a price, we would love to talk.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Software Development Manager, ICON
descriptionHtml:
The Intelligent Cloud Hosting (ICON) team is looking for a Software Development Manager who is passionate to work on the development of innovative software products which will help boost engineers productivity in Amazon, for improving services' posture towards security, availability, efficiency, compliance and maintainability. We aim to eliminate vast quantities of undifferentiated work for Amazon development teams - our opportunity for impact to tens of thousands of developers is enormous.

As the Software Development Manager for ICON's team in Dublin, you are a hands-on leader who guides engineers building the AI native factory that produces automation to operate on Amazon's production infrastructure. Your team owns the test pipeline that validates every workflow before it reaches production, builds workflows that run at Amazon scale, and contributes core capabilities to the factory. ICON operates critical services that power the Amazon shopping experience. Keeping those services healthy has required manual runbook authoring, interrupt-driven toil, and undocumented expertise held by individual engineers. The factory replaces that work with validated automation.

Engineers describe operational intent in natural language, and the factory produces a validated, production-ready workflow tailored to that service's unique context. An engineer describes a routine change, such as moving a service to a new instance type during the next maintenance window, and the factory generates, validates, and executes the workflow. Engineers state the outcome they need, and the factory supplies the operational knowledge, safety checks, and execution steps.

We are an AI-native team. We use AI across every aspect of our work, from workflow generation and validation to execution monitoring and continuous learning. The factory uses AI agents grounded in Amazon's operational history to generate, validate, and improve every workflow it delivers.

On this team, AI-native leadership is a daily practice. You use LLMs and agents in your own work, from drafting designs and analyzing operational data to reviewing code and preparing business reviews. You set the standard for how your team builds with AI, measure the productivity gains, and share what works across the organization. You understand how agentic systems behave in production: where they succeed, how they fail, and which guardrails keep them safe.

Key job responsibilities
– Own the technical vision, roadmap, and architecture for your team's scope, and deliver it end-to-end as the factory takes on new classes of operational work.
– Own the test pipeline that every generated workflow passes before production, and use automated evaluation and execution data to measure correctness and catch regressions before release.
– Partner with service teams to find high-toil operational tasks and turn them into validated, reusable workflows that run at Amazon scale.
– Contribute core capabilities to the factory, and align with partner teams on shared architecture and roadmap.
– Expand the share of operational work that agents own end-to-end, moving each workflow in stages from human-approved execution to supervised autonomy.
– Make the higher-stakes tradeoffs that come with AI in production: autonomy versus approval, speed versus safety, and model capability versus cost.
– Set a safety-first bar for production: separate fast experimentation from production-grade automation, establish operating best practices for traditional and AI-powered workloads, and own risk mitigation and escalations.
– Lead your team's adoption of AI development tools, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and share proven practices with partner teams.
– Hire, retain, and grow a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists who ship AI-native products at Amazon scale; set clear goals, give regular feedback, and manage performance.
– Earn adoption across service teams by making the factory effortless to use and trustworthy in production, and prove its value through measurable results in hours saved and execution success.

A day in the life
As the Dublin SDM, you balance engineering execution, technical judgment, and people leadership. A typical week might look like this:

• Reviewing a design for a new test pipeline stage that applies lessons from a recent operational event, so every generated workflow is checked against that failure mode.
• Meeting with a partner team about a repetitive operational task, and leaving with a plan to turn it into the next automated workflow.
• Aligning with partner teams on a shared platform capability your engineers are contributing.
• Pairing with a scientist on your team on how to score workflow quality automatically, so the platform improves with every run.
• Coaching an engineer through their first design review, helping them reason about blast radius and rollback for automation that runs in production.

Your team uses AI in its own engineering work, from design and prototyping to testing and deployment.

About the team
Our team builds and operates the AI-native factory that produces automation for Amazon's production infrastructure. The Dublin team owns the factory's test pipeline and workflow delivery, and contributes core factory capabilities. We are an AI-native team that uses AI across every aspect of our work, from workflow design and code generation to validation and operational monitoring. ICON hosts Amazon's customer-facing websites and backend services, centralizing management and automation so developers across Amazon can focus on customer innovation.

If you want to build at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and operational automation, and build the safeguards that let engineers rely on AI-generated automation in production, we would like to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience managing teams, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large-scale distributed systems or web services
- Track record of partnering with product, program, and technical leadership to define strategy and priorities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

title: Sr Business Analyst, Competitive Intelligence, Whole Foods Market
descriptionHtml:
Whole Foods Market is looking for a sharp, driven, and analytically minded Business Analyst II to join our Competitive Intelligence team. You will own end-to-end analyses that illuminate the competitive grocery landscape — translating retailer pricing, assortment, and performance data into strategic insights that directly shape our business. As the analytics go-to for competitive intelligence, you'll turn complex competitive data into clear, decision-ready guidance.

This is a high-visibility role with real impact. The right candidate brings a strong foundation in retail merchandising, dives deep into complex pricing and assortment performance metrics, understands the business context behind the data, and continuously strives for deeper insight. As AI accelerates the pace of our work, you'll help shape what's next for competitive analytics — building scalable, self-serve reporting and leveraging emerging AI capabilities to accelerate time-to-insight.

This role goes beyond reporting: you'll conduct deep-dive analyses on pricing, assortment, and competitive positioning, surfacing the "so what" behind the data. Partnering closely with Pricing & Merchandising leaders, you'll develop strategy, launch case studies, and deliver clear, actionable findings — building repeatable analytical frameworks that improve the team's speed and depth over time. We're looking for someone who combines analytical depth with the ability to communicate clearly to senior stakeholders and who thrives on ownership and continuous improvement.

Competitive intelligence is a strategic priority at Whole Foods Market. You'll have the opportunity to shape how we understand and respond to the competitive landscape, with the data, resources, and leadership support to make a real difference.

Skills
Strong ownership mindset — you dive deep, take accountability for your work, and earn trust through consistent delivery
Expert-level SQL (Redshift preferred) and BI tools (QuickSight, Tableau); R or Python a plus
Experience building scalable dashboards and self-serve reporting that drive adoption
Strong quantitative reasoning — comfortable with large, complex datasets and ambiguous questions
Excellent communication — able to distill complex analyses into crisp narratives for senior stakeholders
Proactive and curious — you track food, retail, market news, and natural-products trends, read popular and trade press widely, and experiment with new tools (including AI/ML)
A strong foundation in retail merchandising that lets you contextualize pricing and assortment data within broader market dynamics, operating at both the detail and strategic levels

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end competitive analyses — scope, design, execute, and communicate deep-dives on pricing, assortment, and competitive positioning that surface the "so what" behind the data
Gather retail pricing, assortment, promotion, and location data on competitors, leveraging third-party sources and primary research
Build scalable, self-serve reporting in QuickSight and Redshift SQL that lets stakeholders access competitive insights without analyst dependency
Serve as the analytics subject-matter expert and go-to resource for Global and Regional Merchandising teams in competitive situations
Analyze competitive data to inform strategy, highlight opportunities, and drive recommendations for pricing and assortment adjustments
Partner closely with Pricing & Merchandising leaders to develop strategy, launch case studies, and deliver actionable findings
Build repeatable, scalable analytical frameworks that improve the team's speed and depth
Communicate results clearly to senior business leaders, translating complex data into concise narratives
Accelerate time-to-insight by leveraging emerging AI capabilities and automation
Contribute as a key analytical voice on the Competitive Intelligence team, sharing best practices with fellow analysts

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing a competitor's latest price moves, spotting a gap and opportunity. You inspect a dashboard you built for Merchandising that lets them slice competitive results without filing a request. Mid-morning, you dig into a vendor data feed to validate pricing coverage, then meet with a Merchandising leader to discuss their category's competitive positioning. After lunch, you present findings to a Director-level audience, turning the "so what" into clear action items. You close the day exploring an AI-powered workflow that could halve your analysis time and refining a reusable framework for competitive deep-dives.

- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS Tools and Technologies (Redshift, S3, EC2)
- Experience utilizing R or Python
- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Grocery, retail, or CPG industry experience
- Familiarity with competitive price measurement, assortment analytics, pricing analytics, or merchandising analytics

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Cloudscape
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
AWS ships over 280 services and more than 50 off-console applications. Every one carries a full surface area — APIs, SDK, CLI, console, documentation, infrastructure-as-code support, identity integration, logging, monitoring, pricing, and regional availability. Producing and maintaining these interfaces consumes enormous engineering capacity, and the quality customers experience is uneven.

Managed Interfaces changes the model: when customer needs change, AWS responds in weeks, not months. Every interface a customer touches is generated from one source of truth — the service's API model — and stays consistent as the service evolves. Builders launch new services with near-zero effort on undifferentiated engineering, and user testing starts at the beginning of a project, when changes are cheap.

You will own the program management for this effort, coordinating three workstreams: agentic capabilities for builders, the managed console experience, and the agents that keep documentation and downstream channels current. This is a cross-organizational role that turns a multi-year north star into shippable, measurable proof points.

Key job responsibilities
Drive the program end-to-end. Own the roadmap, milestones, and dependencies across all three workstreams, translating the 2027 north star into quarterly deliverables and committed proof points.

Coordinate across teams. Align the UX platform, launch orchestration, console generation, the context layer, and 200+ service teams whose consoles move to the managed path. Resolve cross-team dependencies and sequencing conflicts before they become blockers.

Manage the proof-point scoreboard. Define, track, and report the metrics that demonstrate progress: services registered to the context layer, consoles converted to managed, undifferentiated effort reduced per feature, automated quality improvements shipped per month, task-completion times, and accessibility violations trending to zero.

Communicate up and across. Produce clear status, risk, and decision documents for senior leadership; run operational reviews; and keep stakeholders aligned on scope, trade-offs, and timelines.



Manage risk. Surface technical and organizational risks early — adoption friction, capability gaps for off-console applications, source-of-truth consistency — and drive mitigation.

A day in the life
A single integrated roadmap across the three workstreams with clear ownership and dependencies.

A live scoreboard tracking the committed proof points, reviewed on a regular operating cadence.

The first managed-console conversions in production, moving from one prototype toward a repeatable path.

An adoption plan for moving the standard console path to managed by default, with onboarding support for service teams.

About the team
The Cloudscape team builds the design system that powers the AWS Management Console - one of the most-used enterprise interfaces in the world. We're a multidisciplinary team of 35+ spanning UX design, front-end engineering, research, and program management. We ship 114+ components, maintain comprehensive design guidance, and build AI-powered tools that help teams build faster. Our work directly impacts millions of AWS customers and hundreds of service teams.

title: Senior Tax Analyst, Global WHT

descriptionHtml:
アマゾンでは、"地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること”というミッションの元に日々改善と改革が行われています。
本ポジションは、アマゾンの物流プロセスにおいて重要な役割を担う外部業務委託配送拠点 External Fulfillment Center（以下EF）及び拠点間の路上輸送において、もっとも重要な「安全」をLeadし、お客様一人一人に確実に商品をお届けすることに貢献していただきます。

Central Safetyは、アマゾンの物流を担う各拠点と拠点間輸送で働くあらゆる立場の方が、安全且つ安心して業務が行える環境を提供します。本ポジションは、担当するEFと路上の自然災害・火災・オペレーションに関わるリスク検出、それらの予防措置と是正措置導入、事故防止と削減計画、について関連部署と実行します。また、標準化を進めることで、より効果的且つ効率的な方法を国内外のNetworkへ展開していきます。

title: Sr. Mgr - EF, AB, Analytics, IN External Fulfilment, Amazon Business, 3P Carriers and NOW Procurement
descriptionHtml:
External Fulfilment runs the third-party fulfilment channels that let sellers and vendors ship directly from their own warehouses while giving customers an FBA-grade experience. The channel portfolio spans Seller Flex (SF), Vendor Flex (VF), Direct Fulfilment (DF), Warehouse Integration (WI), Stores Integration (SI) and Easy Ship. These channels carry a large share of unique selection, free up FC capacity for fast-moving selection, and operate at a lower cost to serve than in-FC fulfilment.

We are looking for a senior leader to own the fulfilment channel programs for SF, DF and WI, run flow control for the entire EF network, lead fulfilment operations for Amazon Business, and build the analytical backbone that supports all of the above. This is a broad, ambiguous, network-level mandate that sits at the intersection of operations, program management, product and finance. The role requires an owner who can set strategy, drive execution across cross-functional partners, and hold the bar on performance.

Key job responsibilities
1. Fulfilment channel programs: Own the end-to-end program charter for the Seller Flex, Direct Fulfilment and Warehouse Integration channels. This covers channel program and product strategy, network configuration and policy management. You will drive seller-experience initiatives across these channels and partner with 3P Business, product and tech teams on roadmap and launches.

2. Flow control for EF network: Own flow control across the entire EF network - managing the flow of packages through the transportation network, deploying seller caps and TCAP management to safeguard transportation capacity against surges and over-attainment, and collaborating with supply chain to minimise speed losses.

3. Amazon Business (B2B) fulfilment operations: Own the operations program for Amazon Business in India - the B2B delivery experience, cost, over-all DEX metrics and related programs. This workstream requires cross-org dependencies and leadership visibility involved, and partnership with the category and WW AB teams.

4. GenAI, Analytics and reporting: Build and own the GenAI charter for the entire team, analytical foundation for the above - WBR/MBR dashboards, P0 metric tracking, carrier-level breakdowns and program trackers. You will raise the robustness of analysis and move it beyond daily ops and coordination into decision-grade insight.

About the team
Your day starts with the health of the network - reading overnight P0 metrics and deciding where to act. Then you would prioritise SF, DF and WI program and product with 3P Business, product and tech partners. Then Amazon Business - DEX metrics, the AWIPL network and its escalations. Analytics runs through all of it: you build the data and bring decision-grade insight to weekly and monthly reviews. You partner across 3P Business, Finance, Tech/Product and the last-mile, middle-mile and sort-centre teams, serving customers, sellers and enterprise buyers alike.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of team management experience
- 7+ years of program or project management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- MBA
- 8+ years of team management experience
- Experience in logistics, or experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising
- Experience in transportation or supply chain within a high-volume logistics, manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization
- Exposure to B2B / enterprise fulfilment and delivery-experience metrics.

title: Robotics Systems Eng II , Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy innovative industrial robotics across North America's fulfillment network. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.



Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.

- You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.

- You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.

- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)

- You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization

- You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

- You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.

- You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.

- You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains

- You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment

- You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results





A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply cutting edge advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
- 5+ years experience in troubleshooting robotics systems or other complex mechanical-electrical or networked systems to resolve escalations including quality hand-off, live order testing, site acceptance testing, operational readiness testing, and monitoring system performance
- 5+ years experience in project management related to the deployment, retrofits or technical maintenance of large-scale industrial robotics
- 5+ years experience using project management and supply management tools/software including managing Bills of Material, deployment work instructions, and project task management.
- 3+ years experience working in or around a construction, manufacturing, warehouse, or similar environment
- Demonstrated ability to work with PLCs, SCADA systems, and network infrastructure.
- Ability to travel domestically 75% or more of the year

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, management, or technology, or Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
