title: Data Center Engineering Operations Trainee
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS Data Centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Trainee will be responsible for Data Center Engineering Operations within an Amazon Data Center including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

We are looking for an individual with little to no experience, a result-driven individual with technical (electrical/ mechanical) understanding and the drive and passion to learn data center engineering operations. The role will report to the DCEO Manager and be responsible for sustaining availability, cost management, risk assessment and mitigation, review corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure and metric reporting.

You’ll interface with a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

This position is for a 6 month fixed term hire with a possibility to convert to a full time role.

Key job responsibilities
- Learning the Data Center industry through in-classroom and on-site experience.
- Assist the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed, is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
- Maintaining performance benchmarks, conduct analyses & prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility infrastructure operations & maintenance.
- Generate Change Management requests & Incident Management tickets for DCEO as directed.
- Learn and contribute to documentation relevant to business & facility operations.
- Assist with the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling within its constraints.
- Be involved with the routine maintenance and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
- Assist and learn about the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities.
- Assist with the management of the Facility assets and the provision of infrastructure & inventory asset management as directed.
- May participate in Construction & Operational Meetings as required.
- Assist with Work Order compliance and review of contractual SLAs.
- Interface with Infra Ops teams for day to day operational requirements.
- Assist in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering or services issue.
- Delivery of exceptional customer service and satisfaction.
- Meet daily hours of operations, shift and on-call requirements for response during shift rotations.

This role may involve bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching, ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely.

Due to the location of our sites, candidates should possess a valid driver's license and their own vehicle.

A day in the life
At today’s large-scale data centers, you will be involved in:
- Provide support and assistance to the onsite operations team, in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service-Level Agreements (SLA).
- Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
- Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained.
- On-site management of contractors, subcontractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
- Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications
- Interest in maintenance of a Data Center or Critical space facility.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong attention to detail.
- Strong leadership and organizational skills.
- Facilities Management mindset.
- Ability to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment.
- Physical Security protocol awareness .
- Computer literate, confident with Office Suite
- This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift rack equipment; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines.

Preferred Qualifications
- Degree or Technical (Military/ Trade School)
- Degree / Cert IV and relevant experience
- Data Center Engineering/Operations Experience
- Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or relevant discipline.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of data center engineering experience

title: Sr. Simulation Scientist, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Are you inspired by invention? Do you want to see how your work impacts the bigger picture? If yes, you'll fit right in at Amazon's Last Mile Simulations and Analytics Engineering team.

The WW AMZL Simulations and Analytics Engineering team drives innovation across our Last Mile network delivery stations through digital twin technology and the seamless integration of process engineering, physics, design, technology, and robotics. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do. If you're interested in joining a rapidly growing team building a unique, solutions-advisory group with a relentless focus on the customer, you've come to the right place.

This is a blue-sky role where you'll roll up your sleeves and dive into big data sets to build digital twins—discrete event simulations, robotics models, and physics-based 3D simulations using tools like Flexsim, AnyLogic, and Emulate 3D. You'll develop experimentation systems at scale, integrating process workflows, physical dynamics, facility design, emerging technologies, and robotic automation to create comprehensive virtual replicas of our operations. Build optimization algorithms and leverage advanced technologies across Amazon. This is an opportunity to think big about solving challenging problems for our customers.

As a Senior Simulation Scientist, you'll deep dive into complex problems and drive relentlessly towards innovative solutions with cross-functional teams. You'll interface and influence various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. Lead strategic digital twin and simulation projects that integrate process design, physics modeling, technology innovation, and robotics to drive operational decisions. Your expertise in synthesizing and communicating insights to audiences of varying technical sophistication will enable you to answer specific business questions and innovate for the future. You'll apply advanced multi-disciplinary methodologies—combining process optimization, physics simulation, design thinking, and robotic systems—to complex use cases across the Last Mile network. You'll also contribute to the end-state vision for digital twin simulation and experimentation of future delivery stations at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of the simulation data science solutions to perform system of systems discrete event simulations for significantly complex operational processes that have a long-term impact on a product, business, or function using FlexSim, Demo 3D, AnyLogic or any other Discrete Event Simulation (DES) software packages
• Lead strategic modeling and simulation research projects to drive process design decisions
• Be an exemplary practitioner in simulation science discipline to establish best practices and simplify problems to develop discrete event simulations faster with higher standards
• Identify and tackle intrinsically hard process flow simulation problems (e.g., highly complex, ambiguous, undefined, with less existing structure, or having significant business risk or potential for significant impact
• Deliver artifacts that set the standard in the organization for excellence, from process flow control algorithm design to validation to implementations to technical documents using simulations
• Be a pragmatic problem solver by applying judgment and simulation experience to balance cross-organization trade-offs between competing interests and effectively influence, negotiate, and communicate with internal and external business partners, contractors and vendors for multiple simulation projects
• Provide simulation data and measurements that influence the business strategy of an organization. Write effective white papers and artifacts while documenting your approach, simulation outcomes, recommendations, and arguments
• Lead and actively participate in reviews of simulation research science solutions. You bring clarity to complexity, probe assumptions, illuminate pitfalls, and foster shared understanding within simulation data science discipline
• Pay a significant role in the career development of others, actively mentoring and educating the larger simulation data science community on trends, technologies, and best practices
• Use advanced statistical /simulation tools and develop codes (python or another object oriented language) for data analysis , simulation, and developing modeling algorithms
• Lead and coordinate simulation efforts between internal teams and outside vendors to develop optimal solutions for the network, including equipment specification, material flow control logic, process design, and site layout
• Deliver results according to project schedules and quality


A day in the life
If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

Basic qualifications

-3+ years of investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products experience
-PhD, or Master's degree and 5+ years of quantitative field research experience
-Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive etc.
-Experience communicating qualitative research methods and findings to non-qualitative researchers

Preferred qualifications

-Experience converting research studies into tangible real-world changes
-Experience with discrete and continuous optimization methodologies and algorithms

title: Senior BMS Specialist, Global BMS Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.

OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.

Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.

GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.

We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.

Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.

Key job responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, HVAC controls, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.

1. Support the development and execution of a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services
2. Collaborate closely with GRBD&E, D&C, Sustainability, RME, and other stakeholders to understand customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs
3. Design, implement, and manage BMS standard operating procedures, policies, and processes that are scalable across the globe
4. Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics tools
5. Monitor and maintain ticket and work order queues, ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar
6. Ensure compliance with change management processes
7. Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings
8. Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach
9. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies
10. Take ownership of BMS initiatives, develop technical documentation, manage timelines, and coordinate with stakeholders
11. Lead training sessions and development programs to continuously enhance the capabilities and technical skills of field RME teams and BMS Specialists
12. Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team
13. Willingness to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support across global time zones

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent
- Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, and SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization.
- Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP).
- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
- Deep understanding of HVAC, lighting, Utilities, field devices, and other building systems, as well as energy management principles.
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize initiatives in a dynamic environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a strategic and innovative mindset.
- Organized and self-motivated to take ownership of complex tasks.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software
- Experience working in cross-regional BMS projects with multicultural teams
- Proficiency in cloud-based IoT platforms, data analytics, and visualization tools
- Certification in relevant programming languages or BMS systems
- Certification with Tridium Niagara
- Certification with Distech Controls
- Strong customer relationship management skills
- Experience and understanding of facility management and relevant electrical and mechanical aspects of BMS equipment
- Proficiency in additional spoken languages

title: Sr. Engineer, JP Robotics
descriptionHtml:
アマゾン社は、何百万の商品をお客様へ提供し続けることによって、世界的に認知度が高く、グローバルリーディングカンパニ—としての地位を確立しています。また、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業”であり続けるため、日々改善と改革を行っており、それらの業務へ貢献できる経験豊富な人材を求めています。

JCFS（Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions／オペレーション技術統括本部）は、アマゾンジャパンのオペレーション業務の中核部門として各部門を効率的に連携し、継続的なプロセス改善とイノベーションを通じて次世代のフルフィルメント能力を創造することをミッションとしています。

本ポジションでは、フルフィルメントセンター（FC）における商品の入出荷設備の自動化計画・導入を担うエンジニアを募集します。迅速な配送スピードと低コストを実現するマテリアルハンドリング・在庫システム等の技術開発エンジニアとして、既存FCに加え新規FCの自動化設備の計画・導入に携わっていただきます。

・グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと連携し、最先端の自動化技術を日本のFCへ導入
・安全性・品質の向上、フルフィルメントコストの削減、入出荷能力の最大化を推進

Key job responsibilities
・グローバルエンジニアリングチームと連携し、最新技術を継続的に把握して日本へ導入。将来日本に必要な技術要件を整理し、新規技術開発を通じて日本のフルフィルメント能力を継続的に向上させる
・複雑な物と情報の流れを理解し、人と機械を組み合わせ、在庫保管設備に合わせた入出荷設備の創案・設計・開発・導入を行う
・大規模なエンジニアリングプロジェクトにおいて技術的なリーダーシップを発揮する
・設備スペック、モノの流れ、プロセス設計、サイトレイアウト、知的財産を考慮し、最適なフルフィルメントソリューションの設計とイノベーション創出をリードする
・社内チームおよび外部ベンダーとコミュニケーション・ネゴシエーションを行い、短期間で高品質かつ低コストの入出荷方法を実現する

A day in the life
朝はグローバルエンジニアリングチームとのMTGで最新の自動化技術をキャッチアップ。日中は担当する入出荷設備の設計レビュー、マテハン・保管設備のスペック検討、プロセス設計やレイアウト最適化を進めます。社内オペレーション部門や外部ベンダーとの打ち合わせで仕様・コスト・納期を調整。週の中では各FCへ出張（約30%）し、現地の設備立ち上げや課題解決を実施。複数部署が関わる大規模プロジェクトで技術的リーダーシップを発揮し、日本のフルフィルメント能力向上を推進します。

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing

title: オペレーションマネージャー/Operations Manager, On The Road
descriptionHtml:
※本ポジションの勤務地は兵庫県尼崎市に位置する物流拠点です。

Amazonでは日本のAmazon Logistics （AMZL）チームの新しいビジネスモデルの革新を担うオペレーションマネージャーを募集しています。AMZLのゴールはお客様に荷物をお届けする物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルにおいて、世界水準のオペレーションを構築することです。Amazonではお客様により速く、正確に、そして効果的な方法でお届けすることで、お客様の期待を上回るサービスを提供することに重点的に取り組んでおり、日本でもAMZLが急速に拡大しています。

Operations Manager, OTRは、担当地域体での新しい配送モデルを開発、管理することが求められます。また、ラストマイル（最終拠点からエンドユーザーへの物流サービス）のオペレーション・チームの一員として、お客様へのラストマイル配送に関する様々な手法を開発し、長期的な配送能力を構築していきます。

===================================
*Working location for this position is a Delivery Station base in Hyogo, Amagasaki.

Amazon is looking for an operation manager to be responsible for innovating a new business model for the Amazon Logistics (AMZL) team in Japan. AMZL's goal is to build world-class operations in the last mile, the last leg of logistics to deliver packages to customers. Amazon is focusing on providing services that exceed customer expectations by delivering to customers in a faster, more accurate, and more effective manner, and AMZL is rapidly expanding in Japan as well.

Operations Manager, OTR is required to develop and manage new delivery models in responsible regions. Furthermore, as a member of the Last Mile (logistics service from final location to end user) operation team, we will develop various methods related to last mile delivery to customers and build long-term delivery capabilities.

Key job responsibilities
- 業務提携先の配送パートナーと信頼関係を構築し、チャネルや配送拠点毎の担当エリアの配送コスト、配送キャパシティ、配送品質が、ピーク期間を含め、計画通り推移するよう、管理し、顧客体験の向上、ビジネスの拡大に貢献する。
- 担当地域での新サービス、ビジネスを実現し、新しい配送チャネルの開発、拡大に貢献する。
- チームマネジメント（人材育成・パフォーマンス管理）

===================================

- Build relationships of trust with delivery partners of business partners, manage delivery costs, delivery capacity, and delivery quality in the responsible area for each channel and delivery base so that they change as planned, including peak periods, contributing to improved customer experience and business expansion.
- Realize new services and businesses in responsible regions and contribute to the development and expansion of new delivery channels.
- Team management (human resource development and performance management)

A day in the life
・休日：土日祝
・勤務時間：フレックスタイム制（基本は9:00～18:00ですが業務状況などによってフレキシブルな勤務時間になる場合があります）
・宿泊を伴う国内出張が発生する場合有
・将来的に転勤が発生する可能性がございます

===================================

・Holidays: Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays
・Working hours: Flextime system (Basically, it is 9:00 to 18:00, but there are cases where working hours are flexible depending on work conditions, etc.)
・Domestic business trips involving lodging may occur
・There is a possibility of relocation in the future.

Basic qualifications

- 人・物・金の流れを数値や指標にて管理・向上させる経験3年以上
- 管理職経験（評価、人材育成の経験等）
- プロジェクトマネジメント経験（プロジェクト規模は問わない・多部門横断型プロジェクト等）
- ビジネスレベル（読み書き会話）の日本語力

Preferred qualifications

- 製造・物流・小売において人・物・金の流れを数値や指標にて管理・向上させる経験5年以上
- 間接マネジメント（管理職やチームリーダーを通じたマネジメント）経験、マネージャー/リーダーの育成経験
- 繁忙期に複数名のパート、アルバイトと働いた経験
- 工学、経営、または関連分野の学位やMBA
- 変化する優先順位に対処し、的確な判断を行う能力

title: Senior Sourcing Manager (12-months fixed-term contract), Fleet sourcing
descriptionHtml:
Delivering on Amazon's customer promise depends on having the right vehicles, in the right place, at the right cost. The fleet business powering last mile operations across EU and MENA (Middle East and North Africa) is scaling rapidly into new vehicle types and new geographies, and the Sourcing team needs a Senior Sourcing Manager to help keep pace. In this 12-month fixed-term role, you will own sourcing for assigned fleet categories across both branded (OEM) and variable (rental) last mile fleet — identifying supply options, negotiating terms, and securing committed capacity. On the branded side, you will lead OEM engagement for the MENA region, building the commercial case to secure vehicle capacity. On the rental side, you will grow the supplier portfolio through the Fleet Exchange Marketplace, onboarding new suppliers across EU with a particular focus on southern European markets. If you are a self-starter who enjoys supplier negotiations, data-backed analysis, and working in a business that moves fast, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end sourcing for assigned EU/MENA fleet categories, from identifying supply options to negotiating terms and securing committed capacity across both branded and variable (rental) last mile fleet.
- Lead OEM engagement for the MENA region, preparing commercial cases and running supplier discussions to secure vehicle capacity for Amazon last mile operations.
- Grow the rental supplier portfolio through the Fleet Exchange Marketplace by sourcing new leads and onboarding suppliers onto the platform across EU, with a focus on Italy, Spain, and France.
- Build data-backed sourcing models and analysis to support recommendations to senior leaders, and influence internal stakeholders to secure alignment on sourcing decisions.
- Develop and improve sourcing processes and standards that can scale across markets, mentoring team members and sharing best practices as the programme expands.

A day in the life
You begin by reviewing supplier pipeline data and checking progress on open negotiations. Mid-morning, you join a call with an OEM partner in the MENA region to walk through your commercial proposal and address their questions. After lunch, you shift focus to the Fleet Exchange Marketplace, following up with a prospective rental supplier in Italy to move them through onboarding. Later, you pull together a sourcing recommendation for leadership, pressure-testing your assumptions with a colleague from the capacity planning team before finalizing.

About the team
The Sourcing team sits within the Fleet Strategy and Supply Chain organization, part of Global Fleet and Products at Amazon. We own supplier engagement for the fleet that powers last mile operations across EU and MENA, spanning branded fleet sourced through OEM relationships and variable fleet sourced through a growing ecosystem of rental suppliers. Our closest partners include capacity and fleet planning, supply chain, vehicle engineering, and electrification. We are preparing the fleet model for the next generation of transportation — new vehicle form factors, micromobility, and expansion into new markets — and we are looking for people who want to help build that future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
- Experience handling multiple competing priorities and complex projects with multiple stakeholders (e.g. definition of accurate network expansion plans, vendor development, quality assurance, design and cost improvement, team and stakeholder engagement)
- Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction
- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- Experience performing ad hoc analysis using advanced Excel, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- AI fluency — comfortable using AI tools to accelerate analysis, research, and day-to-day workflows, with the judgment to apply them effectively to sourcing problems.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in French
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Italian
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish
- Experience working in an operations, supply chain, transportation, project management or management consulting role
- Experience in logistics

title: Creative Executive , Amazon MGM Studios
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MGM Studios is the home for talent, creating and producing Original films and television series for a global audience. Original series premiere exclusively on Prime Video, which is available in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Amazon MGM Studios also produces and acquires Original movies for theatrical release and exclusively for Prime Video.

Our Japan Local Originals team is now seeking an exceptional Creative Executive to focus on Scripted Series and Local Original Movies. This pivotal role involves managing the entire lifecycle of original scripted local productions, from sourcing and development to execution, reporting directly to the Head of JP Local Originals.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in content development, either as a producer or commissioner, with a comprehensive understanding of the domestic scripted TV and film landscape. We're looking for someone with proven creative instincts in selecting, developing, producing, and greenlighting projects, coupled with strong interpersonal skills and established industry relationships. This Tokyo-based position requires a dynamic, outgoing, and self-motivated individual capable of juggling multiple high-priority tasks in a fast-paced environment.

The successful applicant will oversee numerous projects in various stages of development and production, manage a high volume of submissions, and attend frequent meetings with industry professionals. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of Japanese content on a global streaming platform.


Amazon MGM Studios は世界中の視聴者向けにオリジナル映画やテレビシリーズを制作、制作しています。オリジナルシリーズは、世界240以上の国と地域で視聴できるプライム・ビデオでのみプレミア上映されます。Amazon MGM Studiosは、劇場公開用のオリジナル映画やプライムビデオ専用のオリジナル映画も制作および購入しています。

現在、日本ローカルオリジナルチームでは、脚本ありのシリーズと国内オリジナル映画を担当する優秀なクリエイティブエグゼクティブを募集しています。この重要な役割は、オリジナルの脚本ありローカル制作の全過程（企画、開発から実行まで）を管理し、日本ローカルオリジナル部門長に直接報告することを含みます。

理想的な候補者は、プロデューサーまたはコミッショナーとしてのコンテンツ開発経験と、国内の脚本ありテレビ・映画業界に関する包括的な理解を持っていることが求められます。プロジェクトの選定、開発、制作、グリーンライトの付与において実証済みの創造的直感を持ち、優れた対人スキルと確立された業界関係を併せ持つ方を探しています。東京を拠点とするこのポジションは、迅速な環境で複数の優先度の高いタスクをこなせる、活動的で外向的、自主性のある個人を必要とします。

採用された方は、様々な段階にある多数のプロジェクトを監督し、大量の企画提案を管理し、業界のプロフェッショナルとの頻繁な会議に出席することになります。このポジションは、グローバルなストリーミングプラットフォームにおける日本のコンテンツの未来を形作る興味深い機会を提供します。

title: 2027 Applied Scientist Internship – Masters, Amazon University Talent Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
We're building systems that turn research into real-world impact — powering sports experiences for millions of Prime Video customers, pioneering multimodal document intelligence, building autonomous AI agents that reason, plan, and act, and transforming how customers discover products they love. If this sounds interesting to you then we have a range of opportunities for you to explore.

We're looking for Masters students across multiple research domains to invent, design, and implement state-of-the-art solutions for never-before-solved problems. Your work here won't just stay in a notebook — it ships to production and reaches customers worldwide.

Check out the details below including the job responsibilities, team details, and basic qualifications before submitting your application.

You can find more information about the Amazon Science community as well as interview preparation tips via the links below;

- https://www.amazon.science/
- https://amazon.jobs/content/en/career-programs/university/science
- https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/university-roles/applied-science

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Science Intern, you will own the design and development of end-to-end systems. You'll have the opportunity to write technical white papers, create roadmaps and drive production level projects that will support Amazon Science.

You will work closely with Amazon scientists and other science interns to develop solutions and deploy them into production. You will have the opportunity to design new algorithms, models, or other technical solutions whilst experiencing Amazon's customer focused culture.

The ideal intern should have the ability to work with diverse groups of people and cross-functional teams to solve complex business problems.


A day in the life
You'll spend your first weeks scoping your project with your mentor, then own the research and implementation end-to-end.

Your work could involve building computer vision models that power live sports experiences for Prime Video, developing multimodal GenAI solutions for AWS document intelligence, creating agentic AI systems that reason and act autonomously, or advancing recommendation models that transform how customers discover content — depending on the team you're matched with.

Many interns publish at top-tier conferences or see their work deployed to production before the internship ends. Interns may also be considered for a return offer at the end of their internship, subject to performance evaluation and headcount availability.

Further benefits of an Amazon Science internship include;

- All of our internships offer a competitive salary
- Interns are paired with an experienced manager and mentor(s)
- Interns get invited to different intern program or office events
- Interns can build their professional and personal network with other Amazon Scientists


About the team
We're hiring interns for multiple teams in Israel, including but not limited to;

• Prime Video Sports — Build innovative sports experiences for Prime Video, spanning computer vision, 3D simulation, and personalized content recommendations.
• Personalization — Leverage LLMs, NLP, and recommender systems to match customers with products that align with their passions and shopping preferences.
• Agentic AI — Build next-generation agentic AI systems that automate real-world knowledge work, spanning retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent workflows, long-term memory and personalization, knowledge-graph construction, and agent evaluation.
• DS3 Textract — Develop multimodal generative AI algorithms that pioneer state-of-the-art document understanding solutions impacting millions of customers.

You'll submit a single application and we'll match you with science teams best aligned with your research interests.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and your application stays active until we find a team match or confirm there are no matches available.

Start dates are available throughout the year. Some teams offer full-time internships (3–6 months) while others offer part-time positions (50–60%, 8–12 months) — your recruiter will confirm the format during team matching.

We offer science internships in multiple locations across the EMEA region and you can indicate your interest in all these locations by applying here (Austria, Estonia, France, Germany, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Jordan, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, UAE, and UK).

Please note we do not offer remote internships.

Basic qualifications

- Are enrolled in a Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, or related fields
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code

title: Sr Design Operations, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching? Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV. From one service, we're delivering versatile ways to watch hundreds of thousands of movies, TV series, and live events on the web, mobile, and TV. Our service is available in 240+ territories globally, and we're just getting started.

The Amazon Prime Video UX team is seeking a self-motivated, ownership-minded, and nimble Senior Design Operations partner to be a force-multiplier for our UX Design & Research team, amplifying our efforts and impact. We design innovative experiences allowing customers around the world to discover, purchase, and watch the latest digital video content live and on demand.

You will collaborate closely with designers, researchers, engineers, product managers, and program managers leading projects throughout the planning, design, and development cycle. Your emphasis will be on planning and prioritization of design deliverables, resource management, schedule tracking, mitigating project risks, and collaborating with design leadership to deliver innovative solutions across workstreams. You will be a key part of a UX Design and Research team collaborating across all aspects of the Prime Video service. Come build the future of entertainment with us!

Key job responsibilities
- Own the operational strategy for complex, ambiguous design programs end to end, where the strategy and often the operating model are not yet defined and there is no precedent to copy
- Partner with UX leadership on key decisions and own the design roadmap for the organization: requirements gathering, scheduling, prioritization, capacity and resource planning, contracting and budget, and coordination of teams and reviews
- Own programs and portfolios of programs from concept to delivery, including the design decisions and escalations along the way
- Define the operational tool and AI strategy for the organization: govern adoption, set responsible-use guidelines, and decide where AI-augmented workflows are appropriate and where the work stays human-led
- Build automated workflows that scale design and research operations, and evaluate emerging tools against clear criteria and measurable outcomes
- Lead design delivery by managing team backlogs and removing obstacles, coordinating reviews with stakeholders and leadership, and empowering designers to own their timelines
- Design change strategies for org-wide operational shifts: build coalition before rollout, measure adoption, iterate, and balance the pace of change against the team's capacity
- Standardize, socialize, and continuously improve our user-centered design process, and build the operational infrastructure behind it, including research repositories, tooling, and how insights reach the people who need them
- Act as a bridge between UX, Engineering, Product Management, and other cross-functional partners, making sure interdependencies are understood and planned for, and influencing priorities without direct authority
- Anticipate bottlenecks, manage escalations, and balance customer needs against business goals and technical constraints, mitigating long-term risk and not only the immediate kind
- Define success metrics and own their implementation across our work, and craft the strategic narratives that connect it to business outcomes for senior leaders in yearly planning and business reviews
- Enable creative solutions through design acumen and high judgment, distinguishing one-way doors from two-way doors
- Promote transparency, visibility, and community across the team

About the team
Prime Video's vision is to be the world's most loved premium video service, and in doing so to become the default entertainment hub, globally for customers. The Prime Video Experience Design (PVXD) team's role is to reduce complexity and design fun, easy-to-use apps, where customers love to watch our content.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of design program management experience
- Experience understanding needs of business and end customers and translating them into right solutions
- Experience gathering and analyzing large amounts of data and delivering continuous business improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of project management tools and methodologies (agile to waterfall)
- Experience working and contributing to project playbooks, building schedules, managing issues/risks, establishing communication plans and stakeholder management

title: Support Engineer - French, Amazon Leo Enterprise Customer Support
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of over 3,000 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Project Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a Support Engineer to join our SATCOM Technical Support team. The ideal candidate will combine strong troubleshooting expertise with the ability to resolve complex satellite network issues through methodical problem analysis and technical resolution. In this role, you'll handle escalated cases involving service degradation, analyzing performance data (latency, jitter, packet loss) and system configurations to restore optimal service levels. Success in this role demands excellent diagnostic skills, the ability to drive technical cases to resolution, and experience working with cross-functional teams to solve challenging network issues. You'll develop and document technical solutions, contribute to our knowledge base, and provide advanced technical guidance to customers and internal teams. While monitoring tools aid your work, your primary focus will be on complex problem resolution and ensuring customer satisfaction through effective technical support. This job may require working in rotating shift schedules and variable days off.

Job Specifics:
This role is fully onsite and requires flexibility to work and rotate shifts : weekends, holidays.

Language requirements:
The role requires candidates to be fluent in 2 languages : English and French.

Note : This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. - Speak, write, and read fluently in French
- Experience in network and operating system support
- Background in L3 NOC operations with experience in emergency response and on-call support scenarios.
- Hands on experience in network design, protocols and troubleshooting tools (TCP/IP, BGP, SD-WAN,MPLS, DNS, DHCP, HTTPS,tcpdump, traceroute, mtr, etc.)

title: Finance Manager - Enterprise Risk Management, North America Trans Buildings
descriptionHtml:
Ever wonder how your Amazon packages get to your doorstep? Now you can learn by being part of the Finance team supporting these operations.

North America Trans Buildings, comprised of six networks, is looking for a Finance Manager to help with the controllership of our multibillion-dollar assets. North America Customer Fulfillment (NACF) is Amazon's large-scale fulfillment network dedicated to getting customer orders picked, packed, and delivered. Every day several million packages from multiple fulfillment centers across the US and Canada arrive in one of the ~100 sort centers where they are sorted for delivery, which improves truck utilization and reduces transportation costs. From here, the delivery network for Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Sub Same Day delivery (SSD), Rural Super Rural (RSR) and Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) takes over the packages for delivery to customer homes.

The Finance Manager will support our Global Controls, Compliance, and Risk Management team based in one of our Finance hubs. You will be pivotal to the team's success, as you partner to build and create global Controls frameworks for operational networks. This role will partner with multiple stakeholders within both, finance and the business teams, to provide Controls guidance and Compliance insights to Worldwide operations. Opportunities await to grow your career as you engage with one of the many facets of this world-class delivery service.

Key job responsibilities
- A successful candidate effectively influences business partners, provides sound and thoughtful recommendations, and manages competing priorities in a quickly changing environment. The candidate should demonstrate amazing analytical skills, ability to work with ambiguity, and strong verbal and written communication skills as direct interaction with worldwide operations leadership is common.
- Perform monthly and quarterly reviews of the fixed asset ledger to check for completeness of data, correct entries, etc. and perform corrective actions whenever necessary.
- Uses solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models, interpret data, draw conclusions, and make recommendations that deliver results, drive improvements, and influence leaders throughout Amazon. These decisions can have global impact.
- Collects and analyzes quantitative data to develop relevant reports that drive cost reductions.
- Identifies opportunities to resolve defects proactively. Improves, scales, or simplifies finance tools across teams and organizations.
- Design and build processes that improve the level of automation and scalability of the aforementioned activities that can be replicated.

A day in the life
A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to innovate by helping to build scalable, robust, dependable and systemic solutions through data-driven decision making.

Partnerships:
- Global Consumer Controllership team
- NACF & AMZL Engineering and Launch teams
- Capex Controllership team
- Accounting, Procurement, and IT

About the team
This role will support Internal Controls across two major networks in North America: NACF and AMZL, while supporting global Launch and Engineering teams. This role will help to A) influence and shape global control mechanisms and B) partner with execution teams on Controls insights.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)
- 5+ years of finance experience, or Master’s degree and 3+ years of finance experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience supporting the implementation of controls or contributing to audits over financial reporting environments

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Controls Deployment Service
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 4+ years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 6+ years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- 3+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

title: Paper Packaging Materials Engineer, Global Materials Science
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Global Materials Science (GMS) organization as we pioneer the future of sustainable e-commerce packaging. As an Advanced Materials Engineer based in the EU, you'll serve as the critical link between our European and North American materials science operations, driving materials development tailored to the EU supplier base while harmonizing global materials strategies across regions. Embedded alongside our automation hardware development teams, you'll ensure that packaging materials and automation systems are co-developed for seamless integration.

This is a hands-on, technically broad role spanning pulp and paper manufacturing, packaging converting operations, tape and adhesive systems, coatings, and packaging automation equipment. You'll conduct laboratory research, characterize materials properties, establish specifications, and work directly with EU-based suppliers to bring novel materials from concept to production, while serving as the conduit to align materials globally, simplify where possible, and solve for region-specific requirements driven by regulation, material supply availability, and operational differences.

Key job responsibilities
Materials Development & Innovation:
- Lead laboratory research and development of packaging materials including paper substrates, adhesives, tapes, coatings, and alternative fiber technologies, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations.

- Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of packaging materials and converting processes.

- Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility, with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability.

- Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment.

- Evaluate and develop tape, adhesive, and coating systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions.

EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment:
- Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions.
- Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base, including paper mills, converters, adhesive manufacturers, tape producers, and coating suppliers, and how it differs from the North American supply landscape.
- Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks.
- Balance global standardization with regional customization, driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation.
- Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GMS strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines.

Automation Hardware Integration:
- Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput.
- Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization, translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters.
- Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, tape applicators, labelers) and how materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds.
- Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings.

Materials Characterization & Testing:
- Perform and direct lab engineers to conduct comprehensive materials characterization using techniques including tensile/burst/tear testing, rheometry, thermal analysis (DSC, TGA), spectroscopy (FTIR), microscopy (SEM, optical), and surface analysis while utilizing ASTM, TAPPI, ISO, EN, and ISTA standards and non-standard methodologies.
- Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes.
- Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations.
- Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base.

Specifications & Quality:
- Define materials specifications based on critical performance thresholds required for packaging to protect products and survive the fulfillment network, accounting for EU-specific substrate variability and supplier capabilities.
- Translate operational requirements and automation equipment constraints into measurable materials properties and acceptable ranges.
- Develop quality control protocols and testing methodologies to ensure EU supplier compliance with specifications, accounting for differences in regional testing standards (EN vs. ASTM/TAPPI).
- Drive specification harmonization between NA and EU where feasible, clearly documenting where and why regional deviations are necessary.

Supplier & Manufacturing Collaboration:
- Work directly with EU-based paper mills, adhesive manufacturers, tape producers, converters, and other suppliers to develop and scale new materials.
- Conduct technical evaluations of EU supplier capabilities, pulp and paper manufacturing processes, converting operations, and quality control systems.
- Guide suppliers on process optimization, from pulp preparation and paper machine settings through converting and finishing operations, to achieve target material properties and consistency.
- Build strong technical relationships across the EU supplier base to enable rapid development cycles and ensure supply resilience.

Cross-Functional Partnership:
- Collaborate with Packaging Design and automation hardware teams on materials-design-equipment integration, ensuring all three dimensions are optimized together.
- Partner with EU and Global Procurement (GPO) on strategic sourcing, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations within the EU supply base.
- Support sustainability initiatives including carbon footprint modeling, recyclability assessment, and compliance with EU-specific sustainability regulations and reporting requirements.
- Provide technical expertise to program managers, product teams, and deployment teams across both EU and NA organizations.
- Communicate complex materials science and manufacturing concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences across multiple geographies and cultures.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:
- Author technical reports, test protocols, specifications documents, and research summaries that serve both EU and global audiences.
- Document experimental procedures, results, and learnings to build institutional knowledge, with particular emphasis on EU-NA materials differences and lessons learned.
- Present findings at design reviews, technical workshops, and leadership reviews across regions.
- Contribute to intellectual property generation through public disclosures and patent applications.
- Mentor junior engineers and technicians on materials science principles, pulp and paper manufacturing fundamentals, converting operations, and testing methodologies.

A day in the life
You're bridging continents and disciplines—ensuring Amazon's packaging materials work seamlessly from lab bench to automated packaging line.

Your morning starts with a technical review alongside the EU automation hardware team, discussing runnability data from a new paper substrate on their latest packaging machine prototype. The converting parameters need adjustment, your deep knowledge of fiber orientation, surface chemistry, and machine dynamics helps the team identify the right combination of adhesive application weight and compression dwell time.

By midday, you're on a call with a European paper mill, discussing modifications to their pulp furnish and machine settings to improve the tensile energy, a critical property for automated forming operations. You're also comparing their capabilities against what your NA colleagues are achieving with North American suppliers, identifying where specifications can be unified.

Your afternoon shifts to the lab work, where you are directing lab engineer to characterize a new tape system for high-speed application on recycled substrates, and a global alignment session with your NA counterparts. You're presenting a proposal to harmonize adhesive specifications across regions, having identified that three separate specs can be consolidated into one without compromising performance in either geography. Where regulatory or supply differences demand regional solutions, you've clearly documented the rationale and developed parallel qualification paths.

This role sits at the intersection of materials science, manufacturing processes, automation engineering, and global supply chain strategy. Your holistic understanding of how pulp becomes paper, how paper becomes packaging, and how packaging runs through automated systems makes you uniquely positioned to solve problems that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, all while keeping EU and NA aligned on a simplified, high-performing materials portfolio.

About the team
The Global Materials Science (GMS) organization is Amazon's Center of Excellence for packaging materials development and supply chain transformation. Our team represents a fundamental shift in how Amazon approaches packaging innovation, moving from supplier-dependent solutions to owning the invention, development, and optimization of materials that power our fulfillment network.


What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials. We're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster, unlock step-change improvements impossible for suppliers alone, and maintain freedom to operate across multiple supply chains.

Our Impact: We're driving Amazon's transition from plastic to paper packaging, developing breakthrough materials and establishing supply chains that reduce costs while advancing our 2040 net-zero commitment. Our work directly influences automation success, customer experience, and sustainability metrics.

Our Culture: We operate with high technical rigor while moving at startup speed. We embrace calculated risk-taking in R&D, fail fast, and iterate based on data. We believe in radical collaboration, our success requires seamless partnership across engineering, procurement, operations, and sustainability teams. We're building something that's never been done before in e-commerce, and we're looking for engineers who thrive in ambiguity, think globally while executing locally, and are energized by complex, high-impact challenges.

Our Team: We bring together materials scientists, chemists, engineers, and program managers who are passionate about solving hard problems. We partner with world-class academic institutions, leading materials suppliers, and internal Amazon teams to push the boundaries of what's possible in packaging materials. Our EU presence ensures we're co-located with automation development and deeply embedded in the European supplier ecosystem

Basic qualifications

- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Experience with materials selection, testing, and scaling to manufacturing
- Bachelor's degree in materials science engineering, chemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, pulp/paper engineering or a related technical discipline

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or higher in materials science engineering, chemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, pulp/paper engineering or a related technical discipline
- Engineering experience in pulp, paper, packaging or related field.
- Experience in characterization techniques and equipment, such as SEM-EDS, FTIR, DSC, TGA, DMA, rheometry, spectrophotometry, optical microscopy, and mechanical property testing related to packaging or other forest products with standard (ASTM, TAPPI, ISO, ISTA, etc.) and non standard methodologies.

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager - Logistics, Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings daily. As we rapidly become the world's largest consumer of corporate services in many categories, the Corporate Strategic Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join our team. This role is uniquely positioned at the nexus of business units across Amazon, and offers singular vision into a broad spectrum of cross-company initiatives and strategies on a global scale. Using this unique insight, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will build and lead sourcing engagements for both existing and newly emerging categories of spend, as well as negotiate multi-faceted partnership agreements for Amazon's high-growth businesses worldwide. Strategic Sourcing Managers own complex categories across multiple business units and regions, often in markets with limited competition and pricing transparency, and lead transformational sourcing initiatives with global scope. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments, and have a strong bias for decision making rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence C-level vendor relationships by advising senior Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business unit and corporate goals, and they raise the bar for sourcing peers across the global team. Successful candidates must work well in a fast-paced and often ambiguous arena, and will be rewarded by working alongside highly collaborative and entrepreneurial colleagues in an environment that feels much more "startup" than "big company". This role supports the Logistics spend category and we are seeking experienced sourcing professional with experience in this arena who have a passion for serving customers and for driving change and impact on a global scale, then we would love to talk with you.

Key job responsibilities
- Owning one or more complex (sub-)categories across multiple business units and/or regions, developing and executing (sub-)category strategies
- Developing global sourcing strategies to deliver against business objectives for internal clients, and achieving sustainable relationships with suppliers.
- Managing categories in markets with limited competition and limited pricing transparency, proactively identifying and mitigating supplier, commercial, and ESG risk.
- Evaluating supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and bench-marking analysis.
- Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities, including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
- Leading transformational sourcing projects with complex, global scope, coordinating work across team members and regions.
- Working with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership, and value creation beyond cost savings.
- Presenting sourcing strategies, recommendations, and decisions to senior leaders up to three levels above you.
- Contributing inputs to annual and long-range operating plans (OP1, OP2, and three-year forecast).
- Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement processes and maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Amazon's global policies.
- Preparing and holding business reviews with stakeholders to review vendor performance, future opportunities, and/or challenges.
- Mentoring and sharing best practices with sourcing peers across the global team.


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. title: Principal GNSS Systems Engineer, Amazon LEO
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an exceptionally skilled Principal GNSS Systems Engineer with a minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in GNSS engineering, satellite systems, and advanced positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) technologies. This is a senior-level technical leadership role requiring deep, first-principles expertise across the full GNSS signal chain — from satellite constellation physics and signal generation through receiver design, carrier phase tracking, and precision position and time solutions delivered to ground terminals.
The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of a custom satellite-based wireless positioning and timing transfer service operating across S-Band and L-Band frequencies. This system will transmit simultaneous multi-source signals that ground terminals can receive, correlate, and process to extract carrier phase differentials, enabling high-accuracy ranging, time delta computation, and precise geolocation. The role demands mastery of both the theoretical underpinnings of GNSS — including relativistic time corrections, ionospheric and tropospheric propagation modeling, and CDMA spreading code correlation — and the practical engineering required to implement real-world satellite communication subsystems. This position sits at the intersection of satellite communications engineering, precision time and frequency, and advanced signal processing. The engineer will own the GNSS subsystem architecture end-to-end, contribute to the TT&C subsystem, and serve as the technical authority on all matters related to satellite-based PNT service design, clock disciplining, and time transfer over wireless and optical physical mediums.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
The Principal GNSS Systems Engineer will serve as the technical lead and subsystem owner for the spacecraft GNSS architecture, driving all aspects of design from initial requirements definition through hardware acceptance.

Basic qualifications

• Master's degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field. A Bachelor's degree may be considered with exceptional demonstrated experience.
• Minimum 10 years of professional engineering experience in GNSS systems engineering, RF systems engineering, satellite payloads, TT&C design, or precision PNT system development.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience with at least two of the major GNSS constellations (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo) at the signal and systems engineering level — not limited to receiver integration.
• Proven experience designing or significantly contributing to precision time transfer systems, including two-way time transfer (satellite or optical medium), with documented accuracy results at the nanosecond level or better.
• Demonstrated experience implementing Kalman filter-based navigation or timing solutions in real-world systems, with measurable performance results.
• Experience with RF systems engineering across S-Band and/or L-Band frequencies, including link budget derivation, antenna specifications, and receiver performance analysis.
• Proven track record managing RF hardware development cycles with external suppliers and defining strict test and qualification parameters for flight hardware.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience designing a custom satellite-based PNT service from initial concept through operational deployment — including waveform design, ground terminal specification, and algorithm development.
• Practical experience with optical time transfer systems (White Rabbit, TWFTF) and integration of optical and RF time references in hybrid synchronization networks.
• Expertise in Alternative PNT (Alt-PNT) system design and evaluation, including non-GNSS positioning technologies and GNSS-independent timing sources.
• Experience with GNSS security: anti-spoofing detection, signal authentication (OSNMA, Chimera), and cryptographic protection of PNT services.
• Background in precise orbit determination (POD) and its integration into GNSS timing error budgets for high-accuracy applications.
• Familiarity with satellite communication standards (CCSDS) and their application to TT&C and custom PNT service link layer design.
• Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for signal simulation, filter design, and automated test data analysis.
