title: Senior Solutions Architect, Storage, WWSO Storage SA Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is proud to be the pioneer and recognized leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide IT infrastructure used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses worldwide, from startups to Global 500 companies across all industries.

AWS is looking for an experienced Storage Solutions Architect to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AWS DataSync, AWS Transfer Family, and AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS). You will be a technical authority working closely with service teams to drive innovation and adoption while supporting field teams and strategic customers across enterprise migrations, data center exits, managed file transfer (MFT) modernization, and disaster recovery.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable diving deep into storage service internals with engineering teams and explaining complex architectures to technical decision-makers. You will partner with AWS storage service teams to influence roadmaps, document best practices, and drive feature adoption through technical content creation and industry event presentations.

In this role, you will partner with Storage Product and GTM teams to enable key technical use cases and drive service adoption. A key focus is translating complex storage and data-movement requirements into scalable, resilient architectures and supporting the field through large-scale data center migrations, modernizing managed file transfer workflows, and designing recovery strategies that keep critical workloads resilient. Through thought leadership, you will establish best practices, propose service enhancements, and create technical content that enables successful implementation of AWS storage solutions.

This role combines service expertise with strategic customer engagement. Travel requirements are approximately 25%, primarily for speaking engagements and technical events.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the primary technical specialist for AWS DataSync, AWS Transfer Family, and AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS), working closely with the service teams to drive feature adoption and customer success
- Partner with DataSync, Transfer Family, and DRS GTM/Product teams to develop and execute technical strategies that drive service growth
- Provide architectural guidance to customers implementing enterprise data migrations, data center exits, managed file transfer (MFT) modernization, and disaster recovery / business continuity across these services
- Create technical content, deliver workshops, and speak at events to educate customers on data movement, secure file transfer, and resilience best practices
- Capture and advocate for customer feedback to influence the DataSync, Transfer Family, and DRS roadmaps, including driving resolution of critical feature gaps blocking large migration and recovery pipelines
- Collaborate with field SA teams to support complex customer opportunities and technical challenges
- Mentor other SAs on data transfer, MFT, and disaster recovery architecture patterns and use cases

About the team
The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the world's largest and most innovative companies. We work backwards from our customer's most complex and business-critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist solutions architecture, and technical field community roles. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire lifecycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as one team.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 6+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Knowledge of cloud architecture
- Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals

title: Senior Recruiter, Scholars, Global Specialty Recruiting
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Scholar team sits within the Global Specialty Recruiting (GSR) team. GSR is a highly specialized group focused on hiring exceptional talent for complex, hard-to-fill scientific, design, academic, & executive tech and non-tech roles across Amazon.

What makes our Global Specialty Recruiting team unique is our deep domain expertise and breadth of experience. Our recruiters are embedded within the academic, scientific and technical communities, allowing us to leverage academic and industry connections, innovative sourcing tactics, and a nuanced understanding of specialized skill sets.

As a full life cycle recruiter on the GSR Scholar team, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented peers, influence at the most senior levels, and make a meaningful impact on the growth and success of Amazon Science. You'll be a vital strategic partner to our science leaders, helping to shape our approach and elevate the candidate experience for some of the most sought-after academicians in the world.

If you're passionate about the sciences, driven to find exceptional talent, and eager to work alongside a best-in-class recruiting organization, this is an unparalleled opportunity to grow your career and opportunity for impact.

Critical success factors for this role include:
• Research acumen and creativity - you learn new science domains quickly and understand how to craft effective search strategies within those domains
• Superb communication skills - you're a compelling communicator able to effectively engage the attention of busy, senior executives
• Able to convey complex arguments (without the luxury of complete data) and engage with senior level scientists & executives with conviction and confidence
• Combine tenacity with tact and high judgement; know when to apply the right pressure and when to move on
• Self-assured, not easily thrown, able to think on your feet; you will be leading complex & highly confidential searches with some of our most seasoned leaders
• Inquisitive; a deep sense of learn & be curious


Key job responsibilities
Some of the core components of this role include:

• Strategically engaging best in class academic passive talent to solve some of Amazon’s toughest technical challenges.
• Developing innovative ways to raise the bar on how Amazon connects with the leading Academics in their fields and drives impact while here at Amazon.
• Continually contributing to the knowledge base of both our team and the broader recruiting community by sharing intelligence related to relevant domains and profiles
• Building out academic talent networks and tapping knowledgeable academic sources (both internal and external) to develop strong relationships within the community.
• Owning business and stakeholder relationships (you're the go-to and trusted advisor), providing strategic guidance and coaching in close partnership with executive hiring managers & their teams.
• Conducting informational/exploratory calls, phone screens, & interviews. You'll actively participate in hiring decisions throughout the candidate life cycle.


About the team
The Amazon Scholar Program enables university professors to work on large-scale and high-impact technical challenges at Amazon by joining Amazon as part-time employees or for limited-term engagements without leaving their academic institutions. We believe that Amazon is a unique place to measure the impact of new scientific ideas, given our scale and our ownership of both an information infrastructure and a physical infrastructure. The program gives academics an opportunity to test and apply research methods in practice and innovate in ways that benefit customers and improves Amazon’s ability to hire, develop, and retain world-class talent.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of advising and influencing executive leadership experience
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience building and driving talent sourcing initiatives and pipelines
- Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects and client relationships
- Experience recruiting passive candidates who are the most senior experts in their field
- • 5+ years of progressive corporate, start up or executive search firm recruiting work with a focus on passive science/academic candidate generation in a high tech markets

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with recruiting and people-related tools, CRM systems, and complex spreadsheets
- • Experience creating, measuring and scaling workflow among candidates, hiring managers and the recruiting team

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Quick
descriptionHtml:
Our team — Quick Core Experience — owns the platform layer behind Amazon Quick, an agentic, AI-powered digital workspace. We deliver the critical infrastructure every feature depends on: asset metadata services (indexing, search, list, favorites), real-time customization, the core design system, and enterprise governance adherence across web, mobile, and desktop experiences in Quick.

Quick is where generative AI meets the enterprise workplace. Chat, custom agents, research, BI, workflow automation — all unified, fast, discoverable, and governed at scale. The platform we build is what makes that possible.

We're looking for a full-stack engineer energized by hard problems on both sides of the stack. You design and operate large-scale distributed systems, and you love crafting scalable front-end experiences. You'll own real problems: high-throughput indexing pipelines that unify writes across dozens of producer teams, real-time customization services scaling across regions and tenants, and the search and discovery experiences that make the platform feel effortless.

You bring a strong sense of ownership, a high bar for code quality, and genuine passion for design and architecture. You don't just know how to solve problems — you build solutions to address them. You challenge yourself and others to constantly find better solutions. You partner with product managers, UX designers, and fellow engineers to turn ambiguous customer needs into shipped, polished features.

This role offers wide scope, real ownership, and the chance to shape Enterprise governance layers we add in Quick, that every team in the product depends on.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead the design and implementation of distributed systems, providing system-wide architectural guidance
* Build Agents to ease on-boarding and evaluation of Enterprise governance across Quick features and Quick accounts.
* Balance speed of execution with architectural requirements, identifying one-way door decisions that require the right long-term solution
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices and operational excellence across the team
* Solve complex technical problems with multiple risks and roadblocks, bringing clarity through simple, well-designed solutions
* Mentor and coach multiple engineers, helping develop the next generation of technical talent
Effectively communicate technical designs to both technical and non-technical audiences

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Financial Analyst III, FOAA
descriptionHtml:
The successful candidate will ensure that accounting processes are run in a controlled environment, meeting and exceeding our customers’ expectations. The candidate will report into Global functional lead. This role requires working with Central Accounting, Finance Operations and Global Finance teams to ensure we have controlled accounting processes for month end accounting and reporting activities in a manner fitting with our "Customer Obsession", “Deliver Results” and “Insist on Highest Standard” philosophy.

The candidate is responsible for smooth operations of global accounting team at Bangalore, which includes closing the global books of accounts, posting of journal entries, preparing global general ledger account reconciliations, reporting and having reviews with leadership team. The person needs to ensure finance processes are operating at the optimum capacity while partnering with operations and accounting teams to achieve the annual operating plan.

The FinOps Accounting team is responsible for preparing, reviewing and reporting on general ledger account and operational reconciliations. This individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining key financial and operational metrics, analyzing and reporting monthly variance analysis and providing ad-hoc reporting and analysis. This individual will also establish and embed principals of financial controls by measuring the quality of general ledger account reconciliations, creating dashboards and metrics to measure quality of processes and controls. This position will also be responsible for hiring and training priorities; ensuring existing policies and procedures are followed.

The successful candidate should have a strong desire in innovating processes and exceed expectations in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, primarily driving innovation on behalf of our customers.



Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include:
Accounting and Control:
· Own financial reporting and may teach others e.g. own the delivery of complete month end close of Accounts Payable accounting functions, reporting decks, reconciliations etc.
· Provide support/direction for process or problem resolution.
· Ensure all processes are operating efficiently and effectively.
· Identify and implement process improvements where required.
· Understand the best practices of industry and set up benchmark for quality.
· Actively participate in strategic initiatives and special projects when assigned or required.
· Ensure appropriate financial policies, procedures, and internal controls are in place, documented, and operating as intended.
· Manage department’s response to internal and external audit requirements and will also ensure compliance with SOX requirements for all geographies/activities.
· Manage complex accounting issues and implement process controls.
· Ability to analyze complex datasets and provide business judgements.
Leadership and Management:
· Stakeholder management and building relationships: Make and keep commitments, seek opportunities to partner with customers, be optimistic, and anticipate needs.
· Protect our brand: Know and live the values.
· Strong systems background.
· Actively participate in strategic initiatives and special projects when assigned or required.
· Ability to work with remote teams in multiple locations.
· Work with cross functional systems and drive process improvement initiatives

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 3+ years of advanced proficiency in Excel (pivots, lookups, etc.) experience
- 6+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience
- 6+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 7+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- 6+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- Qualified Chartered Accountant

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 7+ years of mentoring junior finance and/or business team members experience
- 3+ years of working with senior staff (e.g. c-suite) experience
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MSAccess, Essbase or Cognos) and providing recommendations based on results of ad hoc analyses to management for strategic decision-making

title: Principle Product Manager Tech, Global Corporate Procurement Tech
descriptionHtml:
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) Tech builds and manages the tech portfolio across all of GCP and other global Amazon procurement organization. We started to launch a new global buying experience to roll out over the next three years across all of Amazon, building a new Pan Amazon central supplier data repository and about to launch a first milestone on our Sourcing Suite vision to support our business on spend above $110B yearly.

Join us as a Principle Product Manager Tech on the GCP Tech team, where you'll drive the delivery of generative AI experiences used by millions of Amazon customers worldwide. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead programs at the intersection of large language models and shopping - coordinating across science, engineering, product, and design to ship novel customer experiences at Amazon scale.

In this role, you'll own end-to-end product delivery of new conversational customer experiences and the platforms that bring the Buying and Sourcing experience to life across Amazon surfaces. You'll work alongside software engineers, product managers, scientists and designers to coordinate and ship features that fundamentally change how customers optimize. This is an ideal opportunity for PMTs who are passionate about new AI customer experiences and want to drive impact on a flagship customer-facing generative AI product.

If you are thrilled about delivering customer experiences that will be used by hundreds of thousand Amazonians worldwide and are eager to tackle product challenges that have never been addressed before, then this is the perfect opportunity for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive the end-to-end delivery of large-scale programs that help the organization meet its long-term goals.
- Partner with technical, and business stakeholders to align on priorities, drive consensus, and deliver results at scale.
- Collaborate with science, engineering, product, and UX design to implement scalable, and efficient solutions to key customer problems.
- Define KPIs and metrics to measure success, identify areas for improvement and provide actionable updates to leadership through detailed reporting and insights.
- Act as the key connection point between engineering, business teams, ensuring alignment, effective communication, and seamless execution.

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience technical product management

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements

title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer, Prime Video Personalization and Discovery
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead Personalization and Discovery customer experiences. This role will work across team boundaries within PVPD and with external partners to drive the success of AI-powered content discovery initiatives. You'll be responsible for leading the technical strategy, architecture, and implementation of PV groupings, re-engagement and optimizations. You'll also establish operational excellence practices across the organization.

Key job responsibilities
* Design, develop and maintain AI based recommendation systems services that drive personalized experiences across Prime Video

* Build distributed systems to manage high-volume, low-latency AI powered customers experiences

* Develop tooling and automation to improve the efficiency, visibility, and reliability of recommendation systems.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with applied scientists, product management, and other software development teams to continuously enhance the Prime Video discovery and personalization experiences experience

* Confidently train new team-mates about your customers, what your team’s software does, how it is constructed, tested, operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

* Focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions, taking on projects that improve your team’s software, making it better and easier to maintain.

* Champion best practices around software engineering, including designing, testing, monitoring

A day in the life
Your day begins with team standup meetings, where you help prioritize work streams and unblock critical issues. Some days will involve hands-on development, writing and reviewing code, and other will consist of technical leadership responsibilities, authoring design documents or weighing in on your teammates approaches.

Throughout the day, you'll mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance and collaborating with product managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions. You'll drive discussions with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on architectural decisions.

You'll be responsible for maintaining and improving our personalization infrastructure's reliability and performance, troubleshooting complex production issues and implementing monitoring and alerting systems.

About the team
We are a team that is passionate about using Machine Learning and experiments to help surfacing the right content to the right customer at the right time. We love experimentation and learning how we can improve the quality of our recommendations.

You’ll join a diverse group of engineers at different career stages, combining fresh perspectives with deep technical expertise. Our mission is to create intuitive, fast, and personalized experiences that delight our global customer base. We blend technical excellence with strong product thinking, and our culture emphasizes learning and growth, with senior members actively mentoring newer engineers.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.


Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

A day in the life
As an Area Manager II at an Amazon fulfillment center, you'll act as a strategic leader overseeing upto 80 associates while driving department level operational improvements. You'll conduct planning sessions with your team, coaching them through operational challenges while developing their leadership capabilities. title: Electric Propulsion Engineer, Amazon Leo, GNC
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Amazon Leo's Propulsion team designs, tests and builds its own propulsion systems - enabling current and future missions to serve customers. This position demands a combination of technical depth, leadership abilities, and systems engineering experience capable of driving innovation of spacecraft propulsion technologies that ultimately enable customer service via the Amazon Leo satellite constellation. In this role, you will advise test, manufacturing, and mechanical engineers on electric propulsion best practices. Your expertise will directly influence all aspects of propulsion system design and development, including propellant storage and delivery, magnetic circuit design, cathode design, propulsion system architecture, avionics requirements, thermal management, embedded software design, and in-flight concepts of operation (CONOPs).


Key job responsibilities
The Electric Propulsion Engineer supports the system and design throughout the hardware development lifecycle, from conception, prototyping, design validation & test, through production manufacturing, and flight operations. Key responsibilities will include
- impact and influence the full scope of propulsion system design, development, and production including: propellant storage and delivery; thruster magnetic circuit design; cathode design; overall system architecture trades; Propulsion avionics requirements; thermal management; system integration; and propulsion embedded software
- perform detailed system performance and risk analyses to support design trades, risk assessments, and risk mitigation plans
- act with delegated design authority to approve: production non-conformances; changes in design, test, and systems engineering artifacts; and Concepts of Operations for the Amazon Leo Propulsion system
- identify and assess technical risks based on data and outcomes in development, production, and flight operations
- support test execution for development, validation, and risk assessments - especially for integrated tests across multiple large vacuum chambers suitable for testing Hall effect thrusters
- define test plans & test requirements to meet development and production test objectives
- define procedures for in-flight responses to novel off-nominal scenarios, and directly support flight operations as needed
- support root-cause and corrective-action investigations supported by multidisciplinary engineering teams (e.g. design, manufacturing, test, quality)


A day in the life
The Electric Propulsion Engineer will work within multi-disciplinary teams as the go-to source for electric propulsion knowledge. Teams will work on all aspects of propulsion system development, implementation and production and will require you, as propulsion expert, to ensure the key aspects of device operation are being properly considered and tested within constraints. You will aid in test planning, operation and data analysis, co-author test reports and disseminate impactful results.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures?
- 3+ years of experience with electric propulsion technologies through design or test

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- 5+ years of developing electric propulsion technologies through design & test cycles Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE) Familiarity with electric circuit design Experience with finite element analysis for electromagnetic fields and/or fluid flow

title: Network Development Engineer, 5G NTN Network Integration and Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a Low Earth Orbit satellite constellation to deliver high speed, low latency broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. As part of Payload Integration and Test, this role is focused on hands on integration, validation, troubleshooting, and qualification of end to end satellite communications systems across space, ground, RF, modem, RAN, Core, transport, and cloud infrastructure. The work is lab centered and system focused. The role is not a software development position, but the ability to use Linux, Python, protocol traces, packet captures, and automation to debug complex systems is highly valuable.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident that is a current Green Card holder, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
This role owns the network integration path between Open RAN, 5G Core, IMS, transport, lab infrastructure, and satellite payload test systems. The candidate should be able to debug across CU, DU, RU, gNodeB, Core, routing, switching, tunnels, packet captures, and lab hardware without needing the problem to be pre isolated by another team.

Key Job Responsibilities
• Integrate and validate end to end network connectivity across Open RAN, gNodeB, 5G Core, IMS, transport, and LEO satellite test systems.
• Validate 3GPP Release 17 NTN behaviors from a network integration perspective, including attach, registration, bearer setup, user plane, mobility, and service continuity.
• Integrate and test Open RAN architecture components including CU, DU, RU, F1, E1, Xn, and gNodeB connectivity into lab and payload environments.
• Validate VoNR and IMS call flows, including registration, SIP signaling, media path, QoS, emergency call behavior where applicable, and failure recovery.
• Troubleshoot NGC, NGU, NGAP, GTP U, SCTP, PFCP, VLANs, routing, MPLS, Segment Routing, QoS, MTU, timing, and user plane performance issues.
• Build and execute integration, regression, interoperability, failover, resiliency, and performance test plans for lab and HIL environments.
• Use packet captures, protocol logs, Linux tools, telemetry, and system traces to drive root cause across RF, RAN, Core, payload, transport, and cloud teams.
• Partner with RF, modem, payload, Core, RAN, software, and systems teams to define pass fail criteria and drive issues from ambiguous system behavior to clear resolver ownership.
• Support readiness reviews, test reports, and operational handoff for production bound satellite terrestrial network capabilities.

Basic qualifications

- Associate's degree or above
- 5+ years experience integrating, testing, or operating LTE or 5G networks in lab, carrier, vendor, or large scale production environments.
- Strong practical knowledge of 3GPP network architecture, including RAN to Core interfaces and 5G user plane and control plane flows.
- Experience with Open RAN or disaggregated RAN architecture, including CU, DU, RU, gNodeB integration, and related interfaces.
- Knowledge of 3GPP Release 17 NTN concepts and ability to apply standards knowledge during integration and troubleshooting.
- Experience with VoNR and IMS protocols, including SIP, RTP, registration, call setup, media path validation, and failure analysis.
- Strong Linux networking skills and ability to troubleshoot routing, interfaces, packet captures, firewalls, tunnels, timing, and performance.
- Experience with Wireshark or equivalent tools for packet and protocol analysis.
- Experience working in hands on lab environments with physical infrastructure, HIL setups, network equipment, and multi team debug.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with LEO, satellite communications, NTN, or space to ground network integration.
- Experience with 3GPP Release 18 NTN or emerging NTN standards.
- Experience with MOCN, MORAN, Multi PLMN broadcast, PLMN operations, network slicing, or shared RAN deployments.
- Experience with Cisco, Juniper, Arista, MikroTik, or comparable routing and switching platforms.
- Experience with MPLS, Segment Routing, EVPN, VXLAN, BGP, OSPF, IS IS, QoS, and high availability transport design.
- Python scripting experience for test automation, log parsing, packet analysis, or lab tooling.
- Experience with Kubernetes, cloud networking, CI based regression, or automated lab orchestration.
- Experience producing clear test reports, defect summaries, and executive ready readiness assessments.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer- Actuators and Gearbox , Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our actuator team. You will play a pivotal role in designing, prototyping, testing, and scaling the actuator systems for our robotic systems. This role requires a strong background in motor and precision gearing design, including broader knowledge around motor electromagnetics, transmission types, sensing, structural components, and thermal management. You will help drive actuator development across the full engineering lifecycle while establishing scalable design, test, and integration practices for future robotic platforms.

Key job responsibilities
Lead the selection, design, and integration of robotic actuators.

Create and optimize precision mechanical systems, including linkages, joints, and actuation systems

Collaborate with electrical and software engineers to integrate sensors, drive electronics, and control systems

Define actuator requirements around torque density, bandwidth, efficiency, thermal performance, back drivability, inertia, reliability, manufacturability, and cost.

Develop test infrastructure and expertise for measuring performance and reliability.

Work with suppliers and manufacturers worldwide to source components, manage production timelines, and maintain quality standards

Perform life-cycle testing, quality assurance, and failure analysis to validate designs and ensure product reliability

Oversee the transition of designs from prototype to mass production, including working directly with manufacturing partners globally

Maintain detailed design documentation, including CAD models, drawings, and test data

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in robotics, mechanical/mechatronics engineering, systems engineering or related field
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- 7+ years of working  designing gears systems, robotic actuators, or precision mechatronic hardware.
- Experience with CAD software (Solidworks, Onshape, NX, Catia, etc)
- Strong understanding of motors, transmissions, bearings, encoders, structural design, thermal management, and precision mechanical integration.
- Proficiency in designing machined, cast, and 3D-printed parts
- Experience with mechatronics, including sensors, actuators, and motion control systems
- Understanding of manufacturing processes and working with a global supply chain

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production

title: Principal Program Manager, WHS Strategy, Workplace Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) organization is responsible for safeguarding the health and wellbeing of more than 1.2 million operations employees across Amazon's global operations network. WHS advances safety performance through three pillars: people, programs, and technology. The organization builds a self-sustaining safety culture, prevents incidents through engineering and standardized operational practices, and applies artificial intelligence and computer vision to drive faster, proactive safety interventions at scale.

We are seeking a Principal Program Manager to lead the WHS Strategy team. This is a high-visibility leadership role at the intersection of enterprise strategy, executive communications, and operational safety performance. The leader in this position will serve as the primary owner of WHS's strategic planning cycle and will be accountable for the quality, coherence, and timeliness of the safety narrative presented to Amazon's most senior executives, including VP, SVP, and Board-level audiences.

This role requires a strategic leader who is effective under pressure, comfortable navigating organizational complexity, and capable of exercising sound judgment on matters with broad impact. The right candidate brings deep experience partnering directly with executive leadership, the ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, and a consistent track record of delivering on high-stakes commitments. A core requirement is the ability to take complex, technical safety programs and communicate them with clarity and simplicity to audiences ranging from front-line operators to Board members. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are not a differentiator for this role; they are a baseline requirement.

Key job responsibilities
This leader will own the end-to-end strategic planning lifecycle for WHS, including the development of 1 to 3 year strategic roadmaps, annual operating plans (OP1/OP2), and recurring executive reviews at monthly, quarterly, and annual cadences. Specific accountabilities include:

Collecting, synthesizing, and integrating strategic inputs from WHS teams across the organization, then drafting that content into a single, unified voice that reflects the WHS leader's perspective, ensuring consistent messaging, tone, and narrative alignment from document to document.

Authoring and managing the portfolio of WHS executive-level documents, ensuring analytical rigor, narrative precision, and strategic alignment across every deliverable that represents WHS to senior leadership.

Partnering with operations, engineering, and technology organizations across Amazon to integrate health and safety priorities into their strategic plans, influencing outcomes without direct authority.

Designing and governing the mechanisms through which safety data is reported to leadership, including ownership of data lock processes that ensure consistency and accuracy across all executive-facing materials.

Identifying opportunities to modernize how safety performance data is visualized, shared, and consumed by decision-makers at every level, raising the standard for insight-driven reporting.

Managing the enterprise planning calendar and orchestrating cross-functional inputs from a broad coalition of WHS field teams, central program teams, and operations stakeholders globally.

Translating complex operational programs, technical initiatives, and nuanced safety concepts into clear, concise, and accessible content for executive and non-specialist audiences.

A day in the life
You are a results-oriented leader with a genuine intellectual curiosity about what drives safety performance in complex operational environments. You combine strategic thinking with operational discipline: you can frame a multi-year vision and then build the mechanisms to bring it to life. You are comfortable being the person in the room who is expected to have the answer, and you hold yourself to that standard.

You bring a data-driven approach to every decision, an instinct for continuous improvement, and the organizational fluency to move work forward across teams that do not report to you. You are energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. You communicate with clarity and economy, recognizing that at the executive level, every word carries weight. You are ready to own the strategic direction of safety for one of the world's largest employers and to ensure that direction is understood, aligned, and acted upon from the front line to the boardroom.
This is an in-office role requiring five days per week on-site. Travel is expected at 10 to 20 percent annually.

About the team
The WHS Strategy team functions as the connective tissue between WHS's technical and operational organizations and Amazon's executive leadership. The team builds and manages the mechanisms through which WHS compiles, creates, and refines the strategic planning and reporting documents that represent safety performance at the highest levels of the company. This is the program management group that owns the majority of WHS executive-level content and serves as the central authority for safety data and narrative consistency across Amazon.

The team operates as a trusted, high-credibility point of contact for a large global network of senior and executive stakeholders. The work is inherently cross-functional, requiring the ability to synthesize competing inputs, reconcile inconsistencies in data or direction, and produce a unified strategic view under tight timelines. The team's output directly shapes how Amazon's senior leaders understand and act on safety.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, Communications, Supply Chain or related field of study.

Preferred qualifications

- MBA
- Experience defining and executing program requirements
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- 6+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree

title: Principal Tech Program Manager, AWS Hardware Engineering Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead cross-organizational hardware component initiatives within our Core Hardware Engineering organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the full lifecycle of mechanical and electrical components that power the entire AWS server fleet, from early architecture and design through manufacturing readiness, production ramp, and long-term fleet sustainment.

About the Role
Core Hardware Engineering is a horizontal organization that provides foundational hardware engineering capabilities across multiple vertical product lines within AWS Infrastructure. The mechanical portfolio includes fans, heatsinks, liquid cooling systems, cold plates, quick disconnects, chassis, rack frames, cables, and connectors. The electrical portfolio includes motherboards, power boards, system boards, PCIe switches and retimers, CPUs, and memory. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will own the strategy and delivery of component-level outcomes that serve every server platform in the AWS fleet.

What You Will Do
You will define and deliver complex component initiatives with broad cross-organizational impact in areas where business and architectural strategy has not yet been established. Your work begins before vertical server programs are formally defined and extends through manufacturing and long-term fleet sustainment, an end-to-end lifecycle span unique to this role.

You will own a portfolio spanning multiple component domains, dozens of active qualifications, concurrent technology transitions, and fleet-wide operations. You will orchestrate deliverables across multiple hardware engineering teams, managing prioritization and trade-offs between design, new product introduction, manufacturing, and sustaining operations to ensure engineering capacity is allocated against the highest-impact work.

You will drive strategic supplier relationships to reduce component lead times, establishing joint development roadmaps, negotiating capacity commitments ahead of demand signals, and creating multi-source qualification paths. You will hold commitments across vertical product teams, data center operations, manufacturing test teams, and external vendors, establishing scalable mechanisms for roadmap inspection, manufacturing readiness reviews, and cross-team dependency tracking that operate independently of your direct involvement.

You will deliver four primary outcomes: entitlement performance, manufacturing readiness, annualized failure rate and unsellable performance, and supply continuity, translating directly into platform readiness, cost reduction, and stability at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience managing the full hardware product lifecycle from design through manufacturing ramp and sustaining operations.
- Experience driving cross-organizational programs spanning multiple engineering teams, manufacturing operations, and external suppliers.
- Experience with component-level hardware development including mechanical and electrical systems.
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Direct experience with server or data center hardware at scale, including familiarity with ODM and JDM engagement models.
- Experience driving supplier development strategies, including joint development roadmaps, capacity planning, and multi-source qualification.
- Demonstrated ability to operate with complete independence in ambiguous environments where business and architectural strategy has not yet been defined.
- Experience establishing organizational mechanisms such as roadmap reviews, manufacturing readiness reviews, and supplier business reviews that persist and scale beyond individual involvement.
- Track record of delivering measurable business outcomes tied to total cost of ownership, time-to-market, manufacturing yield, and fleet reliability.
- Experience with firmware and software integration as it relates to hardware component readiness and platform bring-up.
- Master's degree in Engineering or an MBA.

title: Project Design Mechanical Engineer, Fleet Remediation Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We have an immediate opening for a Project Design Mechanical Engineer in Singapore Cluster. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

As an Amazon Fleet Remediation Project Design Mechanical Engineer, you will lead design projects in operational data centers, that remediate issues, upgrade our existing infrastructure or add new services. You will be the 'go to' engineering resource for these projects and will provide lifecycle support from design through implementation. You will use your mechanical expertise to:
• Own the design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions which add data center infrastructure, capacity, improve availability, and/or increase sustainability
• Perform design and equipment submittal review for Data Centers in your region
• Interface with internal and external data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team, field engineering, and controls engineering to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered
• Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions
• Act as a technical subject matter expert for your given discipline during new remediation projects
• Support construction, commissioning, operations, and turnover

Key job responsibilities
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As a Fleet Remediation Project Design Mechanical Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale.

As an ideal candidate you:
• Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide design and recommendations despite uncertainty
• Are detail and data oriented with familiarity with design/construction processes
• Have experience managing engineering projects and engineering consultants.
• Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Commissioning, Construction and Design)
• Manage design and as built drawings and documents
• Prepare and present progress reports to all relevant stakeholders
• Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center safety, remediation projects, capacity, and availability, focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Experience as a resident engineer or hands-on design consultant
- 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License

- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Japan はビジネスの成長をサポートする新しいフルフィルメントセンター,インバウンドクロスドック,アウトバウンドソートセンターなどFirst Mile/Middle Mileの新規サイト立ち上げおよび数十の既存サイトにおける改造プロジェクトにおいて、設置されるマテハン機器や自動化設備の安定稼働に向けて設備の安全性や品質、信頼性、生産性の改善を技術的にリードする Senior Engineer を探しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンのグローバルチームや国内外のサプライヤーと協力し共に成長しながら技術的なリーダーシップを発揮し、安全性やコストバランスを維持しつつ設備およびプロセスの能力と品質を最大化させます。また、オートメーションを含む最新鋭の搬送設備の導入に伴い新たに発生する技術課題に対しても状況に応じて最適なソリューションを提案し、関係するステークホルダーとの合意形成をとりながらタイムリーに解決へ導くことで新規ソートセンターの立ち上げを成功させ、日本のお客様へお届けする商品のリードタイム短縮と輸送コスト削減に貢献します。そして幅広い技術力や経験知を指導することでチーム全体の技術力を底上げし、さらに設備仕様や業務プロセスの標準化へつなげていくことで技術のスケールアップにも貢献します。下記が主な業務となります。
- 日本のオペレーションが計画する中期および年次計画に基づいてフルフィルメントセンターおよびソートセンターの立ち上げを実現すること。
- 設備の技術問題に対して重大性や影響度を迅速かつ正確に捉え、状況に応じて安全、日程、品質、コストの全体最適となるソリューションを提案し解決させること。
- 既存のコミュニケーションチャネルとワークプロセスの更なる改善を行い、社内外のステークホルダーとの信頼関係を構築しながらコンフリクトを解消し合意形成に結び付けるようマネージすること。
- グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと連携し、最先端の設備や業務プロセスを日本に導入して、入出荷能力の向上や業務効率化を図ること。また、日本のベストプラクティスはグローバルへ提案し標準化すること。
- 国内外の協力会社と連携するだけでなく、継続的にそれら協力会社の能力を高め、安全性・品質の向上と低コスト化を推進すること。
- 安全基準とエンジニアリング指針に則り、標準作業作りなどを通してメカニズムを構築し安全な職場を実現すること。

Amazon Japan is seeking an Senior Engineer to manage the construction of the material handling equipment and automation equipment, verify the operational capability, and start up the new fulfillment center/IB cross-dock/OB sort center that handles First mile/Middle mile delivery. This position will demonstrate technical leadership while working and growing with Amazon's global team and domestic and international suppliers to maximize facility and process capability and quality while maintaining safety and cost balance. In addition, we propose optimal solutions for new technical issues that arise with the introduction of state-of-the-art transportation equipment, including automation. By guiding them, we will successfully launch a new sort center and contribute to shortening lead times and reducing transportation costs for products delivered to Japanese customers. In addition, by teaching a wide range of technical skills and empirical knowledge, we will raise the technical skills of the entire team, and furthermore, we will contribute to the scale-up of technology by leading to the standardization of equipment specifications and business processes.
The following are the main duties.
- Realize the launch of fulfillment centers and sort centers based on the mid-term and annual plans planned by the Japanese operations.
- Quickly and accurately grasp the severity and impact of technical problems with equipment, and propose and resolve solutions that optimize overall safety, schedule, quality, and cost, depending on the situation.
- Further improve existing communication channels and work processes, build relationships of trust with internal and external stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and manage to build consensus.
- Collaborate with global engineering teams and introduce new technology and processes to Japan to improve shipping and receiving capabilities and improve business efficiency. In addition, Japan's best practices should be proposed globally and standardized.
- In addition to collaborating with partner companies in Japan and overseas, continuously improve the capabilities of these partner companies, and promote improvements in safety and quality as well as cost reductions.
- According to safety standards and engineering guidelines, create a mechanism through the creation of standard work, etc., and realize a safe workplace.
More Information (Japanese Only)
- Department: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。

一週間に 3~4 日を工事中のサイトで勤務し現場の工事安全を統括リードし、各ベンダーや関係部署にまたがる複雑な技術課題の解決をリードします。グローバルチームメンバーと協業しながら業務プロセスや標準の改善に向けてドキュメントを作成し提案、実行します。業務を進めるうえで何か迷うことがあれば、チャットや F2F の会話を通して気軽に相談しながら、チーム全体でサポートし合います。フレックスが基本ですが、原則 18 時以降は会議やメールは行いません。有給休暇の取得率も高く長期休暇も、もちろん取得可能です。

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization), AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you embed directly with strategic customers to build, optimize, and run custom generative AI models in production alongside their engineering teams. You own complete model workstreams end-to-end from defining the evaluation bar and preparing data, through training and inference optimization, to production deployment.

FDE IIs on this team works at the intersection of models and systems. They customize state-of-the-art open-weight and foundation models for new domains, languages, and modalities; migrate and optimize training and inference workloads on AWS Trainium and operate those models as production services. They are autonomous contributors who take on projects where the business goal is clear, but the path is not. They make design trade-offs with appropriate guidance, limit short-term workarounds, coach others on producing high-quality code, and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer ML and engineering teams: Understand the customer's business, data, model stack, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous goals into a measurable evaluation bar and a technical plan for your workstream such as model selection, customization approach, and serving architecture. Requires up to 25% travel.

Customize and post-train models. Adapt open-weight and foundation models to customer domains through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning (including RLHF, RL with verifiable rewards, and multi-turn agentic RL). Build the data pipelines, synthetic data generation, and evaluation harnesses that prove a customized model out performs the baseline on the customer's own quality, latency, and cost bar. Apply these techniques to high-value patterns such as coding agents, domain foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Build large-scale training and inference systems. Design and implement distributed training and RL post-training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl. Build RL interaction harnesses using NeMo Gym or OpenEnv to connect agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions to training. Develop production inference stacks with engines such as SGLang and vLLM, and optimize throughput, latency, memory footprint, and cost per token through quantization, parallelism, speculative decoding, and batching.

Optimize models on AWS chips. Migrate and tune training and inference workloads for AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Profile performance, close accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, and develop custom kernels where needed. Benchmark rigorously and turn results into decisions customers can act on.

Accelerate impact beyond the engagement. Codify reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and optimization patterns that accelerate future deployments. Feed field learnings back to AWS service teams, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron. Identify opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer engagement.


About the team
ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Team
The Custom Model and Optimization team, part of the Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with enterprises, AI-native startups, and foundation model providers to build, customize, and optimize generative AI models at scale. Our work spans domain foundation models, post-training of open-weight models, and moving training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. As embedded engineers within the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering motion, we bring deep model and optimization expertise to customers' most strategic AI workloads, and we turn what we learn into tooling and patterns that scale across AWS.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

- Experience with agentic and spec-driven development (developing AI agents a plus)

title: Data Center Material Associate, IT Services (Warehouse)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's IT Services (ITS) team is seeking a detail-oriented Data Center Material Associate, Warehouse (Reverse Logistics) to support the recovery, tracking, and lifecycle management of IT assets within our India operations. In this role, you will own the end-to-end reverse-logistics journey for IT equipment — ensuring that devices are retrieved, verified, and processed accurately as employees transition out of the organization.

You will act as the central coordination point between internal stakeholders, logistics partners, and asset-management systems to drive timely asset returns and maintain a high IT-clearance completion rate. The position combines operational execution, data accuracy, and strong communication, working within established policies and standard operating procedures.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys structured, process-driven work with measurable outcomes. You will contribute directly to inventory accuracy, cost avoidance, and compliance goals while gaining exposure to large-scale operations, logistics coordination, and IT asset-management tooling. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and comfortable managing a steady volume of cases, following up persistently, and resolving discrepancies through collaboration. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and take pride in operational excellence, we encourage you to apply.

Key job responsibilities
- Asset recovery coordination: Manage the day-to-day queue of reverse-logistics cases, ensuring IT assets are recovered promptly and tracked through each stage of the return process.

- Stakeholder communication: Send structured notifications and reminders to relevant stakeholders, follow up on pending returns, and respond to queries in a professional, timely manner.

- Logistics partner coordination: Work with third-party logistics providers to schedule pickups, confirm shipments, and validate receipt of assets at designated locations.

- Data accuracy & tracking: Maintain accurate records of asset status, movements, and discrepancies using asset-management and tracking tools; reconcile data to ensure inventory integrity.

- Discrepancy resolution: Identify and resolve mismatches, missing items, or tagging errors by collaborating with internal teams and following defined escalation paths.

- Clearance & compliance: Support IT-clearance workflows and ensure processes adhere to organizational policies and audit requirements.

- Reporting: Prepare and share regular status updates and queue reports to provide visibility into operational performance and open items.

- Process improvement: Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to increase efficiency, reduce turnaround time, and improve the overall return experience.

- Documentation: Maintain clear, organized records to support traceability and knowledge continuity across the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you will review and prioritize the reverse-logistics case queue, send notifications and follow-up reminders for pending asset returns, and coordinate pickups and shipments with logistics partners. You will update asset-tracking systems with current statuses, confirm receipts, and reconcile any data discrepancies. Part of your day involves responding to stakeholder queries, escalating blocked cases through defined channels, and verifying that recovered assets are correctly logged and processed. Prepare short status updates summarizing queue health and open items. Throughout, you will apply standard operating procedures to keep cases moving and ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.

About the team
You will join the **ITS Reverse Logistics team**, a group dedicated to managing the recovery and lifecycle of IT assets across Amazon's India operations. The team ensures that equipment is efficiently returned, verified, and processed as employees transition, directly supporting inventory accuracy, cost efficiency, and compliance goals. We work closely with internal IT, logistics partner and logistics partners, using modern asset-management and tracking tools to coordinate a high volume of cases at scale. The team values accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement, and offers a collaborative, process-driven environment where your contributions have a clear, measurable impact on operational performance.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager
- 1+ years of shipping & receiving, inventory and warehousing practices experience
- Education qualification : Graduate

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in courier industry, or experience in logistics
