title: Software Development Engineer II, Prime Benefits
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about transforming the shopping experience for millions of Prime members worldwide? Join Amazon's Benefits, Pricing & Constructs team where you'll build innovative technical solutions that directly impact customer satisfaction and engagement. You'll tackle complex architectural challenges that span multiple tech stacks, designing scalable systems that serve millions of Prime members globally.

In this role, you'll drive technical innovation in the benefits space by adopting novel approaches and technologies. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create operationally sustainable solutions while mentoring fellow engineers and contributing to a culture of technical excellence. This is your opportunity to solve challenging problems that cut across diverse technologies while building high-impact products that enhance the Prime membership experience.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement scalable technical solutions for key Prime benefit products that reach millions of members worldwide, ensuring operational sustainability and performance at scale
Lead technical problem-solving for complex architectural components, contributing to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance
Collaborate with senior engineers to develop architecture solutions and provide meaningful feedback through active participation in code reviews for team members at all levels
Drive technical innovations in the benefits space through adoption of novel approaches and technologies, balancing customer requirements with team operational needs
Mentor junior engineers on software development best practices while documenting team software construction, testing, and operational procedures for knowledge sharing

A day in the life
You'll start your day analyzing performance metrics for Prime benefit systems, then dive into leading technical design sessions with senior engineers to architect solutions for upcoming features. Mid-morning, you'll conduct code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates and ensuring operational excellence standards. Afternoons often involve hands-on development work, implementing scalable solutions that will serve millions of customers, followed by mentoring sessions with junior engineers where you share best practices and guide their technical growth.


About the team
The Worldwide Prime Benefits, Pricing & Constructs team drives Amazon's north star vision to create Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program. Our mission focuses on four key areas: increasing potential value through innovative benefits, making Prime members aware of their program value, scaling new constructs to reach distinct customer segments, and growing long-term free cash flow through strategic partnerships and pricing decisions.

You'll join a collaborative team that values knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and technical innovation. Our inclusive environment celebrates different perspectives and experiences, fostering growth through continuous learning opportunities and challenging projects that directly impact millions of Prime members across the globe.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: AIT Auditor II, Audits & Insights Team, Audit and Insights
descriptionHtml:
Amazon provides individuals or enterprises the opportunity to sell their goods on the Amazon platform. Over 2 million sellers in 14 countries (and growing) list their products for sale on Amazon and thereby contribute to the success of Amazon. Amazon is growing worldwide and Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. These Sellers offer hundreds of millions of unique items, providing a broad and diverse inventory of products from Books, Electronics, Apparel, Consumables and beyond.

Our team, through a partnership with core business teams, contribute to key goals that help improve Seller/Buyer experience on Amazon. This team is made up of people like you. People who are: a) Entrepreneurial – we build solutions for Buyers and Sellers, regardless of size, b) Innovative – our problem space evolves every day due to scale, new categories, and new geographies. There is no playbook, so innovation and creativity are a must, c) Passionate – Everyone’s an owner at Amazon, and our team is no exception. We are passionate about our customers, both Sellers, and Buyers.


Key job responsibilities
Establish SOPs, process controls, recommend revisions and ensure alignment with business goals
· Build and scale system-level solutions that have metric impact; drive adoption of solutions across teams
· Perform data analysis on trends observed and recommend solutions to the product and BD teams
· Collaborate with partner teams and stakeholders across the globe to deliver on key business goals and objectives by driving consensus and building trust
· Perform high level failure (error) investigations which may be either operational or business specific in nature
· Establishes key reporting/MIS for functional area & write strong, well-structured and detail oriented reports in a clear, concise and audience-specific format
· Drives continuous improvement and contribute to COE (Correction of Error) process by documenting any issues/RCAs/action planning in functional area and own specific action or change
· Demonstrates the ability to dive deep into a problem, performs ‘root cause analysis,’ and identifies constraints to recommend a solution
· Interacts with multiple stakeholders to communicate on gaps identified/metrics information and project reviews

Basic qualifications

- Minimum 1 year of experience displaying high ownership, ability to dive deep and deliver results through projects, contributions to program level goals etc.
- Minimum 1 year of experience managing a team directly or indirectly (coaching underperformance, mentorship, training new hires etc.)
- Experience leading initiatives and/or managing operational metrics at program or org level
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Experience managing multiple stakeholders and collaborating with partner teams (Ops, product, policy etc.)
- Knowledge of Quality auditing methodology and tools
- Proficiency in Excel (Pivots, VLOOKUP etc.)
- Excellent analytical thinking, problem solving skills and proven ability of managing multiple competing priorities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in seller facing risk functions (SEPO, SPR etc.).
- Experience managing multiple programs and driving high level process improvement initiatives
- Knowledge of Lean principles or DMAIC methodology will be an added advantage

title: AHS Compliance Spec - English & German, Account Health Support
descriptionHtml:
The Account Health Support team acts as the primary interface between Amazon and our third-party business partners (Sellers). We provide dedicated support to Sellers on the Amazon platform, predicting their needs proactively and delivering solutions that help them better serve customers.


Key job responsibilities
•You will support Selling Partners to resolve account health issues via phone and email, managing high volumes of inbound and outbound contacts with effective education, de-escalation and communication in every interaction.
•You will conduct thorough investigations to identify root causes of account health issues, including policy violations, enforcement actions, and appeals — providing clear, accurate solutions and redirecting difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
•You will serve as a dedicated contact for Sellers throughout their compliance journey, executing structured outreach plans including proactive contacts, follow-ups, and pre-enforcement outreach across applicable legislations.
•You will document all interactions according to standard operating procedures, managing cases through centralized mechanisms to ensure visibility, consistency, audit readiness, and high data integrity.
• You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify process improvements, flag policy gaps, and consistently achieve productivity and quality performance goals in a metric-driven environment


A day in the life
As an Account Health Support Specialist, you will serve as a dedicated point of contact for Amazon's Selling Partners, guiding them through their compliance journey. You will resolve account health issues, conduct investigations into policy violations, and execute proactive outreach to help Sellers maintain and regain compliant status across Amazon policies and EU regulations — including product compliance, sustainability, and general product safety (GPSR). AHS Specialists work across voice and written channels, supporting Sellers through account health issues, enforcement actions, and compliance journeys depending on role specialization.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in any field of study
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English and German (B2 or above)
- Experience using computer-based tools and systems to process or track work

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a contact center environment
- Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing operations environment
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, inspiring confidence while guiding customers through resolution steps via phone and email
- Demonstrated empathy and active listening skills
- Ability to deliver performance in a metric-driven environment with high productivity and quality standards
- Multitasking ability: handling phone, chat, and email contacts simultaneously
- Ability to troubleshoot, research, and translate technical or procedural instructions into clear guidance for customers
- Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and willing to learn new skills
- Demonstrated ability to identify and drive process improvements

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Software and Technology
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
Join the AWS Solutions Architecture team as a Sr Solutions Architect for Software and Technology customers. Our customers are born in the cloud and are leading the industry in AI-Native transformation. You will define and prove technical direction by combining architectural reasoning and strategic advisory with hands-on validation in customer environments. You will build working prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and AI-driven solutions that accelerate customer decisions and remove the gap between architectural recommendation and validated proof.  You operate where the path forward is undefined and must be defined by you. Your customers have business objectives but may not have defined technology strategy or solution design. You create and adapt approaches for situations where established patterns are insufficient, applying contextual judgment about your customers' operational constraints, regulatory environment, and competitive dynamics.  You will be the primary technical partner for your customers. You lead with Agentic AI and AI-assisted development to solve customer problems, and you steer customers away from where hype outpaces practical value for their operational context. You maintain technical currency so customers receive guidance based on current capability, not outdated expertise. You build deep relationships with customers’ senior technical leaders to enable them to be cloud advocates.  You are technically self-sufficient, yet you know when to seek help: you are capable of using AI tools and delivering directly in customer sandbox environments. You drive the architectural decisions that downstream teams (customer engineering, ProServe, partners) build against, and you own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting.    

Key job responsibilities  

Technical Proof & Validation  
Build working prototypes in customer non-production sandbox environments using AI-augmented development tools (Kiro, Claude Code, Bedrock) to validate architectural recommendations and accelerate customer adoption  
• Implement directly to unblock customer decisions: build PoCs for agentic AI and other use cases proving architectural approaches that conversations alone cannot validate  
• Deploy infrastructure using IaC (CDK, Terraform) in customer sandboxes, demonstrating scalability and security patterns  
• Apply GenAI and agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, foundation model integration) where they solve customer problems.   

Architectural Reasoning & Decision Ownership
 • Frame and resolve technical trade-offs involving multiple competing concerns (security vs. cost vs. operational burden vs. time-to-market vs. industry compliance), bringing a clear recommendation with alternatives articulated  
• Make cross-cutting architectural decisions that ensure coherence across systems, teams, and workstreams; flag decisions that are difficult to reverse before the customer commits  
• Diagnose non-obvious architectural issues including resilience gaps, failover weaknesses, scaling bottlenecks, and security vulnerabilities.
• Own the architectural decisions that downstream teams build against and own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting  
• Stay engaged through implementation to ensure the architecture holds against the reality of the customer's environment; know when accumulated context warrants a revised approach   

Strategic Advisory & Customer Influence  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for customers, maintaining the current view of their technical landscape, industry context, and competitive dynamics  
• Partner with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS  
• Influence senior leaders' technology direction by connecting short-term AI and cloud decisions to long-term business outcomes; earn trust through guidance that consistently delivers the outcomes they expected  
• Challenge customer direction when evidence indicates a better path; customers avoid costly rework because you identify risk early and bring considered alternatives  
• Shape AI and cloud strategy for major operators — translating complex capabilities into business-outcome narratives.  

Revenue & Opportunity Acceleration  
• Accelerate customer adoption by removing ambiguity through validated proof points, measurably reducing the time from architectural recommendation to customer commitment  
• Identify new opportunities discovered during customer engagements  
• Increase service adoption through tangible multi-service integration demos  • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS  
• Identify implementation pathways that benefit from ProServe expertise, creating natural expansion opportunities through demonstrated value   Customer

Relationship & Communication Skills  
• Experience presenting to both large and small audiences (Executives, IT Management, and developers)  
• Experience communicating across internal and external organizations  
• Ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience  
• Ability to pick up on non-verbal communication and "un-said" drivers   

Thought Leadership & Product Influence  • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as blogs and whitepapers.  
• Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable requirements that service teams act on; synthesize evidence across multiple engagements rather than relaying feedback from one. Accelerate development and reduce ambiguity by creating code for a proposed feature to illustrate your requirement that can be reviewed and evaluated for inclusion into product codebase.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Demonstrated ability to build and validate solutions hands-on (code, infrastructure as code, tested deployments), not only advise
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients including building deep relationships with senior technical leaders.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is looking for a dynamic Commissioning Engineer. It is the responsibility of all Amazonians to have alignment with our leadership principles and demonstrate these at the highest level.

The responsibilities of the ACx Commissioning Engineer (CxE) include, but are not limited to, oversight and coordination of multi-discipline division of work related to design review and commissioning of Amazon critical infrastructure for new construction and special projects. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems including medium and low voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC, Chilled Water, BMS, and EPMS systems. They shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to develop and review electrical and mechanical component and integrated systems testing along with other commissioning documents to ensure they are compliant with the basis of design, specification, industry standards and sequence of operations. It is the CxE responsibility to ensure that all commissioning procedures follow the appropriate safety practices and policies. CxE is responsible for auditing commissioning activities continuously to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. The CxE proactively communicates with the ACx Regional Manager and the ACx team to ensure that the applicable test documents are created and executed in accordance with all commissioning requirements. This individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects, lessons learned, and program improvements to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight schedules.

Key job responsibilities
Physical Requirements

• Walk job sites in uneven terrain
• Work at heights and from ladders
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
• Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
• Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
• Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
• Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
• Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
• Work in a noisy environment
• Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment


Additional Job Requirements

• Ability to relocate to the North Virginia area.
• Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 50% of the year. Typical travel is 20%.
• Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 3+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Ausbildung - Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.


Key job responsibilities
• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.



A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst Du in unserer modernen Partnerlehrwerkstatt sowie der Berufsschule, während Du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon am Standort erwirbst.
Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst eine Störung an einer Förderanlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, führst eine vorbeugende Wartung durch oder unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Technik.
Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Du hast mindestens einen Hauptschulabschluss zum Beginn der Ausbildung
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Gute Schulnoten in Mathematik und Physik (abhängig von der Schulform)

Preferred qualifications

- Du besitzt handwerkliches Geschick und verfügst über ein technisches Grundverständnis
- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)
- Du bringst bereits erste Vorerfahrungen im handwerklichen Bereich mit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität“
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). Sollten die Bewerbungsunterlagen nicht vollständig sein, können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen! Bitte beachte, dass du im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses ein Videointerview über ein externes Tool durchführen musst. Mit der Übersendung Deines Lebenslaufs erklärst Du Dich mit der Speicherung Deiner Daten zum Zwecke der Feststellung der Eignung für dieses und zukünftige Stellenangebot/e in der weltweiten Amazon Konzernpersonaldatenbank, die derzeit in den USA geführt wird, einverstanden.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Technical for Lead Qualification , Marketing Technology, AI, and Analytics (TAA)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Marketing is looking for a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own lead qualification: the machine learning (ML) service that connects Marketing investment to sales outreach. Marketing generates the demand. Your service determines which of that demand is handed off to Sales, starting from the needs of sellers, partners and the Marketing Operations teams who manage the funnel.

ML is at the core of this role. You will evolve a deep-learning propensity model that scores each lead's readiness and likelihood to convert, and own the tooling Marketing Operations uses to see scoring impact, qualify segments and manage exceptions.

You will own lead qualification end to end: deciding how and when leads qualify, setting the thresholds and suppression rules behind those decisions, and keeping qualified leads flowing to Sales based on seller and partner needs. Your focus is delivering qualified leads, making scoring more accurate and transparent, and finding new qualification opportunities in existing demand.

Scope and Impact
ML qualification is how AWS Marketing produces Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) at global scale, so a change to the model, its thresholds or the flow of leads reaches every seller and partner who receives them. Small improvements compound across the funnel, which gives this role considerable scope and complexity. Every lead surfaced that would otherwise be missed is return on Marketing investment already made.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the lead qualification roadmap and priorities, including new opportunities to qualify leads from existing demand using customer engagement signals, and make sound trade-offs when data is incomplete.
- Define how and when leads qualify, and set the propensity-score thresholds and suppression rules that determine which leads advance to Sales.
- Drive new iterations of the scoring model with Data Science and engineering teams: translate business problems into model requirements, evaluate technical proposals, and run A/B tests before launching changes globally.
- Own the tooling and exception process Marketing Operations uses to qualify segments and handle cases the model does not.
- Keep qualified leads flowing to sellers and partners, define leading indicators that surface delivery or scoring regressions early, and lead full-funnel diagnosis when conversion or delivery changes.
- Influence without authority across Sales, Marketing Operations and Data Science, bringing stakeholders along from hypothesis through test to scale.
- Represent internal customers by generalizing requirements across sellers, partners and Marketing Operations, and staying close to how qualified leads perform in the field.
- Write the narratives, such as press release and FAQ documents and business cases, that align senior leaders on qualification decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 6+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Software and Technology
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
Join the AWS Solutions Architecture team as a Sr Solutions Architect for Software and Technology customers. Our customers are born in the cloud and are leading the industry in AI-Native transformation. You will define and prove technical direction by combining architectural reasoning and strategic advisory with hands-on validation in customer environments. You will build working prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and AI-driven solutions that accelerate customer decisions and remove the gap between architectural recommendation and validated proof.  You operate where the path forward is undefined and must be defined by you. Your customers have business objectives but may not have defined technology strategy or solution design. You create and adapt approaches for situations where established patterns are insufficient, applying contextual judgment about your customers' operational constraints, regulatory environment, and competitive dynamics.  You will be the primary technical partner for your customers. You lead with Agentic AI and AI-assisted development to solve customer problems, and you steer customers away from where hype outpaces practical value for their operational context. You maintain technical currency so customers receive guidance based on current capability, not outdated expertise. You build deep relationships with customers’ senior technical leaders to enable them to be cloud advocates.  You are technically self-sufficient, yet you know when to seek help: you are capable of using AI tools and delivering directly in customer sandbox environments. You drive the architectural decisions that downstream teams (customer engineering, ProServe, partners) build against, and you own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting.    

Key job responsibilities  

Technical Proof & Validation  
Build working prototypes in customer non-production sandbox environments using AI-augmented development tools (Kiro, Claude Code, Bedrock) to validate architectural recommendations and accelerate customer adoption  
• Implement directly to unblock customer decisions: build PoCs for agentic AI and other use cases proving architectural approaches that conversations alone cannot validate  
• Deploy infrastructure using IaC (CDK, Terraform) in customer sandboxes, demonstrating scalability and security patterns  
• Apply GenAI and agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, foundation model integration) where they solve customer problems.   

Architectural Reasoning & Decision Ownership
 • Frame and resolve technical trade-offs involving multiple competing concerns (security vs. cost vs. operational burden vs. time-to-market vs. industry compliance), bringing a clear recommendation with alternatives articulated  
• Make cross-cutting architectural decisions that ensure coherence across systems, teams, and workstreams; flag decisions that are difficult to reverse before the customer commits  
• Diagnose non-obvious architectural issues including resilience gaps, failover weaknesses, scaling bottlenecks, and security vulnerabilities.
• Own the architectural decisions that downstream teams build against and own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting  
• Stay engaged through implementation to ensure the architecture holds against the reality of the customer's environment; know when accumulated context warrants a revised approach   

Strategic Advisory & Customer Influence  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for customers, maintaining the current view of their technical landscape, industry context, and competitive dynamics  
• Partner with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS  
• Influence senior leaders' technology direction by connecting short-term AI and cloud decisions to long-term business outcomes; earn trust through guidance that consistently delivers the outcomes they expected  
• Challenge customer direction when evidence indicates a better path; customers avoid costly rework because you identify risk early and bring considered alternatives  
• Shape AI and cloud strategy for major operators — translating complex capabilities into business-outcome narratives.  

Revenue & Opportunity Acceleration  
• Accelerate customer adoption by removing ambiguity through validated proof points, measurably reducing the time from architectural recommendation to customer commitment  
• Identify new opportunities discovered during customer engagements  
• Increase service adoption through tangible multi-service integration demos  • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS  
• Identify implementation pathways that benefit from ProServe expertise, creating natural expansion opportunities through demonstrated value   Customer

Relationship & Communication Skills  
• Experience presenting to both large and small audiences (Executives, IT Management, and developers)  
• Experience communicating across internal and external organizations  
• Ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience  
• Ability to pick up on non-verbal communication and "un-said" drivers   

Thought Leadership & Product Influence  • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as blogs and whitepapers.  
• Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable requirements that service teams act on; synthesize evidence across multiple engagements rather than relaying feedback from one. Accelerate development and reduce ambiguity by creating code for a proposed feature to illustrate your requirement that can be reviewed and evaluated for inclusion into product codebase.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Demonstrated ability to build and validate solutions hands-on (code, infrastructure as code, tested deployments), not only advise
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients including building deep relationships with senior technical leaders.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience working in a Software and Technology segment, with startups or ISVs.
- Hands-on proficiency with AI/ML in production: agentic architectures, RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, foundation model integration

title: Duales Studium - Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest verstehen, wie Roboter, Sensoren und automatisierte Anlagen zusammenspielen?

Bei Amazon setzt du dein Wissen direkt in der Praxis ein. Du arbeitest an Anlagen, die Produkte durch eines der komplexesten Logistiknetzwerke der Welt bewegen. Vom ersten Tag an übernimmst du Verantwortung, arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und siehst den direkten Einfluss deiner Arbeit.

Als Teil von Amazon eröffnet sich dir ein Universum an Möglichkeiten: Zugang zu modernster Technik, vielfältige Karrierewege und ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen zählen und du früh gefördert und gefordert wirst.

Während des dualen Studiums besuchst du die Hochschule, um einen Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) mit Vertiefung Automatisierungstechnik zu erwerben. In einem Trainingszentrum erhältst du eine praktische Grundausbildung, und bei Amazon wendest du dein Wissen direkt an, an der Seite von erfahrenen Automation Engineers, die dich fördern und fordern.

Dabei entwickelst du Kenntnisse in Elektronik und Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Programmierung sowie Automatisierungs- und Steuerungstechnik. Gleichzeitig tauchst du in Zukunftsthemen wie Robotik, Smart Systems und IoT ein.

Beginn: 01.08.2027
Standort: Achim
Hochschule: HAW Hamburg
Ausbildungszentrum: Siemens AG Hamburg

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
• Hardware Engineering und Konfiguration von Anlagen
• Inbetriebnahme komplexer Infrastruktursysteme
• Arbeit mit Automatisierungssystemen und Prozessvisualisierungen
• Intelligente Fabrikautomation mit Cloud-Konnektivität
• IoT-Anwendungen in der Gebäude- und Anlagentechnik
• Installation elektrischer Einrichtungen
• Prüfung von elektrischen, pneumatischen und hydraulischen Steuerungen
• Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und technischen Teams an realen Projekten

A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du an der Hochschule sowie in einem Trainingszentrum, während du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon an deinem Standort erwirbst.

Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers eine Störung an einer Förder- oder Sortieranlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. An einem anderen Tag konfigurierst du eine Steuerung und nimmst neue Technik in Betrieb. Und dann gibt es die Tage, an denen du an einem Projekt rund um Robotik, Sensorik oder IoT mitarbeitest.

Kein Tag ist wie der andere – mal stehst du an der Anlage, mal suchst du Fehler vor Ort, mal analysierst und optimierst du Systeme am Computer.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers zusammen, lernst von ihnen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Du probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Elektro-/ Automatisierungs-/ Steuerungstechnik oder verwandten Bereichen

Preferred qualifications

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität"
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung

title: Food Safety Risk Manager III – Sanitation, North America Food Safety
descriptionHtml:

title: Delivery Consultant - Migrations, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in leading large-scale portfolio assessment and application disposition for enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS — assigning R-strategies (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retire, Retain, Relocate) and designing wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on migration best practices, risk mitigation, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end migration assessment process, ensuring adherence to AWS well-architected principles, optimizing wave sequencing, and managing risks throughout the programme lifecycle.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
• Own Portfolio Assessment for assigned application estates (1,000+ servers), scoring apps across dimensions from Technical Designs and CMDB data
• Apply the migration decision tree to assign R-strategies (Rehost/Replatform/Refactor/Retire/Retain/Relocate) and document rationale in Architecture Decision Records
• Build and maintain dependency maps using applications, resolving conflicting data between tooling output and application owner interviews
• Design wave plans: group applications by dependency, balance capacity, respect regulatory frozen zones, and coordinate across geographies
• Run Tech Bridge sessions with customer application owners to validate disposition decisions and unblock migration paths
• Feed wave planning into AWS Transform, ensuring move groups are sized, sequenced, and ready for factory execution
• Proactively identify and escalate risks to wave timelines — then propose and drive mitigations before they become blockers
• Collaborate with Security, Networking, and Replatform teams to ensure cross-cutting dependencies are addressed in wave sequencing

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 3+ years of external or internal customer-facing, complex and large-scale project delivery experience in migration programmes

- Experience with portfolio assessment and application disposition on large VMware estates (1,000+ servers)
- Experience with application discovery and dependency mapping tools (e.g., ModelizeIT, AWS Application Discovery Service, or equivalent)
- Experience with wave planning: dependency grouping, capacity balancing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Off-Search Online Sourcing team builds the real-time ad retrieval systems behind every Detail Page, Home Page, and non-Search surface on Amazon — searching hundreds of millions of ads in milliseconds using embedding models and approximate nearest neighbor indexes. You'll design and deliver the low-latency services, model serving infrastructure, and distributed indexing pipelines that determine which ads shoppers see, enriched with delivery speed, locality, and return signals so ads surface products that can reach customers quickly.

This is a team that ships fast — rapidly experimenting with new models, indexes, and signals in production through A/B experiments to grow both advertiser results and shopper engagement. You'll partner closely with applied scientists to bring new retrieval models from research into production, and use experimental results to decide what ships.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop high-throughput, low-latency services that retrieve and enrich ad candidates within strict latency budgets across Amazon's non-Search surfaces
- Build and scale model serving infrastructure for real-time embedding inference, partnering with applied scientists to bring new retrieval models into production
- Develop distributed indexing pipelines that build and refresh large approximate nearest neighbor search indexes across hundreds of millions of ads
- Deliver real-time fulfillment signals — delivery speed, locality, return eligibility — that improve ad filtering and ranking quality for shoppers
- Launch new retrieval models and indexes behind A/B experiments, analyze results, and use data to decide what ships to production
- Deliver features end to end — from design and code reviews through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and on-call operations
- Improve operational excellence through caching, graceful degradation, monitoring, and root-cause analysis
- Mentor peers through code and design reviews, helping raise the engineering quality bar across the team

A day in the life
On a typical day you might start by reviewing latency dashboards for your retrieval services, then dive into building a new distributed pipeline to refresh a nearest neighbor index. After lunch, you could be partnering with an applied scientist to integrate a new embedding model into the serving path, setting up the A/B experiment framework to measure its impact. Between coding sessions, you'll review pull requests, debug a latency regression, and check on the results of a running experiment to decide whether a new signal improves shopper engagement enough to ship.

About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry-leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace.

The Off-Search Online Sourcing team within SPB builds the real-time systems that choose which ads shoppers see on the Detail Page, Home Page, and other Amazon pages — searching hundreds of millions of ads in milliseconds using embedding models and approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and enriching every candidate with delivery speed, locality, and return signals so shoppers see ads for products that can reach them quickly.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building low-latency, high-throughput distributed services
- Experience with search or vector retrieval systems, such as Lucene, Elasticsearch or approximate nearest neighbor indexes
- Experience serving machine learning or generative AI models in production
- Experience with large-scale data processing, such as Spark
- Background in advertising technology, recommendation systems or e-commerce platforms

descriptionHtml:

Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. title: Manufacturing Engineer I - Launch Payload Processing Facility, LEO Satellite Processing Zone
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The success of Leo depends on the quality, reliability, cost, integration, throughput, and security of the products delivered. It is a fast-paced, dynamic environment. As part of the Leo team, you will support resolution of difficult problems that have high impact, and help create a brand new set of launch site processes and standards. To be successful you need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while maintaining the highest standards of execution.

The Manufacturing Engineer will lead a team of technicians through satellite offloading from shipping system, processing through the cleanroom, performing electrical test validation and battery charging, and other movements of the spacecraft. The satellite operations consist of using with tools and equipment like overhead cranes, forklifts, and hand tools. The electrical test consists of operating a power supply system, running scripts and commands, and reviewing data from the spacecraft.

The Manufacturing Engineer will author and update work instructions, ensure operations follow system and process requirements, identify and implement process controls, and drive continuous improvements and corrective actions. This individual with work closely with other Launch Operations teams and cross-functional organizations like engineering and quality.

The ideal candidate is comfortable in a highly technical, fast-paced, and collaborative setting ; is able to interpret technical requirements and turn them into actionable steps ; is knowledgeable with assembly and test of flight hardware.


Key job responsibilities
Planning material flow and implementing manufacturing processes for satellite handling and testing operations.

Adhere to safety requirements, standards and procedures in all work locations.

Receiving and test of fully built Leo satellites using various ground systems in a clean-room and Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) controlled environment.

Verify satellite health using computer-controlled equipment to command and monitor satellite telemetry.

Execute work assigned individually and/or with the team to meet production schedule.

Define rigging diagrams and lift operations and the process and validation of commissioning lift equipment.

Interface with cross-functional teams for payload processing facility commissioning and setup validation.

Evaluate and improve takt time of operations.
Author and implement work instructions and standard processes.

Resolve anomalies and implement corrective actions.

Responsible for maintenance and calibration of mechanical ground equipment and tooling.
Collaborate with leads, peers, and engineers to improve processes and activities.

Perform other duties, as assigned, to ensure an efficient, safe and effective work environment.
Able to obtain and maintain licenses, and/or certifications as required by job responsibilities (i.e. forklift, crane, electrical).

Able to use pallet jacks and forklifts for hardware movement.

Use precision calibrated tools – torque wrenches, micrometers, and calipers.

Use electrical test equipment tools -- multi-meters, breakout boxes, and harnesses.

Mentor new and junior team members.

Operations will occur primarily on first shift, Monday-Friday but off-shift and weekend work may be required depending on production/launch schedule.

Must be willing and able to perform extended travel up to 25% annually, either domestically or internationally as business needs demand.

A day in the life
The Manufacturing Engineer will spend majority of their day on the shop floor leading a team of technicians through satellite receiving and offload operations through electrical checkout and battery charging. They will work with other engineering, quality, and manufacturing teams to setup, operate, and maintain the electrical checkout equipment and the satellite receiving/offload mechanical ground equipment. They will lead root cause investigations and implement production controls and corrective actions. They will use engineering best practices in a safe, repeatable manner to increase operation efficiency and reduce non-conformances.

The Manufacturing Engineer will have experience in space hardware assembly, integration, and test, with a particular focus on mechanical handling and electrical test systems.

About the team
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences.

At Amazon, our mission is to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. We're dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

- • Able to obtain and maintain a US Passport & must meet customs entry requirements to include but not limited to: Yellow Fever vaccine and other immunization requirements as recommended by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

Preferred qualifications

title: Manager, Device Mgmt Team, Amazon Devices Beta Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Device Services & Operations organization is seeking a dynamic, results-oriented leader to manage the Device Management Team (DMT) — the team responsible for the complete prototype device lifecycle across all Amazon consumer device families. This is a high-impact, high-visibility operations leadership role that sits at the intersection of hardware development, supply chain logistics, and cross-functional program execution within one of the world’s most innovative consumer electronics organizations.

As DMT Manager, you will lead a globally distributed team of approximately 10 team members spanning three sites: Seattle (primary), Munich, and Chennai. Your team owns the end-to-end prototype device lifecycle — from procurement and inbound logistics through inventory management, allocation and distribution, beta program support, and device destruction. This lifecycle touches every Amazon device family, including Alexa, Fire TV, Tablet, Kindle E-reader, Ring, Blink, Eero, Leo (Project Kuiper), V-Care, and Smart Home products. The breadth of product lines and the global nature of operations create a uniquely challenging and rewarding management opportunity.

You will be responsible for managing a diverse team that includes Program Managers, Device Associates, and Administrative Support staff operating across multiple time zones (Pacific, Central European, and India Standard Time). Your direct reports include operations leads in each geography, a PVT Procurement and Budget lead, an Inbound Lead, Outbound Leads in both Seattle and Munich, and specialized roles in device flashing and customer returns. You will need to develop strong deputies in each location to ensure operational continuity during non-overlapping business hours, while fostering a cohesive team culture that transcends geographic boundaries.

The role carries significant stakeholder management responsibilities. You will interface regularly with product teams across Alexa, Fire TV, Ring/Blink, Tablet, E-reader, Leo, V-Care, and Smart Home — each with distinct working styles, escalation tendencies, and volume profiles. Beta program coordination is the most complex and escalation-prone workstream, requiring careful negotiation between product team timelines and DMT operational capacity. Allocations represent the highest throughput function, and managing competing priorities across product lines during peak season (typically April through September) demands sophisticated prioritization skills and the confidence to push back when necessary.

Operational reporting is a core element of this role. You will own the Weekly Business Review (WBR) cadence, ensuring timely and accurate reporting of operational metrics every Wednesday. You will also maintain a regular weekly reporting cadence with senior leadership. The ability to synthesize complex operational data into clear, actionable narratives for director-level and VP-level audiences is essential.

This role also includes ownership of several high-priority strategic initiatives. You will drive the DBS (Device Build System) integration — a platform dependency that underpins three of the team’s annual goals: increasing operations capacity, increasing PM capacity through global functional consolidation, and improving quality by reducing defects per thousand opportunities (DPTO). You will also oversee a VP-directed initiative to reduce PVT device ordering volumes and champion the KFlex integration pilot to modernize the team’s tooling and workflow automation.

Perhaps most critically, this role requires a people-first leader who can build team morale. The team is currently under significant workload pressure, and team members have historically struggled to set boundaries with stakeholders. You must create a culture where it is safe to push back, establish clear prioritization frameworks, and visibly advocate upward for headcount relief and process improvements. Protecting the team from unreasonable demands — while maintaining strong partnerships with product teams — is the defining leadership challenge of this position.

The ideal candidate brings experience managing geographically distributed operations teams in a fast-paced hardware or technology environment. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at managing competing priorities under resource constraints, and energized by the challenge of optimizing prototype logistics at global scale. Familiarity with device lifecycle management, prototype operations, or consumer electronics supply chain is strongly preferred.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and develop a globally distributed team of ~10 across Seattle, Munich, and Chennai, fostering a collaborative, resilient culture despite timezone challenges and high operational tempo.

Own the end-to-end prototype device lifecycle — procurement, inbound logistics, inventory management, allocation/distribution, beta program support, and destruction — across all Amazon device families.

Manage escalations and competing priorities across multiple product teams (Alexa, Fire TV, Ring/Blink, Tablet, Leo, and others), balancing urgency against team capacity with data-driven prioritization.

Drive the Weekly Business Review (WBR) process: ensure accurate, timely operational data and narrative reporting for director and VP-level leadership.

Own and advance strategic initiatives including DBS integration, KFlex pilot, global PM functional consolidation, and VP-directed PVT device ordering reduction.

Build capacity plans and workload models to anticipate peak-season surges (April–September) and advocate for staffing adjustments when operational demand exceeds capacity.

Coach team members on stakeholder management, process optimization, and career development — particularly strengthening the team’s ability to set boundaries and push back constructively on unreasonable timelines.

Establish and maintain strong cross-functional partnerships with product, engineering, logistics, and security teams while protecting the team from scope creep and last-minute demand spikes.

Champion continuous improvement by identifying automation opportunities, documenting tribal knowledge into SOPs, and cross-training team members to reduce single-points-of-failure.

A day in the life
Your morning starts early — often by 6:30 AM PT when you are online for overlap with Munich and Chennai, reviewing overnight deployment updates and triaging any escalations that came in across time zones. By 8:00 AM you are leading the global team sync (Tuesdays) or reviewing WBR data (Wednesdays), ensuring operational metrics are accurate before they reach senior leadership.

Mid-morning shifts to stakeholder engagement: a product team has moved up an in-hand date for a beta deployment, another needs expedited allocations for a launch milestone. You negotiate trade-offs, re-sequence the queue, and coach your team on when to absorb the request and when to push back. The afternoon brings 1:1s with your reports, where you discuss career growth alongside operational blockers. Between meetings, you check on the KFlex pilot, review a hire requisition for a critical backfill, and Slack your manager a status update. No two days are identical — but the pace is always high.

About the team
The Device Management Team (DMT) operates within the Beta organization under Amazon’s DevicesTech division. DMT is the operational backbone of prototype device management — every device that moves through the pre-launch pipeline passes through this team’s hands.

With team members across Seattle, Munich, and Chennai, DMT supports all Amazon device families including Alexa, Fire TV, Kindle, Ring, Blink, Eero, and emerging programs like Project Kuiper (Leo). The team prides itself on a collaborative, roll-up-your-sleeves culture where everyone supports each other across functions and geographies. It is a team that consistently delivers under pressure and takes genuine pride in its work — and it deserves a leader who will invest in its people as much as its processes.

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

title: ACM Consultant (S), US Accommodations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.

We are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best-in-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability & Leave Services Team.

The ACM Consultant provides case management for all types of accommodation request related to life events. The ACM Consultant is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.

Key job responsibilities
This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.

Essential Responsibilities:

• Initiate and respond to inquiries about accommodation events, benefits, and options available to employees

• Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation in compliance with the corresponding, federal and state laws and policy as defined by Amazon

• Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of aan accommodation as appropriate

• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs

• Address and respond to sensitive situations

• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event

• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs

• Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information

• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work

• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing

• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy

• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate

• Other duties as assigned
