- Demonstrated ownership of multi-year planning cycles and executive rhythm-of-business documents (narratives, reviews, reporting) for senior leadership.experience operating at organization or multi-team scope.

- Familiarity with Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering) systems and tooling (APM, Compass, QuickSight, Quick Suite Spaces) and with metric-definition / data-governance work.

title: Controls Engineer, Amazon Leo Optical Inter-Satellite Link
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are looking for a PAT Engineer to assist in the development, testing, and validation of pointing, acquisition, and tracking (PAT) systems for free-space optical links across the Amazon LEO satellite constellation. This role blends electrical engineering, opto-mechatronics, and controls knowledge to support the PAT team across FPGA verification, hardware integration and testing, and model-based design. You will work closely with senior PAT engineers to execute test campaigns, maintain verification infrastructure, and help bridge the gap between algorithm models and hardware implementations.

This is an on-site role. The position sits within the OISL Electrical Engineering team, with workload focused on PAT/controls activities directed by the senior PAT engineer and also supporting the EE team on production RCAs, trade studies, and board-level design and bring-up. The split is flexible based on program phase and candidate strengths.
Day to day, you will work alongside senior PAT engineers and EE team members, contributing across multiple workstreams. A controls-focused background is ideal, with supporting knowledge in electrical engineering, mechanical systems, optics, or aerospace. The role requires comfort moving between flight data analysis, simulation, test infrastructure, and hardware debug depending on program needs. Flexible hours may be needed during test campaigns, and occasional travel to integration/testing facilities is required.

Over time, there is opportunity to grow ownership of specific PAT subsystems and take on more independent technical leadership within the PAT and EE domains.

Key job responsibilities
Flight Data Analysis & Simulation Correlation
• Analyze flight telemetry data and compare against simulation predictions — identify discrepancies, characterize on-orbit behavior, and support anomaly investigations
• Run and maintain simulation environments to reproduce flight scenarios and validate model fidelity against observed data
• Help narrow down root causes by correlating flight data trends with known model behaviors and hardware characteristics
Production Failure Support & RCA
• Support production and on-orbit failure investigations — review data, identify patterns, and help narrow down failure modes
• Assist with electrical RCAs and help debug board-level issues
• Contribute to failure analysis reports and corrective action documentation
• Support production ramp activities requiring EE analysis and hardware troubleshooting

FPGA Verification & Test Vector Development
• Develop and maintain test vectors to verify PAT FPGA implementations against Simulink reference models
• Run bit-accurate simulations, compare outputs, and flag discrepancies between model and FPGA behavior
• Work with existing models of PAT control loops and state machines — run simulations, generate test cases, and validate behavior
• Support model-in-the-loop (MIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) verification activities
Electrical Engineering Support
• Contribute to trade studies for data converter selection and signal chain architecture
• Support board-level testing, characterization, and troubleshooting for analog and mixed-signal circuits
• Assist with electrical design reviews
• Support production ramps and RCAs from an electrical and controls perspective

Documentation & Configuration Management
• Document test procedures, results, RCA findings, and discrepancy investigations clearly
• Help maintain version-controlled models, scripts, and test artifacts
• Contribute to test reports, review materials, and configuration management records

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 3+ years experience in a hardware-adjacent controls, test, or systems engineering role
- MATLAB/Simulink proficiency — comfortable running models, interpreting results, building test cases, and debugging issues
- Experience with reading schematics and understanding digital/analog signal interfaces
- Experience with control system fundamentals — feedback loops, transfer functions, stability concepts
- Experience with working across disciplines — comfortable interfacing with EE, FPGA, and mechanical teams
- Experience analyzing test or flight data to identify trends, anomalies, and correlations

Preferred qualifications

- Data converter (ADC/DAC) electrical characteristics, architectures, and design tradeoffs (SNR, ENOB, linearity, settling time), including basic understanding of sampling theory, decimation/interpolation filters, and anti-aliasing as they relate to converter performance in closed-loop control systems
- Analog and mixed-signal board-level design and troubleshooting best practices (power integrity, signal integrity, grounding)
- Experience with production hardware debug and root cause analysis
- Low-noise design techniques (grounding, shielding, power supply filtering)
- Filter design basics (active/passive, analog/digital)
- Digital interface protocols (SPI, I2C, LVDS, CAN, Ethernet) and use cases
- Basic programming experience (Python, C, or scripting for test automation)
- Awareness of radiation effects (SEU, TID) on semiconductor devices
- Thermal considerations for space-qualified electronics
- Experience in aerospace or defense environments
- MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Git, lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, signal generators, spectrum analyzers), FPGA tools (Vivado/ModelSim), real-time platforms (Speedgoat/dSPACE), schematic capture and PCB CAD tools

title: Senior BIE, Business Intelligence & Analytics (BIA)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to drive the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation in analytics, powering executive-level decision making for AWS Platform Experience (PLEX).

The Platform Experience Business Intelligence & Analytics (PLEX BIA) team serves as the central hub for transforming the data into trusted business insights. We build and manage scalable analytics infrastructure, standardized metrics, dashboards, and automated reporting that support decision-making across Billing, Fraud Prevention, Payment and Order to Cash systems. We've already shown that governed, AI-powered self-service analytics works: our generative AI insights agent answers business questions for hundreds of users and has saved thousands of hours of manual work. Our next goal is to go from answering questions to investigating them. That means proactive, agent-driven analytics that explain why a metric moved and what to do about it.

As a Senior BIE, you'll be a technical leader for that work. You'll own end-to-end Business Intelligence (BI) solutions in complex, ambiguous areas, set the engineering standards others follow, and work with Data Engineers, Applied Scientists, Finance and business leaders. You'll turn open-ended questions into insight leaders can trust and act on, and your work will directly shape decisions in Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and revenue assurance.

Key job responsibilities
Architecture: Own the technical roadmap for the team's analytics stack, including data models, semantic layers, governance controls, and the integration patterns that let AI agents use our data reliably.
AI-powered analytics: Design and build products for root-cause investigation, anomaly detection and proactive insights, using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agent frameworks.
Metric governance: Define and enforce governance for S-team/AWS Goal business metrics, covering definitions, lineage, freshness and validation. Evaluate AI-generated outputs so answers stay accurate, auditable and trusted by Finance.
Automation: Replace manual Key Performance Indicator (KPI) decks and recurring reports with self-service and agent-generated insights.
Technical judgment: Review data designs for quality, scalability, latency, security and performance. Make high-impact calls on data modeling, build-vs-buy, legacy migrations, and cost/performance across Amazon Redshift, Athena and related services.
Statistical rigor: Define, calibrate and monitor KPIs with statistical methods, including alarms based on historical variance and experiments that measure business impact.
Communication: Write design docs and narratives that align senior stakeholders, and explain capabilities, limitations and trade-offs in business terms.
Raising the bar: Mentor BIEs, provide technical assessments for promotions, take part in hiring, and drive best practices across the organization: code reviews, naming conventions, metric definitions and operational excellence.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of professional or military experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
- 8+ years of SQL experience
- 8+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
- 8+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
- 8+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
- Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with AWS technologies
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
- Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining
- Experience working as a BIE in a technology company

title: Engineering Operation Technician, Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

We are seeking experienced Engineering Operations Technicians to join our data center operations team, specifically focusing on liquid cooling infrastructure and water distribution systems. This role is vital in maintaining the continuous operation of our advanced cooling systems that support critical data center operations.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety, and cooling equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor and operate mission critical liquid cooling infrastructure
• Conduct glycol concentration testing and adjustments
• Operate and maintain water distribution systems, including water chemistry, pumps and piping networks
• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of liquid cooling systems
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts are usually 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined day, mid, or night schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations. Must be flexible on work schedule and willing to work holidays and weekends, as needed
• Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

title: Sr Production TPM, AMZ Leo Production Ops
descriptionHtml:
Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
To deliver these complex solutions, as the Sr Operations Program Manager you will partner with peers across all Leo teams, including hardware, software, supply chain, manufacturing, launch, facilities, finance, compliance, and HR.

This role includes direct responsibility for program management of system level development, integration, and test of production value stream. This is a highly technical role requiring experience with data analytics, data modeling, integrated hardware and software as well as some appreciation for complex applications and manufacturing systems.

Candidate superpowers should include ownership, insist on high standards, stakeholder management, influencing without authority, innovation, creating clarity out of ambiguity, and enabling productive collaboration.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the production roadmap for production value streams that delivers the end-to-end solutions necessary to source, build, test and integrate satellites.
- Establish the linkage between production roadmap and annual goals & objectives, creating data models, owning tools and mechanisms to measure, monitor and optimize these value streams.
- Drive daily execution working across supply chain, planning, fulfillment and production teams.
- Represent the overall production roadmap in assessing technical trades related to innovation, speed, manufacturability, cost, stability and trust.
- Translate strategic goals into actionable plans for specific projects and operations.
- Understand dependencies between roadmap projects, synchronize milestones, identify constraints and dive deep where necessary to unblock and deliver the roadmap.
- Create new tools and business processes that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence across the entire production value stream.
- Develop and own operational rhythms for all of production operations teams
- Identify potential risks in manufacturing processes and develop mitigation strategies and recovery plans.
- Execute a strategic plan that defines how teams will deliver on forward looking production plans.
- Support the development and execution of Production Rate Ramp roadmaps.
- Partner with business teams on scalable, standardized approaches to meet their demand and enable growth.
- Drive the creation, documentation, and adoption of scalable, standardized, and highly visible processes across all supply chain, manufacturing and launch functions.
- Drive executive communication cadence and deliver artifacts that provide insight into the activities, accomplishments, challenges and risks of operations to senior leadership.
- Measure, analyze, improve, and control KPIs across all aspects of the operation.
- Work with software and analytics teams to develop reporting tools and applications that support, operating rhythms
- Analyze production data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
- Support implementation training on new processes or improvements identified through PDCA cycles
- Drive year over year optimization opportunities in all areas of operations, including manufacturing and sourcing.
- Provide feedback/escalate systemic concerns to tech teams regarding approaches that are cost-inefficient or detrimental to scaling.
- Advices production directors and sr. managers on technology and execution decisions.
- Unblocks production teams and increases the speed of delivery. Negotiates resources and priorities across different technology stakeholders.
- Create new tools and business processes that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence across the entire production value stream.
- Ensure effective communication of changes and improvements across the organization.
- Perform internal audits to assess adherence to procedures, systems and standards.



A day in the life
This role will be highly collaborative, requiring partnerships with cross-functional production stakeholders to drive positive results. This role requires the ability to advocate on behalf of our customers (internal and external) and an ability to push back without being adversarial.

This role will be supporting production of satellite operations across our facilities in Redmond and Kirkland, WA. A typical day for this role will be working directly with production teams and value stream owners on plan execution and check process adherence. Throughout the day, an Sr. Operations TPM for satellite manufacturing must balance strategic planning with hands-on oversight of project execution. Communication skills are crucial, as they interact with various stakeholders including customers, suppliers, and internal teams. The role requires strong leadership to motivate and coordinate teams towards achieving project goals while maintaining a focus on quality, efficiency, and adherence to timelines.

Overall, the role demands strategic thinking, effective leadership, and meticulous oversight to drive satellite manufacturing projects forward successfully. This role will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.

About the team
Project Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. To deliver these complex solutions, as the Senior Technical Program Manager you will partner with peers across all Leo teams, including hardware, software, supply chain, manufacturing, launch, facilities, finance, compliance, and HR.

This role includes direct responsibility for program management of planning, manufacturing, integration, and test of production value stream. This is a highly technical role requiring experience with integrated hardware and software as well as some appreciation for complex applications and manufacturing systems. Candidate superpowers should include bias for action, ownership, insist on high standards, stakeholder management, innovation, creating clarity out of ambiguity, and enabling productive collaboration across different organization.

- Experience in manufacturing, process, or industrial engineering
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 3+ years of analytical, quantitative, communication, and presentations experience
- 4+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience in program or project management including the delivery of cross-functional projects
- Experience with Lean/Six Sigma

title: Senior SerDes Characterization Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, designs and delivers high-end, custom silicon that sits at the very heart of AWS. Our devices don't just support the cloud — they actively define it. From Trainium, the purpose-built machine learning accelerator driving the next wave of AI innovation, to Graviton, the Arm-based server processor redefining price-performance for compute workloads, to Nitro, the advanced network and cloud management controller that powers every AWS instance — Annapurna's products consistently set the standard for the entire industry.
This is an exciting opportunity to join Amazon in developing the next generation of cloud products, in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment.
We are hiring a Senior SerDes Characterization Engineer to join the Signal Integrity and Packaging (SiP) group at Amazon's Annapurna Labs. This is a hands-on technical position for an experienced lab engineer who will lead characterization efforts for high-speed serial protocols in advanced semiconductor platforms.
You will design and execute comprehensive lab characterization campaigns, troubleshoot complex signal integrity issues, and drive data-driven optimization across PCIe, Ethernet, and other industry-standard serial interfaces. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong hardware debugging skills, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional design and validation teams.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead SerDes characterization campaigns for PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, and other serial protocols on advanced silicon and package platforms
- Design comprehensive test plans covering eye diagrams, bathtubs, jitter analysis and protocol compliance
- Operate and troubleshoot industry-standard lab equipment: oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers and VNAs
- Analyze complex waveform and signal data; identify root causes of performance issues and signal integrity problems
- Collaborate with design teams to validate silicon behavior, debug hardware anomalies, and optimize link margins
- Develop characterization scripts and measurement techniques to improve efficiency and repeatability
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to hardware design reviews from a characterization perspective
- Document findings and present technical results to stakeholders and leadership


A day in the life
As a Senior SerDes Characterization Engineer, you will own the lab characterization and validation of high-speed serial interfaces — from test plan definition and bench setup through silicon and board bring-up, link debug. You will work hands-on with oscilloscopes, VNAs and other test equipment.
You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including board design, packaging, ASIC, and firmware teams, to isolate link failures to their true source and drive them to closure. In addition, you will serve as the technical focal point for characterization on your projects — defining measurement methodology, making the judgement calls on what a marginal eye means, and setting the standard for how link margin is proven before silicon ships.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of hands-on lab characterization experience with SerDes protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, or equivalent high-speed serial interfaces)
- Expert-level proficiency with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers and VNAs
- Deep understanding of signal integrity, jitter, eye diagrams, and link budget analysis
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in hardware bring-up and platform validation
- Experience with protocol compliance testing and standards (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, or similar)
- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent field with substantial lab experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience characterizing multiple SerDes protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe)
- Familiarity with high-speed package design, signal routing, and layout considerations

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switchgears, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems. They provide 24/7 shift coverage which could include 12 hour shifts, rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day work weeks.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center
- Troubleshoot of facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs
- Perform limited maintenance tasks to including filter changes, HVAC PMs, rack power installs, rack PDU, and rack ATS replacements
- Provide support to Data Center Operations technicians
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Work a 12 hour shift (rotating 3 and 4 day work weeks days or nights)
- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)
- Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows and spare part inventory
- Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance
- Respond to off hour emergency calls per on call rotation for any one of the region’s sites
- Fully comply with all physical security procedures and policies
- Drive innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities
- Manipulate small wires and objects
Perform the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more
- Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in noisy environments

A day in the life
After an initial training period, you will support data center infrastructure operations on a shift schedule supporting our 24/7 staffing model. title: GTM AWS Edge Services, AWS WWSO Edge
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a marketing-minded Senior Go-to-Market (GTM) Specialist to join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Edge team. In this role you will own the content and enablement engine behind the AWS Edge Services portfolio translating complex technical capabilities into compelling, customer-ready narratives, campaigns, and sales assets that accelerate pipeline and adoption worldwide.

This is a highly cross-functional, builder-oriented role for someone who thrives at the intersection of marketing, sales enablement, and product. You will create and maintain the GTM content library, support demand-generation and social campaigns, and equip the global field (Account Teams, Specialists, and Partners) with the messaging, playbooks, and tools they need to win. You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Service teams, field sales, and events to ensure a consistent, high-quality story across every customer touchpoint.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who writes exceptionally well, moves fast, measures impact, and is comfortable operating with ambiguity in a rapidly evolving technology space. You are equally comfortable drafting a solution brief, briefing a field seller, and partnering with social and demand-gen teams to amplify a launch.

Key job responsibilities
Content Creation & Maintenance:

Collaborate with marketing, service team. Create, own, and continuously maintain the Edge GTM content library solution briefs, pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQs, battlecards, customer-facing narratives, and web content across the full Edge portfolio.

Translate technical service capabilities and launches into clear, benefit-led messaging tailored to Technical Decision Makers, Builders, and Business Leaders.

Establish a single source of truth for GTM assets, retiring stale content and keeping messaging current with product roadmap, pricing, and competitive changes.

Campaign Support/Demand Generation:

Develop campaign content, messaging frameworks, and creative assets that drive awareness, pipeline, and adoption.

Support integrated campaigns tied to launches and sales motions. Contributing outreach, copy/messaging, and nurture assets, and helping measure performance.

Apply a data-driven lens: track engagement, share of voice, and campaign outputs, and iterate messaging based on results.

Field & Partner Enablement:

Design and deliver enablement programs, playbooks, and training that equip the global field (Account Teams, Specialists, SAs) and partners to position and sell Edge services with confidence.

Support and maintain sales plays and GTM narratives that connect customer problems to Edge solutions and clear next steps.

Act as a connective tissue between Product Marketing, service teams, and the field gathering feedback and closing content and enablement gaps.

About the team
The WWSO Edge GTM team drives the worldwide go-to-market strategy for the AWS Edge Services portfolio, spanning two major pillars:

Protected Perimeter: Amazon CloudFront (content delivery), AWS WAF, AWS Shield, and related edge security and networking services that keep customer applications fast, available, and secure at global scale.

Streaming Media: The AWS Elemental Media Services portfolio (live and on-demand video processing, packaging, ad insertion and delivery) powering broadcast and streaming experiences for the world’s largest media and entertainment customers as well as IVS, a near-real time interactive video service platform.

As part of WWSO, this team sits at the center of AWS’s specialist sales motion working across field sales, Product Marketing, service product teams, and partners to build and scale repeatable GTM motions, sales plays, and enablement programs that grow the Edge business.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- 5+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Knowledge of publisher ad tech stacks and/or advertising technology
- Experience leading complex, multi-year initiatives that may be cross-functional and/or span business and technology

Preferred qualifications

- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams
- Experience using analytical tools for workforce metrics and reporting

title: Night Shift Data Center Facility Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: Associate Corporate Counsel, AWS Legal
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Legal Department is looking for a talented technology lawyer to support Amazon Web Services (AWS) in selling to commercial and public sector customers throughout the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region, with a primary focus on supporting AWS sales in Switzerland, Austria, and Germany. AWS is at the forefront of the cloud computing industry, providing AI and IT infrastructure services, such as on-demand compute capacity, storage, content delivery, database services, and more to private and public sector customers.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for drafting, negotiating, and advising on strategic technology service agreements with enterprise customers, public sector customers, and partners, as well as providing legal support for local and regional services and initiatives. The role will also involve ongoing legal counsel and regulatory interpretation and guidance for senior executives and other business and legal team members on a variety of product development, operational, security, compliance, data protection and public policy matters. The role includes participating in other legal team projects, including managing legal issues that arise in existing relationships and handling customer and business partner inquiries.

We are looking for a candidate who is proactive, entrepreneurial, enjoys being challenged, has strong technology and communication skills, and demonstrates sound, pragmatic judgment in ambiguous situations.

This position is based in Zurich, Switzerland. Some regional and international travel will be required.

- Previous work experience in a law firm, government, or in-house at a technology company.
- Transactional experience, including drafting and negotiating commercial contracts.
- Professional fluency in English and German, written and spoken.
- Excellent communication, drafting and negotiation skills.

Preferred qualifications

- Professional fluency in additional languages, especially French.
- Familiarity with cloud computing, IT infrastructure and telecommunications policies, laws, and regulations.
- Familiarity with AI tools and capabilities
- Experience with IT transactions, including services agreements.
- Experience supporting Swiss government/public sector procurement.
- Experience engaging with policy makers, regulators, government contracting officials, system integrators, prime contractors, subcontractors, and resellers.

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

Basic qualifications

-3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
-2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
-Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

-3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
-Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer - Security Automation, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. title: Senior Product Manager, Technical, Device Technologies
descriptionHtml:
Device Technologies (DT) provides the infrastructure that lets Amazon's operations teams provision, deploy, and manage the edge devices, robotics, and material-handling equipment they run on. We build the connectivity, observability, and scale underneath them, so builder teams can bring their hardware online and keep it running across Amazon's worldwide operations and the deliveries customers depend on. Our products are in use across fulfillment centers, sortation centers, delivery stations, and grocery sites. We're part of Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS), and we're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Technical to own a product in this portfolio and the customer experience that goes with it.

Our job is to make Amazon's frontline technology self-service and dependable. Operators should set up, recover, and manage their own devices without waiting on us, and a device that fails should be back at work in minutes. You'll set the strategy and roadmap for your area, decide which problems matter most, and work backward from the people who run our sites every day: process-path owners, application teams, and site operators. The work is technical and the stakes are operational — when there's a device issue on-site, packages stop moving.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for your product area, working backward from the needs of Amazon's operations customers and the economics of running a global fulfillment network.
- Partner with engineering and science teams to shape functional and non-functional requirements, make architecture trade-offs across reliability, scale, and cost, and hold a high bar for the quality of what ships.
- Move DT's core outcomes measurably forward: empowering builder teams to move fast on their own (self-service), returning devices to productive work quickly when they fail (availability), and lowering the cost to serve each site.
- Decide where AI, including agentic and generative capabilities, genuinely improves the product or the speed at which your team builds, and where it adds risk or complexity that isn't worth it.
- Define the metrics that tell you whether the product is working, instrument them, and use site-level data and operator feedback to decide what to build next.

A day in the life
No two days are the same, but most begin with data from the floor. You might start with overnight numbers from a site rollout: adoption, device health, ticket volume, and the questions they raise about what to prioritize next. By mid-morning you're in a design review, pushing engineering on whether a recovery flow holds up under the conditions of a live building. The afternoon is for writing: a PR/FAQ for a capability you want funded, or a document that works through a trade-off you need leadership to weigh in on. You end the day with your partners in operations and the application teams who build on DT, making sure what you're about to ship will land cleanly in the sites that depend on it.

title: Software Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line.

Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it.

What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience.

You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job.

Key job responsibilities
Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates.

Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities.

Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion.

Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them.

Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership.

Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises.

Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases.

A day in the life
Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1:1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates.

About the team

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AWS DC Central Operations
descriptionHtml:

The Central Infrastructure Analytics Team (CIAT) is the unified source for Infrastructure Operations data and business intelligence solutions across AWS's global data center fleet. We support Central Operations leaders running rack install, decommission, repair, logistics, capacity optimization, and network operations.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to design and own customer-facing analytics products and to drive analytics adoption across our customer teams. You will partner with operations leaders to translate business questions into measurable KPIs, build dashboards and metric layers in QuickSight, and increasingly leverage GenAI tools — Amazon Q, natural language query interfaces, and retrieval-augmented analytics — to multiply your impact across thousands of users.

Successful BIEs on this team are customer-obsessed, comfortable with operational ambiguity, and equally interested in building great dashboards and in teaching customers to build their own. They write strong SQL, communicate clearly with non-technical leaders, and treat GenAI as a tool they actively use rather than a topic to read about.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain dashboards and analytical reporting solutions in QuickSight that support InfraOps decision-making
- Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate operational questions into KPIs, data products, and Weekly and Monthly Business Review (WBR/MBR) narratives
- Develop and present recommendations to senior leaders, including written narratives and verbal walk-throughs of insights
- Design Amazon Q topics and supporting datasets that enable customer analysts to self-serve on questions previously requiring a CIAT engagement
- Use CIAT's GenAI tools — Amazon Q, natural language query interfaces, and retrieval-augmented analytics — as a primary part of the job
- Contribute to CIAT's analytics enablement programs that train Central Ops analysts on BI tools, query platforms, and GenAI capabilities

A day in the life
Most days mix a few hours of focused build work — SQL development, dashboard iteration, metric validation — with stakeholder time. You might join a working session with a Logistics or Capacity Optimization team to walk through a metric definition, then sit with one of their analysts to review a query they wrote against CIAT's datalake. After lunch you might pair with a Data Engineer on the data model behind a new WBR metric, draft the narrative for that week's review, and review another BIE's pull request before logging off. On a different day, the focus is an Amazon Q topic for a domain that has been generating repeat ad-hoc requests — designing the supporting dataset, configuring synonyms, and testing answers against real questions customers have asked.

You will be in front of customers regularly — not constantly, but enough that you should enjoy that side of the work. The team partners closely with Data Engineers and Systems Development Engineers, so you will rarely be the only person on a problem.

CIAT gathers, transforms, and analyzes data for inventory, change-of-state, system health, safety, security, workload, and resource efficiency across AWS's global data center fleet. - 3+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience

title: InfraOps Support Engineer, Operations Management Center (OMC)
descriptionHtml:
The InfraOps Support Engineer is a Tier 1 support engineer in Amazon's Operations Management Center (OMC) - a 24/7/365 team that keeps the technology inside Amazon's 400+ corporate office buildings running across Networking, Audio-Visual (AV), and Print services. This engineer is the first line of response for office-infrastructure incidents.

Operating within the Amazon Support Engineer (SupEng) job family, the engineer provides high-quality support across all three service areas while beginning to develop deep subject-matter expertise in one or more focus areas, for which they become the technical point of contact on their team. They respond, triage and resolve incidents within target times using established procedures, detect trends before they become problems, contribute to and refine the team's operating procedures, and mentor more junior engineers. Success requires the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, shift-based environment.

Key job responsibilities
On a typical shift, an InfraOps Support Engineer will:

1. Monitor, Detect & Triage

Be the first line of response and keep ahead of problems.

Triage incoming incidents (tickets) within defined target response times, using judgment to resolve in place or route to the responsible team.

Use dashboards, alarms, and other tools for Networking, AV, and Print services across the global building fleet, interpreting what those signals indicate to solve incidents.

Detect ongoing trends or emerging problems before they occur and define proactive actions to prevent customer impact.

Assess incident scope and severity, correlate related incidents into a single parent incident, and prioritise work against SLAs.

2. Troubleshoot & Support

Resolve issues and support the team's products and systems.

Provide high-quality Tier 1 support for the products and systems in the team's scope, resolving straightforward problems with limited documentation and minimal escalation.

Support critical issues using existing runbooks; maintain composure through difficult interactions until the issue is resolved.

Perform on-call duties on a rotating schedule and respond to emergent events.

Escalate appropriately when resolution requires significant deviation from procedure or when an issue becomes a risk.

3. Subject-Matter Expertise & Technical Leadership

Grow into the go-to person for a focus area.

Develop and apply expertise in one or more focus areas (e.g., Networking, AV, or Print), acting as the technical point of contact for that area within the team.

Give technical direction to others and impart knowledge to users, customers, and teammates.

Lead internal team projects and deliver on defined goals and timelines.

4. Documentation & Operational Improvement

Improve how the team operates.

Identify areas to improve support documentation and processes, and author new runbooks/SOPs and knowledge-base articles where gaps exist.

Identify improvements to existing and new support tools that increase operational efficiency, and help drive their implementation.

Help develop and refine the operational policies and procedures used by the team.

5. Mentoring & Collaboration

Raise the bar for the team.

Serve as a mentor to junior engineers and act as a training buddy for new hires; may assist in hiring activities.

Maintain good working relationships across Amazon and work cross-functionally with partner teams to solve problems and improve processes.

Communicate infrastructure health and trends clearly, both in real time and as inputs to weekly/monthly business reviews.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in software development, or experience in technical support
- Experience scripting in modern program languages
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience scripting in modern programming languages

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
- Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID
- Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON

descriptionHtml:

We deliver billions of ad impressions and process massive volumes of advertiser data every single day. You'll work with us to pioneer breakthrough approaches in how AI agents access and reason over real-time advertiser data at scale.

The Campaign Management team is responsible for capturing inputs for advertisers to control their advertising efforts. You can think of our team as the brain and nervous system of all the advertisements you see on amazon.com. We build large scale, high velocity distributed systems to service 100’s of millions of API requests per day, steam data at PB scale, process business logic on tight latency budgets, all while streaming and the data at high fidelity to 20+ other services to perform other critical advertising functions. We stand up world class CI/CD pipelines to deploy our service automating infrastructure provisioning, high volume load testing and first-rate monitoring so our engineers can keep their heads down inventing for our advertisers. Our team uses the latest AWS products and services to solve our problems including but not limited to: ECS, Fargate, EC2, EMR, Lambda, Kafka, Elastic Search, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, Cloud watch, CDK, Cloud Formation and many more.

We are using generative AI and agentic systems to help advertising agents provide instant, strategic advice to millions of advertisers. You'll create feedback loops to ensure our solutions are constantly evaluating themselves and improving.

title: Sr. Applied Scientist - CV, Vulcan Stow
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to create the greatest-possible worldwide impact in Robotics? Amazon has the world's most exciting treasure trove of robotics challenges. At Amazon Robotics we build high-performance, real-time robotic systems that can perceive, learn, and act intelligently alongside humans—at Amazon scale. Amazon Robotics invents and scales AI systems for robotics in fulfillment. Our mission is to enable robots to interact safely, efficiently, and fluently high density real-world fulfillment centers. Our AI solutions enable robots to learn from their own experiences, from each other, and from humans to build intelligence that feeds itself.

We hire and develop subject matter experts in AI with a focus on 3D perception, computer vision, deep learning, and generative modeling. We target high-impact algorithmic unlocks in areas such as 3D scene understanding and completion, semantic occupancy prediction, multi-view 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, shape completion, and real-time inference - all of which have high-value impact for our current and future fulfillment networks.

We are seeking an passionate, hands-on, seasoned Senior Applied Scientist who will be deep in code and algorithms; who is technically strong in building scalable 3D perception systems across semantic scene completion, encoder-decoder and transformer architectures (e.g., VoxFormer, MonoScene), voxelized occupancy prediction, panoptic and instance segmentation, depth estimation, point cloud processing, and multi-view fusion. As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will contribute to the research and development of advanced 3D perception pipelines that enable robots to reason about occluded and partially observed environments; your work along with other top-notch scientists and engineers will deliver the world's most scalable and robust robotic perception systems. You will drive ideas to products using paradigms such as 3D generative models, query-based transformers, masked autoencoder-style completion, and scalable pseudo-ground-truth data generation.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will also help lead and mentor our team of applied scientists and engineers. You will take on challenging perception problems - such as completing 3D bin scenes from partial observations, integrating multi-camera inputs, and optimizing inference latency for edge deployment - distill requirements, and then deliver solutions that either leverage existing academic and industrial research or utilize your own out-of-the-box but pragmatic thinking. In addition to coming up with novel solutions and prototypes, you will directly contribute to implementation while you lead. A successful candidate has excellent technical depth in 3D computer vision, scientific vision, project management skills, great communication skills, and a drive to achieve results in a collaborative team environment.

You should enjoy the process of solving real-world problems that, quite frankly, haven't been solved at scale anywhere before. Along the way, we guarantee you'll get opportunities to be a disruptor, prolific innovator, and a reputed problem solver—someone who truly enables AI and robotics to significantly impact the lives of millions of consumers.


Key job responsibilities
Architect, design, and implement 3D perception models - including encoder-decoder networks, query-based transformers, and generative architectures- for semantic occupancy prediction and scene completion on robotic platforms.

Own the end-to-end model lifecycle: develop scalable training pipelines, optimize inference latency for ARM-based edge processors, and deploy production models that meet real-time performance targets.
Design and scale pseudo-ground-truth data generation pipelines - both heuristic-based and learning-based (e.g., SAM3D, shape completion) to produce curated training samples using SageMaker infrastructure.
Drive multi-view perception integration by fusing multiple view camera inputs for robust 3D reconstruction in partially observed and occluded bin environments.

Influence the team's technical strategy and contribute to the long-term vision and roadmap for 3D perception in fulfillment robotics.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, science, and operations teams to define requirements, iterate on system design, and deliver end-to-end solutions from research prototype to production deployment.

Maintain high standards by participating in design and code reviews, designing for fault tolerance and operational excellence, and creating mechanisms for continuous improvement.
Prototype and validate concepts through simulation, synthetic data evaluation, and live robotic workcell testing using 3D metrics (mIoU, IoU) and affordance-based evaluation frameworks.

Mentor applied scientists and engineers, raise the technical bar, and foster a culture of scientific rigor and rapid experimentation.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

title: Senior Acoustic Engineer , Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Acoustic Engineer to lead the design, integration, and validation of acoustic and audio subsystems for robots. You will own the full acoustic architecture from early-stage prototyping through production spanning microphone arrays, speaker systems, noise management, and electromechanical acoustic interaction. This role requires deep expertise in electroacoustic transducer design, acoustic measurement, and hands-on hardware development in a fast-paced R&D environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Architect and own the acoustic subsystem design for robotic platforms, including microphone arrays, speaker modules, and noise isolation strategies for mechanically dynamic environments

- Serve as the subject-matter expert on acoustics and audio signal processing, providing technical guidance across hardware, embedded software, mechanical, and systems engineering teams

- Research, specify, and characterize electroacoustic components (microphones, speakers, receivers) for integration into robotic form factors with unique mechanical and thermal constraints

- Develop and validate acoustic measurement methodologies, test fixtures, and quality assurance processes for low-volume and prototype production

- Design and execute acoustic simulations (e.g., COMSOL Multiphysics) to guide enclosure design, transducer placement, and noise mitigation strategies

- Drive acoustic performance from concept through prototype builds and production ramp, including root cause analysis and troubleshooting of acoustic anomalies in electromechanical systems

- Collaborate cross-functionally with robotics engineers, mechanical designers, embedded software teams, and external research partners

- Manage relationships with acoustic component vendors and external consultants, defining specifications and integrating third-party inputs into programs

- Author technical documentation, SOPs, and test specifications for acoustic validation and production test

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with at least one of the following: Matlab, R, Python, Stata
- Experience in embedded development in C/C++, or experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 7+ years of experience in acoustic design, validation, and integration for hardware products or electromechanical systems
- Proficiency in acoustic measurement tools such as SoundCheck, Audio Precision, or equivalent platforms
- Experience with microphone and speaker selection, characterization, and integration into space-constrained, mechanically complex enclosures
- Deep acoustic and signal-processing fundamentals: transducer physics, enclosure acoustics, digital signal processing, and filter design
- Hands-on prototype development, hardware bring-up of audio subsystems, and iterative design cycles from concept through production
- Practical knowledge of test system design, including acoustic test fixture development, production test plans, and test-to-spec validation
- Experience with acoustic simulation tools (e.g., COMSOL Multiphysics) for transducer and enclosure modeling
- Proven ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams, including international manufacturing and vendor partners
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (Acoustics specialization), Audio Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience with acoustic design in robotics, automotive, aerospace, or other electromechanical platforms with significant self-generated noise
- Familiarity with beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, spatial audio, or loudspeaker array design
- Experience with noise isolation and vibration management strategies for acoustic subsystems in mechanically active environments
- Experience designing acoustic systems for low-volume or prototype production environments rather than high-volume consumer manufacturing

descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

 In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

 The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes.

 You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.



Key job responsibilities
- Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and making high-judgment decisions that align with policy intent while minimizing risk. Establish and implement mechanisms that ensure consistent, fair application of policies while maintaining compliance with evolving regulations.

- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict future challenges, and implement proactive solutions at the site level. Turn insights into practical initiatives that drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance.

- Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs. Maintain meaningful floor presence to gather insights, identify early signs of disengagement, and partner with leaders to drive targeted improvements.

- Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and complex employee relations matters. Support leaders in building inclusive, high-performing teams.

You'll build strong partnerships across all levels of the organization while contributing to meaningful workplace improvements.

 Success in this role comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations.
