title: Senior Supply Chain Manager, Technology Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Tech-SC keeps Amazon's technology infrastructure running, ready, and cost-efficient across the full asset lifecycle. We are looking for a Supply Chain Manager III to build the economic model that proves it.

You will design and own the model that quantifies the value Tech-SC delivers that a third party can't match: uptime, readiness, and capital efficiency. You will turn "what is this worth to Amazon" into a defensible number leadership and partner business units rely on to make sourcing and investment decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and model the Tech-SC supply chain: determine what connections should exist and how capital and capacity are assigned across business units, rather than operating within the chain.
- Own fully-loaded cost-to-serve allocation to the customer grain, with transparent, defensible assumptions.
- Agree baselines and attribution rules with partner business-unit finance teams, then report value enabled versus value realized so the numbers reconcile to their books.
- Build the comparison that answers "why Tech-SC", grounded in incentive and capability, not per-unit price alone.
- Translate the model into clear narratives and the few numbers that drive leadership decisions, working from strategy set with your manager and director.
- Partner across finance, planning, and customer organizations to source the data the model depends on.

A day in the life
You move between building and defending numbers. A morning might be spent pulling cost and demand data with a planning partner and pressure-testing a cost-to-serve allocation; an afternoon translating that into a one-page value story for a business-unit review. You work closely with finance partners to align baselines, with supply chain planners on capacity and positioning, and with your leadership to shape strategy. You reason about trade-offs first and allocate costs second. Your output is the analytical backbone the organization uses to decide where Tech-SC competes and how it proves its value.

About the team
Technology Supply Chain (Tech-SC) provides full-lifecycle, global technology fulfillment for Amazon's Stores and AWS data centers: planning, sourcing, assembly, configuration, distribution, repair, and asset management. We combine owned Rapid Asset Deployment facilities, integrated technology platforms, and deep lifecycle expertise to deliver speed, cost, and quality that fragmented external providers can't. Our Program Enablement team builds the mechanisms, models, and standards that let the broader organization operate and scale. We value clear writing, defensible analysis, and intellectual honesty about what we know and what we don't.

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.  Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.  Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

title: Supply Planning Manager, Technology Materials Planning
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's technology supply chain supports a complex and rapidly evolving portfolio of infrastructure, end-user equipment, and technology products across thousands of locations globally. As the business scales, disciplined and responsive supply planning is critical to ensuring material availability, managing inventory investment, optimizing procurement execution, enabling network efficiency, and delivering predictable outcomes for customers.

We are seeking a Manager, Supply Planning to lead the supply planning capability within Supply Chain Planning. This leader will manage a team responsible for developing and continuously improving supply plans across the existing customer business segments, while establishing scalable mechanisms that can support new businesses, products, and fulfillment models.

The successful candidate will build a supply planning organization that combines strong planning fundamentals with data, technology, and automation. This includes improving material requirement plan quality, integrating demand signals with supply constraints and lead times, optimizing network topology through hub-and-spoke and regional distribution strategies, identifying structural sources of supply risk and excess inventory, and partnering with Product, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to reduce manual planning activity and enable increasingly intelligent supply planning capabilities.

The ideal candidate combines strong supply chain expertise, analytical depth, customer orientation, business judgment, and people leadership. They must be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating incomplete or conflicting signals, and influencing stakeholders across Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, Operations, Procurement, and customer organizations.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for supply planning across Launch, KTLO, and Programs.
• Own the end-to-end supply planning mechanism, including material requirement plan (MRP) creation and execution, order management, inventory performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
• Translate demand plans, supply constraints, lead times, funding availability, and inventory positions into executable material requirement plans at the appropriate product, geographic, and time horizons.
• Establish clear accountability for supply inputs and challenge assumptions, overrides, and changes that are not supported by measurable business signals or supply data.
• Define and improve supply availability, inventory health, Days of Cover, excess and obsolescence, order accuracy, and other metrics that distinguish true supply variability from process, data, and system defects.
• Lead capacity planning efforts to ensure supplier and network capacity aligns with demand forecasts, proactively identifying and mitigating capacity constraints across the planning horizon.
• Design and optimize hub-and-spoke distribution and network topology strategies to improve fulfillment speed, reduce transportation costs, and support regional inventory positioning across global sites.
• Partner with Demand Planning and Enterprise S&OP to incorporate demand uncertainty, quantify supply risks, and support scenario and trade-off decisions.
• Develop segmented planning approaches appropriate for different supply patterns, including new site launches, steady-state replenishment, and program-driven procurement, incorporating network optimization principles to determine optimal stocking locations and replenishment flows.
• Partner with Product, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to automate material requirement plan generation, order validation, exception management, and planner workflows.
• Advance the use of optimization models, machine learning, and AI to improve supply plan quality and reduce dependence on manual reconciliation and judgment.
• Simplify fragmented supply processes and data sources, with a long-term goal of connecting Planning more directly to real-time inventory positions, supplier capacity, network capacity utilization, and procurement execution.
• Build scalable mechanisms that support new products, businesses, regions, and planning paradigms without creating parallel planning processes.
• Communicate supply outlook, inventory risks, capacity constraints, network optimization opportunities, funding gaps, procurement constraints, and recommended actions clearly to senior stakeholders.


A day in the life
In this role, you may begin the day reviewing inventory positions and open order status with your team, determining whether a supply gap reflects a true constraint or a defect in the underlying data or process. You may evaluate hub capacity utilization and assess whether regional inventory positioning is aligned with current demand patterns.

You may work with Demand Planning to understand the implications of a forecast change on the material requirement plan, partner with Procurement to resolve a supplier lead time or capacity issue, or support Enterprise S&OP with scenarios where supply constraints, network bottlenecks, or funding gaps require a broader business decision.

You may also spend time with Product or Technology teams improving how material requirement plans are generated, automating a repetitive planner workflow, optimizing network flows across hub-and-spoke distribution points, or defining how optimization models and AI can augment planner judgment.

The role balances near-term supply performance with the longer-term objective of creating a scalable, technology-enabled supply planning capability where planners spend less time collecting and reconciling information and more time managing supply risk, optimizing network and inventory investment, and improving the quality of the plan.

- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in team management
- Experience in cross functional project delivery
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

title: Site Operations Leader, OneMHS
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 2+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Refrigeration Trade School certificate
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with performance metrics such as OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), downtime, throughput, or quality
- Experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments

Amazonのラストマイル配送拠点（デリバリーステーション）において、拠点運営を支えるアドミニストレーション業務全般を担います。アソシエイトの勤怠管理、人材派遣会社との調整、拠点の各種データ管理・レポーティング、備品や設備の管理、拠点イベントの運営などを通じて、現場マネージャーがオペレーションに集中できる環境を構築します。定型業務の自動化・効率化を企画・推進し、拠点全体の生産性向上に貢献するポジションです。

descriptionHtml:
Amazonは、何百万の商品をお客様へ提供し続けることによって、世界的に認知度が高く、グローバルリーディングカンパニ—としての地位を確立しています。また、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業”であり続けるため、日々改善と改革を行っており、それらの業務へ貢献できる経験豊富な人材を求めています。

JCFS(Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions)とは、AmazonのFulfillment Solutionを追求するオペレーション技術統括本部です。アマゾンジャパンオペレーション業務の中核部門としてオペレーションの各部門を効率的に連携することに貢献します。JCFSのリライアビリティー＆メンテナンスエンジニアリングファシリティーズ部門(RME-F)において、Facility Launch Specialistを探しています。

このポジションではAmazonの物流倉庫の運営に必要なビルディング・マネジメント、クリーニング、売店、自動販売機、シャトルバス、駐車場、廃棄物処理などのサービスをローンチスケジュールに合わせてスタートし、年間で4～5件を担当しランニング・チームに引き渡します。

安全と遵法性を最優先とし、安全面は現場目線での危険予知と5Sを軸にしたソリューションの提案力と実行力、遵法面では改変された法律・条例を把握するとともに、施設運営に必要な行政への届け出管理も行います。
また、サービスを立ち上げていく過程ではステークホルダーとの合意形成に向けたスケジュール管理力、サプライヤーへの要求事項・サービスレベルやコストが妥当であることをロジカルに説明された資料の作成力が求められます。

チームは中長期的なビジネス視点で戦略的に各サービス別にサプライヤー体制を構築し、スタンダートをベースとしながらも既存拠点にない新たなサービスや改善を積極的に取り入れると供に、毎年複数拠点を立ち上げるスケールメリットを活かしたコストダウンも図ります。

こういった取組を自ら行動に起こし結果に繋げる強いドライブ力をもった方がフィットする会社です。
世界的に日々成長していく企業の中で、社内外ともに良好な関係性を築ける、高いコミュニケーション能力を持った方からの応募をお待ちしています。

title: Principal Optical Quality Engineer, Leo Quality
descriptionHtml:
Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Have you ever wanted to be part of a team who is building industry changing technology? Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a Principal Optical Quality Engineer, you will own the quality of optical communication systems between satellites. You will develop, drive and optimize mechanisms for quality assurance and control activities the supply chain for these optical components and assemblies.

The ideal candidate is a systems thinker with excellent analytical abilities, strong technical skills, effective written and verbal communication, and most importantly, a passion for developing suppliers to produce high-quality, mission-critical hardware in volume production.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the quality elements in the design, build, and qualification of optical system and metrology for build, test, and manufacturing of optical Inter-satellite Link systems.
- Implement optical inspections and tests in the supply chain.
- Drive resolution of technical problems arising in optical testing and manufacturing by developing optimal strategies and guiding the team toward solutions.
- Champion the development of new and improvement of existing optical measurement methods, leveraging metrology equipment such as interferometers, cameras, imaging systems, and Hartmann sensors for optical module integration, alignment, and testing.
- Lead the quality elements in development of measurement processes and procedures for volume manufacturing.
- Collaborate with engineering, suppliers, supply chain, and manufacturing to optimize Design for Excellence.
- Move quality checks upstream and eliminate the need to inspect quality into the product by achieving high process capability.
- Foster a culture of quality, improvement and learning with Leo.

A day in the life
This role is an individual contributor and is the quality lead for Leo's optical communication systems between satellites. This role must identify and solve problems within a supply chain while coaching teams and developing mechanisms to consistently deliver high-quality products.

You will be challenged with solving problems that have never been tackled before at scale. We guarantee that you will get to work some of the smartest people in the industry, learn a lot, have fun and have the chance to positively impact the life of millions of people.

About the team
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

At Amazon, our mission is to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. We're dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in optical systems development across full product life cycles - concept to production
- Experience with mirrors, lenses, filters, lasers, detectors, modulators, optical fiber and devices, testing and characterization
- Experience with optical metrology (e.g. interferometers and profilometers) for component and system test, qualification, and failure analysis
- Experience with various optical thin film coating methodologies, failure modes, and processes
- Bachelor's degree in Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Must be able to visually inspect and distinguish fine scratch / dig requirements in precision optical/mechanical components
- Experience in physical and geometric optics, Gaussian beam propagation, and detection, with the ability to guide team members and review technical work in these domains.
- Experience in performing process audits, product audits, and QMS audits.
- 7+ years' experience with manufacturing & assembly of optical components and complex optical systems
- Proficient in ISO 10110-7 / ISO 9211 / MIL-PRF-14830 / MIL-C-48497
- Proficient in ISO 9001 / AS9100 / IATF 16949 requirements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Master's degree or PhD in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electronics, or related discipline, or equivalent experience
- Ability to lead interdisciplinary discussions across Hardware, Reliability, Firmware, and Manufacturing teams to drive alignment on optical test strategies
- Experience working in high paced / high volume / high precision manufacturing environments
- Experience with fiber optics components and handling of optical fiber
- Familiar with interpreting MetroPro, Zemax, Code V files

title: Process Improvement Specialist III, AMXL ACES Customer Experience
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) ACES End-to-End Customer Experience (E2E CX) team is seeking an innovative, customer-obsessed, and results-driven individual to develop strategies and drive measurable improvements across the AMXL network. This highly visible, strategic role will support one of the team's core focus areas within Quality, Concessions, or Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), with the overarching goal of improving the end-to-end customer experience across First, Middle, and Last Mile operations.

As a Senior Process Improvement Specialist on the E2E Customer Experience team, you will focus on developing and executing long-term initiatives that improve operational performance and customer experience. This includes establishing strategies and goals, analyzing performance trends, identifying opportunities for improvement, developing scalable solutions, and driving adherence to operational standards. You will leverage data analytics, statistical methodologies, artificial intelligence (AI), and emerging technologies to solve complex business problems and improve decision-making. This role requires strong program management capabilities and the ability to collaborate across diverse, cross-functional stakeholder groups to drive alignment, execute initiatives, and deliver measurable results.

To be successful in this position, you must be able to operate independently in a fast-paced, highly demanding, and often ambiguous environment while maintaining strong attention to detail. You will demonstrate exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, develop compelling business narratives, and present strategies and recommendations to senior and executive leadership. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of influencing stakeholders, navigating ambiguity, and scaling programs that deliver sustained business improvements.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute end-to-end customer experience strategies across AMXL's First, Middle, and Last Mile operations, with a focus on improving Quality, Concessions, and Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA).
- Establish strategic goals, performance metrics, and mechanisms to measure progress, identify gaps, and drive sustained improvements in customer experience and operational performance.
- Analyze network performance, customer experience metrics, and operational trends to identify defects, determine root causes, and prioritize improvement opportunities.
- Leverage data analytics, statistical analysis, and quantitative methodologies to evaluate performance, validate hypotheses, measure initiative effectiveness, and make data-driven decisions.
- Establish and continuously improve network-wide standards, processes, and operating mechanisms to reduce variation, improve consistency, and drive adherence across AMXL operations.
- Partner with Field Operations and cross-functional stakeholders to implement standards, establish accountability mechanisms, and drive sustained compliance and performance improvement.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer experience through innovation, process simplification, standardization, automation, and scalable solutions.
- Effectively leverage artificial intelligence (AI) and emerging technologies to accelerate analysis, improve decision-making, automate processes, and develop innovative solutions to complex business problems.
- Act quickly to investigate and resolve network-level quality, customer experience, and process escalations, implementing sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
- Develop clear, concise, and data-driven written narratives, business reviews, strategic proposals, and recommendations that articulate complex problems, proposed solutions, and measurable business impacts.
- Present strategies, performance insights, and business recommendations to senior and executive leadership, influencing decisions, securing alignment, and driving organizational priorities.
- Provide network-level direction on strategic initiatives, process changes, program implementations, and performance improvement efforts.
- Work autonomously to identify and solve complex business problems, understanding operational constraints, scalability considerations, dependencies, and long-term customer impacts.
- Partner with Operations, Technology, Finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, coordinate resources, and execute initiatives that improve end-to-end customer experience.
- Identify and address gaps between teams, processes, and systems, driving cross-functional alignment, clear ownership, and effective mechanisms to prevent recurring defects.
- Proactively identify and mitigate operational and program risks, removing barriers to execution and ensuring initiatives deliver measurable, sustainable results.

Up to 50% travel required, 75% during peak season.

title: Software Development Engineer, Trainium Systems
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wondered what it takes to build the software systems that turn a rack of AI accelerators from inert silicon into a system a customer can run workloads on? Do you want deep ownership of a service that every one of those systems depends on to boot, run, and stay healthy?

Who are we?
Annapurna Labs is the part of Amazon that designs the custom silicon behind the cloud, including Trainium for AI training, Graviton CPUs, and the AWS Nitro system. Nearly every server in AWS runs hardware we designed. We build the chips, the systems, and the software that power some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world.

What do we do?
We build the software that provisions, operates, updates, and monitors the servers behind AWS's largest AI training workloads, built on Trainium, Graviton, and the AWS Nitro system. We give the people who run this hardware a complete way to stand it up, watch its health, deliver new software to it, and diagnose it, all through open, standard interfaces. We own that software from design through the running system.

Why it's high-impact?
The hardware is just silicon until our software makes it provisionable, observable, and serviceable. Every system runs through what we build. The service you own is on the path for all of them, and the people who run this hardware depend on it every day.

What's the challenge?
There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast-moving space. Our services require deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love.

What you will do?
You own a service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics, depending on where the team needs you. You take it from design to production, you work backward from what the operator needs, and you build on the interfaces the hardware teams expose.

Who would succeed in this role?
An engineer who likes building and operating a service in production and takes it the whole way. You read logs and reason across process and system boundaries, you ship in small verifiable steps, and you turn requirements into a service other people rely on.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the design and implementation of a large component or service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics.
- Make the application-level trade-offs on your component, and seek direction on the calls that reach beyond it.
- Automate and simplify the team's development, test, and operations work, and mentor peers as you grow.
- work backward from customer requirements and deliver solutions that are simple.

A day in the life
You design and build the provisioning and management surface over standard interfaces like Redfish, and the boot flow operator tools drive. You build the offline software-update service and prove the signed bundle applies and recovers cleanly. You design each system against the interfaces the platform exposes and turn architecture decisions into APIs and tools a customer runs without you in the loop.

About the team
Our team builds the software suite for provisioning, monitoring, software delivery, and the diagnostics of Trainium systems, and we build all of it on open, standard interfaces. We serve the engineers and operators who run large-scale AI training and need to provision, monitor, update, and troubleshoot it on their own terms. We own it end to end.

We're a small team with a large charter. You own real systems on day one. There are no layers between you and the problem. You build it, you ship it, you operate it, you improve it.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 2+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems
- Knowledge of computer architecture, operating systems, and parallel computing
- Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

title: DataCenter Technician , Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a skilled Data Center Technician with a passion for technology to help us expand our cloud to the next level. You may be the primary point of contact for both internal teams (such as Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, and Software Developers) and external partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, and Service Providers). You'll be working in large-scale, high-density data centers where you'll help change the face of cloud technology in the region.

At AWS, career progression is part of our culture. Whether your path leads to Systems, Network, or Database Engineering, Software Development, AWS Support, Technical Operations, or Project Management, we'll work with you to create a development plan that helps you reach your goals — starting from Day One.

Please apply with your updated CV in English.


Key job responsibilities
Problem Solving
• Maintain high system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently
• Serve as an escalation point and technical troubleshooter for systems and network hardware issues
• Investigate and resolve complex Linux server issues
• Troubleshoot virtualization service problems

Technical

• Install and configure server racks per internal SLAs
• Triage and resolve trouble tickets for all devices in the assigned region
• Act as the data center point of contact for high-severity issues
• Replace server and network device components as needed
• Ensure correct rotation of spare parts
• Contribute to uptime improvement metrics
• Enforce Amazon's security best practices
• Collaborate with third-party vendors, contractors, and remote support teams

Project Management
• Participate in and deliver high-impact small to mid-scale projects
• Attend team meetings for metric analysis and project status updates
• Contribute to building the world's largest cloud infrastructure

Mentoring
• Share knowledge and support team members in developing their technical skills and best practices


A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician, no two days are the same. You might start your morning reviewing support tickets and prioritizing the day's interventions. From there, you could be installing new servers in racks, diagnosing a network issue, or performing preventive maintenance on critical equipment.

You'll work at the heart of our infrastructure, collaborating with cross-functional teams — network engineers, operations managers, and vendors. Each day brings new technical challenges that allow you to grow your skills and have a direct impact on the reliability of AWS services used by millions of customers worldwide.

You'll also have the opportunity to mentor colleagues, contribute to continuous improvement projects, and help shape the evolution of our practices and team. AWS provides assistive lifting equipment to support the physical aspects of the role, ensuring a safe and comfortable working environment for everyone.


About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating. That's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Server hardware troubleshooting experience, including server booting processes (POST, BIOS, PXE, Kickstart, GRUB/LILO, RAID)
- Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, Ethernet) and network hardware (copper/fiber cabling, switches, routers)
- Linux administration knowledge
- Good level of English

Preferred qualifications

- Strong understanding of Linux/Unix administration
- Experience with remote access tools (console routers, IPMI, BMC)
- Network equipment installation and configuration experience
- Understanding of redundancy concepts (power feeds, ATS, server hardware, RAID, network connectivity)
- Project management experience
- Scripting experience (Bash, Python, Perl, Ruby, or similar programming languages)

descriptionHtml:
****This position is based in MXP6-Agognate. Please note that this role requires on-site presence. Relocation support will be provided. Applying to the talent pool is non-binding and does not guarantee a specific start date or offer.****

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.


A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

title: PM, Non-UDS (AMXL), AMXL Japan
descriptionHtml:
エアコン・水回り・ドライブレコーダー…「届けるだけ」では終わらない、設置まで責任を持つ新しい配送体験を一緒につくりませんか？
アマゾンジャパンでは、専門施工業者（Service Provider）と連携して商品の設置・組み立てを提供する「non-UDS（Non-Unified Delivery Services）」プログラムのプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。エアコン工事、水栓設置、スマートロック、ドライブレコーダー取り付け、壁掛けテレビなど、Customerが自分では難しい施工を、購入と同時にシームレスに予約・完了できる体験を作ることが私たちのミッションです。
本ポジションは Amazon Logistics Extra Large Team（AMXL）に所属し、専門施工業者との関係構築・運営管理、サービスカテゴリの拡張、そして Customerエクスペリエンスの継続的な改善をリードします。
本ポジションの所属部門等に関する詳細は、下記リンク先をご参照ください。 ■部門紹介：Last Mile (AMZL) / Extra Large (AMXL) ■職種紹介：Project / Program Management
※Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazon は男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。
Amazon では、最新の AI Tool・生成 AI を日々の業務に積極的に取り入れています。意思決定のスピードを加速させ、本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中できる環境を提供しています。

Would you like to build a service experience that goes beyond delivery — one that takes responsibility all the way through installation?
Amazon Japan is hiring a Program Manager for its non-UDS (Non-Unified Delivery Services) program, which partners with professional Service Providers (SPs) to offer installation and assembly services — air conditioners, faucets, smart locks, dashcams, wall-mount TVs, and more — seamlessly bundled with product purchase.
This role sits within the Amazon Logistics Extra Large Team (AMXL) and leads SP relationship management, service category expansion, and continuous Customer experience improvement.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities / 主な職務内容
プログラムマネージャーとして、専門施工業者（SP）との関係を軸に、以下の業務全般をリードします。

施工業者の管理・立ち上げ
・新規施工業者の発掘・コスト交渉・契約締結
・既存施工業者の週次パフォーマンスレビューと改善指示（最速予約可能日・日程変更率・初回完工率などを管理）
・施工業者・社内サポート窓口からの問い合わせ対応・解決
・施工業者への月次支払い処理（将来的な自動化の推進を含む）

サービスカテゴリの管理
・エアコン・水回り・スマートロック・ドライブレコーダー等のサービス設定・価格設定・サービス紹介ページ作成
・取り付けサービスを提供する対象商品の管理（追加・削除）
・サービス選択フローの設計・最適化による現地での追加料金発生の削減
・新カテゴリのローンチロードマップ策定と実行

日常オペレーションの管理
・施工業者のサービス提供エリア・稼働枠の設定サポート
・試験稼働の実施・段階的ローンチ計画の立案
・カスタマーサービス・社内サポート向け作業マニュアルの作成・改訂

カスタマーエクスペリエンスの改善
・Customerレビュー・問い合わせデータの分析と改善策立案
・AIを活用したサービス選択フローの精度向上（2027年計画）
・サービス品質指標（初回完工率・日程変更率・Customerレビュー）のモニタリング

﻿-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
As a Program Manager, you will lead the following across partner management, service operations, and Customer experience.
・Build and manage relationships with professional installation partners across categories including air conditioning, plumbing, smart locks, dashcams, and TV mounting
・Lead weekly partner performance reviews, track key metrics (earliest appointment availability, rescheduling rate, first-visit completion rate), and drive improvement actions
・Own partner onboarding end-to-end: recruiting, cost negotiation, contract execution, and setup of service area and capacity management
・Manage service configuration, service page creation, and service option flow design to reduce unexpected on-site charges
・Handle partner and support team inquiry escalations; coordinate resolutions across Customer Service and product planning teams
・Create and revise operational manuals for Customer Service and support teams
・Drive service category expansion roadmap; manage phased launches with trial operations
・Analyze Customer review data and develop experience improvement plans (including 2027 AI-assisted service scoping initiative)

A day in the life
朝は前日のパフォーマンスデータの確認から始まります。日程変更率が上昇している施工業者があればすぐに原因を特定し、対応を調整します。

午前中は施工業者との週次定例で、稼働不足の解消策と新エリアの拡大計画を議論します。昼過ぎは商品企画チームと新カテゴリ（例：ガス周り施工）のローンチに向けたサービス選択フローの設計を検討。夕方は社内サポート窓口からエスカレーションされたサービス表示のトラブルを調査し、翌日の作業マニュアル更新につなげます。単なる「問題対応」ではなく、「次回は現場で自己解決できる仕組みを作る」という視点で動き続けます。

Each day starts with a review of previous-day performance data. If rescheduling rates are spiking for a particular partner, you quickly identify root causes and coordinate fixes. Morning brings a weekly sync with a partner to discuss staffing shortfalls and new area expansion.
In the afternoon, you work with the product planning team on service option flow design for a new category launch. In the evening, you investigate a service display issue escalated from the support team, then update the operational manual. The mindset is never just "fix the issue" — it's always "build the system so the field can solve it next time."

About the team
我々は施工業者・Amazon・Customerの三者全員にとって「良い仕組み」を作ることに情熱を持つチームです。オペレーションとビジネスの境界を越えて動くことを楽しめる人を求めています。経験よりも「なぜそうなっているのか」を問い続ける姿勢と、現場・データ・関係者の声を束ねて前進できる実行力を重視します。
施工業者との信頼関係の構築、商品企画チームとの戦略議論——多様な関係者と対等に向き合いながら、日本の施工サービス体験を変えていく仕事です。

We are a team passionate about building systems that work well for installation partners, Amazon, and Customers alike. We value people who enjoy moving across the boundaries of operations and business — those who keep asking "why does it work this way?" and who can synthesize the voices of the field, data, and stakeholders into forward momentum.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

At Amazon, every day is still Day One.
Bold bets are made, and energy is drawn from inventing on behalf of customers. Success is measured against the possible, not the probable. This is an opportunity to make history.
The My HR Live Support (MHLS) Team is seeking a Senior Advisor to support the Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and case management channels, addressing inquiries related to benefits, payroll, leave of absence, data management, onboarding, terminations, and absence reporting requests. This role serves as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts.
The Senior Advisor reports to the Team Manager and provides subject-matter expertise and comprehensive support in resolving matters related to all HR inquiries. The role requires proficiency in answering questions, obtaining accurate information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through live and written channels, understanding employee situations, applying appropriate benefits, and responding to changing circumstances — paving the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Trends and patterns are escalated to management to address training or quality gaps identified during daily operations.
The ideal candidate possesses exceptional communication and organizational skills, keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus aligned with Amazon's global standards.


Key job responsibilities
• Handle and resolve HR queries in both German and English by leveraging documentation including frequently asked questions and standard operating procedures, escalating issues appropriately when they exceed the scope while maintaining ownership of the employee experience
• Take full accountability for each employee contact, ensuring queries are accepted and resolved with exceptional customer focus and demonstrating Earn Trust through every interaction
• Identify gaps in supporting documentation and internal processes, proactively recommending improvements to enhance service delivery and Insist on the Highest Standards
• Communicate effectively both verbally and in written form with employees, explaining and resolving concerns across the entire Amazon employee lifecycle with clarity and professionalism
• Actively seek employee feedback to continuously improve service levels, demonstrating Learn and Be Curious by using insights to enhance the support experience
• Work rotational shifts across weekdays and weekends, exhibiting flexibility and Bias for Action to ensure uninterrupted support for our employee community

- Proficiency in written and verbal in German (C1 CEFR) and English (C1 CEFR).
- Computer skills (Windows, Microsoft Office, Outlook)
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
- Experience in Human Resource management or customer service
- Bachelor's degree from accredited university or equivalent experience

- Very good proficiency in additional European languages beyond English and German
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in international teams with members across different locations and cultures

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability, and scaling) new and existing systems. Experience programming with at least one software programming language: Java, Python, or TypeScript. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU Member state.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building and operating scalable, high-availability production systems, and owning their operational excellence. Experience developing with SQL and NoSQL databases, and with cloud technologies (AWS). Experience quickly prototyping new systems and solutions. Familiarity with security automation, threat detection, or incident response tooling (a plus, not required). Excellent written and oral communication skills. Meets/exceeds Amazon's leadership principles requirements for this role. Meets/exceeds Amazon's functional/technical depth and complexity for this role.

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, Ads Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future with us! What unites all Amazonians (across teams and geographies) is that we are all striving to delight customers and make their lives easier, whoever that customer may be. In pursuit of delighting customers, Amazonians have developed many products and services that transformed the way our customers live their lives and run their businesses. Together, we are building the future, one innovative product, service, and idea at a time.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, publishers, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including retail media, display, video, DSP, measurement, and ad tech solutions—leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys.

We're seeking a strategic and customer-obsessed Product Marketing Manager to join our Ads Product Marketing team. In this role, you'll serve as a critical bridge between product development and go-to-market execution, translating complex advertising solutions into compelling narratives that resonate with advertisers and drive product adoption at scale.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you'll partner closely with Product Management, Go-to-Market, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape product strategy through deep customer insights and competitive intelligence. You'll own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle—from informing the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research to crafting positioning and messaging that differentiates our solutions in market. Your work will directly influence how thousands of advertisers discover, adopt, and maximize value from Amazon Ads products.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with creative storytelling, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven track record of launching products that achieve measurable business impact. You'll need to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, moving seamlessly from conducting advertiser research to developing sales enablement materials to presenting product vision to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
1. Collaborate with Product Managers to align on customer research priorities that will inform the product roadmap.
2. Conduct in-depth research and competitive analysis to identify the most promising opportunities for Amazon Ads products.
3. Communicate the product vision and direction to internal and external stakeholders to drive buy-in and adoption, establishing a regular cadence of stakeholder engagement.
4. Partner with Product Managers to recommend customer feedback prioritization, support effective Alpha/Beta testing, and refine the strategic roadmap.
5. Align GTM strategy to the product roadmap, translate complex product information into simple and clear language, and continue to gather customer feedback post-launch to inform future iterations.
6. Develop single-source-of-truth documentation to enable sales and marketing with positioning, messaging, product availability, best practices, implementation guides, and FAQs.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the latest campaign performance data and customer feedback, then shift into a working session with product managers to refine messaging for an upcoming launch. After lunch, you could be presenting a go-to-market strategy to senior leaders, gathering input, and aligning on next steps. Later, you'll connect with sales and partner teams to ensure enablement materials are landing effectively. Throughout it all, you're asking the right questions, simplifying complexity, and keeping cross-functional teams moving toward a shared goal.

About the team
The Ads Product Marketing team within Amazon Ads is the strategic connective tissue between product innovation and market impact. We don't just launch products, we shape how advertisers discover, understand, and derive value from Amazon's advertising solutions across the full funnel.

The Commerce pod sits at the heart of this mission, owning product marketing for some of Amazon Ads' core solutions: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Brand Stores. Together, these products serve millions of advertisers globally from small businesses running their first campaign to the large brands.

This role is part of the Sponsored Products & Sponsored Brands (SPB) product marketing team. We are evolving the PMM function beyond traditional launch communications to earning a seat at the table to directly influence the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research, competitive intelligence, and deep advertiser insights. Our work spans the full marketing lifecycle: from shaping what gets built, to how it's positioned in market, to driving adoption and measuring impact post-launch.

You'll join a collaborative, fast-paced team that partners daily with Product Management, Go-to-Market, Sales Enablement, and cross-functional leadership. We operate with a builder mentality by testing, learning, and iterating to deliver solutions that move the needle for advertisers and for the business. If you're passionate about translating complex ad tech into compelling stories that drive real outcomes, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 9+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with creating GTM initiatives at scale
- Experience working cross-functionally across marketing, product management, analytics, UX, and research
