title: Senior Product Manager, Technical - External Services, AWS Life Sciences
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Are you passionate about leveraging AI to revolutionize life sciences? AWS Life Sciences Applied AI is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Technical to lead the development of applications that reimagine how clinical trials are designed, executed, and delivered.

Key job responsibilities
As Senior Product Manager, Technical, you'll lead pioneering product development for AI-driven clinical trials transformation. You'll guide a team of builders (product managers, developers, and scientists) to invent and simplify on behalf of pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, and clinical operations teams—defining novel, generative AI agent-based experiences that help them accelerate the path from discovery to treatment. You will drive innovation by reimagining how clinical evidence is generated and how trial operations are managed, replacing fragmented manual processes with intelligent, continuously learning systems. This is a highly visible and impactful role within AWS, offering the opportunity to shape the future of clinical development and drive innovation at a global scale. You will be responsible for defining key product directions, adopting or inventing new machine learning techniques, reimagining user workflows and experiences, and fundamentally changing how life-saving therapies reach patients.

About the team
ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
- 5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)
- Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market
- Experience working with customers, technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience

title: Research Operations Manager, Research Services I PV & Studios - Ops
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at any time and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.



About the role

The Prime Video & Studios Research Services team is looking for a Research Operations Manager to join our operations team supporting customer-focused primary research across global markets. You'll be part of the engine that makes research happen, owning the technical execution of surveys from programming through to deployment, managing panel operations, and helping build AI-powered tools that automate our reporting workflows.

You will partner closely with Consumer Insights researchers, Data Science, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure research is fielded on time, to spec, and at the highest quality. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on operational excellence, has a passion for research methodology, and wants to be at the intersection of research and technology.


Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:

title: Operations Intern - Belgium, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note:
- You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.
- This internship is offered on a voluntary, extracurricular basis. As it is structured under a remunerated immersion agreement, it is not eligible for credit toward Belgian university or school programs.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:

- Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results

- Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement

- Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones

- Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.

Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. The AWS Security Assurance team is responsible for demonstrating the security controls of services offered by AWS. At AWS’ scale, we must invent new ways to provide the highest level of assurance to our most regulatory conscious customers.

We are looking for a highly motivated assurance expert to join our team. As part of the team, you will manage targeted campaigns to solve complex compliance challenges, improve processes, and drive greater efficiencies across the security assurance organization. title: IT Support Engineer, Ring IT
descriptionHtml:
Ring IT is hiring an IT Support Engineer II for our Hawthorne, CA headquarters (LAX32). You'll be one of two on-site technical leads for an office of about 440 employees, and this is a fully on-site role.

You'll own the day-to-day technology experience for everyone at the site, from senior executives and their assistants to new hires on their first morning. That covers:

Mac and Windows hardware, imaging and asset management
Identity and access, including onboarding and offboarding
Conference room and event AV
The collaboration tools Ring's engineers, designers and business teams use every day: Slack, Jira, Confluence, TestRail and Figma
You'll also support remote employees, shipping configured equipment and resolving issues over chat and video.

At this level, you're expected to work through difficult and ambiguous problems to root cause without a playbook. You'll spot patterns across tickets, coordinate fixes with partner teams, and keep customers informed until the issue is closed. Partner teams include Amazon corporate IT, Security and Facilities. You'll lead site projects, such as lab network extensions, office changes and executive events.

Ring IT is moving toward self-service and AI-enabled support. We want someone who writes scripts and uses AI tools to remove repetitive work rather than repeat it. You'll mentor peers and serve as an escalation point for the broader support team.

Key job responsibilities
Site support and customer experience
Provide high-touch, discreet support to senior leaders (VP and above) and their executive assistants
Handle walk-up, ticket and Slack support across hardware, software, network and access issues, and find the root cause of difficult problems
Set up and troubleshoot conference rooms and meeting AV, and support executive events, demos and all-hands meetings
Share site coverage with your peer engineer to keep the office staffed throughout business hours, with occasional after-hours support

Identity, access and lifecycle
Run employee onboarding, offboarding and internal transfers, including timely access removal and asset recovery
Provision access and administer Slack, Jira/Confluence (projects and spaces), TestRail and Figma

Hardware and assets
Image, deploy, ship and track laptops, loaners, mobile test devices, peripherals and security keys
Manage equipment returns and e-waste, keeping asset records accurate

Escalation and improvement
Detect issues affecting many users, document the pattern, and escalate to partner teams until resolved
Automate repeatable work with scripts and AI tools, and write and maintain runbooks and knowledge-base articles
Lead site projects such as lab network extensions and office changes
Mentor peers and serve as an escalation point for the support team

A day in the life
Your morning starts in the LAX32 IT room with walk-ups: a new hire's Mac that won't enroll, a lost security key. An executive assistant pings you: their VP's all-hands starts in an hour and the room display won't connect. Back at your desk, you work the queue: a batch of application access requests, a new Jira project. When a dozen users hit the same compliance error, you write up the pattern and escalate it. title: Sr. Inventory Manager, PAC
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
The Power & Cooling (PAC) team is seeking a results-oriented individual with deep inventory and logistics expertise to own the storage and inventory governance that makes on-time commissioning possible for Data Center Power & Cooling equipment. Our Inventory & Logistics Leaders are high-energy self-starters who bring a specialized skill set — inventory control, warehouse governance, and logistics execution — that raises the bar for how AWS manages a large, fast-growing long-lead-equipment inventory.
As a member of the Power and Cooling Post-Delivery organization, this is an individual-contributor role that owns the upstream governance of storage and inventory for Long Lead Equipment (LLE) — not the physical warehousing itself, but everything that makes it work. You will hold third-party storage locations accountable for receiving standards and equipment condition, drive accurate inventory tracking and reconciliation, and maintain full visibility into what is on hand and where, across roughly 15 storage vendors and more than 30 locations. You own the capability that lets the organization trust what it holds — the foundation every commissioning enabler depends on. You report to the Leader of Post-Delivery & Commissioning.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own projects through completion.


Key job responsibilities
• The Inventory & Logistics Leader is an individual contributor who owns storage and inventory governance for long-lead equipment (LLE), making certain the organization knows — with confidence — what it holds, in what condition, and where.
• Storage Governance — Hold third-party storage locations accountable for receiving-inspection standards and for equipment condition while in storage; establish the receiving, condition, and reconciliation standards that do not exist today, so crates are no longer received without clear instructions or left unopened and unverified.
• Inventory Accuracy and Visibility — Drive active and accurate inventory tracking, including cycle counts, and maintain full on-hand visibility on demand. Resolve the conditions behind unvalued and unreconciled inventory — past-due material still carried in storage and item-part-number-to-purchase-order mismatches — so the portfolio can be fully valued and trusted.
• Logistics Execution — Own coordination with Amazon Cloud Logistics (ACL) for the movement of equipment into, between, and out of storage, and issue advance shipping notices to storage locations ahead of each site’s Need By Date (NBD). Make this a governed responsibility with one accountable owner rather than a side task spread across many people.
• Capacity Forecasting — Forecast storage capacity with the third party against where the build is heading, sizing the storage footprint for both growth and decline rather than being surprised by either.
• Enabling Redundancy and Spare Parts — Provide the inventory confidence that makes equipment redundancy real — swapping equipment between sites to cover a shortfall — and absorb the steady-state tracking and availability of the Critical Spare Parts program once it moves from stand-up into operation.
• Success in this role is measured by inventory accuracy, the share of the portfolio under governed and verified visibility, and the elimination of the storage surprises that today surface at commissioning — directly enabling on-time PFHO


A day in the life
• Communicate ideas concisely to a wide variety of stakeholders, for purposes ranging from informative to securing approvals from executives.
• Embody a true pioneering spirit, willing to “get your hands dirty” in a start-up environment while simultaneously developing processes, automation, and delivering results.
• Clearly define data requirements and metrics, working with teams to implement the entire data flow from capture to presentation and management.
• Apply high attention to detail and a proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
• Continuously improve inventory and logistics processes, building the standards and automation that make governance repeatable as the build scales.


About the team
*Why AWS* Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
*Inclusive Team Culture* Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

title: Data Engineer II, DSP Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Do you enjoy diving deep into data, developing real-time and batch pipelines that generate actionable insights?
The DSP Analytics team has an exciting opportunity for a Data Engineer to make impactful contributions to Amazon's Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program tackling modern data challenges by combining traditional engineering practices with transformative analytics and Generative AI.

You'll help design and build the next generation of data infrastructure powering GenAI applications, and develop agents that automate the end-to-end data operations lifecycle. We are a team of Data Engineers working closely with Data Scientists, Economists, and Analysts turning machine learning and AI research into scalable products that delight customers worldwide.

You're passionate about technology, strongly biased toward going deep to find insights, and driven to build scalable analytical platforms. You're relentless about quality and reliability, and comfortable communicating across different levels of leadership. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead and design complex data architectures, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with business objectives
• Drive implementation of large-scale data pipelines and ETL processes using AWS technologies
• Identify and resolve system-wide data challenges, including performance bottlenecks and architectural deficiencies
• Establish data engineering best practices, including governance, security standards, and operational excellence
• Ensure data solutions are auditable, accessible, and maintainable across the organization
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative data solutions


About the team
We are the Amazon DSP Analytics team, supporting all business pillars across the DSP organization horizontally, with the vision to enable data-, insights-, and science-driven decision-making. We are an exceptionally talented and fun-loving team. Here, you'll have the opportunity to dive deep into complex business and data problems, drive large-scale technical solutions, and raise the bar for operational excellence. We love sharing ideas and learning from each other, and we believe in using those ideas to disrupt the status quo.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- 4+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Demonstrated use of generative AI tools (e.g., agentic coding assistants, AI-powered IDEs) in a professional or project setting

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
- Experience designing or building AI agents or multi-agent solutions that automate engineering workflows
- Familiarity with agentic AI patterns including tool use, function calling, and multi-agent orchestration

title: Sr. HR Specialist, AIS HRP Team, AIS HRP Team
descriptionHtml:
This role sits on the Data Center's People Foundations team, which owns the Data Center's time, pay, and people-infrastructure demand signal. The team turns diffuse requirements from across the DC network into delivered, compliant solutions by working through the central teams that own each domain (TimeHub, Workforce Solutions, Payroll, Compensation, policy, and Benefits), then operationalizing the result with the business. The team is small and specialist. It builds the standards and mechanisms the network runs on, and partners with those owner teams to make sure the data center use case is built in, not bolted on.
You own how people-infrastructure needs get gathered from the field across the network and see them through to delivery. You gather what the business actually needs across every workstream, translate it into structured requirements, and partner with the central owner teams to land real solutions, running against the prioritization criteria and roadmapping mechanisms the function sets. You are fungible by design: one week you're supporting a site launch, the next a retrofit or closure, the next carrying a time and pay requirement into the owner teams or building something net-new for how DC operations run. You go where the highest-value problem sits, and you're trusted to size it, work it, and see it through. You're based in the EU, and where the work calls for on-the-ground regional support, your focus is EMEA and APJC.
Specifically, you will support the full site lifecycle (launches, retrofits, closures, and replacements) so the people experience holds through every transition; support accurate time and pay for the DC population by bringing clear requirements to the timekeeping and payroll owner teams and helping operationalize the fixes; and take a solution proven in one market and help turn it into the standard other markets adopt, so the network solves once rather than rebuilding in parallel. This is a net-new operating model for the data centers, so you'll help stand up the mechanisms as you run them.


Key job responsibilities
• Own how the people-infrastructure demand signal gets gathered from the field across every workstream: translate needs into structured build requirements, and drive each one through to a delivered, compliant solution rather than letting it resurface as a post-launch defect.
• Support the full site lifecycle (launches, retrofits, closures, and replacements), making sure people transitions are planned before the physical work begins, not after; where on-the-ground support is needed, your focus is EMEA and APJC.
• Support accurate time and pay for the DC population: bring clear, well-structured requirements to the timekeeping and payroll owner teams and partner with them to operationalize solutions through launches and site transitions.
• Partner with the owner teams (TimeHub, Workforce Solutions, Payroll, Compensation, policy, and Benefits) as a single, reliable point of contact: bring them the data center use case early, work alongside them to land it, and track progress so requirements arrive as delivered solutions.
• Solve once, apply everywhere: take a problem worked to a solution in one market and help turn it into the standard other markets adopt, running against the mechanisms and standards the function sets.
• Surface risks in the intake-to-delivery pipeline early and work them to resolution with the owner teams, so a gap is closed before it becomes a compliance issue or business disruption.
• Flex across the team's workstreams as priorities shift, taking on the highest-value problem wherever it sits.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
- • 5+ years of HR, talent program, or program and project management experience.
- • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.
- • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured requirements and delivered solutions.
- • Experience supporting or leading initiatives across multiple countries or business lines.
- • Experience working cross-functionally with teams you influence rather than manage

Preferred qualifications

- • Experience with intake, prioritization, and delivery across a portfolio of requirements or programs.
- • Experience in site launch, expansion, or new-market or greenfield operational stand-up.
- • Direct experience with time and pay / timekeeping systems (e.g., TimeHub, MyTime, payroll platforms) or comparable HR-systems configuration environments.
- • Experience partnering with policy, benefits, legal, tech, and operations teams in a matrixed environment.
- • Experience in a data center, mission-critical facility, or high-growth infrastructure environment.
- • Readiness to operate with increasing scope and ambiguity, and to grow into broader ownership over time.
- • MBA or advanced degree in Industrial/Labor Relations, Organizational Development, HR, or a related field.

title: Principal UX Researcher, AWS Experience Analytics (EXA)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Principal Researcher who will shape how AWS understands, measures, and acts on the health of customer journeys at scale. AWS customers are shifting from console-based building toward AI-augmented, agent-primary, and autonomous workflows. With the wide adoption of agentic AI, customer journeys are changing fundamentally. You will set the strategic direction for how journey data becomes meaningful insight for stakeholders and partner teams, and establish EXA as the trusted voice on customer experience across AWS.

This is an individual contributor role. You will conduct research and operate at the intersection of customer stories, metrics, and strategy — translating complex journey signals into actionable intelligence that informs roadmaps across AWS service teams to improve customer experiences. You will mentor and develop researchers across levels, raise the bar for research quality and rigor across the organization, and contribute directly to scaling the team's capacity, methodologies, and mechanisms. You will bring creativity and a Learn and Be Curious mindset, lead through ambiguity, and drive alignment across engineering, science, and product teams with competing priorities.

The problems are genuinely interesting. With the wide adoption of agentic AI, customer needs and expectations are changing fundamentally — and there are many new problems we do not yet have answers to. We have far more questions than we can research, and that is where you come in.


Key job responsibilities
• Define and own the research strategy to inform how AWS measures, interprets, and acts on customer journey health — including what signals matter, how they stitch together to tell compelling stories, and what "meaningful insight" looks like.

• Convert complex journey signals into clear, actionable intelligence that shapes roadmaps and priorities across AWS service teams.

• Drive alignment and shared understanding across engineering, science, and product teams — navigating competing priorities and leading through ambiguity.

• Establish and elevate EXA as the trusted perspective on customer experience across AWS, ensuring journey insights reach the right stakeholders at the right time.

• Raise the bar for research quality, methodology, and storytelling across the organization — ensuring that every insight is grounded in evidence and designed to drive action.

• Mentor and develop researchers across levels, building the team's capacity to take on increasingly complex and ambiguous problems.

• Design and implement repeatable methodologies and mechanisms that allow the team to scale its impact beyond individual studies and projects.

• Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept tools using generative AI technologies to explore new ways of surfacing and communicating customer insights, or to scale research.



About the team
AWS Experience Analytics (EXA) turns customer understanding into products and intelligence that teams across AWS can use. We are building a unified customer lifecycle data platform and customer intelligence system that delivers deep customer understanding at scale. Our team approaches data both qualitatively and quantitatively, fusing customer insights with telemetry to tell actionable customer stories — insight is the critical layer that makes data meaningful.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in HCI, Social Science, or a related field
• 12+ years of experience conducting qualitative and quantitative research in a corporate setting, with demonstrated cross-organizational impact
• Proven track record of defining research strategy that has influenced product direction across multiple teams or organizations
• Experience working with data scientists and engineers to develop models and metrics
• Experience mentoring and developing researchers across multiple levels
• Experience conducting B2B research at scale
• Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership
• Fluency in triangulating customer insights with telemetry data

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building and scaling research practices and methodologies
• Experience working with large-scale technology platforms and complex system architectures
• Experience working with agent-supported, non-deterministic experiences
• Experience with customer journey analytics, metrics development, behavioral segmentation, or experimentation design
• Proficiency in Python, SQL, or equivalent tools for working with behavioral and telemetry data
• Experience presenting to and influencing VP-level or above leadership

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. title: Solutions Architect Manager, AI & Growth - ASEAN, ASEAN APO PSA Team
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping AI-driven consulting partners to scale across ASEAN using the cloud and AI services? We are looking for an experienced and technically strong people manager to lead our Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) teams within the ASEAN Partner Organization.
This role owns the technical strategy, team development, and partner engagement for:
• AI Partner PSAs: A team of Partner Solutions Architects who support AI/ML Consulting Partners to co-build solutions on AWS, co-sell through AWS Marketplace, and scale globally across AWS Regions. These partners are building next-generation AI applications leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and other AWS AI/ML services.
• Growth Partner PSAs: A team of Partner Solutions Architects supporting AWS Growth Partners, driving technical enablement, solution design, and scale motions through the channel partners to accelerate Cloud and AI adoption across ASEAN markets.
This is a highly visible, dual-charter leadership role that requires to cover ASEAN countries (Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Philippines) to engage directly with partners, lead executive briefings, and represent AWS at area and country events.

Key job responsibilities
Technical Strategy, Migration & Modernization & AI Enablement
• Set the technical vision, Migration & Modernization and AI acceleration strategy across teams, identifying common enablement needs and opportunities for shared tooling, mechanisms, agentic tools and AI/ML reference architectures.
• Stay current on AWS AI/ML services (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Quick, Kiro etc.) and industry trends to inform partner technical guidance and co-build motions.
• Build mechanisms to measure and improve partner technical outcomes including Migration & Modernization, AI competency and Managed Services certifications, validated AI solution designs, Marketplace listings, and customer wins.
• Drive partner enablement programs for both AI Partners and Growth Partners, ensuring partners can effectively leverage generative AI, agentic tools, foundation models, and ML services in their solutions.
• Establish technical bar-raising mechanisms to ensure partners deliver production-quality AI/ML solutions to end customers.
Stakeholder & Partner Engagement
• Serve as a senior technical voice to AI Partner and Growth Partner executives, building trusted advisor relationships at the CTO/VP Engineering level.
• Represent partner technical needs internally, influencing AWS AI service teams, partner programs, and product roadmaps to better serve the ASEAN partner ecosystem.
• Partner cross-functionally with Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Sales, Marketing, Training, and Professional Services to drive holistic partner success across the AI and distribution segments.
• Present at partner events, executive briefings, AWS Summits, and industry forums across ASEAN to elevate AWS partner technical thought leadership in AI.
• Cultivate relationships with AI Partner founders and Growth Partner technical leadership to drive co-innovation and joint go-to-market motions.
People Management and Operational Excellence
• Define and track team goals and performance metrics aligned to ASEAN Partner organizational priorities and business outcomes.
• Recruit, hire, and retain top technical talent across ASEAN; build a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team culture that spans multiple countries and cultures.
• Establish scalable operating rhythms, reporting mechanisms, and continuous improvement practices across both team charters.
• Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and prioritization across AI Partner and Growth Partner engagement models.


About the team
The Partner Solutions Architecture (PSA) organization is the technical backbone of the AWS Partner community. PSAs work hands-on with AWS Partners to raise their technical bar, help them build differentiated solutions, and ensure customers receive world-class outcomes through the partner channel.

The ASEAN Cloud and AI Acceleration team is at the forefront of driving AI adoption across Southeast Asia’s diverse and rapidly growing markets. This role offers a unique leadership opportunity: you will shape how AWS engages technically with both the fast-moving Partner segment (startups and ISVs building AI-first solutions) and the high-scale Growth Partner channel (distributors enabling downstream resellers).

By leading across these two domains, you will develop cross-pollination strategies, identify common AI enablement patterns, and build mechanisms that amplify partner impact at scale. You will work closely with Partner Development Managers, AWS service teams, and regional leadership to ensure ASEAN partners are equipped to deliver AI solutions to customers.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of enterprise IT application work that includes at least 2 years of hands-on software development or DevOps engineering experience
- 2+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
- 8+ years of technology solutions development and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience leading and growing teams of senior technology professionals, ideally in customer facing roles

Preferred qualifications

- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Knowledge of cloud technology partner ecosystem and related products
- Experience in a technical role within a sales organization

品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。

Based in Luxembourg or London, you will operate at the intersection of product strategy, vendor governance, and large-scale program delivery — driving outcomes across EU and global markets.

Please note that this is a 12 months fixed-term contract.

- Own the multi-year telematics product strategy and roadmap, aligning with global fleet and last-mile delivery objectives across EU and international markets

- Define and govern contractual relationships with telematics vendors, including leading commercial negotiations, SLA frameworks, performance accountability structures, and contract renewals
- Establish and maintain vendor governance mechanisms to ensure delivery against contractual commitments, data quality standards, and operational KPIs
- Partner with engineering, data science, legal, and operations teams to deliver telematics capabilities including real-time vehicle tracking, fault diagnostics, driver behavior monitoring, and predictive maintenance
- Drive adoption of telematics solutions across Delivery Service Partner (DSP) networks and internal fleet operations at scale
- Define, track, and report on key product metrics and use insights to continuously improve product outcomes
- Lead market and competitive analysis to identify emerging connected vehicle technologies and integration opportunities, including direct OEM integrations
- Ensure compliance with regional data privacy and regulatory requirements, including GDPR and EU-specific frameworks, in close collaboration with legal and privacy teams
- Communicate product strategy, roadmap progress, and business impact clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across geographies

The Fleet Safety & Technology (FS&T) team sits within International Global Fleet & Products (GFP). title: Senior Global Supply Manager
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS ISCaP ASC (Amazon Subtier Components) team is seeking for a results-oriented Senior Global Supply Manager to own supply management for EE/Interconnect components that go into server racks for our global datacenter network. The role will manage internal stakeholders as well as supplier relationships to ensure support on continuity of supply, lifecycle management, key programs, process improvement, contracts, and technical needs. The ideal candidate will deliver operational excellence with a focus on hardware demand/supply optimization. This individual must be a high energy, high impact individual with demonstrated ability to succeed in a dynamic business environment. Successful candidates will build long lasting, strategic partnerships, be well organized with strong communication skills to position themselves and AWS for continued success. The ideal candidate will raise the bar on driving schedules and deep diving into data, actively participates with a strong curiosity to understand the business end-to-end, and has a track record of delivering strong results.

This role leads supply management for interconnect or EE components. The ideal candidate will deliver operational excellence with a focus on hardware demand/supply optimization. This individual must be a high-energy, high-impact individual with demonstrated ability to succeed in a dynamic business environment.

Key job responsibilities
1. Clear-to-Build (CTB) & Shortage Resolution Own and drive CTB tracking for critical components; lead shortage resolution by identifying root causes, developing mitigation plans, and coordinating across multi-tier suppliers and internal stakeholders to unblock production; engage suppliers to expedite, reallocate, or pull-in supply to close gaps; validate demand signals and communicate risk exposure and recovery plans to leadership with clarity and urgency.

2. Inventory & Buffer Strategy Design and manage supply buffer strategies (safety stock, strategic inventory, VMI) to build resiliency without driving excess; define buffer targets based on lead time variability, demand volatility, and supply risk profiles; manage allocation of on-hand and in-transit inventory to highest-priority demands across VMI sites; monitor inventory health metrics (WOS and excess/obsolescence) and partner with Finance and Operations to align buffer investment with business risk tolerance and cost targets.

3. Spot Market Buy Identify and evaluate spot market opportunities to bridge supply gaps; maintain a vetted network of authorized brokers and enforce compliance with quality and authenticity standards; lead spot buy negotiations for competitive pricing while managing counterfeit risk; define governance processes including approval thresholds and traceability requirements; track cost premiums and risk exposure while analyzing market dynamics to proactively position before shortages materialize.

4. Lead Time Reduction Analyze end-to-end lead time drivers — including raw material pre-positioning, line balance, and manufacturing process optimization — to structurally reduce effective lead times; hub/consignment arrangements;

5. Travel Up to 50% on site in suppliers’ international locations.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Software Development Engineer, RBS Tech
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about building the future of Retail Automation powered by Generative AI?

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enriches ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination, where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow; and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops intelligent automation powered by GenAI, LLM and Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of highly complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time.

Why join us

We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you love designing elegant abstractions for messy real world problems, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you get a kick out of seeing your code improve the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide, we definitely need you. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.

About the role

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands, customer obsession is part of our company DNA. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer II to join the SAMAI team and help us push the boundaries of what's possible with Generative AI in retail automation. As an SDE2, you will not just write code, you will architect systems that think. You will design scalable, distributed platforms that orchestrate LLM powered agents, build robust pipelines that process millions of data points daily, and make critical design trade offs that directly influence a multi billion dollar business. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, distributed systems and real world business impact. Every system you build will be tested against the unforgiving scale of Amazon's catalog, hundreds of millions of ASINs, dozens of marketplaces and billions of customer interactions. You will collaborate closely with Applied Scientists and senior engineers to turn cutting edge research into production systems that work at scale. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.

If you enjoy designing and building GenAI powered platforms, highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come join us!

Work/Life Balance

RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship and Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal and Senior Engineers from RBS Tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. And on a team building Gen AI systems every day, the learning opportunities are endless.

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

About the team

We are building SAMAI, our Gen AI powered automation platform that is redefining how RBS delivers at scale. SAMAI harnesses the power of LLMs, agentic AI workflows and cutting edge ML to automate complex retail business processes end to end. Think of it as the brain behind RBS's next generation automation, orchestrating intelligent agents that can reason, act and deliver outcomes that previously needed hundreds of human hours. We are not just using Gen AI as a feature; we are building a platform that makes GenAI the foundation of retail operations.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Program Manager, Listings Seller Experience
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s team! We are looking for talented Program Manager to make it dramatically easier for sellers to launch and grow their business on our marketplace. In this role, you'll own the seller journey from registration end through first listing and early success, removing friction at every step so more sellers reach their first sale and long-term growth faster. You'll partner with product, tech, verification, and business teams to reinvent onboarding, accelerate sellers to key milestones, and turn seller pain points into solutions. If you love building programs that unlock growth for hundreds of thousands of sellers, this is for you.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. Over 2 million Sellers in 10 countries list their products for sale on the Amazon Marketplace. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.

Key job responsibilities
Drive seller listing success: Own programs that move sellers from registration to first listing and early revenue milestones, reducing onboarding friction and lifting funnel conversion.
Define and track success metrics: Build the program metrics, dashboards, and queries needed to measure funnel performance, set achievable goals, and report progress in WBRs/MBRs.
Ensure smooth GTM of new features: Plan and execute phased rollouts and dial-ups of new listing experiences, monitoring seller impact and iterating quickly on early results.
Educate and communicate with sellers: Create educational content, FAQs, and in-context guidance, and run seller comms across email, WhatsApp, and Seller Central.
Capture and act on Voice of Seller: Gather seller feedback and anecdotes, translate them into product requirements, and channel them to the right product and tech teams to close experience gaps.
Lead cross-functional execution: Coordinate and influence product, tech, verification, legal, and business partners (up to senior leadership) to align on requirements, roles, and delivery timelines.
Establish routines and mechanisms: Set up follow-up cadences, monitoring, and governance to detect issues early, track adoption, and continuously improve the seller experience.

- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements

descriptionHtml:

The DCEO Cluster Manager position encompasses leadership responsibility for multiple data center facilities and their corresponding infrastructure. The successful candidate will direct a substantial organizational structure, providing oversight to Facility Managers while ensuring operational excellence across multiple data center locations.

This position requires demonstrated leadership capabilities and a track record of exceptional performance in managing complex technical operations. The role is integral to maintaining Amazon's world-class data center infrastructure and supporting our continued growth and innovation.

The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong understanding of data center/mission critical MEP infrastructure. You will be the single point of contact for all facility related issues and work as the technical resource to support Regional Cluster Manager. You will solely be responsible for maintaining 100% service uptime in your Cluster. You have a very high-level view of your organization, but you will need to dive into detail as needed. You will also be interacting with the global team daily by representing the Data Center Engineering Operations team.
If you are passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon.com data centers. This may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

* Hiring, managing, and developing the operations management team, including facility managers, chief engineers, and facility technicians.
* Establishing performance benchmarks, conducting analyses, and preparing reports on all aspects of critical facility operations and maintenance.
* Overseeing the on-site management of shift technicians, senior shift technicians, subcontractors, and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices and procedures.
* Operating and maintaining the mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for Amazon data centers, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and change management.
* Managing all facility-related repairs in a timely manner.
* Liaising with the global team on global initiatives, as well as processes and procedures, and implementing those initiatives locally in Bangkok.

* Driving continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, methods, and tools.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience operating as a manager of managers.
* 7+ years of experience operating as a manager.
* 10+ years of relevant experience managing mission critical facilities.
* In-depth knowledge of mission critical facilities, including generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, UPS, electrical sub-distribution systems, fire detection and suppression systems, and cable reticulation systems.

Preferred qualifications

* Mission-critical facility management experience within a large enterprise or large colocation provider.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams.

title: Manager, Business Development, GSSC
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Global Selling has been helping individuals and businesses increase sales and reach new customers around the globe. The Global Selling team in China is responsible for recruiting local businesses to sell on Amazon’s 21 overseas marketplaces, and supporting local Sellers’ success and growth on the Amazon. Our vision is to be the first choice for all types of Chinese business to go globally.

Amazon Global Selling is seeking an experienced, results-driven Carrier Business Development Manager to join the Global Seller Supply Chain (GSSC) central PMO team, leading a team of carrier managers focused on building and scaling logistics carrier networks for CN cross-border shipping to emerging marketplaces — including Latin America, Middle East, and other high-growth destinations. In this highly visible role, you will manage the full carrier lifecycle — from acquisition, onboarding, and rate negotiation to performance management and network expansion — while partnering closely with marketplace teams and global product teams to develop logistics solutions that improve seller experience and business outcomes.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the logistic strategy for Amazon’s fastest-growing cross-border corridors, influence global product roadmaps, and build a high-performing team in an exciting and fast-paced business. The ideal candidate is customer-obsessed, has deep carrier management or logistics BD experience, demonstrates a track record of building and developing high-performing teams, excels at navigating complex multi-stakeholder environments across cultures, and possesses best-in-class oral and written communication skills in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key job responsibilities
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Carrier Managers; set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and build a culture of operational excellence and data-driven decision-making.

Own end-to-end carrier acquisition and network expansion for CN-to-emerging-marketplace carriers, identifying and onboarding carriers that meet Amazon’s requirements.

Drive carrier performance management across multiple dimensions, including delivery accuracy, tracking timeliness, cost-to-serve, and compliance; establish and maintain carrier scorecards and performance review cadences.

Lead rate negotiation and cost optimization initiatives with strategic carriers, balancing cost competitiveness with service quality and network resilience.

Partner closely with marketplace teams and global product teams to identify logistics gaps and co-develop shipping solutions that improve seller experience, reduce transit times, and support business growth in emerging markets.

Serve as a program leader for critical cross-border logistics initiatives, independently interfacing with and influencing marketplace leadership and global stakeholders to drive alignment and execution.

Own Operational Planning (3YP/OP1/OP2) for assigned domains, define and deliver key performance indicators, and proactively identify roadblocks and business opportunities.

Lead key planning cycles and reporting cadences for your assigned domain, including regular readouts up to VP level and contributions to SVP-level business reviews.

We are Amazon Global Selling (AGS) PMO team under the Global Seller Supply Chain (GSSC) organization. We collaborate with AGS business teams to identify key Seller needs and partner with global product teams to develop tools and solutions to improve Seller experience and sustainable growth.

title: Senior Program Manager, JP DSP
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to play a defining role in optimizing the cost of our last mile network and protecting it from loss and leakage? Do you thrive on leveraging data to uncover savings opportunities and drive decisions? Are you looking for a role where you can have a direct, measurable impact on the bottom line? The JP Delivery Service Partner (DSP) organization is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead our Cost Optimization and Network Losses charter.

As a Senior Program Manager in the JP DSP organization, you will own and execute the strategy to optimize cost-to-serve and minimize network losses across our delivery operations in Japan. This role is responsible for identifying and driving down the structural cost drivers of DSP operations, and for designing programs that reduce losses and leakage, such as lost, damaged, and misrouted packages, concessions, and payment inaccuracies. You will partner with Program, Product, Operations, Finance, and Technology teams across Last Mile to deliver long-term scalable solutions and improve process efficiency. You will be deeply connected to the data, possess a high degree of ownership, and make excellent decisions. This role is central to Amazon Japan's long-term ambition to structurally improve last mile cost-to-serve and drive step-change efficiency across the DSP network over the coming years.

A successful candidate will be highly analytical, be customer obsessed, able to overcome obstacles, and have excellent written and verbal communication. The candidate should be comfortable leading cross-functional business decisions, aligning partner teams, and recommending long-term solutions grounded in data. The ideal candidate will be someone who is comfortable rolling up their sleeves, has attention to detail, is comfortable with ambiguity, and has a passion for data.

Key job responsibilities
- Own DSP team's annual budget planning cycle and cost optimization agenda
- Identify structural drivers of cost-to-serve and lead strategic programs that reduce cost while protecting delivery quality and partner experience
- Design and run network loss reduction programs across the DSP network
- Develop and improve processes, mechanisms, and controls that address loss and cost challenges
- Partner with WW Product, Finance, and Technology teams to implement systems, integrations, and automation that give early visibility into cost and loss drivers

Verwendung interner Reporting-Tools zur Datenanalyse und Bereitstellung von Informationen für die Unternehmensführung zur Unterstützung sicherheitsrelevanter Entscheidungen.
Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Pflege von Sicherheitsschulungsprogrammen, Ergonomie-Initiativen und Präventionsprogrammen zur Verbesserung der Sicherheitskultur.
Durchführung von Risikobewertungen für neue Prozesse und Maschinen, Überprüfung von Änderungen an standardisierten Prozessen und Aktualisierung bestehender Risikobewertungen.
Förderung des Engagements für Arbeitsschutzmaßnahmen bei Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden zur Stärkung einer soliden Sicherheitskultur.

A day in the life
Dies ist eine äußerst vielseitige Rolle an einem unserer Standorte, die Dir ermöglicht, direkt zu vielen Aspekten unserer Sicherheitskultur beizutragen. Du verwaltest die Arbeitsschutzstandards und verbesserst gleichzeitig Funktionalität und Effizienz. Außerdem leitest Du Dein Team und hilfst bei der Umsetzung von Änderungen basierend auf Mitarbeiterfeedback oder bei der Nutzung von Möglichkeiten zur kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserung.

Deine Rolle ist entscheidend für die Sicherheit der Mitarbeitenden, die Verwaltung ihrer Zufriedenheit und die Überwachung ihres Wohlbefindens und ihrer Produktivität. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitssicherheit und förderst eine Kultur des sicheren Arbeitens.

Unser Team arbeitet mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitenden und lokalen Behörden an allen unseren Standorten zusammen, um die Einhaltung der Amazon-Richtlinien und gesetzlichen Vorschriften sicherzustellen und die Sicherheit unserer Arbeitsumgebungen zu gewährleisten. Das Team bietet vielfältige Möglichkeiten — von Safety Technicians bis hin zu Programm Manager:innen. Unabhängig von Deiner Position trägst Du zur Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Sicherheitsstrategie im gesamten Netzwerk bei.

title: System Manufacturing Engineer, Graviton server development team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon, is the team behind AWS (Amazon Web Services) Graviton — the industry's most advanced Arm-based server CPU — and we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

We're looking for System Manufacturing Engineer to be part of defining, shaping and integrating solutions to next generation of our cloud platforms.

As a System Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll own the development, testing, and monitoring of the manufacturing health of Amazon Graviton server products. You’ll be part of a team integrating new silicon, hardware, firmware, and software into a revolutionary system architecture.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with hardware design teams to drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Test (DFT), providing early feedback that reduces cost, defects, and ramp risk.
- Work with design partners and contract manufacturer (CM/ODM) sites to set up assembly, test, and burn-in processes, tooling, and fixtures that enable reliable manufacturing of Graviton-based servers.
- Define functional, stress, and in-circuit test coverage; drive first-pass yield up and defect/DPPM rates down through data-driven root cause analysis.
- Review, identify, and qualify second-source components to enable continuity of supply.
- Continuously assess process capability and innovate to simplify processes, reduce cost, and shorten cycle time across Graviton server development and manufacturing.
- Own defect containment, RMA root-cause, corrective/preventive actions (CAPA), and continuous improvement of production quality and reliability.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams — design, SI/PI, firmware, supply chain, and quality — to improve product design, processes, and quality.
- Work with upstream vendors and downstream customers to optimize the entire value stream and build joint processes that drive better cost and cycle time.
- Willingness to travel 4–6 times per year (approximately 1 week per trip) to design partner and manufacturing sites.

About the team
Our Graviton System group owns the design, manufacturing, and health of the Arm-based server fleet powering Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud). We work close to the metal — across firmware, board bring-up, diagnostics, and hardware debug — to keep servers running and return failed units to production fast. In close partnership with design partners, data center operations, and hardware engineering teams, we bring new server platforms into the fleet and drive them to launch faster, healthier, and more reliably, at a scale that directly impacts millions of customers around the world.
If you are a systems, HW, or SW engineer who thrives on hard problems at the intersection of hardware and software, enjoys root-causing failures on real servers, and wants to see your work make a measurable difference across a global fleet — we would love to talk.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent.
- 6+ years of experience bringing hardware products from design through mass production- including production test development, process development, and yield management.
- 6+ years experience with electronics manufacturing processes (SMT, assembly, system integration, test, and burn-in) and the supporting test equipment.
- Demonstrated ability to conduct manufacturing bring-up, failure analysis, and root cause investigation in both a lab and a production environment -on-site and at external CM/ODM partner sites.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience ramping server, networking, or data center hardware, especially multi-socket or GPU/AI platforms.
- Experience with production testing of DDR4/5, PCIe Gen4/5/6, CXL, and 100/400GbE.
- Knowledge of SPC, DOE, Six Sigma, and yield/data analytics.
- Experience in sustaining engineering, root cause analysis, ECOs, yield improvement, and vendor/CM support.
- Experience with Bash, Python, or SQL for data analysis, automation, or process monitoring; familiarity with AI-assisted tools.
- Exposure to networking, storage, or Linux-based servers.
- Strong technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration across design, test, firmware, supply chain, and manufacturing teams.
