title: Senior Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support and Unified Operations Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies - including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

The Role As a TAM you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services - including EC2, S3, DynamoDB and RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support, and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support and Unified Operations customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!

The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Key job responsibilities
- You'll develop strategic engagement plans, working backwards from customer outcomes, challenges and blockers
- You'll advise on solutions, provide technical guidance, and advocate for our customers
- Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
- Develop trusting relationships with customers understanding their business needs and technical challenges
- Using your technical acumen and customer obsession you'll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
- Consult with a range of stakeholders from developers through to C-suite executives
- Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
- With a bias for action you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
- Provide detailed reviews of service events, monthly and quarterly metrics, detailed pre-launch planning
- Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical engineering experience
- 5+ years of experience in design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications and infrastructure
- Experience in a similar role as a Technical Account Manager, Consultant, Solutions Architect, Platform Engineer, Systems Engineer, Cloud Architect etc.
- Understand operational parameters and troubleshooting for four (4) of the following, deep in at least one (1): Security & Compliance / Resilience & Reliability / Operational Excellence & Observability / Cost Optimisation & FinOps / Operations for AI & AI for IT Operations.
- External customer-facing experience with the ability to communicate across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Ability to juggle tasks and projects in a fast-paced environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead
- Professional experience with AWS and/or other cloud offerings such as Azure, Google Cloud Platform etc.
- Programming or scripting skills with a combination of Java, Python Perl, Ruby, C#, and/or PHP a plus but not a requirement
- Previous experience as a Software Engineer, Developer, Solution Architect, DevOps Engineer, etc.
- Understanding of DevOps practices and tools, including: Continuous Integration / Deployment, Puppet, Docker, Kubernetes, Chef etc.
- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Bachelor's degree, or Associate's degree or above
- Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering)

title: Graduate Logistics/Shift Manager - Austria Wide
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic qualifications

- Erfolgreich absolviertes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor- oder Master) vor Arbeitsbeginn
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: Operations specialist, CSBA
descriptionHtml:
Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, hungry and passionate about e-commerce? Are you an experienced professional with a strong work ethic and a bias for action? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. The ideal candidate is energized by digging into messy data, forming a hypothesis, finding the root cause, and driving a fix to closure across multiple teams and locations. We are looking for an Operations Specialist who shares Amazon's passion for the customer, someone who understands that a dependable delivery and fulfillment experience is central to how both sellers and buyers experience the Amazon platform.

In this role, you will work closely with sellers, seller support, customer service, sales, and third-party carriers to identify delivery and fulfillment issues that sellers face, and resolve their acute and short-term problems. You will investigate why sellers struggle with or leave fulfillment programs, separate seller-owned gaps from Amazon-owned gaps, and recommend specific fixes. You will also partner with product management teams to translate recurring seller pain points into longer-term features and programs that improve the seller and customer experience.



Key job responsibilities
Monitor operational performance and partner with other teams (third-party carriers, customer service, seller support, product, operations) to resolve performance issues and keep metrics within goal.
Monitor and drive seller-impacting operational tickets and escalations to resolution within defined service levels, flagging anything at risk of breaching its window ahead of time.
Run structured deep dives into seller friction and program attrition: pull and sanity-check the data yourself, form a hypothesis, establish the root cause with transaction-level evidence, identify whether the gap sits with the seller or with Amazon, and recommend a fix.
Review and investigate incoming seller issues and feedback from multiple sources, and route each finding to the right team with a clear owner and next step, leaving nothing open at the end of the week.
Size cost and savings opportunities across marketplaces and fulfillment methods, explaining what the numbers mean rather than passing dashboard output through unchanged.
Build and run recurring operational reports (including automating them where possible) and produce weekly business-review inputs that lead with the headline metric, the week-over-week movement, and the reason for any change.
Gather and analyze seller contacts and feedback to develop seller-experience improvement suggestions, and work with Product Managers on solutions.
Must be open to working on Saturday and Sunday, with any other 2 days of the week off.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with Excel

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies

title: Sr. Pre-Construction Manager with French, EMEA Pre-Construction
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Data Centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of security, safety, space utilization, efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are the global team responsible for the construction of the Amazon owned sites.
The EMEA Data Center Construction team is looking for a Senior Pre-Construction Manager to serve as the primary liaison between Real Estate, Design Engineering, Construction and other critical partner teams during initial planning, conceptual design and design development; providing cost, schedule, and constructibility guidance.
Our pre-Construction Managers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for changing the face of cloud computing. As a pre-Construction Manager you will support the development and implementation of design standards across regional construction programs and will create and release high quality, consistent documentation for processes, standards and procedures.
Our goal is to find the candidate that has highly developed critical facility pre-construction knowledge coupled with extensive practical construction experience to drive standards in this essential part of our delivery process.

If you have experience driving global pre-construction standards, bid documents, specifications and general requirements to describe all the elements of a construction project and working within a broad design and construction infrastructure environment, then this could be your role!


Key job responsibilities
-You will review and provide input into global standards and data center template designs.
-You will independently support, overview and manage complex, cross-functional Data Center projects from site selection, permitting and contract execution, and keep project stakeholders informed to contribute to the performance of the team, building trust and respect in all working relationships.
-You will keep the scope progress under control a by driving crisp and timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately.
-You will work with internal/external teams including real estate, design engineering, construction, finance, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers and landlords to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities, milestones and drive results through clearing blockers, making decisions, leading and influencing.
-You will conduct negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids/proposals participating in pricing reviews for scope inclusions/exclusions and negotiate the cost of the work with developers, general contractors and design consultants.
-You will evaluate Due Diligences, schedule tracking, and identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project hand-over to Amazon stakeholders.
-You will insist on the highest standards from self and others and drive accountability for results, leading externals, and potentially, internals, including coaching and/or disciplinary actions, as needed



A day in the life
Each day you will represent AWS in ensuring the on time and in budget execution of Amazon projects, while strategically improving its processes, costs, quality H&S, and sustainability performance.
You will be leading and mentoring large cross-functional teams as an expert technical and project management resource to complete construction projects and skillfully motivate and focus people of all levels to deliver.
You will drive significant communication across departments, to front line and executive level managers while serving as an authority on project issues.
You will leverage your experience and tools to understand where gaps exist in project plans and propose solutions.
You will be understanding and negotiating terms of contracts with developers, contractors and consultants representing AWS’ interests. Daily tasks may be comprised of site validation, due diligence and risk analysis, design management, contract/lease and cost negotiations, stakeholder and vendor management.
You will act as the primary escalation point for the evaluation of the feasibility of potential future projects and pre-development actions; owning and tracking issues to ensure that they are addressed, documented, and resolved using influence to manage team members.
You will lead negotiations with general contractors and internal procurement partners and evaluate bids/proposals/claims with detail and accuracy, reporting key construction/commercial metrics, including schedule, cost and budget.
.



About the team
Our Pre-Construction team is a multicultural, multinational group on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for changing the face of cloud computing.
We support the development and implementation of design standards across regional construction programs and will create and release high quality, consistent documentation for processes, standards and procedures and serve as the primary liaison between Real Estate, Design Engineering, Construction and other critical partner teams between site selection and construction starts on site.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering
- Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English with respect to complex technical instructions and concepts
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- 7+ years of experience in conducting negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids/proposals with detail and accuracy.
- 7+ years of experience in mission critical facilities (design, pre-construction, scheduling, construction and commissioning), or equivalent.
- 5+ years in construction site management.
- Knowledge of best practice industry safety, quality standards and local safety regulations with experience performing the role of a client within those regulations.

Support customers' order fulfillment by working directly and on a regular basis on operations tasks within your department
Deliver coaching and feedback to line operators related to productivity and quality performance, and safe behaviors
Develop subject matter expertise on all operations processes in assigned department

title: SATCOM Ecommerce Technical Program Manager, Amazon Leo Government
descriptionHtml:
Sr. Technical Program Manager - Amazon Leo Government Ecommerce

In this role, you will work with engineering teams, product management, and operational stakeholders to execute and document delivery of government customer ecommerce system develpoment, deployment and user acceptance testing (UAT) programs with considerable impact. You will cover the end-to-end development cadence and testing readiness strategy — from test case requirements definition through test automation, stakeholder sign-off, and launch — operating with limited guidance in environments where the business problem, program strategy, and technology solutions may not yet be fully defined.

You will work in a collaborative, analytical, and fast-paced environment and must be comfortable interacting with highly technical cross-functional teams. The candidate must have strong business judgment, dive deep into data, working with engineering teams on technical solution development and trade off; while also be comfortable with proposing and delivering processing tactical actions. Candidates must be able to Multi-task different business operation tasks within Amazon, engineering teams, and external vendors. The best candidates will have deep understanding of prioritization and task completion.

This role will lead complex, cross-organizational technical programs spanning multiple areas within Amazon Leo Government and external partners. Focusing on the customer lifecycle integration and optimization by driving architectural decisions and delivery of mission-critical solutions across Amazon Leo internal ecommerce and support systems, SAP, ServiceNow and other related platforms while ensuring alignment with government service requirements and commercial capabilities.




Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities

Program Definition & Strategy - Define the B2G customer UAT automation program mission, vision, and tenets for testing programs - Set clear objectives and create plans with measurable success criteria - Influence resource allocation decisions across engineering and business teams - Own organizational test roadmaps including OP1/OP2 narrative contributions
Stakeholder Alignment & Decision-Making - Drive alignment discussions with business and technical stakeholders to ensure crisp decisions on scope, schedule, and quality - Partner with accounting, security and engineering teams to prioritize and sequence testing work.

UAT & Testing Ownership - Plan and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with operations, security, finance, accounting and tax stakeholders, end users, and ALG software engineering teams before each release or launch - Assess engineering development processes, test plans, and operations/maintenance requirements - Help teams reduce exposure to classic failure modes including insufficient testing and gaps in QA - Lead participation in Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), UAT, and User Training - Define measurable success criteria for testing phases and ensure readiness gates are met before go-live

Technical Oversight - Understand ecommerce system limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and the reasons for architectural decisions relevant to testing - Oversee gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures that affect test coverage - Streamline and eliminate excess process; work with teams to improve concurrent delivery and testing cycles - Hold engineering teams to a high standard for solutions and engineering practices

Risk Management - Proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks - Be data-driven; regularly review quality metrics and seek improved visibility mechanisms - Demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate

Communication & Leadership - Write effective narratives (Amazon 6-pagers) and present to Directors and VPs - Clearly communicate development and testing progress, outcomes, and defect resolution to broad audiences.

Security Clearance: This position requires that the selected candidate be a US Citizen and must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

descriptionHtml:

The Amazon Stores Finance Tech Team is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead the strategic evolution of our financial analytics platforms supporting the Global Customer Fulfillment network. You will orchestrate the transition from legacy systems to a modern data lakehouse architecture, ensuring Finance customers have reliable, performant access to the insights they need. title: Maintenance Planner
descriptionHtml:
Without the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team, our operations grind to a halt. As an RME Planner in this core part of our large, EU-wide team, you’ll be a leading voice in all conversations surrounding the technologies in our warehouses and delivery networks. You’ll anticipate problems before they materialise and keep track of the equipment needed for different tasks to keep running smoothly. As the expert in our Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), you’ll be efficient and flexible in a fast-paced warehouse environment.

Key job responsibilities
Establish where maintenance and repairs resource should be allocated using our CMMS software
Understand and implement EU standards across all systems in your scope
Consistently review and analyse on-site equipment, ensuring stock levels remain sufficient
Monitor the maintenance system to ensure that equipment levels are correctly recorded, and that forecasting is accurate

A day in the life
The primary objective of your role as a RME Planner is to keep operations running without a hitch. Based at one of our operational sites, you’ll be responsible for managing assets and preventative maintenance planning. You’ll dive deep into logistical performance, set high standards, and aim to optimise the equipment we have available.

From small, individual machine parts to entire systems, you’ll make decisions on where maintenance resources should be applied, working closely with the local engineering team. Collaborating with other members of our EU-wide network, you’ll continue to seek out innovative new ways to drive efficiency even further.

About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we’re changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

We have ambitious plans to expand our specialist fulfilment centres and delivery stations across the UK and Europe. While those of us who work in delivery stations will do some night shifts, most of us work during the day. Our team is made up of people across operations, supply chain, business intelligence and programme management, and everyone plays a crucial role in growing this part of the business.

- Relevant experience in planning, scheduling and auditing maintenance activities
- Relevant experience working with a CMMS software

- Relevant experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written in Spanish and English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using the Infor enterprise asset management platform

- Experience in delivering training or coaching to colleagues

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about using technology to create a positive impact for people and the planet? Are you excited by the challenge of turning fragmented, manual supplier processes into a single, scalable, intelligent experience? Supplier Engagement & Development (SED) — the consolidated supplier-facing function across Amazon's Global Procurement Sustainability organization — is looking for a Program Manager to lead the Digital First Strategy and own the One Supplier Journey program: the technology spine that lets SED engage, develop, and recognize suppliers at scale across Environment, Social Responsibility, Supplier Development & Impact (SDI), and Community Impact.

In this role you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of how thousands of suppliers experience Amazon's sustainability expectations — moving them from fragmented, uncoordinated touchpoints across a dozen systems to one coordinated, self-service journey. You will translate SED's strategic priorities (communication consolidation, the Supplier for Good badge program, segmentation, and an integrated supplier portal) into a coherent technology roadmap, and you will partner deeply with Global Procurement Technology (GPT), Global Supplier Management (GSM), the Ada/Quick Suite teams, and each GPS sub-pillar to deliver it.

This is a high-visibility role where a single, well-designed platform decision can change the experience of tens of thousands of suppliers across 20+ countries and directly advance Amazon's sustainability commitments.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the Digital First Strategy for SED: define and maintain the multi-year technology roadmap that consolidates fragmented supplier-facing systems into the One Supplier Journey, sequencing delivery across communications, development, and recognition.
- Serve as SED's named business owner / co-owner for the One Supplier Journey platform and represent SED's equities in cross-organizational technology intake, ensuring supplier engagement, development, and recognition requirements are embedded in relevant roadmap projects rather than added after the fact.
- Translate SED's strategic priorities into scoped, prioritized product requirements: the Supplier for Good (S4G) Badge dashboard, the Supplier for Good (S4G) Academy (segmentation-driven training delivery), the consolidated communication/action queue, the supplier-voice feedback loop, and the AI-powered "Supplier Advisor."
- Partner with GPT, the Ada and Quick Suite teams, and Amazon Learn to design and deliver integrations (e.g., Supplier Connect, Supplier 360, EcoVadis/Avetta, Contract Central), defining build/buy decisions, phasing, and dependencies.
- Design and govern the cross-pillar content and curriculum model: establish SED as the content-governance authority while sub-pillars contribute pillar-specific modules under a shared standard.
- Define, instrument, and report the metrics that matter: supplier participation and adoption, duplicative-outreach reduction, learning completion correlated to compliance outcomes, badge-tier progression, and the commercial pull-through of certified suppliers into sourcing.
- Build mechanisms — playbooks, SOPs, intake and prioritization frameworks, and self-service pathways— that let the journey scale across categories, regions, and business units without proportional headcount growth.
- Serve as a primary point of contact for supplier-engagement technology questions and development activity across the GPS ecosystem, and drive alignment across procurement, sustainability, learning, legal, and technology partners.


A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing adoption and participation metrics from the supplier portal and triaging where suppliers are getting stuck in the journey. Mid-morning, you are in a working session with the GPT and Ada teams, pressure-testing the design of the Supplier Advisor agent and the S4G Badge dashboard against real supplier scenarios. After lunch, you are aligning three GPS sub-pillars on a single, deduplicated communication queue so suppliers stop receiving conflicting requests. Later, you are writing the requirements that connect training completion to certification scoring, and preparing a business review that connects those technology investments to supplier outcomes and GPS goals. No two days look alike, but the through-line is constant: making Amazon's sustainability expectations clear, accessible, and worth achieving for every supplier — through technology that scales.

About the team
We sit at the intersection of procurement and sustainability, focused on one mission: partnering with suppliers to make life better every day. We consolidate supplier engagement and development across Community Impact, Social Responsibility, Environment, and Supplier Development & Impact into one coordinated function, so suppliers experience a single, coherent Amazon rather than four uncoordinated ones. We make it easier for suppliers of every size — small, medium, and large; local and global — to understand what Amazon expects, to build the capabilities to meet it, and to be recognized when they do. We are collaborative, data-driven, and builder-minded: we partner across procurement, sustainability, learning, and technology to turn independent activities into a scalable, accountable system. If you want work that combines strategic thinking, technology, and tangible impact on real businesses and communities, this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- 1+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document, or experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)
- Experience running metrics reports, analyzing data to identify problems and using data analysis to generate and explain metrics
- Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
- Experience producing executive-level written materials and presenting to executive audiences
- Experience leading process improvement, systems development, and project management

title: SDE-II, Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got to you so fast? What if you could build the AI-powered systems that make that happen — and make it faster, cheaper, and more sustainable?

Watch this video to learn more about our organization, SCOT: http://bit.ly/amazon-scot

Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization is responsible for the end-to-end systems that plan, optimize, and execute the movement of billions of packages across the world's most complex logistics network. We build real-time, intelligent, and fully automated systems that touch every aspect of the delivery experience — from the moment a customer clicks "Buy" to the package arriving at their door.

What you'll work on:
- You'll join a team within SCOT that's pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI and algorithms in transportation:
- AI-Powered Network Automation – Build agentic AI systems that continuously monitor, optimize, and autonomously evolve one of the world's largest transportation networks. You'll work on systems that generate, validate, and deploy network configurations using large language models and advanced automation — moving toward a future where the network intelligently adapts itself.
- Route Optimization at Scale – Design and implement graph algorithms that find optimal routes across a massive, multi-modal transportation network — optimizing simultaneously for speed, cost, and environmental sustainability. You'll solve multi-variable optimization problems at a scale few companies in the world operate at.
- Scalable Distributed Systems – Build highly available, low-latency services that process millions of decisions in real-time, powering the backbone of Amazon's transportation planning and execution

What we're looking for:

- Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, and system design
- Experience with or passion for: graph algorithms, optimization, AI/ML systems, or generative AI
- Ability to break down ambiguous, complex problems into elegant, shippable solutions
- Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where you own your systems end-to-end
- Excellent communication skills and a track record of raising the engineering bar on your team

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises

* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- A Bachelor's degree or International Equivalent, OR 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience, OR 6+ years of Military Experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)

- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team is deeply committed to the safety and wellbeing of our people. WHS sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS) to join our team. In this role, you will be a part of the local WHS team and will lead both onsite injury prevention and proactive safety. This position will work in an Amazon Fulfillment Center and report directly to the Site WHS Manager. You will work closely with AAs one-on-one with the goal to improve physical movement techniques prior to the onset of soreness or injury through ergonomic training and engagement.

Core Impact Areas:
Proactive Prevention - Drive injury prevention through advanced data analysis and evidence-based solutions. Design and implement targeted ergonomic interventions based on risk assessment findings and injury trends. Lead comprehensive workplace evaluations to identify and eliminate potential hazards before they cause harm. Transform complex injury data into actionable strategies that protect associates and optimize work processes.

Wellness Education - Champion a culture of proactive health and injury prevention through innovative training programs and hands-on coaching. Develop and deliver engaging ergonomic education that empowers associates to make informed decisions about their wellbeing. Build trusted partnerships with operations teams to integrate prevention strategies into daily workflows. Create sustainable behavior change through personalized coaching and positive reinforcement techniques.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Must be a Certified Athletic Trainer, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification
- Must have a valid card evidencing successful completion of a First Aid, CPR, and AED course from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital recordkeeping

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with an industrial wellness program

title: System Development Engineer, Controls Development Experience
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon's Data Center Engineering organization, within the Controls Design eXecution (CDX) org, is seeking a Systems Development Engineer (SysDE) to join our Electrical Controls development team. In this role, you will design, develop, deploy, and scale control systems software on the CODESYS platform that runs the electrical controls and power distribution of AWS data centers. You will work at the intersection of software development and physical infrastructure, developing the control logic for the newest generation of in-house electrical controllers. As the controller components you develop go into their first-of-kind builds, you will occasionally travel on-site (approximately 15%) to provide real-time break/fix support and validate your work in the field.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain mechanical control systems software on the CODESYS (IEC 61131-3) PLC platform for AWS data center infrastructure.
• Develop and refine control logic, function blocks, and Sequences of Operations (SOO) to meet performance and reliability requirements across varied site types and equipment vendors.
• Perform triage, root-cause analysis, and remediation of control system issues.
• Support first-of-kind builds — the first field deployment of a newly developed controller component — including occasional on-site travel to provide real-time break/fix support.
• Partner with other electrical controls product development, Controls Design Engineering, Field Engineering, and other Data Center Engineering teams to develop the next generation of controllers.
• Document control system designs, configurations, and sequences of operation.
• Participate in design reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of controls development standards and tooling.
• Provide escalation support for critical control system issues.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Experience tools for automation (building, testing, releasing or monitoring)
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related discipline

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience with iterative, agile development methodologies (including scrum)
- Experience working in data centers or critical infrastructure
- Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences, or experience in similar environments

title: Email Marketing Manager, AWS Marketing Integrated DC
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an Email Marketing Manager to join our Events Email team. You'll own the end-to-end build and delivery of email campaigns for our global event programs from the moment a campaign is briefed through to building it in our marketing automation platform, quality-checking it, launching it and reporting on how it performed. If you're the kind of person who gets a kick out of a flawless send going out on time to the right audience, in the right language, with every link working, you'll fit right in. Come build the email campaigns behind some of the world's largest cloud technology events, reaching millions of customers across the globe.

This is a hands-on role for someone who's both the strongest Marketo practitioner in the room and a sharp marketer. You'll turn campaign plans into high-quality, localized, compliant emails that go out across multiple regions and time zones, partnering closely with campaign managers, content, localization, and platform teams. You'll also help raise the bar on how we build, test, and quality-check email at scale.

What you'll bring:

Deep hands-on expertise in a marketing automation platform (Marketo / Adobe Marketo Engage)
A sharp eye for detail and calm under tight launch deadlines
Strong understanding of email compliance (consent, suppression, regional tracking rules) and deliverability
Experience building and QA-ing localized email across multiple markets
Clear communication and the ability to juggle many campaigns and stakeholders at once

Key job responsibilities
Build, test, and launch email campaigns and automated journeys in our marketing automation platform including audience segmentation, dynamic content and reusable templates.
Own email quality before launch: run quality reviews and live send tests, and make sure every email renders correctly, all links are live, and the send meets our standards and compliance rules.
Manage the full lifecycle of each email, from intake through build, localization, review, deployment, and post-send reporting keeping sends on schedule across regional launch windows.
Apply consent, suppression, and regional tracking requirements, and protect sender reputation through list hygiene and bounce management.
Coordinate and quality-check multi-language versions of each email so specs and content standards hold in every market.
Build and improve reusable templates and modules that let the wider team create emails faster and with fewer errors.
Partner with campaign, content, and platform teams to translate requirements into technical build specs on short timelines.
Report on performance by send and audience and turn the results into recommendations that improve engagement.
Troubleshoot build, rendering, deliverability and data issues, and work with vendors and engineering on fixes.
Manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders at once while meeting agreed service levels and flagging risk early.

A day in the life
No two days look the same there's always an event on the horizon. You might start by reviewing how an overnight send performed in another region, then build the next campaign in the automation platform: audience, localized content, and logic. Midday, you'll quality-check a teammate's email before launch and give it the green light. In the afternoon, you'll turn a new brief into a build plan, coordinate translated versions, or troubleshoot a deliverability issue with the platform team. and you make sure they land at the highest quality

About the team
We're the Events Email team, and we run the email that powers AWS's biggest global events - Summits around the world, re:Invent, and more. Every invitation, reminder, and follow-up that helps millions of customers discover and register for these events comes through us. We're a tight, globally distributed group that cares deeply about quality: getting the right message to the right person, in the right language, on time, every time. We move fast, support each other across time zones, and take real pride in flawless launches. If you love email done well, you'll feel at home here.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
- Experience in audience segmentation and targeting
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience with at least one enterprise marketing automation platform (e.g., Adobe Marketo Engage, Oracle Eloqua, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in designing, building, and launching successful email engagement programs, specifically events programs
- Experience using at least one enterprise event technology platform (e.g., RainFocus, Cvent, or Jomablue)
- Adobe Marketo Engage Certified Expert or equivalent marketing automation certification

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Private Brands
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Private Brands (APB) is reinventing Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) with AI at its core. Private Brands Central (PBC) is our PLM platform, and we're building a new generation of AI-native experiences, from Gen AI copilots that accelerate new product development to agentic workflows that automate the manual, high-dwell steps in bringing a product to market.

As a Software Development Engineer II on our team, you will design and build the AI-powered components and features that make this happen, working across the full software development lifecycle, from working backwards from customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You'll get to apply the latest Gen AI tools and techniques to real, high-volume product-development problems and see the efficiency gains land. title: Product Designer, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Observability is being rewritten. For a decade the job was to watch servers, services, and dashboards — metrics, logs, and traces for systems that did what they were told. That world is ending. The systems people now have to understand reason, call tools, and act on their own, and they generate signal at a scale and unpredictability the old tooling was never built for. When something breaks at 2am, the question is no longer only "which host is down" — it's "what did the system decide, why, and what did it touch."

AWS CloudWatch is where that gets solved at scale, for hundreds of thousands of engineers. You'll focus on two of the places that future is being built: Omni, a blank-canvas, IDE-style way to explore and query telemetry, and the DevOps agent — an AI agent that helps engineers investigate and resolve issues with a human in the loop. Your work will shape how engineers actually move through these experiences: what they see first, how they navigate, and how a problem goes from signal to cause to fix.

We're looking for a Product Designer who's hungry to do excellent craft on genuinely hard problems. You won't be handed pixel-perfect specs to execute — you'll own features end to end, partner closely with PM and engineering, and grow your scope as you show you can carry it. You'll have senior designers around you to learn from and a domain where the right answers aren't settled yet.

If you want to sharpen your craft on one of the most consequential problems in cloud — alongside people who treat CX as the thing that wins, not the thing you add at the end — this is a great place to do it.


Key job responsibilities
1. Own the design of features within Omni and the DevOps agent experience — from early exploration and IA through interaction, visual craft, and ship — with guidance from senior designers and your manager.
2. Make complex system behavior legible: turn high-cardinality, fast-moving telemetry and agent activity into views an engineer can actually reason about.
3. Design for the agentic shift — experiences where an AI agent helps engineers investigate and resolve issues, and where the human stays firmly in control (what the agent found, what it proposes, and how a person approves or redirects it).
4. Partner day to day with PM and engineering, contributing to problem definition — not just executing handed-off specs — and iterating quickly from their input.
5. Build prototypes that communicate intent precisely and move conversations forward.
6. Fold in evidence — usability testing, customer sessions, and telemetry — and let what you learn change the design.
7. Contribute to the shared design system: use and extend patterns rather than inventing one-off screens.

A day in the life
Morning. You pick up the feature you're closest to — say, how the Omni/DevOps agent surfaces what it found while triaging an incident, and how an engineer approves or redirects the next step. You've got a flow in progress and a couple of questions from yesterday's sync. You take a focused block to push the interaction model before the day fills up.

Midday. A working session with your PM and an engineer. You walk through your latest cut, hear what's technically cheap versus expensive, and leave with a sharper direction. You're part of the problem-definition conversation, not waiting at the end of it.

Afternoon. You sit in on a customer usability session and watch someone get stuck exactly where you worried they might. You bring the flow to design critique, get it pressure-tested by the broader team, and give feedback on someone else's work too. You end the day updating your prototype with what you learned.

The throughline. You're close to real customer problems, you're growing your scope with real support around you, and the work you do shows up in the product in weeks, not quarters.

About the team
We're the design team behind the broader AWS Security, Search, Observability & Governance organization. Our mandate is to make the most technical, highest-stakes workflows in cloud feel clear, fast, and even good to use.

What's distinctive about us:

- Design is the competitive advantage here. We're betting that in a market still figuring out what observability for the AI era even looks like, the team with the clearest experience wins — and we back that with real scope for designers at every level.
- We ship, and we ship hard things. Omni, the DevOps agent, core monitoring at massive scale — these are launching now, to real customers, against real competitors. Your work isn't theoretical.
- We work from evidence. Usability labs, customer sessions, and telemetry are part of the rhythm, not an afterthought.
- It's a place to grow. The designers around you have deep backgrounds in AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise platforms. You'll be challenged, well-supported, and surrounded by people worth learning from.

If you want to do excellent work in observability for the AI era — and grow fast while you're at it — come build it with us.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in design
- Experience in delivering design solutions as a UX designer or interaction designer
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience prototyping (HTML, XHTML, JavaScript, CSS, Flash or Flash Catalyst, or Axure)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in mass-market consumer web / mobile products
- Experience working in a collaborative team and working directly with developers for implementation of designs

title: Air Program Manager, AWS Environmental
descriptionHtml:
Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As a member of the Environmental team, you will support environmental programs aimed at ensuring compliance with air quality regulations and standards in the Americas while also enabling AWS's growth around the world.

As an Air Program Manager, your primary focus will be serving as the air compliance subject matter expert (SME) across an Americas sub-region, providing programmatic oversight and ensuring alignment of compliance practices across all AWS data centers. You will build regional-level compliance infrastructure (frameworks, standards, tools, and visibility) and provide functional direction to the Regional Environmental Engineers (REEs) who execute compliance at their sites. You will work closely with the Environmental team, engineering, operations teams, vendors, and other partners to ensure consistent application of air quality compliance programs, particularly those related to Tier 4 compliant diesel generators. Your role will involve providing technical expertise on local, state, and federal air regulations and creating strategies for continuous improvement in air compliance management. As the team's air compliance SME, you will support REEs across the region to resolve complex air compliance challenges and drive environmental performance. You will also play a key role in standardizing incident response and reporting protocols related to air compliance events.

The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of air compliance and regulatory requirements in North America, demonstrated ability to develop and standardize complex compliance systems across multiple jurisdictions, and proven experience leading air quality initiatives that drive environmental performance and sustainability. The ideal candidate will excel at providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong attention to technical details and have a track record of successfully collaborating with diverse stakeholders to implement environmental compliance programs at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and lead regional air quality compliance programs, providing standards and functional direction to in-region engineers across North and South America
- Set and maintain the regional framework for compliance with federal, state, and local air quality regulations related to emergency backup power systems
- Ensure compliance with EPA regulations including 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII (Standards of Performance for Stationary Compression Ignition Internal Combustion Engines)
- Develop and implement air quality monitoring programs and compliance tracking systems for permitted backup power generation (Tier 2/Tier 4 diesel generators, natural gas, etc)
- Establish standardized emissions testing programs and protocols that engineers and testing firms execute at their sites
- Provide technical guidance on air quality compliance requirements
- Support emergency response planning related to air quality incidents
- Collaborate with the air permitting team and in-region engineers to ensure operational compliance with existing permit conditions
- Stay current with evolving air quality regulations and industry best practices for diesel generator management
- Develop and deliver air quality compliance training for relevant staff
- Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for air quality compliance

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years with air permitting and/or compliance experience at local, state, federal levels

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
- 3+ years with engine specific regulations including 40 CFR 63 Subpart ZZZZ and 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII

We're changing an industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today.

Key job responsibilities
- Perform finite element simulations and analytical modeling to evaluate assembly, test, and reliability risks for advanced semiconductor packages
- Design and execute experiments on materials and packaging or system structures to validate performance and inform design decisions

- Collaborate with Quality and Reliability, Package Design, Test, and System Design teams to optimize package architectures and resolve cross-functional technical challenges
- Communicate findings through clear documentation and design reviews, contributing to specifications and trade-off analyses that guide team decisions

A day in the life
Your primary focus is ensuring the thermal and mechanical integrity of Annapurna's semiconductor packages. On a given day you might run finite element simulations to stress-test a new package stackup, then head to the lab to collect experimental data on material behavior under thermal cycling. You'll review results with Package Design engineers, flag risks to the Quality and Reliability team, and refine your models based on real-world feedback — all while keeping an eye on how your work feeds into the next product generation.

About the team
Annapurna Labs, our organization within Amazon Web Services (AWS), designs custom silicon and software that accelerates cloud innovation. Within Annapurna, the Packaging team focuses on the thermal, mechanical, and materials engineering challenges that come with pushing semiconductor package performance forward. We work closely with Quality and Reliability, Package Design, Test, and System Design groups to deliver robust, manufacturable solutions at data-center scale.

Our team values collaboration and knowledge sharing. We are investing in advanced packaging technologies to support the growing demands of machine learning and compute workloads, and you will play a direct role in shaping those next-generation solutions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 5+ years industry experience in mechanical design of semiconductor-based systems – silicon, packaging, and system design
- 3+ years industry experience in advanced packaging of semiconductors
- Direct experience in designing and testing of test vehicles to assess future packaging architectures and evaluating properties of next-generation materials
- Expertise in optimizing in packaging architectures to meet quality, performance, and cost goals
- Industry experience of working with packaging component vendors and ODMs, and internal design teams on cross-boundary triaging, debugging, and resolving issues across organization
- Proficiency with simulation tools such as ANSYS, ABAQUS, COMSOL, FLOTHERM, ICEPACK or equivalent FEA/CFD software

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in advanced packaging metrologies for characterization, and design validation of semiconductor components, packages, and platforms. Hands-on experience with lab-based thermal and mechanical measurements, including instrumentation, infrared thermography, acoustic chambers, mechanical stress/strain gauges, power measurement equipment, and thermal test setups for package and system-level characterization.
- Strong understanding of product development lifecycles from concept through high volume manufacturing
- Experience with various types of technologies used for Heatsink solutions, Thermal Interface Materials (TIMs) and liquid cooling technologies - including cold plate design. Working knowledge on fans, UQDs, manifolds, and CDUs.
- Developed detailed CFD and compact RC models for SoC and Package thermal analysis. Experience correlating simulation models with experimental data and iterating designs based on empirical findings.
- Demonstrated ability to design, set up, and execute experiments in a lab environment, including building custom test fixtures, operating data acquisition systems, and performing root-cause failure analysis on hardware. Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE) and Six Sigma methodologies.
- Knowledge of hardware and software based thermal / power management control algorithms
- Validated thermal models through power/thermal measurements on Hardware

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, LOAF - Lifecycle of A Finding
descriptionHtml:
Join LOAF to drive programs that eradicate entire classes of security vulnerabilities across all of Amazon. As a Senior TPM, you will own cross-org initiatives that shift security left and prevent escapes before they happen, leveraging neural networks and unified visibility across Amazon's full security landscape.

LOAF maintains the single unified view of security escapes across all of Amazon and builds the tooling to prevent them. We don't just find vulnerabilities; we eliminate the patterns that create them. This role puts you at the intersection of security strategy and engineering execution at Amazon-wide scale.

Own and drive programs spanning multiple organizations to implement shift-left security strategies that prevent escapes at their source
Partner with engineering teams across Amazon to adopt LOAF tooling and neural network-powered detection capabilities

Define program roadmaps that move the needle on eradicating vulnerability classes, not just individual findings

Operate with high visibility to senior leadership, translating complex technical security work into measurable business impact

Navigate ambiguity across diverse stakeholder groups with competing priorities to drive alignment and delivery

You will thrive in this role if you enjoy working across organizational boundaries, can earn trust quickly with deeply technical teams, and want your programs to have measurable impact on Amazon's overall security posture.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead escape prevention programs end-to-end, defining milestones, tracking delivery, and removing blockers across multiple engineering teams
- Drive shift-left security initiatives that embed vulnerability prevention earlier in the software development lifecycle, reducing escapes at the source
- Partner with internal security teams to align on priorities and ensure LOAF tooling meets their needs
- Own technical delivery for cross-org programs, translating security strategy into executable plans with clear dependencies and timelines
- Manage stakeholder communication across all levels, from service team engineers to Directors and VPs, ensuring visibility into program health and risk
- Define and track program metrics that measure real reduction in escape volume and vulnerability class coverage
- Identify and drive process improvements that accelerate how quickly Amazon can respond to and prevent new vulnerability patterns
- Coordinate cross-team dependencies and resolve conflicts when multiple organizations have competing priorities or resource constraints

title: Tax Analyst, Federal Compliance & Reporting, Tax Provision Technology
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Tax department is a fast-paced, team-focused and dynamic environment. Amazon is seeking a Tax Analyst to join our Federal Tax Reporting and Compliance team with experience in process improvements and data analytics to help deliver support surrounding US Federal income tax filings and the US Federal elements of Amazon’s worldwide tax provision.

This role will be part of a specialized team driving the delivery of solutions to standardize, optimize and transform tax processes that will scale as the business grows. You will help define the right models, tools and mechanisms necessary to address business opportunities, drive automation, improve controllership and earn trust across the tax organization. Amazon has a culture of being builders and you will get to use the latest technology and internal Amazon tools to help scale big and fast.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated great attention to detail, a proven track record of building and improving complex financial models, effective written and verbal communication skills and a strong desire to continuously learn and invent. You must be a fast learner who can quickly understand Amazon's data structure. You need to be analytical in decision-making with ability to drive issues to completion.


Key job responsibilities
• Perform hands-on data delivery, detailed data research and analysis of large-scale, complex financial data sets; investigate, troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data
• Collaborate with customer teams to identify opportunities for improving efficiency and controllership in current processes to eliminate manual efforts within the US Federal Tax Return and worldwide tax provision
• Drive process improvements and coordinate with the Tax Technology team to facilitate streamlining and automation
• Develop tax models for various tax calculations and review tools through the creation of end-to-end scalable processes by leveraging technology.
• Preparation and review of tax adjustments, audit-ready workpapers and federal tax returns for US reporting
• Stay up-to-date on tax law and organizational impact of those changes


About the team
The Federal Reporting and Compliance team manages Amazon's worldwide taxable income calculations and federal tax obligations. We own the full lifecycle of federal tax provision and compliance, including worldwide taxable income calculations for quarterly closes, forecasts, and annual returns. While collaborating with specialist teams on areas like stock compensation, R&D credits, and TCJA provisions, we drive technological innovation and process improvements to enhance efficiency and controllership in our deliverables. Our work directly impacts Amazon's global tax provision and US federal income tax reporting.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business or related field
- 2+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
- Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
- Experience with Corptax tax return and provision preparation or equivalent software
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department

Preferred qualifications

- CPA
- Passion for process, data and efficiencies
- Positive mindset, strong professionalism, sound judgment and an insatiable intellectual curiosity
