title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, GES NA, Technical Vendor Management, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
Are you an innovative leader that wants to lead the cross-functional design and deployment of innovative solutions into our world-class existing fulfillment centers and logistics systems? Do you want to take ownership of solving the industry’s most complex problems? Does the challenge of designing and implementing ground breaking solutions for automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing appeal to you? If you’re looking to be challenged in a fast paced and often ambiguous environment, and you have strong technical problem solving and project management skills, then this job is for you!

Amazon is searching for an innovative and solutions-oriented Technical Program Manager who is able to collaborate effectively with internal and external technical teams and be responsible for the design, development and deployment of our material handling systems across multiple building types. The role primarily focuses on the Technical Program Management of integrating systems and devices and delivering turnkey deployable solutions to be delivered in the field.

In this role you will be responsible for working with internal customers to define highly ambiguous problem statements, influencing a global Amazon MHE sourcing and integration strategy, writing technical specifications and performing technical evaluations on equipment, generating multiyear budgets, driving project schedules from design to release, and managing multiple large, high visibility programs simultaneously through the project lifecycle.

This person will possess a strong engineering and program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current MHE technologies and storage solutions. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an innovative environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done.

This role requires 50% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
- Own multiple large, complex programs through the full development and deployment lifecycle — you are the accountable driver from concept through field delivery
- Partner with internal customers to define ambiguous problem statements and translate them into clear technical requirements and specifications
- Contribute to Amazon's MHE sourcing and integration strategy by evaluating vendor capabilities, performing technical assessments, and generating data-driven recommendations
- Understand product integration requirements across mechanical, electrical, and controls functions at a systems level
- Critique and debate technical designs, assess viability of proposed solutions, and help engineering teams make appropriate trade-offs considering business goals, throughput, quality, maintainability, and operability
- Drive project schedules from design through release, managing dependencies and risks across internal and external stakeholders
- Generate multiyear budgets and track program financials
- Identify engineering standards and drive consistent application of changes across North America
- Synthesize complex technical and business inputs into clear documentation and specifications
- Lead weekly Team Leads Sync meetings — facilitate agenda, surface hot topics, and track open action items
- Facilitate bi-weekly Team All Call meetings, coordinating topic shares across the team
- Compile and distribute bi-weekly Lookahead/Flash reports covering highlights, lowlights, key meetings, FAT testing schedules, and vendor POCs
- Manage monthly document reviews, ensuring working papers are reviewed internally before leadership submission
- Support quarterly business reviews by compiling executive summaries, sub-pillar updates, FAQs, and appendices
- Prepare quarterly Big Rocks updates for leadership review
- Coordinate annual Charter/Strategy and Headcount Reviews, maintaining documentation in SharePoint and WorkDocs
- Support annual goal-setting processes and provide monthly goal update reminders
- Manage the Team Request Tracker — assign and track action items across team members
- Maintain and optimize operational mechanisms in Smartsheet and Slack to support team workflows

A day in the life
Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Technical Vendor Management operates at the intersection of engineering execution and vendor partnership across North America. A day in the life may involve leading a weekly business review with a general contractor, reviewing scorecard data to identify systemic performance patterns, conducting a strategic planning session with your team leads, or presenting portfolio risk assessments to GES leadership. You will engage with vendor executives, coordinate with GPO on sourcing decisions, align with TVM counterparts, and drive cross-portfolio intelligence that no single project team can see. GES NA Technical Vendor Management is highly collaborative, working daily to make vendor performance consequential, vendor relationships strategic, and Amazon’s construction supply base stronger every year.

About the team
The Technical Vendor Management (TVM) organization is an engineering and performance-focused function within NA GES, consisting of five pillars: TVM MHE Vendor Management, TVM MHE Vendor Development, TVM MHE Components, Construction Contracts, and Technical Vendor Management, Construction. We manage the full project lifecycle of Amazon’s vendor relationships for general contractors and specialty subcontractors—from qualification through active project execution, performance accountability, and continuous improvement. Technical Vendor Management exists because vendor performance directly impacts whether Amazon’s network launches on time, on budget, and at the quality level operations require. With our team, vendor performance improves year over year because we make it consequential. We build strategic relationships that unlock decisions site-level teams cannot reach, see patterns across the portfolio that no single project can see, and act on them before they repeat.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or other STEM field
- 5+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience managing end-to-end project lifecycles including scope definition, scheduling, risk management, vendor coordination, and delivery
- Experience with project management tools and reporting frameworks (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent) and data-driven decision-making
- Position includes travel up to 50% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: Colo Controls Engineer, APAC Controls Deployment and Service Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world leader in providing a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world!

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data centre industry. You will be responsible for innovating, deploying, optimising, and maintaining the automation systems within the data centres. Automation systems consist of building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space.

As a Controls Engineer you will:

Perform controls root cause analysis.
Schedule and supervise Quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS.
Provide vendor management.
Develop scope of work for site improvement projects.
Support Global Controls projects team.
Work under tight project timelines.
Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate difficult situations.
Review controls sequence of operation and provide feedback to design.
Financially manage service invoices.
Provide technical assistance to internal customers during life cycle of the data center.
Participate in a global on-call schedule.
Grow in technical ability by learning a multitude of different automation platforms.

Controls Engineer may also perform the following:
Ensure data center controls are deployed in accordance with scope of work (SOW) and specifications.
Develop building automation controls drawings and wiring diagrams.
Size controls valves and damper actuators and select controls devices.
Review and provide feedback on mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) drawings.
Develop controls bill of material (BOM).
Develop and modify controls logic programming.
Develop and modify graphical user interface.
Act in a project sponsor capacity.

Key job responsibilities
Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)
Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

A day in the life
* Join the cloud leader: Customers are choosing AWS over other providers because it has a lot more functionality, the largest and most dynamic community of customers and partners, the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
* Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
* Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
* Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
* Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.


About the team
The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers six disciplines of deployments, projects, service, colo, on-call support, and management.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:
Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in full lifecycle deployment and maintenance of Industrial automation system: PLC, SCADA, BMS, EPMS, DCS, HMIs
- Experience in scripting/automation (Python, SQL, or similar) for data extraction, reporting, or controls system configuration

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
- Experience in electrical or mechanical engineering
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Mandarin
- Familiarity with data analytics platforms (e.g., AWS IoT Analytics, SageMaker, or equivalent) for industrial data processing
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Cantonese.

title: Software Development Manager, Product Data Quality Measurement Systems
descriptionHtml:
Every time a customer searches, browses or asks an AI assistant for help on Amazon, the experience depends on great product data. Lead the team that defines what "high-quality" means for every product in our catalog of billions, and builds the LLM and agentic systems that measure it.

Amazon's Catalog Systems division is looking for an exceptional engineering manager to lead, architect and deliver Generative AI-powered solutions that measure and raise the quality of the world's largest product catalog. An accurate, information-rich catalog powers product discovery, helps customers make confident buying decisions and makes Amazon the first stop for shoppers. That's true whether customers shop through search and detail pages or through conversational assistants and AI agents.

You'll be the engineering leader behind the single quality score used across Amazon for every product. Brands and sellers use it to fix their listings. Category leaders use it to set goals. Search, shopping experiences and AI assistants use it to decide which products and details to show customers. Your systems use LLMs and multimodal models to find defects in titles, attributes, bullet points, rich content, variations and images. They catch text that contradicts the product image, weigh each defect by how much it hurts the customer, and roll it all into one score people trust.

There's no single right answer here, and that's what makes it interesting. Some days it's a smart heuristic or a classic ML model. Other days it's LLM-as-a-judge, multimodal reasoning or an autonomous agent that improves its own prompts. You'll do all of this at a scale few places can offer, and your work will shape how millions of customers discover and buy products worldwide.

What you'll work on:

- GenAI and LLMs: Run production LLM and multimodal pipelines at catalog scale. Benchmark models, tune prompts and fine-tune for high precision at low cost.
- Agentic systems: Build AI agents that detect defects, find root causes, check their own accuracy and close the loop with selling partners. Bring agentic coding practices to how your team builds software.
- Powering customer experiences: Supply trusted, machine-readable quality signals that search, detail pages, recommendations and AI shopping assistants use to decide which products and details customers see.
- Scale and cost: Build batch and real-time, event-driven systems on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, EMR/Spark, ECS, Lambda). Keep inference and compute costs growing more slowly than the catalog.
- Measuring the measurers: Track precision and recall for every detector, and use human-in-the-loop auditing and smart sampling to build ground truth.
- Insights and guardrails: Give brands and sellers fast feedback and self-service insights, and set up AI guardrails that block bad data before it reaches the catalog.
What you'll own:

- The vision, strategy and roadmap for AI-driven product quality measurement
- Hiring, mentoring and growing a high-performing team of engineers and tech leads
- Partnerships with science, image/media, catalog and selling partner teams to keep raising the quality bar
- Technical decisions that balance innovation, accuracy, cost and operational excellence
If you want your work to shape what millions of customers see every day, however they choose to shop, let's talk.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the long-term vision and strategy for AI-driven product data quality measurement, and turn it into a roadmap your team can deliver.
- Lead a team of software engineers, including senior engineers, to architect, build, test and deploy scalable batch and real-time systems with a constant focus on customers.
- Drive delivery of LLM, multimodal and agentic solutions that detect product data defects, weigh them by customer impact and roll them up into a trusted quality score.
- Partner with science teams to benchmark models, tune prompts and fine-tune, so quality signals stay accurate as costs come down.
- Set and track precision, recall and cost metrics for every detection system, and use the results to keep improving.
- Work with image/media, search, catalog and selling partner teams to define product quality and turn measurements into fixes customers can see, across search, detail pages and AI shopping assistants.
- Make technical decisions that balance speed, accuracy, cost and operational excellence. Manage technical debt and own system reliability and on-call health.
- Hire, mentor and develop engineers and future technical leaders, and keep the team performing at a high level.
- Report on progress, quality, operations and system performance to senior leadership, and influence their technical direction and investment decisions.

A day in the life
Your main job is making sure the product quality score is accurate, trusted and gets better every week. Most mornings start with your team's dashboards. Are the detectors catching real defects? Did a new LLM prompt raise precision or just cost? Is the real-time pipeline healthy?

From there, the day is a mix of people and problems. You might work through a design with your engineers on scaling a new multimodal check to billions of products. Then you might sit down with scientists to decide whether a fine-tuned model is ready for production. You'll also meet with partner teams in image, search and selling partner experience, who rely on your score and bring you the hard questions. For example, why does this product get a low grade? Or can you flag this defect before it goes live?

Your customers are both inside and outside Amazon. Brands and sellers use your signals to fix their listings. Category leaders use them to set goals. Shopping experiences, from search to AI assistants, use them to decide what customers see.

Some days go beyond the usual work. You might dig into a customer complaint that shows a gap in how quality is measured, try out an AI agent that improves its own prompts, or explain to senior leaders why a metric moved. And you'll always make time to coach your team and help your engineers grow.

About the team
We believe every customer should be able to shop on Amazon with confidence in the product information they see. Our team builds the systems that measure product data quality across billions of products, then turns them into action. Brands and sellers use our insights to improve their listings, category teams use them to set goals, and shopping experiences from search to AI assistants use them to decide what customers see. You'll work with engineers, scientists and partner teams in image, search and selling partner experience. We value trust over coverage, design for billions from day one, and believe customer stories reveal what metrics miss.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Brand Specialist

Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role

Account Management- Brand Specialist

As a Brand Specialist you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon.

You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.

You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing activities/campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting business.



Key job responsibilities
• Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.

• Partnering with the Retail Category Team and build successful communication channels at all levels, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan for the vendors.

• Build and execute on a joint business plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.

title: DC/DC Power Electronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a DC/DC Power Electronics Engineer to design isolated high-power DC/DC converter stages forming the core of the MV-to-800 VDC SST power-conversion architecture.

As a DC/DC Power Electronics Engineer you will own the DC/DC stage: Designs DAB/CLLC isolated converters at the core of the MV-to-800 VDC chain, delivering a defined stage independently. You will optimize ZVS/ZCS regions, high-frequency modulation, paralleling/current-sharing and efficiency across variable AI/data-center load profiles. You will coordinate with MFT/inductor, front-end and 800 VDC interfaces and validates transient/efficiency/thermal behavior against measurement.

About AIS
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Converter development:
- Design DAB, CLLC and related isolated DC/DC converter architectures.
- Develop high-frequency modulation strategies for high-power operation.
- Optimize ZVS/ZCS operating regions and switching performance.
- Evaluate efficiency across variable AI/data-center load profiles.

System interaction:
- Coordinate DC/DC design with medium-frequency transformer and inductor designs.
- Define electrical interfaces with the AC/DC front end and 800 VDC output.
- Assess paralleling, current sharing and module fault-isolation strategies.
- Support protection and control requirements for the DC/DC stage.

Simulation & validation:
- Use PLECS, PSIM and/or MATLAB/Simulink to model converter behavior.
- Validate transient response, efficiency and thermal performance.
- Correlate simulation with hardware measurements.
- Support prototype testing and design iteration.

SST System Alignment:
- Design the isolated DC/DC stage to support the system 800 Vdc unipolar LVDC interface, including ±0.5% switching ripple, ±1% static regulation and ±3% dynamic regulation targets.
- Support 150%/150 ms fault-protection coordination and 120%/5 s overload capability, subject to final product-level verification.
- Address redundancy, catcher/block architectures, current sharing and LVDC load-profile verification.

A day in the life
As a DC/DC Power Electronics Engineer, your primary focus is designing and optimizing isolated converter architectures that serve as the core of our medium-voltage to 800 VDC power-conversion chain. You'll spend your time developing DAB and CLLC converter designs, using simulation tools like PLECS, PSIM, and MATLAB/Simulink to model converter behavior and validate performance against real-world requirements.

Your day involves collaborating with colleagues across magnetics, thermal, controls, and PCB design to ensure your DC/DC stage integrates seamlessly with the broader system. You'll coordinate electrical interfaces with the AC/DC front end and 800 VDC output, assess paralleling and current-sharing strategies, and support prototype testing to correlate simulation results with hardware measurements. You'll also document design decisions, trade-offs, and technical specifications to ensure clarity across the team and support future iterations.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure—the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they depend on. Our team is committed to advancing power-conversion technology to support the next generation of AI and data-center infrastructure. We're building a collaborative environment where engineers from different disciplines—power electronics, magnetics, thermal management, and controls—work together to solve complex technical challenges. You'll be part of a group that values continuous learning, knowledge-sharing, and mentorship as we push the boundaries of what's possible in power electronics. We're excited to welcome someone who can contribute to our vision of delivering efficient, reliable, and scalable power solutions for the future of cloud computing

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering,
- Experience with isolated high-power DC/DC converter design.
- Experience with high-voltage power electronics and laboratory validation.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate with controls, magnetics, thermal and PCB engineers.
- Experience documenting design decisions, assumptions, trade-offs, risks and technical specifications.

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years experience in isolated high-power DC/DC (DAB/CLLC/LLC) design and validation.
- Demonstrated strong knowledge of DAB/CLLC or comparable resonant/isolated topologies.
- Demonstrated understanding of soft switching, modulation and dynamic response.

title: Senior Human Rights Due Diligence Advisor, WW Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements that support Amazon's long-term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact on communities and the environment while helping shape the future of sustainable business practices.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon's scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable. Through innovative programs and strategic partnerships, we're creating lasting positive change in the communities where we operate while advancing Amazon's commitment to environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

Amazon's Human Rights & Social Impact program drives customer trust, business continuity, and sustainable social impact by embedding respect for human rights throughout Amazon’s entire value chain. We implement company-wide standards and commitments such as our Global Human Rights Principles (GHRP) and Supply Chain Standards (SCS). We seek to continuously improve the tools and processes used in integrating human rights due diligence across the business. We work with businesses across Amazon to embed and scale respect for human rights. Within HRSI, the Human Rights Due Diligence (HRDD) team works with businesses to identify and prioritize human rights risks across the value chain, and develops the methodologies that assess those risks and measure the performance of business efforts to prevent and mitigate harm.

We are hiring a Senior Human Rights Due Diligence Advisor to serve as a specialized subject matter expert operating at the intersection of two areas: (1) due diligence advisory services and (2) methodology and tool development. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can work both strategically and tactically, operate with limited guidance in ambiguous problem spaces, and act as the primary point of accountability for complex human rights due diligence work.

As a trusted advisor to HRSI teams, Worldwide Sustainability partners, and business customers, you will own multiple or complex business relationships, conduct end-to-end risk analyses, and translate international human rights standards into operational guidance. Critically, you will not only bring deep knowledge of frameworks such as the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights; you will operationalize them by designing quantitative, data-driven methodologies and risk scoring logics that make human rights risk measurable and comparable at enterprise scale. You will also serve as a single-threaded leader for methodology and tool development, defining the strategy and frameworks that enable the entire team's success.


Key job responsibilities
- Own multiple or complex business relationships for human rights due diligence, serving as the primary point of accountability for assigned businesses.
- Work with businesses to identify and prioritize human rights risks across the value chain.
- Conduct end-to-end risk analyses, write comprehensive risk reports, and translate findings into actionable insights for business stakeholders.
- Design and develop quantitative, data-driven methodologies and risk scoring logics that assess human rights risk and measure the performance of business efforts to prevent and mitigate harm.
- Act as a single-threaded leader (STL) for the end-to-end development of enterprise due diligence methodologies and tools, often in ambiguous contexts where the desired outcome is not previously defined.
- Partner with other HRDD advisors to understand their use cases and needs, defining strategy and frameworks that enable the broader team to succeed.
- Assess risks across differing business models, supply chain structures, and regulatory environments while maintaining a big-picture view of how human rights risks connect to business goals and compliance requirements.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to HRSI teams and Amazon businesses, translating international standards into operational realities.

Basic qualifications

- - Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., human rights, international development, law, sustainability, social sciences, or related).
- - 8+ years of experience in human rights, sustainability, ESG, responsible sourcing, or corporate due diligence.
- - Demonstrated knowledge of international human rights frameworks, particularly the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
- - Experience developing quantitative, data-driven risk methodologies or scoring logics that translate qualitative standards into measurable, comparable outputs.
- - Familiarity with human rights due diligence regulation (e.g., CSDDD, CSRD, national supply chain due diligence and modern slavery laws).
- - Experience conducting human rights or value chain risk assessments and translating findings into actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.
- - Pragmatic operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, working across functions and business teams with competing priorities to find actionable, high-judgment solutions. Skilled at translating human rights standards into practical approaches that deliver value to the business while delivering for people.
- - Experience working independently on complex or ambiguous programs with limited guidance.

Preferred qualifications

- - Advanced degree in human rights, law, international affairs, sustainability, or a related discipline.
- - Experience developing due diligence methodologies, frameworks, or tools for use across an enterprise or multiple business units.
- - Experience building risk scoring models or measurement frameworks in partnership with data science, analytics, or product teams.
- - Experience serving as a single-threaded leader or program owner driving alignment across cross-functional stakeholders (science, product, legal, and business teams).
- - Experience advising senior leaders and building durable stakeholder relationships across a large, complex organization.

descriptionHtml:
このポジションでは、Amazonで急速な進化を遂げる広告事業において、動画広告セールスの重要な役割を担っていただきます。

広告主のビジネス目標およびマーケティング課題を深く理解した上で、Prime Video広告を中心とした動画広告ソリューション（Fire TV、Twitch、DSP経由の3rd party動画広告等）を活用し、ブランド構築および中長期的な成長を支援します。

本ポジションは新設ロールとして、新規顧客開拓に対する明確なオーナーシップを担います。動画広告を起点に、これまでAmazon Adsと接点の少なかった広告主も含め、幅広い顧客に対してAmazonが持つ購買シグナルや独自のインサイトを活用した価値提案を行い、長期的なパートナーシップ構築を目指します。

パフォーマンスマーケティングに限定せず、Amazon Adsの認知ソリューションの価値を分かりやすく伝え、動画広告が広告主のビジネスにどのようなインパクトをもたらすのかを、中長期視点で説明する役割も担います。

title: Pricing Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon, we're seeking for an experienced Program Manager to lead our pricing initiatives for the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program in India. In this key role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing pricing strategies that maximize profitability for both the AMZL and DSP partners while ensuring competitiveness in the last-mile delivery market. You will be developing cost-effective pricing models while maintaining service quality in the rapidly evolving e-commerce delivery landscape.

Key Responsibilities:
• Analyze last-mile delivery costs, including labor, fuel, vehicle expenses, and regional variations and build cluster pricing to remain competitive.
• Develop and maintain dynamic pricing models for various delivery options (same-day, next-day, scheduled) across different delivery windows.
• Monitor and optimize pricing strategies for different zones, time slots, and delivery types balancing capacity resilience, competitiveness and cost to serve.
• Analyze competitor pricing and market trends in the last-mile delivery and build fluidic models to generate proposals within short timelines.
• Generate various what if scenarios and present recommendations for operational leaders to make a informed decision.
• Evaluate the impact of peak periods, seasonal fluctuations, and special events on pricing and incorporate the same in quarterly guidance.
• Collaborate with operations teams to understand delivery constraints and capacity needs and support them with right flexibility levers to prioritize customer experience.
• Generate regular performance reports on pricing effectiveness, profitability, capacity sufficiency, DA earning and evolving market trends.

Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or related field
• 2-4 years of experience
• Strong analytical and mathematical skills
• Proficient in Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools
• Experience with transportation management systems (TMS)
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy


Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with pricing model development
• Knowledge of machine learning and predictive analytics
• Background in e-commerce or courier services

Technical Skills:
• Advanced Excel skills
• SQL and database management
• Python or R programming (preferred)
• Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau)

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program or project management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in MS Access and SQL

title: Trust and Privacy TPM, Devices & Services Trust, Privacy, and Accessibility
descriptionHtml:
Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.

As we expand our scope into trust incident response and crisis management, we are growing the team to address trust risks across our devices and services portfolio. The TPA team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will manage incident response for high-severity, trust-impacting events, from intake through containment, mitigation, and closure, operating the mechanisms, playbooks, and metrics that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident manager during active events, drive escalations with urgency, keep stakeholders aligned, and write clear briefs for senior leadership. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and partners with our US-based incident leads to sustain continuous, cross-time-zone coverage.

A successful candidate will have a strong background driving cross-functional programs, solid program-management, technical problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions, derive insights from complex data, write clear business documents, and hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure. The ability to stay detail-oriented and decisive under pressure will be critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end response for assigned trust-impacting incidents by defining scope and success criteria, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across dependent teams, and driving each case to closure within SLA.
- Set up incident rooms for high-severity events; triage, classify, escalate, and coordinate response under pressure using established severity matrices.
- Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to understand system architecture, data flows, and design trade-offs, ensuring remediation meets scalability, performance, and operational standards.
- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure, and prepare incident narratives, escalation briefs, and status updates for leadership.
- Evaluate opportunities to apply generative artificial intelligence tools and process improvements to streamline detection and triage workflows, while mentoring peers and contributing to team hiring efforts.

A day in the life
As a Technical Program Manager on the Trust Incident & Crisis Management team, you will work on high-impact, high-visibility programs that directly protect our customers. You start your day triaging newly reported issues across trust surfaces and picking up open incidents and corrective actions. During an active event you step into the incident-manager role: classify severity, coordinate the response, assign clear ownership for each action, and keep every item moving to closure within SLA. Between events you run post-incident reviews, keep playbooks and dashboards current, and partner with Engineering and Product to embed trust-by-design practices upstream. You collaborate across trust, privacy, accessibility, security, engineering, legal, and product teams to drive these programs from intake to resolution.

About the team
Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function sits within Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA), building the programs and services at Amazon scale that grow customer trust, create mechanisms to meet evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can fulfill their trust obligations without disruption. We run a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events: detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. This is a newly expanded area of investment, so it is a great time to join and help shape how we build out this capability. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational rigor, and we support new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience with roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues

This role involves initiating and supporting the implementation of the regulatory and Safety standards within EU AIR, ensuring alignment with Operations internal and external partners. You will identify improvement opportunities and influence cross-functional stakeholders. You will thrive in a flexible environment and not be hindered by ambiguity. Strong judgment, analytic talent, and ownership are essential. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders to understand high-priority execution targets and drive measurable impacts across Global Program frameworks. You will work across business units and geographies to support the development of long-term strategies and operational direction for WHS programs. You will be a motivated Safety Specialist with a proven record of developing team members’ competencies.

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end aviation safety oversight for the assigned perimeter, including quarterly gateway assessments, scheduled and ad-hoc site visits, structured audits with 3P carriers, and compliance monitoring against Amazon AIR WHS standards, local/national legislation, and EU aviation regulations, proactively identifying gaps and implementing remediation plans



Manage safety investigations and incident prevention programs, conducting root cause analysis for incidents and precursor events, leveraging trend data and industry best practices to drive corrective actions to verified closure and mitigate risks before they materialise



Support EU Gateway WHS Safety Oversight Programs and new gateway launches, including safety readiness assessments, protocol development, and ongoing monitoring frameworks



Proactively identify safety risks and drive process improvements across the 3P network to enhance operational efficiency, reduce incident rates, and strengthen safety culture



Generate in-depth safety analyses and maintain accurate documentation, using internal reporting tools, precursor event data, and operational metrics to produce actionable recommendations and ensure data integrity for regulatory reporting and trend identification



Partner across internal teams, 3P suppliers, carriers, and ground handling agents to implement scalable safety solutions and cross-functional process improvements, support cross-regional WHS collaboration on standardised frameworks, contribute to safety-related projects and business reviews, and drive adoption of safety technologies, automation, and digitalisation initiatives to enhance oversight capabilities

About the team
The EU AIR Safety Team ensures the highest aviation safety standards across Amazon Air's European third-party (3P) air gateways and collaborates with India WHS teams to support the India AIR network. We manage safety compliance across Europe and the UK through proactive risk management, regulatory compliance, data-driven decision making, and continuous innovation.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- Demonstrated experience conducting safety audits, site inspections, or compliance assessments against regulatory or internal standards
- Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time within the assigned EU gateway perimeter to support scheduled and ad-hoc site visits
- Experience managing or contributing to incident investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective action tracking
- Experience in aviation field
- Bachelor degree (or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework) in health and safety or related subject
- Experience in English language communication skills (B2), both written and verbal.

Preferred qualifications

- Analyzing metrics to drive business improvements
- Experience in Spanish language communication skills (B2), both written and verbal.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician, RME
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
• Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes.
• Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
• Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
• Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
• Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardize processes across the EU network

A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or innovative tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience in automated conveyors systems and controls, electrical and electronic principles, preventative maintenance procedures, blueprint and schematic reading, industrial electrical, industrial controls, industrial electronics, Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programs, National Electrical Code (NEC), work order management
- Experience using CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) to plan proactive maintenance and record reactive tasks

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechatronics or a related technical field
- Experience in vendor management
- Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead
- Experience working with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards in accordance with OEM requirements

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU Member state.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

title: Manager, Software Development, Pre Station Planning Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon has come a long way since opening on the World Wide Web in July 1995. Today, we operate retail websites in multiple countries across geographies, offering products in many categories (books, media, digital, electronics etc.) worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history! The Amazon.com brand has become synonymous with a superior level of convenience, selection, low prices, and customer service. The

Last Mile Planning team, within the LMT organization, is at the heart of our growing logistics network at Amazon. We build all the software that creates efficient route, station and capacity plans that operations uses to deliver billions of packages that Amazon customers order worldwide, right up to their doorsteps. We’re challenged to constantly improve and innovate on our vehicle routing/planning software and tools to better support fast delivery to customers. The technology innovations that are developed by the Last Mile Technology team scale our growing network and include a wide breadth of solutions from ML and operations research-based routing and planning algorithms, our own in-house maps and navigation platform, IoT and hardware innovations, doorstep delivery experience, and the consumer grade native mobile apps that brings all these experiences together.

The Pre Station Planning Technology team is one of the critical teams supporting and enabling Last Mile operations for Amazon Worldwide. We build software for demand forecasting, capacity planning, jurisdiction and topology management and fleet planning among other areas. All of these services help estimate the precise number of stations, vehicles, drivers and routes to deliver billions of packages to customers worldwide and have a high impact on cost as well as deliver efficiency.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager with exceptional technical skills and a passion for delivering great software to join our team. As a member of this team, you will be responsible to own and deliver highly visible, innovative projects that directly impact the customer experience. You will be involved in driving the technical and architectural vision for a planning team that touches every Amazon package, as well as all the aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing & delivery of our product.

Key job responsibilities
1. Be responsible for the end to end ownership of a technology team, including setting the technical vision for developing our systems to serve Amazon's needs.
2. Build and manage great software engineers that are responsible for developing and maintaining software that ensures safety and compliance for our customers, associates and carrier partners.
3. Be a champion of engineering and operational excellence: establish team metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence and a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvement.
4. Establish a consistent, project management framework and excellent development processes to deliver high quality software, in rapid iterations, for business partners in multiple geographies.
5. Show strong business and technical judgment that will accelerate time to market of releases, while incrementally moving our services towards the long term vision.
6. Be responsible for mentoring and developing engineers.
7. Represent the technical organization and evangelize the work to business stakeholders and senior leadership.
8. Raise the bar on technical excellence, show thought leadership, and communicate well to different audiences.

A day in the life
1. Be part of discussions, brainstorming ideas with Product Managers, SMEs, SDMs etc.,
2. Drive tech team with Sprint execution, identify efficiencies, operational improvements and be part of design reviews, two-way door decisions etc.,
3. Have 1:1s with the team, cross-team SDMs, managers and skip managers
4. Drive the team and org vision with innovative solutions and think big ideas
5. Have a lots of customer obsession and deliver results.
6. Collaborate closely with partners, stakeholders, UX and others to help define the scope of the product.
7. Contribute to OP plans, OE/ EE/ KTLO

The Pre Station Planning Technology team is one of the critical teams supporting and enabling Last Mile operations for Amazon Worldwide. We build software for demand forecasting, capacity planning, jurisdiction and topology management and fleet planning among other areas. All of these services help estimate the precise number of stations, vehicles, drivers and routes to deliver billions of packages to customers worldwide and have a high impact on cost as well as deliver efficiency.

- 7+ years of engineering experience

title: Network Cabling Quality Technician , Global Cabling Quality
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) designs, plans, delivers, and operates all AWS global infrastructure. We keep the cloud running by supporting AWS data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that give customers continual access to innovation. We solve complex problems with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain.

You'll join software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other essential roles. You'll collaborate across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing capacity at the lowest cost for customers.

In this role, you will:

Work with Network Deployment and Vendor Management teams to integrate quality assurance into cable installation processes throughout the project lifecycle. You'll participate in reviews of training curriculums and cabling design documents, providing Quality Assurance representation to ensure standards are met during cable installation activities. You'll influence partner teams and cabling vendors to adopt quality assurance checklists that validate conformance to both Amazon and jurisdictional standards during critical milestone checks for cable installation and testing activities.

You'll bring the voice of the customer forward by gathering feedback from internal stakeholders and cabling vendors, then refining quality processes based on their needs. You'll verify that cable installations meet standards by reviewing documentation and data from milestone inspections and cable validation testing. You'll drive cable validation testing adoption and defect management while establishing performance benchmarks to improve vendor performance and enhance quality metrics. You'll document and align cable installation standards and standard operating procedures as new technology and cabling methods integrate into our infrastructure. You’ll also conduct training with partner teams and provide guidelines to cabling vendors to ensure consistent execution across all network installations.

This role matters because cable installation quality directly impacts data center network reliability and customer experience. You'll own the quality process from participating in cabling design reviews through training delivery, ensuring our infrastructure meets the standards our customers depend on.

Key job responsibilities
Support Quality Assurance related programs to drive world-class quality in network cabling in the new constructions of Data Centers to achieve the best operating, lowest cost infrastructure in the world. The Network Cabling Quality Technician will be obsessed with quality, engineering and design continuous improvements

Partner with Network Deployment teams to adopt defined quality assurance checklists, gather feedback, and generate recommendations to improve checklists. Work with partner teams to track cabling scope changes and perform impact analysis to address business needs

Partner with the Vendor Management team to drive cable vendor quality, provide vendor performance metrics through business reviews, and refine processes to improve vendor performance

Support cable installation benchmark according to Amazon policies and industry standards; maintain cable installation standards, checklists, standard operating procedures and best practices guidelines

Conduct Network Cabling Installation Quality Training Programs, and the creation of training materials, to support internal and external partner and stakeholder teams

Collaborate with stakeholder teams to capture metrics data such as inspection reports and cable test results; track defects for root cause analysis, generate recommendations, evaluate vendor performances and escalate issues to respective owners for remediation plans

Track and report on project milestones, vendor performance metrics, and quality KPIs including First Pass Yield, defect rates, and schedule adherence across multiple concurrent projects

Support continuous improvement initiatives by capturing lessons learned, facilitating post-project reviews, and implementing process improvements to enhance future project delivery

Identify opportunities to reduce Cost of Poor Quality and improve overall project efficiency

Regional and Local Travel up to 25% to attend site visits and meetings for onsite quality standards review and collect feedback from onsite personnel



This is an opportunity to leverage and grow your existing program management, quality assurance and engineering experience in an innovative and highly collaborative environment where the results of your work will directly impact AWS and its customers.

A day in the life
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a highly innovative company that collaborates across disciplines to produce new technology that changes our world. The AWS Quality Team is a fast-growing global team that is rethinking the implementation and design for the critical arteries that connect the various pieces of hardware inside AWS’ data centers and edge sites.

As a member of this team, you will be charged with visiting our data centers and ensuring that we are following AWS and Industry standards while also collecting lessons learned so we are continually improving. You will work directly with engineers, managers, and operations teams across the company to develop and improve network pathway and installation standards based on these observations and lessons learned.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment
- 2+ years of data center experience, or experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Associate's degree in Telecommunications or related discipline, or equivalent work experience
- Knowledge of basic quality tools (e.g., defect categorization, root cause analysis, or quality reporting systems)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of critical data center equipment
- Experience with program and project management in a matrixed organization, including managing details, keeping multiple tasks/projects on track, and influencing others
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in technical support
- Proven track record on ability to identify creative and innovative solutions to improve quality, reliability, or maintainability

descriptionHtml:

Amazon Web Services (AWS) has helped over one million customers in more than 190 countries deliver flexibility, scalability, and reliability across their organizations. Your broad responsibilities will include owning the technical engagement and the ultimate success of specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in AWS technologies along with broad know-how of how applications and services are built on the AWS platform. title: Senior Manager, Applied Science, Amazon Business System Integrations
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by building technology that makes life easier for business customers? If you enjoy working at the center of enterprise commerce, connecting Amazon Business with the procurement, ERP, and finance systems that organizations run on ethn Amazon Business System (ABS) Integrations team is the place for you.

We build systems integrations capabilities that let business customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. This includes APIs, protocols, and partner connections that make procurement faster, more automated, and more reliable at global scale. Our teams design, launch, and operates these integrations with a wide range of partners, and each launch has to work securely and seamlessly across many different systems, regions, and customer needs.

We are seeking a Senior Manager Applied Science to build and lead the science organization in Amazon Business Systems Integrations. This is a foundational leadership role spanning the full integrations portfolio. This role will hire, grow, and lead a team of applied scientists who define how we measure and improve the performance of AI agents and human-AI teams. A core part of the role is defining the science agenda itself - identifying which problems are most worth solving and where the highest-leverage bets lie. Directions worth exploring might include Organizational Intelligence (turning institutional knowledge into agent-consumable skills) AI Agent Experience / AiAX (agent observability and autonomous remediation) and contextual behavioral security that adapts enforcement in real time for human and agent sessions and anything which the defines how we measure and improve agents and human-AI teams i.e benchmarks, task suites, and metrics (accuracy cost-per-task task completion productivity) that turn subjective "it works" judgments into rigorous reproducible measurement that gates what we ship. There are no established industry patterns in this field and the team will set the scientific direction, determine how AI agents and people perceive reason and act reliably within computing environments at enterprise scale.

This role requires building, leading and retaining a high calibre applied science team spanning the Agentic Integrations portfolio. This leader will set the bar for scientific talent, create the growth paths, and build the culture that makes Amazon Business a destination for the best agent and human-AI researchers.


Key job responsibilities
• Set the long-term scientific vision and team strategy: Define what best-in-class agent performance evaluation and learning look like across Agentic WorkSpaces - for computer-using agents and human-AI teams alike. Chart a multi-year research roadmap and build the team and plan to deliver it. Secure buy-in from VP-level leadership.
• Hire and grow scientific talent: Own recruiting calibration development and retention for the science team. Mentor scientists toward senior and principal scope and raise the scientific bar across the organization.
• Direct research on highly ambiguous novel problems: Guide the team through foundational challenges in agent perception reasoning evaluation reliability and human-AI collaboration - problems where neither the approach nor the success criteria are pre-defined.
• Drive cross-organizational alignment: Work across partner teams (AgentCore Bedrock model teams Identity Security the MCP ecosystem) and across the Applied AI Solutions product portfolio with product and engineering leadership to ensure scientific decisions compose into a coherent product.
• Deliver measurable business impact: Ensure your team's research translates to customer outcomes: higher task accuracy lower cost-per-action faster time-to-production measurable productivity for human-AI teams and the trust that lets enterprises scale agent workflows.
• Establish scientific rigor and operational excellence: Set the standard for experimentation evaluation and reproducibility and the mechanisms that keep the science organization productive and accountable.
• Advance the state of the art: Enable and champion contributions to the external technical community through publications patents and open-source work that position AWS as the leader in the science of secure agent-computer interaction and human-AI teamwork.
• Translate science into shipped product. Partner with engineering, product, and program leaders to move models evaluation and learning systems from prototype into a decade-old production service operating at massive scale without compromising the reliability that customers depend on.
• Represent science in leadership and to customers. Be the scientific voice in org-level planning and roadmap decisions across AAWS and engage directly with enterprise customers on how agent performance safety and human-AI productivity are measured and earned.

Basic qualifications

-Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or equivalent
-Experience building large-scale machine learning and AI solutions at Internet scale
-Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives
-Experience hiring and leading experienced scientists as well as having a successful record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a successful career track

Preferred qualifications

-10+ years of practical work applying ML to solve complex problems for large-scale applications experience
-5+ years of hands-on work in big data, machine learning and predictive modeling experience
-5+ years of people management experience
-PhD in Computer Science (Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or equivalent)
-Experience in practical work applying ML to solve complex problems for large scale applications
-Experience working with big data, machine learning and predictive modeling
-Experience in people management
-Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive etc.
-Experience with Java, C++, or other programming language, as well as with R, MATLAB, Python, or an equivalent scripting language
-Experience researching actual applications
