title: Engineering Operation Technician (Night Shift)
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

We are seeking experienced Engineering Operations Technicians to join our data center operations team, specifically focusing on liquid cooling infrastructure and water distribution systems. This role is vital in maintaining the continuous operation of our advanced cooling systems that support critical data center operations.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

- Technical writing to support change management program

- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

- Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Quality Assurance Engineer II, Amazon Robotics Systems Quality and Performance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about quality and robotics? Do you thrive on solving complex problems that span hardware, software, and system integration? Amazon Robotics is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer II to own quality for robotic systems deployed across Amazon's fulfillment network.

In this role, you won't just execute test plans — you'll define them. You'll take ambiguous product requirements and turn them into comprehensive test strategies covering functional, integration, and performance testing. You'll work hands-on with robotic systems on our test floors, validating that releases meet the quality bar before they reach production sites. When you find problems, you won't just file a bug — you'll trace the root cause across system boundaries and give developers the evidence they need to fix it fast.

You'll also build tools and automation that make the whole team more effective — scripting repeatable test scenarios, developing methods to evaluate release quality, and creating documentation that lets teammates run your tests independently. Your work will multiply the impact of everyone around you. You'll collaborate daily with software engineers, hardware engineers, and systems engineers, representing quality in design reviews, release decisions, and cross-team discussions.

This is a hands-on role based at our BOS27 facility in Westborough, MA. If you want to work at the intersection of robotics, quality engineering, and real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end test strategy for robotic features and systems — defining what to test, how to test it, and what infrastructure is needed, even when requirements are ambiguous or evolving.
Create and execute test plans for complex test scenarios including system integration, robotic workcell validation, and safety-critical functionality across hardware, software, and firmware boundaries.
Design and build automated test solutions that are maintainable, reusable, and reliable — enabling other engineers to run and extend them independently.
Develop test strategies for non-functional areas such as performance, reliability, and regression detection to ensure product quality is measured objectively.
Isolate, document, and validate defects with detailed evidence and root-cause analysis, enabling development teams to triage and resolve issues efficiently.
Represent quality assurance in cross-functional discussions including design reviews, release readiness decisions, and retrospectives — advocating for quality at every stage of the development lifecycle.
Collaborate with software developers, hardware engineers, and systems engineers to understand technical architecture and assess how changes impact test scope and product behavior.
Mentor junior engineers, interns, and contractors — training them on products, test methodologies, and tools, and creating documentation that reduces tribal knowledge.
Execute testing on physical test floors to qualify releases prior to production deployment, working directly with robotic systems and workcells.
Proactively identify quality risks, propose solutions, and take on projects that improve testing processes or more accurately measure product quality.

A day in the life
Your day starts with a team standup where you and your fellow QA engineers level set on priorities, blockers, and what's happening across active test campaigns. From there, your day might look different depending on where you are in a release cycle.

Some days are heavily hands-on — you're on the test floor at BOS27 running test scenarios against robotic workcells, capturing logs, and investigating unexpected behavior. You'll troubleshoot across hardware, software, and firmware boundaries, pulling data from multiple sources to build a clear picture of what went wrong and why.

Other days are more collaborative — you're in design reviews with software and hardware engineers, asking the questions that shape how a feature gets tested. You might be scoping a test strategy for a new capability, defining what "done" looks like when the requirements are still evolving, or presenting release analysis to stakeholders who need a clear verdict on whether a build is ready for production.

In between, you're building — writing test cases, developing automation that your teammates can pick up and run, creating documentation that eliminates the need for someone to tap you on the shoulder every time. You'll also spend time mentoring junior engineers and contractors, helping them ramp on products and test approaches.

You'll regularly collaborate with software development engineers, systems engineers, hardware engineers, and program managers. Your internal customers are the development teams who depend on your test results to make release decisions, and the operations teams who rely on the quality of what ships to fulfillment sites.

In this role you will work at the intersection of machine learning and physical robotics hardware. You will collaborate with hardware engineers to evaluate how your models perform on real sensors and edge compute, run experiments that directly influence what gets built next, and validate perception systems alongside robotics program teams. You will push the boundaries of computer vision for robotic applications while seeing your work deploy on real robots in real fulfillment centers. This is applied science with immediate, measurable impact at a scale no other robotics company can offer.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The Amazon Robotics Quality Assurance Engineering team is a group of approximately 20 engineers supporting a broad portfolio of robotic products and solutions — from manipulation systems and autonomous mobile robots to sortation, storage and retrieval, and outbound dock automation. Our work spans first mile, middle mile, last mile, and outbound dock operations across Amazon's fulfillment network.

We operate across three major test sites in Massachusetts — BOS12 (North Reading), BOS27 (Westborough), and BOS33 (Woburn) — where we maintain dedicated test floors with real robotic workcells and integration environments. We are a mix of hands-on testers, automation builders, and quality strategists who work closely with software, hardware, and systems engineering teams to make sure what ships to production actually works. We are growing and looking for curious, technically strong people who want to make a real impact on how robotics technology serves customers worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
- Experience of using test case management tools (e.g. Test Rail, TestLink) and issue management tools (Jira)

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
Most AI assistants today start every conversation from scratch, forgetting what they learned yesterday about developer's codebase, patterns, and the way they like to work. You will help create generative AI technologies, including Kiro IDE and CLI, that are transforming how software gets built.

You will take on some of the hardest open problems in machine learning: how a model keeps learning without forgetting what it already knew, how to store and retrieve the right memory at the right moment, and how to personalize the experience for each developer and team without starting over every time. Your work will reach millions of developers rather than sit in a paper, and you will own a research direction end to end rather than share a sliver of attention across many priorities.

- Push the boundaries of continual and lifelong learning for large language models specialized in code intelligence

- Deploy products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide
- Publish and present your work at premier ML and NLP conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP)

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Hybrid Work
We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near one of our U.S. Amazon offices.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a global e-commerce experience for Internet Service Provider (ISP) customers, and we need a Software Development Engineer II. You will build the backend-for-frontend layer, the service that sits directly behind the customer-facing surfaces and orchestrates over the many backend systems that make satellite internet work: ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support.

The job is to shape what the frontend needs, route and orchestrate requests across those systems, translate between them, and compose their responses into reliable operations the customer experience can depend on. The core of the work is integration: calling many APIs, handling partial failures gracefully, mapping between different service models, and keeping latency and reliability high across a lot of moving parts. Much of this is built zero-to-one and expanding into new countries, so you will move from ambiguous problems to working products. You will own the full development lifecycle and work closely with frontend, product, and partner service teams.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build backend gateway APIs in Java that route and orchestrate requests across many downstream services, from concept through deployment and operation.
- Integrate with ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support services: calling their APIs, translating between their models, and composing their responses.
- Handle the realities of a distributed system: partial failures, retries, timeouts, error translation, and keeping latency and reliability high across many dependencies.
- Work with product managers, frontend engineers, and partner service teams, and help the platform expand into new countries.
- Use agentic development workflows and generative AI tools to deliver faster, and improve the system with AWS native services.
- Review code, give feedback, and coach teammates on service integration patterns and well-tested code.
- Document your team's software and train new team members on how it is built, tested, and operated.

About the team
We build the e-commerce experience for a global ISP customer base at Amazon Leo. Our team owns the backend-for-frontend layer: the single API the customer-facing app talks to, and the orchestration behind it that connects to the systems provisioning and running satellite internet. We work hand in hand with the frontend team, shaping our APIs around what their experiences need. We are scaling the team and investing in AI-based development and operational workflows.

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 5+ years of programming using a modern programming language such as Java, C++, or C#, including object-oriented design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

- Experience with test-driven development

title: Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer, Amazon Leo OISL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an innovative program aiming to provide low-latency, high-speed internet to underserved populations across the globe through the deployment of a constellation of over 3000 satellites to Low Earth Orbit, and we're looking for a talented Senior Test Engineer to join the Optical Inter-Satellite Link (OISL) Manufacturing Team.

As a Senior Test Engineer for the OISL Manufacturing Team, you will be responsible for the end-to-end Electrical testing process for a Line-Replaceable-Unit, from initial concept through sustaining support in production. You’ll be the leading technical voice for a team of test engineers working on your product, solving challenging technical problems associated with testing an ultra-high-performing optical, electrical, and mechatronic module. You will serve as a key lynchpin connection design/development, factory operations, quality engineering, program management, and more as you drive the test processes we use from initial production introduction to full rate production. You will leverage your expertise in electrical system design and manufacturing to lead deep root cause and corrective action investigations for test yield failures. You’ll solve complex industrial challenges associated with balancing production velocity, exceptional quality, and cost competitive production concepts while ensuring smooth technical execution of current production operations. title: Sr Pre-Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's senior owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for autonomously managing complex, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the senior project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — serving major business customers within your region.

You execute deliverables with limited oversight, using advanced professional concepts to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. You deliver a mix of tactical and strategic initiatives (60% tactical / 40% strategic) that impact multiple teams and/or geographies in support of significant business objectives. You own project budgets, oversee design management, select external vendor partners, and lead project procurement — and you are accountable for the full performance of your external project teams. You show excellent judgment when driving project escalations and make difficult trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs, defending those decisions to internal stakeholders.

Beyond project delivery, you guide preconstruction managers in best practices in stakeholder management and project delivery, contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks, and are learning to force multiply — elevating the performance of the teams and partners around you. You write effective narratives and present complex decisions and trade-offs to Directors and VPs. You actively recruit, mentor, and develop other preconstruction managers.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Own and enforce Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases; set the standard for safety culture on complex projects
- Lead coordination with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand and apply zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects
- Proactively identify and eliminate compliance risks before they become project roadblocks

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Autonomously manage complex, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution; contribute to significantly complex projects as part of a team
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — overseeing design teams in developing site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Oversee design management end-to-end, including design evaluations, design conformance reviews, and value engineering assessments
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously, leading a region or program with limited management oversight
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and managing escalations with excellent judgment
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource and authority on project issues for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Monitor project performance metrics, anticipate roadblocks and risks, manage escalations, and ensure corrective actions are taken
- Resolve complex issues and find a path forward in difficult situations; make and defend trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability; deliver solutions that meet standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, and operational excellence
- Maintain a broad perspective — understand how project components drive successful programs, business portfolios, and not just individual projects

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own project budgets and oversee spend approvals across all assigned preconstruction projects
- Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; lead negotiations on the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
- Lead external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement functions; ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements
- Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis and approvals of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
- Review additional reports including noise and traffic studies and environmental assessments
- Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
- Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between short-term and long-term needs

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; serve as an authority on project issues across diverse audiences
- Select external vendor partners and manage delivery from external service partners to drive delivery with efficient use of resources and technology
- Lead large cross-functional teams to complete preconstruction projects; skillfully motivate and focus people of all levels to deliver complex projects
- Drive significant communication across departments, from front-line to executive-level managers; achieve high-level alignment and consensus with internal and external stakeholders across diverse teams (legal, regulatory, operations, engineering, finance, external industry groups)
- Act as the primary escalation point for project team members; own and track issues to ensure they are addressed, documented, and resolved
- Support crucial relationships and lead negotiations of agreements with customers, suppliers, and external partners
- Contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks

Communication & Reporting
- Write effective narratives and present complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential solutions to Directors and VPs
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end stories providing detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, driving detailed discussions, and achieving high-level alignment and consensus
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement, Best Practices & People Development
- Drive continuous improvement and create sustainable, repeatable processes and playbooks for the team and region
- Contribute to process improvement ideas; develop tools and procedures that improve project efficiency and delivery across the organization
- Drive efficiencies, streamline workflows, and mitigate excess process and risk
- Learn to force multiply — drive adoption of best practices and elevate the performance of teams and partners
- Recommend improvements to the way projects are scoped, permitted, and executed across the region or organization
- Guide preconstruction managers in best practices in stakeholder management and project delivery; frequently serve as an expert resource on complicated technical, jurisdictional, or regulatory issues
- Actively recruit, mentor, and develop other preconstruction managers within your organization and location
- Assist leadership in building internal and external talent networks
- Participate in the interview process and help train new team members
- Support Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion as fundamentally right for all employees by fostering a culture where inclusion is the norm
- Insist on the highest standards from self and others; drive accountability for results

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's senior owner during the preconstruction phase — executing autonomously, leading with no authority, and influencing the best project decisions across your region. You are 60% tactical and 40% strategic, planning your projects with limited management oversight and frequently called upon as an expert resource. Your day may include:
- Leading design reviews and providing strategic direction to architects, engineers, and design consultants on complex projects
- Negotiating contract terms with developers, general contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
- Presenting project status, risks, and trade-off decisions to senior leadership (Directors and VPs)
- Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
- Monitoring project performance metrics and driving corrective actions with external partners
- Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
- Mentoring PCMs and contributing to team development and best practices
- Developing or updating process playbooks based on lessons learned from current projects
- Leveraging project management principles and analytics to identify, avoid, or correct issues before they become roadblocks

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of project management, real estate development, architecture/design experience
- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 7+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline
- 7+ years of project management experience from design phase through implementation and operation, including negotiating construction, procurement, and labor contracts
- Experience within packaging, processing, or logistical facilities with complex equipment, or comparable experience
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or certification in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills; demonstrated ability to lead with no authority and build consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
- Demonstrated success communicating complex decisions and trade-offs to senior leadership (Director/VP level)
- Experience developing and implementing preconstruction processes, playbooks, or best practice frameworks
- Experience mentoring and developing junior preconstruction professionals
- Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent

title: Consumer Insights Manager: Tracking, Amazon Devices Consumer Insights & User Experience
descriptionHtml:
About the role:
The Amazon Devices research team seeks a strategic and passionate Consumer Insights Manager to manage the day-to-day operations for a multi-marketplace tracking research program. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the program runs on time, within budget, and at the right quality bar. You’ll also partner with marketers, strategists, and builders to translate research questions into actionable insights. You will work on overlapping initiatives, so skill in project management is essential.

About You:
You have a deep understanding of traditional market research methods and best practices, as well as a passion for tracking and brand research. Where some see tracking studies as repetitive, you see an ongoing challenge to unlock hidden insights from patterns in the data. You work quickly and lead with an operational mindset. You get satisfaction from making the complex look simple. You seek efficiencies through continuous improvement. You leverage AI to assist in your work and you're interested in pushing the boundaries of agile research. You actively collaborate with your peers to elevate research standards, and you are energized by a relentless determination to do what is right for your customers.


Key job responsibilities
• Oversee the day-to-day operations for a multi-marketplace tracking research program, including but not limited to partner and agency management, ensuring key milestones are met on time, managing ad-hoc requests, quality control, inputting into ongoing rhythm of the business forums, and overall program advocacy.
• Partner with internal partners globally to identify category and brand health shifts and identify the right research opportunities to dive deeper into the insights. Connect the “what,” with the “so what,” and “now what” using your own research and other data sources.
• Build scalable and nimble market research solutions, tools, and processes and leverage AI to democratize and socialize tracking insights. Actively publish insights and represent the data/program in regular rhythm of the business forums.
• Communicate complex concepts clearly and persuasively to audiences at varying levels of the organization. Drive impact to the business and customer experience, as measured by adoption of research findings.

A day in the life
Our team moves fast and iterates often, and you will too on one of our largest research programs. You’ll partner with Marketers and Brand Strategists to develop a holistic and comprehensive understanding of our brands and the categories we participate in. You’ll partner with builders to help them understand what they build influences how our brands are perceived. You’ll need to switch between thinking strategically and acting tactically (e.g., thinking through how to get the right data for a novel problem in the morning and writing a brand health update in the afternoon). As a trusted partner, you’ll be expected to help identify the right solution, even if it’s not research.

About the team
We design and execute primary research to inform new solutions, measure brand health and customer satisfaction, and we dive deep with our partners to improve the customer experience of our devices and services. We’re also builders, which means we’re actively using various tools – including AI – to make research scalable and efficient. Our team consists of Designers, Researchers, and Technologists who can envision, create, and execute ideas from start to finish. We maintain a collaborative culture grounded in respect and empathy for our peers and partners.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (end to end) with all aspects of research (study design, recruiting, moderation, analysis, reporting)
- 4+ years of market research analyst, product manager, or equivalent experience
- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel, or experience with advanced use of Excel and using statistical analysis applications
- Strong project and vendor management skills
- Experience using AI in research workflows

Preferred qualifications

- Experience conducting and applying research in a global context
- Experience working in a highly Agile/Scrum environment
- 1+ years of consumer electronics experience
- Experience with brand strategy
- • Experience using statistical tools/languages like SPSS/SAS/R/Q/Python

descriptionHtml:

We are seeking Security Engineers who want to help secure Amazon. Through these engagements, we accelerate store builders, improve their security maturity, and generate insights about the efficacy of self-service security that feed back into improving existing or investing in new security mechanisms.

Our mission: Remediate differentiated security gaps across Amazon Stores through targeted BU engagements while partnering with core security partner teams to improve existing mechanisms.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: ファシリティエンジニア - DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services はすべての AWS グローバルインフラストラクチャの設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。私たちは、クラウドを稼働させ続ける人々です。すべての AWS データセンターとお客様がイノベーションに継続的にアクセスできるようにするすべてのサーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電源、冷却設備をサポートしています。私たちはサプライチェーンに影響を与える数千もの要因を考慮しながら、最も困難な課題に取り組んでいます。そして私たちと共に支援したいと考える優秀な人材を探しています。

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Data Center Operationsチームは AWS のバックボーンであり、急速に成長する AWS ビジネスとお客様を 24 時間 365 日サポートしています。私たちは AWS の物理インフラストラクチャを維持し、安全性、セキュリティ、可用性、生産性、容量、効率性、コストの分野における運用パフォーマンスの基準を確保することに取り組んでいます。



Key job responsibilities
主な職務内容

Facility Engineer - Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) の役割は、大規模で高密度のデータセンターにおいて、施設（電気/機械システム、制御/消火システムなど）の展開、運用、保守、および関連プロジェクトの管理を担当します。
日常業務では、以下の業務に携わります:
• 建物システムの点検と監視、および施設の問題のトラブルシューティング
• 運用効率の改善とエネルギー削減
• ベンダーやパートナーとの定期メンテナンスと修理の計画と実施。これには、ブレーカー操作、機械/電気設備操作などの重要な施設運用が含まれます
• プロジェクトチームメンバーと協力してテストなどをサポート

勤務時間

12時間のシフト勤務 (うち2時間休憩)など、標準外の時間帯勤務が可能な方（4勤3休のシフトで働ける方。標準勤務時間は 8:00 ～ 20:00、20:00 ～ 8:00、または 9:00 ～ 21:00、21:00 ～ 9:00 です）



About the team
多様な経験

AWS は多様な経験を重視しています。職務内容に記載されているすべての資格やスキルを満たしていなくても、応募することをお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの場合、従来の道を歩んでいない場合、または関連しない経験がある場合でも、応募をためらわないでください。

なぜ AWS なのか?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

包括的なチーム文化

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

メンターシップとキャリア成長

私たちは、地球上で最高の雇用主になるために、継続的にパフォーマンスバーを引き上げています。だからこそ、ここには、より多角的な専門家に成長するのに役立つ、無限の知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア向上リソースがあります。

ワークライフバランス

私たちはワークライフハーモニーを重視しています。仕事での成功は、家庭での犠牲を伴うべきではありません。だからこそ、柔軟な勤務時間と勤務体制が私たちの文化の一部となっています。職場と家庭でサポートされていると感じるとき、クラウドで達成できないことは何もありません。

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
This position requires in-role training at an operating site which will be 2+ weeks in duration. This training will be located 50+ miles away from the home site location. All travel accommodations for training will be booked and paid for by Amazon.

Please note: this role requires open flexibility to work 10 hour overnight shifts (late afternoon to early morning hours) and will be scheduled on a front-half (Sunday – Wednesday) or back-half (Wednesday – Saturday) schedule. Shifts will be assigned upon starting in the role and could be subject to change based upon business need.


ABOUT AMAZON

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly employees and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces. Come build the future with us!

Key job responsibilities
- Support, mentor, and motivate your team
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Ops Integration, Loss Prevention and Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, as well as continuously climb and descend stairs
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments, and grocery locations include refrigerated environments)
- Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field

descriptionHtml:

title: Program Manager, Amazon Now
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview
The L5 Program Manager at Amazon Now is responsible for strategically planning, leading, and executing small to medium-scale projects and programs that drive operational excellence across Amazon Now's ultra-fast delivery network. This role focuses on managing dark store operations, scaling initiatives, and ensuring seamless execution of key programs that impact customer experience and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
Program Execution & Delivery

Own and manage lifecycle activities for 2-3 medium-sized programs simultaneously, driving end-to-end delivery from conception to implementation
Develop and execute project plans, securing resources and managing implementation across cross-functional teams
Track tasks, deliverables, deadlines, and milestones through regular status checks with stakeholders
Make appropriate trade-offs to optimize timelines and deliverables in consultation with stakeholders
Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, and other cross-functional teams to align on program objectives
Clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to all stakeholders
Provide fortnightly status updates to leadership on program progress, team readiness, challenges, and support requirements
Influence without authority by building trust and consensus across multiple teams

Key job responsibilities
Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

Identify pain points and opportunities for process optimization within dark store operations
Drive continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven decision-making and root cause analysis
Implement best practices and standardized processes to support scalability
Manage Business Continuity Plan (BCP) situations and develop mitigation strategies
Data Analysis & Reporting

Use data and metrics to drive improvements and measure program success
Conduct deep dives into operational metrics to identify trends and areas for improvement
Create executive-level reports and presentations for senior leadership
Track and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) relevant to program objectives
Launch & Scale Management

Support new marketplace and dark store launches, coordinating with multiple teams
Manage launch readiness activities including resource onboarding, fund transfers, and team coordination
Document learnings from launches and scale initiatives to enrich organizational knowledge
Drive strategic change across broader operations teams
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of relevant professional experience
3+ years of program or project management experience
Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience in data collection and root cause analysis
2-3 years of experience managing or participating in projects with multiple stakeholders
Proficiency with MS Office Professional Suite, including intermediate to advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLookUps)
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience working cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in operations, logistics, supply chain management, or retail/e-commerce environments
Lean Six Sigma certification or experience with process improvement methodologies (Kaizen, Six Sigma)
PMP or similar project management certification
Experience with SQL, data visualization tools (Tableau), or business intelligence platforms
Experience in fast-paced, ambiguous environments requiring independent decision-making
Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence senior leadership

title: Senior Solutions Architect, AWS Private Equity
descriptionHtml:
This role can be based in Amsterdam, Madrid, Munich, Milan, Luxembourg, Paris, Stockholm, Zurich, or London.

Would you like to help the largest Private Equity (PE) firms and their portfolio companies leverage new technologies to improve their operations? Would you like to use your IT leadership experience to build relationships with technical leaders, C-level executives, and influencers at all levels across the PE segment?

As a Private Equity Solutions Architect, you will work directly with Private Equity firms, their portfolio companies, and consulting partners to help them adopt new technologies and build new solutions to make the most of the Cloud. You will be at the crossroads of business and technology, engaging with organisations at all stages of cloud adoption. You will provide thought leadership in terms of looking beyond the technology and considering the value that technology creates for our customers. You will practice your creativity by linking technology to tangible solutions and business outcomes. You will educate PE firms and their portfolio companies about the art of the possible, defining and developing cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. You will have the opportunity to present publicly at AWS conferences and industry events.

The ideal candidate will possess a technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement with business, finance or IT executives at the highest levels of our PE customers. You will have experience working with complex IT environments including applications, middleware, storage, networks, information security, and operations. You will also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and long-term about the needs of businesses

The Private Equity Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a balanced technical foundation and a desire to learn. You will develop deep expertise in AWS technologies, as well as a broad set of tools and methodologies of how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform.

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of your customers. We value your passion to discover, invent, and build on behalf of customers. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones so you can make impactful contributions to architecture discussions with customers.

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.

AWS Global Sales

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Key job responsibilities
As a Private Equity Solutions Architect, you will work directly with Private Equity Firms and/or executives of their portfolio companies to design technology solutions to solve specific business challenges or accelerate business initiatives.

- Scoping and understand specific use cases to design appropriate AWS-based technical solutions (including, integrations with third party solutions).

- Own the technical relationship with PE firms and the C-suite of portfolio companies and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.

- Serve as a key technical member of the AWS PE team to help ensure customer success in architecting, building, migrating, or optimizing applications and services on the AWS platform.

- Build rapport with Executives at both PE firms and their portfolio companies leveraging your understanding of enterprise architecture, merger and acquisitions, migration and cost optimization of IT infrastructure and other key technologies

- Establish technical credibility with PE firms and their portfolio companies to lead discussions with CTOs, CIOs, Chief Architects, Senior Developers, etc. from both customer and partners across the PE segment.

- Provide technical and architectural guidance to PE firms and their portfolio companies and help develop cost optimization strategies by deploying the right architecture given their budget constraints.

- Evangelize and educate key stakeholders with the Private Equity ecosystem about AWS technologies.

- Influence AWS's roadmap of new features and services based on customer feedback.

- Create and capture best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).

- Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organization by hiring, coaching and mentoring others.

- Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customer's outcomes.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Spezialist/in für Arbeitssicherheit
descriptionHtml:
Arbeitsschutz und Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeitenden haben bei Amazon höchste Priorität. Unsere Safety Specialists spielen dabei eine entscheidende Rolle. In dieser Funktion sorgst Du proaktiv dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden an Deinem Standort in einem sicheren und gesunden Umfeld arbeiten. Du hast die Möglichkeit, jeden Tag einen Unterschied für Menschen zu machen. Indem Du proaktiv für ihre Sicherheit sorgst, gibst Du ihnen Zuversicht in ihrer Rolle und motivierst sie zu Höchstleistungen.

Key job responsibilities
- Überwachung der Standortleistung anhand festgelegter KPIs und Erstellung von Plänen zur Verbesserung von Prozessen.
- Entwicklung von Programmen für den Arbeitsschutz und Planung von Schulungen.
- Auswertung von Sicherheitskennzahlen und Trends bei Vorfällen, um Kolleg:innen bei der Ressourcenplanung für Bereiche mit dem höchsten Risiko zu unterstützen.
- Durchführung von Audits, um die Einhaltung der relevanten Arbeitsschutzgesetze sicherzustellen und Lösungen bei identifizierten Risiken umzusetzen.

A day in the life
Du arbeitest vor Ort an einem unserer Logistikstandorte — einem Fulfillment Center, Sortierzentrum oder einer Lieferstation. Dort nimmst Du die Prozesse genau unter die Lupe. Neben der Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Arbeitsschutzvorschriften erkennst Du mögliche Probleme und Chancen für Verbesserungen. Du arbeitest eng mit Mitarbeitenden im gesamten Unternehmen zusammen, um die Risiken zu verstehen, denen sie ausgesetzt sind, und sammelst Daten, um intelligentere und sicherere Arbeitsweisen zu entwickeln. Außerdem entwickelst Du Schulungen und andere Programme, damit alle die neuen Sicherheitsprozesse befolgen und neue Standards erreichen.

About the team
Das Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung des mentalen und körperlichen Wohlbefindens unserer Mitarbeitenden am Arbeitsplatz. Unser Team arbeitet mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitenden und lokalen Behörden an allen unseren Standorten zusammen, um die Einhaltung der Amazon-Richtlinien und gesetzlichen Vorschriften sicherzustellen und die Sicherheit unserer Arbeitsumgebungen zu gewährleisten. Das Team bietet vielfältige Möglichkeiten — von Safety Technicians bis hin zu Programm Manager:innen. Unabhängig von Deiner Position trägst Du zur Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Sicherheitsstrategie im gesamten Netzwerk bei.

Basic qualifications

- Ein Bachelorabschluss oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation entsprechend dem Europäischen Qualifikationsrahmen (EQF).
- Zertifizierung als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (gemäß §6 ASiG).
- Kenntnis der deutschen Arbeitsschutzgesetzgebung.
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (B2), in Wort und Schrift.

Preferred qualifications

- Bevorzugte Qualifikationen sind nicht erforderlich, um sich bei Amazon zu bewerben. Wenn Du alle oben genannten Grundqualifikationen erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.
- Erfahrung mit Lean-, 5S- oder Kaizen-Methoden.
- Erfahrung in der Planung oder Durchführung umweltbewusster Initiativen.
- Fähigkeit, sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten.

title: Transportation Representative, NOC-NL
descriptionHtml:
TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for
‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple
geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight
from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case
of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on
the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with
understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process
changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and
significant analysis of network data.
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation
and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion.

Key job responsibilities
Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers
(Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data
management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams
who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by TOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that
make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the
relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and
identifying activities performed.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative
outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review
forum.
Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24*7 operating environmen

Basic qualifications

- - Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent - Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL - Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments - 10+ 2 degree

Preferred qualifications

- - Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers - Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL

title: Software Dev Engineer II, DC Bridge
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Help us push the availability and reliability of cloud infrastructure to new heights! The AWS Data Center Systems team builds services to monitor and data center infrastructure controls monitoring and alerting systems. Our services directly contribute to the high availability of AWS data centers and Amazon’s sustainability goals. Teams in Data Center Systems solve problems of massive metric ingestion, distributed systems/cloud computing, data visualization, anomaly detection, analytics, and graph networks.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is passionate about leading the architecture and development of application software that helps keep Amazon data centers running efficiently and securely. On any given day, we use Python, Java, Kotlin, Lambda, DynamoDB, and CloudFormation, as well as other public AWS services and a host of Amazon-internal tools.

Key job responsibilities
In this role you’ll be leading the design, development, testing and launch of new services for data acquisition, configuration, processing in the data center infrastructure space. You will work with senior members and junior members in the team to build new features. You will make sure enough test has been done to maintain the quality of the delivered software. title: Data Center Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about protecting critical infrastructure and ensuring the safety of the systems that millions of people rely on every day? We are looking for a Data Center Security Specialist II to serve as the primary physical security contact for an assigned data center site or campus. In this role, you will manage day-to-day security operations, oversee vendor performance, and ensure compliance with established security standards and policies. You will play a hands-on role in maintaining and improving security systems such as access controls, video surveillance, and intrusion detection — all while collaborating with operations teams and partner organizations to deliver a consistently secure environment. If you are a detail-oriented security professional who thrives on solving problems and driving operational improvements, we want to hear from you.

Our team is dedicated to safeguarding the data center infrastructure that our customers depend on around the clock. We work closely with operations, engineering, and partner teams to maintain the highest security standards while continuously looking for ways to improve. We value collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and a commitment to getting the details right. If you are looking for a role where your work has a direct and meaningful impact on the security of critical systems, this is the team for you.

- Manage vendor relationships by assessing compliance with established work orders, tracking service deliverables and SLAs, and escalating corrective actions as needed.

- Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: access-control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security

We are seeking a Manufacturing Operations and Industrial Engineering Program Manager to help us fuel AWS’ explosive growth. title: Senior Security Compliance Specialist, Devices & Services Security Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Devices & Services organization is expanding into new markets and facing a wave of new regulations, including the EU Cyber Resilience Act. We are looking for a Security Industry Specialist to help us stay ahead of these changes by building and scaling the compliance programs that earn customer trust for products like Kindle, Alexa, Echo, Fire Tablets, and Fire TV. In this role, you will work across security, engineering, legal, and business teams to assess control environments, design compliance frameworks grounded in standards like ISO 27001, and drive remediation strategies to completion. You will also help reshape how we work by contributing to an AI-first approach to compliance processes. If you thrive on solving complex compliance challenges across a global organization, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Key job responsibilities
Design and drive scalable Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) frameworks that address security assurance requirements for Amazon devices across multiple regulated markets, including new certifications and labels as the product portfolio expands.
Assess and mitigate security compliance risks by developing remediation strategies, tracking issues to resolution, and escalating blockers with actionable recommendations for leadership.
Collaborate with engineering, legal, and business teams to translate evolving regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act into control designs and compliance programs aligned with security audit frameworks like ISO 27001.
Represent Amazon in industry groups and with external regulators to understand and shape emerging compliance requirements before they impact the security and control environment.
Create repeatable process paths for security control design, testing, and validation that reduce duplicate effort and can be adopted by multiple teams across the organization.

You might start your morning reviewing updates to an upcoming regulation and mapping its requirements against existing device certifications. Later, you could lead a working session with engineering and security partners to close a control gap, then prepare a compliance briefing for leadership. You will regularly engage with external auditors and industry peers, turning what you learn into practical guidance for internal teams. Mentoring colleagues and refining shared processes round out a day focused on protecting customers and enabling business growth.

About the team
The Devices & Services Compliance Team supports Amazon's consumer devices products, including Kindle, Alexa, Echo, Fire Tablets, and Fire TV, by setting a high security bar, ensuring regulatory compliance, and obtaining industry certifications. The team is investing in an AI-first redesign of its compliance processes and expanding its coverage as Amazon enters new markets and navigates new regulatory demands. You will join a collaborative group that values creative problem-solving and works closely with security, engineering, legal, and business partners worldwide.
