title: Senior Site EHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure safety record keeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Deep Dive safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Deep Dive trends and propose action plans to Sr. Leadership on site.
- Audit record keeping practices and Global Safety Database entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the Safety Managers and Safety Associates in your assigned site.
- Engage the Injury Prevention Specialists (IPS) and Site Leadership to drive long-term strategic actions to achieve incident reduction.
- Perform targeted Kaizen events in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).
- Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.
- Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Review for effectiveness the deployed safety tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
- Partner with corporate and other regional field safety personnel to leverage global safety and environmental best practices into NA network standards.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in safety and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations, or relevant experience applicable to the role
- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
- Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends, as required to support direct reports and site needs

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree preferred
- Certified Safety Professional preferred
- Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic organization
- Interest in long-term career development through assignments in multiple business units across the nation
- Prior experience in a management development training program
- Track record of effectively managing a safety operation comprising both salaried and hourly staff

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about creating both the best buying AND selling experience on the internet? Would you enjoy being able to tell your friends your team shipped code that made buying on Amazon easier and safer in your first few weeks? As a Software Development Engineer on the Customer Trust and Partner Services team you will be actively working on systems and features that accomplish this for buyers and sellers on Amazon.com everyday.

Who you are: You’re a a technical leader with the prowess to deliver world-class software. You have great intuition - Amazon teams run like businesses giving you the ownership, allowing you as an engineer to be responsible for the technical solutions that deliver exceptional customer experience.

The Selling Partner Trust team is geared to protect Amazon customers (Buyers, Brand owners and Sellers) from bad actors, abuse and fraud. As a SDE at Amazon, you will drive the technical direction of the team, working with many different technologies. You will design and code, troubleshoot and support.

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to protect how Amazon's workforce signs in and accesses critical systems every day? Amazon Foundational Security Services is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build and operate the identity and authentication services that keep tens of thousands of employees secure and productive. You'll design and deliver distributed systems that handle real-time identity data sync, certificate issuance for corporate devices, and Kerberos authentication—solving problems where correctness and availability matter around the clock.

This role offers rare breadth across the identity space in one team. You'll work on workforce sign-in and AWS access, near real-time directory sync, a corporate certificate authority, and Kerberos authentication. You'll balance building new capabilities on AWS with modernizing long-running core infrastructure, all through a security-first lens. If you're ready to turn well-understood business problems into simple, secure, and maintainable code while learning from every incident and mentoring others, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, GDCO Central Intelligence and Analytics Team
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Technical Product/Program Manager to own a portfolio of these business-facing products and programs end to end: shaping what each one should do and for whom, driving its design and delivery with engineering, science and data technicians, and proving it changes business outcomes. This role is oriented toward business problems and the products/programs that solve them, not toward running shared platform infrastructure. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a system architecture or challenging a recommendations quality as presenting a roadmap to senior executives like VPs.

## The portfolio you'll own
- **Self-service analytics, to production.** Take our natural-language and SQL analytics product over the governed data lake from team tool to a production service leaders rely on: accuracy on governed metrics, onboarding new domains, reliability, access controls, and adoption.
- **Recommendation engine delivery and quality.** Deliver the AI-assisted recommendation engine from pilot to broad use, own its quality bar: what it recommends, with what confidence, when it should stay silent, and how we know it worked.
- **Business domain decision products.** Our operation runs on a few core business domains, each with its own leaders, metrics, data sources, and decisions. For each one, you'll own the product that moves a leader from "what's happening" to "what should I do about it": define the decisions it supports, the metrics and data it needs, and how we measure whether it improved the domain's outcome. Today that means: data products that cover repair backlog and aging, repair throughput and turnaround time, parts availability and other blockers, and repeat failures. The core decision is where to focus the effort so it returns the most capacity to customers fastest. Data products track deliveries from plan through install and hand-off, show what's on track, what's at risk, and why (parts, labor, facilities, network readiness), and route each blocker to the owner who can clear it. The core decision is which at-risk deliveries need intervention now. Success is more capacity delivered on its committed date.


Key job responsibilities
- **Own program strategy and roadmap** for each product/program in the portfolio, tied to a business outcome (repair turnaround, labor productivity, capacity on time), and phase scope deliberately from pilot to GA.
- **Define and enforce quality.** Set the bar for each products/programs, such as answer accuracy for self-service analytics or recommendation precision, confidence, and abstain behavior for the recommendation engine. Partner with engineering and science so no product presents correlation as causation or claims more confidence than it has earned.
- **Prove business impact.** Define how actions are captured, how impact is measured against matched baselines, and how outcomes feed back into the product. Success is not "recommendations accepted" or "queries run"; it's decisions that changed outcomes.
- **Run technical delivery with the engineering team.** Own the delivery cadence, sprint planning, and release management for your products/programs. Review design docs, understand the architecture well enough to weigh tradeoffs (build vs. reuse, latency vs. cost, coupling between services), and keep scope, sequencing, and dependencies honest.
- **Drive launch readiness** across security review, penetration testing, operational readiness (ORR), and privacy reviews for each product moving to production.
- **Lead cross-org dependencies** with Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Facilities, workforce planning, and peer data teams: write the asks, negotiate data contracts, and escalate when a partner dependency blocks the roadmap.
- **Write the narratives** (PR/FAQs, 6-pagers, pilot readouts) for Director and VP audiences, with honest accounting of what is proven vs. pending.

About the team
Our team is focused on building and delivering data solutions that drive meaningful outcomes for AWS and our customers. We operate in a collaborative environment where program managers work closely with engineers, scientists, and business leaders to tackle challenging problems at scale. We value clear thinking, thoughtful communication, and a willingness to take initiative in unstructured situations. If you are excited about shaping program strategy, influencing technical direction, and growing alongside a talented group of peers, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- - 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- - 3+ years of technical program management experience with a software application or software engineering team
- - Experience with software architecture and system design, including reviewing design documents and driving technical tradeoff decisions with engineers
- - Experience owning and driving roadmap strategy and definition
- - Experience shipping data, analytics, or decision-support products to business or senior-leadership customers
- - Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- - Experience managing software engineers, directly or as a technical lead
- - Software development experience
- - Owned a portfolio of several products at once, each tied to a different business outcome
- - Shipped ML/LLM-powered products to production, including evaluation design (golden sets, LLM-as-judge) and failure-mode analysis (hallucination, over-confidence)
- - Productionized a self-service analytics or natural-language query product, including accuracy measurement and access controls
- - Taken a product through security, privacy, and operational-readiness reviews
- - MBA or advanced technical degree

title: NW Deployment Build Lead , Infra - GND
descriptionHtml:
Job description
AWS is looking for a Network Deploy Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Leadership and Technical Project Managers.

You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Deploy Technician, you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
• Managing work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
• Collaborating with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
• Troubleshooting networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords
• Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment
• Participating in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware

Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

A day in the life
Our team has three primary tasks:
1. Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. And then partner with network engineers to ensure all configurations are ready. You'll also be working on link and device troubleshooting within a certain Service-Level Agreement
2. There is also console builds (and room builds) that are really exciting. You'll be exposed to more teams whose goal is to provide more space and capacity for customer racks.
3. Work with ID-Scaling peers to build higher-level networking devices.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

title: Security Engineer, Security for Employee and Legal Systems (SEALS)
descriptionHtml:
Protect the HR and Legal applications millions of Amazonians trust with their most sensitive data. You will join a team that is replacing traditional security reviews with continuous automated evaluation and learning to secure a new generation of GenAI and agentic applications.


Key job responsibilities
● Execute security assessments and code reviews for HR and Legal applications using your team's established processes and tooling, primarily in Java, Python, and JavaScript.
● Contribute to threat models for the applications in your domain, learning to identify the risks that matter most to customers with guidance from senior engineers.
● Help author and refine automated detection rules that catch risks at code commit and give builders clear remediation guidance.

In this role, you'll navigate ambiguity daily, reading program health against RPE's goals, making high-judgment calls on where to focus, and course-correcting as new information emerges. You'll orchestrate the operating rhythms and the operating plan, turning many owners' inputs into one coherent narrative and driving the decisions and follow-through that keep RPE on track. title: Multi-Site EHS Lead
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We're seeking a dedicated Multi-Site Workplace Heathy and Safety Lead to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to directly impact associate wellbeing while driving operational excellence.

As a Multi-Site WHS Lead you will provide WHS support to multiple sites within your region to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce or eliminate conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes. The Multi-Site WHS Lead partners with Operations leadership across sites, advises on regulatory compliance and risk mitigation, and serves as a subject matter expert, influencing change through comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Possess a thorough understanding of local and regional regulations and company policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS Policies across assigned sites.

- Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy, and audit the quality, delivery, and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Ability to travel up to 50-70% of the time.
- Must be flexible regarding shifts.

Additional Job Elements include:

- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience
- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon Safety (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations (specifically 29 CFR 1910) and applicable federal and state safety standards

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Data Center Structural Engineer to join its design team in Herndon, Virginia.

AWS designs, builds, and operates Data Centers (DC) around the world and is a leader in worldwide cloud-computing infrastructure. Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost effective DC facilities. Our team is responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers and drive to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness, while finding new ways to meet AWS’s growing demand.

As a DC Structural Engineer at AWS, you will be part of the design team for Amazon DCs in our Americas Region and impact other projects around the world. As a subject matter expert, you will have a direct impact on the design of prototypical DC facilities, provide technical guidance to team members, review milestone drawings by consultants, solve large scale implementation issues, and be responsible for structural design requirements.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Structural Engineering
- 3+ years experience in structural design for industrial or commercial projects
- 1+ with design of Data Center, Mission Critical, Hospital, Schools, Commercial or Residential Tower facilities
- Proficiency in building codes, regulations, and standard including IBC and ASCE

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
- Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and MS Office Suite
- Detailed understanding of tilt-up and precast concrete structures, structural steel systems, seismic design, wind loading, snow loading, and forensic analysis of building design and construction defects.
- Experience in value engineering for building structural systems

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


As a Capacity Planning Manager, you will drive programs to create and manage supply/capacity at our Data Centers in the APAC region. You will improve infrastructure utilization as well as availability. You will engage effectively with various stakeholders (Technical Program Managers, Engineers, Supply Chain teams, Business Development Managers, Product Managers) in planning programs and will collaborate with our partners to deliver these efficiently. You will help establish Amazon Web Services as the key cloud technology provider across the region and help our customers leverage our Data Center capacity for their success.

Do you look around corners to find ways of optimizing resources & speeding up deliverables? Do you enjoy dealing with ambiguity and finding solutions independently? Are you passionate about using technology to solve business problems that have big customer impact?
Come, build the future with us.

Location: Tokyo


Key job responsibilities
Technical Infrastructure Program Managers (TIPM) in Capacity Delivery Planning drive programs to identify, execute and manage supply/capacity at our Data Centers in the APAC region. The TIPM strives towards improving infrastructure utilization as well as availability. This role requires effective engagement with multiple AWS internal partners (Build TIPMs, Engineering teams, Supply Chain teams, Business Development Managers, etc) to co-deliver planning programs. Further, the TIPM engages with partners to drive the right outcomes to balance customer requirements with site risks. Lastly, TIPMs are required to effectively convey accurate information across all aspects of program communication with audiences therefore requires excellent written and verbal skills.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.z

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query), or experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
- Knowledge of SQL, Perl, Unix/Linux, Visual Basic or other programming languages
- 1+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

title: Recruiting Coordinator Manager, Recruiting Operations
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Talent Acquisition team is looking for a talented and customer-focused manager to lead our Recruiting Coordination (RC) team. RCs are the backbone of recruiting at Amazon, and work to provide world class service as they support candidates through the interview process. They are highly customer-focused, have excellent attention to detail, and multi-task like pros.

We expect the Recruiting Coordinator Manager to be a dynamic and passionate leader with proven analytical capabilities, ability to track and measure results, and the ability to forge strong partnerships with partner teams. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a passion for recruiting, a high level of flexibility, commitment, and the ability to tackle ambiguity.

This Recruiting Coordinator Manager will lead successful operations for managing a team of RCs supporting multiple business lanes, in both the technical and non-technical recruiting space. This includes forecasting demand and RC capacity, managing all core scheduling and coordinating activities and results, and partnering with various stakeholders to improve the end-to-end scheduling process. They will develop staff members so each team member is trained, supported, and able to thrive.

Key job responsibilities
The successful Recruiting Coordinator Manager must:
• Build and manage a high performing team
• Conduct performance evaluations and prepare developmental plans for staff in a timely manner
• Develop and implement volume and capacity forecasts
• Manage multiple tasks, emerging priorities, and meet deadlines
• Be able to handle multiple problems simultaneously, and prioritize effectively
• Have excellent problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills
• Continuously improve processes and procedures


A day in the life
Your day begins with a review of regional performance metrics across your three RCM teams spanning North America. You're looking at trends—not just today's numbers, but patterns over the past few weeks that tell you where to focus your attention. You notice scheduling decline rates creeping up in one vertical and make a note to investigate root causes. You start your morning with a leadership sync with your peer managers and your senior leader, discussing capacity planning for Q2 hiring surges and aligning on strategic priorities. You're advocating for a process improvement initiative based on insights you've gathered from your RCMs, and you come prepared with data that makes the business case clear.

Mid-morning, you're in a working session with recruiting leadership and a business partner team to address a systemic challenge with interview scheduling for a high-volume hiring initiative. You're representing the operations perspective, asking clarifying questions, and proposing solutions that balance candidate experience with operational feasibility. You commit to piloting an approach with one of your teams and measuring the impact.

You have back-to-back 1-on-1s with your three RCMs after lunch. With your first manager, you're coaching through a performance issue on their team—helping them think through documentation, feedback delivery, and performance improvement plans. With your second, you're discussing their career development and identifying stretch opportunities. With your third, you're problem-solving a complex stakeholder relationship and helping them navigate organizational dynamics.

The afternoon includes a deep dive session where you're analyzing scheduling data to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency gains. You're building a proposal for your senior leader that outlines how reallocating work could improve throughput by 20% without adding headcount. You're thinking several steps ahead about implementation, change management, and how to bring your RCMs along as partners in the change.

You join a cross-functional project meeting focused on improving the candidate scheduling experience. You're contributing the operations lens, sharing pain points your teams have surfaced, and collaborating with product and tech partners on solutions. You volunteer to pilot a new tool feature with one of your teams and provide feedback.

Before wrapping your day, you review and approve several decisions your RCMs have escalated—a scheduling exception for an executive hire, a capacity reallocation between teams, and a process deviation request. You're empowering your managers to make decisions while ensuring consistency and alignment with broader strategy. You end your day preparing for tomorrow's business review with your senior leader, where you'll present your team's performance, highlight wins, address challenges transparently, and propose your roadmap for the next 30 days.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with recruiting tools and systems, including resume databases, internet sourcing tools, and spreadsheets
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 6+ years of team leadership and development experience
- Experience presenting data to stakeholders to drive results and meet SLAs

Preferred qualifications

- Experience creating, measuring and scaling workflow among candidates, hiring managers and the recruiting team
- Experience managing senior staff or staffing managers
- Experience with workforce planning
- Experience partnering with hiring teams to build effective sourcing, assessment, and closing approaches with an ability to manage customer/partner expectations

title: Senior Regional EHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Regional Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with a regional operations team to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local, regional and federal regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for Amazon’s Associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial.

You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals within your designated region. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team and give frequent and appropriate feedback to your WHS teams while ensuring they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon WHS professional. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS Policies.
- Measure the regions and sites’ performance against published requirements in WHS policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure WHS recordkeeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business WHS initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations. Deliver quality projects on time to Operations.
- Analyze WHS metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Analyze Global Safety Peer Review results and develop and implement solutions to eliminate exposure to these risks and prevent injury at other FCs.
- Audit recordkeeping practices and Global WHS Database entries to ensure compliance to global WHS standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the FC WHS Manager and WHS Associates in your assigned FCs.
- Spend time at the fulfillment centers and seek input from WHS teams, Associates and leaders on WHS program improvement opportunities. Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
- Lead soft tissue injury reduction efforts by performing targeted Kaizens in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).
- Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy. Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required WHS training.
- Review for effectiveness the deployed WHS tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
- Partner with corporate and other regional field WHS personnel to leverage global WHS and environmental best practices into NA network standards.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of manufacturing equipment development experience
- Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Occupational Safety and Health, Construction Management, or related field of study
- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in safety and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, service operations, or relevant experience applicable to the role
- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment.
- Ability to travel up to 50%
- Office within one of the designated region's sites. Must be willing to relocate if not currently within region
- Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends, as required to support direct reports and site needs.

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree preferred
- Certified Safety Professional preferred
- 5+ years of direct responsibilities related to manufacturing
- Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic organization
- Interest in long-term career development through assignments in multiple business units across the nation
- Prior experience in a management development training program
- Track record of effectively managing a safety operation comprising both salaried and hourly staff
- Demonstrate experience in developing others into higher levels of responsibility in an organization
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with Directors and VPs.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

descriptionHtml:

Instead of buying, owning, and maintaining physical data centers and servers, companies can access technology services, such as computing power, storage, and databases, on an as-needed basis from AWS. AWS offers over 175 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, mobile, security, hybrid, and augmented reality, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 77 Availability Zones across 24 geographic regions. AWS services are trusted by millions of active customers around the world - including the fastest-growing start-ups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—to power their infrastructure, make them more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit https://aws.amazon.com.

The AWS Health, and Safety (H&S) team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer-facing enterprises and products. title: Risk Manager, NA Launch, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Environmental Assurance and Protection team works to make Amazon the global benchmark for environmental excellence across our operations. As the NA Launch Program Manager, you own the lifecycle of Amazon's most complex environmental launch and emergency response programs across North America and turn an ambiguous, fast-moving regulatory landscape into program frameworks the field can execute. That scope covers environmental permitting and regulatory readiness for new site launches, emergency and spill response planning, incident management and contingency programs, and emerging launch and response regulatory obligations across the region. You take partially defined business problems and regulatory requirements and build them into structured programs with clear objectives, milestones, and success criteria, owning each program through its pilot and scaled rollout.

As an individual contributor, you own the strategic definition and lifecycle management of these launch and emergency response programs. You break ambiguous challenges into program plans that account for real field constraints, define what "done" looks like, and design the systems, processes, and tools, with measurement built in, that the field organization adopts and sustains on its own. You partner with legal, regulatory affairs, operations, technology, design and construction, due diligence, and procurement to keep programs aligned with the operating model, and you contribute to internal operations planning while owning goals within the NA launch and emergency response program portfolio.

You identify and influence cross-functional investments that solve long-term launch readiness and emergency response requirements, negotiating resources, priorities, and timelines across organizations. You build business cases with quantified risk and return, present them to director and vice-president audiences, and represent EAP in cross-functional planning forums so that launch and emergency response requirements are built into business decisions. You own the program governance, business reviews, escalation paths, and metric dashboards that surface risk and drive accountability in real time, and you stand in for the senior manager independently in business reviews and cross-functional forums with full ownership.

This role requires independent judgment, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and the ability to find a path forward where solutions are not predefined, driving cross-functional alignment without pushing decisions upward. You communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to executive, operational, and legal audiences, and you use data and business intelligence to look around corners, spotting and mitigating risk before it surfaces. If you are motivated by solving complex regulatory problems at scale and building the compliance infrastructure to match, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate the compliance vision into functional programs. Integrate them into annual and multi-year planning and shape the budgets that fund them, weighing near-term compliance needs against long-term infrastructure investment.
- Work independently in an ambiguous, high-stakes regulatory environment, finding paths forward where no solution is predefined and driving alignment without pushing decisions upward.
- Own compliance programs end to end, taking problem definitions through pilot to full rollout, and build the resulting standards into daily operations so field teams sustain them on their own.
- Build the metrics and review system that holds the program accountable, covering KPIs, business reviews, escalation paths, and dashboards that give leaders real-time visibility into performance, milestones, and regulatory standing.
- Report program status, risks, and escalations clearly to director and vice-president audiences across operations, legal, finance, and technology, and stand in for the senior manager in business reviews and cross-functional forums.
- Oversee third-party contractors, consultants, and inspection vendors, holding them to program milestones and quality standards through structured audits.
- Travel up to 25 to 50% of the time.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- 5+ years of program or project Management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in environmental compliance and permitting, waste management, contractual, regulatory, and liability assessments, environmental permit evaluations and applications, EIAs and water discharge requirements
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Master's degree in environmental engineering, environmental science, environmental management, or a related field
- Professional credential where applicable, for example a Professional Engineer (PE), a Qualified Environmental Professional (QEP), a Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), a Certified Energy Manager (CEM), or an equivalent professional environmental certification
- Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 management system design, implementation, or certification

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
locations: City of Industry, CA, United States
SANTA FE SPRINGS, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory compliance problems in the field, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.
- Apply risk management methods such as waste compliance audits and site inspections to monitor compliance thresholds, test controls, and take corrective action when findings arise.
- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, including status reports, audit results, metrics, and project communications, so the right information reaches the right audience at the right time.
- Travel expected up to 50% of the time.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin by reviewing incoming risk-related requests and prioritizing your project tasks. You will spend time conducting audits or risk assessments, updating documentation, and coordinating with compliance operations and partner teams. Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- 2+ years of experience in environmental compliance, regulated waste management, or workplace risk investigations
- Experience interpreting and applying environmental regulations (RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules)
- Experience collecting and analyzing data to identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory compliance problems in the field, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.
- Apply risk management methods such as waste compliance audits and site inspections to monitor compliance thresholds, test controls, and take corrective action when findings arise.
- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, including status reports, audit results, metrics, and project communications, so the right information reaches the right audience at the right time.
- Travel expected up to 50% of the time.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin by reviewing incoming risk-related requests and prioritizing your project tasks. You will spend time conducting audits or risk assessments, updating documentation, and coordinating with compliance operations and partner teams. Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

title: Sustainability Program Manager, EU Ops Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
EU Operations Sustainability drives the decarbonization of Amazon's operational footprint across Europe, focusing on reducing environmental impact from transportation, buildings, and energy consumption. The team develops and executes strategies spanning First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile logistics — including energy efficiency, renewable energy, building material decarbonization and climate resiliency and adaptation, at fulfillment centers, sort centres and delivery stations. Working cross-functionally with EU Operations, WW Sustainability, engineering and procurement, the EU Ops Sustainability team translates Amazon's Climate Pledge commitments into actionable programs with measurable targets. The team navigates also the evolving European regulatory landscape to ensure compliance while identifying opportunities to accelerate decarbonization ahead of mandated timelines.

EU Ops Sustainability is looking for a Sustainability Program Manager to support energy efficiency programs across all miles. In this role, you will own strategic, tactical, and cross-functional projects and programs within the STEP organization to meet sustainability goals. You will be responsible for scoping and creating project plans, developing processes, coordinating and driving execution, and communicating progress to senior leadership. You will work day-to-day with cross-functional partners including RME, Finance, Real Estate, Design & Construction (D&C), and IT to deliver measurable energy and carbon reductions. You will also have the opportunity to work with selected start-ups through the Amazon Sustainability Accelerator (ASA) – Climate Tech programme, helping to evaluate, pilot, and scale innovative sustainability technologies across Amazon's European fulfillment network.

This role can be also based in other EU cities: Paris (CDG10), Barcelona (BCN10), Madrid (MAD12), Milan (LIN15), and Munich (MUC11).

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Logistics, Delivery and Shipping Sector
The position is classified at level 1 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
Manage full lifecycle complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across multiple organizations

Work closely with partner teams and stakeholders in and outside of your organization to source, allocate, and coordinate resources
Build and own financial models including business cases, Capital Appropriation Request (CAR) submissions, and discounted payback period (DPP) analysis to justify energy efficiency investments;

Own reporting on the state of initiatives, measuring improvements and impact of changes

Navigate the evolving European regulatory landscape — including EPBD (Energy Performance of Buildings Directive), Décret Tertiaire, and ISO 50001 to ensure compliance and identify opportunities to accelerate decarbonization ahead of mandated timelines

Work autonomously in an ambiguous environment, seeking to understand business problems, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions and reasons behind leadership decisions

Solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks)

Work with program managers, business leaders and executive team to communicate and impact critical business initiatives

Develop, implement, and govern Key Performance Metrics (KPI) reporting for a portfolio of programs, providing visibility to the milestones, and performance across all projects

Set-up mechanisms to audit and perform necessary course corrections where needed to meet business objectives


About the team
EU STEP brings together Supply Chain, Network Design, and Transportation Planning teams to improve end-to-end forecasting, network flow, planning, and execution. It also brings together our teams from across the business focused on our Operational Excellence pillars - Amazon Customer Excellence Systems (ACES), Learning, Quality, Service, Sustainability and Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) Field teams. This integration strengthens operations and execution while driving quality improvements and enhanced customer experience across the entire value chain.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Senior Program Manager, Flex Capacity, Amazon Flex
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where people can come to find and discover anything they might want to buy online. At Amazon Transportation, we are building a world-class last mile operation, significantly complimented by our brand new service, which works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With this new last mile delivery service (Amazon Flex), individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. It is powered by a mobile app that works in concert with our advanced logistics systems that allows delivery partners to on board, schedule delivery times, guide them through their deliveries with in-app mapping and navigation, and more. The approach and technology are nothing short of disruptive, and promise to challenge traditional approaches, and change the way the industry operates.

We are continuing to build a high paced and lean Japan team to implement and expand our last mile capabilities across key segments of Japan Transportation business. Amazon is now looking to hire an experienced, passionate, dynamic, analytical, innovative, hands-on, and (most importantly) customer-obsessed program manager.

We are seeking a Sr. Program Manager in Japan to help establish Amazon Transportation’s last mile delivery as the preferred provider in this specific space in order to build our network of Delivery Partners to drive product utilization and service optimization within the Amazon Transportation world. Internally, this leader will work directly with functions that cut across the organization, including technology, transportation, operations and customer service, to drive a great customer experience for our program. This position will be responsible for volume planning, both short-term and long-term, for Amazon Flex.

The successful candidate will be self-motivated, passionate, highly analytical and detail-oriented, possess superior interpersonal and communication skills, and be comfortable working independently to drive growth and change in a fast-paced environment. An extreme bias for action is an absolute must, and candidates must demonstrate a superior track record of delivering results.

title: Capacity Intelligence Analyst, Network Strategy & Performance
descriptionHtml:
As a Capacity Intelligence Analyst within the Network Strategy & Performance team, you will support and execute labor planning for Amazon's Customer Service network, including outsourced (Global Outsourcing) sites. You will work at the intersection of data and operations — translating demand signals into accurate staffing plans that protect customer experience while contributing to cost efficiency.

You will operate independently within your workstream, navigating ambiguity with analytical rigor and sound judgment. You will build effective working relationships with CS Operations, Global Outsourcing (GO) Vendor Management, CS Finance, Service Delivery, and Planning Intelligence teams. You will present your analysis and recommendations independently to senior stakeholders, contribute to planning decisions through well-reasoned, data-backed arguments, and actively participate in the team's AI-driven transformation agenda.

This role participates in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews and contributes directly to outsourcing and staffing decisions across the CS network.

Key job responsibilities
- Support the development, maintenance, and execution of labor capacity plans for internal and outsourced sites, covering short-term (4-week), operational (monthly/quarterly), and long-term (3-year) planning horizons. Build toward full ownership of assigned planning workstreams.
- Proactively identify and flag capacity risks by mapping dependencies across internal sites and Global Outsourcing vendor partners. Communicate risks and proposed mitigation plans to stakeholders with clarity and specificity. Coordinate with CS Operations and GO Vendor Management teams to ensure staffing plans are aligned with service level targets and outsourcing strategy.
- Support quarterly submissions to CS Finance, contributing to accurate Year-to-Go (YTG) labor cost projections and revisions versus OP targets.
- Independently apply AI tools (e.g., AgentZ, Kiro) to improve planning workflows without prompting, identifying opportunities to increase the speed, quality, and scale of your planning outputs. Develop side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your planning workstream, and contribute concrete use cases to the team's AI adoption agenda.
- Develop structured frameworks to address recurring planning problems within your scope, reducing rework and improving the consistency of planning outputs over time.
- Present analysis and planning recommendations to senior stakeholder audiences independently, adapting your communication style for technical and non-technical, operational and strategic stakeholders. Write clear, concise, and compelling narratives for QBRs, MBRs, and planning reviews. Documents must meet Amazon's standard formatting guidelines, with conclusions that tie to the organization's working-backwards framework.
- Communicate planning analysis in a way that is accessible to senior, non-expert audiences, anticipating likely objections to your recommendations and addressing them proactively.

Core Competencies
- AI Fluency: Independently applies AI tools to improve planning workflows without prompting. Develops side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your own workstream. Coaches at least one peer on AI tool usage. Contributes to the team's AI adoption agenda with concrete use cases demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
- Critical Thinking: Independently diagnoses complex planning problems. Challenges assumptions — including your own — with data. Develops structured frameworks to address recurring problems within your scope. Anticipates the most likely objections to a recommendation and addresses them proactively.
- Executive Presence: Presents analysis and recommendations to senior audiences independently. Adapts communication style for different stakeholders — technical and non-technical, operational and strategic. Handles pushback constructively without becoming defensive or capitulating without reason.
- Problem Solving: Navigates ambiguous problems with limited guidance. Develops multiple solution options with explicit trade-off analysis. Drives problems to resolution end-to-end — does not hand off and forget. Learns from misses and applies those learnings to the next problem.
- Boundaryless: Builds effective working relationships with key partner teams — Service Delivery, CS Finance, and GO Vendor Management. Proactively identifies and resolves cross-team dependencies before they become blockers. Represents Network Strategy & Performance in partner forums with credibility.


About the team
The Network Strategy & Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.

We analyze historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.

The Network Strategy & Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking an experienced Capacity Intelligence Analyst to join this team and contribute to how Amazon plans, staffs, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
- Experience building automation solutions using Python, R, or similar tools, or demonstrated experience with standard ERP or open-source planning tools.
- Experience presenting analytical recommendations to manager or director-level audiences.

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Project Lead to join our growing team within AWS Data Center Delivery. title: Technical Program Manager, Long Term Planning
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever ordered something on Amazon and wondered how it reached you so fast? The answer starts years earlier, with a plan. Long Term Planning decides which of our sites connect to which, how volume flows between them, and how much capacity we need — one to three years ahead of the customer placing the order.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to join that team in Madrid. You will own the mechanisms that turn dozens of separate inputs — demand forecasts, building plans, speed targets, cost targets, capacity constraints — into one coherent plan for Amazon's European network. It is a role for someone who is comfortable both in the data and in a room of senior stakeholders, and who would rather build a repeatable process than run the same manual exercise twice.

Key job responsibilities
Run the planning calendar for one or more planning cycles end to end: set the timeline, secure the inputs, chase the gaps, and keep 20+ partner teams aligned to it.
Own the input intake process. Define what "good" looks like for each input, build the validation checks, and hold partner teams to that standard.
Turn business questions into scenarios, run them through our planning tools, and explain what the numbers say and what we should do about it.
Build and automate the reporting layer — the views that let planners and leadership see plan versus prior plan, and understand what changed and why.
Write concise, data-backed status updates and review documents for senior leadership. Drive open decisions to closure and track them.
Find the parts of the planning process that are manual, slow or error-prone, and work with engineers, scientists and analysts to fix them at the root.


A day in the life
You start by checking whether this week's inputs have landed and passed validation. Mid-morning you are in a partner-team review, unblocking a missing assumption. The afternoon you spend in the data, quantifying what that assumption does to speed, cost and capacity, and writing up the answer for a decision meeting later in the week.

About the team
Long Term Planning designs Amazon's European transportation network one to three years out, optimising for delivery speed, cost to serve and customer experience. Our plans are the basis for building, capacity and investment decisions across the region, so we sit at the centre of a wide set of partners — Operations, Finance, Science, Product, Engineering and Retail. The team is a mix of program managers, business intelligence engineers, scientists and analysts, and we are deliberately transversal: we work on the problems that cross organisational boundaries, because those are the ones nobody else can own.

- Knowledge of software development and project management concepts
- Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in making data driven business decisions
- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in transportation and supply chain
- Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization, or experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Experience with AWS data warehouse and reporting technologies like Redshift, Athena, S3, etc.
- Experience presenting to senior leadership
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
